````typescript
import { sql } from './db.mjs';
import { decryptHostSecrets } from './crypto.mjs';
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl } from './host-url.mjs';
import type { AppAuthContext } from './auth.mjs';
import { deliverSlackAlerts } from './slack-delivery.mjs';
import { deliverAlertWebhooks } from './webhook-destinations.mjs';

type OrgRole = 'owner' | 'admin' | 'member' | 'viewer' | string;
type AlertSeverity = 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'critical';
type AlertStatus = 'open' | 'acknowledged' | 'resolved';
type AlertConditionType = 'host_offline' | 'container_exited' | 'container_restart_loop' | 'cpu_usage' | 'memory_usage';

interface AlertRuleRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  condition_type: AlertConditionType;
  resource_scope: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  threshold_value: number | string | null;
  threshold_window_minutes: number;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  notification_channels: string[] | null;
  enabled: boolean;
  created_by: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface DockerHostRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  host_url: string;
  connection_mode: string;
  docker_socket_path: string | null;
  status: string;
  last_seen_at: string | null;
  last_error: string | null;
}

interface ContainerRow {
  Id: string;
  Names?: string[];
  Image?: string;
  State?: string;
  Status?: string;
  _hostId: string;
  _hostName: string;
}

interface ContainerStatRow {
  containerId: string;
  hostId: string;
  cpu_percent: number;
  memory_usage: number;
  memory_limit: number;
}

interface DerivedAlertSignal {
  ruleId: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  sourceType: 'host' | 'container' | 'metric';
  sourceRef: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface AlertEventRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  rule_id: string | null;
  incident_id: string | null;
  fingerprint: string;
  source_type: 'host' | 'container' | 'metric' | 'system';
  source_ref: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  status: AlertStatus;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  first_seen_at: string;
  last_seen_at: string;
  acknowledged_at: string | null;
  acknowledged_by: string | null;
  resolved_at: string | null;
  resolved_by: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

const DEFAULT_RULE_DEFINITIONS: Array<{
  name: string;
  condition_type: AlertConditionType;
  threshold_value: number | null;
  threshold_window_minutes: number;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  notification_channels: string[];
}> = [
  { name: 'Host offline', condition_type: 'host_offline', threshold_value: null, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'critical', notification_channels: ['slack'] },
  { name: 'Container exited', condition_type: 'container_exited', threshold_value: null, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'warning', notification_channels: ['slack'] },
  { name: 'Restart loop detected', condition_type: 'container_restart_loop', threshold_value: 1, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'error', notification_channels: ['slack', 'email'] },
  { name: 'CPU usage threshold', condition_type: 'cpu_usage', threshold_value: 85, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'warning', notification_channels: ['email'] },
  { name: 'Memory usage threshold', condition_type: 'memory_usage', threshold_value: 90, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'warning', notification_channels: ['email'] },
];

function normalizeThresholdValue(value: number | string | null | undefined) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function normalizeChannels(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string');
}

function normalizeAlertRule(row: AlertRuleRow) {
  return {
    ...row,
    threshold_value: normalizeThresholdValue(row.threshold_value),
    notification_channels: normalizeChannels(row.notification_channels),
    resource_scope: row.resource_scope ?? { scope: 'organization' },
  };
}

function trimContainerName(container: Pick<ContainerRow, 'Names' | 'Id'>) {
  return container.Names?.[0]?.replace(/^\//, '') || container.Id.slice(0, 12);
}

function buildDockerRequest(
  host: Pick<DockerHostRow, 'host_url' | 'connection_mode' | 'docker_socket_path'>,
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
  dockerPath: string,
) {
  const base = host.host_url.replace(/\/$/, '');
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};

  if (secrets?.agent_api_key) headers['X-Agent-Key'] = secrets.agent_api_key;
  if (host.docker_socket_path && host.docker_socket_path !== '/var/run/docker.sock') headers['X-Docker-Socket'] = host.docker_socket_path;
  if (host.connection_mode === 'cloudflare_tunnel') {
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_id) headers['CF-Access-Client-Id'] = secrets.cf_service_token_id;
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_secret) headers['CF-Access-Client-Secret'] = secrets.cf_service_token_secret;
  }

  return { url: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, `/docker${dockerPath}`), headers };
}

async function dockerFetchJson<T>(
  host: Pick<DockerHostRow, 'host_url' | 'connection_mode' | 'docker_socket_path'>,
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
  dockerPath: string,
  timeoutMs = 5000,
): Promise<T | null> {
  try {
    const request = buildDockerRequest(host, secrets, dockerPath);
    const response = await fetch(request.url, { method: 'GET', headers: request.headers, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs) });
    if (!response.ok) return null;
    return (await response.json()) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function mapConcurrent<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  const results: R[] = [];
  let index = 0;
  const worker = async () => {
    while (index < items.length) {
      const current = index++;
      results[current] = await fn(items[current]);
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, worker));
  return results;
}

export async function getOrganizationRole(auth: AppAuthContext): Promise<OrgRole> {
  const memberships = await sql`
    SELECT role
    FROM organization_members
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND user_id = ${auth.userId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (memberships.length === 0) throw new Error('Access denied');
  return memberships[0].role;
}

export async function requireOrganizationAdmin(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);
  if (!['owner', 'admin'].includes(role)) throw new Error('Admin access required for active organization');
  return role;
}

export async function ensureDefaultAlertRules(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const existing = await sql`
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
  `;
  if (existing[0]?.count > 0) return;

  for (const rule of DEFAULT_RULE_DEFINITIONS) {
    await sql`
      INSERT INTO alert_rules (
        organization_id, name, condition_type, resource_scope, threshold_value,
        threshold_window_minutes, severity, notification_channels, enabled, created_by
      )
      VALUES (
        ${auth.orgId}, ${rule.name}, ${rule.condition_type}, ${{ scope: 'organization' }},
        ${rule.threshold_value}, ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}, ${rule.severity},
        ${JSON.stringify(rule.notification_channels)}, true, ${auth.userId}
      )
    `;
  }
}

export async function listAlertRules(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  await ensureDefaultAlertRules(auth);
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
  `;
  return (rows as AlertRuleRow[]).map(normalizeAlertRule);
}

async function listAccessibleHosts(auth: AppAuthContext): Promise<DockerHostRow[]> {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT h.*
    FROM docker_hosts h
    JOIN organization_members om ON h.organization_id = om.organization_id
    WHERE h.organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND om.user_id = ${auth.userId}
    ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
  `;
  return rows as DockerHostRow[];
}

async function loadHostSecrets(hostId: string) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT agent_api_key, cf_service_token_id, cf_service_token_secret
    FROM docker_host_secrets
    WHERE host_id = ${hostId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  return rows.length > 0 ? rows[0] : null;
}

async function fetchContainersForHosts(hosts: DockerHostRow[]): Promise<ContainerRow[]> {
  const collected: ContainerRow[] = [];
  await mapConcurrent(hosts, 4, async (host) => {
    const encryptedSecrets = await loadHostSecrets(host.id);
    const secrets = decryptHostSecrets(encryptedSecrets, host.id);
    const containers = await dockerFetchJson<any[]>(host, secrets, '/containers/json?all=true', 6000);
    if (!Array.isArray(containers)) return null;
    collected.push(...containers.map((container) => ({ ...container, _hostId: host.id, _hostName: host.name })));
    return null;
  });
  return collected;
}

async function fetchContainerStatsForHosts(hosts: DockerHostRow[]): Promise<ContainerStatRow[]> {
  const allStats: ContainerStatRow[] = [];
  await mapConcurrent(hosts.filter((host) => host.status === 'connected'), 3, async (host) => {
    const encryptedSecrets = await loadHostSecrets(host.id);
    const secrets = decryptHostSecrets(encryptedSecrets, host.id);
    const containers = await dockerFetchJson<any[]>(host, secrets, '/containers/json', 4000);
    if (!Array.isArray(containers)) return null;
    await mapConcurrent(containers.slice(0, 20), 4, async (container) => {
      const stats = await dockerFetchJson<any>(host, secrets, `/containers/${container.Id}/stats?stream=false`, 4000);
      if (!stats) return null;
      const cpuDelta = (stats.cpu_stats?.cpu_usage?.total_usage ?? 0) - (stats.precpu_stats?.cpu_usage?.total_usage ?? 0);
      const systemDelta = (stats.cpu_stats?.system_cpu_usage ?? 0) - (stats.precpu_stats?.system_cpu_usage ?? 0);
      const onlineCpus = stats.cpu_stats?.online_cpus || 1;
      const cpuPercent = systemDelta > 0 ? (cpuDelta / systemDelta) * onlineCpus * 100 : 0;
      allStats.push({
        containerId: container.Id,
        hostId: host.id,
        cpu_percent: Math.round(cpuPercent * 100) / 100,
        memory_usage: stats.memory_stats?.usage ?? 0,
        memory_limit: stats.memory_stats?.limit ?? 0,
      });
      return null;
    });
    return null;
  });
  return allStats;
}

function deriveAlertSignals(
  rules: ReturnType<typeof normalizeAlertRule>[],
  hosts: DockerHostRow[],
  containers: ContainerRow[],
  stats: ContainerStatRow[],
): DerivedAlertSignal[] {
  const signals: DerivedAlertSignal[] = [];
  const containersById = new Map(containers.map((container) => [container.Id, container]));

  for (const rule of rules) {
    if (!rule.enabled) continue;

    if (rule.condition_type === 'host_offline') {
      for (const host of hosts.filter((item) => ['stale', 'error', 'disconnected', 'unhealthy'].includes(item.status))) {
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${host.id}:${host.status}`,
          sourceType: 'host',
          sourceRef: host.id,
          title: host.status === 'stale' ? 'Host connection stale' : 'Host offline',
          message: host.last_error ? `${host.name} is ${host.status}. ${host.last_error}` : `${host.name} is ${host.status}. Check agent connectivity.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: host.id, host_name: host.name, host_status: host.status },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'container_exited') {
      for (const container of containers.filter((item) => item.State === 'exited')) {
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${container._hostId}:${container.Id}:exited`,
          sourceType: 'container',
          sourceRef: container.Id,
          title: 'Container exited',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is stopped and needs review.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), image: container.Image ?? null },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'container_restart_loop') {
      for (const container of containers.filter((item) => item.State === 'restarting')) {
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${container._hostId}:${container.Id}:restarting`,
          sourceType: 'container',
          sourceRef: container.Id,
          title: 'Restart loop detected',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is restarting repeatedly.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), image: container.Image ?? null },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'cpu_usage') {
      const threshold = normalizeThresholdValue(rule.threshold_value) ?? 85;
      for (const stat of stats.filter((item) => item.cpu_percent >= threshold)) {
        const container = containersById.get(stat.containerId);
        if (!container) continue;
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${stat.hostId}:${stat.containerId}:cpu`,
          sourceType: 'metric',
          sourceRef: stat.containerId,
          title: 'High CPU usage',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is at ${stat.cpu_percent.toFixed(1)}% CPU.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), metric: 'cpu_percent', metric_value: stat.cpu_percent, threshold },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'memory_usage') {
      const threshold = normalizeThresholdValue(rule.threshold_value) ?? 90;
      for (const stat of stats) {
        const memoryPercent = stat.memory_limit > 0 ? (stat.memory_usage / stat.memory_limit) * 100 : 0;
        if (memoryPercent < threshold) continue;
        const container = containersById.get(stat.containerId);
        if (!container) continue;
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${stat.hostId}:${stat.containerId}:memory`,
          sourceType: 'metric',
          sourceRef: stat.containerId,
          title: 'High memory usage',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is at ${memoryPercent.toFixed(1)}% memory.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), metric: 'memory_percent', metric_value: Number(memoryPercent.toFixed(2)), threshold },
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return signals;
}

function mapAlertHref(event: AlertEventRow) {
  const metadata = event.metadata ?? {};
  const hostId = typeof metadata.host_id === 'string' ? metadata.host_id : null;
  const containerShortId = typeof metadata.container_short_id === 'string' ? metadata.container_short_id : typeof metadata.container_id === 'string' ? metadata.container_id.slice(0, 12) : null;
  if ((event.source_type === 'container' || event.source_type === 'metric') && containerShortId && hostId) return `/app/containers/${containerShortId}?host=${hostId}`;
  if (hostId) return `/app/hosts/${hostId}`;
  return '/app/alerts';
}

export async function syncAlertEvents(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rules = await listAlertRules(auth);
  const hosts = await listAccessibleHosts(auth);
  const needsStats = rules.some((rule) => rule.enabled && ['cpu_usage', 'memory_usage'].includes(rule.condition_type));
  const containers = hosts.length > 0 ? await fetchContainersForHosts(hosts) : [];
  const stats = needsStats && hosts.length > 0 ? await fetchContainerStatsForHosts(hosts) : [];
  const derivedSignals = deriveAlertSignals(rules, hosts, containers, stats);

  const activeEvents = (await sql`
    SELECT id, fingerprint
    FROM alert_events
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND resolved_at IS NULL
  `) as Array<{ id: string; fingerprint: string }>;

  const activeByFingerprint = new Map(activeEvents.map((event) => [event.fingerprint, event]));

  for (const signal of derivedSignals) {
    const existing = activeByFingerprint.get(signal.fingerprint);

    if (existing) {
      await sql`
        UPDATE alert_events
        SET
          rule_id = ${signal.ruleId},
          title = ${signal.title},
          message = ${signal.message},
          severity = ${signal.severity},
          metadata = ${JSON.stringify(signal.metadata)},
          last_seen_at = now(),
          updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = ${existing.id}
      `;
      continue;
    }

    const insertedRows = await sql`
      INSERT INTO alert_events (
        organization_id, rule_id, fingerprint, source_type, source_ref,
        title, message, severity, status, metadata, first_seen_at, last_seen_at
      )
      VALUES (
        ${auth.orgId}, ${signal.ruleId}, ${signal.fingerprint}, ${signal.sourceType}, ${signal.sourceRef},
        ${signal.title}, ${signal.message}, ${signal.severity}, 'open', ${JSON.stringify(signal.metadata)}, now(), now()
      )
      RETURNING *
    `;
    await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, insertedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.opened');
    await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, insertedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.opened');
  }

  const activeFingerprints = new Set(derivedSignals.map((signal) => signal.fingerprint));
  const staleEvents = activeEvents.filter((event) => !activeFingerprints.has(event.fingerprint));

  for (const event of staleEvents) {
    const resolvedRows = await sql`
      UPDATE alert_events
      SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = COALESCE(resolved_at, now()), updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = ${event.id}
      RETURNING *
    `;
    if (resolvedRows[0]) {
      await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, resolvedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.resolved');
      await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, resolvedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.resolved');
    }
  }
}

export async function listAlertEvents(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  filters: { severity?: string | null; status?: string | null } = {},
) {
  await syncAlertEvents(auth);

  const rows = (await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM alert_events
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY
      CASE severity
        WHEN 'critical' THEN 0
        WHEN 'error' THEN 1
        WHEN 'warning' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
      END,
      last_seen_at DESC
  `) as AlertEventRow[];

  return rows
    .filter((row) => (filters.severity ? row.severity === filters.severity : true))
    .filter((row) => (filters.status ? row.status === filters.status : row.resolved_at === null))
    .map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      href: mapAlertHref(row),
    }));
}

export async function listIncidents(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  return sql`
    SELECT i.*, e.title AS source_alert_title
    FROM incidents i
    LEFT JOIN alert_events e ON e.id = i.source_alert_event_id
    WHERE i.organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY i.opened_at DESC
    LIMIT 12
  `;
}

export async function listAlertHistory(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rows = (await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM alert_events
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 12
  `) as AlertEventRow[];

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    href: mapAlertHref(row),
  }));
}

export async function buildAlertsWorkspaceSummary(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const [rules, activeAlerts, incidents] = await Promise.all([
    listAlertRules(auth),
    listAlertEvents(auth),
    listIncidents(auth),
  ]);

  const activeOnly = activeAlerts.filter((alert) => alert.resolved_at === null);

  return {
    total_alerts: activeOnly.length,
    critical_alerts: activeOnly.filter((alert) => alert.severity === 'critical').length,
    enabled_rules: rules.filter((rule) => rule.enabled).length,
    open_incidents: incidents.filter((incident: any) => incident.status !== 'resolved').length,
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { sql } from './db.mjs';
import { clerkClient, getClerkConfig } from './clerk.mjs';
import { assertTenantAccessAllowed } from './access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureAdminSchema } from './ensure-admin-schema.mjs';
import { isPlatformAdminEmail } from './platform-admin.mjs';

export interface AppAuthContext {
  userId: string; // The internal UUID
  orgId: string | null;  // The internal UUID, nullable if requireOrg is false
  clerkUserId: string;
  clerkOrgId: string | null;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
  email: string;
}

interface AuthOptions {
  requireOrg?: boolean;
}

type AppAuthErrorCode = 'SYNC_PENDING';

interface AppAuthError extends Error {
  code?: AppAuthErrorCode;
}

const DEFAULT_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES = [
  'https://app.dockerdash.app',
  'https://dockerdash.app',
  'https://www.dockerdash.app',
  'http://localhost:5173',
  'http://localhost:8080',
  'http://localhost:8081',
  'http://localhost:8888',
];

function makeAppAuthError(message: string, code?: AppAuthErrorCode): AppAuthError {
  const err: AppAuthError = new Error(message);
  if (code) err.code = code;
  return err;
}

function normalizeAuthorizedParty(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;

  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  try {
    return new URL(trimmed).origin;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function getAuthorizedParties(req: Request) {
  const parties = new Set<string>();

  for (const value of DEFAULT_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES) {
    const normalized = normalizeAuthorizedParty(value);
    if (normalized) parties.add(normalized);
  }

  for (const value of (process.env.CLERK_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES || '').split(',')) {
    const normalized = normalizeAuthorizedParty(value);
    if (normalized) parties.add(normalized);
  }

  const requestOrigin = normalizeAuthorizedParty(req.headers.get('origin'));
  if (requestOrigin) {
    parties.add(requestOrigin);
  }

  try {
    parties.add(new URL(req.url).origin);
  } catch {
    // Netlify provides an absolute URL in production, but keep auth resilient in local tests.
  }

  const forwardedProto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto');
  const forwardedHost = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host');
  if (forwardedProto && forwardedHost) {
    const forwardedOrigin = normalizeAuthorizedParty(`${forwardedProto}://${forwardedHost}`);
    if (forwardedOrigin) {
      parties.add(forwardedOrigin);
    }
  }

  return Array.from(parties);
}

export async function requireAuth(
  req: Request,
  options: AuthOptions = { requireOrg: true }
): Promise<AppAuthContext> {
  const requireOrg = options.requireOrg ?? true;

  // Test bypass has been removed from production code.
  // For testing, use mock implementations in test files only.
  // See: /workspace/netlify/functions/lib/auth.test.mts for test mocks

  const requestState = await clerkClient.authenticateRequest(req, {
    ...getClerkConfig(),
    authorizedParties: getAuthorizedParties(req),
  });

  if (!requestState.isSignedIn) {
    const reason = requestState.reason || 'unknown';
    const message = requestState.message || 'none';
    const hasAuthHeader = req.headers.get('authorization') ? 'yes' : 'no';
    console.error(`[requireAuth] 401 | reason=${reason} | message=${message} | has-auth-header=${hasAuthHeader}`);

    const reasonLower = reason.toLowerCase();
    const messageLower = message.toLowerCase();
    if (reasonLower === 'session-token-outdated' || messageLower.includes('sync')) {
      throw makeAppAuthError('Sync pending. Your account is currently syncing.', 'SYNC_PENDING');
    }

    throw new Error(`Unauthorized. Reason: ${reason}, Message: ${message}`);
  }

  const authData = requestState.toAuth();
  if (!authData.userId) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: No user found');
  }
  
  // The frontend <OrganizationSwitcher/> injects the org_id into the session token automatically
  if (requireOrg && !authData.orgId) {
    throw new Error('No active organization selected. Please select an organization.');
  }

  const clerkUserId = authData.userId;
  const clerkOrgId = authData.orgId || null;

  await ensureAdminSchema();
  const userResult = await sql`SELECT id, email, is_approved FROM public.users WHERE clerk_user_id = ${clerkUserId}`;
  if (userResult.length === 0) {
    throw makeAppAuthError('Sync pending. Your account is currently syncing.', 'SYNC_PENDING');
  }

  const isPlatformAdmin = isPlatformAdminEmail(userResult[0].email);

  let orgId = null;
  if (clerkOrgId) {
    const orgResult = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.organizations WHERE clerk_org_id = ${clerkOrgId}`;
    if (orgResult.length === 0 && requireOrg) {
      throw new Error('Sync pending. Your organization is currently syncing.');
    }
    if (orgResult.length > 0) {
      orgId = orgResult[0].id;
    }
  }

  await assertTenantAccessAllowed({
    userId: userResult[0].id,
    organizationId: orgId,
    isPlatformAdmin,
    isApproved: Boolean(userResult[0].is_approved),
  });

  return {
    userId: userResult[0].id,
    orgId,
    clerkUserId,
    clerkOrgId,
    isPlatformAdmin,
    email: userResult[0].email,
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { createClerkClient } from "@clerk/backend";

export function getClerkConfig() {
  const config: {
    secretKey?: string;
    publishableKey?: string;
    jwtKey?: string;
  } = {
    secretKey: process.env.CLERK_SECRET_KEY,
    publishableKey: process.env.CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || process.env.VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY,
  };

  // Prefer server-side secret verification when a secret key is available.
  // A stale injected CLERK_JWT_KEY can otherwise force invalid local token checks.
  if (!config.secretKey && process.env.CLERK_JWT_KEY) {
    config.jwtKey = process.env.CLERK_JWT_KEY;
  }

  return config;
}

export const clerkClient = createClerkClient(getClerkConfig());
````

````typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';

const ALGO = 'aes-256-gcm';
const IV_LENGTH = 12;
const AUTH_TAG_LENGTH = 16;
const LEGACY_PREFIX = 'v1:';
const KEYED_PREFIX = 'v2:';
const LEGACY_KEY_ID = 'V1';

type HostSecretField = 'agent_api_key' | 'cf_service_token_id' | 'cf_service_token_secret';

export interface EncryptedHostSecretsRecord {
  agent_api_key?: string | null;
  cf_service_token_id?: string | null;
  cf_service_token_secret?: string | null;
}

export interface DecryptedHostSecrets {
  agent_api_key: string | null;
  cf_service_token_id: string | null;
  cf_service_token_secret: string | null;
}

export class SecretCryptoError extends Error {
  code: string;

  constructor(code: string, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'SecretCryptoError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

function decodeKeyMaterial(keyString: string, envName: string): Buffer {
  let keyBuf: Buffer;
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(keyString) && Buffer.from(keyString, 'base64').length === 32) {
    keyBuf = Buffer.from(keyString, 'base64');
  } else if (/^[A-Fa-f0-9]+$/.test(keyString) && Buffer.from(keyString, 'hex').length === 32) {
    keyBuf = Buffer.from(keyString, 'hex');
  } else {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'INVALID_KEY_FORMAT',
      `${envName} must be a valid base64 or hex string encoding exactly 32 bytes.`,
    );
  }

  if (keyBuf.length !== 32) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'INVALID_KEY_LENGTH',
      `${envName} decoded to ${keyBuf.length} bytes. Expected exactly 32 bytes for AES-256.`,
    );
  }

  return keyBuf;
}

function loadKeyring() {
  const keys = new Map<string, Buffer>();

  for (const [envName, envValue] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
    if (!envName.startsWith('APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_') || !envValue) continue;
    const keyId = envName.substring('APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_'.length);
    if (!keyId) continue;
    keys.set(keyId, decodeKeyMaterial(envValue, envName));
  }

  const legacyValue = process.env.APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1;
  if (legacyValue && !keys.has(LEGACY_KEY_ID)) {
    keys.set(LEGACY_KEY_ID, decodeKeyMaterial(legacyValue, 'APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1'));
  }

  const activeKeyId = process.env.APP_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID || (legacyValue ? LEGACY_KEY_ID : null);
  if (!activeKeyId) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'MISSING_ACTIVE_KEY_ID',
      'APP_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID is required when using keyed encryption. Legacy fallback only works when APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1 is set.',
    );
  }

  const activeKey = keys.get(activeKeyId);
  if (!activeKey) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'MISSING_ACTIVE_KEY',
      `Active encryption key ${activeKeyId} is not configured. Expected APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_${activeKeyId}.`,
    );
  }

  return { activeKeyId, keys };
}

const KEYRING = loadKeyring();

function buildAad(prefix: string, hostId: string, fieldName: string, keyId?: string) {
  const suffix = keyId ? `:${keyId}` : '';
  return Buffer.from(`${prefix}${hostId}:${fieldName}${suffix}`, 'utf8');
}

function encodeKeyedCiphertext(keyId: string, iv: Buffer, authTag: Buffer, encrypted: string) {
  return `${KEYED_PREFIX}${keyId}:${iv.toString('base64')}:${authTag.toString('base64')}:${encrypted}`;
}

function parseLegacyCiphertext(encryptedString: string) {
  const parts = encryptedString.substring(LEGACY_PREFIX.length).split(':');
  if (parts.length !== 3) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_SECRET_FORMAT', 'Invalid legacy encrypted secret format.');
  }
  return parts as [string, string, string];
}

function parseKeyedCiphertext(encryptedString: string) {
  const parts = encryptedString.substring(KEYED_PREFIX.length).split(':');
  if (parts.length !== 4) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_SECRET_FORMAT', 'Invalid keyed encrypted secret format.');
  }
  return parts as [string, string, string, string];
}

function parseIv(ivB64: string) {
  const iv = Buffer.from(ivB64, 'base64');
  if (iv.length !== IV_LENGTH) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_IV', `Invalid IV length. Expected ${IV_LENGTH} bytes.`);
  }
  return iv;
}

function parseAuthTag(authTagB64: string) {
  const authTag = Buffer.from(authTagB64, 'base64');
  if (authTag.length !== AUTH_TAG_LENGTH) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_AUTH_TAG', `Invalid Auth Tag length. Expected ${AUTH_TAG_LENGTH} bytes.`);
  }
  return authTag;
}

function decryptWithKey(
  key: Buffer,
  prefix: string,
  hostId: string,
  fieldName: string,
  iv: Buffer,
  authTag: Buffer,
  ciphertextB64: string,
  keyId?: string,
) {
  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(ALGO, key, iv);
  decipher.setAAD(buildAad(prefix, hostId, fieldName, keyId));
  decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);

  try {
    let decrypted = decipher.update(ciphertextB64, 'base64', 'utf8');
    decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
    return decrypted;
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'AUTH_MISMATCH',
      `Failed to decrypt secret for host ${hostId} field ${fieldName}. Internal error: ${err.message}`,
    );
  }
}

export function getActiveEncryptionKeyId(): string {
  return KEYRING.activeKeyId;
}

export function encryptSecret(plaintext: string, hostId: string, fieldName: string): string {
  if (!plaintext) return plaintext;

  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(IV_LENGTH);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(ALGO, KEYRING.keys.get(KEYRING.activeKeyId)!, iv);
  cipher.setAAD(buildAad(KEYED_PREFIX, hostId, fieldName, KEYRING.activeKeyId));

  let encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8', 'base64');
  encrypted += cipher.final('base64');
  const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();

  return encodeKeyedCiphertext(KEYRING.activeKeyId, iv, authTag, encrypted);
}

export function decryptSecret(
  encryptedString: string | null | undefined,
  hostId: string,
  fieldName: string,
): string | null {
  if (!encryptedString) return null;

  if (!encryptedString.startsWith(LEGACY_PREFIX) && !encryptedString.startsWith(KEYED_PREFIX)) {
    return encryptedString;
  }

  if (encryptedString.startsWith(LEGACY_PREFIX)) {
    const legacyKey = KEYRING.keys.get(LEGACY_KEY_ID);
    if (!legacyKey) {
      throw new SecretCryptoError(
        'MISSING_LEGACY_KEY',
        'APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1 is required to decrypt legacy host secrets.',
      );
    }
    const [ivB64, authTagB64, ciphertextB64] = parseLegacyCiphertext(encryptedString);
    return decryptWithKey(
      legacyKey,
      LEGACY_PREFIX,
      hostId,
      fieldName,
      parseIv(ivB64),
      parseAuthTag(authTagB64),
      ciphertextB64,
    );
  }

  const [keyId, ivB64, authTagB64, ciphertextB64] = parseKeyedCiphertext(encryptedString);
  const key = KEYRING.keys.get(keyId);
  if (!key) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'UNKNOWN_KEY_ID',
      `Encrypted secret references key ${keyId}, but APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_${keyId} is not configured.`,
    );
  }

  return decryptWithKey(
    key,
    KEYED_PREFIX,
    hostId,
    fieldName,
    parseIv(ivB64),
    parseAuthTag(authTagB64),
    ciphertextB64,
    keyId,
  );
}

export function decryptHostSecrets(
  record: EncryptedHostSecretsRecord | null | undefined,
  hostId: string,
): DecryptedHostSecrets | null {
  if (!record) return null;

  return {
    agent_api_key: decryptSecret(record.agent_api_key, hostId, 'agent_api_key'),
    cf_service_token_id: decryptSecret(record.cf_service_token_id, hostId, 'cf_service_token_id'),
    cf_service_token_secret: decryptSecret(record.cf_service_token_secret, hostId, 'cf_service_token_secret'),
  };
}

export function isSecretUsingActiveKey(encryptedString: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!encryptedString) return true;
  if (!encryptedString.startsWith(KEYED_PREFIX)) return false;

  const [keyId] = parseKeyedCiphertext(encryptedString);
  return keyId === KEYRING.activeKeyId;
}

export function reencryptSecret(
  encryptedString: string | null | undefined,
  hostId: string,
  fieldName: HostSecretField,
): string | null {
  if (!encryptedString) return null;
  const plaintext = decryptSecret(encryptedString, hostId, fieldName);
  if (!plaintext) return null;
  return encryptSecret(plaintext, hostId, fieldName);
}
````

````typescript
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema } from "./ensure-dedicated-deployment-schema.mjs";
import type { AppAuthContext } from "./auth.mjs";

export type DedicatedDeploymentStatus =
  | "intake_received"
  | "capacity_reserved"
  | "provisioning"
  | "hardening"
  | "ready_for_handoff"
  | "active";

function buildReferenceId() {
  const now = new Date();
  const yyyy = now.getUTCFullYear();
  const mm = String(now.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const dd = String(now.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const suffix = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6).toUpperCase();
  return `DD-DED-${yyyy}${mm}${dd}-${suffix}`;
}

export function buildDeploymentChecklist(payload: Record<string, unknown>, status: DedicatedDeploymentStatus) {
  const requiresSSO = Boolean(payload.requiresSSO);
  const integrations = Array.isArray(payload.integrations) ? payload.integrations.map(String) : [];

  return [
    {
      id: "brief",
      label: "Deployment brief accepted",
      completed: true,
    },
    {
      id: "contacts",
      label: "Technical owner and escalation contacts captured",
      completed: Boolean(payload.technicalOwnerName) && Boolean(payload.technicalOwnerEmail),
    },
    {
      id: "identity",
      label: requiresSSO ? "SSO requirements queued for handoff" : "Identity model confirmed",
      completed: status !== "intake_received",
    },
    {
      id: "integrations",
      label: integrations.length > 0 ? "Integration requirements staged" : "Initial integration scope confirmed",
      completed: status === "hardening" || status === "ready_for_handoff" || status === "active",
    },
    {
      id: "handoff",
      label: "Handoff workspace prepared",
      completed: status === "ready_for_handoff" || status === "active",
    },
  ];
}

export async function listUserOrganizations(userId: string) {
  await ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema();
  return sql<{ organization_id: string }[]>`
    SELECT organization_id
    FROM public.organization_members
    WHERE user_id = ${userId}
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
  `;
}

export async function getCurrentDedicatedDeployment(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  await ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema();

  let organizationId = auth.orgId;
  if (!organizationId) {
    const orgs = await listUserOrganizations(auth.userId);
    organizationId = orgs[0]?.organization_id ?? null;
  }

  if (!organizationId) {
    return null;
  }

  const rows = await sql<any[]>`
    SELECT
      organization_id,
      reference_id,
      plan_id,
      status,
      target_window_label,
      latest_update_note,
      intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    FROM public.dedicated_deployments
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const row = rows[0];
  return {
    organization_id: String(row.organization_id),
    reference_id: String(row.reference_id),
    plan_id: "enterprise" as const,
    status: String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus,
    target_window_label: String(row.target_window_label),
    latest_update_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
    latest_update_note: String(row.latest_update_note),
    technical_owner_name: String(row.technical_owner_name || ""),
    technical_owner_email: String(row.technical_owner_email || ""),
    intake_payload: (row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
    checklist: buildDeploymentChecklist((row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>, String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus),
    created_at: new Date(String(row.created_at)).toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function createOrUpdateDedicatedDeployment(auth: AppAuthContext, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  await ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema();

  if (!auth.orgId) {
    throw new Error("Select an active organization before starting a dedicated deployment.");
  }

  const referenceId = buildReferenceId();
  const technicalOwnerName = typeof payload.technicalOwnerName === "string" ? payload.technicalOwnerName.trim() : "";
  const technicalOwnerEmail = typeof payload.technicalOwnerEmail === "string" ? payload.technicalOwnerEmail.trim() : "";

  const [row] = await sql<any[]>`
    INSERT INTO public.dedicated_deployments (
      organization_id,
      reference_id,
      plan_id,
      status,
      target_window_label,
      latest_update_note,
      intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email,
      created_by
    ) VALUES (
      ${auth.orgId},
      ${referenceId},
      'enterprise',
      'intake_received',
      '3-5 business days',
      'Deployment brief accepted. Capacity review starts next.',
      ${JSON.stringify(payload)}::jsonb,
      ${technicalOwnerName},
      ${technicalOwnerEmail},
      ${auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      plan_id = 'enterprise',
      status = CASE
        WHEN public.dedicated_deployments.status = 'active' THEN public.dedicated_deployments.status
        ELSE 'intake_received'
      END,
      target_window_label = '3-5 business days',
      latest_update_note = 'Deployment brief accepted. Capacity review starts next.',
      intake_payload = EXCLUDED.intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name = EXCLUDED.technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email = EXCLUDED.technical_owner_email
    RETURNING
      organization_id,
      reference_id,
      plan_id,
      status,
      target_window_label,
      latest_update_note,
      intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email,
      created_at,
      updated_at
  `;

  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.dedicated_deployment_updates (
      organization_id,
      status,
      note,
      created_by
    ) VALUES (
      ${auth.orgId},
      ${row.status},
      'Deployment brief accepted. Capacity review starts next.',
      ${auth.userId}
    )
  `;

  return {
    organization_id: String(row.organization_id),
    reference_id: String(row.reference_id),
    plan_id: "enterprise" as const,
    status: String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus,
    target_window_label: String(row.target_window_label),
    latest_update_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
    latest_update_note: String(row.latest_update_note),
    technical_owner_name: String(row.technical_owner_name || ""),
    technical_owner_email: String(row.technical_owner_email || ""),
    intake_payload: (row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
    checklist: buildDeploymentChecklist((row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>, String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus),
    created_at: new Date(String(row.created_at)).toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
  };
}
````

````typescript
export function extractDnr8Token(text: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!text) return null;
  const upper = text.toUpperCase();
  const match = upper.match(/DNR-[A-Z0-9]{8}/);
  if (!match) return null;
  return /^DNR-[A-Z0-9]{8}$/.test(match[0]) ? match[0] : null;
}

export function parseFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }
  return null;
}

export function coerceString(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return null;
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return trimmed ? trimmed : null;
}
````

````typescript
import { coerceString, extractDnr8Token, parseFiniteNumber } from "./donor-billing-helpers.mjs";

describe("donor billing helpers", () => {
  it("extracts DNR-8 token from arbitrary text", () => {
    expect(extractDnr8Token("paid token dnr-ab12cd34 thanks")).toBe("DNR-AB12CD34");
    expect(extractDnr8Token("missing token")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("parses numeric values safely", () => {
    expect(parseFiniteNumber("29.5")).toBe(29.5);
    expect(parseFiniteNumber(10)).toBe(10);
    expect(parseFiniteNumber("abc")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("coerces non-empty strings only", () => {
    expect(coerceString(" hello ")).toBe("hello");
    expect(coerceString("   ")).toBeNull();
    expect(coerceString(3)).toBeNull();
  });
});
````

````typescript
function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  try {
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
      year: "numeric",
      month: "long",
      day: "numeric",
    });
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}
````

## File: netlify/functions/lib/email.mts
````typescript
export interface EmailPayload {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  text: string;
  html?: string;
  replyTo?: string;
}

export interface EmailResult {
  success: boolean;
  provider: string;
  messageId: string | null;
  error: string | null;
}

function provider() {
  return (process.env.EMAIL_PROVIDER || "resend").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function fromAddress() {
  return (process.env.EMAIL_FROM || "Dockerdash <no-reply@dockerdash.app>").trim();
}

function replyToAddress(override?: string) {
  return (override || process.env.EMAIL_REPLY_TO || "").trim() || undefined;
}

async function sendWithResend(payload: EmailPayload): Promise<EmailResult> {
  const apiKey = (process.env.RESEND_API_KEY || "").trim();
  if (!apiKey) {
    return {
      success: false,
      provider: "resend",
      messageId: null,
      error: "RESEND_API_KEY is not configured",
    };
  }

  const response = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from: fromAddress(),
      to: [payload.to],
      subject: payload.subject,
      text: payload.text,
      html: payload.html,
      reply_to: replyToAddress(payload.replyTo),
    }),
  });

  const raw = await response.text();
  let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    body = { raw };
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    return {
      success: false,
      provider: "resend",
      messageId: null,
      error: typeof body.message === "string" ? body.message : `Resend request failed (${response.status})`,
    };
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    provider: "resend",
    messageId: typeof body.id === "string" ? body.id : null,
    error: null,
  };
}

export async function sendEmail(payload: EmailPayload): Promise<EmailResult> {
  const mode = provider();

  if (mode === "resend") {
    return sendWithResend(payload);
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    provider: mode,
    messageId: null,
    error: `Unsupported EMAIL_PROVIDER: ${mode}`,
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { sql } from './db.mjs';

let schemaEnsured = false;

/**
 * Runtime-safe schema backfill for onboarding status.
 *
 * Why this exists:
 * - Local/dev DBs can be behind schema.sql.
 * - Onboarding relies on organizations.onboarding_status.
 * - We guarantee column existence before read/write paths execute.
 */
export async function ensureOnboardingSchema() {
  if (schemaEnsured) return;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_status text
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ALTER COLUMN onboarding_status SET DEFAULT 'not_started'
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_skipped_at timestamptz
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_completed_at timestamptz
  `;

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET onboarding_status = 'not_started'
    WHERE onboarding_status IS NULL
  `;

  const dockerHostsTable = await sql`
    SELECT to_regclass('public.docker_hosts') AS table_name
  `;

  if (dockerHostsTable[0]?.table_name) {
    await sql`
      UPDATE public.organizations o
      SET
        onboarding_status = 'completed',
        onboarding_completed_at = COALESCE(o.onboarding_completed_at, now())
      WHERE o.onboarding_status = 'not_started'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.docker_hosts h
        WHERE h.organization_id = o.id
      )
    `;
  }

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET onboarding_skipped_at = COALESCE(onboarding_skipped_at, updated_at)
    WHERE onboarding_status = 'skipped' AND onboarding_skipped_at IS NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET onboarding_completed_at = COALESCE(onboarding_completed_at, updated_at)
    WHERE onboarding_status = 'completed' AND onboarding_completed_at IS NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ALTER COLUMN onboarding_status SET NOT NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS organizations_onboarding_status_check
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD CONSTRAINT organizations_onboarding_status_check
    CHECK (onboarding_status IN ('not_started', 'skipped', 'completed'))
  `;

  schemaEnsured = true;
}
````

## File: netlify/functions/lib/host-health.mjs
````javascript
export const DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES = 5;
export const DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD = 3;

export function parseStaleThresholdMinutes(rawValue) {
  const n = Number(rawValue);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES;
  return Math.floor(n);
}

export function staleCutoffDate(now = new Date(), staleThresholdMinutes = DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES) {
  return new Date(now.getTime() - staleThresholdMinutes * 60_000);
}

export function shouldMarkHostStale(host, now = new Date(), staleThresholdMinutes = DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES) {
  if (!host) return false;
  if (host.status !== 'connected') return false;
  if (!host.last_seen_at) return false;

  const seenAt = new Date(host.last_seen_at);
  if (Number.isNaN(seenAt.getTime())) return false;

  return seenAt < staleCutoffDate(now, staleThresholdMinutes);
}

export function failureStatusForCount(failureCount, unhealthyThreshold = DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD) {
  return failureCount >= unhealthyThreshold ? 'unhealthy' : 'error';
}
````

## File: netlify/functions/lib/host-url.mts
````typescript
import { isIP } from "node:net";

const LOCAL_HOSTS = new Set(["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"]);

function isTrue(value: string | undefined) {
  return value?.trim().toLowerCase() === "true";
}

function isLocalHostname(hostname: string) {
  const normalized = hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  return LOCAL_HOSTS.has(normalized);
}

function isPrivateIpv4(hostname: string) {
  const parts = hostname.split(".").map((segment) => Number(segment));
  if (parts.length !== 4 || parts.some((segment) => !Number.isInteger(segment) || segment < 0 || segment > 255)) {
    return false;
  }

  const [a, b] = parts;
  return (
    a === 10 ||
    a === 127 ||
    (a === 169 && b === 254) ||
    (a === 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) ||
    (a === 192 && b === 168)
  );
}

function isBlockedIpv6(hostname: string) {
  const normalized = hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  return normalized === "::1" || normalized.startsWith("fc") || normalized.startsWith("fd") || normalized.startsWith("fe80:");
}

function allowLocalAgentUrls() {
  return process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" || isTrue(process.env.ALLOW_LOCAL_AGENT_URLS);
}

export function normalizeAndValidateHostUrl(input: string) {
  const value = input.trim();
  if (!value) {
    throw new Error("host_url is required");
  }

  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("host_url must be a valid absolute URL");
  }

  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) {
    throw new Error("host_url must not include embedded credentials");
  }

  if (parsed.search || parsed.hash) {
    throw new Error("host_url must not include query parameters or fragments");
  }

  const hostname = parsed.hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!hostname) {
    throw new Error("host_url must include a hostname");
  }

  const ipVersion = isIP(hostname);
  const isLocal = isLocalHostname(hostname);

  if (parsed.protocol === "http:") {
    if (!isLocal || !allowLocalAgentUrls()) {
      throw new Error("host_url must use https unless local agent URLs are explicitly allowed for development");
    }
  } else if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
    throw new Error("host_url must use https");
  }

  if (isLocal) {
    if (!allowLocalAgentUrls()) {
      throw new Error("host_url cannot target localhost in this environment");
    }
  } else if (ipVersion === 4 && isPrivateIpv4(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("host_url cannot target private, loopback, or link-local IPv4 ranges");
  } else if (ipVersion === 6 && isBlockedIpv6(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("host_url cannot target loopback, link-local, or unique-local IPv6 ranges");
  }

  parsed.hostname = hostname;
  return parsed.toString().replace(/\/$/, "");
}

export function buildValidatedAgentUrl(hostUrl: string, path: string) {
  const normalizedBase = normalizeAndValidateHostUrl(hostUrl).replace(/\/$/, "");
  const normalizedPath = path.startsWith("/") ? path : `/${path}`;
  return `${normalizedBase}${normalizedPath}`;
}

function parseExternalHttpsUrl(input: string) {
  const value = input.trim();
  if (!value) {
    throw new Error("URL is required");
  }

  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("URL must be a valid absolute URL");
  }

  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
    throw new Error("URL must use https");
  }

  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) {
    throw new Error("URL must not include embedded credentials");
  }

  const hostname = parsed.hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!hostname) {
    throw new Error("URL must include a hostname");
  }

  const ipVersion = isIP(hostname);
  if (isLocalHostname(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("URL cannot target localhost");
  }
  if (ipVersion === 4 && isPrivateIpv4(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("URL cannot target private, loopback, or link-local IPv4 ranges");
  }
  if (ipVersion === 6 && isBlockedIpv6(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("URL cannot target loopback, link-local, or unique-local IPv6 ranges");
  }

  parsed.hostname = hostname;
  return parsed;
}

export function normalizeAndValidateWebhookUrl(input: string) {
  return parseExternalHttpsUrl(input).toString();
}

export function normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl(input: string) {
  const parsed = parseExternalHttpsUrl(input);
  const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (hostname !== "hooks.slack.com") {
    throw new Error("Slack webhook URL must target hooks.slack.com");
  }
  if (!parsed.pathname.startsWith("/services/")) {
    throw new Error("Slack webhook URL must use the standard /services/ path");
  }
  return parsed.toString();
}
````

````typescript
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { requireAuth } from "./auth.mjs";
import { clerkClient } from "./clerk.mjs";
import {
  assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed,
  buildOrganizationAccessSummary,
  canManageOrganizationMembers,
  normalizeOrganizationRole,
  toClerkOrganizationRole,
  type OrganizationAccessInvitationItem,
  type OrganizationAccessMemberRow,
  type OrganizationRole,
} from "./org-access.mjs";
import { buildCorsHeaders } from "./security.mjs";

async function handleOrganizationAccessRequest(req: Request) {
  // Build secure CORS headers based on request origin
  const corsHeaders = buildCorsHeaders(req);
  
  function json(data: unknown, status = 200) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const path = url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/org-access/, "") || "/";
    const parts = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 0) {
      return await getOrganizationAccess(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "invitations") {
      return await createInvitation(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "invitations" && parts[2] === "resend") {
      return await resendInvitation(req, parts[1]);
    }

    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "invitations") {
      return await revokeInvitation(req, parts[1]);
    }

    if (req.method === "PATCH" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "members") {
      return await updateMember(req, parts[1]);
    }

    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "members") {
      return await deleteMember(req, parts[1]);
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unauthorized";
    const status = message.toLowerCase().includes("unauthorized") || message.toLowerCase().includes("access denied") ? 401 : 400;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: message }), { status, headers });
  }
}
````

````typescript
export type OrganizationRole = "owner" | "admin" | "member";

export interface OrganizationAccessMemberRow {
  user_id: string;
  clerk_user_id: string | null;
  email: string;
  full_name: string | null;
  avatar_url: string | null;
  role: string;
  joined_at: string;
}

export interface OrganizationAccessInvitationItem {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  role: OrganizationRole;
  created_at: string;
  expires_at: string | null;
  status: "invited";
}

export function normalizeOrganizationRole(role: string | null | undefined): OrganizationRole {
  const normalized = (role || "member").toLowerCase().replace(/^org:/, "");
  if (normalized === "owner" || normalized === "admin") return normalized;
  return "member";
}

export function toClerkOrganizationRole(role: OrganizationRole) {
  return `org:${role}` as const;
}

export function canManageOrganizationMembers(role: string | null | undefined) {
  const normalized = normalizeOrganizationRole(role);
  return normalized === "owner" || normalized === "admin";
}

export function countPrivilegedMembers(members: Array<{ role: string }>) {
  return members.filter((member) => ["owner", "admin"].includes(normalizeOrganizationRole(member.role))).length;
}

export function countOwners(members: Array<{ role: string }>) {
  return members.filter((member) => normalizeOrganizationRole(member.role) === "owner").length;
}

export function buildOrganizationAccessSummary(
  members: Array<{ role: string }>,
  invitations: OrganizationAccessInvitationItem[],
) {
  return {
    members_count: members.length,
    pending_invites_count: invitations.length,
    admins_count: countPrivilegedMembers(members),
  };
}

export function assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
  requesterRole,
  targetRole,
  nextRole,
  ownerCount,
  isRemoval = false,
}: {
  requesterRole: string;
  targetRole: string;
  nextRole?: string;
  ownerCount: number;
  isRemoval?: boolean;
}) {
  const requester = normalizeOrganizationRole(requesterRole);
  const target = normalizeOrganizationRole(targetRole);
  const next = nextRole ? normalizeOrganizationRole(nextRole) : undefined;

  if (!canManageOrganizationMembers(requester)) {
    throw new Error("Admin access required for active organization");
  }

  if (requester === "admin") {
    if (target === "owner") {
      throw new Error("Admins cannot manage owners");
    }
    if (next === "owner") {
      throw new Error("Admins cannot promote members to owner");
    }
  }

  if (target === "owner" && (isRemoval || next === "admin" || next === "member") && ownerCount <= 1) {
    throw new Error("The last owner cannot be removed or demoted");
  }
}
````

````typescript
import {
  assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed,
  buildOrganizationAccessSummary,
  normalizeOrganizationRole,
} from "./org-access.mjs";

describe("org-access helpers", () => {
  it("normalizes Clerk and app role strings", () => {
    expect(normalizeOrganizationRole("org:admin")).toBe("admin");
    expect(normalizeOrganizationRole("OWNER")).toBe("owner");
    expect(normalizeOrganizationRole("unknown")).toBe("member");
  });

  it("builds summary counts from real members and invites", () => {
    expect(
      buildOrganizationAccessSummary(
        [
          { role: "owner" },
          { role: "admin" },
          { role: "member" },
        ],
        [
          {
            id: "invite-1",
            email: "pending@example.com",
            role: "member",
            created_at: "2026-04-12T00:00:00.000Z",
            expires_at: null,
            status: "invited",
          },
        ],
      ),
    ).toEqual({
      members_count: 3,
      pending_invites_count: 1,
      admins_count: 2,
    });
  });

  it("blocks admins from managing owners", () => {

      assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
        requesterRole: "admin",
        targetRole: "owner",
        ownerCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toThrow(/admins cannot manage owners/i);

  it("blocks removing or demoting the last owner", () => {
    expect(() =>
      assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
        requesterRole: "owner",
        targetRole: "owner",
        ownerCount: 1,
        isRemoval: true,
      }),
    ).toThrow(/last owner/i);

    expect(() =>
      assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
        requesterRole: "owner",
        targetRole: "owner",
        nextRole: "member",
        ownerCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toThrow(/last owner/i);
  });
````

````typescript
export function isPlatformAdminEmail(email: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!email) return false;
  const configuredEmails = (process.env.PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS || "")
    .split(",")
    .map((value) => value.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return configuredEmails.includes(email.toLowerCase());
}
````

## File: netlify/functions/lib/secret-migration.mts
````typescript
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { getActiveEncryptionKeyId, isSecretUsingActiveKey, reencryptSecret } from "./crypto.mjs";

export interface SecretMigrationScope {
  organizationId?: string | null;
  hostId?: string | null;
  dryRun?: boolean;
}

export interface SecretMigrationResult {
  activeKeyId: string;
  migratedCount: number;
  alreadyCurrentCount: number;
  failedCount: number;
  scannedCount: number;
  failures: Array<{ hostId: string; field: string; error: string }>;
}

export async function runSecretMigration(scope: SecretMigrationScope): Promise<SecretMigrationResult> {
  const secrets = scope.hostId
    ? await sql`
        SELECT s.*
        FROM public.docker_host_secrets s
        JOIN public.docker_hosts h ON h.id = s.host_id
        WHERE s.host_id = ${scope.hostId}
      `
    : scope.organizationId
      ? await sql`
          SELECT s.*
          FROM public.docker_host_secrets s
          JOIN public.docker_hosts h ON h.id = s.host_id
          WHERE h.organization_id = ${scope.organizationId}
        `
      : await sql`
          SELECT s.*
          FROM public.docker_host_secrets s
          JOIN public.docker_hosts h ON h.id = s.host_id
        `;

  let migratedCount = 0;
  let alreadyCurrentCount = 0;
  let failedCount = 0;
  const failures: Array<{ hostId: string; field: string; error: string }> = [];

  for (const secret of secrets as Array<Record<string, string | null>>) {
    try {
      const needsUpdate =
        (!!secret.agent_api_key && !isSecretUsingActiveKey(secret.agent_api_key)) ||
        (!!secret.cf_service_token_id && !isSecretUsingActiveKey(secret.cf_service_token_id)) ||
        (!!secret.cf_service_token_secret && !isSecretUsingActiveKey(secret.cf_service_token_secret));

      if (!needsUpdate) {
        alreadyCurrentCount++;
        continue;
      }

      if (scope.dryRun) {
        migratedCount++;
        continue;
      }

      const newAgentKey = secret.agent_api_key
        ? reencryptSecret(secret.agent_api_key, String(secret.host_id), "agent_api_key")
        : null;
      const newCfId = secret.cf_service_token_id
        ? reencryptSecret(secret.cf_service_token_id, String(secret.host_id), "cf_service_token_id")
        : null;
      const newCfSecret = secret.cf_service_token_secret
        ? reencryptSecret(secret.cf_service_token_secret, String(secret.host_id), "cf_service_token_secret")
        : null;

      await sql`
        UPDATE public.docker_host_secrets
        SET
          agent_api_key = ${newAgentKey},
          cf_service_token_id = ${newCfId},
          cf_service_token_secret = ${newCfSecret}
        WHERE host_id = ${String(secret.host_id)}
      `;

      migratedCount++;
    } catch (error) {
      failedCount++;
      failures.push({
        hostId: String(secret.host_id),
        field: "docker_host_secrets",
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    activeKeyId: getActiveEncryptionKeyId(),
    migratedCount,
    alreadyCurrentCount,
    failedCount,
    scannedCount: secrets.length,
    failures,
  };
}
````

````typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';

import { decryptSecret, encryptSecret } from './crypto.mjs';
import { sql } from './db.mjs';
import type { AppAuthContext } from './auth.mjs';
import { normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl } from './host-url.mjs';

type SlackDeliveryEventType = 'alert.opened' | 'alert.acknowledged' | 'alert.resolved' | 'alert.test';

interface SlackDestinationRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  webhook_url: string;
  webhook_url_preview: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  created_by: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface SlackAttemptRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  slack_destination_id: string;
  alert_event_id: string | null;
  delivery_kind: 'alert' | 'test';
  event_type: string;
  succeeded: boolean;
  http_status: number | null;
  error_summary: string | null;
  response_excerpt: string | null;
  attempted_at: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface AlertPayloadSource {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  incident_id?: string | null;
  rule_id?: string | null;
  source_type: 'host' | 'container' | 'metric' | 'system';
  source_ref: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: string;
  status: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  first_seen_at?: string;
  last_seen_at?: string;
  acknowledged_at?: string | null;
  resolved_at?: string | null;
  created_at?: string;
  updated_at?: string;
  href?: string;
}

function normalizeDestination(row: SlackDestinationRow & {
  latest_attempt_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_org_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_destination_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_alert_event_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_delivery_kind?: 'alert' | 'test' | null;
  latest_attempt_event_type?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_succeeded?: boolean | null;
  latest_attempt_http_status?: number | null;
  latest_attempt_error_summary?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_response_excerpt?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_attempted_at?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_created_at?: string | null;
}) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    organization_id: row.organization_id,
    name: row.name,
    webhook_url_preview: row.webhook_url_preview,
    enabled: row.enabled,
    created_by: row.created_by,
    created_at: row.created_at,
    updated_at: row.updated_at,
    latest_attempt: row.latest_attempt_id ? {
      id: row.latest_attempt_id,
      organization_id: row.latest_attempt_org_id!,
      webhook_destination_id: row.latest_attempt_destination_id!,
      alert_event_id: row.latest_attempt_alert_event_id ?? null,
      delivery_kind: row.latest_attempt_delivery_kind!,
      event_type: row.latest_attempt_event_type!,
      succeeded: !!row.latest_attempt_succeeded,
      http_status: row.latest_attempt_http_status ?? null,
      error_summary: row.latest_attempt_error_summary ?? null,
      response_excerpt: row.latest_attempt_response_excerpt ?? null,
      attempted_at: row.latest_attempt_attempted_at!,
      created_at: row.latest_attempt_created_at!,
    } : null,
  };
}

function maskSlackWebhookUrl(webhookUrl: string) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(webhookUrl);
    const parts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const tail = parts.slice(-2).join('/');
    return `${url.origin}/.../${tail}`;
  } catch {
    return `${webhookUrl.slice(0, 18)}...`;
  }
}

function emojiForSeverity(severity: string) {
  if (severity === 'critical') return ':rotating_light:';
  if (severity === 'error') return ':x:';
  if (severity === 'warning') return ':warning:';
  return ':information_source:';
}

function emojiForStatus(status: string) {
  if (status === 'resolved') return ':white_check_mark:';
  if (status === 'acknowledged') return ':eyes:';
  return ':bell:';
}

function capText(value: string | null | undefined, max = 280) {
  if (!value) return null;
  return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max - 3)}...` : value;
}

function mapAlertHref(alert: AlertPayloadSource) {
  if (alert.href) return alert.href;
  const metadata = alert.metadata ?? {};
  const hostId = typeof metadata.host_id === 'string' ? metadata.host_id : null;
  const containerShortId =
    typeof metadata.container_short_id === 'string'
      ? metadata.container_short_id
      : typeof metadata.container_id === 'string'
        ? metadata.container_id.slice(0, 12)
        : null;
  if ((alert.source_type === 'container' || alert.source_type === 'metric') && containerShortId && hostId) return `/app/containers/${containerShortId}?host=${hostId}`;
  if (hostId) return `/app/hosts/${hostId}`;
  return '/app/alerts';
}

function buildAppUrl(path: string) {
  const base = (process.env.APP_URL || 'https://app.dockerdash.app').replace(/\/$/, '');
  return `${base}${path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`}`;
}

function buildSlackPayload(alert: AlertPayloadSource, eventType: SlackDeliveryEventType) {
  const href = buildAppUrl(mapAlertHref(alert));
  const statusLine = `${emojiForSeverity(alert.severity)} ${emojiForStatus(alert.status)} *${alert.title}*`;
  const sourceLabel = `${alert.source_type}:${alert.source_ref}`;
  return {
    text: `${alert.title} (${alert.severity}/${alert.status})`,
    blocks: [
      {
        type: 'section',
        text: {
          type: 'mrkdwn',
          text: `${statusLine}\n${alert.message}`,
        },
      },
      {
        type: 'context',
        elements: [
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Event* ${eventType}` },
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Source* ${sourceLabel}` },
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Organization* ${alert.organization_id}` },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: 'actions',
        elements: [
          {
            type: 'button',
            text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Open in Docker Dashboard' },
            url: href,
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };
}

async function recordAttempt(params: {
  organizationId: string;
  destinationId: string;
  alertEventId?: string | null;
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test';
  eventType: string;
  succeeded: boolean;
  httpStatus?: number | null;
  errorSummary?: string | null;
  responseExcerpt?: string | null;
}) {
  const [attempt] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO alert_slack_delivery_attempts (
      organization_id, slack_destination_id, alert_event_id, delivery_kind,
      event_type, succeeded, http_status, error_summary, response_excerpt
    )
    VALUES (
      ${params.organizationId}, ${params.destinationId}, ${params.alertEventId ?? null}, ${params.deliveryKind},
      ${params.eventType}, ${params.succeeded}, ${params.httpStatus ?? null}, ${params.errorSummary ?? null}, ${params.responseExcerpt ?? null}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return attempt as SlackAttemptRow;
}

async function dispatchSlackWebhook(
  destination: SlackDestinationRow,
  webhookUrl: string,
  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
  eventType: SlackDeliveryEventType,
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test',
  alertEventId?: string | null,
) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'User-Agent': 'DockerDash-Slack/1.0',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    const responseText = capText(await response.text());
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: response.ok,
      httpStatus: response.status,
      errorSummary: response.ok ? null : capText(response.statusText || 'Slack responded with non-2xx status'),
      responseExcerpt: responseText,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: false,
      errorSummary: capText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Slack request failed'),
    });
  }
}

async function getDestinationForOrg(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM slack_destinations
    WHERE id = ${destinationId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  return (rows[0] as SlackDestinationRow | undefined) ?? null;
}

export async function listSlackDestinations(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      d.*,
      a.id AS latest_attempt_id,
      a.organization_id AS latest_attempt_org_id,
      a.slack_destination_id AS latest_attempt_destination_id,
      a.alert_event_id AS latest_attempt_alert_event_id,
      a.delivery_kind AS latest_attempt_delivery_kind,
      a.event_type AS latest_attempt_event_type,
      a.succeeded AS latest_attempt_succeeded,
      a.http_status AS latest_attempt_http_status,
      a.error_summary AS latest_attempt_error_summary,
      a.response_excerpt AS latest_attempt_response_excerpt,
      a.attempted_at AS latest_attempt_attempted_at,
      a.created_at AS latest_attempt_created_at
    FROM slack_destinations d
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT *
      FROM alert_slack_delivery_attempts
      WHERE slack_destination_id = d.id
      ORDER BY attempted_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) a ON true
    WHERE d.organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  `;

  return rows.map((row) => normalizeDestination(row as any));
}

export async function createSlackDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { name: string; webhook_url: string; enabled?: boolean },
) {
  const webhookUrl = normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl(values.webhook_url);
  const destinationId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const encryptedWebhookUrl = encryptSecret(webhookUrl, destinationId, 'webhook_url');
  const [row] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO slack_destinations (
      id, organization_id, name, webhook_url, webhook_url_preview, enabled, created_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${destinationId}, ${auth.orgId}, ${values.name}, ${encryptedWebhookUrl}, ${maskSlackWebhookUrl(webhookUrl)}, ${values.enabled ?? true}, ${auth.userId}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return normalizeDestination(row as any);
}

export async function updateSlackDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { id: string; name?: string; webhook_url?: string; enabled?: boolean },
) {
  const existing = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, values.id);
  if (!existing) throw new Error('Slack destination not found');

  const validatedWebhookUrl = values.webhook_url ? normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl(values.webhook_url) : null;
  const nextWebhookUrl = validatedWebhookUrl ? encryptSecret(validatedWebhookUrl, existing.id, 'webhook_url') : existing.webhook_url;
  const nextPreview = validatedWebhookUrl ? maskSlackWebhookUrl(validatedWebhookUrl) : existing.webhook_url_preview;

  const [row] = await sql`
    UPDATE slack_destinations
    SET
      name = ${values.name ?? existing.name},
      webhook_url = ${nextWebhookUrl},
      webhook_url_preview = ${nextPreview},
      enabled = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, 'enabled') ? values.enabled : existing.enabled}
    WHERE id = ${values.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return normalizeDestination(row as any);
}

export async function sendSlackDestinationTest(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const destination = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, destinationId);
  if (!destination) throw new Error('Slack destination not found');
  const webhookUrl = decryptSecret(destination.webhook_url, destination.id, 'webhook_url');
  if (!webhookUrl) throw new Error('Slack webhook URL unavailable');

  const payload = {
    text: 'Docker Dashboard Slack test',
    blocks: [
      {
        type: 'section',
        text: {
          type: 'mrkdwn',
          text: ':satellite: *Docker Dashboard Slack test*\nYour Slack destination is ready to receive alert notifications.',
        },
      },
      {
        type: 'context',
        elements: [
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Organization* ${auth.orgId}` },
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Destination* ${destination.name}` },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };

  return dispatchSlackWebhook(destination, webhookUrl, payload, 'alert.test', 'test', null);
}

export async function deliverSlackAlerts(auth: AppAuthContext, alert: AlertPayloadSource, eventType: SlackDeliveryEventType) {
  if (!alert.rule_id) return [];

  const ruleRows = await sql`
    SELECT notification_channels
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE id = ${alert.rule_id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  const channels = Array.isArray(ruleRows[0]?.notification_channels)
    ? ruleRows[0].notification_channels.filter((item: unknown): item is string => typeof item === 'string')
    : [];

  if (!channels.includes('slack')) return [];

  const destinationRows = (await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM slack_destinations
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND enabled = true
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
  `) as SlackDestinationRow[];

  if (destinationRows.length === 0) return [];

  const payload = buildSlackPayload(alert, eventType);
  return Promise.all(
    destinationRows.map(async (destination) => {
      const webhookUrl = decryptSecret(destination.webhook_url, destination.id, 'webhook_url');
      if (!webhookUrl) {
        return recordAttempt({
          organizationId: destination.organization_id,
          destinationId: destination.id,
          alertEventId: alert.id,
          deliveryKind: 'alert',
          eventType,
          succeeded: false,
          errorSummary: 'Slack webhook URL unavailable',
        });
      }
      return dispatchSlackWebhook(destination, webhookUrl, payload, eventType, 'alert', alert.id);
    }),
  );
}
````
