````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { ensureDefaultAlertRules, listAlertRules, requireOrganizationAdmin, syncAlertEvents } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import { assertAdvancedAlertsAccessAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      await ensureDefaultAlertRules(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(await listAlertRules(auth)), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      await assertAdvancedAlertsAccessAllowed({ organizationId: auth.orgId, isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin });
      const body = await req.json();

      const [rule] = await sql`
        INSERT INTO alert_rules (
          organization_id, name, condition_type, resource_scope, threshold_value,
          threshold_window_minutes, severity, notification_channels, enabled, created_by
        )
        VALUES (
          ${auth.orgId}, ${body.name}, ${body.condition_type},
          ${JSON.stringify(body.resource_scope || { scope: 'organization' })},
          ${body.threshold_value ?? null},
          ${body.threshold_window_minutes ?? 5},
          ${body.severity},
          ${JSON.stringify(body.notification_channels || [])},
          ${body.enabled ?? true},
          ${auth.userId}
        )
        RETURNING *
      `;

      await syncAlertEvents(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(rule), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      await assertAdvancedAlertsAccessAllowed({ organizationId: auth.orgId, isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin });
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Rule id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const currentRows = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM alert_rules
        WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (currentRows.length === 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Rule not found' }), { status: 404, headers });
      }

      const current = currentRows[0];
      const [rule] = await sql`
        UPDATE alert_rules
        SET
          name = ${body.name ?? current.name},
          condition_type = ${body.condition_type ?? current.condition_type},
          resource_scope = ${JSON.stringify(body.resource_scope ?? current.resource_scope)},
          threshold_value = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'threshold_value') ? body.threshold_value : current.threshold_value},
          threshold_window_minutes = ${body.threshold_window_minutes ?? current.threshold_window_minutes},
          severity = ${body.severity ?? current.severity},
          notification_channels = ${JSON.stringify(body.notification_channels ?? current.notification_channels)},
          enabled = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'enabled') ? body.enabled : current.enabled}
        WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
        RETURNING *
      `;

      await syncAlertEvents(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(rule), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied/.test(error?.message || '') ? 403 : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process alert rules' }), { status, headers });
  }
};
````

## File: netlify/functions/api-alerts.mts
````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { getOrganizationRole, listAlertEvents, listAlertRules, listIncidents, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import { deliverSlackAlerts } from './lib/slack-delivery.mjs';
import { deliverAlertWebhooks } from './lib/webhook-destinations.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const url = new URL(req.url);
      const severity = url.searchParams.get('severity');
      const status = url.searchParams.get('status');
      const [alerts, rules, incidents] = await Promise.all([
        listAlertEvents(auth, { severity, status }),
        listAlertRules(auth),
        listIncidents(auth),
      ]);

      const activeAlerts = alerts.filter((alert) => alert.resolved_at === null);
      const summary = {
        total_alerts: activeAlerts.length,
        critical_alerts: activeAlerts.filter((alert) => alert.severity === 'critical').length,
        enabled_rules: rules.filter((rule) => rule.enabled).length,
        open_incidents: incidents.filter((incident: any) => incident.status !== 'resolved').length,
      };

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ alerts, summary, role, can_manage: ['owner', 'admin'].includes(role) }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id || !body?.action) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Alert id and action required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      if (body.action === 'acknowledge') {
        const [alert] = await sql`
          UPDATE alert_events
          SET status = 'acknowledged', acknowledged_at = COALESCE(acknowledged_at, now()), acknowledged_by = ${auth.userId}
          WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          RETURNING *
        `;
        if (alert) {
          await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, alert, 'alert.acknowledged');
          await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, alert, 'alert.acknowledged');
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(alert), { headers });
      }

      if (body.action === 'resolve') {
        const [alert] = await sql`
          UPDATE alert_events
          SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = COALESCE(resolved_at, now()), resolved_by = ${auth.userId}
          WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          RETURNING *
        `;
        if (alert) {
          await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, alert, 'alert.resolved');
          await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, alert, 'alert.resolved');
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(alert), { headers });
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unsupported action' }), { status: 400, headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied/.test(error?.message || '') ? 403 : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process alerts' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/alerts',
};
````

## File: netlify/functions/api-billing-webhook.mts
````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { applyRateLimit, RATE_LIMITS, verifyWebhookTimestamp, logSecurityEvent, getClientIp } from './lib/security.mjs';

const PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET = process.env.PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET;

const verifySignature = (body: string, signature: string): boolean => {
  if (!PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET || !signature) return false;

  // Paddle signature format: ts=1234567;h1=abcdef...
  const parts = signature.split(';');
  const tsPart = parts.find(p => p.startsWith('ts='));
  const h1Part = parts.find(p => p.startsWith('h1='));

  if (!tsPart || !h1Part) return false;

  const ts = tsPart.split('=')[1];
  const h1 = h1Part.split('=')[1];

  const payload = `${ts}:${body}`;
  const cryptoHash = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
    .update(payload)
    .digest('hex');

  return cryptoHash === h1;
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return new Response('Method Not Allowed', { status: 405 });
  }

  // Apply rate limiting for webhook endpoint
  const rateLimitResponse = await applyRateLimit(req, 'webhook:paddle', RATE_LIMITS.WEBHOOK);
  if (rateLimitResponse) {
    return rateLimitResponse;
  }

  const signature = req.headers.get('paddle-signature') || '';
  const rawBody = await req.text();
  const clientIp = getClientIp(req);

  // Verify timestamp to prevent replay attacks
  const tsMatch = signature.match(/ts=(\d+)/);
  const timestampHeader = tsMatch ? tsMatch[1] : null;
  const nonceMatch = signature.match(/h1=([a-f0-9]+)/);
  const nonceHeader = nonceMatch ? nonceMatch[1] : null;
  
  const timestampResult = await verifyWebhookTimestamp(timestampHeader, nonceHeader);
  if (!timestampResult.valid) {
    logSecurityEvent({
      type: 'replay_attack',
      endpoint: '/api/billing/webhook',
      ip: clientIp,
      reason: `Timestamp verification failed: ${timestampResult.error}`,
      metadata: { provider: 'paddle' },
    });
    console.error('Invalid Paddle timestamp/nonce:', timestampResult.error);
    return new Response('Invalid Timestamp', { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!verifySignature(rawBody, signature)) {
    logSecurityEvent({
      type: 'webhook_signature_failure',
      endpoint: '/api/billing/webhook',
      ip: clientIp,
      reason: 'Invalid Paddle signature',
      metadata: { provider: 'paddle' },
    });
    console.error('Invalid Paddle signature');
    return new Response('Invalid Signature', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const event = JSON.parse(rawBody);
    const eventType = event.event_type;
    const data = event.data;

    console.log(`Processing Paddle webhook: ${eventType}`, {
      subscription_id: data.id,
      customer_id: data.customer_id
    });

    // Extract organization_id and intended_plan from custom_data
    const { organization_id, intended_plan } = data.custom_data || {};

    if (!organization_id) {
      console.warn('Webhook missing organization_id in custom_data', { event_id: event.event_id });
      // Return 200 to acknowledge receipt even if we can't process it (to avoid retries)
      return new Response('OK - No org_id', { status: 200 });
    }

    // Status mapping: active, past_due, canceled, paused, trial, incomplete
    const status = data.status;
    const paddleSubscriptionId = data.id;
    const paddleCustomerId = data.customer_id;
    const paddlePriceId = data.items?.[0]?.price?.id || null;
    const currentPeriodEndsAt = data.current_period_end || null;
    const cancelAtPeriodEnd = data.scheduled_change?.action === 'cancel' || false;

    // Determine the logical plan name. 
    // We prefer the custom_data.intended_plan if provided during checkout, 
    // otherwise fallback to a generic lookup if needed.
    const plan = intended_plan || 'free';

    // Handle activation: only set active if status is 'active' or 'trialing'
    const isPaidActive = status === 'active' || status === 'trialing';
    
    // For 'subscription.created', we record details but don't necessarily update status yet if not active
    // Most checkouts will trigger 'created' then 'activated' (or just 'activated' with full data)

    await sql`
      UPDATE organizations 
      SET 
        plan = ${isPaidActive ? plan : 'free'},
        subscription_status = ${status},
        paddle_subscription_id = ${paddleSubscriptionId},
        paddle_customer_id = ${paddleCustomerId},
        paddle_price_id = ${paddlePriceId},
        current_period_ends_at = ${currentPeriodEndsAt},
        cancel_at_period_end = ${cancelAtPeriodEnd},
        billing_updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = ${organization_id}
    `;

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { 
      status: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    });

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Webhook processing error:', err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), { 
      status: 500,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/billing/webhook',
};
````

````typescript
import { Webhook } from 'svix';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationSeatCapacityAvailable } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { applyRateLimit, RATE_LIMITS, verifyWebhookTimestamp, logSecurityEvent, getClientIp } from './lib/security.mjs';

const webhookSecret = process.env.CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET;

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return new Response('Method Not Allowed', { status: 405 });
  }

  // Apply rate limiting for webhook endpoint
  const rateLimitResponse = await applyRateLimit(req, 'webhook:clerk', RATE_LIMITS.WEBHOOK);
  if (rateLimitResponse) {
    return rateLimitResponse;
  }

  if (!webhookSecret) {
    console.error('Missing CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET');
    return new Response('Internal Server Error', { status: 500 });
  }

  // Get headers
  const svix_id = req.headers.get("svix-id");
  const svix_timestamp = req.headers.get("svix-timestamp");
  const svix_signature = req.headers.get("svix-signature");
  const clientIp = getClientIp(req);

  if (!svix_id || !svix_timestamp || !svix_signature) {
    logSecurityEvent({
      type: 'webhook_signature_failure',
      endpoint: '/api/clerk/webhook',
      ip: clientIp,
      reason: 'Missing Svix headers',
      metadata: { provider: 'clerk' },
    });
    return new Response('Missing svix headers', { status: 400 });
  }

  // Verify timestamp to prevent replay attacks
  const timestampResult = await verifyWebhookTimestamp(svix_timestamp, svix_id);
  if (!timestampResult.valid) {
    logSecurityEvent({
      type: 'replay_attack',
      endpoint: '/api/clerk/webhook',
      ip: clientIp,
      reason: `Timestamp verification failed: ${timestampResult.error}`,
      metadata: { provider: 'clerk' },
    });
    console.error('Invalid Clerk timestamp/nonce:', timestampResult.error);
    return new Response('Invalid Timestamp', { status: 400 });
  }

  // Get body
  const payload = await req.text();

  // Verify webhook
  let evt: any;
  try {
    const wh = new Webhook(webhookSecret);
    evt = wh.verify(payload, {
      "svix-id": svix_id,
      "svix-timestamp": svix_timestamp,
      "svix-signature": svix_signature,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logSecurityEvent({
      type: 'webhook_signature_failure',
      endpoint: '/api/clerk/webhook',
      ip: clientIp,
      reason: `Signature verification failed: ${err.message}`,
      metadata: { provider: 'clerk' },
    });
    console.error('Webhook signature verification failed:', err.message);
    return new Response('Invalid signature', { status: 400 });
  }

  const { id } = evt.data;
  const eventType = evt.type;

  try {
    if (eventType === 'user.created' || eventType === 'user.updated') {
      const email = evt.data.email_addresses?.[0]?.email_address;
      const firstName = evt.data.first_name || '';
      const lastName = evt.data.last_name || '';
      const fullName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim();
      const avatarUrl = evt.data.image_url;

      if (!email) {
        throw new Error('No email found for user');
      }

      await sql`
        INSERT INTO public.users (clerk_user_id, email, full_name, avatar_url)
        VALUES (${id}, ${email}, ${fullName}, ${avatarUrl})
        ON CONFLICT (clerk_user_id) DO UPDATE
        SET email = EXCLUDED.email,
            full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
            avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url,
            updated_at = now()
      `;

      // Auto-approve if email is in beta allowlist (case-insensitive)
      if (eventType === 'user.created') {
        const allowed = await sql`
          SELECT 1 FROM beta_allowlist WHERE lower(email) = lower(${email})
        `;
        if (allowed.length > 0) {
          await sql`UPDATE users SET is_approved = true WHERE clerk_user_id = ${id}`;
          console.log(`Auto-approved beta user ${id} (${email})`);
        } else {
          console.log(`User ${id} (${email}) signed up but is NOT in beta allowlist`);
        }
      }

      console.log(`Synced user ${id} (${email})`);
    } 
    else if (eventType === 'organization.created' || eventType === 'organization.updated') {
      const name = evt.data.name;
      const slug = evt.data.slug;
      const creatorClerkId = evt.data.created_by;
      
      let creatorId = null;
      if (creatorClerkId) {
        const creatorData = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE clerk_user_id = ${creatorClerkId}`;
        if (creatorData.length > 0) {
          creatorId = creatorData[0].id;
        }
      }

      // If we don't have the creator locally yet for some reason, we can't reliably set "created_by" 
      // without breaking FK constraint if this is an INSERT. We will skip it or use a default if need be.
      // But usually user.created fires before organization.created.

      await sql`
        INSERT INTO public.organizations (clerk_org_id, name, slug, created_by)
        VALUES (${id}, ${name}, ${slug}, ${creatorId})
        ON CONFLICT (clerk_org_id) DO UPDATE
        SET name = EXCLUDED.name,
            slug = EXCLUDED.slug,
            updated_at = now()
      `;
      console.log(`Synced org ${id} (${name})`);
    }
    else if (eventType === 'organizationMembership.created') {
      const organizationId = evt.data.organization.id;
      const publicUserData = evt.data.public_user_data;
      const userId = publicUserData.user_id;
      const role = evt.data.role.toLowerCase().replace('org:', ''); // e.g. org:admin -> admin

      // Map Clerk IDs to our internal UUIDs
      const orgData = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.organizations WHERE clerk_org_id = ${organizationId}`;
      const userData = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE clerk_user_id = ${userId}`;

      if (orgData.length > 0 && userData.length > 0) {
        const internalOrgId = orgData[0].id;
        const internalUserId = userData[0].id;

        const existingMembership = await sql`
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.organization_members
          WHERE organization_id = ${internalOrgId} AND user_id = ${internalUserId}
          LIMIT 1
        `;

        if (existingMembership.length === 0) {
          await assertOrganizationSeatCapacityAvailable({
            organizationId: internalOrgId,
            isPlatformAdmin: false,
          });
        }

        await sql`
          INSERT INTO public.organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role)
          VALUES (${internalOrgId}, ${internalUserId}, ${role})
          ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO UPDATE
          SET role = EXCLUDED.role
        `;
        console.log(`Synced membership for user ${userId} in org ${organizationId}`);
      } else {
        console.error(`Failed to sync membership: internal org or user not found. (org=${organizationId}, user=${userId})`);
      }
    }
    else if (eventType === 'organizationMembership.deleted') {
      // NOTE: Clerk provides public_user_data.user_id in deleted event, too.
      const organizationId = evt.data.organization.id;
      const userId = evt.data.public_user_data.user_id;

      const orgData = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.organizations WHERE clerk_org_id = ${organizationId}`;
      const userData = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE clerk_user_id = ${userId}`;

      if (orgData.length > 0 && userData.length > 0) {
        await sql`
          DELETE FROM public.organization_members 
          WHERE organization_id = ${orgData[0].id} AND user_id = ${userData[0].id}
        `;
        console.log(`Deleted membership for user ${userId} in org ${organizationId}`);
      }
    }
    else if (eventType === 'user.deleted') {
      await sql`DELETE FROM public.users WHERE clerk_user_id = ${id}`;
    }
    else if (eventType === 'organization.deleted') {
      await sql`DELETE FROM public.organizations WHERE clerk_org_id = ${id}`;
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`Error processing webhook ${eventType}:`, err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  }
};
````

````typescript
import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";
import { requireAuth } from "./lib/auth.mjs";
import { assertOrganizationWriteAllowed } from "./lib/access-controls.mjs";
import {
  createOrUpdateDedicatedDeployment,
  getCurrentDedicatedDeployment,
} from "./lib/dedicated-deployments.mjs";

const headers = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
};

function json(body: unknown, init: ResponseInit = {}) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    ...init,
    headers: { ...headers, ...(init.headers || {}) },
  });
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAuth(req, { requireOrg: false });
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const pathname = url.pathname;

    if (req.method === "GET" && pathname.endsWith("/current")) {
      const deployment = await getCurrentDedicatedDeployment(auth);
      return json(deployment);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && pathname.endsWith("/dedicated-deployments")) {
      if (!auth.orgId) {
        return json({ error: "Select an active organization before starting a dedicated deployment." }, { status: 409 });
      }

      await assertOrganizationWriteAllowed({
        organizationId: auth.orgId,
        isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
      });

      const body = await req.json();
      const deployment = await createOrUpdateDedicatedDeployment(auth, body || {});
      return json(deployment, { status: 201 });
    }

    return json({ error: "Method not allowed" }, { status: 405 });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const message = error?.message || "Request failed";
    const status =
      message.toLowerCase().includes("active organization")
        ? 409
        : message.toLowerCase().includes("locked")
          ? 403
          : 401;
    return json({ error: message }, { status });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/dedicated-deployments*",
};
````

````typescript
import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";

import { requireAuth } from "./lib/auth.mjs";
import { createDonorIntent, donorJsonHeaders } from "./lib/donor-billing.mjs";

const headers = donorJsonHeaders();

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), { status: 405, headers });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as Record<string, unknown>));

    const nextReq = new Request(req.url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: req.headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...body,
        organization_id: body.organization_id || auth.orgId,
        payer_email: body.payer_email || auth.email,
      }),
    });

    return await createDonorIntent(nextReq);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to create donor intent";
    const status = /unauthorized/i.test(message) ? 401 : 400;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: message }), { status, headers });
  }
````

````typescript
import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";

import { donorJsonHeaders, sendDueDonorReminders } from "./lib/donor-billing.mjs";

const headers = donorJsonHeaders();

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  if (req.method !== "POST" && req.method !== "GET") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), { status: 405, headers });
  }

  const cronSecret = (process.env.DONOR_REMINDER_CRON_SECRET || "").trim();
  if (cronSecret) {
    const provided = req.headers.get("x-cron-secret") || "";
    if (provided !== cronSecret) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }), { status: 403, headers });
    }
  }

  try {
    const result = await sendDueDonorReminders();
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, ...result }), { status: 200, headers });
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to send donor reminders" }),
      { status: 500, headers },
    );
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/donor-reminders",
};
````

````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { listAlertHistory, listIncidents, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const [incidents, history] = await Promise.all([listIncidents(auth), listAlertHistory(auth)]);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ incidents, history }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.source_alert_event_id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'source_alert_event_id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const [sourceAlert] = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM alert_events
        WHERE id = ${body.source_alert_event_id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
      `;

      if (!sourceAlert) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Alert not found' }), { status: 404, headers });
      }

      const existing = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM incidents
        WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          AND source_alert_event_id = ${body.source_alert_event_id}
          AND resolved_at IS NULL
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (existing.length > 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(existing[0]), { headers });
      }

      const [incident] = await sql`
        INSERT INTO incidents (
          organization_id, source_alert_event_id, title, summary,
          severity, status, metadata, opened_by
        )
        VALUES (
          ${auth.orgId}, ${body.source_alert_event_id},
          ${body.title || sourceAlert.title},
          ${body.summary || sourceAlert.message},
          ${body.severity || sourceAlert.severity},
          'open',
          ${JSON.stringify({ source_type: sourceAlert.source_type, source_ref: sourceAlert.source_ref })},
          ${auth.userId}
        )
        RETURNING *
      `;

      await sql`
        UPDATE alert_events
        SET
          incident_id = ${incident.id},
          status = CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 'acknowledged' ELSE status END,
          acknowledged_at = COALESCE(acknowledged_at, now()),
          acknowledged_by = COALESCE(acknowledged_by, ${auth.userId})
        WHERE id = ${body.source_alert_event_id}
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(incident), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied/.test(error?.message || '') ? 403 : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process incidents' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/incidents',
};
````

````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const authContext = await requireAuth(req);
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    
    // Use the orgId from the Clerk active organization token context, or fallback to query param
    const orgId = authContext.orgId || url.searchParams.get('orgId');

    if (req.method !== 'GET') {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
    }
    if (!orgId) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'orgId required' }), { status: 400, headers });
    }

    await assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
      organizationId: orgId,
      isPlatformAdmin: authContext.isPlatformAdmin,
      feature: 'team_collaboration',
    });

    const members = await sql`
      SELECT u.id as user_id, u.full_name, u.avatar_url, om.role, om.created_at as joined_at
      FROM organization_members om
      JOIN users u ON u.id = om.user_id
      WHERE om.organization_id = ${orgId}
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM organization_members 
        WHERE organization_id = ${orgId} AND user_id = ${authContext.userId}
      )
    `;

    return new Response(JSON.stringify(members), { headers });

  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/members',
};
````

````typescript
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, X-Agent-Key, X-Docker-Socket',

};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const path = url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/mock-docker-agent/, '');

    const config = await sql`SELECT mode FROM mock_agent_config WHERE id = 1`;
    const mode = config[0]?.mode || 'success';

    if (mode === 'failure') {
      return new Response('Service Unavailable - Mock failure mode', {
        status: 503,
        headers,
      });
    }

    if (path === '/docker/_ping' || path.endsWith('/_ping')) {
      return new Response('OK', { status: 200, headers });

    if (path === '/agent/version' || path.endsWith('/agent/version')) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        agent_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION,
        version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION,
      }), { status: 200, headers });
    }

    if (path === '/metrics' || path.endsWith('/metrics')) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        cpu_time_ns: 1_200_000_000,
        system_time_ns: 4_800_000_000,
        online_cpus: 4,

        network_in_bytes_per_sec: 524_288,

        disk_read_bytes_per_sec: 131_072,

        Arch: 'amd64',
        KernelVersion: '6.1.0-mock',
        GoVersion: 'go1.22.0',
      }), { status: 200, headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Not found', path }), {
      status: 404,
      headers,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), { status: 500, headers });
  }
};
````

````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationWriteAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureOnboardingSchema } from './lib/ensure-onboarding-schema.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureOnboardingSchema();
    const authContext = await requireAuth(req, { requireOrg: false });

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const orgs = await sql`
        SELECT o.* 
        FROM organizations o
        JOIN organization_members om ON o.id = om.organization_id
        WHERE om.user_id = ${authContext.userId}
        ORDER BY o.created_at ASC
      `;
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(orgs), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      const { name } = await req.json();
      if (!name) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Name required' }), { status: 400, headers });

      const [{ create_organization: orgId }] = await sql`
        SELECT public.create_organization(${name}, ${authContext.userId})
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ id: orgId }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      const body = await req.json();
      const onboardingStatus = body?.onboardingStatus;
      const requestedClerkOrgId = typeof body?.clerkOrgId === 'string' ? body.clerkOrgId : null;
      const allowedStatuses = ['not_started', 'skipped', 'completed'];

      if (!allowedStatuses.includes(onboardingStatus)) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid onboardingStatus. Allowed values: not_started, skipped, completed' }),
          { status: 400, headers }
        );
      }

      let targetOrgId = authContext.orgId;
      const activeClerkOrgId = authContext.clerkOrgId ?? null;
      const membershipRows = await sql`
        SELECT o.id
        FROM organizations o
        JOIN organization_members om ON o.id = om.organization_id
        WHERE om.user_id = ${authContext.userId}
        ORDER BY om.created_at ASC
      `;

      if (requestedClerkOrgId) {
        const requestedOrgRows = await sql`
          SELECT o.id
          FROM organizations o
          JOIN organization_members om ON o.id = om.organization_id
          WHERE om.user_id = ${authContext.userId} AND o.clerk_org_id = ${requestedClerkOrgId}
          LIMIT 1
        `;

        if (requestedOrgRows.length === 0) {
          const canCreatePendingOrg =
            activeClerkOrgId === requestedClerkOrgId ||
            (!activeClerkOrgId && membershipRows.length === 0);

          if (canCreatePendingOrg) {
            const pendingSlugBase = requestedClerkOrgId
              .toLowerCase()
              .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
              .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
              .slice(0, 40) || 'pending-org';
            const pendingSlug = `${pendingSlugBase}-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

            const [createdOrg] = await sql`
              INSERT INTO public.organizations (name, slug, clerk_org_id, created_by)
              VALUES ('Pending organization', ${pendingSlug}, ${requestedClerkOrgId}, ${authContext.userId})
              ON CONFLICT (clerk_org_id) DO UPDATE
              SET updated_at = now()
              RETURNING id
            `;

            await sql`
              INSERT INTO public.organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role)
              VALUES (${createdOrg.id}, ${authContext.userId}, 'owner')
              ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
            `;

            targetOrgId = createdOrg.id;
          } else if (activeClerkOrgId === requestedClerkOrgId) {
            return new Response(
              JSON.stringify({ error: 'Organization sync pending. Please retry.', retry: true }),
              { status: 202, headers }
            );
          }

          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Requested organization not found for current user' }), { status: 404, headers });
        }

        targetOrgId = requestedOrgRows[0].id;
      }

      if (!targetOrgId) {
        if (membershipRows.length === 0) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'No organization membership found' }), { status: 400, headers });
        }

        if (membershipRows.length > 1) {
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({ error: 'Multiple organizations found. Please select an active organization and retry.' }),
            { status: 400, headers }
          );
        }

        targetOrgId = membershipRows[0].id;
      }

      const memberships = await sql`
        SELECT 1
        FROM organization_members
        WHERE organization_id = ${targetOrgId} AND user_id = ${authContext.userId}
      `;

      if (memberships.length === 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Access denied' }), { status: 403, headers });
      }

      await assertOrganizationWriteAllowed({
        organizationId: targetOrgId,
        isPlatformAdmin: authContext.isPlatformAdmin,
      });

      const updated = await sql`
        UPDATE organizations
        SET
          onboarding_status = ${onboardingStatus},
          onboarding_skipped_at = CASE
            WHEN ${onboardingStatus} = 'skipped' THEN COALESCE(onboarding_skipped_at, now())
            ELSE onboarding_skipped_at
          END,
          onboarding_completed_at = CASE
            WHEN ${onboardingStatus} = 'completed' THEN COALESCE(onboarding_completed_at, now())
            ELSE onboarding_completed_at
          END
        WHERE id = ${targetOrgId}
        RETURNING id, clerk_org_id, onboarding_status, onboarding_skipped_at, onboarding_completed_at
      `;

      if (updated.length === 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Organization not found' }), { status: 404, headers });
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(updated[0]), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[api-organizations] caught error:', err?.message);

    if (err?.code === 'SYNC_PENDING') {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message, retry: true }), {
        status: 202,
        headers,
      });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/organizations',
};
````

````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const users = await sql`SELECT email, full_name, avatar_url FROM users WHERE id = ${auth.userId}`;
      if (!users.length) return new Response('User not sync', { status: 404 });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(users[0]), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });

  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/profile',
};
````

````javascript
import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import 'dotenv/config';

const { Client } = pg;

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

async function run() {
  const url = process.env.NETLIFY_DATABASE_URL;
  if (!url) {
    console.error('NETLIFY_DATABASE_URL is required in .env');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const client = new Client({
    connectionString: url,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
  });

  await client.connect();
  const schemaPath = path.join(__dirname, 'schema.sql');
  const schema = fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8');

  console.log('Connected to Neon DB. Executing schema...');
  
  try {
    await client.query(schema);
    console.log('✓ Successfully initialized schema in Neon DB.');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('✗ Failed:', err.message);
  } finally {
    await client.end();
  }
}

run().catch(console.error);
````

## File: public/watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh
````bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

SERVICE_NAME="watchtower-agent"
SERVICE_USER="watchtower-agent"
INSTALL_DIR="/opt/watchtower-agent"
CONFIG_DIR="/etc/watchtower-agent"
ENV_FILE="${CONFIG_DIR}/watchtower-agent.env"
SERVICE_FILE="/etc/systemd/system/watchtower-agent.service"
UNINSTALL_BIN="/usr/local/bin/watchtower-agent-uninstall"

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh [options]

Options:
  --purge           Remove /etc/watchtower-agent and stored secrets
  --delete-config   Same as --purge
  --keep-config     Preserve /etc/watchtower-agent for reinstall
  --help            Show this help text
EOF
}

fail() {
  echo "ERROR: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

require_root() {
  [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || fail "Run this uninstaller with sudo or as root"
}

HAD_INSTALL="false"
DELETE_CONFIG=""

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --purge|--delete-config)
      DELETE_CONFIG="true"
      shift
      ;;
    --keep-config)
      DELETE_CONFIG="false"
      shift
      ;;
    --help)
      usage
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      fail "Unknown option: $1"
      ;;
  esac
done

require_root

if [ -f "$SERVICE_FILE" ] || [ -f "$UNINSTALL_BIN" ] || [ -d "$INSTALL_DIR" ] || [ -d "$CONFIG_DIR" ]; then
  HAD_INSTALL="true"
fi

if [ -z "$DELETE_CONFIG" ]; then
  if [ -t 0 ]; then
    read -r -p "Delete stored config and secrets in ${CONFIG_DIR}? [y/N]: " reply
    case "$reply" in
      y|Y|yes|YES)
        DELETE_CONFIG="true"
        ;;
      *)
        DELETE_CONFIG="false"
        ;;
    esac
  else
    DELETE_CONFIG="false"
  fi
fi

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl stop "${SERVICE_NAME}.service" 2>/dev/null || true
  systemctl disable "${SERVICE_NAME}.service" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

rm -f "$SERVICE_FILE"

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
  systemctl reset-failed "${SERVICE_NAME}.service" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

rm -f "$UNINSTALL_BIN"
rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR"

if [ "$DELETE_CONFIG" = "true" ]; then
  rm -rf "$CONFIG_DIR"
  echo "Deleted config in $CONFIG_DIR"
else
  echo "Preserved config at $ENV_FILE"
fi

if [ "$DELETE_CONFIG" = "true" ] && id "$SERVICE_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  userdel "$SERVICE_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ "$DELETE_CONFIG" = "true" ] && getent group "$SERVICE_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  groupdel "$SERVICE_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ "$HAD_INSTALL" = "true" ]; then
  echo "watchtower-agent has been removed."
else
  echo "watchtower-agent was not installed; nothing needed removal."
fi
````

## File: scripts/prepare-watchtower-agent-release.mjs
````javascript
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, copyFile, readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const repoRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const publicDir = path.join(repoRoot, "public");
const releaseDir = path.join(repoRoot, ".release", "watchtower-agent");
const versionFile = path.join(repoRoot, "shared", "watchtower-agent-release.ts");

const versionSource = await readFile(versionFile, "utf8");
const versionMatch = versionSource.match(/version:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
const version = versionMatch?.[1];

if (!version) {
  throw new Error(`Could not determine release version from ${versionFile}`);
}

const tag = `v${version}`;
const outputDir = path.join(releaseDir, tag);
const assetNames = [
  "watchtower-agent-install.sh",
  "watchtower-agent.sh",
  "watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh",
];

await mkdir(outputDir, { recursive: true });

const checksumLines = [];

for (const assetName of assetNames) {
  const sourcePath = path.join(publicDir, assetName);
  const buffer = await readFile(sourcePath);
  const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(buffer).digest("hex");
  checksumLines.push(`${sha256}  ${assetName}`);
  await copyFile(sourcePath, path.join(outputDir, assetName));
}

await writeFile(path.join(outputDir, "SHA256SUMS.txt"), `${checksumLines.join("\n")}\n`, "utf8");

console.log(`Prepared watchtower-agent release assets in ${outputDir}`);
console.log("Checksums:");
for (const line of checksumLines) {
  console.log(`  ${line}`);
}
console.log("");
console.log("Suggested GitHub CLI release command:");
console.log(
  `gh release create ${tag} "${path.join(outputDir, "watchtower-agent-install.sh")}" "${path.join(outputDir, "watchtower-agent.sh")}" "${path.join(outputDir, "watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh")}" "${path.join(outputDir, "SHA256SUMS.txt")}" --title "Watchtower Agent ${version}" --notes "Host agent release ${version}"`,
);
````

## File: shared/lib/diagnostics.ts
````typescript
function trimDiagnostic(value: string, maxLength = 160) {
  return value.length > maxLength ? `${value.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...` : value;
}

function decodeHtmlEntities(value: string) {
  return value
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'");
}

function summarizeHtmlDiagnostic(rawDetails: string) {
  const titleMatch = rawDetails.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  const title = titleMatch ? decodeHtmlEntities(titleMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()) : null;
  const isCloudflare = /cloudflare/i.test(rawDetails);

  if (title && isCloudflare) {
    return trimDiagnostic(`Cloudflare HTML error page: ${title}`);
  }

  if (title) {
    return trimDiagnostic(`HTML error page: ${title}`);
  }

  if (isCloudflare) {
    return "Cloudflare returned an HTML error page.";
  }

  return "The upstream service returned an HTML error page.";
}

export function summarizeDiagnosticText(rawDetails: string) {
  const normalized = rawDetails.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

  if (!normalized) {
    return "";
  }

  if (/<(?:!doctype|html|head|body)\b/i.test(rawDetails)) {
    return summarizeHtmlDiagnostic(rawDetails);
  }

  return trimDiagnostic(normalized);
}

export function parseDiagnosticPayload(rawDetails: string) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(rawDetails);
  } catch {
    return summarizeDiagnosticText(rawDetails);
  }
}

export function formatDiagnosticDetail(details: unknown) {
  if (details === null || details === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  if (typeof details === "string") {
    return summarizeDiagnosticText(details);
  }

  if (typeof details === "object") {
    const error =
      typeof (details as { error?: unknown }).error === "string"
        ? summarizeDiagnosticText((details as { error: string }).error)
        : null;

    if (error) {
      return error;
    }

    try {
      return trimDiagnostic(JSON.stringify(details));
    } catch {
      return "Upstream error details were unavailable.";
    }
  }

  return String(details);
}
````

````typescript
import { OpenAPIRegistry, OpenApiGeneratorV3 } from "@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi";
import { ProxyRequestParamsSchema, ProxyActionSchema, LogQueryParamsSchema, IdempotencyHeaderSchema } from "./proxy.js";
import { ProblemDetailsSchema } from "./error.js";

export const registry = new OpenAPIRegistry();

registry.registerComponent('securitySchemes', 'bearerAuth', {
  type: 'http',
  scheme: 'bearer',
  bearerFormat: 'JWT',
});

registry.registerPath({
  method: 'post',
  path: '/api/docker-proxy',
  summary: 'Proxy Docker commands to a host',
  tags: ['Docker'],
  security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
  request: {
    headers: IdempotencyHeaderSchema,
    body: {
      content: {
        'application/json': {
          schema: ProxyRequestParamsSchema
        }
      }
    }
  },
  responses: {
    200: {
      description: 'Successful proxy response',
      content: {
        'application/json': {
          schema: {
            type: 'object'
          }
        }
      }
    },
    400: {
      description: 'Bad request or missing required fields',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    403: {
      description: 'Access denied',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    404: {
      description: 'Resource not found',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    500: {
      description: 'Internal Server Error',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    502: {
      description: 'Proxy downstream error',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    }
  }
});

export function generateOpenAPI() {
  const generator = new OpenApiGeneratorV3(registry.definitions);
  return generator.generateDocument({
    openapi: '3.0.0',
    info: {
      version: '1.0.0',
      title: 'Docker Watchtower Dashboard APIs',
      description: 'Proxy and control endpoints for remote Docker management',
    },
    servers: [{ url: 'https://docker.watchtower.dash.local' }]
  });
}
````

````typescript
import { Loader2, ShieldPlus } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import type { AlertEvent } from "@/types/database";

type AlertRow = AlertEvent & { href?: string };

function formatEventTime(value: string | null) {
  return value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString() : "Never";
}

function describeResource(alert: AlertRow) {
  const metadata = alert.metadata ?? {};
  const hostName = typeof metadata.host_name === "string" ? metadata.host_name : null;
  const containerName = typeof metadata.container_name === "string" ? metadata.container_name : null;

  if (containerName && hostName) return `${containerName} on ${hostName}`;
  if (hostName) return hostName;
  return alert.source_ref;
}

export function ActiveAlertsTable({
  alerts,
  canManage,
  onAcknowledge,
  onResolve,
  onCreateIncident,
  pendingId,
}: {
  alerts: AlertRow[];
  canManage: boolean;
  pendingId?: string | null;
  onAcknowledge: (id: string) => void;
  onResolve: (id: string) => void;
  onCreateIncident: (alert: AlertRow) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Active Alerts</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Persisted alert state with acknowledgement, resolution, and incident escalation.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow className="hover:bg-transparent">
            <TableHead>Alert</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Severity</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Affected Resource</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Last Seen</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {alerts.length === 0 ? (
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell colSpan={6} className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                No alerts match the current view.
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ) : (
            alerts.map((alert) => (
              <TableRow key={alert.id}>
                <TableCell className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="font-medium">{alert.title}</div>
                  <div className="max-w-xl text-xs text-muted-foreground">{alert.message}</div>
                  <Link to={alert.href || "/app/alerts"} className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline">
                    Open affected resource
                  </Link>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell><StatusBadge status={alert.severity} /></TableCell>
                <TableCell><StatusBadge status={alert.status} /></TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{describeResource(alert)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{formatEventTime(alert.last_seen_at)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">
                    {canManage ? (
                      <>
                        {alert.status === "open" ? (
                          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onAcknowledge(alert.id)} disabled={pendingId === alert.id}>
                            {pendingId === alert.id ? <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : null}
                            Acknowledge
                          </Button>
                        ) : null}
                        {alert.status !== "resolved" ? (
                          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onResolve(alert.id)} disabled={pendingId === alert.id}>
                            Resolve
                          </Button>
                        ) : null}
                        {!alert.incident_id ? (
                          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onCreateIncident(alert)} disabled={pendingId === alert.id}>
                            <ShieldPlus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            Incident
                          </Button>
                        ) : null}
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Read only</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))
          )}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
              incidents.map((incident) => (
                <div key={incident.id} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/20 p-3">
                  <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="font-medium">{incident.title}</span>
                    <StatusBadge status={incident.status} />
                  </div>
                  {incident.summary ? <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{incident.summary}</p> : null}
                  <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Opened {new Date(incident.opened_at).toLocaleString()}</div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
            <Clock3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Alert History
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {history.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Alert history will appear here as signals are detected and resolved.</p>
            ) : (
              history.slice(0, 6).map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/20 p-3">
                  <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">

                    <StatusBadge status={item.status} />

                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{item.message}</p>
                  <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <span>{new Date(item.updated_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    <Link to={item.href || "/app/alerts"} className="text-primary hover:underline">Open resource</Link>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import type { AlertRule } from "@/types/database";
import type { AlertConditionType, AlertRuleFormValues, AlertSeverity } from "@/types/alerts";

const CONDITION_OPTIONS: Array<{ value: AlertConditionType; label: string }> = [
  { value: "host_offline", label: "Host offline" },
  { value: "container_exited", label: "Container exited" },
  { value: "container_restart_loop", label: "Restart loop" },
  { value: "cpu_usage", label: "CPU threshold" },
  { value: "memory_usage", label: "Memory threshold" },
];

const SEVERITY_OPTIONS: AlertSeverity[] = ["info", "warning", "error", "critical"];
const CHANNEL_OPTIONS = ["slack", "email", "webhook"];

function toInitialValues(rule?: AlertRule | null): AlertRuleFormValues {
  return {
    name: rule?.name ?? "",
    condition_type: rule?.condition_type ?? "host_offline",
    threshold_value: rule?.threshold_value ?? null,
    threshold_window_minutes: rule?.threshold_window_minutes ?? 5,
    severity: rule?.severity ?? "warning",
    notification_channels: rule?.notification_channels ?? ["slack"],
    enabled: rule?.enabled ?? true,
  };
}

export function AlertRuleDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  rule,
  saving,
  slackDestinationsCount,
  webhookDestinationsCount,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  rule?: AlertRule | null;
  saving?: boolean;
  slackDestinationsCount?: number;
  webhookDestinationsCount?: number;
  onSubmit: (values: AlertRuleFormValues) => void;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<AlertRuleFormValues>(toInitialValues(rule));

  useEffect(() => {
    setValues(toInitialValues(rule));
  }, [rule, open]);

  const requiresThreshold = values.condition_type === "cpu_usage" || values.condition_type === "memory_usage";

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{rule ? "Edit alert rule" : "Create alert rule"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Rules are stored per organization and evaluated against connected hosts and containers.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid gap-4 py-2 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
            <Label htmlFor="rule-name">Rule name</Label>
            <Input id="rule-name" value={values.name} onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, name: event.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. High CPU usage" />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Condition</Label>
            <Select value={values.condition_type} onValueChange={(value) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, condition_type: value as AlertConditionType }))}>
              <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {CONDITION_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Severity</Label>
            <Select value={values.severity} onValueChange={(value) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, severity: value as AlertSeverity }))}>
              <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {SEVERITY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>{option}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="rule-window">Window (minutes)</Label>
            <Input
              id="rule-window"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              value={values.threshold_window_minutes}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, threshold_window_minutes: Math.max(1, Number(event.target.value) || 1) }))}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="rule-threshold">Threshold</Label>
            <Input
              id="rule-threshold"
              type="number"
              value={values.threshold_value ?? ""}
              disabled={!requiresThreshold}
              placeholder={requiresThreshold ? "85" : "Not required"}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({
                ...current,
                threshold_value: event.target.value === "" ? null : Number(event.target.value),
              }))}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
            <Label>Notification channels</Label>
            <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/30 p-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              {CHANNEL_OPTIONS.map((channel) => {
                const checked = values.notification_channels.includes(channel);
                return (
                  <label key={channel} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm capitalize">
                    <Checkbox
                      checked={checked}
                      onCheckedChange={(next) =>
                        setValues((current) => ({
                          ...current,
                          notification_channels: next
                            ? [...current.notification_channels, channel]
                            : current.notification_channels.filter((item) => item !== channel),
                        }))
                      }
                    />
                    {channel}
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            {values.notification_channels.includes("slack") && (slackDestinationsCount ?? 0) === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-warning">No Slack destinations are configured yet. Rules can still be saved, but Slack notifications won&apos;t be sent until Settings &gt; Notifications is configured.</p>
            ) : null}
            {values.notification_channels.includes("webhook") && (webhookDestinationsCount ?? 0) === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-warning">No webhook destinations are configured yet. Rules can still be saved, but deliveries won&apos;t be sent until Settings &gt; Webhooks is configured.</p>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-3 md:col-span-2">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Rule enabled</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disabled rules stay stored but won’t generate alerts.</p>
            </div>
            <Switch checked={values.enabled} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, enabled: checked }))} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => onSubmit(values)} disabled={saving || !values.name.trim() || values.notification_channels.length === 0}>
            {saving ? "Saving..." : rule ? "Save changes" : "Create rule"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

## File: src/components/alerts/AlertRulesPanel.tsx
````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { Plus, Settings2 } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import { AlertRuleDialog } from "@/components/alerts/AlertRuleDialog";
import type { AlertRule } from "@/types/database";
import type { AlertRuleFormValues } from "@/types/alerts";

function formatCondition(rule: AlertRule) {
  if (rule.condition_type === "cpu_usage") return `CPU > ${rule.threshold_value ?? 85}% for ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}m`;
  if (rule.condition_type === "memory_usage") return `Memory > ${rule.threshold_value ?? 90}% for ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}m`;
  if (rule.condition_type === "host_offline") return `Host state unhealthy for ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}m`;
  if (rule.condition_type === "container_exited") return "Container exit detected";
  return "Container restart loop detected";
}

export function AlertRulesPanel({
  rules,
  canManage,
  saving,
  slackDestinationsCount,
  webhookDestinationsCount,
  onCreate,
  onUpdate,
}: {
  rules: AlertRule[];
  canManage: boolean;
  saving?: boolean;
  slackDestinationsCount?: number;
  webhookDestinationsCount?: number;
  onCreate: (values: AlertRuleFormValues) => void;
  onUpdate: (ruleId: string, values: Partial<AlertRuleFormValues>) => void;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingRule, setEditingRule] = useState<AlertRule | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = (values: AlertRuleFormValues) => {
    if (editingRule) {
      onUpdate(editingRule.id, values);
    } else {
      onCreate(values);
    }
    setOpen(false);
    setEditingRule(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Alert Rules</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Organization-level rules for host health, container lifecycle, and resource thresholds.</p>
          </div>
          {canManage ? (
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setEditingRule(null); setOpen(true); }}>
              <Plus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Create rule
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="divide-y divide-border">
          {rules.map((rule) => (
            <div key={rule.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="font-medium">{rule.name}</span>
                  <StatusBadge status={rule.enabled ? "running" : "paused"} />
                  <StatusBadge status={rule.severity} />
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{formatCondition(rule)}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Channels: {rule.notification_channels.join(", ") || "none"}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {canManage ? (
                  <>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setEditingRule(rule); setOpen(true); }}>
                      <Settings2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Edit
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={saving} onClick={() => onUpdate(rule.id, { enabled: !rule.enabled })}>
                      {rule.enabled ? "Pause" : "Enable"}
                    </Button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Read only</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <AlertRuleDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        rule={editingRule}
        saving={saving}
        slackDestinationsCount={slackDestinationsCount}
        webhookDestinationsCount={webhookDestinationsCount}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      />
    </>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
````
````typescript
import { LucideIcon, ArrowUpRight, ArrowDownRight } from "lucide-react";

interface KPICardProps {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  subtext?: string;
  trend?: {
    value: string | number;
    type: "positive" | "negative" | "neutral";
  };
  status?: "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | "neutral";
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  className?: string;
}

export function KPICard({ 
  label, 
  value, 
  subtext, 
  trend, 
  status = "neutral", 
  icon: Icon, 
  className 
}: KPICardProps) {
  const statusColors = {
    success: "bg-success/20 text-success",
    warning: "bg-warning/20 text-warning",
    destructive: "bg-destructive/20 text-destructive",
    neutral: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
  };

  const dotColors = {
    success: "bg-success",
    warning: "bg-warning",
    destructive: "bg-destructive",
    neutral: "bg-muted-foreground",
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card p-4 flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[120px] transition-all hover:border-primary/30 group", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className={cn("w-2 h-2 rounded-full", dotColors[status])} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest">{label}</span>
        </div>
        {Icon && <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />}
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
          <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">{value}</span>
          {trend && (
            <div className={cn("flex items-center text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded", 
              trend.type === "positive" ? "text-success bg-success/10" : 
              trend.type === "negative" ? "text-destructive bg-destructive/10" : 
              "text-muted-foreground bg-muted"
            )}>
              {trend.type === "positive" ? <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3 mr-0.5" /> : 
               trend.type === "negative" ? <ArrowDownRight className="h-3 w-3 mr-0.5" /> : null}
              {trend.value}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {subtext && <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1">{subtext}</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````
