````typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { formatDistanceToNowStrict, parseISO, isValid } from "date-fns";
import { Search, AlertTriangle, Clock3, Info, TerminalSquare, RefreshCw, XCircle } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type LogTone = "error" | "warning" | "info" | "neutral";
type TimeRangeValue = "all" | "5m" | "15m" | "1h" | "6h" | "24h";

interface LogConsoleProps {
  logs: string[];
  loading?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  heightClassName?: string;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
  refreshLabel?: string;
}

interface ParsedLogLine {
  raw: string;
  message: string;
  timestamp: string | null;
  timestampDate: Date | null;
  relativeTime: string | null;
  tone: LogTone;
}

const timeRangeOptions: Array<{ value: TimeRangeValue; label: string; minutes: number | null }> = [
  { value: "all", label: "All time", minutes: null },
  { value: "5m", label: "Last 5m", minutes: 5 },
  { value: "15m", label: "Last 15m", minutes: 15 },
  { value: "1h", label: "Last 1h", minutes: 60 },
  { value: "6h", label: "Last 6h", minutes: 360 },
  { value: "24h", label: "Last 24h", minutes: 1440 },
];

function parseLogLine(line: string): ParsedLogLine {
  const match = line.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T[^\s]+)\s+(.*)$/);
  const timestamp = match?.[1] ?? null;
  const message = match?.[2] ?? line;
  const lower = message.toLowerCase();
  const parsedTimestamp = timestamp ? parseISO(timestamp) : null;
  const timestampDate = parsedTimestamp && isValid(parsedTimestamp) ? parsedTimestamp : null;
  const relativeTime =
    timestampDate
      ? formatDistanceToNowStrict(timestampDate, { addSuffix: true })
      : null;

  let tone: LogTone = "neutral";
  if (/\b(error|fatal|panic|exception|failed|traceback)\b/.test(lower)) {
    tone = "error";
  } else if (/\b(warn|warning|retry|timeout|deprecated)\b/.test(lower)) {
    tone = "warning";
  } else if (/\b(info|ready|started|listening|connected|healthy|ok)\b/.test(lower)) {
    tone = "info";
  }

  return { raw: line, message, timestamp, timestampDate, relativeTime, tone };
}

const toneStyles: Record<LogTone, string> = {
  error: "border-l-destructive/70 bg-destructive/[0.06]",
  warning: "border-l-warning/70 bg-warning/[0.06]",
  info: "border-l-primary/60 bg-primary/[0.05]",
  neutral: "border-l-border bg-transparent",
};

const toneBadgeStyles: Record<LogTone, string> = {
  error: "text-destructive bg-destructive/10 border-destructive/20",
  warning: "text-warning bg-warning/10 border-warning/20",
  info: "text-primary bg-primary/10 border-primary/20",
  neutral: "text-muted-foreground bg-secondary/70 border-border",
};

export function LogConsole({
  logs,
  loading = false,
  title = "Logs",
  emptyMessage = "No logs available.",
  heightClassName = "h-[520px]",
  onRefresh,
  refreshLabel = "Refresh",
}: LogConsoleProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [timestampFilter, setTimestampFilter] = useState("");
  const [activeTone, setActiveTone] = useState<LogTone | null>(null);
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<TimeRangeValue>("all");

  const parsedLogs = useMemo(() => logs.map(parseLogLine), [logs]);
  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    const messageNeedle = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const timestampNeedle = timestampFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
    const selectedRange = timeRangeOptions.find((option) => option.value === timeRange);
    const cutoff = selectedRange?.minutes ? Date.now() - selectedRange.minutes * 60_000 : null;

    return parsedLogs.filter((line) => {
      const matchesTone = !activeTone || line.tone === activeTone;
      const matchesMessage = !messageNeedle || line.raw.toLowerCase().includes(messageNeedle);
      const matchesTimestamp =
        !timestampNeedle ||
        line.timestamp?.toLowerCase().includes(timestampNeedle) ||
        line.relativeTime?.toLowerCase().includes(timestampNeedle);
      const matchesTimeRange =
        !cutoff || (line.timestampDate ? line.timestampDate.getTime() >= cutoff : false);

      return matchesTone && matchesMessage && matchesTimestamp && matchesTimeRange;
    });
  }, [activeTone, parsedLogs, search, timeRange, timestampFilter]);

  const severityCounts = useMemo(
    () =>
      parsedLogs.reduce(
        (acc, line) => {
          acc[line.tone] += 1;
          return acc;
        },
        { error: 0, warning: 0, info: 0, neutral: 0 } as Record<LogTone, number>,
      ),
    [parsedLogs],
  );

  const severityMeta: Array<{ tone: LogTone; label: string; count: number; icon: typeof XCircle }> = [
    { tone: "error", label: "errors", count: severityCounts.error, icon: XCircle },
    { tone: "warning", label: "warnings", count: severityCounts.warning, icon: AlertTriangle },
    { tone: "info", label: "info", count: severityCounts.info, icon: Info },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="border-b border-border bg-card/90 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <TerminalSquare className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              <span>{filteredLogs.length} visible</span>
              <span>{logs.length} total</span>
              {severityMeta.map(({ tone, label, count, icon: Icon }) => (
                <button
                  key={tone}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveTone((current) => (current === tone ? null : tone))}
                  className={cn(
                    "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 transition-colors",
                    toneBadgeStyles[tone],
                    activeTone === tone && "ring-1 ring-current",
                    activeTone && activeTone !== tone && "opacity-50",
                  )}
                  title={activeTone === tone ? `Clear ${label} filter` : `Filter to ${label}`}
                >
                  <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />
                  {count} {label}
                </button>
              ))}
              {activeTone ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveTone(null)}
                  className="rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
                >
                  Clear level
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:min-w-[34rem]">
            <div className="relative min-w-[220px] flex-1 sm:w-72">
              <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Filter message text..."
                className="h-9 border-white/10 bg-background/70 pl-8 text-sm"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-2.5">
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">
                <Clock3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Time Window
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {timeRangeOptions.map((option) => (
                    <button
                      key={option.value}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setTimeRange(option.value)}
                      className={cn(
                        "rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
                        timeRange === option.value
                          ? "border-primary/50 bg-primary/15 text-primary shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15)]"
                          : "border-white/10 bg-background/60 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground",
                      )}
                    >
                      {option.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                  <Select value={timeRange} onValueChange={(value) => setTimeRange(value as TimeRangeValue)}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="h-9 border-white/10 bg-background/70 text-sm sm:w-[160px]">
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Choose range" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {timeRangeOptions.map((option) => (
                        <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                          {option.label}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                  <Input
                    value={timestampFilter}
                    onChange={(event) => setTimestampFilter(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Match exact timestamp or relative label..."
                    className="h-9 border-white/10 bg-background/70 text-sm"
                  />
                  {onRefresh ? (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onRefresh} className="gap-1.5">
                      <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      {refreshLabel}
                    </Button>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex h-40 items-center justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading logs...</div>
      ) : logs.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{emptyMessage}</div>
      ) : filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No log lines match the current filter.</div>
      ) : (
        <ScrollArea className={cn("bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,14,18,0.9),rgba(7,10,14,0.96))]", heightClassName)}>
          <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
            {filteredLogs.map((line, index) => (
              <div
                key={`${line.raw}-${index}`}
                className={cn(
                  "grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-3 border-l-2 px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors hover:bg-white/[0.03]",
                  toneStyles[line.tone],
                )}
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col items-end gap-1 text-right">
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-muted-foreground/70">
                    {String(index + 1).padStart(3, "0")}
                  </span>
                  <span className={cn("rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em]", toneBadgeStyles[line.tone])}>
                    {line.tone}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
                  {line.timestamp ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-primary/80">
                      <span>{line.timestamp}</span>
                      {line.relativeTime ? (
                        <span className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">
                          {line.relativeTime}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                  <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono text-[12px] leading-6 text-foreground/92">
                    {line.message}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

    webhook_url: "",
    enabled: destination?.enabled ?? true,
  };
}

export function SlackDestinationDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  destination,
  saving,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  destination?: SlackDestination | null;
  saving?: boolean;
  onSubmit: (values: SlackDestinationFormValues) => void;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<SlackDestinationFormValues>(toInitialValues(destination));

  useEffect(() => {
    setValues(toInitialValues(destination));
  }, [destination, open]);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{destination ? "Edit Slack destination" : "Add Slack destination"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Add a Slack Incoming Webhook URL to send alert notifications into a Slack channel.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid gap-4 py-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="slack-name">Name</Label>
            <Input
              id="slack-name"
              value={values.name}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, name: event.target.value }))}
              placeholder="Ops channel"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="slack-webhook-url">Slack Incoming Webhook URL</Label>
            <Input
              id="slack-webhook-url"
              type="password"
              value={values.webhook_url}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, webhook_url: event.target.value }))}
              placeholder={destination ? "Leave blank to keep existing webhook URL" : "https://hooks.slack.com/services/..."}
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              The webhook URL is stored encrypted and used to send alert messages to Slack.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-3">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Destination enabled</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disabled Slack destinations stay stored but won&apos;t receive alert notifications.</p>
            </div>
            <Switch checked={values.enabled} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, enabled: checked }))} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => onSubmit(values)} disabled={saving || !values.name.trim() || (!destination && !values.webhook_url.trim())}>
            {saving ? "Saving..." : destination ? "Save changes" : "Create destination"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { MessageSquareShare, Plus, Send, Settings2 } from "lucide-react";

import type { SlackDestination } from "@/types/database";

function formatAttemptSummary(destination: SlackDestination) {
  const attempt = destination.latest_attempt;
  if (!attempt) return "No notifications sent yet";
  const status = attempt.succeeded ? "Success" : "Failed";
  const code = attempt.http_status ? ` (${attempt.http_status})` : "";
  const detail = attempt.error_summary ? ` - ${attempt.error_summary}` : "";
  return `${status}${code}${detail}`;
}

export function SlackDestinationsPanel({
  destinations,
  canManage,
  saving,
  testingId,
  onCreate,
  onUpdate,
  onTest,
}: {
  destinations: SlackDestination[];
  canManage: boolean;
  saving?: boolean;
  testingId?: string | null;
  onCreate: (values: SlackDestinationFormValues) => void;
  onUpdate: (id: string, values: Partial<SlackDestinationFormValues>) => void;
  onTest: (id: string) => void;
}) {

  const [editingDestination, setEditingDestination] = useState<SlackDestination | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = (values: SlackDestinationFormValues) => {
    if (editingDestination) {
      onUpdate(editingDestination.id, values);
    } else {
      onCreate(values);
    }
    setOpen(false);
    setEditingDestination(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-border px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">

            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Send real alert notifications to Slack channels using Incoming Webhooks.</p>
          </div>
          {canManage ? (
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setEditingDestination(null); setOpen(true); }}>
              <Plus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Add Slack destination
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {destinations.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={MessageSquareShare}
            title="No Slack destinations yet"
            description="Add a Slack Incoming Webhook URL to send warning, error, and critical alerts into your team channel."
            actionLabel={canManage ? "Add Slack destination" : undefined}
            onAction={canManage ? () => { setEditingDestination(null); setOpen(true); } : undefined}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-border">
            {destinations.map((destination) => (
              <div key={destination.id} className="flex flex-col gap-4 px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">

                    {destination.latest_attempt ? (
                      <StatusBadge status={destination.latest_attempt.succeeded ? "success" : "failed"} />
                    ) : null}
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatAttemptSummary(destination)}</div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {canManage ? (
                    <>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={testingId === destination.id} onClick={() => onTest(destination.id)}>
                        <Send className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        {testingId === destination.id ? "Testing..." : "Send test"}
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setEditingDestination(destination); setOpen(true); }}>
                        <Settings2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Edit
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={saving} onClick={() => onUpdate(destination.id, { enabled: !destination.enabled })}>
                        {destination.enabled ? "Disable" : "Enable"}
                      </Button>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Read only</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <SlackDestinationDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        destination={editingDestination}
        saving={saving}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      />
    </>
  );
}

  const status = attempt.succeeded ? "Success" : "Failed";
  const code = attempt.http_status ? ` (${attempt.http_status})` : "";
  const detail = attempt.error_summary ? ` - ${attempt.error_summary}` : "";
  return `${status}${code}${detail}`;
}

export function WebhookDestinationsPanel({
  destinations,
  canManage,
  saving,
  testingId,
  latestSecret,
  onCreate,
  onUpdate,
  onTest,
  onDismissSecret,
}: {
  destinations: WebhookDestination[];
  canManage: boolean;
  saving?: boolean;
  testingId?: string | null;
  latestSecret?: { destinationName: string; value: string } | null;
  onCreate: (values: WebhookDestinationFormValues) => void;
  onUpdate: (id: string, values: Partial<WebhookDestinationFormValues> & { regenerate_secret?: boolean }) => void;
  onTest: (id: string) => void;
  onDismissSecret: () => void;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingDestination, setEditingDestination] = useState<WebhookDestination | null>(null);

      onUpdate(editingDestination.id, values);
    } else {
      onCreate(values);
    }
    setOpen(false);
    setEditingDestination(null);
  };

  const handleCopySecret = async () => {
    if (!latestSecret?.value) return;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(latestSecret.value);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-border px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">

                <p className="mt-1 break-all font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{latestSecret.value}</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">This is only shown once. Copy it into your receiver before dismissing.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={handleCopySecret}>
                  <Copy className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Copy secret
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onDismissSecret}>Dismiss</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {destinations.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Webhook}
            title="No webhook destinations yet"
            description="Add an organization-level endpoint to start sending signed alert deliveries and test events."
            actionLabel={canManage ? "Add destination" : undefined}
            onAction={canManage ? () => { setEditingDestination(null); setOpen(true); } : undefined}
          />

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-medium">{destination.name}</span>

                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    <a href={destination.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-foreground">
                      {destination.url}
                      <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </a>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Secret preview: <span className="font-mono">{destination.signing_secret_preview}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatAttemptSummary(destination)}</div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {canManage ? (
                    <>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={testingId === destination.id} onClick={() => onTest(destination.id)}>
                        <Send className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        {testingId === destination.id ? "Testing..." : "Send test"}
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={saving} onClick={() => onUpdate(destination.id, { regenerate_secret: true })}>
                        <KeyRound className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Regenerate secret
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setEditingDestination(destination); setOpen(true); }}>
                        <Settings2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Edit
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={saving} onClick={() => onUpdate(destination.id, { enabled: !destination.enabled })}>
                        {destination.enabled ? "Disable" : "Enable"}
                      </Button>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Read only</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <WebhookDestinationDialog
        open={open}

        saving={saving}

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type StatusType = "healthy" | "running" | "success" | "paid" | "resolved" |
  "warning" | "acknowledged" | "paused" |
  "critical" | "unhealthy" | "firing" | "failed" | "investigating" |
  "offline" | "exited" | "restarting" | "identified" |
  "info" | "owner" | "admin" | "member" | "active" | "invited" | "developer" | "viewer" | "billing" |
  "production" | "staging" | "development";

const statusStyles: Record<string, string> = {
  healthy: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
  running: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
  success: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
  paid: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
  resolved: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",

  warning: "bg-warning/15 text-warning border-warning/20",
  acknowledged: "bg-warning/15 text-warning border-warning/20",
  paused: "bg-warning/15 text-warning border-warning/20",
  identified: "bg-warning/15 text-warning border-warning/20",

  critical: "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border-destructive/20",
  unhealthy: "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border-destructive/20",
  firing: "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border-destructive/20",
  failed: "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border-destructive/20",
  investigating: "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border-destructive/20",

  offline: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",
  exited: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",

  restarting: "bg-primary/15 text-primary border-primary/20",
  info: "bg-primary/15 text-primary border-primary/20",

  owner: "bg-primary/15 text-primary border-primary/20",
  admin: "bg-warning/15 text-warning border-warning/20",
  member: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",
  active: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
  invited: "bg-primary/15 text-primary border-primary/20",
  developer: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
  viewer: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",
  billing: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",

  production: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20",
  staging: "bg-warning/10 text-warning border-warning/20",
  development: "bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20",
};

const hasDot = ["healthy", "running", "warning", "critical", "unhealthy", "offline", "firing", "restarting", "exited", "paused", "active", "invited"];

export function StatusBadge({ status, className }: { status: StatusType; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={cn(
      "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md border capitalize",
      statusStyles[status] || "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",
      className
    )}>
      {hasDot.includes(status) && (
        <span className={cn("w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full", {
          "bg-success animate-pulse-dot": ["healthy", "running", "active"].includes(status),
          "bg-warning": status === "warning" || status === "paused",
          "bg-destructive": ["critical", "unhealthy", "firing"].includes(status),
          "bg-muted-foreground": ["offline", "exited"].includes(status),
          "bg-primary": status === "restarting" || status === "invited",
        })} />
      )}
      {status}
    </span>
  );
}
````

import * as React from "react";
import useEmblaCarousel, { type UseEmblaCarouselType } from "embla-carousel-react";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1];
type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>;
type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0];
type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1];

type CarouselProps = {
  opts?: CarouselOptions;
  plugins?: CarouselPlugin;
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void;
};

type CarouselContextProps = {
  carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0];
  api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1];
  scrollPrev: () => void;
  scrollNext: () => void;
  canScrollPrev: boolean;
  canScrollNext: boolean;
} & CarouselProps;

const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null);

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />");
  }

  return context;
}

const Carousel = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & CarouselProps>(
  ({ orientation = "horizontal", opts, setApi, plugins, className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
      {
        ...opts,
        axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
      },
      plugins,
    );
    const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false);
    const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false);

    const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
      if (!api) {
        return;
      }

      setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev());
      setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext());
    }, []);

    const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollPrev();
    }, [api]);

    const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollNext();
    }, [api]);

    const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
      (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
          event.preventDefault();
          scrollPrev();
        } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
          event.preventDefault();
          scrollNext();
        }
      },
      [scrollPrev, scrollNext],
    );

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api || !setApi) {
        return;
      }

      setApi(api);
    }, [api, setApi]);

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api) {
        return;
      }

      onSelect(api);
      api.on("reInit", onSelect);
      api.on("select", onSelect);

      return () => {
        api?.off("select", onSelect);
      };
    }, [api, onSelect]);

    return (
      <CarouselContext.Provider
        value={{
          carouselRef,
          api: api,
          opts,
          orientation: orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
          scrollPrev,
          scrollNext,
          canScrollPrev,
          canScrollNext,
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={ref}
          onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
          className={cn("relative", className)}
          role="region"
          aria-roledescription="carousel"
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </CarouselContext.Provider>
    );
  },
);
Carousel.displayName = "Carousel";

const CarouselContent = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel();

    return (
      <div ref={carouselRef} className="overflow-hidden">
        <div
          ref={ref}
          className={cn("flex", orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col", className)}
          {...props}
        />
      </div>
    );
  },
);
CarouselContent.displayName = "CarouselContent";

const CarouselItem = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { orientation } = useCarousel();

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="group"
        aria-roledescription="slide"
        className={cn("min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full", orientation === "horizontal" ? "pl-4" : "pt-4", className)}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
CarouselItem.displayName = "CarouselItem";

const CarouselPrevious = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>>(
  ({ className, variant = "outline", size = "icon", ...props }, ref) => {
    const { orientation, scrollPrev, canScrollPrev } = useCarousel();

    return (
      <Button
        ref={ref}
        variant={variant}
        size={size}
        className={cn(
          "absolute h-8 w-8 rounded-full",
          orientation === "horizontal"
            ? "-left-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"
            : "-top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
          className,
        )}
        disabled={!canScrollPrev}
        onClick={scrollPrev}
        {...props}
      >
        <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        <span className="sr-only">Previous slide</span>
      </Button>
    );
  },
);
CarouselPrevious.displayName = "CarouselPrevious";

const CarouselNext = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>>(
  ({ className, variant = "outline", size = "icon", ...props }, ref) => {
    const { orientation, scrollNext, canScrollNext } = useCarousel();

    return (
      <Button
        ref={ref}
        variant={variant}
        size={size}
        className={cn(
          "absolute h-8 w-8 rounded-full",

````typescript
import * as React from "react";
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: "", dark: ".dark" } as const;

export type ChartConfig = {
  [k in string]: {
    label?: React.ReactNode;
    icon?: React.ComponentType;
  } & ({ color?: string; theme?: never } | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> });
};

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig;
};

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null);

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />");
  }

  return context;
}

const ChartContainer = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    config: ChartConfig;
    children: React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>["children"];
  }
>(({ id, className, children, config, ...props }, ref) => {
  const uniqueId = React.useId();
  const chartId = `chart-${id || uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`;

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-chart={chartId}
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-none [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-none [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-none",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>{children}</RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  );
});
ChartContainer.displayName = "Chart";

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(([_, config]) => config.theme || config.color);

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color = itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] || itemConfig.color;
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null;
  })
  .join("\n")}
}
`,
          )
          .join("\n"),
      }}
    />
  );
};

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip;

const ChartTooltipContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
    React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
      hideLabel?: boolean;
      hideIndicator?: boolean;
      indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed";
      nameKey?: string;
      labelKey?: string;
    }
>(
  (
    {
      active,
      payload,
      className,
      indicator = "dot",
      hideLabel = false,
      hideIndicator = false,
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      labelClassName,
      formatter,
      color,
      nameKey,
      labelKey,
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart();

    const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
      if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
        return null;
      }

      const [item] = payload;
      const key = `${labelKey || item.dataKey || item.name || "value"}`;
      const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
      const value =
        !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
          ? config[label as keyof typeof config]?.label || label
          : itemConfig?.label;

      if (labelFormatter) {
        return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{labelFormatter(value, payload)}</div>;
      }

      if (!value) {
        return null;
      }

      return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>;
    }, [label, labelFormatter, payload, hideLabel, labelClassName, config, labelKey]);

    if (!active || !payload?.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot";

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
          className,
        )}
      >
        {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          {payload.map((item, index) => {
            const key = `${nameKey || item.name || item.dataKey || "value"}`;
            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
            const indicatorColor = color || item.payload.fill || item.color;

            return (
              <div
                key={item.dataKey}
                className={cn(
                  "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
                  indicator === "dot" && "items-center",
                )}
              >
                {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                  formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                      <itemConfig.icon />
                    ) : (
                      !hideIndicator && (
                        <div
                          className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-[--color-border] bg-[--color-bg]", {
                            "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
                            "w-1": indicator === "line",
                            "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent": indicator === "dashed",
                            "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                          })}
                          style={
                            {
                              "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                              "--color-border": indicatorColor,
                            } as React.CSSProperties
                          }
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                        nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center",
                      )}
                    >
                      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                        {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">{itemConfig?.label || item.name}</span>
                      </div>
                      {item.value && (
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums text-foreground">
                          {item.value.toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
ChartTooltipContent.displayName = "ChartTooltip";

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend;

const ChartLegendContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> &
    Pick<RechartsPrimitive.LegendProps, "payload" | "verticalAlign"> & {
      hideIcon?: boolean;
      nameKey?: string;
    }
>(({ className, hideIcon = false, payload, verticalAlign = "bottom", nameKey }, ref) => {
  const { config } = useChart();

  if (!payload?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn("flex items-center justify-center gap-4", verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3", className)}
    >
      {payload.map((item) => {
        const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || "value"}`;
        const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);

        return (
          <div
            key={item.value}
            className={cn("flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground")}
          >
            {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
              <itemConfig.icon />
            ) : (
              <div
                className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: item.color,
                }}
              />
            )}
            {itemConfig?.label}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});
ChartLegendContent.displayName = "ChartLegend";

// Helper to extract item config from a payload.
function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config: ChartConfig, payload: unknown, key: string) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload && typeof payload.payload === "object" && payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined;

  let configLabelKey: string = key;

  if (key in payload && typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string") {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string;
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] as string;
  }

  return configLabelKey in config ? config[configLabelKey] : config[key as keyof typeof config];
}

export { ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, ChartStyle };

import * as React from "react";
import * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label";
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot";
import { Controller, ControllerProps, FieldPath, FieldValues, FormProvider, useFormContext } from "react-hook-form";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

const Form = FormProvider;

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
> = {
  name: TName;
};

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>({} as FormFieldContextValue);

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  );
};

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext);
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext);
  const { getFieldState, formState } = useFormContext();

  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState);

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>");
  }

  const { id } = itemContext;

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  };
};

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string;
};

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>({} as FormItemContextValue);

const FormItem = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const id = React.useId();

    return (
      <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
        <div ref={ref} className={cn("space-y-2", className)} {...props} />
      </FormItemContext.Provider>
    );
  },
);
FormItem.displayName = "FormItem";

const FormLabel = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField();

  return <Label ref={ref} className={cn(error && "text-destructive", className)} htmlFor={formItemId} {...props} />;
});
FormLabel.displayName = "FormLabel";

const FormControl = React.forwardRef<React.ElementRef<typeof Slot>, React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Slot>>(
  ({ ...props }, ref) => {
    const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFormField();

    return (
      <Slot
        ref={ref}
        id={formItemId}
        aria-describedby={!error ? `${formDescriptionId}` : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`}
        aria-invalid={!!error}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
FormControl.displayName = "FormControl";

const FormDescription = React.forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField();

    return <p ref={ref} id={formDescriptionId} className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)} {...props} />;
  },
);
FormDescription.displayName = "FormDescription";

const FormMessage = React.forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>>(
  ({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField();
    const body = error ? String(error?.message) : children;

    if (!body) {
      return null;
    }

    return (
      <p ref={ref} id={formMessageId} className={cn("text-sm font-medium text-destructive", className)} {...props}>
        {body}
      </p>
    );
  },
);
FormMessage.displayName = "FormMessage";

export { useFormField, Form, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, FormField };
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";

export function LoginBackground() {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;

    // Check pre-reduced motion preference
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const prefersReducedMotion = mediaQuery.matches;

    // Determine particle count based on screen width
    // Capping at 800 to keep it very subtle and performant (user requested 600-1000)
    const particleCount = window.innerWidth < 768 ? 400 : 800;

    // 1. Scene Setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();

    // 2. Camera Setup
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      75,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      1000
    );
    camera.position.z = 40;

    // 3. Renderer Setup (Transparent background)
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      alpha: true,
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "low-power",
    });
    // Limit pixel ratio for performance
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    containerRef.current.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // 4. Geometry & Particles
    const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    const positions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);

    // Distribute particles in a wide 3D sphere/cloud
    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount * 3; i += 3) {
      // Create a spherical distribution cluster
      const radius = 100 * Math.cbrt(Math.random());
      const theta = Math.random() * 2 * Math.PI;
      const phi = Math.acos(2 * Math.random() - 1);

      const x = radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
      const y = radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
      const z = radius * Math.cos(phi);

      positions[i] = x;
      positions[i + 1] = y;
      positions[i + 2] = z;
    }

    geometry.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));

    // 5. Material
    // User constraint: muted cyan / blue-tinted white, low contrast, very low opacity
    const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
      size: 0.25,
      color: 0x88ccff, // Muted cyan/blue-tinted white
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.15, // Very low opacity to sit quietly behind
      blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
      depthWrite: false, // Prevents depth sorting issues with transparent particles
    });

    const particles = new THREE.Points(geometry, material);
    scene.add(particles);

    // 6. Animation & Mouse Parallax Constraints
    let animationFrameId: number;
    let targetX = 0;
    let targetY = 0;
    
    // Using simple variables mapped inside the event listener to respect resizing
    let windowHalfX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let windowHalfY = window.innerHeight / 2;

    const onDocumentMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
      // Very gentle parallax influence (10% of standard effect)
      targetX = (event.clientX - windowHalfX) * 0.02;
      targetY = (event.clientY - windowHalfY) * 0.02;
    };

    const onWindowResize = () => {
      windowHalfX = window.innerWidth / 2;
      windowHalfY = window.innerHeight / 2;
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    };

    window.addEventListener("resize", onWindowResize, false);
    document.addEventListener("mousemove", onDocumentMouseMove, false);

    const animate = () => {
      animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      // Natural slow drift
      if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
        particles.rotation.x += 0.0002;
        particles.rotation.y += 0.0004;

        // Gentle camera parallax smoothing
        camera.position.x += (targetX - camera.position.x) * 0.02;
        camera.position.y += (-targetY - camera.position.y) * 0.02;
        camera.lookAt(scene.position);
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    };

    animate();

    // Store DOM node reference for reliable cleanup
    const containerNode = containerRef.current;

    // 7. Cleanup
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onWindowResize);
      document.removeEventListener("mousemove", onDocumentMouseMove);
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);

      // Clean up Three.js objects
      geometry.dispose();
      material.dispose();
      renderer.dispose();

      if (containerNode && containerNode.contains(renderer.domElement)) {
        containerNode.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className="absolute inset-0 z-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none"
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
  );
}
````

import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar:state";
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7;
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem";
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem";
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem";
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b";

type SidebarContext = {
  state: "expanded" | "collapsed";
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  openMobile: boolean;
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void;
  isMobile: boolean;
  toggleSidebar: () => void;
};

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContext | null>(null);

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.");
  }

  return context;
}

const SidebarProvider = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
    open?: boolean;
    onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  }
>(({ defaultOpen = true, open: openProp, onOpenChange: setOpenProp, className, style, children, ...props }, ref) => {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false);

  // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  const open = openProp ?? _open;
  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
      const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value;
      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openState);
      } else {
        _setOpen(openState);
      }

      // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
      document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`;
    },
    [setOpenProp, open],
  );

  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open);
  }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile]);

  // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        toggleSidebar();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [toggleSidebar]);

  // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
  // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
  const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed";

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContext>(
    () => ({
      state,
      open,
      setOpen,
      isMobile,
      openMobile,
      setOpenMobile,
      toggleSidebar,
    }),
    [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar],
  );

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
        <div
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
              "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
              ...style,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          className={cn("group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full has-[[data-variant=inset]]:bg-sidebar", className)}
          ref={ref}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  );
});
SidebarProvider.displayName = "SidebarProvider";

const Sidebar = React.forwardRef<

  const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();

  if (collapsible === "none") {
    return (
      <div
        className={cn("flex h-full w-[--sidebar-width] flex-col bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground", className)}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
        <SheetContent
          data-sidebar="sidebar"

          }
          side={side}

  return (

        <div

        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>

## File: src/components/ui/toaster.tsx

import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { Toast, ToastClose, ToastDescription, ToastProvider, ToastTitle, ToastViewport } from "@/components/ui/toast";

export function Toaster() {
  const { toasts } = useToast();

  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      {toasts.map(function ({ id, title, description, action, ...props }) {
        return (
          <Toast key={id} {...props}>
            <div className="grid gap-1">
              {title && <ToastTitle>{title}</ToastTitle>}
              {description && <ToastDescription>{description}</ToastDescription>}
            </div>
            {action}
            <ToastClose />
          </Toast>
        );
      })}
      <ToastViewport />
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}

  variant: "default",

  React.ElementRef<typeof ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root>,

>(({ className, variant, size, children, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root ref={ref} className={cn("flex items-center justify-center gap-1", className)} {...props}>
    <ToggleGroupContext.Provider value={{ variant, size }}>{children}</ToggleGroupContext.Provider>
  </ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root>
));

ToggleGroup.displayName = ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root.displayName;

const ToggleGroupItem = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item> & VariantProps<typeof toggleVariants>
>(({ className, children, variant, size, ...props }, ref) => {
  const context = React.useContext(ToggleGroupContext);

  return (
    <ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        toggleVariants({
          variant: context.variant || variant,
          size: context.size || size,

        className,

      {...props}

import React from "react";
import { getAppOrigin, isAppHost } from "@/lib/hostname";

/**
 * Enforces that product routes are only accessible on the app subdomain.
 * Redirects exactly to the matching path on the app subdomain.
 * Safe fallback for localhost development.
 */
export function RequireAppSubdomain({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  if (isAppHost()) {
    return <>{children}</>;
  }

  const targetUrl = `${getAppOrigin()}${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}`;
  window.location.replace(targetUrl);
  return null;

}

  const { data: viewer, isLoading, error } = useViewerState();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );

    return <Navigate to="/app" replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

import * as React from "react";

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768;

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    };
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, []);

  return !!isMobile;
}

## File: src/hooks/use-toast.ts
````typescript
import * as React from "react";

import type { ToastActionElement, ToastProps } from "@/components/ui/toast";

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1;
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  action?: ToastActionElement;
};

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const;

let count = 0;

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  return count.toString();
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;

type Action =
  | {
      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"];
      toast: ToasterToast;
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"];
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>;
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"];
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"];
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    };

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[];
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return;
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    });
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
};

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      };

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) => (t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t)),
      };

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action;

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
        });
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t,
        ),
      };
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        };
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      };
  }
};

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = [];

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState);
  });
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">;

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId();

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    });
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id });

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss();
      },
    },
  });

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  };
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState);
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }, [state]);

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  };
}

export { useToast, toast };
````

````typescript
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import type { AlertItem, DashboardContainerSummary } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-types";
import { getHostAlertCopy, isUnhealthyHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";

export interface DashboardStats {
  hostsCount: number;
  connectedCount: number;
  unhealthyCount: number;
  containersCount: number;
  runningCount: number;
  stoppedCount: number;
  alerts: AlertItem[];
  containers: DashboardContainerSummary[];
}

type RawContainer = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is RawContainer {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function toStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const strings = value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string");
  return strings.length > 0 ? strings : undefined;
}

export function normalizeDashboardContainers(containers: unknown): DashboardContainerSummary[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(containers)) {
    return [];
  }

  return containers.flatMap((container) => {
    if (!isRecord(container)) {
      return [];
    }

    const id = typeof container.Id === "string" ? container.Id : null;
    if (!id) {
      return [];
    }

    return [
      {
        Id: id,
        State: typeof container.State === "string" ? container.State : "unknown",
        Names: toStringArray(container.Names),
        Image: typeof container.Image === "string" ? container.Image : undefined,
        _hostId: typeof container._hostId === "string" ? container._hostId : undefined,
        _hostName: typeof container._hostName === "string" ? container._hostName : undefined,
      },
    ];
  });
}

export function buildDashboardStats(hosts: DockerHost[], containers: unknown): DashboardStats {
  const normalizedContainers = normalizeDashboardContainers(containers);
  const connectedHosts = hosts.filter((host) => host.status === "connected");
  const unhealthyHosts = hosts.filter((host) => isUnhealthyHostStatus(host.status));
  const runningContainers = normalizedContainers.filter((container) => container.State === "running");
  const stoppedContainers = normalizedContainers.filter((container) => container.State !== "running");
  const exitedContainers = normalizedContainers.filter((container) => container.State === "exited");

  const alerts: AlertItem[] = [
    ...unhealthyHosts.map((host) => {
      const copy = getHostAlertCopy(host.status, host.name);

      return {
        id: `host-${host.id}`,
        type: "host" as const,
        severity: "error" as const,
        title: copy.title,
        description: copy.description,
        timestamp: host.last_seen_at ? "Seen recently" : "Never seen",
        href: `/app/hosts/${host.id}`,
      };
    }),
    ...exitedContainers.map((container) => ({
      id: `cont-exited-${container.Id}`,
      type: "container" as const,
      severity: "warning" as const,
      title: "Container Exited",
      description: `${container.Names?.[0]?.replace("/", "") || "Container"} is stopped and needs review.`,
      timestamp: "Current state",
      href: container._hostId ? `/app/containers/${container.Id.substring(0, 12)}?host=${container._hostId}` : "/app/containers",
    })),
    ...normalizedContainers
      .filter((container) => container.State === "restarting")
      .map((container) => ({
        id: `cont-${container.Id}`,
        type: "container" as const,
        severity: "warning" as const,
        title: "Container Restart Loop",
        description: `${container.Names?.[0]?.replace("/", "") || "Container"} is restarting frequently.`,
        timestamp: "Just now",
        href: container._hostId ? `/app/containers/${container.Id.substring(0, 12)}?host=${container._hostId}` : "/app/containers",
      })),
  ];

  return {
    hostsCount: hosts.length,
    connectedCount: connectedHosts.length,
    unhealthyCount: unhealthyHosts.length,
    containersCount: normalizedContainers.length,
    runningCount: runningContainers.length,
    stoppedCount: stoppedContainers.length,
    alerts,
    containers: normalizedContainers,
  };
}
````

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  getHostAlertCopy,
  getHostStatusAppearance,
  isReadableHostStatus,
  isUnhealthyHostStatus,
  normalizeHostStatus,
} from "@/lib/host-health-state";

describe("host-health-state", () => {
  it("normalizes supported statuses and falls back to unknown", () => {
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("CONNECTED")).toBe("connected");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("stale")).toBe("stale");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("Down")).toBe("down");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("weird-status")).toBe("unknown");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus(null)).toBe("unknown");
  });

  it("classifies readable host statuses", () => {
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("connected")).toBe(true);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("stale")).toBe(true);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("down")).toBe(false);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("disconnected")).toBe(false);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("error")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("classifies unhealthy host statuses", () => {
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("stale")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("error")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("unhealthy")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("down")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("disconnected")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("connected")).toBe(false);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("unknown-value")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("returns consistent appearance metadata for connected and offline states", () => {
    expect(getHostStatusAppearance("connected")).toMatchObject({
      isOnlineIcon: true,
      pillClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-success"),
      dotClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-success"),
    });

    expect(getHostStatusAppearance("down")).toMatchObject({
      isOnlineIcon: false,
      pillClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-destructive"),
      dotClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-destructive"),
    });

    expect(getHostStatusAppearance("stale")).toMatchObject({
      isOnlineIcon: false,
      pillClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-warning"),
      dotClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-warning"),
    });
  });

  it("returns status-aware alert copy", () => {
    expect(getHostAlertCopy("stale", "Prowlarr")).toEqual({
      title: "Host Heartbeat Stale",
      description: 'Host "Prowlarr" has not checked in recently. Metrics may be delayed until the next successful heartbeat.',
    });

    expect(getHostAlertCopy("down", "docker host")).toEqual({
      title: "Host Down",
      description: 'Host "docker host" appears offline. Check power, network reachability, and the local agent service.',
    });

    expect(getHostAlertCopy("unknown", "node-1")).toEqual({
      title: "Host Alert",
      description: 'Host "node-1" needs attention. Review connectivity and agent health.',
    });
  });
});

## File: src/lib/host-health-state.ts
````typescript
export const DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES = 5;
export const DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD = 3;

export type NormalizedHostStatus =
  | "connected"
  | "stale"
  | "error"
  | "unhealthy"
  | "down"
  | "disconnected"
  | "unknown";

export function normalizeHostStatus(status: string | null | undefined): NormalizedHostStatus {
  const normalized = String(status || "").toLowerCase();

  switch (normalized) {
    case "connected":
    case "stale":
    case "error":
    case "unhealthy":
    case "down":
    case "disconnected":
      return normalized;
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

export function isReadableHostStatus(status: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);
  return normalizedStatus === "connected" || normalizedStatus === "stale";
}

export function isUnhealthyHostStatus(status: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);
  return ["error", "disconnected", "down", "stale", "unhealthy"].includes(normalizedStatus);
}

export function getHostStatusAppearance(status: string | null | undefined): {
  pillClassName: string;
  dotClassName: string;
  isOnlineIcon: boolean;
} {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);

  switch (normalizedStatus) {
    case "connected":
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
        dotClassName: "bg-success shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(34,197,94,0.6)]",
        isOnlineIcon: true,
      };
    case "unhealthy":
    case "down":
    case "disconnected":
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border-destructive/20",
        dotClassName: "bg-destructive shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(239,68,68,0.45)]",
        isOnlineIcon: false,
      };
    case "stale":
    case "error":
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-warning/15 text-warning border-warning/20",
        dotClassName: "bg-warning shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,158,11,0.45)]",
        isOnlineIcon: false,
      };
    default:
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",
        dotClassName: "bg-muted-foreground/40",
        isOnlineIcon: false,
      };
  }
}

export function getHostAlertCopy(status: string | null | undefined, hostName: string): {
  title: string;
  description: string;
} {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);

  switch (normalizedStatus) {
    case "stale":
      return {
        title: "Host Heartbeat Stale",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" has not checked in recently. Metrics may be delayed until the next successful heartbeat.`,
      };
    case "unhealthy":
      return {
        title: "Host Unhealthy",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" is failing health checks repeatedly. Investigate the agent and host connectivity.`,
      };
    case "down":
      return {
        title: "Host Down",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" appears offline. Check power, network reachability, and the local agent service.`,
      };
    case "disconnected":
      return {
        title: "Host Disconnected",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" is disconnected from the dashboard. Check tunnel or agent connectivity.`,
      };
    case "error":
      return {
        title: "Host Error",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" returned an error during health checks. Review agent logs and connectivity.`,
      };
    default:
      return {
        title: "Host Alert",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" needs attention. Review connectivity and agent health.`,
      };
  }
}

export function parseStaleThresholdMinutes(rawValue: unknown): number {
  const n = Number(rawValue);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES;
  return Math.floor(n);
}

export function shouldMarkHostStale(
  host: { status?: string; last_seen_at?: string | null } | null | undefined,
  now: Date,
  staleThresholdMinutes: number,
): boolean {
  if (!host) return false;
  if (host.status !== "connected") return false;
  if (!host.last_seen_at) return false;

  const seenAt = new Date(host.last_seen_at);
  if (Number.isNaN(seenAt.getTime())) return false;

  const cutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - staleThresholdMinutes * 60_000);
  return seenAt < cutoff;
}

export function failureStatusForCount(failureCount: number, unhealthyThreshold: number): "error" | "unhealthy" {
  return failureCount >= unhealthyThreshold ? "unhealthy" : "error";
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Hostname detection for subdomain-based routing.
 *
 * - `dockerdash.app`     => marketing
 * - `app.dockerdash.app` => product
 * - `docs.dockerdash.app` => documentation
 * - `localhost` / dev    => local development
 * - `*.netlify.app`      => preview deploys
 */

const APP_SUBDOMAIN = "app.dockerdash.app";
const DOCS_SUBDOMAIN = "docs.dockerdash.app";
const NETLIFY_PREVIEW_SUFFIX = ".netlify.app";

export function isLocalDev(): boolean {
  const host = window.location.hostname;
  return host === "localhost" || host === "127.0.0.1" || host.endsWith(".local");
}

export function isNetlifyPreview(): boolean {
  return window.location.hostname.endsWith(NETLIFY_PREVIEW_SUFFIX);
}

export function isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled(): boolean {
  return isNetlifyPreview() && import.meta.env.VITE_PREVIEW_BYPASS_AUTH === "true";
}

export function isAppHost(): boolean {
  return isLocalDev() || isNetlifyPreview() || window.location.hostname === APP_SUBDOMAIN;
}

export function isAppSubdomain(): boolean {
  if (isLocalDev()) return false;
  return window.location.hostname === APP_SUBDOMAIN;
}

export function isDocsSubdomain(): boolean {
  if (isLocalDev()) return false;
  return window.location.hostname === DOCS_SUBDOMAIN;
}

export function getAppOrigin(): string {
  if (isLocalDev() || isNetlifyPreview()) {
    return window.location.origin;
  }

  return `https://${APP_SUBDOMAIN}`;
}

export function getPublicOrigin(): string {
  if (isLocalDev() || isNetlifyPreview()) {
    return window.location.origin;
  }

  return "https://dockerdash.app";
}
````

````typescript
export type OnboardingStatus = 'not_started' | 'skipped' | 'completed' | null;

export function normalizeOnboardingStatus(value: unknown): OnboardingStatus {
  if (value === 'not_started' || value === 'skipped' || value === 'completed') {
    return value;
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Single source of truth for route gating behavior.
 *
 * Rules:
 * - No org yet -> onboarding required
 * - not_started -> onboarding required
 * - skipped/completed -> onboarding not required
 */
export function deriveNeedsOnboarding(hasOrgs: boolean, onboardingStatus: OnboardingStatus): boolean {
  if (!hasOrgs) return false;
  return onboardingStatus !== 'skipped' && onboardingStatus !== 'completed';
}
````

      : Math.max(STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(deployment.status), 0);
  const activeCopy = STATUS_COPY[deployment.status];

  return (

curl -fsSL https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-main.gpg | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare.gpg >/dev/null
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare.gpg] https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflared $(lsb_release -cs) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudflared.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install cloudflared`}

            <CopyBlock

cloudflared tunnel route dns watchtower-agent docker.your-team.com
