async function mutateUserApproval(userId: string, approved: boolean, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT id, is_approved
    FROM public.users
    WHERE id = ${userId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (before.length === 0) return json({ error: "User not found" }, 404);

  const updated = await sql`
    UPDATE public.users
    SET is_approved = ${approved}
    WHERE id = ${userId}
    RETURNING id, is_approved
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: approved ? "approve-user" : "revoke-user-approval",
    targetType: "user",
    targetId: userId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    afterState: updated[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    requestMetadata: { ip: req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") || null },
  });

  return json({ user: updated[0] });
}

async function mutateUserAccess(userId: string, mode: "suspend" | "unsuspend" | "hard-disable" | "hard-enable", req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  const notes = typeof body.internal_notes === "string" ? body.internal_notes.trim() : null;
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const users = await sql`
    SELECT u.id, u.clerk_user_id, u.email, COALESCE(uac.is_suspended, false) AS is_suspended, COALESCE(uac.is_hard_disabled, false) AS is_hard_disabled
    FROM public.users u
    LEFT JOIN public.user_access_controls uac ON uac.user_id = u.id
    WHERE u.id = ${userId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (users.length === 0) return json({ error: "User not found" }, 404);

  const before = users[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
  const user = users[0];
  const isSuspended = mode === "suspend" ? true : mode === "unsuspend" ? false : Boolean(user.is_suspended);
  const isHardDisabled = mode === "hard-disable" ? true : mode === "hard-enable" ? false : Boolean(user.is_hard_disabled);
  const suspensionReason = mode === "suspend" || mode === "hard-disable" ? reason : null;

  if (user.clerk_user_id) {
    if (mode === "hard-disable") {
      await clerkClient.users.banUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
      await clerkClient.users.lockUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
    } else if (mode === "hard-enable") {
      await clerkClient.users.unbanUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
      await clerkClient.users.unlockUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
    }
  }

  const afterRows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.user_access_controls (
      user_id,
      is_suspended,
      is_hard_disabled,
      suspension_reason,
      internal_notes,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${userId},
      ${isSuspended},
      ${isHardDisabled},
      ${suspensionReason},
      ${notes},
      ${admin.auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      is_suspended = EXCLUDED.is_suspended,
      is_hard_disabled = EXCLUDED.is_hard_disabled,
      suspension_reason = EXCLUDED.suspension_reason,
      internal_notes = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.internal_notes, public.user_access_controls.internal_notes),
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
    RETURNING user_id, is_suspended, is_hard_disabled, suspension_reason, internal_notes
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: mode,
    targetType: "user",
    targetId: userId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before,
    afterState: afterRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  return json({ control: afterRows[0] });
}

async function addOrganizationBan(userId: string, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const organizationId = typeof body.organization_id === "string" ? body.organization_id : "";
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  if (!organizationId) return json({ error: "organization_id is required" }, 400);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT organization_id, user_id, reason
    FROM public.organization_user_bans
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId} AND user_id = ${userId}
  `;

  const afterRows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.organization_user_bans (organization_id, user_id, reason, created_by)
    VALUES (${organizationId}, ${userId}, ${reason}, ${admin.auth.userId})
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO UPDATE
    SET reason = EXCLUDED.reason, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, created_at = now()
    RETURNING organization_id, user_id, reason, created_at
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "add-org-ban",
    targetType: "organization-user-ban",
    targetId: `${organizationId}:${userId}`,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
    afterState: afterRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  return json({ ban: afterRows[0] }, 201);
}

async function removeOrganizationBan(userId: string, organizationId: string, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT organization_id, user_id, reason
    FROM public.organization_user_bans
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId} AND user_id = ${userId}
  `;
  if (before.length === 0) return json({ error: "Ban not found" }, 404);

  await sql`
    DELETE FROM public.organization_user_bans
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId} AND user_id = ${userId}
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "remove-org-ban",
    targetType: "organization-user-ban",
    targetId: `${organizationId}:${userId}`,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    afterState: {},
  });

  return json({ success: true });
}

async function mutateOrganizationLock(organizationId: string, locked: boolean, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT
      organization_id,
      COALESCE(is_locked, false) AS is_locked,
      lock_reason
    FROM public.organization_access_controls
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId}
  `;

  const afterRows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.organization_access_controls (
      organization_id,
      is_locked,
      lock_reason,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${organizationId},
      ${locked},
      ${locked ? reason : null},
      ${admin.auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      is_locked = EXCLUDED.is_locked,
      lock_reason = EXCLUDED.lock_reason,
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
    RETURNING organization_id, is_locked, lock_reason
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: locked ? "lock-organization" : "unlock-organization",
    targetType: "organization",
    targetId: organizationId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
    afterState: afterRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  return json({ organization_control: afterRows[0] });
}

async function updateOrganizationBilling(organizationId: string, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const plan = typeof body.plan === "string" ? body.plan : null;
  const subscriptionStatus = typeof body.subscription_status === "string" ? body.subscription_status : null;
  const currentPeriodEndsAt = toNullableTimestamp(body.current_period_ends_at);
  const cancelAtPeriodEnd = typeof body.cancel_at_period_end === "boolean" ? body.cancel_at_period_end : null;

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT
      o.id,
      o.plan,
      o.subscription_status,
      o.current_period_ends_at,
      o.cancel_at_period_end,
      o.paddle_subscription_id,
      o.paddle_customer_id,
      o.paddle_price_id,
      oac.plan_override,
      oac.subscription_status_override,
      oac.current_period_ends_at_override,
      oac.cancel_at_period_end_override
    FROM public.organizations o
    LEFT JOIN public.organization_access_controls oac ON oac.organization_id = o.id
    WHERE o.id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (before.length === 0) return json({ error: "Organization not found" }, 404);

  const [organization] = await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET
      plan = COALESCE(${plan}, plan),
      subscription_status = COALESCE(${subscriptionStatus}, subscription_status),
      current_period_ends_at = COALESCE(${currentPeriodEndsAt}, current_period_ends_at),
      cancel_at_period_end = COALESCE(${cancelAtPeriodEnd}, cancel_at_period_end),
      billing_updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    RETURNING id, plan, subscription_status, current_period_ends_at, cancel_at_period_end
  `;

  const [overrides] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.organization_access_controls (
      organization_id,
      plan_override,
      subscription_status_override,
      current_period_ends_at_override,
      cancel_at_period_end_override,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${organizationId},
      ${plan},
      ${subscriptionStatus},
      ${currentPeriodEndsAt},
      ${cancelAtPeriodEnd},
      ${admin.auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      plan_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.plan_override, public.organization_access_controls.plan_override),
      subscription_status_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.subscription_status_override, public.organization_access_controls.subscription_status_override),
      current_period_ends_at_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.current_period_ends_at_override, public.organization_access_controls.current_period_ends_at_override),
      cancel_at_period_end_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cancel_at_period_end_override, public.organization_access_controls.cancel_at_period_end_override),
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
    RETURNING organization_id, plan_override, subscription_status_override, current_period_ends_at_override, cancel_at_period_end_override
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "edit-billing",
    targetType: "organization",
    targetId: organizationId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    afterState: { organization, overrides },
  });

  return json({ organization, overrides });
}

async function mutateHostControl(hostId: string, mode: "quarantine" | "unquarantine" | "mark-needs-reconnect", req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT
      host_id,
      COALESCE(is_quarantined, false) AS is_quarantined,
      quarantine_reason,
      COALESCE(needs_reconnect, false) AS needs_reconnect
    FROM public.docker_host_admin_controls
    WHERE host_id = ${hostId}
  `;

  const afterRows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.docker_host_admin_controls (
      host_id,
      is_quarantined,
      quarantine_reason,
      needs_reconnect,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${hostId},
      ${mode === "quarantine"},
      ${mode === "quarantine" ? reason : null},
      ${mode === "mark-needs-reconnect"},
      ${admin.auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (host_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      is_quarantined = CASE
        WHEN ${mode} = 'quarantine' THEN true
        WHEN ${mode} = 'unquarantine' THEN false
        ELSE public.docker_host_admin_controls.is_quarantined
      END,
      quarantine_reason = CASE
        WHEN ${mode} = 'quarantine' THEN ${reason}
        WHEN ${mode} = 'unquarantine' THEN NULL
        ELSE public.docker_host_admin_controls.quarantine_reason
      END,
      needs_reconnect = CASE
        WHEN ${mode} = 'mark-needs-reconnect' THEN true
        ELSE public.docker_host_admin_controls.needs_reconnect
      END,
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
    RETURNING host_id, is_quarantined, quarantine_reason, needs_reconnect
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: mode,
    targetType: "docker-host",
    targetId: hostId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
    afterState: afterRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  return json({ host_control: afterRows[0] });
}

async function runAdminSecretMigration(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const scope = {
    organizationId: typeof body.organization_id === "string" ? body.organization_id : null,
    hostId: typeof body.host_id === "string" ? body.host_id : null,
    dryRun: toBoolean(body.dry_run),
  };

  const result = await runSecretMigration(scope);
  const [operation] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.admin_operation_runs (
      actor_user_id,
      operation_name,
      scope_type,
      scope_id,
      status,
      reason,
      metadata,
      result_summary
    )
    VALUES (
      ${admin.auth.userId},
      'migrate-secrets',
      ${scope.hostId ? "host" : scope.organizationId ? "organization" : "global"},
      ${scope.hostId ?? scope.organizationId ?? null},
      ${result.failedCount > 0 ? "completed-with-errors" : "completed"},
      ${reason},
      ${JSON.stringify(scope)}::jsonb,
      ${JSON.stringify(result)}::jsonb
    )
    RETURNING id, operation_name, scope_type, scope_id, status, reason, metadata, result_summary, created_at
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "migrate-secrets",
    targetType: "operation",
    targetId: String(operation.id),
    reason,
    beforeState: {},
    afterState: { result, operationId: operation.id },
  });

  return json({ success: true, result, operation: { ...operation, created_at: new Date(String(operation.created_at)).toISOString() } });
}

async function listNotifications() {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      n.id,
      n.organization_id,
      n.title,
      n.message,
      n.type,
      n.link,
      n.expires_at,
      n.created_at,
      u.email as created_by_email,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.notification_dismissals d WHERE d.notification_id = n.id)::int as dismiss_count
    FROM public.notifications n
    LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id = n.created_by
    ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 100
  `;
  return rows;
}

async function createNotification(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  
  const title = body.title?.trim();
  const message = body.message?.trim();
  const type = body.type || 'info';
  const organizationId = body.organizationId || null;
  const link = body.link?.trim() || null;
  const expiresAt = toNullableTimestamp(body.expiresAt);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);

  assertAdminReason(reason);
  if (!title || !message) throw new Error("Title and message are required");

  const [notification] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.notifications (
      organization_id, title, message, type, link, created_by, expires_at
    ) VALUES (
      ${organizationId}, ${title}, ${message}, ${type}, ${link}, ${admin.auth.userId}, ${expiresAt}
    )
    RETURNING id
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "create_notification",
    targetType: "notification",
    targetId: notification.id,
    reason,
    beforeState: {},
    afterState: { title, message, type, organizationId, link, expiresAt }
  });

  return { success: true, notificationId: notification.id };
}

async function deleteNotification(id: string, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);

  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const [notification] = await sql`
    SELECT * FROM public.notifications WHERE id = ${id}
  `;
  if (!notification) throw new Error("Notification not found");

  await sql`
    DELETE FROM public.notifications WHERE id = ${id}
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "delete_notification",
    targetType: "notification",
    targetId: id,
    reason,
    beforeState: { title: notification.title },
    afterState: {}
  });

  return { success: true };
}

export async function handleAdminRequest(req: Request) {
  // Build secure CORS headers based on request origin
  const corsHeaders = buildCorsHeaders(req);
  
  // Override the json helper to use CORS headers
  function json(data: unknown, status = 200) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAdminSchema();
    const parts = parsePath(req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 0) {
      return json(await getOverview());
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "overview") {
      return json(await getOverview());
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "users") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ users: await listUsers() });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "users") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const user = await getUserDetail(parts[1]);
      return user ? json({ user }) : json({ error: "User not found" }, 404);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "approve") return await mutateUserApproval(parts[1], true, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "revoke-approval") return await mutateUserApproval(parts[1], false, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "suspend") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "suspend", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "unsuspend") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "unsuspend", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "hard-disable") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "hard-disable", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "hard-enable") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "hard-enable", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "org-bans") return await addOrganizationBan(parts[1], req);
    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 4 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "org-bans") return await removeOrganizationBan(parts[1], parts[3], req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "organizations") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ organizations: await listOrganizations() });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "organizations") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const organization = await getOrganizationDetail(parts[1]);
      return organization ? json({ organization }) : json({ error: "Organization not found" }, 404);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "lock") return await mutateOrganizationLock(parts[1], true, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "unlock") return await mutateOrganizationLock(parts[1], false, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "billing") return await updateOrganizationBilling(parts[1], req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "reset-onboarding") return await resetOrganizationOnboarding(parts[1], req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "hosts") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ hosts: await listHosts() });
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "hosts" && parts[2] === "quarantine") return await mutateHostControl(parts[1], "quarantine", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "hosts" && parts[2] === "unquarantine") return await mutateHostControl(parts[1], "unquarantine", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "hosts" && parts[2] === "mark-needs-reconnect") return await mutateHostControl(parts[1], "mark-needs-reconnect", req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "audit-log") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ audit_log: await listAuditLog() });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "operations") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ operations: await listOperationRuns() });
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "migrate-secrets") return await runAdminSecretMigration(req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "unmatched") {
      return await listUnmatchedBillingEvents(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "match") {
      return await adminMatchBillingEvent(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "email-deliveries") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const url = new URL(req.url);
      const limitParam = Number(url.searchParams.get("limit") || 100);
      const limit = Number.isFinite(limitParam) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(300, Math.floor(limitParam))) : 100;
      return json({ deliveries: await listDonorEmailDeliveries(limit) });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "email-deliveries") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const delivery = await getDonorEmailDelivery(parts[2]);
      return delivery ? json({ delivery }) : json({ error: "Delivery not found" }, 404);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 4 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "email-deliveries" && parts[3] === "resend") {
      const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const body = await readBody(req);
      const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
      assertAdminReason(reason);
      return json(await resendDonorEmailDelivery({
        deliveryId: parts[2],
        actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
        actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
        reason,
      }));
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "notifications") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ notifications: await listNotifications() });
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "notifications") {
      return json(await createNotification(req));
    }

    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "notifications") {
      return json(await deleteNotification(parts[1], req));
    }

    return json({ error: "Method not allowed" }, 405);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    const lower = message.toLowerCase();
    const status = lower.includes("forbidden") ? 403 : lower.includes("unauthorized") ? 401 : 400;
    return json({ error: message }, status);
  }
}

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/alerts.mts">
import { sql } from './db.mjs';
import { decryptHostSecrets } from './crypto.mjs';
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl } from './host-url.mjs';
import type { AppAuthContext } from './auth.mjs';
import { deliverSlackAlerts } from './slack-delivery.mjs';
import { deliverAlertWebhooks } from './webhook-destinations.mjs';

type OrgRole = 'owner' | 'admin' | 'member' | 'viewer' | string;
type AlertSeverity = 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'critical';
type AlertStatus = 'open' | 'acknowledged' | 'resolved';
type AlertConditionType = 'host_offline' | 'container_exited' | 'container_restart_loop' | 'cpu_usage' | 'memory_usage';

interface AlertRuleRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  condition_type: AlertConditionType;
  resource_scope: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  threshold_value: number | string | null;
  threshold_window_minutes: number;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  notification_channels: string[] | null;
  enabled: boolean;
  created_by: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface DockerHostRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  host_url: string;
  connection_mode: string;
  docker_socket_path: string | null;
  status: string;
  last_seen_at: string | null;
  last_error: string | null;
}

interface ContainerRow {
  Id: string;
  Names?: string[];
  Image?: string;
  State?: string;
  Status?: string;
  _hostId: string;
  _hostName: string;
}

interface ContainerStatRow {
  containerId: string;
  hostId: string;
  cpu_percent: number;
  memory_usage: number;
  memory_limit: number;
}

interface DerivedAlertSignal {
  ruleId: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  sourceType: 'host' | 'container' | 'metric';
  sourceRef: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface AlertEventRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  rule_id: string | null;
  incident_id: string | null;
  fingerprint: string;
  source_type: 'host' | 'container' | 'metric' | 'system';
  source_ref: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  status: AlertStatus;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  first_seen_at: string;
  last_seen_at: string;
  acknowledged_at: string | null;
  acknowledged_by: string | null;
  resolved_at: string | null;
  resolved_by: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

const DEFAULT_RULE_DEFINITIONS: Array<{
  name: string;
  condition_type: AlertConditionType;
  threshold_value: number | null;
  threshold_window_minutes: number;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  notification_channels: string[];
}> = [
  { name: 'Host offline', condition_type: 'host_offline', threshold_value: null, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'critical', notification_channels: ['slack'] },
  { name: 'Container exited', condition_type: 'container_exited', threshold_value: null, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'warning', notification_channels: ['slack'] },
  { name: 'Restart loop detected', condition_type: 'container_restart_loop', threshold_value: 1, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'error', notification_channels: ['slack', 'email'] },
  { name: 'CPU usage threshold', condition_type: 'cpu_usage', threshold_value: 85, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'warning', notification_channels: ['email'] },
  { name: 'Memory usage threshold', condition_type: 'memory_usage', threshold_value: 90, threshold_window_minutes: 5, severity: 'warning', notification_channels: ['email'] },
];

function normalizeThresholdValue(value: number | string | null | undefined) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function normalizeChannels(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string');
}

function normalizeAlertRule(row: AlertRuleRow) {
  return {
    ...row,
    threshold_value: normalizeThresholdValue(row.threshold_value),
    notification_channels: normalizeChannels(row.notification_channels),
    resource_scope: row.resource_scope ?? { scope: 'organization' },
  };
}

function trimContainerName(container: Pick<ContainerRow, 'Names' | 'Id'>) {
  return container.Names?.[0]?.replace(/^\//, '') || container.Id.slice(0, 12);
}

function buildDockerRequest(
  host: Pick<DockerHostRow, 'host_url' | 'connection_mode' | 'docker_socket_path'>,
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
  dockerPath: string,
) {
  const base = host.host_url.replace(/\/$/, '');
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};

  if (secrets?.agent_api_key) headers['X-Agent-Key'] = secrets.agent_api_key;
  if (host.docker_socket_path && host.docker_socket_path !== '/var/run/docker.sock') headers['X-Docker-Socket'] = host.docker_socket_path;
  if (host.connection_mode === 'cloudflare_tunnel') {
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_id) headers['CF-Access-Client-Id'] = secrets.cf_service_token_id;
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_secret) headers['CF-Access-Client-Secret'] = secrets.cf_service_token_secret;
  }

  return { url: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, `/docker${dockerPath}`), headers };
}

async function dockerFetchJson<T>(
  host: Pick<DockerHostRow, 'host_url' | 'connection_mode' | 'docker_socket_path'>,
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
  dockerPath: string,
  timeoutMs = 5000,
): Promise<T | null> {
  try {
    const request = buildDockerRequest(host, secrets, dockerPath);
    const response = await fetch(request.url, { method: 'GET', headers: request.headers, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs) });
    if (!response.ok) return null;
    return (await response.json()) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function mapConcurrent<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  const results: R[] = [];
  let index = 0;
  const worker = async () => {
    while (index < items.length) {
      const current = index++;
      results[current] = await fn(items[current]);
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, worker));
  return results;
}

export async function getOrganizationRole(auth: AppAuthContext): Promise<OrgRole> {
  const memberships = await sql`
    SELECT role
    FROM organization_members
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND user_id = ${auth.userId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (memberships.length === 0) throw new Error('Access denied');
  return memberships[0].role;
}

export async function requireOrganizationAdmin(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);
  if (!['owner', 'admin'].includes(role)) throw new Error('Admin access required for active organization');
  return role;
}

export async function ensureDefaultAlertRules(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const existing = await sql`
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
  `;
  if (existing[0]?.count > 0) return;

  for (const rule of DEFAULT_RULE_DEFINITIONS) {
    await sql`
      INSERT INTO alert_rules (
        organization_id, name, condition_type, resource_scope, threshold_value,
        threshold_window_minutes, severity, notification_channels, enabled, created_by
      )
      VALUES (
        ${auth.orgId}, ${rule.name}, ${rule.condition_type}, ${{ scope: 'organization' }},
        ${rule.threshold_value}, ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}, ${rule.severity},
        ${JSON.stringify(rule.notification_channels)}, true, ${auth.userId}
      )
    `;
  }
}

export async function listAlertRules(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  await ensureDefaultAlertRules(auth);
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
  `;
  return (rows as AlertRuleRow[]).map(normalizeAlertRule);
}

async function listAccessibleHosts(auth: AppAuthContext): Promise<DockerHostRow[]> {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT h.*
    FROM docker_hosts h
    JOIN organization_members om ON h.organization_id = om.organization_id
    WHERE h.organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND om.user_id = ${auth.userId}
    ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
  `;
  return rows as DockerHostRow[];
}

async function loadHostSecrets(hostId: string) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT agent_api_key, cf_service_token_id, cf_service_token_secret
    FROM docker_host_secrets
    WHERE host_id = ${hostId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  return rows.length > 0 ? rows[0] : null;
}

async function fetchContainersForHosts(hosts: DockerHostRow[]): Promise<ContainerRow[]> {
  const collected: ContainerRow[] = [];
  await mapConcurrent(hosts, 4, async (host) => {
    const encryptedSecrets = await loadHostSecrets(host.id);
    const secrets = decryptHostSecrets(encryptedSecrets, host.id);
    const containers = await dockerFetchJson<any[]>(host, secrets, '/containers/json?all=true', 6000);
    if (!Array.isArray(containers)) return null;
    collected.push(...containers.map((container) => ({ ...container, _hostId: host.id, _hostName: host.name })));
    return null;
  });
  return collected;
}

async function fetchContainerStatsForHosts(hosts: DockerHostRow[]): Promise<ContainerStatRow[]> {
  const allStats: ContainerStatRow[] = [];
  await mapConcurrent(hosts.filter((host) => host.status === 'connected'), 3, async (host) => {
    const encryptedSecrets = await loadHostSecrets(host.id);
    const secrets = decryptHostSecrets(encryptedSecrets, host.id);
    const containers = await dockerFetchJson<any[]>(host, secrets, '/containers/json', 4000);
    if (!Array.isArray(containers)) return null;
    await mapConcurrent(containers.slice(0, 20), 4, async (container) => {
      const stats = await dockerFetchJson<any>(host, secrets, `/containers/${container.Id}/stats?stream=false`, 4000);
      if (!stats) return null;
      const cpuDelta = (stats.cpu_stats?.cpu_usage?.total_usage ?? 0) - (stats.precpu_stats?.cpu_usage?.total_usage ?? 0);
      const systemDelta = (stats.cpu_stats?.system_cpu_usage ?? 0) - (stats.precpu_stats?.system_cpu_usage ?? 0);
      const onlineCpus = stats.cpu_stats?.online_cpus || 1;
      const cpuPercent = systemDelta > 0 ? (cpuDelta / systemDelta) * onlineCpus * 100 : 0;
      allStats.push({
        containerId: container.Id,
        hostId: host.id,
        cpu_percent: Math.round(cpuPercent * 100) / 100,
        memory_usage: stats.memory_stats?.usage ?? 0,
        memory_limit: stats.memory_stats?.limit ?? 0,
      });
      return null;
    });
    return null;
  });
  return allStats;
}

function deriveAlertSignals(
  rules: ReturnType<typeof normalizeAlertRule>[],
  hosts: DockerHostRow[],
  containers: ContainerRow[],
  stats: ContainerStatRow[],
): DerivedAlertSignal[] {
  const signals: DerivedAlertSignal[] = [];
  const containersById = new Map(containers.map((container) => [container.Id, container]));

  for (const rule of rules) {
    if (!rule.enabled) continue;

    if (rule.condition_type === 'host_offline') {
      for (const host of hosts.filter((item) => ['stale', 'error', 'disconnected', 'unhealthy'].includes(item.status))) {
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${host.id}:${host.status}`,
          sourceType: 'host',
          sourceRef: host.id,
          title: host.status === 'stale' ? 'Host connection stale' : 'Host offline',
          message: host.last_error ? `${host.name} is ${host.status}. ${host.last_error}` : `${host.name} is ${host.status}. Check agent connectivity.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: host.id, host_name: host.name, host_status: host.status },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'container_exited') {
      for (const container of containers.filter((item) => item.State === 'exited')) {
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${container._hostId}:${container.Id}:exited`,
          sourceType: 'container',
          sourceRef: container.Id,
          title: 'Container exited',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is stopped and needs review.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), image: container.Image ?? null },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'container_restart_loop') {
      for (const container of containers.filter((item) => item.State === 'restarting')) {
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${container._hostId}:${container.Id}:restarting`,
          sourceType: 'container',
          sourceRef: container.Id,
          title: 'Restart loop detected',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is restarting repeatedly.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), image: container.Image ?? null },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'cpu_usage') {
      const threshold = normalizeThresholdValue(rule.threshold_value) ?? 85;
      for (const stat of stats.filter((item) => item.cpu_percent >= threshold)) {
        const container = containersById.get(stat.containerId);
        if (!container) continue;
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${stat.hostId}:${stat.containerId}:cpu`,
          sourceType: 'metric',
          sourceRef: stat.containerId,
          title: 'High CPU usage',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is at ${stat.cpu_percent.toFixed(1)}% CPU.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), metric: 'cpu_percent', metric_value: stat.cpu_percent, threshold },
        });
      }
    }

    if (rule.condition_type === 'memory_usage') {
      const threshold = normalizeThresholdValue(rule.threshold_value) ?? 90;
      for (const stat of stats) {
        const memoryPercent = stat.memory_limit > 0 ? (stat.memory_usage / stat.memory_limit) * 100 : 0;
        if (memoryPercent < threshold) continue;
        const container = containersById.get(stat.containerId);
        if (!container) continue;
        signals.push({
          ruleId: rule.id,
          fingerprint: `${rule.id}:${stat.hostId}:${stat.containerId}:memory`,
          sourceType: 'metric',
          sourceRef: stat.containerId,
          title: 'High memory usage',
          message: `${trimContainerName(container)} on ${container._hostName} is at ${memoryPercent.toFixed(1)}% memory.`,
          severity: rule.severity,
          metadata: { host_id: container._hostId, host_name: container._hostName, container_id: container.Id, container_short_id: container.Id.slice(0, 12), container_name: trimContainerName(container), metric: 'memory_percent', metric_value: Number(memoryPercent.toFixed(2)), threshold },
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return signals;
}

function mapAlertHref(event: AlertEventRow) {
  const metadata = event.metadata ?? {};
  const hostId = typeof metadata.host_id === 'string' ? metadata.host_id : null;
  const containerShortId = typeof metadata.container_short_id === 'string' ? metadata.container_short_id : typeof metadata.container_id === 'string' ? metadata.container_id.slice(0, 12) : null;
  if ((event.source_type === 'container' || event.source_type === 'metric') && containerShortId && hostId) return `/app/containers/${containerShortId}?host=${hostId}`;
  if (hostId) return `/app/hosts/${hostId}`;
  return '/app/alerts';
}

export async function syncAlertEvents(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rules = await listAlertRules(auth);
  const hosts = await listAccessibleHosts(auth);
  const needsStats = rules.some((rule) => rule.enabled && ['cpu_usage', 'memory_usage'].includes(rule.condition_type));
  const containers = hosts.length > 0 ? await fetchContainersForHosts(hosts) : [];
  const stats = needsStats && hosts.length > 0 ? await fetchContainerStatsForHosts(hosts) : [];
  const derivedSignals = deriveAlertSignals(rules, hosts, containers, stats);

  const activeEvents = (await sql`
    SELECT id, fingerprint
    FROM alert_events
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND resolved_at IS NULL
  `) as Array<{ id: string; fingerprint: string }>;

  const activeByFingerprint = new Map(activeEvents.map((event) => [event.fingerprint, event]));

  for (const signal of derivedSignals) {
    const existing = activeByFingerprint.get(signal.fingerprint);

    if (existing) {
      await sql`
        UPDATE alert_events
        SET
          rule_id = ${signal.ruleId},
          title = ${signal.title},
          message = ${signal.message},
          severity = ${signal.severity},
          metadata = ${JSON.stringify(signal.metadata)},
          last_seen_at = now(),
          updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = ${existing.id}
      `;
      continue;
    }

    const insertedRows = await sql`
      INSERT INTO alert_events (
        organization_id, rule_id, fingerprint, source_type, source_ref,
        title, message, severity, status, metadata, first_seen_at, last_seen_at
      )
      VALUES (
        ${auth.orgId}, ${signal.ruleId}, ${signal.fingerprint}, ${signal.sourceType}, ${signal.sourceRef},
        ${signal.title}, ${signal.message}, ${signal.severity}, 'open', ${JSON.stringify(signal.metadata)}, now(), now()
      )
      RETURNING *
    `;
    await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, insertedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.opened');
    await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, insertedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.opened');
  }

  const activeFingerprints = new Set(derivedSignals.map((signal) => signal.fingerprint));
  const staleEvents = activeEvents.filter((event) => !activeFingerprints.has(event.fingerprint));

  for (const event of staleEvents) {
    const resolvedRows = await sql`
      UPDATE alert_events
      SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = COALESCE(resolved_at, now()), updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = ${event.id}
      RETURNING *
    `;
    if (resolvedRows[0]) {
      await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, resolvedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.resolved');
      await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, resolvedRows[0] as AlertEventRow, 'alert.resolved');
    }
  }
}

export async function listAlertEvents(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  filters: { severity?: string | null; status?: string | null } = {},
) {
  await syncAlertEvents(auth);

  const rows = (await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM alert_events
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY
      CASE severity
        WHEN 'critical' THEN 0
        WHEN 'error' THEN 1
        WHEN 'warning' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
      END,
      last_seen_at DESC
  `) as AlertEventRow[];

  return rows
    .filter((row) => (filters.severity ? row.severity === filters.severity : true))
    .filter((row) => (filters.status ? row.status === filters.status : row.resolved_at === null))
    .map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      href: mapAlertHref(row),
    }));
}

export async function listIncidents(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  return sql`
    SELECT i.*, e.title AS source_alert_title
    FROM incidents i
    LEFT JOIN alert_events e ON e.id = i.source_alert_event_id
    WHERE i.organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY i.opened_at DESC
    LIMIT 12
  `;
}

export async function listAlertHistory(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rows = (await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM alert_events
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 12
  `) as AlertEventRow[];

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    href: mapAlertHref(row),
  }));
}

export async function buildAlertsWorkspaceSummary(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const [rules, activeAlerts, incidents] = await Promise.all([
    listAlertRules(auth),
    listAlertEvents(auth),
    listIncidents(auth),
  ]);

  const activeOnly = activeAlerts.filter((alert) => alert.resolved_at === null);

  return {
    total_alerts: activeOnly.length,
    critical_alerts: activeOnly.filter((alert) => alert.severity === 'critical').length,
    enabled_rules: rules.filter((rule) => rule.enabled).length,
    open_incidents: incidents.filter((incident: any) => incident.status !== 'resolved').length,
  };
}

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/auth.mts">
import { sql } from './db.mjs';
import { clerkClient, getClerkConfig } from './clerk.mjs';
import { assertTenantAccessAllowed } from './access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureAdminSchema } from './ensure-admin-schema.mjs';
import { isPlatformAdminEmail } from './platform-admin.mjs';

export interface AppAuthContext {
  userId: string; // The internal UUID
  orgId: string | null;  // The internal UUID, nullable if requireOrg is false
  clerkUserId: string;
  clerkOrgId: string | null;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
  email: string;
}

interface AuthOptions {
  requireOrg?: boolean;
}

type AppAuthErrorCode = 'SYNC_PENDING';

interface AppAuthError extends Error {
  code?: AppAuthErrorCode;
}

const DEFAULT_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES = [
  'https://app.dockerdash.app',
  'https://dockerdash.app',
  'https://www.dockerdash.app',
  'http://localhost:5173',
  'http://localhost:8080',
  'http://localhost:8081',
  'http://localhost:8888',
];

function makeAppAuthError(message: string, code?: AppAuthErrorCode): AppAuthError {
  const err: AppAuthError = new Error(message);
  if (code) err.code = code;
  return err;
}

function normalizeAuthorizedParty(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;

  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  try {
    return new URL(trimmed).origin;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function getAuthorizedParties(req: Request) {
  const parties = new Set<string>();

  for (const value of DEFAULT_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES) {
    const normalized = normalizeAuthorizedParty(value);
    if (normalized) parties.add(normalized);
  }

  for (const value of (process.env.CLERK_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES || '').split(',')) {
    const normalized = normalizeAuthorizedParty(value);
    if (normalized) parties.add(normalized);
  }

  const requestOrigin = normalizeAuthorizedParty(req.headers.get('origin'));
  if (requestOrigin) {
    parties.add(requestOrigin);
  }

  try {
    parties.add(new URL(req.url).origin);
  } catch {
    // Netlify provides an absolute URL in production, but keep auth resilient in local tests.
  }

  const forwardedProto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto');
  const forwardedHost = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host');
  if (forwardedProto && forwardedHost) {
    const forwardedOrigin = normalizeAuthorizedParty(`${forwardedProto}://${forwardedHost}`);
    if (forwardedOrigin) {
      parties.add(forwardedOrigin);
    }
  }

  return Array.from(parties);
}

export async function requireAuth(
  req: Request,
  options: AuthOptions = { requireOrg: true }
): Promise<AppAuthContext> {
  const requireOrg = options.requireOrg ?? true;

  // Test bypass has been removed from production code.
  // For testing, use mock implementations in test files only.
  // See: /workspace/netlify/functions/lib/auth.test.mts for test mocks

  const requestState = await clerkClient.authenticateRequest(req, {
    ...getClerkConfig(),
    authorizedParties: getAuthorizedParties(req),
  });

  if (!requestState.isSignedIn) {
    const reason = requestState.reason || 'unknown';
    const message = requestState.message || 'none';
    const hasAuthHeader = req.headers.get('authorization') ? 'yes' : 'no';
    console.error(`[requireAuth] 401 | reason=${reason} | message=${message} | has-auth-header=${hasAuthHeader}`);

    const reasonLower = reason.toLowerCase();
    const messageLower = message.toLowerCase();
    if (reasonLower === 'session-token-outdated' || messageLower.includes('sync')) {
      throw makeAppAuthError('Sync pending. Your account is currently syncing.', 'SYNC_PENDING');
    }

    throw new Error(`Unauthorized. Reason: ${reason}, Message: ${message}`);
  }

  const authData = requestState.toAuth();
  if (!authData.userId) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: No user found');
  }
  
  // The frontend <OrganizationSwitcher/> injects the org_id into the session token automatically
  if (requireOrg && !authData.orgId) {
    throw new Error('No active organization selected. Please select an organization.');
  }

  const clerkUserId = authData.userId;
  const clerkOrgId = authData.orgId || null;

  await ensureAdminSchema();
  const userResult = await sql`SELECT id, email, is_approved FROM public.users WHERE clerk_user_id = ${clerkUserId}`;
  if (userResult.length === 0) {
    throw makeAppAuthError('Sync pending. Your account is currently syncing.', 'SYNC_PENDING');
  }

  const isPlatformAdmin = isPlatformAdminEmail(userResult[0].email);

  let orgId = null;
  if (clerkOrgId) {
    const orgResult = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.organizations WHERE clerk_org_id = ${clerkOrgId}`;
    if (orgResult.length === 0 && requireOrg) {
      throw new Error('Sync pending. Your organization is currently syncing.');
    }
    if (orgResult.length > 0) {
      orgId = orgResult[0].id;
    }
  }

  await assertTenantAccessAllowed({
    userId: userResult[0].id,
    organizationId: orgId,
    isPlatformAdmin,
    isApproved: Boolean(userResult[0].is_approved),
  });

  return {
    userId: userResult[0].id,
    orgId,
    clerkUserId,
    clerkOrgId,
    isPlatformAdmin,
    email: userResult[0].email,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/clerk.mts">
import { createClerkClient } from "@clerk/backend";

export function getClerkConfig() {
  const config: {
    secretKey?: string;
    publishableKey?: string;
    jwtKey?: string;
  } = {
    secretKey: process.env.CLERK_SECRET_KEY,
    publishableKey: process.env.CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || process.env.VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY,
  };

  // Prefer server-side secret verification when a secret key is available.
  // A stale injected CLERK_JWT_KEY can otherwise force invalid local token checks.
  if (!config.secretKey && process.env.CLERK_JWT_KEY) {
    config.jwtKey = process.env.CLERK_JWT_KEY;
  }

  return config;
}

export const clerkClient = createClerkClient(getClerkConfig());
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/crypto.mts">
import crypto from 'crypto';

const ALGO = 'aes-256-gcm';
const IV_LENGTH = 12;
const AUTH_TAG_LENGTH = 16;
const LEGACY_PREFIX = 'v1:';
const KEYED_PREFIX = 'v2:';
const LEGACY_KEY_ID = 'V1';

type HostSecretField = 'agent_api_key' | 'cf_service_token_id' | 'cf_service_token_secret';

export interface EncryptedHostSecretsRecord {
  agent_api_key?: string | null;
  cf_service_token_id?: string | null;
  cf_service_token_secret?: string | null;
}

export interface DecryptedHostSecrets {
  agent_api_key: string | null;
  cf_service_token_id: string | null;
  cf_service_token_secret: string | null;
}

export class SecretCryptoError extends Error {
  code: string;

  constructor(code: string, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'SecretCryptoError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

function decodeKeyMaterial(keyString: string, envName: string): Buffer {
  let keyBuf: Buffer;
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(keyString) && Buffer.from(keyString, 'base64').length === 32) {
    keyBuf = Buffer.from(keyString, 'base64');
  } else if (/^[A-Fa-f0-9]+$/.test(keyString) && Buffer.from(keyString, 'hex').length === 32) {
    keyBuf = Buffer.from(keyString, 'hex');
  } else {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'INVALID_KEY_FORMAT',
      `${envName} must be a valid base64 or hex string encoding exactly 32 bytes.`,
    );
  }

  if (keyBuf.length !== 32) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'INVALID_KEY_LENGTH',
      `${envName} decoded to ${keyBuf.length} bytes. Expected exactly 32 bytes for AES-256.`,
    );
  }

  return keyBuf;
}

function loadKeyring() {
  const keys = new Map<string, Buffer>();

  for (const [envName, envValue] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
    if (!envName.startsWith('APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_') || !envValue) continue;
    const keyId = envName.substring('APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_'.length);
    if (!keyId) continue;
    keys.set(keyId, decodeKeyMaterial(envValue, envName));
  }

  const legacyValue = process.env.APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1;
  if (legacyValue && !keys.has(LEGACY_KEY_ID)) {
    keys.set(LEGACY_KEY_ID, decodeKeyMaterial(legacyValue, 'APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1'));
  }

  const activeKeyId = process.env.APP_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID || (legacyValue ? LEGACY_KEY_ID : null);
  if (!activeKeyId) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'MISSING_ACTIVE_KEY_ID',
      'APP_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID is required when using keyed encryption. Legacy fallback only works when APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1 is set.',
    );
  }

  const activeKey = keys.get(activeKeyId);
  if (!activeKey) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'MISSING_ACTIVE_KEY',
      `Active encryption key ${activeKeyId} is not configured. Expected APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_${activeKeyId}.`,
    );
  }

  return { activeKeyId, keys };
}

const KEYRING = loadKeyring();

function buildAad(prefix: string, hostId: string, fieldName: string, keyId?: string) {
  const suffix = keyId ? `:${keyId}` : '';
  return Buffer.from(`${prefix}${hostId}:${fieldName}${suffix}`, 'utf8');
}

function encodeKeyedCiphertext(keyId: string, iv: Buffer, authTag: Buffer, encrypted: string) {
  return `${KEYED_PREFIX}${keyId}:${iv.toString('base64')}:${authTag.toString('base64')}:${encrypted}`;
}

function parseLegacyCiphertext(encryptedString: string) {
  const parts = encryptedString.substring(LEGACY_PREFIX.length).split(':');
  if (parts.length !== 3) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_SECRET_FORMAT', 'Invalid legacy encrypted secret format.');
  }
  return parts as [string, string, string];
}

function parseKeyedCiphertext(encryptedString: string) {
  const parts = encryptedString.substring(KEYED_PREFIX.length).split(':');
  if (parts.length !== 4) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_SECRET_FORMAT', 'Invalid keyed encrypted secret format.');
  }
  return parts as [string, string, string, string];
}

function parseIv(ivB64: string) {
  const iv = Buffer.from(ivB64, 'base64');
  if (iv.length !== IV_LENGTH) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_IV', `Invalid IV length. Expected ${IV_LENGTH} bytes.`);
  }
  return iv;
}

function parseAuthTag(authTagB64: string) {
  const authTag = Buffer.from(authTagB64, 'base64');
  if (authTag.length !== AUTH_TAG_LENGTH) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError('INVALID_AUTH_TAG', `Invalid Auth Tag length. Expected ${AUTH_TAG_LENGTH} bytes.`);
  }
  return authTag;
}

function decryptWithKey(
  key: Buffer,
  prefix: string,
  hostId: string,
  fieldName: string,
  iv: Buffer,
  authTag: Buffer,
  ciphertextB64: string,
  keyId?: string,
) {
  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(ALGO, key, iv);
  decipher.setAAD(buildAad(prefix, hostId, fieldName, keyId));
  decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);

  try {
    let decrypted = decipher.update(ciphertextB64, 'base64', 'utf8');
    decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
    return decrypted;
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'AUTH_MISMATCH',
      `Failed to decrypt secret for host ${hostId} field ${fieldName}. Internal error: ${err.message}`,
    );
  }
}

export function getActiveEncryptionKeyId(): string {
  return KEYRING.activeKeyId;
}

export function encryptSecret(plaintext: string, hostId: string, fieldName: string): string {
  if (!plaintext) return plaintext;

  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(IV_LENGTH);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(ALGO, KEYRING.keys.get(KEYRING.activeKeyId)!, iv);
  cipher.setAAD(buildAad(KEYED_PREFIX, hostId, fieldName, KEYRING.activeKeyId));

  let encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8', 'base64');
  encrypted += cipher.final('base64');
  const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();

  return encodeKeyedCiphertext(KEYRING.activeKeyId, iv, authTag, encrypted);
}

export function decryptSecret(
  encryptedString: string | null | undefined,
  hostId: string,
  fieldName: string,
): string | null {
  if (!encryptedString) return null;

  if (!encryptedString.startsWith(LEGACY_PREFIX) && !encryptedString.startsWith(KEYED_PREFIX)) {
    return encryptedString;
  }

  if (encryptedString.startsWith(LEGACY_PREFIX)) {
    const legacyKey = KEYRING.keys.get(LEGACY_KEY_ID);
    if (!legacyKey) {
      throw new SecretCryptoError(
        'MISSING_LEGACY_KEY',
        'APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1 is required to decrypt legacy host secrets.',
      );
    }
    const [ivB64, authTagB64, ciphertextB64] = parseLegacyCiphertext(encryptedString);
    return decryptWithKey(
      legacyKey,
      LEGACY_PREFIX,
      hostId,
      fieldName,
      parseIv(ivB64),
      parseAuthTag(authTagB64),
      ciphertextB64,
    );
  }

  const [keyId, ivB64, authTagB64, ciphertextB64] = parseKeyedCiphertext(encryptedString);
  const key = KEYRING.keys.get(keyId);
  if (!key) {
    throw new SecretCryptoError(
      'UNKNOWN_KEY_ID',
      `Encrypted secret references key ${keyId}, but APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_${keyId} is not configured.`,
    );
  }

  return decryptWithKey(
    key,
    KEYED_PREFIX,
    hostId,
    fieldName,
    parseIv(ivB64),
    parseAuthTag(authTagB64),
    ciphertextB64,
    keyId,
  );
}

export function decryptHostSecrets(
  record: EncryptedHostSecretsRecord | null | undefined,
  hostId: string,
): DecryptedHostSecrets | null {
  if (!record) return null;

  return {
    agent_api_key: decryptSecret(record.agent_api_key, hostId, 'agent_api_key'),
    cf_service_token_id: decryptSecret(record.cf_service_token_id, hostId, 'cf_service_token_id'),
    cf_service_token_secret: decryptSecret(record.cf_service_token_secret, hostId, 'cf_service_token_secret'),
  };
}

export function isSecretUsingActiveKey(encryptedString: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!encryptedString) return true;
  if (!encryptedString.startsWith(KEYED_PREFIX)) return false;

  const [keyId] = parseKeyedCiphertext(encryptedString);
  return keyId === KEYRING.activeKeyId;
}

export function reencryptSecret(
  encryptedString: string | null | undefined,
  hostId: string,
  fieldName: HostSecretField,
): string | null {
  if (!encryptedString) return null;
  const plaintext = decryptSecret(encryptedString, hostId, fieldName);
  if (!plaintext) return null;
  return encryptSecret(plaintext, hostId, fieldName);
}
</file>
