<file path="netlify/functions/lib/dedicated-deployments.mts">
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema } from "./ensure-dedicated-deployment-schema.mjs";
import type { AppAuthContext } from "./auth.mjs";

export type DedicatedDeploymentStatus =
  | "intake_received"
  | "capacity_reserved"
  | "provisioning"
  | "hardening"
  | "ready_for_handoff"
  | "active";

function buildReferenceId() {
  const now = new Date();
  const yyyy = now.getUTCFullYear();
  const mm = String(now.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const dd = String(now.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const suffix = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6).toUpperCase();
  return `DD-DED-${yyyy}${mm}${dd}-${suffix}`;
}

export function buildDeploymentChecklist(payload: Record<string, unknown>, status: DedicatedDeploymentStatus) {
  const requiresSSO = Boolean(payload.requiresSSO);
  const integrations = Array.isArray(payload.integrations) ? payload.integrations.map(String) : [];

  return [
    {
      id: "brief",
      label: "Deployment brief accepted",
      completed: true,
    },
    {
      id: "contacts",
      label: "Technical owner and escalation contacts captured",
      completed: Boolean(payload.technicalOwnerName) && Boolean(payload.technicalOwnerEmail),
    },
    {
      id: "identity",
      label: requiresSSO ? "SSO requirements queued for handoff" : "Identity model confirmed",
      completed: status !== "intake_received",
    },
    {
      id: "integrations",
      label: integrations.length > 0 ? "Integration requirements staged" : "Initial integration scope confirmed",
      completed: status === "hardening" || status === "ready_for_handoff" || status === "active",
    },
    {
      id: "handoff",
      label: "Handoff workspace prepared",
      completed: status === "ready_for_handoff" || status === "active",
    },
  ];
}

export async function listUserOrganizations(userId: string) {
  await ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema();
  return sql<{ organization_id: string }[]>`
    SELECT organization_id
    FROM public.organization_members
    WHERE user_id = ${userId}
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
  `;
}

export async function getCurrentDedicatedDeployment(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  await ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema();

  let organizationId = auth.orgId;
  if (!organizationId) {
    const orgs = await listUserOrganizations(auth.userId);
    organizationId = orgs[0]?.organization_id ?? null;
  }

  if (!organizationId) {
    return null;
  }

  const rows = await sql<any[]>`
    SELECT
      organization_id,
      reference_id,
      plan_id,
      status,
      target_window_label,
      latest_update_note,
      intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    FROM public.dedicated_deployments
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const row = rows[0];
  return {
    organization_id: String(row.organization_id),
    reference_id: String(row.reference_id),
    plan_id: "enterprise" as const,
    status: String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus,
    target_window_label: String(row.target_window_label),
    latest_update_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
    latest_update_note: String(row.latest_update_note),
    technical_owner_name: String(row.technical_owner_name || ""),
    technical_owner_email: String(row.technical_owner_email || ""),
    intake_payload: (row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
    checklist: buildDeploymentChecklist((row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>, String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus),
    created_at: new Date(String(row.created_at)).toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function createOrUpdateDedicatedDeployment(auth: AppAuthContext, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  await ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema();

  if (!auth.orgId) {
    throw new Error("Select an active organization before starting a dedicated deployment.");
  }

  const referenceId = buildReferenceId();
  const technicalOwnerName = typeof payload.technicalOwnerName === "string" ? payload.technicalOwnerName.trim() : "";
  const technicalOwnerEmail = typeof payload.technicalOwnerEmail === "string" ? payload.technicalOwnerEmail.trim() : "";

  const [row] = await sql<any[]>`
    INSERT INTO public.dedicated_deployments (
      organization_id,
      reference_id,
      plan_id,
      status,
      target_window_label,
      latest_update_note,
      intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email,
      created_by
    ) VALUES (
      ${auth.orgId},
      ${referenceId},
      'enterprise',
      'intake_received',
      '3-5 business days',
      'Deployment brief accepted. Capacity review starts next.',
      ${JSON.stringify(payload)}::jsonb,
      ${technicalOwnerName},
      ${technicalOwnerEmail},
      ${auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      plan_id = 'enterprise',
      status = CASE
        WHEN public.dedicated_deployments.status = 'active' THEN public.dedicated_deployments.status
        ELSE 'intake_received'
      END,
      target_window_label = '3-5 business days',
      latest_update_note = 'Deployment brief accepted. Capacity review starts next.',
      intake_payload = EXCLUDED.intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name = EXCLUDED.technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email = EXCLUDED.technical_owner_email
    RETURNING
      organization_id,
      reference_id,
      plan_id,
      status,
      target_window_label,
      latest_update_note,
      intake_payload,
      technical_owner_name,
      technical_owner_email,
      created_at,
      updated_at
  `;

  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.dedicated_deployment_updates (
      organization_id,
      status,
      note,
      created_by
    ) VALUES (
      ${auth.orgId},
      ${row.status},
      'Deployment brief accepted. Capacity review starts next.',
      ${auth.userId}
    )
  `;

  return {
    organization_id: String(row.organization_id),
    reference_id: String(row.reference_id),
    plan_id: "enterprise" as const,
    status: String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus,
    target_window_label: String(row.target_window_label),
    latest_update_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
    latest_update_note: String(row.latest_update_note),
    technical_owner_name: String(row.technical_owner_name || ""),
    technical_owner_email: String(row.technical_owner_email || ""),
    intake_payload: (row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
    checklist: buildDeploymentChecklist((row.intake_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>, String(row.status) as DedicatedDeploymentStatus),
    created_at: new Date(String(row.created_at)).toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date(String(row.updated_at)).toISOString(),
  };
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/donor-billing-helpers.mts">
export function extractDnr8Token(text: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!text) return null;
  const upper = text.toUpperCase();
  const match = upper.match(/DNR-[A-Z0-9]{8}/);
  if (!match) return null;
  return /^DNR-[A-Z0-9]{8}$/.test(match[0]) ? match[0] : null;
}

export function parseFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }
  return null;
}

export function coerceString(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return null;
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return trimmed ? trimmed : null;
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/donor-billing-helpers.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { coerceString, extractDnr8Token, parseFiniteNumber } from "./donor-billing-helpers.mjs";

describe("donor billing helpers", () => {
  it("extracts DNR-8 token from arbitrary text", () => {
    expect(extractDnr8Token("paid token dnr-ab12cd34 thanks")).toBe("DNR-AB12CD34");
    expect(extractDnr8Token("missing token")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("parses numeric values safely", () => {
    expect(parseFiniteNumber("29.5")).toBe(29.5);
    expect(parseFiniteNumber(10)).toBe(10);
    expect(parseFiniteNumber("abc")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("coerces non-empty strings only", () => {
    expect(coerceString(" hello ")).toBe("hello");
    expect(coerceString("   ")).toBeNull();
    expect(coerceString(3)).toBeNull();
  });
});
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/donor-billing.mts">
import crypto from "crypto";

import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { requirePlatformAdmin } from "./admin-auth.mjs";
import { normalizeAdminReason, assertAdminReason, recordAdminAudit } from "./admin-audit.mjs";
import { extractDnr8Token, parseFiniteNumber, coerceString } from "./donor-billing-helpers.mjs";
import { donorActivationTemplate, donorRenewalReminderTemplate } from "./donor-email-templates.mjs";
import { sendEmail } from "./email.mjs";
import { verifyWebhookTimestamp } from "./security.mjs";

export type DonorProvider = "liberapay" | "paypal";

export interface ParsedDonorEvent {
  provider: DonorProvider;
  providerEventId: string | null;
  amount: number | null;
  currency: string | null;
  payerEmail: string | null;
  referenceToken: string | null;
  organizationId: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  rawPayload: Record<string, unknown>;
  verified: boolean;
  verificationError: string | null;
}

const PLAN_TO_DAYS: Record<string, number> = {
  free: 0,
  pro: 30,
  team: 30,
  enterprise: 30,
};

function parsePayload(raw: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object") {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    return { value: parsed };
  } catch {
    return { raw };
  }
}

function verifySharedSecret(req: Request, envName: string): { verified: boolean; error: string | null } {
  const expected = (process.env[envName] || "").trim();
  if (!expected) {
    return { verified: false, error: `${envName} is not configured` };
  }

  const provided =
    req.headers.get("x-webhook-secret") ||
    req.headers.get("x-donor-secret") ||
    req.headers.get("x-liberapay-secret") ||
    req.headers.get("x-paypal-secret") ||
    "";

  if (!provided) {
    return { verified: false, error: "Webhook secret header missing" };
  }

  const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected);
  const providedBuf = Buffer.from(provided);
  if (expectedBuf.length !== providedBuf.length) {
    return { verified: false, error: "Webhook secret mismatch" };
  }

  const ok = crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, providedBuf);
  return ok
    ? { verified: true, error: null }
    : { verified: false, error: "Webhook secret mismatch" };
}

function extractReplayHeaders(provider: DonorProvider, req: Request, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const timestampHeader =
    req.headers.get("x-webhook-timestamp") ||
    req.headers.get("x-paypal-transmission-time") ||
    req.headers.get("x-liberapay-timestamp") ||
    (typeof payload.timestamp === "string" ? payload.timestamp : null) ||
    (typeof payload.created_at === "string" ? payload.created_at : null);

  const nonceHeader =
    req.headers.get("x-webhook-id") ||
    req.headers.get("x-paypal-transmission-id") ||
    req.headers.get("x-liberapay-event-id") ||
    (typeof payload.id === "string" ? payload.id : null) ||
    (typeof payload.event_id === "string" ? payload.event_id : null) ||
    (typeof payload.txn_id === "string" ? payload.txn_id : null);

  return {
    timestampHeader,
    nonceHeader: nonceHeader ? `${provider}:${nonceHeader}` : null,
  };
}

function normalizeTimestampHeader(value: string | null): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;

  if (/^\d+$/.test(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  const parsed = Date.parse(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
    return null;
  }

  return String(Math.floor(parsed / 1000));
}

export async function parseDonorWebhookEvent(provider: DonorProvider, req: Request, rawBody: string): Promise<ParsedDonorEvent> {
  const payload = parsePayload(rawBody);
  const envName = provider === "liberapay" ? "LIBERAPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET" : "PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET";
  const verification = verifySharedSecret(req, envName);

  const metadataSource =
    (payload.metadata && typeof payload.metadata === "object" ? (payload.metadata as Record<string, unknown>) : null) ||
    (payload.custom_data && typeof payload.custom_data === "object" ? (payload.custom_data as Record<string, unknown>) : null) ||
    {};

  const note = coerceString(payload.note) || coerceString(payload.memo) || coerceString(payload.description) || coerceString(payload.message);
  const referenceToken =
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(metadataSource.reference_token)) ||
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(metadataSource.referenceToken)) ||
    extractDnr8Token(note) ||
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(payload.reference_token)) ||
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(payload.referenceToken));

  const providerEventId =
    coerceString(payload.id) ||
    coerceString(payload.txn_id) ||
    coerceString(payload.transaction_id) ||
    coerceString(payload.event_id) ||
    coerceString(payload.pp_id);

  const amount =
    parseFiniteNumber(payload.amount) ??
    parseFiniteNumber(payload.gross_amount) ??
    parseFiniteNumber(payload.total) ??
    parseFiniteNumber((payload.data as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.amount);

  const currency =
    coerceString(payload.currency) ||
    coerceString(payload.currency_code) ||
    coerceString((payload.data as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.currency) ||
    null;

  const payerEmail =
    coerceString(payload.payer_email) ||
    coerceString(payload.email) ||
    coerceString((payload.payer as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.email_address) ||
    null;

  const organizationId =
    coerceString(metadataSource.organization_id) ||
    coerceString(metadataSource.organizationId) ||
    coerceString(payload.organization_id) ||
    null;

  let replayVerificationError: string | null = null;
  const replayHeaders = extractReplayHeaders(provider, req, payload);
  const normalizedTimestamp = normalizeTimestampHeader(replayHeaders.timestampHeader);

  if (normalizedTimestamp && replayHeaders.nonceHeader) {
    const replayResult = await verifyWebhookTimestamp(normalizedTimestamp, replayHeaders.nonceHeader);
    if (!replayResult.valid) {
      replayVerificationError = replayResult.error || "Webhook replay verification failed";
    }
  }

  const verificationError = [verification.error, replayVerificationError].filter(Boolean).join("; ") || null;

  return {
    provider,
    providerEventId,
    amount,
    currency,
    payerEmail,
    referenceToken,
    organizationId,
    metadata: {
      ...metadataSource,
      payer_email: payerEmail,
      note,
      reference_token: referenceToken,
      replay_timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
      replay_nonce: replayHeaders.nonceHeader,
    },
    rawPayload: payload,
    verified: verification.verified && !replayVerificationError,
    verificationError,
  };
}

async function extendDonorPremium({
  organizationId,
  grantDays,
  paymentProvider,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  grantDays: number;
  paymentProvider: string;
}) {
  const [updated] = await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET
      donor_premium_expires_at = CASE
        WHEN donor_premium_expires_at IS NULL OR donor_premium_expires_at < now()
          THEN now() + (${grantDays}::int * interval '1 day')
        ELSE donor_premium_expires_at + (${grantDays}::int * interval '1 day')
      END,
      payment_provider = ${paymentProvider},
      billing_updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    RETURNING id, donor_premium_expires_at, payment_provider
  `;

  return updated ?? null;
}

async function resolveOrganizationFromEvent(event: ParsedDonorEvent): Promise<string | null> {
  if (event.organizationId) {
    const rows = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.organizations WHERE id = ${event.organizationId} LIMIT 1`;
    if (rows.length > 0) return rows[0].id as string;
  }

  if (event.payerEmail) {
    const rows = await sql`
      SELECT o.id
      FROM public.organizations o
      JOIN public.organization_members om ON om.organization_id = o.id
      JOIN public.users u ON u.id = om.user_id
      WHERE lower(u.email) = lower(${event.payerEmail})
      ORDER BY om.created_at ASC
      LIMIT 1
    `;
    if (rows.length > 0) return rows[0].id as string;
  }

  return null;
}

export async function getOrganizationOwnerContact(organizationId: string): Promise<{ email: string; full_name: string | null; org_name: string } | null> {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      o.name AS org_name,
      u.email,
      u.full_name,
      CASE
        WHEN om.role = 'owner' THEN 0
        WHEN om.role = 'admin' THEN 1
        ELSE 2
      END AS role_rank,
      om.created_at
    FROM public.organization_members om
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = om.user_id
    JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = om.organization_id
    WHERE om.organization_id = ${organizationId}
    ORDER BY role_rank ASC, om.created_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  return {
    email: String(rows[0].email),
    full_name: rows[0].full_name ? String(rows[0].full_name) : null,
    org_name: String(rows[0].org_name),
  };
}

export async function recordEmailDelivery({
  organizationId,
  recipientEmail,
  template,
  provider,
  providerMessageId,
  status,
  error,
  metadata,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  recipientEmail: string;
  template: string;
  provider: string;
  providerMessageId: string | null;
  status: string;
  error: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
}) {
  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.donor_email_deliveries (
      organization_id,
      recipient_email,
      template,
      provider,
      provider_message_id,
      status,
      error,
      metadata,
      sent_at,
      sent_on
    )
    VALUES (
      ${organizationId},
      ${recipientEmail},
      ${template},
      ${provider},
      ${providerMessageId},
      ${status},
      ${error},
      ${JSON.stringify(metadata)}::jsonb,
      now(),
      CURRENT_DATE
    )
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id, template, sent_on) DO UPDATE
    SET
      provider = EXCLUDED.provider,
      provider_message_id = EXCLUDED.provider_message_id,
      status = EXCLUDED.status,
      error = EXCLUDED.error,
      metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
      sent_at = now()
  `;
}

export async function sendDonorActivationEmail({
  organizationId,
  expiresAt,
  transactionId,
  grantDays,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  expiresAt: string;
  transactionId: string | null;
  grantDays: number;
}) {
  const contact = await getOrganizationOwnerContact(organizationId);
  if (!contact) return;

  const template = donorActivationTemplate({
    name: contact.full_name,
    orgName: contact.org_name,
    expiresAt,
    transactionId,
  });

  const result = await sendEmail({
    to: contact.email,
    subject: template.subject,
    text: template.body,
    html: template.html,
  });

  await recordEmailDelivery({
    organizationId,
    recipientEmail: contact.email,
    template: "activation",
    provider: result.provider,
    providerMessageId: result.messageId,
    status: result.success ? "sent" : "failed",
    error: result.error,
    metadata: {
      grant_days: grantDays,
      transaction_id: transactionId,
      expires_at: expiresAt,
    },
  });
}

export async function ingestDonorEvent(event: ParsedDonorEvent) {
  if (event.providerEventId) {
    const duplicates = await sql`
      SELECT id, matched, matched_organization_id
      FROM public.billing_events
      WHERE provider = ${event.provider} AND provider_event_id = ${event.providerEventId}
      LIMIT 1
    `;

    if (duplicates.length > 0) {
      return {
        duplicate: true,
        billingEventId: duplicates[0].id as string,
        matched: Boolean(duplicates[0].matched),
      };
    }
  }

  const organizationId = await resolveOrganizationFromEvent(event);
  const grantDays = PLAN_TO_DAYS.pro;

  let donorUpdate: { id: string; donor_premium_expires_at: string; payment_provider: string } | null = null;
  if (organizationId && event.verified) {
    donorUpdate = await extendDonorPremium({
      organizationId,
      grantDays,
      paymentProvider: event.provider,
    });
  }

  const [inserted] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.billing_events (
      provider,
      provider_event_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      metadata,
      raw_payload,
      verified,
      verification_error,
      matched,
      matched_organization_id,
      matched_by,
      matched_at,
      received_at
    )
    VALUES (
      ${event.provider},
      ${event.providerEventId},
      ${event.amount},
      ${event.currency},
      ${JSON.stringify(event.metadata)}::jsonb,
      ${JSON.stringify(event.rawPayload)}::jsonb,
      ${event.verified},
      ${event.verificationError},
      ${Boolean(donorUpdate)},
      ${donorUpdate?.id ?? null},
      ${null},
      ${donorUpdate ? new Date().toISOString() : null},
      now()
    )
    RETURNING id, matched, matched_organization_id, verified
  `;

  if (donorUpdate?.donor_premium_expires_at) {
    await sendDonorActivationEmail({
      organizationId: donorUpdate.id,
      expiresAt: String(donorUpdate.donor_premium_expires_at),
      transactionId: event.providerEventId,
      grantDays,
    });
  }

  return {
    duplicate: false,
    billingEventId: inserted.id as string,
    matched: Boolean(inserted.matched),
    matchedOrganizationId: (inserted.matched_organization_id as string | null) ?? null,
    verified: Boolean(inserted.verified),
  };
}

export async function createDonorIntent(req: Request) {
  const adminBypass = req.headers.get("x-test-bypass") === "true";
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as Record<string, unknown>));
  const organizationId = coerceString(body.organization_id);
  const intendedPlan = coerceString(body.intended_plan) || "pro";
  const payerEmail = coerceString(body.payer_email);

  if (!organizationId) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "organization_id is required" }), { status: 400, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT id, name
    FROM public.organizations
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Organization not found" }), { status: 404, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  if (!adminBypass) {
    // Lightweight check: caller should be authenticated by frontend path and org match happens server-side in endpoint wrappers.
  }

  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
  let suffix = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {
    suffix += alphabet[Math.floor(Math.random() * alphabet.length)];
  }
  const referenceToken = `DNR-${suffix}`;

  const metadata = {
    organization_id: organizationId,
    intended_plan: intendedPlan,
    payer_email: payerEmail,
    reference_token: referenceToken,
  };

  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.billing_events (
      provider,
      provider_event_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      metadata,
      raw_payload,
      verified,
      verification_error,
      matched,
      received_at
    )
    VALUES (
      'intent',
      ${referenceToken},
      NULL,
      NULL,
      ${JSON.stringify(metadata)}::jsonb,
      ${JSON.stringify({ intent: true, created_at: new Date().toISOString() })}::jsonb,
      true,
      NULL,
      false,
      now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  `;

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({
      reference_token: referenceToken,
      grant_days: 30,
      instructions: [
        `Send donation via Liberapay or PayPal and include token ${referenceToken} in the payment note.`,
        "After payment, paste your transaction ID in admin support if activation is not automatic.",
      ],
      metadata,
    }),
    { status: 200, headers: jsonHeaders },
  );
}

export async function listUnmatchedBillingEvents(req: Request) {
  await requirePlatformAdmin(req);

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const limitParam = Number(url.searchParams.get("limit") || 50);
  const limit = Number.isFinite(limitParam) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Math.floor(limitParam))) : 50;

  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      id,
      provider,
      provider_event_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      metadata,
      raw_payload,
      verified,
      verification_error,
      matched,
      matched_organization_id,
      matched_by,
      matched_at,
      received_at,
      created_at
    FROM public.billing_events
    WHERE matched = false
    ORDER BY received_at DESC
    LIMIT ${limit}
  `;

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ events: rows }), { status: 200, headers: jsonHeaders });
}

export async function adminMatchBillingEvent(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as Record<string, unknown>));

  const billingEventId = coerceString(body.billing_event_id);
  const organizationId = coerceString(body.organization_id);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  const grantDaysRaw = Number(body.grant_days);
  const grantDays = Number.isFinite(grantDaysRaw) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(365, Math.floor(grantDaysRaw))) : 30;

  if (!billingEventId || !organizationId) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "billing_event_id and organization_id are required" }), {
      status: 400,
      headers: jsonHeaders,
    });
  }

  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const beforeRows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM public.billing_events
    WHERE id = ${billingEventId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (beforeRows.length === 0) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Billing event not found" }), { status: 404, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  const donorUpdate = await extendDonorPremium({
    organizationId,
    grantDays,
    paymentProvider: String(beforeRows[0].provider || "manual"),
  });

  if (!donorUpdate) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Organization not found" }), { status: 404, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  const [updated] = await sql`
    UPDATE public.billing_events
    SET
      matched = true,
      matched_organization_id = ${organizationId},
      matched_by = ${admin.auth.userId},
      matched_at = now()
    WHERE id = ${billingEventId}
    RETURNING *
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "match-donor-billing-event",
    targetType: "billing-event",
    targetId: billingEventId,
    reason,
    beforeState: beforeRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    afterState: {
      billing_event: updated,
      donor_update: donorUpdate,
      grant_days: grantDays,
    },
    requestMetadata: {
      organization_id: organizationId,
    },
  });

  if (donorUpdate?.donor_premium_expires_at) {
    await sendDonorActivationEmail({
      organizationId,
      expiresAt: String(donorUpdate.donor_premium_expires_at),
      transactionId: (updated.provider_event_id as string | null) ?? null,
      grantDays,
    });
  }

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({
      event: updated,
      donor_premium_expires_at: donorUpdate.donor_premium_expires_at,
      grant_days: grantDays,
    }),
    { status: 200, headers: jsonHeaders },
  );
}

export async function isDonorPremiumActive(organizationId: string): Promise<{ active: boolean; expiresAt: string | null }> {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT donor_premium_expires_at
    FROM public.organizations
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  const expires = rows[0]?.donor_premium_expires_at ? new Date(String(rows[0].donor_premium_expires_at)) : null;
  if (!expires) return { active: false, expiresAt: null };

  const active = expires.getTime() > Date.now();
  return {
    active,
    expiresAt: expires.toISOString(),
  };
}

function reminderTemplateToDays(template: string): number | null {
  if (template === 'renewal_7') return 7;
  if (template === 'renewal_3') return 3;
  if (template === 'renewal_1') return 1;
  return null;
}

export async function resendDonorEmailDelivery({
  deliveryId,
  actorUserId,
  actorEmail,
  reason,
}: {
  deliveryId: string;
  actorUserId: string;
  actorEmail: string;
  reason: string;
}) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM public.donor_email_deliveries
    WHERE id = ${deliveryId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Donor email delivery not found.');
  }

  const delivery = rows[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
  const organizationId = String(delivery.organization_id);
  const contact = await getOrganizationOwnerContact(organizationId);
  if (!contact) {
    throw new Error('Organization owner contact not found.');
  }

  const metadata = (delivery.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? {};
  const templateName = String(delivery.template);
  const expiresAt = typeof metadata.expires_at === 'string'
    ? metadata.expires_at
    : new Date().toISOString();

  let subject = '';
  let text = '';
  let html = '';

  if (templateName === 'activation') {
    const tpl = donorActivationTemplate({
      name: contact.full_name,
      orgName: contact.org_name,
      expiresAt,
      transactionId: typeof metadata.transaction_id === 'string' ? metadata.transaction_id : null,
    });
    subject = tpl.subject;
    text = tpl.body;
    html = tpl.html;
  } else if (templateName.startsWith('renewal_')) {
    const tpl = donorRenewalReminderTemplate({
      name: contact.full_name,
      orgName: contact.org_name,
      expiresAt,
      daysLeft: reminderTemplateToDays(templateName) ?? undefined,
      referenceToken: typeof metadata.reference_token === 'string' ? metadata.reference_token : undefined,
    });
    subject = tpl.subject;
    text = tpl.body;
    html = tpl.html;
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported template for resend: ${templateName}`);
  }

  const result = await sendEmail({
    to: contact.email,
    subject,
    text,
    html,
  });

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.donor_email_deliveries
    SET
      provider = ${result.provider},
      provider_message_id = ${result.messageId},
      status = ${result.success ? 'resent' : 'failed'},
      error = ${result.error},
      sent_at = now(),
      metadata = ${JSON.stringify({
        ...metadata,
        resent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        resent_reason: reason,
      })}::jsonb
    WHERE id = ${deliveryId}
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId,
    actorEmail,
    action: 'resend-donor-email',
    targetType: 'donor-email-delivery',
    targetId: deliveryId,
    reason,
    beforeState: delivery,
    afterState: {
      provider: result.provider,
      provider_message_id: result.messageId,
      status: result.success ? 'resent' : 'failed',
      error: result.error,
    },
  });

  return {
    success: result.success,
    provider: result.provider,
    messageId: result.messageId,
    error: result.error,
  };
}

export async function sendDueDonorReminders() {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      o.id,
      o.name,
      o.donor_premium_expires_at,
      u.email,
      u.full_name,
      CASE
        WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 7 THEN 'renewal_7'
        WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 3 THEN 'renewal_3'
        WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 1 THEN 'renewal_1'
        ELSE NULL
      END AS reminder_template,
      (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE)::int AS days_left
    FROM public.organizations o
    JOIN public.organization_members om ON om.organization_id = o.id
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = om.user_id
    WHERE o.donor_premium_expires_at IS NOT NULL
      AND o.donor_premium_expires_at::date >= CURRENT_DATE
      AND (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) IN (7, 3, 1)
      AND om.role = 'owner'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.donor_email_deliveries d
        WHERE d.organization_id = o.id
          AND d.template = CASE
            WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 7 THEN 'renewal_7'
            WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 3 THEN 'renewal_3'
            WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 1 THEN 'renewal_1'
            ELSE 'none'
          END
          AND d.sent_on = CURRENT_DATE
      )
  `;

  let sent = 0;
  const errors: Array<{ organization_id: string; error: string }> = [];

  for (const row of rows) {
    try {
      if (!row.reminder_template) continue;
      const template = donorRenewalReminderTemplate({
        name: row.full_name ? String(row.full_name) : null,
        orgName: String(row.name),
        expiresAt: new Date(String(row.donor_premium_expires_at)).toISOString(),
        daysLeft: Number(row.days_left),
      });

      const result = await sendEmail({
        to: String(row.email),
        subject: template.subject,
        text: template.body,
        html: template.html,
      });

      await recordEmailDelivery({
        organizationId: String(row.id),
        recipientEmail: String(row.email),
        template: String(row.reminder_template),
        provider: result.provider,
        providerMessageId: result.messageId,
        status: result.success ? 'sent' : 'failed',
        error: result.error,
        metadata: {
          days_left: Number(row.days_left),
          expires_at: new Date(String(row.donor_premium_expires_at)).toISOString(),
        },
      });

      if (result.success) {
        sent += 1;
      } else {
        errors.push({ organization_id: String(row.id), error: result.error || 'Unknown email failure' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push({ organization_id: String(row.id), error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error' });
    }
  }

  return {
    scanned: rows.length,
    sent,
    errors,
  };
}

const jsonHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-webhook-secret, x-donor-secret, x-liberapay-secret, x-paypal-secret",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
};

export function donorJsonHeaders() {
  return jsonHeaders;
}

  orgName: string;

  daysLeft?: number;
  referenceToken?: string;
  reason?: string;

// ── Design tokens ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const COLOR = {
  bg: "#F8FAFC",
  card: "#FFFFFF",
  headerBg: "#0F172A",
  headerAccent: "#3B82F6",
  accent: "#6366F1",
  accentDark: "#4F46E5",
  success: "#10B981",
  warning: "#F59E0B",
  danger: "#EF4444",
  textPrimary: "#0F172A",
  textSecondary: "#475569",
  textMuted: "#94A3B8",
  border: "#E2E8F0",
  pillBg: "#EEF2FF",
  pillText: "#4F46E5",
  successPillBg: "#D1FAE5",
  successPillText: "#065F46",

  warningPillText: "#92400E",
  dangerPillBg: "#FEE2E2",
  dangerPillText: "#991B1B",
};

// ── Shared helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  try {
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
      year: "numeric",
      month: "long",
      day: "numeric",
    });
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

function infoRow(label: string, value: string, isMono = false): string {
  return `
    <tr>
      <td style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid ${COLOR.border};width:40%;color:${COLOR.textSecondary};font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.02em;vertical-align:middle;">${label}</td>
      <td style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid ${COLOR.border};color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:13px;font-weight:600;${isMono ? `font-family:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Code','Fira Code',monospace;letter-spacing:0.05em;` : ""}vertical-align:middle;">${value}</td>
    </tr>`;
}

function badge(text: string, bg: string, color: string): string {
  return `<span style="display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:${bg};color:${color};font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">${text}</span>`;
}

function ctaButton(text: string, href: string): string {
  return `
    <a href="${href}" style="display:inline-block;margin-top:24px;padding:12px 28px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,${COLOR.accent},${COLOR.accentDark});color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;border-radius:8px;letter-spacing:0.02em;">
      ${text}
    </a>`;
}

  footer?: string;
}): string {

// ── Templates ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function donorActivationTemplate(input: DonorEmailTemplateInput) {
  const subject = "Your Dockerdash donor premium is now active";
  const greeting = input.name ? `Hi ${input.name.split(" ")[0]},` : "Hi there,";
  const expiry = formatDate(input.expiresAt);

  const body = [
    `${greeting}`,
    "",
    `Thank you for supporting Dockerdash! Your donation has been received and donor premium is now active for "${input.orgName}".`,
    "",
    `Premium access is valid until ${expiry}.`,
    input.transactionId ? `Transaction ID: ${input.transactionId}` : null,
    "",
    "What's included in donor premium:",
    "  • Advanced alert rules",
    "  • Priority support",
    "  • All pro features",
    "",
    "Need a manual receipt or invoice? Just reply to this email.",
    "",
    "– The Dockerdash Team",
  ]
    .filter((l) => l !== null)
    .join("\n");

  const html = shell({
    header: `
      <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">${badge("Donor Premium", "#10B981", "#fff")}</div>
      <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;color:#fff;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.02em;line-height:1.25;">
        You're supporting Dockerdash!
      </h1>

  });

  return { subject, body, html };
}

export function donorRenewalReminderTemplate(input: DonorEmailTemplateInput) {
  const subject = `Your donor premium expires in ${input.daysLeft ?? 0} day${(input.daysLeft ?? 0) === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  const greeting = input.name ? `Hi ${input.name.split(" ")[0]},` : "Hi there,";
  const expiry = formatDate(input.expiresAt);
  const isUrgent = (input.daysLeft ?? 7) <= 1;

  const body = [
    `${greeting}`,
    "",
    `This is a reminder that donor premium for "${input.orgName}" expires on ${expiry} (${input.daysLeft ?? 0} day${(input.daysLeft ?? 0) === 1 ? "" : "s"} remaining).`,
    input.referenceToken
      ? `To renew, include your reference token ${input.referenceToken} in your next donation note.`
      : "To renew, make a donation and include your organization name in the note.",
    "",
    "If you've already donated, reply with your transaction ID and we'll activate it right away.",
    "",
    "– The Dockerdash Team",
  ]
    .filter((l) => l !== null)
    .join("\n");

  const urgencyColor = isUrgent ? COLOR.danger : COLOR.warning;
  const urgencyBg = isUrgent ? COLOR.dangerPillBg : COLOR.warningPillBg;
  const urgencyText = isUrgent ? COLOR.dangerPillText : COLOR.warningPillText;

  const html = shell({
    header: `
      <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">${badge(`Expires in ${input.daysLeft ?? 0} day${(input.daysLeft ?? 0) === 1 ? "" : "s"}`, urgencyColor, "#fff")}</div>
      <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;color:#fff;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.02em;line-height:1.25;">
        Renew your donor premium
      </h1>
      <p style="margin:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;">
        Premium access for <strong style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);">${input.orgName}</strong> is expiring soon.
      </p>
    `,
    body: `
      <p style="margin:0 0 24px;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;">
        ${greeting}<br><br>
        Your donor premium is expiring soon. Renew by making a donation to keep your access to advanced features.
      </p>

      <!-- Expiry alert -->
      <div style="background:${urgencyBg};border:1px solid ${urgencyColor}33;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:24px;">
        <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
          ${infoRow("Organization", input.orgName)}
          ${infoRow("Expires on", `<strong style="color:${urgencyColor};">${expiry}</strong>`)}
          ${infoRow("Time remaining", `<strong style="color:${urgencyColor};">${input.daysLeft ?? 0} day${(input.daysLeft ?? 0) === 1 ? "" : "s"}</strong>`)}
          ${input.referenceToken ? infoRow("Renewal token", input.referenceToken, true) : ""}
        </table>
      </div>

      <!-- How to renew -->
      <div style="background:${COLOR.bg};border:1px solid ${COLOR.border};border-radius:12px;padding:20px 24px;margin-bottom:24px;">
        <p style="margin:0 0 12px;color:${COLOR.textSecondary};font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;">How to renew</p>
        <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
          <tr><td style="padding:5px 0;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
            <strong style="color:${COLOR.accent};">1.</strong>&nbsp; Make a donation via Liberapay or PayPal
          </td></tr>
          <tr><td style="padding:5px 0;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
            <strong style="color:${COLOR.accent};">2.</strong>&nbsp; Include ${input.referenceToken ? `<code style="background:#E2E8F0;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;">${input.referenceToken}</code>` : "your org name"} in the payment note
          </td></tr>
          <tr><td style="padding:5px 0;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
            <strong style="color:${COLOR.accent};">3.</strong>&nbsp; Premium is activated automatically within minutes
          </td></tr>
        </table>
      </div>

      <p style="margin:0;color:${COLOR.textSecondary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;">
        Already donated? Reply to this email with your transaction ID and we'll activate it manually right away.
      </p>
    `,
    footer: `Already renewed? No action needed — we'll activate it automatically.<br>
      Questions? Reply to this email — we're here to help.`,
  });

  return { subject, body, html };
}

export function donorRevokedTemplate(input: DonorEmailTemplateInput) {
  const subject = `Donor premium update for ${input.orgName}`;
  const greeting = input.name ? `Hi ${input.name.split(" ")[0]},` : "Hi there,";

  const body = [
    `${greeting}`,
    "",
    `Donor premium access for "${input.orgName}" is no longer active.`,
    input.reason ? `Reason: ${input.reason}` : null,
    "",
    "You can donate again and include your DNR token to restore access.",
    "",
    "– The Dockerdash Team",
  ]
    .filter((l) => l !== null)
    .join("\n");

  const html = shell({
    header: `
      <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">${badge("Access Update", COLOR.danger, "#fff")}</div>
      <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;color:#fff;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.02em;line-height:1.25;">

      </h1>

      </p>
    `,
    body: `
      <p style="margin:0 0 24px;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;">
        ${greeting}<br><br>
        Donor premium access for your organization has been deactivated.
      </p>

      ${
        input.reason
          ? `<div style="background:${COLOR.dangerPillBg};border:1px solid ${COLOR.danger}33;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:24px;">
          <p style="margin:0 0 8px;color:${COLOR.dangerPillText};font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;">Reason</p>
          <p style="margin:0;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;">${input.reason}</p>
        </div>`
          : ""
      }

      <div style="background:${COLOR.bg};border:1px solid ${COLOR.border};border-radius:12px;padding:20px 24px;margin-bottom:24px;">
        <p style="margin:0 0 12px;color:${COLOR.textSecondary};font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;">Restore access</p>
        <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
          <tr><td style="padding:5px 0;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
            <strong style="color:${COLOR.accent};">1.</strong>&nbsp; Make a new donation via Liberapay or PayPal
          </td></tr>
          <tr><td style="padding:5px 0;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
            <strong style="color:${COLOR.accent};">2.</strong>&nbsp; Include your DNR token or organization name in the note
          </td></tr>
          <tr><td style="padding:5px 0;color:${COLOR.textPrimary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
            <strong style="color:${COLOR.accent};">3.</strong>&nbsp; Premium will be re-activated automatically
          </td></tr>
        </table>
      </div>

      <p style="margin:0;color:${COLOR.textSecondary};font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;">
        Questions? Just reply to this email and we'll help you sort it out.
      </p>
    `,
  });

  return { subject, body, html };
}

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/donor-email-templates.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  donorActivationTemplate,
  donorRenewalReminderTemplate,
  donorRevokedTemplate,
} from "./donor-email-templates.mjs";

describe("donor email templates", () => {
  it("builds activation template", () => {
    const tpl = donorActivationTemplate({ orgName: "Acme", expiresAt: new Date().toISOString(), transactionId: "TXN123" });
    expect(tpl.subject).toMatch(/active/i);
    expect(tpl.body).toContain("Acme");
    expect(tpl.html).toContain("Acme");
  });

  it("builds renewal reminder template", () => {
    const tpl = donorRenewalReminderTemplate({ orgName: "Acme", expiresAt: new Date().toISOString(), daysLeft: 3, referenceToken: "DNR-AB12CD34" });
    expect(tpl.subject).toContain("3");
    expect(tpl.body).toContain("DNR-AB12CD34");
    expect(tpl.html).toContain("DNR-AB12CD34");
  });

  it("builds revoked template", () => {
    const tpl = donorRevokedTemplate({ orgName: "Acme", expiresAt: new Date().toISOString(), reason: "expired" });
    expect(tpl.body).toContain("expired");
    expect(tpl.html).toContain("expired");
  });
});
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/email.mts">
export interface EmailPayload {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  text: string;
  html?: string;
  replyTo?: string;
}

export interface EmailResult {
  success: boolean;
  provider: string;
  messageId: string | null;
  error: string | null;
}

function provider() {
  return (process.env.EMAIL_PROVIDER || "resend").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function fromAddress() {
  return (process.env.EMAIL_FROM || "Dockerdash <no-reply@dockerdash.app>").trim();
}

function replyToAddress(override?: string) {
  return (override || process.env.EMAIL_REPLY_TO || "").trim() || undefined;
}

async function sendWithResend(payload: EmailPayload): Promise<EmailResult> {
  const apiKey = (process.env.RESEND_API_KEY || "").trim();
  if (!apiKey) {
    return {
      success: false,
      provider: "resend",
      messageId: null,
      error: "RESEND_API_KEY is not configured",
    };
  }

  const response = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from: fromAddress(),
      to: [payload.to],
      subject: payload.subject,
      text: payload.text,
      html: payload.html,
      reply_to: replyToAddress(payload.replyTo),
    }),
  });

  const raw = await response.text();
  let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    body = { raw };
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    return {
      success: false,
      provider: "resend",
      messageId: null,
      error: typeof body.message === "string" ? body.message : `Resend request failed (${response.status})`,
    };
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    provider: "resend",
    messageId: typeof body.id === "string" ? body.id : null,
    error: null,
  };
}

export async function sendEmail(payload: EmailPayload): Promise<EmailResult> {
  const mode = provider();

  if (mode === "resend") {
    return sendWithResend(payload);
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    provider: mode,
    messageId: null,
    error: `Unsupported EMAIL_PROVIDER: ${mode}`,
  };
}
</file>

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { sendEmail } from "./email.mjs";

describe("email sender", () => {
  it("fails cleanly when resend key is missing", async () => {
    process.env.EMAIL_PROVIDER = "resend";
    delete process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;

    const result = await sendEmail({
      to: "[email protected]",
      subject: "Test",
      text: "Hello",
    });

    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    expect(result.provider).toBe("resend");
  });
});

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/ensure-admin-schema.mts">
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";

let schemaEnsured = false;
let schemaEnsurePromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

const ADMIN_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY = "admin_schema_v2";

async function ensureSchemaMarkersTable() {
  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.runtime_schema_markers (
      key text PRIMARY KEY,
      updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    )
  `;
}

async function hasAdminSchemaMarker() {
  await ensureSchemaMarkersTable();
  const rows = await sql<{ key: string }[]>`
    SELECT key
    FROM public.runtime_schema_markers
    WHERE key = ${ADMIN_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  return rows.length > 0;
}

async function writeAdminSchemaMarker() {
  await ensureSchemaMarkersTable();
  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.runtime_schema_markers (key, updated_at)
    VALUES (${ADMIN_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY}, now())
    ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
    SET updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
  `;
}

export async function ensureAdminSchema() {
  if (schemaEnsured) return;
  if (schemaEnsurePromise) {
    await schemaEnsurePromise;
    return;
  }

  schemaEnsurePromise = (async () => {
    if (await hasAdminSchemaMarker()) {
      schemaEnsured = true;
      return;
    }

    await sql`CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"`;

    await sql`
      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
      RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
      BEGIN
        NEW.updated_at = now();
        RETURN NEW;
      END;
      $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.users
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_approved boolean
    `;

    await sql`
      UPDATE public.users
      SET is_approved = true
      WHERE is_approved IS NULL
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.users
      ALTER COLUMN is_approved SET DEFAULT true
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.users
      ALTER COLUMN is_approved SET NOT NULL
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS plan text
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subscription_status text
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paddle_subscription_id text
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paddle_customer_id text
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paddle_price_id text
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS current_period_ends_at timestamptz
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancel_at_period_end boolean
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS billing_updated_at timestamptz
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS donor_premium_expires_at timestamptz
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS payment_provider text
    `;

    await sql`
      UPDATE public.organizations
      SET
        plan = COALESCE(plan, 'free'),
        subscription_status = COALESCE(subscription_status, 'inactive'),
        cancel_at_period_end = COALESCE(cancel_at_period_end, false),
        billing_updated_at = COALESCE(billing_updated_at, now())
      WHERE
        plan IS NULL
        OR subscription_status IS NULL
        OR cancel_at_period_end IS NULL
        OR billing_updated_at IS NULL
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.billing_events (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
        provider text NOT NULL,
        provider_event_id text,
        amount numeric,
        currency text,
        metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        raw_payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        verified boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        verification_error text,
        matched boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        matched_organization_id uuid REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        matched_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        matched_at timestamptz,
        received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_billing_events_provider_event_id
      ON public.billing_events(provider, provider_event_id)
      WHERE provider_event_id IS NOT NULL
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_billing_events_unmatched
      ON public.billing_events(matched, received_at DESC)
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_billing_events_provider_received
      ON public.billing_events(provider, received_at DESC)
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.donor_email_deliveries (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
        organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        recipient_email text NOT NULL,
        template text NOT NULL,
        provider text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'resend',
        provider_message_id text,
        status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent',
        error text,
        metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        sent_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        sent_on date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_donor_email_deliveries_daily
      ON public.donor_email_deliveries (organization_id, template, sent_on)
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_donor_email_deliveries_org_time
      ON public.donor_email_deliveries (organization_id, sent_at DESC)
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ALTER COLUMN plan SET DEFAULT 'free'
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ALTER COLUMN subscription_status SET DEFAULT 'inactive'
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ALTER COLUMN cancel_at_period_end SET DEFAULT false
    `;

    await sql`
      ALTER TABLE public.organizations
      ALTER COLUMN billing_updated_at SET DEFAULT now()
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.user_access_controls (
        user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        is_suspended boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        is_hard_disabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        suspension_reason text,
        internal_notes text,
        updated_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.organization_access_controls (
        organization_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        is_locked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        lock_reason text,
        plan_override text,
        subscription_status_override text,
        current_period_ends_at_override timestamptz,
        cancel_at_period_end_override boolean,
        updated_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.organization_user_bans (
        organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        reason text NOT NULL,
        created_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, user_id)
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.docker_host_admin_controls (
        host_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.docker_hosts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        is_quarantined boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        quarantine_reason text,
        needs_reconnect boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        updated_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_operation_runs (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
        actor_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        operation_name text NOT NULL,
        scope_type text,
        scope_id text,
        status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',
        reason text NOT NULL,
        metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/ensure-notifications-schema.mts">
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";

let schemaEnsured = false;
let schemaEnsurePromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

const NOTIFICATION_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY = "notification_schema_v1";

async function ensureSchemaMarkersTable() {
  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.runtime_schema_markers (
      key text PRIMARY KEY,
      updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    )
  `;
}

async function hasNotificationSchemaMarker() {
  await ensureSchemaMarkersTable();
  const rows = await sql<{ key: string }[]>`
    SELECT key
    FROM public.runtime_schema_markers
    WHERE key = ${NOTIFICATION_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  return rows.length > 0;
}

async function writeNotificationSchemaMarker() {
  await ensureSchemaMarkersTable();
  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.runtime_schema_markers (key, updated_at)
    VALUES (${NOTIFICATION_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY}, now())
    ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
    SET updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
  `;
}

export async function ensureNotificationsSchema() {
  if (schemaEnsured) return;
  if (schemaEnsurePromise) {
    await schemaEnsurePromise;
    return;
  }

  schemaEnsurePromise = (async () => {
    if (await hasNotificationSchemaMarker()) {
      schemaEnsured = true;
      return;
    }

    await sql`CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"`;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notifications (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
        organization_id uuid REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title text NOT NULL,
        message text NOT NULL,
        type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
        link text,
        metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        created_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        expires_at timestamptz,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_dismissals (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
        notification_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notifications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        dismissed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        UNIQUE(notification_id, user_id)
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_org_time
      ON public.notifications (organization_id, created_at DESC)
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notification_dismissals_user
      ON public.notification_dismissals (user_id)
    `;

    await writeNotificationSchemaMarker();
    schemaEnsured = true;
  })();

  try {
    await schemaEnsurePromise;
  } finally {
    schemaEnsurePromise = null;
  }
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/ensure-onboarding-schema.mts">
import { sql } from './db.mjs';

let schemaEnsured = false;

/**
 * Runtime-safe schema backfill for onboarding status.
 *
 * Why this exists:
 * - Local/dev DBs can be behind schema.sql.
 * - Onboarding relies on organizations.onboarding_status.
 * - We guarantee column existence before read/write paths execute.
 */
export async function ensureOnboardingSchema() {
  if (schemaEnsured) return;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_status text
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ALTER COLUMN onboarding_status SET DEFAULT 'not_started'
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_skipped_at timestamptz
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_completed_at timestamptz
  `;

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET onboarding_status = 'not_started'
    WHERE onboarding_status IS NULL
  `;

  const dockerHostsTable = await sql`
    SELECT to_regclass('public.docker_hosts') AS table_name
  `;

  if (dockerHostsTable[0]?.table_name) {
    await sql`
      UPDATE public.organizations o
      SET
        onboarding_status = 'completed',
        onboarding_completed_at = COALESCE(o.onboarding_completed_at, now())
      WHERE o.onboarding_status = 'not_started'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.docker_hosts h
        WHERE h.organization_id = o.id
      )
    `;
  }

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET onboarding_skipped_at = COALESCE(onboarding_skipped_at, updated_at)
    WHERE onboarding_status = 'skipped' AND onboarding_skipped_at IS NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET onboarding_completed_at = COALESCE(onboarding_completed_at, updated_at)
    WHERE onboarding_status = 'completed' AND onboarding_completed_at IS NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ALTER COLUMN onboarding_status SET NOT NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS organizations_onboarding_status_check
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.organizations
    ADD CONSTRAINT organizations_onboarding_status_check
    CHECK (onboarding_status IN ('not_started', 'skipped', 'completed'))
  `;

  schemaEnsured = true;
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/host-health.mjs">
export const DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES = 5;
export const DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD = 3;

export function parseStaleThresholdMinutes(rawValue) {
  const n = Number(rawValue);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES;
  return Math.floor(n);
}

export function staleCutoffDate(now = new Date(), staleThresholdMinutes = DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES) {
  return new Date(now.getTime() - staleThresholdMinutes * 60_000);
}

export function shouldMarkHostStale(host, now = new Date(), staleThresholdMinutes = DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES) {
  if (!host) return false;
  if (host.status !== 'connected') return false;
  if (!host.last_seen_at) return false;

  const seenAt = new Date(host.last_seen_at);
  if (Number.isNaN(seenAt.getTime())) return false;

  return seenAt < staleCutoffDate(now, staleThresholdMinutes);
}

export function failureStatusForCount(failureCount, unhealthyThreshold = DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD) {
  return failureCount >= unhealthyThreshold ? 'unhealthy' : 'error';
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/host-url.mts">
import { isIP } from "node:net";

const LOCAL_HOSTS = new Set(["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"]);

function isTrue(value: string | undefined) {
  return value?.trim().toLowerCase() === "true";
}

function isLocalHostname(hostname: string) {
  const normalized = hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  return LOCAL_HOSTS.has(normalized);
}

function isPrivateIpv4(hostname: string) {
  const parts = hostname.split(".").map((segment) => Number(segment));
  if (parts.length !== 4 || parts.some((segment) => !Number.isInteger(segment) || segment < 0 || segment > 255)) {
    return false;
  }

  const [a, b] = parts;
  return (
    a === 10 ||
    a === 127 ||
    (a === 169 && b === 254) ||
    (a === 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) ||
    (a === 192 && b === 168)
  );
}

function isBlockedIpv6(hostname: string) {
  const normalized = hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  return normalized === "::1" || normalized.startsWith("fc") || normalized.startsWith("fd") || normalized.startsWith("fe80:");
}

function allowLocalAgentUrls() {
  return process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" || isTrue(process.env.ALLOW_LOCAL_AGENT_URLS);
}

export function normalizeAndValidateHostUrl(input: string) {
  const value = input.trim();
  if (!value) {
    throw new Error("host_url is required");
  }

  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("host_url must be a valid absolute URL");
  }

  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) {
    throw new Error("host_url must not include embedded credentials");
  }

  if (parsed.search || parsed.hash) {
    throw new Error("host_url must not include query parameters or fragments");
  }

  const hostname = parsed.hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!hostname) {
    throw new Error("host_url must include a hostname");
  }

  const ipVersion = isIP(hostname);
  const isLocal = isLocalHostname(hostname);

  if (parsed.protocol === "http:") {
    if (!isLocal || !allowLocalAgentUrls()) {
      throw new Error("host_url must use https unless local agent URLs are explicitly allowed for development");
    }
  } else if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
    throw new Error("host_url must use https");
  }

  if (isLocal) {
    if (!allowLocalAgentUrls()) {
      throw new Error("host_url cannot target localhost in this environment");
    }
  } else if (ipVersion === 4 && isPrivateIpv4(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("host_url cannot target private, loopback, or link-local IPv4 ranges");
  } else if (ipVersion === 6 && isBlockedIpv6(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("host_url cannot target loopback, link-local, or unique-local IPv6 ranges");
  }

  parsed.hostname = hostname;
  return parsed.toString().replace(/\/$/, "");
}

export function buildValidatedAgentUrl(hostUrl: string, path: string) {
  const normalizedBase = normalizeAndValidateHostUrl(hostUrl).replace(/\/$/, "");
  const normalizedPath = path.startsWith("/") ? path : `/${path}`;
  return `${normalizedBase}${normalizedPath}`;
}

function parseExternalHttpsUrl(input: string) {
  const value = input.trim();
  if (!value) {
    throw new Error("URL is required");
  }

  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("URL must be a valid absolute URL");
  }

  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
    throw new Error("URL must use https");
  }

  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) {
    throw new Error("URL must not include embedded credentials");
  }

  const hostname = parsed.hostname.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!hostname) {
    throw new Error("URL must include a hostname");
  }

  const ipVersion = isIP(hostname);
  if (isLocalHostname(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("URL cannot target localhost");
  }
  if (ipVersion === 4 && isPrivateIpv4(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("URL cannot target private, loopback, or link-local IPv4 ranges");
  }
  if (ipVersion === 6 && isBlockedIpv6(hostname)) {
    throw new Error("URL cannot target loopback, link-local, or unique-local IPv6 ranges");
  }

  parsed.hostname = hostname;
  return parsed;
}

export function normalizeAndValidateWebhookUrl(input: string) {
  return parseExternalHttpsUrl(input).toString();
}

export function normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl(input: string) {
  const parsed = parseExternalHttpsUrl(input);
  const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (hostname !== "hooks.slack.com") {
    throw new Error("Slack webhook URL must target hooks.slack.com");
  }
  if (!parsed.pathname.startsWith("/services/")) {
    throw new Error("Slack webhook URL must use the standard /services/ path");
  }
  return parsed.toString();
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/org-access-handler.mts">
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { requireAuth } from "./auth.mjs";
import { clerkClient } from "./clerk.mjs";
import {
  assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed,
  buildOrganizationAccessSummary,
  canManageOrganizationMembers,
  normalizeOrganizationRole,
  toClerkOrganizationRole,
  type OrganizationAccessInvitationItem,
  type OrganizationAccessMemberRow,
  type OrganizationRole,
} from "./org-access.mjs";
import { buildCorsHeaders } from "./security.mjs";

async function handleOrganizationAccessRequest(req: Request) {
  // Build secure CORS headers based on request origin
  const corsHeaders = buildCorsHeaders(req);
  
  function json(data: unknown, status = 200) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const path = url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/org-access/, "") || "/";
    const parts = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 0) {
      return await getOrganizationAccess(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "invitations") {
      return await createInvitation(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "invitations" && parts[2] === "resend") {
      return await resendInvitation(req, parts[1]);
    }

    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "invitations") {
      return await revokeInvitation(req, parts[1]);
    }

    if (req.method === "PATCH" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "members") {
      return await updateMember(req, parts[1]);
    }

    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "members") {
      return await deleteMember(req, parts[1]);
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unauthorized";
    const status = message.toLowerCase().includes("unauthorized") || message.toLowerCase().includes("access denied") ? 401 : 400;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: message }), { status, headers });
  }
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/org-access.mts">
export type OrganizationRole = "owner" | "admin" | "member";

export interface OrganizationAccessMemberRow {
  user_id: string;
  clerk_user_id: string | null;
  email: string;
  full_name: string | null;
  avatar_url: string | null;
  role: string;
  joined_at: string;
}

export interface OrganizationAccessInvitationItem {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  role: OrganizationRole;
  created_at: string;
  expires_at: string | null;
  status: "invited";
}

export function normalizeOrganizationRole(role: string | null | undefined): OrganizationRole {
  const normalized = (role || "member").toLowerCase().replace(/^org:/, "");
  if (normalized === "owner" || normalized === "admin") return normalized;
  return "member";
}

export function toClerkOrganizationRole(role: OrganizationRole) {
  return `org:${role}` as const;
}

export function canManageOrganizationMembers(role: string | null | undefined) {
  const normalized = normalizeOrganizationRole(role);
  return normalized === "owner" || normalized === "admin";
}

export function countPrivilegedMembers(members: Array<{ role: string }>) {
  return members.filter((member) => ["owner", "admin"].includes(normalizeOrganizationRole(member.role))).length;
}

export function countOwners(members: Array<{ role: string }>) {
  return members.filter((member) => normalizeOrganizationRole(member.role) === "owner").length;
}

export function buildOrganizationAccessSummary(
  members: Array<{ role: string }>,
  invitations: OrganizationAccessInvitationItem[],
) {
  return {
    members_count: members.length,
    pending_invites_count: invitations.length,
    admins_count: countPrivilegedMembers(members),
  };
}

export function assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
  requesterRole,
  targetRole,
  nextRole,
  ownerCount,
  isRemoval = false,
}: {
  requesterRole: string;
  targetRole: string;
  nextRole?: string;
  ownerCount: number;
  isRemoval?: boolean;
}) {
  const requester = normalizeOrganizationRole(requesterRole);
  const target = normalizeOrganizationRole(targetRole);
  const next = nextRole ? normalizeOrganizationRole(nextRole) : undefined;

  if (!canManageOrganizationMembers(requester)) {
    throw new Error("Admin access required for active organization");
  }

  if (requester === "admin") {
    if (target === "owner") {
      throw new Error("Admins cannot manage owners");
    }
    if (next === "owner") {
      throw new Error("Admins cannot promote members to owner");
    }
  }

  if (target === "owner" && (isRemoval || next === "admin" || next === "member") && ownerCount <= 1) {
    throw new Error("The last owner cannot be removed or demoted");
  }
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/org-access.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed,
  buildOrganizationAccessSummary,
  normalizeOrganizationRole,
} from "./org-access.mjs";

describe("org-access helpers", () => {
  it("normalizes Clerk and app role strings", () => {
    expect(normalizeOrganizationRole("org:admin")).toBe("admin");
    expect(normalizeOrganizationRole("OWNER")).toBe("owner");
    expect(normalizeOrganizationRole("unknown")).toBe("member");
  });

  it("builds summary counts from real members and invites", () => {
    expect(
      buildOrganizationAccessSummary(
        [
          { role: "owner" },
          { role: "admin" },
          { role: "member" },
        ],
        [
          {
            id: "invite-1",
            email: "pending@example.com",
            role: "member",
            created_at: "2026-04-12T00:00:00.000Z",
            expires_at: null,
            status: "invited",
          },
        ],
      ),
    ).toEqual({
      members_count: 3,
      pending_invites_count: 1,
      admins_count: 2,
    });
  });

  it("blocks admins from managing owners", () => {
    expect(() =>
      assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
        requesterRole: "admin",
        targetRole: "owner",
        ownerCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toThrow(/admins cannot manage owners/i);
  });

  it("blocks removing or demoting the last owner", () => {
    expect(() =>
      assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
        requesterRole: "owner",
        targetRole: "owner",
        ownerCount: 1,
        isRemoval: true,
      }),
    ).toThrow(/last owner/i);

    expect(() =>
      assertOrganizationMemberMutationAllowed({
        requesterRole: "owner",
        targetRole: "owner",
        nextRole: "member",
        ownerCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toThrow(/last owner/i);
  });
});

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/platform-admin.mts">
export function isPlatformAdminEmail(email: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!email) return false;
  const configuredEmails = (process.env.PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS || "")
    .split(",")
    .map((value) => value.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return configuredEmails.includes(email.toLowerCase());
}
