<file path="netlify/functions/lib/secret-migration.mts">
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { getActiveEncryptionKeyId, isSecretUsingActiveKey, reencryptSecret } from "./crypto.mjs";

export interface SecretMigrationScope {
  organizationId?: string | null;
  hostId?: string | null;
  dryRun?: boolean;
}

export interface SecretMigrationResult {
  activeKeyId: string;
  migratedCount: number;
  alreadyCurrentCount: number;
  failedCount: number;
  scannedCount: number;
  failures: Array<{ hostId: string; field: string; error: string }>;
}

export async function runSecretMigration(scope: SecretMigrationScope): Promise<SecretMigrationResult> {
  const secrets = scope.hostId
    ? await sql`
        SELECT s.*
        FROM public.docker_host_secrets s
        JOIN public.docker_hosts h ON h.id = s.host_id
        WHERE s.host_id = ${scope.hostId}
      `
    : scope.organizationId
      ? await sql`
          SELECT s.*
          FROM public.docker_host_secrets s
          JOIN public.docker_hosts h ON h.id = s.host_id
          WHERE h.organization_id = ${scope.organizationId}
        `
      : await sql`
          SELECT s.*
          FROM public.docker_host_secrets s
          JOIN public.docker_hosts h ON h.id = s.host_id
        `;

  let migratedCount = 0;
  let alreadyCurrentCount = 0;
  let failedCount = 0;
  const failures: Array<{ hostId: string; field: string; error: string }> = [];

  for (const secret of secrets as Array<Record<string, string | null>>) {
    try {
      const needsUpdate =
        (!!secret.agent_api_key && !isSecretUsingActiveKey(secret.agent_api_key)) ||
        (!!secret.cf_service_token_id && !isSecretUsingActiveKey(secret.cf_service_token_id)) ||
        (!!secret.cf_service_token_secret && !isSecretUsingActiveKey(secret.cf_service_token_secret));

      if (!needsUpdate) {
        alreadyCurrentCount++;
        continue;
      }

      if (scope.dryRun) {
        migratedCount++;
        continue;
      }

      const newAgentKey = secret.agent_api_key
        ? reencryptSecret(secret.agent_api_key, String(secret.host_id), "agent_api_key")
        : null;
      const newCfId = secret.cf_service_token_id
        ? reencryptSecret(secret.cf_service_token_id, String(secret.host_id), "cf_service_token_id")
        : null;
      const newCfSecret = secret.cf_service_token_secret
        ? reencryptSecret(secret.cf_service_token_secret, String(secret.host_id), "cf_service_token_secret")
        : null;

      await sql`
        UPDATE public.docker_host_secrets
        SET
          agent_api_key = ${newAgentKey},
          cf_service_token_id = ${newCfId},
          cf_service_token_secret = ${newCfSecret}
        WHERE host_id = ${String(secret.host_id)}
      `;

      migratedCount++;
    } catch (error) {
      failedCount++;
      failures.push({
        hostId: String(secret.host_id),
        field: "docker_host_secrets",
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    activeKeyId: getActiveEncryptionKeyId(),
    migratedCount,
    alreadyCurrentCount,
    failedCount,
    scannedCount: secrets.length,
    failures,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/security.mts">
import { sql } from './db.mjs';

/**
 * Security utilities for CORS, rate limiting, and request logging
 */

// Trusted origins for CORS
export const TRUSTED_ORIGINS = new Set([
  'https://app.dockerdash.app',
  'https://dockerdash.app',
  'https://www.dockerdash.app',
  'http://localhost:5173',
  'http://localhost:8080',
  'http://localhost:8081',
  'http://localhost:8888',
]);

/**
 * Validate and return allowed origin for CORS
 * Returns null if origin is not trusted
 */
export function getAllowedOrigin(requestOrigin: string | null): string | null {
  if (!requestOrigin) return null;
  
  try {
    const origin = new URL(requestOrigin).origin;
    if (TRUSTED_ORIGINS.has(origin)) {
      return origin;
    }
  } catch {
    // Invalid URL format
    return null;
  }
  
  return null;
}

/**
 * Build secure CORS headers
 * Only allows trusted origins, never uses wildcard
 */
export function buildCorsHeaders(req: Request, allowCredentials = true): Record<string, string> {
  const requestOrigin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const allowedOrigin = getAllowedOrigin(requestOrigin);
  
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Vary': 'Origin',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };
  
  if (allowedOrigin) {
    headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = allowedOrigin;
    if (allowCredentials) {
      headers['Access-Control-Allow-Credentials'] = 'true';
    }
  } else if (requestOrigin) {
    // Don't set Access-Control-Allow-Origin for untrusted origins
    // This effectively blocks cross-origin requests from unknown sites
    console.warn(`[CORS] Blocked untrusted origin: ${requestOrigin}`);
  }
  
  headers['Access-Control-Allow-Headers'] = 'Content-Type, Authorization, Idempotency-Key, X-Idempotency-Key';
  headers['Access-Control-Allow-Methods'] = 'GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS';
  
  return headers;
}

/**
 * Build CORS headers for preflight OPTIONS requests
 */
export function buildCorsPreflightHeaders(req: Request): Record<string, string> {
  return buildCorsHeaders(req, true);
}

/**
 * Rate limiting configuration
 */
export interface RateLimitConfig {
  windowMs: number;      // Time window in milliseconds
  maxRequests: number;   // Max requests per window
}

/**
 * Default rate limit configurations
 */
export const RATE_LIMITS = {
  // Strict limits for auth endpoints
  AUTH: { windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 10 },     // 10 requests per 15 minutes
  // Very strict for webhooks (should only come from provider)
  WEBHOOK: { windowMs: 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 30 },        // 30 requests per minute
  // Standard API limits
  API: { windowMs: 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 100 },           // 100 requests per minute
  // More permissive for proxy operations
  PROXY: { windowMs: 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 200 },         // 200 requests per minute
};

/**
 * Shared, database-backed rate limiting avoids per-instance bypasses in serverless.
 */
interface PersistedRateLimitState {
  count: number;
  resetAt: number;
}

let securitySchemaEnsured = false;

async function ensureSecuritySchema() {
  if (securitySchemaEnsured) return;

  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.security_rate_limits (
      key text NOT NULL,
      window_start_ms bigint NOT NULL,
      window_ms bigint NOT NULL,
      count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      reset_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (key, window_start_ms)
    )
  `;

  await sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_security_rate_limits_reset
    ON public.security_rate_limits (reset_at)
  `;

  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.security_webhook_nonces (
      nonce text PRIMARY KEY,
      expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
      created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    )
  `;

  await sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_security_webhook_nonces_expires
    ON public.security_webhook_nonces (expires_at)
  `;

  securitySchemaEnsured = true;
}

function normalizeRateLimitWindowStart(now: number, windowMs: number) {
  return Math.floor(now / windowMs) * windowMs;
}

async function checkRateLimitPersistent(
  key: string,
  config: RateLimitConfig
): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number; resetAt: number; retryAfter?: number }> {
  await ensureSecuritySchema();
  const now = Date.now();
  const windowStart = normalizeRateLimitWindowStart(now, config.windowMs);
  const resetAt = windowStart + config.windowMs;

  const rows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.security_rate_limits (key, window_start_ms, window_ms, count, reset_at)
    VALUES (${key}, ${windowStart}, ${config.windowMs}, 1, to_timestamp(${resetAt} / 1000.0))
    ON CONFLICT (key, window_start_ms)
    DO UPDATE SET count = public.security_rate_limits.count + 1,
                  reset_at = EXCLUDED.reset_at
    RETURNING count, floor(extract(epoch from reset_at) * 1000)::bigint AS reset_at_ms
  ` as Array<{ count: number; reset_at_ms: string | number }>;

  const row = rows[0];
  const count = Number(row?.count ?? 0);
  const persistedResetAt = Number(row?.reset_at_ms ?? resetAt);

  if (count > config.maxRequests) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      remaining: 0,
      resetAt: persistedResetAt,
      retryAfter: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((persistedResetAt - now) / 1000)),
    };
  }

  return {
    allowed: true,
    remaining: Math.max(0, config.maxRequests - count),
    resetAt: persistedResetAt,
  };
}

/**
 * Generate a rate limit key based on request
 */
export function getRateLimitKey(req: Request, endpoint: string): string {
  // Use IP address if available, otherwise fall back to other identifiers
  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() 
          || req.headers.get('x-real-ip')
          || req.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip')
          || 'unknown';
  return `${endpoint}:${ip}`;
}

/**
 * Check and update rate limit
 * Returns { allowed: boolean, remaining: number, resetAt: number }
 */
export async function checkRateLimit(
  key: string,
  config: RateLimitConfig
): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number; resetAt: number; retryAfter?: number }> {
  return checkRateLimitPersistent(key, config);
}

/**
 * Create rate limit headers for response
 */
export function buildRateLimitHeaders(
  remaining: number,
  resetAt: number,
  limit: number
): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    'X-RateLimit-Limit': String(limit),
    'X-RateLimit-Remaining': String(Math.max(0, remaining)),
    'X-RateLimit-Reset': String(Math.ceil(resetAt / 1000)),
  };
}

/**
 * Apply rate limiting to a request
 * Returns response if rate limited, null if OK to proceed
 */
export async function applyRateLimit(
  req: Request,
  endpoint: string,
  config: RateLimitConfig
): Promise<Response | null> {
  const key = getRateLimitKey(req, endpoint);
  const result = await checkRateLimit(key, config);
  
  if (!result.allowed) {
    console.warn(`[RateLimit] Exceeded limit for ${endpoint}: ${key}`);
    const headers = {
      ...buildRateLimitHeaders(result.remaining, result.resetAt, config.maxRequests),
      'Retry-After': String(result.retryAfter || 60),
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    };
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        error: 'Too Many Requests',
        message: `Rate limit exceeded. Please try again after ${result.retryAfter} seconds.`,
        retry_after: result.retryAfter,
      }),
      { status: 429, headers }
    );
  }
  
  return null;
}

/**
 * Webhook replay attack protection
 */
export interface WebhookVerificationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  error?: string;
  timestamp?: number;
  nonce?: string;
}

/**
 * Shared webhook nonce persistence avoids replay bypasses across instances.
 */
async function registerWebhookNonce(nonce: string, maxAge: number): Promise<boolean> {
  await ensureSecuritySchema();
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + (maxAge * 1000));

  const rows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.security_webhook_nonces (nonce, expires_at)
    VALUES (${nonce}, ${expiresAt.toISOString()})
    ON CONFLICT (nonce) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING nonce
  ` as Array<{ nonce: string }>;

  return rows.length > 0;
}

/**
 * Verify webhook timestamp and nonce to prevent replay attacks
 * @param timestampHeader - Unix timestamp from webhook header
 * @param nonceHeader - Unique nonce from webhook header
 * @param maxAge - Maximum allowed age in seconds (default: 5 minutes)
 */
export async function verifyWebhookTimestamp(
  timestampHeader: string | null,
  nonceHeader: string | null,
  maxAge = 300
): Promise<WebhookVerificationResult> {
  if (!timestampHeader) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Missing timestamp header' };
  }
  
  const timestamp = parseInt(timestampHeader, 10);
  if (Number.isNaN(timestamp)) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid timestamp format' };
  }
  
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const age = now - timestamp;
  
  if (age > maxAge) {
    console.warn(`[Webhook] Replay attack detected: timestamp too old (${age}s)`);
    return { valid: false, error: 'Timestamp too old' };
  }
  
  if (age < -60) {
    // Allow some clock skew but reject future timestamps
    console.warn(`[Webhook] Invalid timestamp: appears to be in the future`);
    return { valid: false, error: 'Timestamp in future' };
  }
  
  // Check nonce if provided
  if (nonceHeader) {
    const inserted = await registerWebhookNonce(nonceHeader, maxAge);
    if (!inserted) {
      console.warn(`[Webhook] Replay attack detected: duplicate nonce`);
      return { valid: false, error: 'Duplicate nonce' };
    }
  }
  
  return { valid: true, timestamp, nonce: nonceHeader || undefined };
}

/**
 * Log security-relevant events
 */
export interface SecurityLogEvent {
  type: 'auth_failure' | 'webhook_signature_failure' | 'rate_limit_exceeded' | 'cors_blocked' | 'replay_attack';
  endpoint: string;
  ip?: string;
  userId?: string;
  reason: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * Log security event for monitoring
 */
export function logSecurityEvent(event: SecurityLogEvent): void {
  const logEntry = {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    level: 'WARN',
    category: 'SECURITY',
    ...event,
  };
  
  // Always log security events
  console.warn('[SECURITY]', JSON.stringify(logEntry));
  
  // In production, you might want to send these to a SIEM or monitoring service
  // Example: sendToMonitoringService(logEntry);
}

/**
 * Get client IP from request headers
 */
export function getClientIp(req: Request): string | undefined {
  return req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() 
      || req.headers.get('x-real-ip')
      || req.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip')
      || undefined;
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/security.test.ts">
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

vi.mock("./db.mjs", () => ({
  sql: vi.fn(),
}));

import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { buildCorsHeaders, checkRateLimit, getAllowedOrigin, TRUSTED_ORIGINS, verifyWebhookTimestamp } from "./security.mts";

const mockedSql = vi.mocked(sql);

afterEach(() => {
  mockedSql.mockReset();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

describe("security CORS helpers", () => {
  it("allows only trusted origins", () => {
    expect(getAllowedOrigin("https://dockerdash.app")).toBe("https://dockerdash.app");
    expect(getAllowedOrigin("https://evil.example.com")).toBeNull();
    expect(getAllowedOrigin("not-a-url")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("includes only production-safe allowed headers", () => {
    const req = new Request("https://dockerdash.app/.netlify/functions/api-test", {
      headers: {
        origin: "https://dockerdash.app",
      },
    });

    const headers = buildCorsHeaders(req);
    const allowedHeaders = headers["Access-Control-Allow-Headers"];

    expect(allowedHeaders).toContain("Content-Type");
    expect(allowedHeaders).toContain("Authorization");
    expect(allowedHeaders).toContain("Idempotency-Key");
    expect(allowedHeaders).toContain("X-Idempotency-Key");

    expect(allowedHeaders).not.toMatch(/x-test-/i);
    expect(allowedHeaders).not.toContain("X-Test-Bypass");
    expect(allowedHeaders).not.toContain("X-Test-User-Id");
    expect(allowedHeaders).not.toContain("X-Test-Org-Id");
    expect(allowedHeaders).not.toContain("X-Test-Platform-Admin");
    expect(allowedHeaders).not.toContain("X-Test-Email");
  });

  it("does not set allow-origin for untrusted origins", () => {
    const req = new Request("https://dockerdash.app/.netlify/functions/api-test", {
      headers: {
        origin: "https://evil.example.com",
      },
    });

    const headers = buildCorsHeaders(req);

    expect(headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("does not warn for requests with no Origin header", () => {
    const warnSpy = vi.spyOn(console, "warn").mockImplementation(() => {});
    const req = new Request("https://dockerdash.app/.netlify/functions/api-test");

    const headers = buildCorsHeaders(req);

    expect(headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]).toBeUndefined();
    expect(warnSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("warns and blocks explicit null origins", () => {
    const warnSpy = vi.spyOn(console, "warn").mockImplementation(() => {});
    const req = new Request("https://dockerdash.app/.netlify/functions/api-test", {
      headers: {
        origin: "null",
      },
    });

    const headers = buildCorsHeaders(req);

    expect(headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]).toBeUndefined();
    expect(warnSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("[CORS] Blocked untrusted origin: null");
  });

  it("keeps localhost origins in trusted set for local development", () => {
    expect(TRUSTED_ORIGINS.has("http://localhost:8080")).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("distributed security persistence", () => {
  it("uses shared SQL storage for rate limiting windows", async () => {
    mockedSql.mockImplementation(async (queryParts: any) => {
      if (queryParts[0].includes("INSERT INTO public.security_rate_limits")) {
        return [{ count: 1, reset_at_ms: String(60_000) }];
      }
      return [];
    });

    const result = await checkRateLimit("api:127.0.0.1", { windowMs: 60_000, maxRequests: 3 });

    expect(mockedSql).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result).toEqual({
      allowed: true,
      remaining: 2,
      resetAt: 60_000,
    });
  });

  it("blocks requests once the shared counter exceeds the configured maximum", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    vi.setSystemTime(new Date("2026-04-18T00:00:30.000Z"));
    mockedSql.mockImplementation(async (queryParts: any) => {
      if (queryParts[0].includes("INSERT INTO public.security_rate_limits")) {
        return [{ count: 4, reset_at_ms: String(Date.parse("2026-04-18T00:01:00.000Z")) }];
      }
      return [];
    });

    const result = await checkRateLimit("api:127.0.0.1", { windowMs: 60_000, maxRequests: 3 });

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(false);
    expect(result.remaining).toBe(0);
    expect(result.retryAfter).toBe(30);
  });

  it("rejects duplicate webhook nonces using shared SQL persistence", async () => {
    mockedSql.mockImplementation(async () => []);

    const result = await verifyWebhookTimestamp(String(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)), "nonce-1", 300);

    expect(result).toEqual({ valid: false, error: "Duplicate nonce" });
    expect(mockedSql).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/slack-delivery.mts">
import crypto from 'crypto';

import { decryptSecret, encryptSecret } from './crypto.mjs';
import { sql } from './db.mjs';
import type { AppAuthContext } from './auth.mjs';
import { normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl } from './host-url.mjs';

type SlackDeliveryEventType = 'alert.opened' | 'alert.acknowledged' | 'alert.resolved' | 'alert.test';

interface SlackDestinationRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  webhook_url: string;
  webhook_url_preview: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  created_by: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface SlackAttemptRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  slack_destination_id: string;
  alert_event_id: string | null;
  delivery_kind: 'alert' | 'test';
  event_type: string;
  succeeded: boolean;
  http_status: number | null;
  error_summary: string | null;
  response_excerpt: string | null;
  attempted_at: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface AlertPayloadSource {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  incident_id?: string | null;
  rule_id?: string | null;
  source_type: 'host' | 'container' | 'metric' | 'system';
  source_ref: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: string;
  status: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  first_seen_at?: string;
  last_seen_at?: string;
  acknowledged_at?: string | null;
  resolved_at?: string | null;
  created_at?: string;
  updated_at?: string;
  href?: string;
}

function normalizeDestination(row: SlackDestinationRow & {
  latest_attempt_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_org_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_destination_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_alert_event_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_delivery_kind?: 'alert' | 'test' | null;
  latest_attempt_event_type?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_succeeded?: boolean | null;
  latest_attempt_http_status?: number | null;
  latest_attempt_error_summary?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_response_excerpt?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_attempted_at?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_created_at?: string | null;
}) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    organization_id: row.organization_id,
    name: row.name,
    webhook_url_preview: row.webhook_url_preview,
    enabled: row.enabled,
    created_by: row.created_by,
    created_at: row.created_at,
    updated_at: row.updated_at,
    latest_attempt: row.latest_attempt_id ? {
      id: row.latest_attempt_id,
      organization_id: row.latest_attempt_org_id!,
      webhook_destination_id: row.latest_attempt_destination_id!,
      alert_event_id: row.latest_attempt_alert_event_id ?? null,
      delivery_kind: row.latest_attempt_delivery_kind!,
      event_type: row.latest_attempt_event_type!,
      succeeded: !!row.latest_attempt_succeeded,
      http_status: row.latest_attempt_http_status ?? null,
      error_summary: row.latest_attempt_error_summary ?? null,
      response_excerpt: row.latest_attempt_response_excerpt ?? null,
      attempted_at: row.latest_attempt_attempted_at!,
      created_at: row.latest_attempt_created_at!,
    } : null,
  };
}

function maskSlackWebhookUrl(webhookUrl: string) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(webhookUrl);
    const parts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const tail = parts.slice(-2).join('/');
    return `${url.origin}/.../${tail}`;
  } catch {
    return `${webhookUrl.slice(0, 18)}...`;
  }
}

function emojiForSeverity(severity: string) {
  if (severity === 'critical') return ':rotating_light:';
  if (severity === 'error') return ':x:';
  if (severity === 'warning') return ':warning:';
  return ':information_source:';
}

function emojiForStatus(status: string) {
  if (status === 'resolved') return ':white_check_mark:';
  if (status === 'acknowledged') return ':eyes:';
  return ':bell:';
}

function capText(value: string | null | undefined, max = 280) {
  if (!value) return null;
  return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max - 3)}...` : value;
}

function mapAlertHref(alert: AlertPayloadSource) {
  if (alert.href) return alert.href;
  const metadata = alert.metadata ?? {};
  const hostId = typeof metadata.host_id === 'string' ? metadata.host_id : null;
  const containerShortId =
    typeof metadata.container_short_id === 'string'
      ? metadata.container_short_id
      : typeof metadata.container_id === 'string'
        ? metadata.container_id.slice(0, 12)
        : null;
  if ((alert.source_type === 'container' || alert.source_type === 'metric') && containerShortId && hostId) return `/app/containers/${containerShortId}?host=${hostId}`;
  if (hostId) return `/app/hosts/${hostId}`;
  return '/app/alerts';
}

function buildAppUrl(path: string) {
  const base = (process.env.APP_URL || 'https://app.dockerdash.app').replace(/\/$/, '');
  return `${base}${path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`}`;
}

function buildSlackPayload(alert: AlertPayloadSource, eventType: SlackDeliveryEventType) {
  const href = buildAppUrl(mapAlertHref(alert));
  const statusLine = `${emojiForSeverity(alert.severity)} ${emojiForStatus(alert.status)} *${alert.title}*`;
  const sourceLabel = `${alert.source_type}:${alert.source_ref}`;
  return {
    text: `${alert.title} (${alert.severity}/${alert.status})`,
    blocks: [
      {
        type: 'section',
        text: {
          type: 'mrkdwn',
          text: `${statusLine}\n${alert.message}`,
        },
      },
      {
        type: 'context',
        elements: [
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Event* ${eventType}` },
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Source* ${sourceLabel}` },
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Organization* ${alert.organization_id}` },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: 'actions',
        elements: [
          {
            type: 'button',
            text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Open in Docker Dashboard' },
            url: href,
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };
}

async function recordAttempt(params: {
  organizationId: string;
  destinationId: string;
  alertEventId?: string | null;
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test';
  eventType: string;
  succeeded: boolean;
  httpStatus?: number | null;
  errorSummary?: string | null;
  responseExcerpt?: string | null;
}) {
  const [attempt] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO alert_slack_delivery_attempts (
      organization_id, slack_destination_id, alert_event_id, delivery_kind,
      event_type, succeeded, http_status, error_summary, response_excerpt
    )
    VALUES (
      ${params.organizationId}, ${params.destinationId}, ${params.alertEventId ?? null}, ${params.deliveryKind},
      ${params.eventType}, ${params.succeeded}, ${params.httpStatus ?? null}, ${params.errorSummary ?? null}, ${params.responseExcerpt ?? null}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return attempt as SlackAttemptRow;
}

async function dispatchSlackWebhook(
  destination: SlackDestinationRow,
  webhookUrl: string,
  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
  eventType: SlackDeliveryEventType,
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test',
  alertEventId?: string | null,
) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'User-Agent': 'DockerDash-Slack/1.0',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    const responseText = capText(await response.text());
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: response.ok,
      httpStatus: response.status,
      errorSummary: response.ok ? null : capText(response.statusText || 'Slack responded with non-2xx status'),
      responseExcerpt: responseText,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: false,
      errorSummary: capText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Slack request failed'),
    });
  }
}

async function getDestinationForOrg(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM slack_destinations
    WHERE id = ${destinationId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  return (rows[0] as SlackDestinationRow | undefined) ?? null;
}

export async function listSlackDestinations(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      d.*,
      a.id AS latest_attempt_id,
      a.organization_id AS latest_attempt_org_id,
      a.slack_destination_id AS latest_attempt_destination_id,
      a.alert_event_id AS latest_attempt_alert_event_id,
      a.delivery_kind AS latest_attempt_delivery_kind,
      a.event_type AS latest_attempt_event_type,
      a.succeeded AS latest_attempt_succeeded,
      a.http_status AS latest_attempt_http_status,
      a.error_summary AS latest_attempt_error_summary,
      a.response_excerpt AS latest_attempt_response_excerpt,
      a.attempted_at AS latest_attempt_attempted_at,
      a.created_at AS latest_attempt_created_at
    FROM slack_destinations d
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT *
      FROM alert_slack_delivery_attempts
      WHERE slack_destination_id = d.id
      ORDER BY attempted_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) a ON true
    WHERE d.organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  `;

  return rows.map((row) => normalizeDestination(row as any));
}

export async function createSlackDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { name: string; webhook_url: string; enabled?: boolean },
) {
  const webhookUrl = normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl(values.webhook_url);
  const destinationId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const encryptedWebhookUrl = encryptSecret(webhookUrl, destinationId, 'webhook_url');
  const [row] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO slack_destinations (
      id, organization_id, name, webhook_url, webhook_url_preview, enabled, created_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${destinationId}, ${auth.orgId}, ${values.name}, ${encryptedWebhookUrl}, ${maskSlackWebhookUrl(webhookUrl)}, ${values.enabled ?? true}, ${auth.userId}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return normalizeDestination(row as any);
}

export async function updateSlackDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { id: string; name?: string; webhook_url?: string; enabled?: boolean },
) {
  const existing = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, values.id);
  if (!existing) throw new Error('Slack destination not found');

  const validatedWebhookUrl = values.webhook_url ? normalizeAndValidateSlackWebhookUrl(values.webhook_url) : null;
  const nextWebhookUrl = validatedWebhookUrl ? encryptSecret(validatedWebhookUrl, existing.id, 'webhook_url') : existing.webhook_url;
  const nextPreview = validatedWebhookUrl ? maskSlackWebhookUrl(validatedWebhookUrl) : existing.webhook_url_preview;

  const [row] = await sql`
    UPDATE slack_destinations
    SET
      name = ${values.name ?? existing.name},
      webhook_url = ${nextWebhookUrl},
      webhook_url_preview = ${nextPreview},
      enabled = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, 'enabled') ? values.enabled : existing.enabled}
    WHERE id = ${values.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return normalizeDestination(row as any);
}

export async function sendSlackDestinationTest(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const destination = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, destinationId);
  if (!destination) throw new Error('Slack destination not found');
  const webhookUrl = decryptSecret(destination.webhook_url, destination.id, 'webhook_url');
  if (!webhookUrl) throw new Error('Slack webhook URL unavailable');

  const payload = {
    text: 'Docker Dashboard Slack test',
    blocks: [
      {
        type: 'section',
        text: {
          type: 'mrkdwn',
          text: ':satellite: *Docker Dashboard Slack test*\nYour Slack destination is ready to receive alert notifications.',
        },
      },
      {
        type: 'context',
        elements: [
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Organization* ${auth.orgId}` },
          { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Destination* ${destination.name}` },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };

  return dispatchSlackWebhook(destination, webhookUrl, payload, 'alert.test', 'test', null);
}

export async function deliverSlackAlerts(auth: AppAuthContext, alert: AlertPayloadSource, eventType: SlackDeliveryEventType) {
  if (!alert.rule_id) return [];

  const ruleRows = await sql`
    SELECT notification_channels
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE id = ${alert.rule_id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  const channels = Array.isArray(ruleRows[0]?.notification_channels)
    ? ruleRows[0].notification_channels.filter((item: unknown): item is string => typeof item === 'string')
    : [];

  if (!channels.includes('slack')) return [];

  const destinationRows = (await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM slack_destinations
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND enabled = true
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
  `) as SlackDestinationRow[];

  if (destinationRows.length === 0) return [];

  const payload = buildSlackPayload(alert, eventType);
  return Promise.all(
    destinationRows.map(async (destination) => {
      const webhookUrl = decryptSecret(destination.webhook_url, destination.id, 'webhook_url');
      if (!webhookUrl) {
        return recordAttempt({
          organizationId: destination.organization_id,
          destinationId: destination.id,
          alertEventId: alert.id,
          deliveryKind: 'alert',
          eventType,
          succeeded: false,
          errorSummary: 'Slack webhook URL unavailable',
        });
      }
      return dispatchSlackWebhook(destination, webhookUrl, payload, eventType, 'alert', alert.id);
    }),
  );
}
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/lib/webhook-destinations.mts">
import crypto from 'crypto';

import { sql } from './db.mjs';
import type { AppAuthContext } from './auth.mjs';
import { normalizeAndValidateWebhookUrl } from './host-url.mjs';

type DeliveryEventType = 'alert.opened' | 'alert.acknowledged' | 'alert.resolved' | 'alert.test';

interface WebhookDestinationRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  name: string;
  url: string;
  signing_secret: string;
  signing_secret_preview: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  created_by: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface DeliveryAttemptRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  webhook_destination_id: string;
  alert_event_id: string | null;
  delivery_kind: 'alert' | 'test';
  event_type: string;
  succeeded: boolean;
  http_status: number | null;
  error_summary: string | null;
  response_excerpt: string | null;
  attempted_at: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface AlertPayloadSource {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  incident_id?: string | null;
  rule_id?: string | null;
  source_type: 'host' | 'container' | 'metric' | 'system';
  source_ref: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: string;
  status: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  first_seen_at?: string;
  last_seen_at?: string;
  acknowledged_at?: string | null;
  resolved_at?: string | null;
  created_at?: string;
  updated_at?: string;
  href?: string;
}

function normalizeDestination(row: WebhookDestinationRow & {
  latest_attempt_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_org_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_destination_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_alert_event_id?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_delivery_kind?: 'alert' | 'test' | null;
  latest_attempt_event_type?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_succeeded?: boolean | null;
  latest_attempt_http_status?: number | null;
  latest_attempt_error_summary?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_response_excerpt?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_attempted_at?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_created_at?: string | null;
}) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    organization_id: row.organization_id,
    name: row.name,
    url: row.url,
    signing_secret_preview: row.signing_secret_preview,
    enabled: row.enabled,
    created_by: row.created_by,
    created_at: row.created_at,
    updated_at: row.updated_at,
    latest_attempt: row.latest_attempt_id ? {
      id: row.latest_attempt_id,
      organization_id: row.latest_attempt_org_id!,
      webhook_destination_id: row.latest_attempt_destination_id!,
      alert_event_id: row.latest_attempt_alert_event_id ?? null,
      delivery_kind: row.latest_attempt_delivery_kind!,
      event_type: row.latest_attempt_event_type!,
      succeeded: !!row.latest_attempt_succeeded,
      http_status: row.latest_attempt_http_status ?? null,
      error_summary: row.latest_attempt_error_summary ?? null,
      response_excerpt: row.latest_attempt_response_excerpt ?? null,
      attempted_at: row.latest_attempt_attempted_at!,
      created_at: row.latest_attempt_created_at!,
    } : null,
  };
}

function buildSecret() {
  const secret = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex');
  return {
    secret,
    preview: `${secret.slice(0, 6)}...${secret.slice(-4)}`,
  };
}

function capText(value: string | null | undefined, max = 280) {
  if (!value) return null;
  return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : value;
}

function mapAlertHref(alert: AlertPayloadSource) {
  if (alert.href) return alert.href;
  const metadata = alert.metadata ?? {};
  const hostId = typeof metadata.host_id === 'string' ? metadata.host_id : null;
  const containerShortId =
    typeof metadata.container_short_id === 'string'
      ? metadata.container_short_id
      : typeof metadata.container_id === 'string'
        ? metadata.container_id.slice(0, 12)
        : null;
  if ((alert.source_type === 'container' || alert.source_type === 'metric') && containerShortId && hostId) return `/app/containers/${containerShortId}?host=${hostId}`;
  if (hostId) return `/app/hosts/${hostId}`;
  return '/app/alerts';
}

function buildSignedRequestBody(destination: Pick<WebhookDestinationRow, 'signing_secret'>, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', destination.signing_secret).update(`${timestamp}.${body}`).digest('hex');
  return {
    body,
    timestamp,
    signature: `sha256=${signature}`,
  };
}

async function recordAttempt(params: {
  organizationId: string;
  destinationId: string;
  alertEventId?: string | null;
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test';
  eventType: string;
  succeeded: boolean;
  httpStatus?: number | null;
  errorSummary?: string | null;
  responseExcerpt?: string | null;
}) {
  const [attempt] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO alert_delivery_attempts (
      organization_id, webhook_destination_id, alert_event_id, delivery_kind,
      event_type, succeeded, http_status, error_summary, response_excerpt
    )
    VALUES (
      ${params.organizationId}, ${params.destinationId}, ${params.alertEventId ?? null}, ${params.deliveryKind},
      ${params.eventType}, ${params.succeeded}, ${params.httpStatus ?? null}, ${params.errorSummary ?? null}, ${params.responseExcerpt ?? null}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return attempt as DeliveryAttemptRow;
}

const DISCORD_URL_RE = /^https:\/\/(?:discord\.com|discordapp\.com)\/api\/webhooks\//;

function isDiscordUrl(url: string) {
  return DISCORD_URL_RE.test(url);
}

const SEVERITY_COLORS: Record<string, number> = {
  critical: 0xef4444, // red
  warning:  0xf59e0b, // amber
  info:     0x3b82f6, // blue
  ok:       0x22c55e, // green
};

function buildDiscordBody(payload: Record<string, unknown>, eventType: DeliveryEventType) {
  const alert = (payload.alert ?? payload.sample ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const severity = String(alert.severity ?? 'info').toLowerCase();
  const status   = String(alert.status ?? eventType);
  const title    = String(alert.title ?? 'Docker Dashboard Alert');
  const message  = String(alert.message ?? '');
  const href     = typeof alert.href === 'string' ? alert.href : null;

  const color = SEVERITY_COLORS[severity] ?? 0x6366f1; // indigo fallback

  const fields: Array<{ name: string; value: string; inline: boolean }> = [
    { name: 'Event',    value: `\`${eventType}\``, inline: true },
    { name: 'Severity', value: severity,           inline: true },
    { name: 'Status',   value: status,             inline: true },
  ];

  if (alert.source_type)  fields.push({ name: 'Source', value: String(alert.source_type), inline: true });
  if (alert.source_ref)   fields.push({ name: 'Ref',    value: `\`${String(alert.source_ref)}\``, inline: true });

  const embed: Record<string, unknown> = {
    title,
    description: message || undefined,
    color,
    fields,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    footer: { text: 'Docker Dashboard' },
  };

  if (href) {
    const base = process.env.URL || 'https://app.dockerdash.app';
    embed.url = href.startsWith('http') ? href : `${base}${href}`;
  }

  return JSON.stringify({ embeds: [embed] });
}

async function dispatchWebhook(
  destination: WebhookDestinationRow,
  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
  eventType: DeliveryEventType,
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test',
  alertEventId?: string | null,
) {
  const discord = isDiscordUrl(destination.url);

  // Build request body — Discord gets embeds, everything else gets signed payload
  let body: string;
  let headers: Record<string, string>;

  if (discord) {
    body = buildDiscordBody(payload, eventType);
    headers = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'DockerDash-Webhooks/1.0',
    };
  } else {
    const signed = buildSignedRequestBody(destination, payload);
    body = signed.body;
    headers = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'DockerDash-Webhooks/1.0',
      'X-DockerDash-Event': eventType,
      'X-DockerDash-Timestamp': signed.timestamp,
      'X-DockerDash-Signature': signed.signature,
    };
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetch(destination.url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers,
      body,
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    const responseText = capText(await response.text());
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: response.ok,
      httpStatus: response.status,
      errorSummary: response.ok ? null : capText(response.statusText || 'Webhook responded with non-2xx status'),
      responseExcerpt: responseText,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: false,
      errorSummary: capText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Webhook request failed'),
    });
  }
}

async function getDestinationForOrg(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM webhook_destinations
    WHERE id = ${destinationId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  return (rows[0] as WebhookDestinationRow | undefined) ?? null;
}

export async function listWebhookDestinations(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      d.*,
      a.id AS latest_attempt_id,
      a.organization_id AS latest_attempt_org_id,
      a.webhook_destination_id AS latest_attempt_destination_id,
      a.alert_event_id AS latest_attempt_alert_event_id,
      a.delivery_kind AS latest_attempt_delivery_kind,
      a.event_type AS latest_attempt_event_type,
      a.succeeded AS latest_attempt_succeeded,
      a.http_status AS latest_attempt_http_status,
      a.error_summary AS latest_attempt_error_summary,
      a.response_excerpt AS latest_attempt_response_excerpt,
      a.attempted_at AS latest_attempt_attempted_at,
      a.created_at AS latest_attempt_created_at
    FROM webhook_destinations d
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT *
      FROM alert_delivery_attempts
      WHERE webhook_destination_id = d.id
      ORDER BY attempted_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) a ON true
    WHERE d.organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  `;

  return rows.map((row) => normalizeDestination(row as any));
}

export async function createWebhookDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { name: string; url: string; enabled?: boolean },
) {
  const destinationUrl = normalizeAndValidateWebhookUrl(values.url);
  const { secret, preview } = buildSecret();
  const [row] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO webhook_destinations (
      organization_id, name, url, signing_secret, signing_secret_preview, enabled, created_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${auth.orgId}, ${values.name}, ${destinationUrl}, ${secret}, ${preview}, ${values.enabled ?? true}, ${auth.userId}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return {
    destination: normalizeDestination(row as any),
    signing_secret: secret,
  };
}

export async function updateWebhookDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { id: string; name?: string; url?: string; enabled?: boolean; regenerate_secret?: boolean },
) {
  const existing = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, values.id);
  if (!existing) throw new Error('Webhook destination not found');

  const secretState = values.regenerate_secret ? buildSecret() : {
    secret: existing.signing_secret,
    preview: existing.signing_secret_preview,
  };
  const nextUrl = values.url ? normalizeAndValidateWebhookUrl(values.url) : existing.url;

  const [row] = await sql`
    UPDATE webhook_destinations
    SET
      name = ${values.name ?? existing.name},
      url = ${nextUrl},
      enabled = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, 'enabled') ? values.enabled : existing.enabled},
      signing_secret = ${secretState.secret},
      signing_secret_preview = ${secretState.preview}
    WHERE id = ${values.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return {
    destination: normalizeDestination(row as any),
    signing_secret: values.regenerate_secret ? secretState.secret : undefined,
  };
}

export async function sendWebhookDestinationTest(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const destination = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, destinationId);
  if (!destination) throw new Error('Webhook destination not found');

  const payload = {
    event_type: 'alert.test',
    sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    organization_id: auth.orgId,
    destination_id: destination.id,
    sample: {
      severity: 'warning',
      status: 'open',
      title: 'Webhook test from Docker Dashboard',
      message: 'This is a signed test delivery from your alert webhook configuration.',
      href: '/app/settings?tab=Webhooks',
    },
  };

  return dispatchWebhook(destination, payload, 'alert.test', 'test', null);
}

export async function deliverAlertWebhooks(auth: AppAuthContext, alert: AlertPayloadSource, eventType: DeliveryEventType) {
  if (!alert.rule_id) return [];

  const ruleRows = await sql`
    SELECT notification_channels
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE id = ${alert.rule_id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  const channels = Array.isArray(ruleRows[0]?.notification_channels)
    ? ruleRows[0].notification_channels.filter((item: unknown): item is string => typeof item === 'string')
    : [];

  if (!channels.includes('webhook')) return [];

  const destinationRows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM webhook_destinations
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND enabled = true
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
  `;

  if (destinationRows.length === 0) return [];

  const payload = {
    event_type: eventType,
    organization_id: alert.organization_id,
    alert: {
      id: alert.id,
      incident_id: alert.incident_id ?? null,
      severity: alert.severity,
      status: alert.status,
      title: alert.title,
      message: alert.message,
      source_type: alert.source_type,
      source_ref: alert.source_ref,
      first_seen_at: alert.first_seen_at ?? null,
      last_seen_at: alert.last_seen_at ?? null,
      acknowledged_at: alert.acknowledged_at ?? null,
      resolved_at: alert.resolved_at ?? null,
      created_at: alert.created_at ?? null,
      updated_at: alert.updated_at ?? null,
      href: mapAlertHref(alert),
      metadata: alert.metadata ?? {},
    },
  };

  return Promise.all(
    (destinationRows as WebhookDestinationRow[]).map((destination) =>
      dispatchWebhook(destination, payload, eventType, 'alert', alert.id),
    ),
  );
}

import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { handleAdminRequest } from './lib/admin-handler.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  const forwarded = new Request(req.url.replace('/stats', '/overview'), {
    method: req.method,
    headers: req.headers,
  });
  const response = await handleAdminRequest(forwarded);
  if (!response.ok) return response;

  const data = await response.json();
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({
    success: true,
    stats: {
      totalOrgs: data.metrics.total_organizations,
      totalUsers: data.metrics.total_users,
      activeHosts: data.metrics.active_hosts,
    }
  }), { headers });
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/admin/stats',
};

<file path="netlify/functions/api-agent-enrollments.mts">
import crypto from "crypto";
import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";
import { sql } from "./lib/db.mjs";
import { requireAuth } from "./lib/auth.mjs";
import { assertOrganizationNodeCapacityAvailable, assertOrganizationWriteAllowed, enforceOrganizationNodeLimit } from "./lib/access-controls.mjs";
import { decryptSecret, encryptSecret } from "./lib/crypto.mjs";
import { ensureAgentEnrollmentSchema } from "./lib/ensure-agent-enrollment-schema.mjs";
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl, normalizeAndValidateHostUrl } from "./lib/host-url.mjs";
import {
  buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentEnrollmentInstallCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentNextStepSummary,
  buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse,
  buildWatchtowerAgentSetupSummary,
  buildWatchtowerAgentVerifySummary,
  CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
  getWatchtowerAgentModeLabel,
  getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress,
  type WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
} from "../../shared/watchtower-agent-release.ts";

const headers = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
};

type SessionStatus = "created" | "claimed" | "installed" | "expired" | "cancelled";
type ReasonCode =
  | "url_unreachable"
  | "agent_unauthorized"
  | "agent_not_installed"
  | "agent_outdated"
  | "cloudflare_access_missing"
  | "metrics_unavailable";

function json(body: unknown, init: ResponseInit = {}) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    ...init,
    headers: { ...headers, ...(init.headers || {}) },
  });
}

function badRequest(error: string, code?: string, status = 400) {
  return json({ error, ...(code ? { code } : {}) }, { status });
}

function parseConnectionMode(value: unknown): WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode | null {
  return value === "agent" || value === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? value : null;
}

function hashEnrollmentToken(token: string) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");
}

function createEnrollmentToken() {
  return crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
}

function createAgentApiKey() {
  return crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
}

function trimOrDefault(value: unknown, fallback: string) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : fallback;
}

async function requireOrgAdmin(organizationId: string, userId: string, isPlatformAdmin: boolean) {
  await assertOrganizationWriteAllowed({ organizationId, isPlatformAdmin });

  const members = await sql`
    SELECT role FROM organization_members
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId} AND user_id = ${userId}
  `;

  return members.length > 0 && ["owner", "admin"].includes(members[0].role);
}

function buildAgentHeaders(options: {
  hostUrl: string;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  dockerSocketPath: string;
  agentApiKey: string | null;
  cfServiceTokenId: string | null;
  cfServiceTokenSecret: string | null;
  path: string;
}) {
  const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};

  if (options.agentApiKey) {
    reqHeaders["X-Agent-Key"] = options.agentApiKey;
  }

  if (options.dockerSocketPath && options.dockerSocketPath !== "/var/run/docker.sock") {
    reqHeaders["X-Docker-Socket"] = options.dockerSocketPath;
  }

  if (options.connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel") {
    if (options.cfServiceTokenId) {
      reqHeaders["CF-Access-Client-Id"] = options.cfServiceTokenId;
    }
    if (options.cfServiceTokenSecret) {
      reqHeaders["CF-Access-Client-Secret"] = options.cfServiceTokenSecret;
    }
  }

  return { url: buildValidatedAgentUrl(options.hostUrl, options.path), headers: reqHeaders };
}

async function fetchWithTimeout(url: string, init: RequestInit, timeoutMs = 5000) {
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs) });
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.name === "AbortError" || error?.name === "TimeoutError") {
      throw new Error("Agent connection timed out");
    }
    throw new Error(error?.message || "Agent connection failed");
  }
}

function reasonFromFailure(options: {
  status?: number;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  message?: string;
  stage: "ping" | "agent_version" | "metrics";
}): ReasonCode {
  if (options.connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" && options.status === 403) {
    return "cloudflare_access_missing";
  }
  if (options.status === 401) {
    return "agent_unauthorized";
  }
  if (options.status === 404 || options.status === 405) {
    return "agent_not_installed";
  }
  if (options.stage === "metrics") {
    return "metrics_unavailable";
  }
  return "url_unreachable";
}

function remediationForReason(
  reason: ReasonCode,
  agentApiKey: string,
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
) {
  switch (reason) {
    case "agent_outdated":
      return buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({ agentApiKey, connectionMode });
    case "metrics_unavailable":
      return buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand();
    case "agent_not_installed":
    case "agent_unauthorized":
    case "cloudflare_access_missing":
    case "url_unreachable":
    default:
      return buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand();
  }
}

async function pingEnrollmentHost(input: {
  hostId: string;
  hostUrl: string;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  dockerSocketPath: string;
  agentApiKey: string;
  cfServiceTokenId: string | null;
  cfServiceTokenSecret: string | null;
}) {
  const common = {
    hostUrl: input.hostUrl,
    connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
    dockerSocketPath: input.dockerSocketPath,
    agentApiKey: input.agentApiKey,
    cfServiceTokenId: input.cfServiceTokenId,
    cfServiceTokenSecret: input.cfServiceTokenSecret,
  };

  try {
    const pingReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/docker/_ping" });
    const pingResp = await fetchWithTimeout(pingReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: pingReq.headers }, 5000);
    const pingText = await pingResp.text();

    if (!pingResp.ok) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        status: pingText,
        reason_code: reasonFromFailure({
          status: pingResp.status,
          connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
          message: pingText,
          stage: "ping",
        }),
      };
    }

    let dockerVersion: string | null = null;
    let osInfo: string | null = null;
    try {
      const versionReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/docker/version" });
      const versionResp = await fetchWithTimeout(versionReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: versionReq.headers }, 5000);
      if (versionResp.ok) {
        const versionData = await versionResp.json();
        dockerVersion = versionData.Version || null;
        osInfo = versionData.Os ? `${versionData.Os}/${versionData.Arch}` : null;
      }
    } catch {
      // best effort
    }

    let agentVersion: string | null = null;
    let agentVersionError: string | null = null;
    try {
      const agentReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/agent/version" });
      const agentResp = await fetchWithTimeout(agentReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: agentReq.headers }, 5000);
      if (agentResp.ok) {
        const agentData = await agentResp.json();
        agentVersion = agentData.agent_version || agentData.version || null;
      } else {
        agentVersionError = `GET /agent/version returned ${agentResp.status}`;
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      agentVersionError = error?.message || "GET /agent/version failed";
    }

    let metricsReason: ReasonCode | null = null;
    let capabilityGap = false;
    try {
      const metricsReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/metrics" });
      const metricsResp = await fetchWithTimeout(metricsReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: metricsReq.headers }, 5000);
      if (!metricsResp.ok) {
        metricsReason = reasonFromFailure({
          status: metricsResp.status,
          connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
          stage: "metrics",
        });
      } else {
        const metricsData = await metricsResp.json();
        capabilityGap = !metricsData || typeof metricsData !== "object" || metricsData.uptime_seconds == null || !Array.isArray(metricsData.disks);
      }
    } catch {
      metricsReason = "metrics_unavailable";
    }

    const releaseResponse = buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(agentVersion, capabilityGap);
    const reasonCode =
      releaseResponse.agent_update_status === "update_required"
        ? "agent_outdated"
        : metricsReason;

    await sql`
      UPDATE docker_hosts
      SET status = 'connected',
          last_seen_at = now(),
          docker_version = COALESCE(${dockerVersion}, docker_version),
          agent_version = COALESCE(${agentVersion}, agent_version),
          os_info = COALESCE(${osInfo}, os_info),
          last_error = ${reasonCode},
          consecutive_failures = 0
      WHERE id = ${input.hostId}
    `;

    return {
      ok: true,
      status: pingText,
      docker_version: dockerVersion,
      agent_version: agentVersion,
      agent_version_error: agentVersionError,
      os_info: osInfo,
      connection_mode: input.connectionMode,
      reason_code: reasonCode,
      ...releaseResponse,
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    const reasonCode = reasonFromFailure({
      connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
      message: error?.message,
      stage: "ping",
    });

    await sql`
      UPDATE docker_hosts
      SET status = 'error',
          last_error = ${error?.message || reasonCode},
          consecutive_failures = COALESCE(consecutive_failures, 0) + 1
      WHERE id = ${input.hostId}
    `;

    return {
      ok: false,
      status: error?.message || "Connection failed",
      reason_code: reasonCode,
      docker_version: null,
      agent_version: null,
      agent_version_error: null,
      os_info: null,
      connection_mode: input.connectionMode,
      ...buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(null),
    };
  }
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  await ensureAgentEnrollmentSchema();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const pathname = url.pathname;

  try {
    if (req.method === "POST" && pathname.endsWith("/exchange")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
      const enrollmentToken = typeof body?.enrollment_token === "string" ? body.enrollment_token.trim() : "";
      if (!enrollmentToken) {
        return badRequest("enrollment_token is required");
      }

      const tokenHash = hashEnrollmentToken(enrollmentToken);
      const rows = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM agent_enrollment_sessions
        WHERE enrollment_token_hash = ${tokenHash}
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        return badRequest("Enrollment token is invalid or expired", "invalid_enrollment_token", 404);
      }

      const session = rows[0];
      const now = new Date();
      const expired = new Date(session.expires_at) <= now;
      if (expired) {
        await sql`
          UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
          SET status = 'expired'
          WHERE id = ${session.id}
        `;
        return badRequest("Enrollment token has expired", "expired_enrollment_token", 410);
      }

      if (session.status !== "created") {
        return badRequest("Enrollment token has already been used", "claimed_enrollment_token", 409);
      }

      await sql`
        UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
        SET status = 'claimed',
            claimed_at = now()
        WHERE id = ${session.id}
      `;

      return json({
        session_id: session.id,
        agent_api_key: decryptSecret(session.encrypted_agent_api_key, session.id, "agent_api_key"),
        expected_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version,
        bind_address: getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(session.connection_mode),
        port: "9876",
        docker_socket_path: session.docker_socket_path,
        connection_mode: session.connection_mode,
      });
    }

    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    if (!auth.orgId) {
      return badRequest("Active org required");
    }

    const isAdmin = await requireOrgAdmin(auth.orgId, auth.userId, auth.isPlatformAdmin);
    if (!isAdmin) {
      return badRequest("Admin access required for active org", undefined, 403);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && pathname.endsWith("/finalize")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
      const sessionId = typeof body?.session_id === "string" ? body.session_id.trim() : "";
      if (!sessionId) {
        return badRequest("session_id is required");
      }

      const rows = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM agent_enrollment_sessions
        WHERE id = ${sessionId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        return badRequest("Enrollment session not found", "missing_enrollment_session", 404);
      }

      const session = rows[0];
      if (session.status === "cancelled") {
        return badRequest("Enrollment session is cancelled", "cancelled_enrollment_session", 409);
      }

      if (new Date(session.expires_at) <= new Date() && session.status !== "installed") {
        await sql`
          UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
          SET status = 'expired'
          WHERE id = ${session.id}
        `;
        return badRequest("Enrollment session has expired", "expired_enrollment_session", 410);
      }

      const agentApiKey = decryptSecret(session.encrypted_agent_api_key, session.id, "agent_api_key");
      const cfServiceTokenId = decryptSecret(session.encrypted_cf_service_token_id, session.id, "cf_service_token_id");
      const cfServiceTokenSecret = decryptSecret(session.encrypted_cf_service_token_secret, session.id, "cf_service_token_secret");
      if (!agentApiKey) {
        return badRequest("Enrollment session is missing an agent API key", "invalid_enrollment_session", 500);
      }

      let hostId = session.docker_host_id as string | null;
      let host;

      if (hostId) {
        const existing = await sql`
          SELECT * FROM docker_hosts
          WHERE id = ${hostId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          LIMIT 1
        `;
        host = existing[0] || null;
      }

      if (!host) {
        await assertOrganizationNodeCapacityAvailable({
          organizationId: auth.orgId,
          isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
        });

        const inserted = await sql`
          INSERT INTO docker_hosts (organization_id, name, host_url, connection_mode, docker_socket_path, created_by, status)
          VALUES (${auth.orgId}, ${session.host_name}, ${session.host_url}, ${session.connection_mode}, ${session.docker_socket_path || "/var/run/docker.sock"}, ${auth.userId}, 'unknown')
          RETURNING *
        `;
        host = inserted[0];
        hostId = host.id;

        await sql`
          INSERT INTO docker_host_secrets (host_id, agent_api_key, cf_service_token_id, cf_service_token_secret)
          VALUES (
            ${host.id},
            ${encryptSecret(agentApiKey, host.id, "agent_api_key")},
            ${cfServiceTokenId ? encryptSecret(cfServiceTokenId, host.id, "cf_service_token_id") : null},
            ${cfServiceTokenSecret ? encryptSecret(cfServiceTokenSecret, host.id, "cf_service_token_secret") : null}
          )
          ON CONFLICT (host_id)
          DO UPDATE SET
            agent_api_key = EXCLUDED.agent_api_key,
            cf_service_token_id = EXCLUDED.cf_service_token_id,
            cf_service_token_secret = EXCLUDED.cf_service_token_secret
        `;

        await sql`
          UPDATE organizations
          SET onboarding_status = 'completed',
              onboarding_completed_at = COALESCE(onboarding_completed_at, now())
          WHERE id = ${auth.orgId}
        `;
      }

      const limitState = await enforceOrganizationNodeLimit({
        organizationId: auth.orgId,
        isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
      });

      if (!limitState.allowedHostIds.includes(hostId!)) {
        return badRequest(
          "This host is over your current plan limit. Remove extra hosts or upgrade to reactivate it.",
          "host_plan_limit_exceeded",
          402,
        );
      }

      const pingResult = await pingEnrollmentHost({
        hostId: hostId!,
        hostUrl: session.host_url,
        connectionMode: session.connection_mode,
        dockerSocketPath: session.docker_socket_path || "/var/run/docker.sock",
        agentApiKey,
        cfServiceTokenId,
        cfServiceTokenSecret,
      });

      const remediationCommand = pingResult.reason_code
        ? remediationForReason(pingResult.reason_code, agentApiKey, session.connection_mode)
        : null;

      await sql`
        UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
        SET docker_host_id = ${hostId},
            status = ${pingResult.ok ? "installed" : session.status === "installed" ? "installed" : "claimed"},
            installed_at = CASE WHEN ${pingResult.ok} THEN now() ELSE installed_at END
        WHERE id = ${session.id}
      `;

      return json({
        host,
        ...pingResult,
        remediation_command: remediationCommand,
      });
    }

    if (req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
      await assertOrganizationNodeCapacityAvailable({
        organizationId: auth.orgId,
        isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
      });

      const connectionMode = parseConnectionMode(body?.connection_mode);
      if (!connectionMode) {
        return badRequest("connection_mode must be 'agent' or 'cloudflare_tunnel'");
      }

      const hostName = trimOrDefault(body?.host_name, "");
      const hostUrl = trimOrDefault(body?.host_url, "");
      const dockerSocketPath = trimOrDefault(body?.docker_socket_path, "/var/run/docker.sock");
      const cfServiceTokenId = trimOrDefault(body?.cf_service_token_id, "");
      const cfServiceTokenSecret = trimOrDefault(body?.cf_service_token_secret, "");

      if (!hostName) {
        return badRequest("host_name is required");
      }
      if (!hostUrl) {
        return badRequest("host_url is required");
      }

      let normalizedHostUrl: string;
      try {
        normalizedHostUrl = normalizeAndValidateHostUrl(hostUrl);
      } catch (error: any) {
        return badRequest(error?.message || "host_url is invalid");
      }

      const token = createEnrollmentToken();
      const sessionApiKey = createAgentApiKey();
      const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000);

      const rows = await sql`
        INSERT INTO agent_enrollment_sessions (
          organization_id,
          created_by_user_id,
          host_name,
          host_url,
          connection_mode,
          docker_socket_path,
          encrypted_agent_api_key,
          encrypted_cf_service_token_id,
          encrypted_cf_service_token_secret,
          enrollment_token_hash,
          status,
          expires_at
        )
        VALUES (
          ${auth.orgId},
          ${auth.userId},
          ${hostName},
          ${normalizedHostUrl},
          ${connectionMode},
          ${dockerSocketPath},
          ${encryptSecret(sessionApiKey, "pending", "agent_api_key")},
          ${cfServiceTokenId ? encryptSecret(cfServiceTokenId, "pending", "cf_service_token_id") : null},
          ${cfServiceTokenSecret ? encryptSecret(cfServiceTokenSecret, "pending", "cf_service_token_secret") : null},
          ${hashEnrollmentToken(token)},
          'created',
          ${expiresAt.toISOString()}
        )
        RETURNING *
      `;

      const session = rows[0];

      await sql`
        UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
        SET encrypted_agent_api_key = ${encryptSecret(sessionApiKey, session.id, "agent_api_key")},
            encrypted_cf_service_token_id = ${cfServiceTokenId ? encryptSecret(cfServiceTokenId, session.id, "cf_service_token_id") : null},
            encrypted_cf_service_token_secret = ${cfServiceTokenSecret ? encryptSecret(cfServiceTokenSecret, session.id, "cf_service_token_secret") : null}
        WHERE id = ${session.id}
      `;

      const enrollUrl = `${url.origin}/api/agent-enrollments/exchange`;
      return json({
        session_id: session.id,
        enrollment_token: token,
        expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
        install_command: buildWatchtowerAgentEnrollmentInstallCommand({
          enrollmentToken: token,
          enrollUrl,
          connectionMode,
          dockerSocketPath,
        }),
        verify_command: buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand(),
        setup_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentSetupSummary(connectionMode),
        verify_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentVerifySummary(connectionMode),
        next_step_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentNextStepSummary(connectionMode),
        mode_label: getWatchtowerAgentModeLabel(connectionMode),
        advanced_manual_command: buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({
          agentApiKey: sessionApiKey,
          connectionMode,
          dockerSocketPath,
        }),
      });
    }

    return badRequest("Method not allowed", undefined, 405);
  } catch (error: any) {
    return badRequest(error?.message || "Request failed", error?.code, 500);
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/agent-enrollments*",
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-alert-rules.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { ensureDefaultAlertRules, listAlertRules, requireOrganizationAdmin, syncAlertEvents } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import { assertAdvancedAlertsAccessAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      await ensureDefaultAlertRules(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(await listAlertRules(auth)), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      await assertAdvancedAlertsAccessAllowed({ organizationId: auth.orgId, isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin });
      const body = await req.json();

      const [rule] = await sql`
        INSERT INTO alert_rules (
          organization_id, name, condition_type, resource_scope, threshold_value,
          threshold_window_minutes, severity, notification_channels, enabled, created_by
        )
        VALUES (
          ${auth.orgId}, ${body.name}, ${body.condition_type},
          ${JSON.stringify(body.resource_scope || { scope: 'organization' })},
          ${body.threshold_value ?? null},
          ${body.threshold_window_minutes ?? 5},
          ${body.severity},
          ${JSON.stringify(body.notification_channels || [])},
          ${body.enabled ?? true},
          ${auth.userId}
        )
        RETURNING *
      `;

      await syncAlertEvents(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(rule), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      await assertAdvancedAlertsAccessAllowed({ organizationId: auth.orgId, isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin });
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Rule id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const currentRows = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM alert_rules
        WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (currentRows.length === 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Rule not found' }), { status: 404, headers });
      }

      const current = currentRows[0];
      const [rule] = await sql`
        UPDATE alert_rules
        SET
          name = ${body.name ?? current.name},
          condition_type = ${body.condition_type ?? current.condition_type},
          resource_scope = ${JSON.stringify(body.resource_scope ?? current.resource_scope)},
          threshold_value = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'threshold_value') ? body.threshold_value : current.threshold_value},
          threshold_window_minutes = ${body.threshold_window_minutes ?? current.threshold_window_minutes},
          severity = ${body.severity ?? current.severity},
          notification_channels = ${JSON.stringify(body.notification_channels ?? current.notification_channels)},
          enabled = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'enabled') ? body.enabled : current.enabled}
        WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
        RETURNING *
      `;

      await syncAlertEvents(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(rule), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied/.test(error?.message || '') ? 403 : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process alert rules' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/alert-rules',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-alerts.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { getOrganizationRole, listAlertEvents, listAlertRules, listIncidents, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import { deliverSlackAlerts } from './lib/slack-delivery.mjs';
import { deliverAlertWebhooks } from './lib/webhook-destinations.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const url = new URL(req.url);
      const severity = url.searchParams.get('severity');
      const status = url.searchParams.get('status');
      const [alerts, rules, incidents] = await Promise.all([
        listAlertEvents(auth, { severity, status }),
        listAlertRules(auth),
        listIncidents(auth),
      ]);

      const activeAlerts = alerts.filter((alert) => alert.resolved_at === null);
      const summary = {
        total_alerts: activeAlerts.length,
        critical_alerts: activeAlerts.filter((alert) => alert.severity === 'critical').length,
        enabled_rules: rules.filter((rule) => rule.enabled).length,
        open_incidents: incidents.filter((incident: any) => incident.status !== 'resolved').length,
      };

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ alerts, summary, role, can_manage: ['owner', 'admin'].includes(role) }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id || !body?.action) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Alert id and action required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      if (body.action === 'acknowledge') {
        const [alert] = await sql`
          UPDATE alert_events
          SET status = 'acknowledged', acknowledged_at = COALESCE(acknowledged_at, now()), acknowledged_by = ${auth.userId}
          WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          RETURNING *
        `;
        if (alert) {
          await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, alert, 'alert.acknowledged');
          await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, alert, 'alert.acknowledged');
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(alert), { headers });
      }

      if (body.action === 'resolve') {
        const [alert] = await sql`
          UPDATE alert_events
          SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = COALESCE(resolved_at, now()), resolved_by = ${auth.userId}
          WHERE id = ${body.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          RETURNING *
        `;
        if (alert) {
          await deliverSlackAlerts(auth, alert, 'alert.resolved');
          await deliverAlertWebhooks(auth, alert, 'alert.resolved');
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(alert), { headers });
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unsupported action' }), { status: 400, headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied/.test(error?.message || '') ? 403 : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process alerts' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/alerts',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-billing-webhook-liberapay.mts">
import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";

import { donorJsonHeaders, ingestDonorEvent, parseDonorWebhookEvent } from "./lib/donor-billing.mjs";
import { applyRateLimit, RATE_LIMITS } from "./lib/security.mjs";

const headers = donorJsonHeaders();

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), { status: 405, headers });
  }

  try {
    const rateLimitResponse = await applyRateLimit(req, "webhook:liberapay-donor", RATE_LIMITS.WEBHOOK);
    if (rateLimitResponse) {
      return rateLimitResponse;
    }

    const rawBody = await req.text();
    const event = await parseDonorWebhookEvent("liberapay", req, rawBody);
    const result = await ingestDonorEvent(event);

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, provider: "liberapay", ...result }), {
      status: 200,
      headers,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to process liberapay webhook";
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: message }), { status: 400, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/billing/webhook/liberapay",
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-billing-webhook.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { applyRateLimit, RATE_LIMITS, verifyWebhookTimestamp, logSecurityEvent, getClientIp } from './lib/security.mjs';

const PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET = process.env.PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET;

const verifySignature = (body: string, signature: string): boolean => {
  if (!PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET || !signature) return false;

  // Paddle signature format: ts=1234567;h1=abcdef...
  const parts = signature.split(';');
  const tsPart = parts.find(p => p.startsWith('ts='));
  const h1Part = parts.find(p => p.startsWith('h1='));

  if (!tsPart || !h1Part) return false;

  const ts = tsPart.split('=')[1];
  const h1 = h1Part.split('=')[1];

  const payload = `${ts}:${body}`;
  const cryptoHash = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
    .update(payload)
    .digest('hex');

  return cryptoHash === h1;
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
