import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { generateOpenAPI } from '../../shared/schema/api.js';

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
      }
    });
  }

  const spec = generateOpenAPI();

  return new Response(JSON.stringify(spec), {
    headers: {
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=3600',
    }
  });
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/api-docs',
};

<file path="netlify/functions/api-donor-intent.mts">
import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";

import { requireAuth } from "./lib/auth.mjs";
import { createDonorIntent, donorJsonHeaders } from "./lib/donor-billing.mjs";

const headers = donorJsonHeaders();

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), { status: 405, headers });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as Record<string, unknown>));

    const nextReq = new Request(req.url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: req.headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...body,
        organization_id: body.organization_id || auth.orgId,
        payer_email: body.payer_email || auth.email,
      }),
    });

    return await createDonorIntent(nextReq);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to create donor intent";
    const status = /unauthorized/i.test(message) ? 401 : 400;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: message }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/donor-intent",
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-donor-reminders.mts">
import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";

import { donorJsonHeaders, sendDueDonorReminders } from "./lib/donor-billing.mjs";

const headers = donorJsonHeaders();

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  if (req.method !== "POST" && req.method !== "GET") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), { status: 405, headers });
  }

  const cronSecret = (process.env.DONOR_REMINDER_CRON_SECRET || "").trim();
  if (cronSecret) {
    const provided = req.headers.get("x-cron-secret") || "";
    if (provided !== cronSecret) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }), { status: 403, headers });
    }
  }

  try {
    const result = await sendDueDonorReminders();
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, ...result }), { status: 200, headers });
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to send donor reminders" }),
      { status: 500, headers },
    );
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/donor-reminders",
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-fleet-metrics.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { enforceOrganizationNodeLimit } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { decryptHostSecrets } from './lib/crypto.mjs';
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl } from './lib/host-url.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

interface FleetMetricsPoint {
  timestamp: number;
  time: string;
  cpu: number;
  memory: number;
  usedCores: number;
  totalCores: number;
  memoryUsed: number;
  memoryLimit: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkOutBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskReadBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec: number | null;
  reportingHosts: number;
  totalHosts: number;
  isPartial: boolean;
}

interface HostMetricsResponse {
  cpu_time_ns: number;
  system_time_ns: number;
  online_cpus: number;
  memory_used: number;
  memory_limit: number;
  network_in_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
  network_out_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
  disk_read_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
  disk_write_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
}

function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

function normalizeOptionalRate(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (numeric === null || numeric < 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return numeric;
}

async function fetchHostMetrics(hostUrl: string, apiKey: string, timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<HostMetricsResponse | null> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(buildValidatedAgentUrl(hostUrl, '/metrics'), {
      headers: {
        'X-Agent-Key': apiKey,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
    });

    if (!response.ok) return null;

    const data = await response.json();
    // Agent returns CPU/memory fields and may include optional network/disk rates.
    return { 
      cpu_time_ns: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.cpu_time_ns) ?? 0),
      system_time_ns: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.system_time_ns) ?? 0),
      online_cpus: Math.max(1, toFiniteNumber(data.online_cpus) ?? 1),
      memory_used: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.memory_used) ?? 0),
      memory_limit: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.memory_limit) ?? 0),
      network_in_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.network_in_bytes_per_sec ?? data.networkInBytesPerSec),
      network_out_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.network_out_bytes_per_sec ?? data.networkOutBytesPerSec),
      disk_read_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.disk_read_bytes_per_sec ?? data.diskReadBytesPerSec),
      disk_write_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.disk_write_bytes_per_sec ?? data.diskWriteBytesPerSec),
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    const orgId = auth.orgId;

    if (!orgId) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Active org required' }), { status: 400, headers });
    }

    // Verify user has access to org
    const memberships = await sql`
      SELECT 1 FROM organization_members 
      WHERE organization_id = ${orgId} AND user_id = ${auth.userId}
    `;
    if (memberships.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Access denied' }), { status: 403, headers });
    }

    const limitState = await enforceOrganizationNodeLimit({
      organizationId: orgId,
      isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
    });

    if (limitState.allowedHostIds.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify([]), { headers });
    }

    // Get all hosts for the org
    const hosts = await sql`
      SELECT h.id, h.host_url, h.name 
      FROM docker_hosts h
      WHERE h.organization_id = ${orgId}
        AND h.id = ANY(${limitState.allowedHostIds})
    `;

    if (hosts.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify([]), { headers });
    }

    // Fetch secrets and metrics for each host concurrently
    const now = new Date();
    const timestamp = now.getTime();
    const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });

    const connectedHostIds: string[] = [];

    const metricsPromises = hosts.map(async (host) => {
      try {
        // Get decrypted secrets for this host
        const secretsRecord = await sql`
          SELECT agent_api_key 
          FROM docker_host_secrets 
          WHERE host_id = ${host.id}
        `;

        if (secretsRecord.length === 0 || !secretsRecord[0].agent_api_key) {
          return null;
        }

        const decryptedSecrets = decryptHostSecrets(secretsRecord[0], host.id);
        const apiKey = decryptedSecrets?.agent_api_key;
        if (!apiKey) return null;

        const metrics = await fetchHostMetrics(host.host_url, apiKey);
        if (metrics) connectedHostIds.push(host.id);
        return metrics;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    });

    const results = await Promise.all(metricsPromises);

    // Update heartbeat for hosts that returned valid metrics
    if (connectedHostIds.length > 0) {
      try {
        await sql`
          UPDATE docker_hosts
          SET status = 'connected', last_seen_at = now(), consecutive_failures = 0
          WHERE id = ANY(${connectedHostIds})
        `;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[fleet-metrics] heartbeat update failed', e);
      }
    }

     // Aggregate: calculate fleet-wide CPU and memory utilization
     // For CPU: 
     //   Used cores = Σ[(cpu_time_ns / system_time_ns) * online_cpus] 
     //   Total capacity = Σ[online_cpus]
     //   Utilization % = (Used cores / Total capacity) * 100
     // For Memory:
     //   Utilization % = (totalMemoryUsed / totalMemoryLimit) * 100
     let totalCpuUsedCores = 0;     // total CPU cores used across fleet
     let totalCpuCapacityCores = 0; // total CPU cores available across fleet
     let totalMemoryUsed = 0;       // bytes
     let totalMemoryLimit = 0;      // bytes
     let networkInSum = 0;
     let networkInCount = 0;
     let networkOutSum = 0;
     let networkOutCount = 0;
     let diskReadSum = 0;
     let diskReadCount = 0;
     let diskWriteSum = 0;
     let diskWriteCount = 0;
     let hostCount = 0;

     results.forEach((result) => {
       if (result && result.system_time_ns > 0) {
         // Calculate used cores for this host: (cpu_time_ns / system_time_ns) * online_cpus
         const hostUsedCores = (result.cpu_time_ns / result.system_time_ns) * result.online_cpus;
         // Add to fleet totals
         totalCpuUsedCores += hostUsedCores;
          totalCpuCapacityCores += result.online_cpus;
          totalMemoryUsed += result.memory_used;
          totalMemoryLimit += result.memory_limit;

          if (result.network_in_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            networkInSum += result.network_in_bytes_per_sec;
            networkInCount++;
          }
          if (result.network_out_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            networkOutSum += result.network_out_bytes_per_sec;
            networkOutCount++;
          }
          if (result.disk_read_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            diskReadSum += result.disk_read_bytes_per_sec;
            diskReadCount++;
          }
          if (result.disk_write_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            diskWriteSum += result.disk_write_bytes_per_sec;
            diskWriteCount++;
          }

          hostCount++;
        }
      });

     // Compute percentages
     // CPU: Fleet utilization percentage = (used cores / total capacity cores) * 100
     // Memory: Fleet utilization percentage = (used memory / total memory) * 100
     let cpuPercent = 0;
     let memPercent = 0;
     
     if (hostCount > 0) {
       // Memory: true fleet-wide percentage
       if (totalMemoryLimit > 0) {
         memPercent = Math.round((totalMemoryUsed / totalMemoryLimit) * 100);
       }
       
       // CPU: Fleet CPU utilization percentage
       if (totalCpuCapacityCores > 0) {
         cpuPercent = Math.round((totalCpuUsedCores / totalCpuCapacityCores) * 100);
       }
     }

      const fleetMetrics: FleetMetricsPoint[] = [{
         timestamp,
         time: timeStr,
         cpu: cpuPercent,
         memory: memPercent,
        usedCores: Math.round(totalCpuUsedCores * 100) / 100, // keep 2 decimal places for display
        totalCores: Math.round(totalCpuCapacityCores * 100) / 100,
        memoryUsed: totalMemoryUsed,
        memoryLimit: totalMemoryLimit,
        networkInBytesPerSec: networkInCount > 0 ? networkInSum : null,
        networkOutBytesPerSec: networkOutCount > 0 ? networkOutSum : null,
        diskReadBytesPerSec: diskReadCount > 0 ? diskReadSum : null,
        diskWriteBytesPerSec: diskWriteCount > 0 ? diskWriteSum : null,
        reportingHosts: hostCount,
        totalHosts: hosts.length,
        isPartial: hostCount > 0 && hostCount < hosts.length,
      }];

    return new Response(JSON.stringify(fleetMetrics), {
      headers,
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Failed to fetch fleet metrics', details: error.message }), { status: 500, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/fleet-metrics',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-host-health-poll.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { decryptHostSecrets, SecretCryptoError } from './lib/crypto.mjs';
import {
  DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD,
  parseStaleThresholdMinutes,
  staleCutoffDate,
  failureStatusForCount,
} from './lib/host-health.mjs';
import { enforceOrganizationNodeLimit } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse } from './lib/agent-release.mts';
import { ensureDockerHostSchema } from './lib/ensure-docker-host-schema.mjs';
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl } from './lib/host-url.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, x-cron-secret',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

const PING_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000

function isAuthorizedSchedulerRequest(req: Request) {
  const expectedSecret = (process.env.HEALTH_POLL_SECRET || '').trim()
  const providedSecret = (req.headers.get('x-cron-secret') || '').trim()
  const schedulerEvent = (req.headers.get('x-nf-event') || '').trim().toLowerCase()

  if (expectedSecret && providedSecret === expectedSecret) {
    return true
  }

  return schedulerEvent === 'schedule'
}

function buildPingRequest(
  host: { host_url: string; connection_mode: string; docker_socket_path: string | null },
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
) {
  const base = host.host_url.replace(/\/$/, '')
  const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = {}

  if (secrets?.agent_api_key) {
    reqHeaders['X-Agent-Key'] = secrets.agent_api_key
  }

  if (host.docker_socket_path && host.docker_socket_path !== '/var/run/docker.sock') {
    reqHeaders['X-Docker-Socket'] = host.docker_socket_path
  }

  if (host.connection_mode === 'cloudflare_tunnel') {
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_id) reqHeaders['CF-Access-Client-Id'] = secrets.cf_service_token_id
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_secret) reqHeaders['CF-Access-Client-Secret'] = secrets.cf_service_token_secret
  }

  return {
    pingUrl: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, '/docker/_ping'),
    dockerVersionUrl: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, '/docker/version'),
    agentVersionUrl: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, '/agent/version'),
    headers: reqHeaders
  }
}

function trimDiagnostic(value: string, maxLength = 160) {
  return value.length > maxLength ? `${value.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...` : value
}

async function fetchAgentVersionReport(
  host: { id: string; host_url: string; connection_mode: string; docker_socket_path: string | null },
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
) {
  const { agentVersionUrl, headers: reqHeaders } = buildPingRequest(host, secrets)

  try {
    const agentResp = await fetch(agentVersionUrl, { headers: reqHeaders, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })
    if (!agentResp.ok) {
      const body = trimDiagnostic((await agentResp.text()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
      return {
        agentVersion: null as string | null,
        agentVersionError: trimDiagnostic(
          body
            ? `GET /agent/version returned ${agentResp.status}: ${body}`
            : `GET /agent/version returned ${agentResp.status}`,
        ),
      }
    }

    const agentData = await agentResp.json()
    const agentVersion = agentData.agent_version || agentData.version || null
    if (!agentVersion) {
      return {
        agentVersion: null as string | null,
        agentVersionError: 'GET /agent/version did not include an agent version',
      }
    }

    return { agentVersion, agentVersionError: null as string | null }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      agentVersion: null as string | null,
      agentVersionError: trimDiagnostic(`GET /agent/version failed: ${err?.message || 'Unknown error'}`),
    }
  }
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureDockerHostSchema();

    if (!isAuthorizedSchedulerRequest(req)) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers })
    }

    const orgRows = await sql<Array<{ organization_id: string | null }>>`
      SELECT DISTINCT organization_id
      FROM docker_hosts
      WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL
    `;

    const allowedHostIds: string[] = [];
    for (const row of orgRows) {
      if (!row.organization_id) continue;
      const limitState = await enforceOrganizationNodeLimit({
        organizationId: row.organization_id,
        isPlatformAdmin: false,
      });
      allowedHostIds.push(...limitState.allowedHostIds);
    }

    if (allowedHostIds.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ polled: 0, message: 'No eligible hosts to poll' }), { headers });
    }

    const hosts = await sql`
      SELECT *
      FROM docker_hosts
      WHERE id = ANY(${allowedHostIds})
    `;

    const staleThresholdMinutes = parseStaleThresholdMinutes(process.env.HOST_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES)
    const staleCutoff = staleCutoffDate(new Date(), staleThresholdMinutes)

    const staleUpdate = await sql`
      UPDATE docker_hosts
      SET status = 'stale'
      WHERE status = 'connected'
        AND id = ANY(${allowedHostIds})
        AND last_seen_at IS NOT NULL
        AND last_seen_at < ${staleCutoff.toISOString()}
      RETURNING id
    `

    if (hosts.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ polled: 0, message: 'No hosts to poll' }), { headers })
    }

    const results: any[] = []

    await Promise.allSettled(hosts.map(async (host) => {
      try {
        const secretsRecord = await sql`
          SELECT agent_api_key, cf_service_token_id, cf_service_token_secret 
          FROM docker_host_secrets WHERE host_id = ${host.id}
        `;
        const secrets = decryptHostSecrets(secretsRecord[0] || null, host.id);

        const { pingUrl, dockerVersionUrl, headers: reqHeaders } = buildPingRequest(host as any, secrets)

        const pingResp = await fetch(pingUrl, {
          method: 'GET',
          headers: reqHeaders,
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(PING_TIMEOUT_MS),
        })

        if (!pingResp.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Ping returned ${pingResp.status}: ${await pingResp.text()}`)
        }
        await pingResp.text()

        let dockerVersion: string | null = null
        let agentVersion: string | null = null
        let agentVersionError: string | null = null
        let osInfo: string | null = null
        try {
          const vResp = await fetch(dockerVersionUrl, { headers: reqHeaders, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })
          if (vResp.ok) {
            const vData = await vResp.json()
            dockerVersion = vData.Version || null
            osInfo = vData.Os ? `${vData.Os}/${vData.Arch}` : null
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        const agentVersionReport = await fetchAgentVersionReport(host as any, secrets)
        agentVersion = agentVersionReport.agentVersion
        agentVersionError = agentVersionReport.agentVersionError
        if (agentVersionError) {
          console.warn('[host-health-poll] agent version lookup failed', {
            hostId: host.id,
            hostUrl: host.host_url,
            error: agentVersionError,
          })
        }

        const releaseResponse = buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(agentVersion)
        const agentNeedsUpdate = releaseResponse.agent_update_status === 'update_required'

        await sql`
          UPDATE docker_hosts 
          SET status = 'connected', 
              last_seen_at = now(), 
              consecutive_failures = 0, 
              last_error = null,
              docker_version = COALESCE(${dockerVersion}, docker_version),
              agent_version = COALESCE(${agentVersion}, agent_version),
              os_info = COALESCE(${osInfo}, os_info)
          WHERE id = ${host.id}
        `;

        results.push({
          hostId: host.id,
          name: host.name,
          status: 'connected',
          docker_version: dockerVersion,
          agent_version: agentVersion,
          agent_version_error: agentVersionError,
          ...releaseResponse,
          agent_update_available: agentNeedsUpdate,
        })
      } catch (err: any) {
        const errorMsg = err.message || 'Unknown error'
        const newFailures = (host.consecutive_failures || 0) + 1
        const newStatus = failureStatusForCount(newFailures, DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD)

        await sql`
          UPDATE docker_hosts 
          SET status = ${newStatus}, 
              consecutive_failures = ${newFailures}, 
              last_error = ${errorMsg.substring(0, 500)}
          WHERE id = ${host.id}
        `;

        results.push({
          hostId: host.id,
          name: host.name,
          status: newStatus,
          error: errorMsg,
          ...(err instanceof SecretCryptoError ? { code: err.code } : {}),
        })
      }
    }))

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      polled: hosts.length,
      stale_marked: staleUpdate.length,
      stale_threshold_minutes: staleThresholdMinutes,
      results,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }), { headers })

  } catch (error: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), { status: 500, headers })
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/host-health-poll',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-incidents.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { listAlertHistory, listIncidents, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const [incidents, history] = await Promise.all([listIncidents(auth), listAlertHistory(auth)]);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ incidents, history }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.source_alert_event_id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'source_alert_event_id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const [sourceAlert] = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM alert_events
        WHERE id = ${body.source_alert_event_id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
      `;

      if (!sourceAlert) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Alert not found' }), { status: 404, headers });
      }

      const existing = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM incidents
        WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          AND source_alert_event_id = ${body.source_alert_event_id}
          AND resolved_at IS NULL
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (existing.length > 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(existing[0]), { headers });
      }

      const [incident] = await sql`
        INSERT INTO incidents (
          organization_id, source_alert_event_id, title, summary,
          severity, status, metadata, opened_by
        )
        VALUES (
          ${auth.orgId}, ${body.source_alert_event_id},
          ${body.title || sourceAlert.title},
          ${body.summary || sourceAlert.message},
          ${body.severity || sourceAlert.severity},
          'open',
          ${JSON.stringify({ source_type: sourceAlert.source_type, source_ref: sourceAlert.source_ref })},
          ${auth.userId}
        )
        RETURNING *
      `;

      await sql`
        UPDATE alert_events
        SET
          incident_id = ${incident.id},
          status = CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 'acknowledged' ELSE status END,
          acknowledged_at = COALESCE(acknowledged_at, now()),
          acknowledged_by = COALESCE(acknowledged_by, ${auth.userId})
        WHERE id = ${body.source_alert_event_id}
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(incident), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied/.test(error?.message || '') ? 403 : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process incidents' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/incidents',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-members.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const authContext = await requireAuth(req);
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    
    // Use the orgId from the Clerk active organization token context, or fallback to query param
    const orgId = authContext.orgId || url.searchParams.get('orgId');

    if (req.method !== 'GET') {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
    }
    if (!orgId) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'orgId required' }), { status: 400, headers });
    }

    await assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
      organizationId: orgId,
      isPlatformAdmin: authContext.isPlatformAdmin,
      feature: 'team_collaboration',
    });

    const members = await sql`
      SELECT u.id as user_id, u.full_name, u.avatar_url, om.role, om.created_at as joined_at
      FROM organization_members om
      JOIN users u ON u.id = om.user_id
      WHERE om.organization_id = ${orgId}
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM organization_members 
        WHERE organization_id = ${orgId} AND user_id = ${authContext.userId}
      )
    `;

    return new Response(JSON.stringify(members), { headers });

  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/members',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-mock-docker-agent.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION } from './lib/agent-version.mts';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, X-Agent-Key, X-Docker-Socket',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const path = url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/mock-docker-agent/, '');

    const config = await sql`SELECT mode FROM mock_agent_config WHERE id = 1`;
    const mode = config[0]?.mode || 'success';

    if (mode === 'failure') {
      return new Response('Service Unavailable - Mock failure mode', {
        status: 503,
        headers,
      });
    }

    if (path === '/docker/_ping' || path.endsWith('/_ping')) {
      return new Response('OK', { status: 200, headers });
    }

    if (path === '/agent/version' || path.endsWith('/agent/version')) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        agent_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION,
        version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION,
      }), { status: 200, headers });
    }

    if (path === '/metrics' || path.endsWith('/metrics')) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        cpu_time_ns: 1_200_000_000,
        system_time_ns: 4_800_000_000,
        online_cpus: 4,
        memory_used: 2_147_483_648,
        memory_limit: 8_589_934_592,
        network_in_bytes_per_sec: 524_288,
        network_out_bytes_per_sec: 262_144,
        disk_read_bytes_per_sec: 131_072,
        disk_write_bytes_per_sec: 65_536,
      }), { status: 200, headers });
    }

    if (path === '/docker/version' || path.endsWith('/version')) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        Version: '27.0.3-mock',
        ApiVersion: '1.46',
        Os: 'linux',
        Arch: 'amd64',
        KernelVersion: '6.1.0-mock',
        GoVersion: 'go1.22.0',
      }), { status: 200, headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Not found', path }), {
      status: 404,
      headers,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), { status: 500, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/mock-docker-agent/*',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-notifications.mts">
import type { Config, Context } from "@netlify/functions";
import { requireAuth } from "./lib/auth.mjs";
import { sql } from "./lib/db.mjs";
import { ensureNotificationsSchema } from "./lib/ensure-notifications-schema.mjs";

export default async (req: Request, context: Context) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, {
      status: 204,
      headers: {
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Authorization, Content-Type",
      },
    });
  }

  const corsHeaders = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  };

  try {
    await ensureNotificationsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req, { requireOrg: false });

    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const pathSegments = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);

    // GET /api/notifications
    if (req.method === "GET") {
      // Fetch active notifications (global or org-specific) that haven't been dismissed by this user
      // and haven't expired
      const notifications = await sql`
        SELECT n.*
        FROM public.notifications n
        LEFT JOIN public.notification_dismissals d 
          ON n.id = d.notification_id AND d.user_id = ${auth.userId}
        WHERE (n.organization_id = ${auth.orgId} OR n.organization_id IS NULL)
          AND d.id IS NULL
          AND (n.expires_at IS NULL OR n.expires_at > now())
        ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 50
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ notifications }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: corsHeaders,
      });
    }

    // POST /api/notifications/:id/dismiss
    if (req.method === "POST" && pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 1] === "dismiss") {
      const notificationId = pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 2];
      
      const [notification] = await sql`
        SELECT id FROM public.notifications 
        WHERE id = ${notificationId} 
          AND (organization_id = ${auth.orgId} OR organization_id IS NULL)
      `;

      if (!notification) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Notification not found or unauthorized" }), {
          status: 404,
          headers: corsHeaders,
        });
      }
      
      await sql`
        INSERT INTO public.notification_dismissals (notification_id, user_id)
        VALUES (${notificationId}, ${auth.userId})
        ON CONFLICT (notification_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: corsHeaders,
      });
    }

    // POST /api/notifications/dismiss-all
    if (req.method === "POST" && pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 1] === "dismiss-all") {
      // Get all active notifications for this org/global
      const notifications = await sql`
        SELECT n.id
        FROM public.notifications n
        LEFT JOIN public.notification_dismissals d 
          ON n.id = d.notification_id AND d.user_id = ${auth.userId}
        WHERE (n.organization_id = ${auth.orgId} OR n.organization_id IS NULL)
          AND d.id IS NULL
          AND (n.expires_at IS NULL OR n.expires_at > now())
      `;

      if (notifications.length > 0) {
        const insertData = notifications.map(n => ({
          notification_id: n.id,
          user_id: auth.userId
        }));

        await sql`
          INSERT INTO public.notification_dismissals ${sql(insertData)}
          ON CONFLICT (notification_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
        `;
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: corsHeaders,
      });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), {
      status: 405,
      headers: corsHeaders,
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Notifications API Error:", error);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), {
      status: error.message?.includes('Unauthorized') || error.message?.includes('Sync pending') ? 401 : 500,
      headers: corsHeaders,
    });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/notifications/*",
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-organizations.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationWriteAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureOnboardingSchema } from './lib/ensure-onboarding-schema.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureOnboardingSchema();
    const authContext = await requireAuth(req, { requireOrg: false });

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const orgs = await sql`
        SELECT o.* 
        FROM organizations o
        JOIN organization_members om ON o.id = om.organization_id
        WHERE om.user_id = ${authContext.userId}
        ORDER BY o.created_at ASC
      `;
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(orgs), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      const { name } = await req.json();
      if (!name) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Name required' }), { status: 400, headers });

      const [{ create_organization: orgId }] = await sql`
        SELECT public.create_organization(${name}, ${authContext.userId})
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ id: orgId }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      const body = await req.json();
      const onboardingStatus = body?.onboardingStatus;
      const requestedClerkOrgId = typeof body?.clerkOrgId === 'string' ? body.clerkOrgId : null;
      const allowedStatuses = ['not_started', 'skipped', 'completed'];

      if (!allowedStatuses.includes(onboardingStatus)) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid onboardingStatus. Allowed values: not_started, skipped, completed' }),
          { status: 400, headers }
        );
      }

      let targetOrgId = authContext.orgId;
      const activeClerkOrgId = authContext.clerkOrgId ?? null;
      const membershipRows = await sql`
        SELECT o.id
        FROM organizations o
        JOIN organization_members om ON o.id = om.organization_id
        WHERE om.user_id = ${authContext.userId}
        ORDER BY om.created_at ASC
      `;

      if (requestedClerkOrgId) {
        const requestedOrgRows = await sql`
          SELECT o.id
          FROM organizations o
          JOIN organization_members om ON o.id = om.organization_id
          WHERE om.user_id = ${authContext.userId} AND o.clerk_org_id = ${requestedClerkOrgId}
          LIMIT 1
        `;

        if (requestedOrgRows.length === 0) {
          const canCreatePendingOrg =
            activeClerkOrgId === requestedClerkOrgId ||
            (!activeClerkOrgId && membershipRows.length === 0);

          if (canCreatePendingOrg) {
            const pendingSlugBase = requestedClerkOrgId
              .toLowerCase()
              .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
              .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
              .slice(0, 40) || 'pending-org';
            const pendingSlug = `${pendingSlugBase}-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

            const [createdOrg] = await sql`
              INSERT INTO public.organizations (name, slug, clerk_org_id, created_by)
              VALUES ('Pending organization', ${pendingSlug}, ${requestedClerkOrgId}, ${authContext.userId})
              ON CONFLICT (clerk_org_id) DO UPDATE
              SET updated_at = now()
              RETURNING id
            `;

            await sql`
              INSERT INTO public.organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role)
              VALUES (${createdOrg.id}, ${authContext.userId}, 'owner')
              ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
            `;

            targetOrgId = createdOrg.id;
          } else if (activeClerkOrgId === requestedClerkOrgId) {
            return new Response(
              JSON.stringify({ error: 'Organization sync pending. Please retry.', retry: true }),
              { status: 202, headers }
            );
          }

          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Requested organization not found for current user' }), { status: 404, headers });
        }

        targetOrgId = requestedOrgRows[0].id;
      }

      if (!targetOrgId) {
        if (membershipRows.length === 0) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'No organization membership found' }), { status: 400, headers });
        }

        if (membershipRows.length > 1) {
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({ error: 'Multiple organizations found. Please select an active organization and retry.' }),
            { status: 400, headers }
          );
        }

        targetOrgId = membershipRows[0].id;
      }

      const memberships = await sql`
        SELECT 1
        FROM organization_members
        WHERE organization_id = ${targetOrgId} AND user_id = ${authContext.userId}
      `;

      if (memberships.length === 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Access denied' }), { status: 403, headers });
      }

      await assertOrganizationWriteAllowed({
        organizationId: targetOrgId,
        isPlatformAdmin: authContext.isPlatformAdmin,
      });

      const updated = await sql`
        UPDATE organizations
        SET
          onboarding_status = ${onboardingStatus},
          onboarding_skipped_at = CASE
            WHEN ${onboardingStatus} = 'skipped' THEN COALESCE(onboarding_skipped_at, now())
            ELSE onboarding_skipped_at
          END,
          onboarding_completed_at = CASE
            WHEN ${onboardingStatus} = 'completed' THEN COALESCE(onboarding_completed_at, now())
            ELSE onboarding_completed_at
          END
        WHERE id = ${targetOrgId}
        RETURNING id, clerk_org_id, onboarding_status, onboarding_skipped_at, onboarding_completed_at
      `;

      if (updated.length === 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Organization not found' }), { status: 404, headers });
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(updated[0]), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[api-organizations] caught error:', err?.message);

    if (err?.code === 'SYNC_PENDING') {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message, retry: true }), {
        status: 202,
        headers,
      });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/organizations',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/functions/api-slack-destinations.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';

import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { getOrganizationRole, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import {
  createSlackDestination,
  listSlackDestinations,
  sendSlackDestinationTest,
  updateSlackDestination,
} from './lib/slack-delivery.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    await assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
      organizationId: auth.orgId!,
      isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
      feature: 'slack_destinations',
    });
    const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const destinations = await listSlackDestinations(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ destinations, role, can_manage: ['owner', 'admin'].includes(role) }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();

      if (body?.action === 'test') {
        if (!body?.id) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
        }
        const attempt = await sendSlackDestinationTest(auth, body.id);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(attempt), { headers });
      }

      if (!body?.name?.trim() || !body?.webhook_url?.trim()) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Name and Slack webhook URL are required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const destination = await createSlackDestination(auth, {
        name: body.name.trim(),
        webhook_url: body.webhook_url.trim(),
        enabled: body.enabled ?? true,
      });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(destination), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const destination = await updateSlackDestination(auth, {
        id: body.id,
        name: typeof body.name === 'string' ? body.name.trim() : undefined,
        webhook_url: typeof body.webhook_url === 'string' ? body.webhook_url.trim() : undefined,
        enabled: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'enabled') ? body.enabled : undefined,
      });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(destination), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied|require a[n]? /.test(error?.message || '')
      ? 403
      : /Slack webhook URL|URL must|URL cannot/.test(error?.message || '')
        ? 400
        : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process Slack destinations' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/slack-destinations',
};
</file>

import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';

import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { getOrganizationRole, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import {
  createWebhookDestination,
  listWebhookDestinations,
  sendWebhookDestinationTest,
  updateWebhookDestination,
} from './lib/webhook-destinations.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    await assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
      organizationId: auth.orgId!,
      isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
      feature: 'webhook_destinations',
    });
    const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const destinations = await listWebhookDestinations(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ destinations, role, can_manage: ['owner', 'admin'].includes(role) }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();

      if (body?.action === 'test') {
        if (!body?.id) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
        }
        const attempt = await sendWebhookDestinationTest(auth, body.id);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(attempt), { headers });
      }

      if (!body?.name?.trim() || !body?.url?.trim()) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Name and URL are required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const result = await createWebhookDestination(auth, {
        name: body.name.trim(),
        url: body.url.trim(),
        enabled: body.enabled ?? true,
      });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const result = await updateWebhookDestination(auth, {
        id: body.id,
        name: typeof body.name === 'string' ? body.name.trim() : undefined,
        url: typeof body.url === 'string' ? body.url.trim() : undefined,
        enabled: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'enabled') ? body.enabled : undefined,
        regenerate_secret: !!body.regenerate_secret,
      });

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {

      ? 403
      : /URL must|URL cannot/.test(error?.message || '')
        ? 400
        : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process webhook destinations' }), { status, headers });

<file path="netlify/functions/auth-me.mts">
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { ensureOnboardingSchema } from './lib/ensure-onboarding-schema.mjs';
import { ensureAdminSchema } from './lib/ensure-admin-schema.mjs';
import { isPlatformAdminEmail } from './lib/platform-admin.mjs';
import { ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema } from './lib/ensure-dedicated-deployment-schema.mjs';
import { resolveOrganizationEntitlements } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';

const allowedOrigins = new Set([
  'https://app.dockerdash.app',
  'http://localhost:5173',
  'http://localhost:8080',
  'http://localhost:8081',
  'http://localhost:8888',
]);

function buildHeaders(req: Request) {
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin') || '';
  const allowOrigin = allowedOrigins.has(origin) ? origin : 'https://app.dockerdash.app';
  return {
    'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': allowOrigin,
    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
    'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials': 'true',
    'Vary': 'Origin',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  const headers = buildHeaders(req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureOnboardingSchema();
    await ensureAdminSchema();
    await ensureDedicatedDeploymentSchema();
    const authContext = await requireAuth(req, { requireOrg: false });

    const users = await sql`
      SELECT
        u.id,
        u.email,
        u.full_name,
        u.avatar_url,
        u.is_approved,
        COALESCE(uac.is_suspended, false) AS is_suspended,
        COALESCE(uac.is_hard_disabled, false) AS is_hard_disabled
      FROM users u
      LEFT JOIN user_access_controls uac ON uac.user_id = u.id
      WHERE u.id = ${authContext.userId}
    `;

    if (users.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'User not found' }), { status: 404, headers });
    }

    const orgMemberships = await sql`
      SELECT
        o.id,
        o.clerk_org_id,
        o.onboarding_status,
        o.plan,
        om.created_at
      FROM organization_members om
      JOIN organizations o ON o.id = om.organization_id
      WHERE om.user_id = ${authContext.userId}
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN ${authContext.orgId}::uuid IS NOT NULL AND o.id = ${authContext.orgId}::uuid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        om.created_at ASC
    `;

    const hasOrgs = orgMemberships.length > 0;
    const activeOrg = orgMemberships.find((org) => org.id === authContext.orgId) ?? null;
    const effectiveOrg = activeOrg ?? orgMemberships[0] ?? null;
    const onboardingStatus = (effectiveOrg?.onboarding_status as string | undefined) ?? null;
    const needsOnboarding = !effectiveOrg || onboardingStatus === 'not_started';
    const isPlatformAdmin = isPlatformAdminEmail(users[0].email);
    const dedicatedDeployment =
      effectiveOrg
        ? await sql`
            SELECT status, updated_at
            FROM public.dedicated_deployments
            WHERE organization_id = ${effectiveOrg.id}
            LIMIT 1
          `
        : [];
    const entitlements = effectiveOrg
      ? await resolveOrganizationEntitlements({
          organizationId: effectiveOrg.id,
          // Plan is the absolute source of truth for all entitlements.
          // Admin status never inflates plan capacity or unlocks paid features.
          isPlatformAdmin: false,
        })
      : null;
    const effectivePlan = entitlements?.effectivePlan ?? 'free';

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      user: {
        ...users[0],
        has_orgs: hasOrgs,
        needs_onboarding: needsOnboarding,
        onboarding_status: onboardingStatus,
        active_org_id: effectiveOrg?.id ?? null,
        active_org_clerk_id: effectiveOrg?.clerk_org_id ?? null,
        active_org_plan: effectiveOrg?.plan ?? null,
        active_org_effective_plan: effectivePlan,
        dedicated_deployment_status: dedicatedDeployment[0]?.status ?? null,
        dedicated_deployment_updated_at: dedicatedDeployment[0]?.updated_at ? new Date(String(dedicatedDeployment[0].updated_at)).toISOString() : null,
        is_platform_admin: isPlatformAdmin,
        is_suspended: Boolean(users[0].is_suspended),
        is_hard_disabled: Boolean(users[0].is_hard_disabled),
        entitlements,
      },
    }), { headers });

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[auth-me] caught error:', err?.message);

    if (err?.code === 'SYNC_PENDING') {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message, code: err.code, retry: true }), { status: 202, headers });
    }

    const message = err?.message || 'Unauthorized';
    const lowerMessage = String(message).toLowerCase();
    const status =
      lowerMessage.includes('awaiting platform approval') ||
      lowerMessage.includes('disabled by a platform administrator') ||
      lowerMessage.includes('account is suspended') ||
      lowerMessage.includes('no longer have access to the selected organization')
        ? 403
        : lowerMessage.includes('no active organization selected')
          ? 409
          : 401;

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: message }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/auth/me',
};
</file>

<file path="netlify/init-db.mjs">
import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import 'dotenv/config';

const { Client } = pg;

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

async function run() {
  const url = process.env.NETLIFY_DATABASE_URL;
  if (!url) {
    console.error('NETLIFY_DATABASE_URL is required in .env');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const client = new Client({
    connectionString: url,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
  });

  await client.connect();
  const schemaPath = path.join(__dirname, 'schema.sql');
  const schema = fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8');

  console.log('Connected to Neon DB. Executing schema...');
  
  try {
    await client.query(schema);
    console.log('✓ Successfully initialized schema in Neon DB.');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('✗ Failed:', err.message);
  } finally {
    await client.end();
  }
}

run().catch(console.error);
</file>

<file path="netlify/schema.sql">
-- Step 1: Extensions
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- Step 2: Users (Replaces Supabase auth.users & public.profiles)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.users (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  email text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash text,
  full_name text,
  avatar_url text,
  clerk_user_id text UNIQUE,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE public.users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS clerk_user_id text UNIQUE;

-- Step 3: Organizations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.organizations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  name text NOT NULL,
  slug text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  clerk_org_id text UNIQUE,
  onboarding_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started' CHECK (onboarding_status IN ('not_started', 'skipped', 'completed')),
  onboarding_skipped_at timestamptz,
  onboarding_completed_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE public.organizations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS clerk_org_id text UNIQUE;
ALTER TABLE public.organizations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_status text;
ALTER TABLE public.organizations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_skipped_at timestamptz;
ALTER TABLE public.organizations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_completed_at timestamptz;
ALTER TABLE public.organizations
  ALTER COLUMN onboarding_status SET DEFAULT 'not_started';
UPDATE public.organizations
SET onboarding_status = 'not_started'
WHERE onboarding_status IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.organizations
  ALTER COLUMN onboarding_status SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.organizations
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS organizations_onboarding_status_check;
ALTER TABLE public.organizations
  ADD CONSTRAINT organizations_onboarding_status_check
  CHECK (onboarding_status IN ('not_started', 'skipped', 'completed'));

-- Backfill onboarding status from existing org activity:
-- if an org already has hosts, onboarding is considered completed.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.tables
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'docker_hosts'
  ) THEN
    UPDATE public.organizations o
    SET
      onboarding_status = 'completed',
      onboarding_completed_at = COALESCE(o.onboarding_completed_at, now())
    WHERE o.onboarding_status = 'not_started'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.docker_hosts h WHERE h.organization_id = o.id
    );
  END IF;
END
$$;

UPDATE public.organizations
SET onboarding_skipped_at = COALESCE(onboarding_skipped_at, updated_at)
WHERE onboarding_status = 'skipped' AND onboarding_skipped_at IS NULL;

UPDATE public.organizations
SET onboarding_completed_at = COALESCE(onboarding_completed_at, updated_at)
WHERE onboarding_status = 'completed' AND onboarding_completed_at IS NULL;

-- Step 4: Organization Members
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.organization_members (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(organization_id, user_id)
);

-- Step 5: Docker Hosts
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.docker_hosts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  host_url text NOT NULL,
  connection_mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent',
  docker_socket_path text DEFAULT '/var/run/docker.sock',
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
  docker_version text,
  agent_version text,
  os_info text,
  last_seen_at timestamptz,
  consecutive_failures integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error text,
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Step 6: Docker Host Secrets (No selecting by frontend)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.docker_host_secrets (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  host_id uuid REFERENCES public.docker_hosts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  agent_api_key text,
  cf_service_token_id text,
  cf_service_token_secret text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Step 7: Mock Agent Config 
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.mock_agent_config (
  id integer PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1 CHECK (id = 1),
  mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'success',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO public.mock_agent_config (id, mode) VALUES (1, 'success') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;



-- Step 8: Update Triggers
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_users_updated_at ON public.users;
CREATE TRIGGER update_users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_organizations_updated_at ON public.organizations;
CREATE TRIGGER update_organizations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.organizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_docker_hosts_updated_at ON public.docker_hosts;
CREATE TRIGGER update_docker_hosts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.docker_hosts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_docker_host_secrets_updated_at ON public.docker_host_secrets;
CREATE TRIGGER update_docker_host_secrets_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.docker_host_secrets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.agent_enrollment_sessions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_by_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  docker_host_id uuid REFERENCES public.docker_hosts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  host_name text NOT NULL,
  host_url text NOT NULL,
  connection_mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent',
  docker_socket_path text NOT NULL DEFAULT '/var/run/docker.sock',
  encrypted_agent_api_key text NOT NULL,
  encrypted_cf_service_token_id text,
  encrypted_cf_service_token_secret text,
  enrollment_token_hash text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created',
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  claimed_at timestamptz,
  installed_at timestamptz,
  cancelled_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT agent_enrollment_sessions_status_check
    CHECK (status IN ('created', 'claimed', 'installed', 'expired', 'cancelled'))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_enrollment_token_hash ON public.agent_enrollment_sessions (enrollment_token_hash);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_enrollment_org_status ON public.agent_enrollment_sessions (organization_id, status, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_enrollment_host ON public.agent_enrollment_sessions (docker_host_id);

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_agent_enrollment_sessions_updated_at ON public.agent_enrollment_sessions;
CREATE TRIGGER update_agent_enrollment_sessions_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.agent_enrollment_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

-- Step 9: Alerts workspace
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.alert_rules (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  condition_type text NOT NULL,
  resource_scope jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"scope":"organization"}'::jsonb,
  threshold_value numeric,
  threshold_window_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  severity text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'warning',
  notification_channels jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alert_rules_org_enabled ON public.alert_rules (organization_id, enabled, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.alert_events (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  rule_id uuid REFERENCES public.alert_rules(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  incident_id uuid,
  fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  source_type text NOT NULL,
  source_ref text NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  message text NOT NULL,
  severity text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  first_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  acknowledged_at timestamptz,
  acknowledged_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  resolved_at timestamptz,
  resolved_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alert_events_org_status ON public.alert_events (organization_id, status, last_seen_at DESC);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alert_events_org_fingerprint_active ON public.alert_events (organization_id, fingerprint) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.incidents (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_alert_event_id uuid REFERENCES public.alert_events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  summary text,
  severity text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  opened_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  opened_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  resolved_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_org_status ON public.incidents (organization_id, status, opened_at DESC);

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_alert_rules_updated_at ON public.alert_rules;
CREATE TRIGGER update_alert_rules_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.alert_rules FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_alert_events_updated_at ON public.alert_events;
CREATE TRIGGER update_alert_events_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.alert_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_incidents_updated_at ON public.incidents;
CREATE TRIGGER update_incidents_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.incidents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.webhook_destinations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  url text NOT NULL,
  signing_secret text NOT NULL,
  signing_secret_preview text NOT NULL,
  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_webhook_destinations_org_enabled ON public.webhook_destinations (organization_id, enabled, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.alert_delivery_attempts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  webhook_destination_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.webhook_destinations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  alert_event_id uuid REFERENCES public.alert_events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  delivery_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alert',
  event_type text NOT NULL,
  succeeded boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  http_status integer,
  error_summary text,
  response_excerpt text,
  attempted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alert_delivery_attempts_destination_time ON public.alert_delivery_attempts (webhook_destination_id, attempted_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alert_delivery_attempts_alert_time ON public.alert_delivery_attempts (alert_event_id, attempted_at DESC);

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_webhook_destinations_updated_at ON public.webhook_destinations;
CREATE TRIGGER update_webhook_destinations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.webhook_destinations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.slack_destinations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  webhook_url text NOT NULL,
  webhook_url_preview text NOT NULL,
  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slack_destinations_org_enabled ON public.slack_destinations (organization_id, enabled, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.alert_slack_delivery_attempts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slack_destination_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.slack_destinations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  alert_event_id uuid REFERENCES public.alert_events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  delivery_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alert',
  event_type text NOT NULL,
  succeeded boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  http_status integer,
  error_summary text,
  response_excerpt text,
  attempted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alert_slack_attempts_destination_time ON public.alert_slack_delivery_attempts (slack_destination_id, attempted_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alert_slack_attempts_alert_time ON public.alert_slack_delivery_attempts (alert_event_id, attempted_at DESC);

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_slack_destinations_updated_at ON public.slack_destinations;
CREATE TRIGGER update_slack_destinations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.slack_destinations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

-- Function to create organization and auto-add owner
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_organization(_name text, _user_id uuid)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  _slug text;
  _org_id uuid;
BEGIN
  _slug := lower(regexp_replace(_name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', 'g'));
  _slug := trim(both '-' from _slug) || '-' || to_hex(extract(epoch from now())::int);
  
  INSERT INTO public.organizations (name, slug, created_by)
  VALUES (_name, _slug, _user_id)
  RETURNING id INTO _org_id;
  
  INSERT INTO public.organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role)
  VALUES (_org_id, _user_id, 'owner')
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  
  RETURN _org_id;
END;
$$;

-- Notifications
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notifications (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title text NOT NULL,
  message text NOT NULL,
  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
  link text,
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_dismissals (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  notification_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notifications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  dismissed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(notification_id, user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_org_time ON public.notifications (organization_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notification_dismissals_user ON public.notification_dismissals (user_id);
</file>
