#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
NEXT_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/watchtower-agent.sh"

cat >&2 <<'EOF'
WARNING: watchtower-dev-connector.sh is deprecated.
Use watchtower-agent-install.sh for new installs:
  curl -fsSLO https://your-watchtower-host/watchtower-agent-install.sh
  chmod +x watchtower-agent-install.sh
  sudo ./watchtower-agent-install.sh
EOF

if [ -x "$NEXT_SCRIPT" ]; then
  exec "$NEXT_SCRIPT" "$@"
fi

echo "watchtower-agent.sh was not found next to this legacy shim." >&2
echo "Download watchtower-agent-install.sh or watchtower-agent.sh instead." >&2
exit 1
</file>

<file path="scripts/prepare-watchtower-agent-release.mjs">
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, copyFile, readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const repoRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const publicDir = path.join(repoRoot, "public");
const releaseDir = path.join(repoRoot, ".release", "watchtower-agent");
const versionFile = path.join(repoRoot, "shared", "watchtower-agent-release.ts");

const versionSource = await readFile(versionFile, "utf8");
const versionMatch = versionSource.match(/version:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
const version = versionMatch?.[1];

if (!version) {
  throw new Error(`Could not determine release version from ${versionFile}`);
}

const tag = `v${version}`;
const outputDir = path.join(releaseDir, tag);
const assetNames = [
  "watchtower-agent-install.sh",
  "watchtower-agent.sh",
  "watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh",
];

await mkdir(outputDir, { recursive: true });

const checksumLines = [];

for (const assetName of assetNames) {
  const sourcePath = path.join(publicDir, assetName);
  const buffer = await readFile(sourcePath);
  const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(buffer).digest("hex");
  checksumLines.push(`${sha256}  ${assetName}`);
  await copyFile(sourcePath, path.join(outputDir, assetName));
}

await writeFile(path.join(outputDir, "SHA256SUMS.txt"), `${checksumLines.join("\n")}\n`, "utf8");

console.log(`Prepared watchtower-agent release assets in ${outputDir}`);
console.log("Checksums:");
for (const line of checksumLines) {
  console.log(`  ${line}`);
}
console.log("");
console.log("Suggested GitHub CLI release command:");
console.log(
  `gh release create ${tag} "${path.join(outputDir, "watchtower-agent-install.sh")}" "${path.join(outputDir, "watchtower-agent.sh")}" "${path.join(outputDir, "watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh")}" "${path.join(outputDir, "SHA256SUMS.txt")}" --title "Watchtower Agent ${version}" --notes "Host agent release ${version}"`,
);
</file>

<file path="shared/lib/diagnostics.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  formatDiagnosticDetail,
  parseDiagnosticPayload,
  summarizeDiagnosticText,
} from "./diagnostics";

describe("diagnostics", () => {
  it("summarizes Cloudflare HTML error pages into a short message", () => {
    const raw = `
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html>
        <head>
          <title>dockerdash.app | 502: Bad gateway</title>
        </head>
        <body>cloudflare</body>
      </html>
    `;

    expect(summarizeDiagnosticText(raw)).toBe(
      "Cloudflare HTML error page: dockerdash.app | 502: Bad gateway",
    );
  });

  it("parses JSON diagnostics when available", () => {
    expect(parseDiagnosticPayload('{"error":"boom","code":"agent_connection_failed"}')).toEqual({
      error: "boom",
      code: "agent_connection_failed",
    });
  });

  it("trims plain text diagnostics", () => {
    expect(parseDiagnosticPayload("  upstream timed out   ")).toBe("upstream timed out");
  });

  it("formats object diagnostics using nested error when present", () => {
    expect(formatDiagnosticDetail({ error: "  gateway down " })).toBe("gateway down");
  });
});
</file>

<file path="shared/lib/diagnostics.ts">
function trimDiagnostic(value: string, maxLength = 160) {
  return value.length > maxLength ? `${value.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...` : value;
}

function decodeHtmlEntities(value: string) {
  return value
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'");
}

function summarizeHtmlDiagnostic(rawDetails: string) {
  const titleMatch = rawDetails.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  const title = titleMatch ? decodeHtmlEntities(titleMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()) : null;
  const isCloudflare = /cloudflare/i.test(rawDetails);

  if (title && isCloudflare) {
    return trimDiagnostic(`Cloudflare HTML error page: ${title}`);
  }

  if (title) {
    return trimDiagnostic(`HTML error page: ${title}`);
  }

  if (isCloudflare) {
    return "Cloudflare returned an HTML error page.";
  }

  return "The upstream service returned an HTML error page.";
}

export function summarizeDiagnosticText(rawDetails: string) {
  const normalized = rawDetails.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

  if (!normalized) {
    return "";
  }

  if (/<(?:!doctype|html|head|body)\b/i.test(rawDetails)) {
    return summarizeHtmlDiagnostic(rawDetails);
  }

  return trimDiagnostic(normalized);
}

export function parseDiagnosticPayload(rawDetails: string) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(rawDetails);
  } catch {
    return summarizeDiagnosticText(rawDetails);
  }
}

export function formatDiagnosticDetail(details: unknown) {
  if (details === null || details === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  if (typeof details === "string") {
    return summarizeDiagnosticText(details);
  }

  if (typeof details === "object") {
    const error =
      typeof (details as { error?: unknown }).error === "string"
        ? summarizeDiagnosticText((details as { error: string }).error)
        : null;

    if (error) {
      return error;
    }

    try {
      return trimDiagnostic(JSON.stringify(details));
    } catch {
      return "Upstream error details were unavailable.";
    }
  }

  return String(details);
}
</file>

<file path="shared/schema/api.ts">
import { OpenAPIRegistry, OpenApiGeneratorV3 } from "@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi";
import { ProxyRequestParamsSchema, ProxyActionSchema, LogQueryParamsSchema, IdempotencyHeaderSchema } from "./proxy.js";
import { ProblemDetailsSchema } from "./error.js";

export const registry = new OpenAPIRegistry();

registry.registerComponent('securitySchemes', 'bearerAuth', {
  type: 'http',
  scheme: 'bearer',
  bearerFormat: 'JWT',
});

registry.registerPath({
  method: 'post',
  path: '/api/docker-proxy',
  summary: 'Proxy Docker commands to a host',
  tags: ['Docker'],
  security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
  request: {
    headers: IdempotencyHeaderSchema,
    body: {
      content: {
        'application/json': {
          schema: ProxyRequestParamsSchema
        }
      }
    }
  },
  responses: {
    200: {
      description: 'Successful proxy response',
      content: {
        'application/json': {
          schema: {
            type: 'object'
          }
        }
      }
    },
    400: {
      description: 'Bad request or missing required fields',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    403: {
      description: 'Access denied',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    404: {
      description: 'Resource not found',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    500: {
      description: 'Internal Server Error',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    },
    502: {
      description: 'Proxy downstream error',
      content: {
        'application/problem+json': {
          schema: ProblemDetailsSchema
        }
      }
    }
  }
});

export function generateOpenAPI() {
  const generator = new OpenApiGeneratorV3(registry.definitions);
  return generator.generateDocument({
    openapi: '3.0.0',
    info: {
      version: '1.0.0',
      title: 'Docker Watchtower Dashboard APIs',
      description: 'Proxy and control endpoints for remote Docker management',
    },
    servers: [{ url: 'https://docker.watchtower.dash.local' }]
  });
}
</file>

<file path="shared/schema/error.ts">
import { z } from "zod";
import { extendZodWithOpenApi } from "@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi";

extendZodWithOpenApi(z);

export const ProblemDetailsSchema = z.object({
  type: z.string().url().default("about:blank").openapi({
    description: "A URI reference that identifies the problem type.",
    example: "https://example.com/probs/out-of-credit",
  }),
  title: z.string().openapi({
    description: "A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.",
    example: "You do not have enough credit.",
  }),
  status: z.number().int().min(100).max(599).openapi({
    description: "The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.",
    example: 403,
  }),
  detail: z.string().optional().openapi({
    description: "A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.",
    example: "Your current balance is 30, but that costs 50.",
  }),
  instance: z.string().url().optional().openapi({
    description: "A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.",
    example: "/account/12345/msgs/abc",
  }),
}).openapi("ProblemDetails");

export function createProblemResponse(
  status: number,
  title: string,
  detail?: string,
  type = "about:blank",
  headers: Record<string, string> = {},
): Response {
  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({
      type,
      title,
      status,
      detail,
    }),
    {
      status,
      headers: {
        ...headers,
        "Content-Type": "application/problem+json",
      },
    }
  );
}
</file>

<file path="shared/schema/plan-policy.ts">
export type PlanId = "free" | "pro" | "team" | "enterprise";

export type SubscriptionStatus = "active" | "inactive" | "past_due" | "canceled" | "paused";

export interface PlanPolicy {
  seatLimit: number | null;
  nodeLimit: number | null;
  logTailLines: number;
  maxPayloadBytes: number;
  canUseWebhookDestinations: boolean;
  canUseSlackDestinations: boolean;
  canUseAdvancedAlerts: boolean;
  canUseTeamCollaboration: boolean;
  canUseLogs: boolean;
  canUseFileManager: boolean;
}

export const PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN: Record<PlanId, PlanPolicy> = {
  free: {
    seatLimit: 1,
    nodeLimit: 1,
    logTailLines: 100,
    maxPayloadBytes: 4 * 1024 * 1024, // 4 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: false,
    canUseSlackDestinations: false,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: false,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: false,
    canUseLogs: false,
    canUseFileManager: false,
  },
  pro: {
    seatLimit: 1,
    nodeLimit: 5,
    logTailLines: 1_000,
    maxPayloadBytes: 6 * 1024 * 1024, // 6 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: true,
    canUseSlackDestinations: false,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: true,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: false,
    canUseLogs: true,
    canUseFileManager: true,
  },
  team: {
    seatLimit: 10,
    nodeLimit: 25,
    logTailLines: 5_000,
    maxPayloadBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: true,
    canUseSlackDestinations: true,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: true,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: true,
    canUseLogs: true,
    canUseFileManager: true,
  },
  enterprise: {
    seatLimit: null,
    nodeLimit: null,
    logTailLines: 5_000,
    maxPayloadBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: true,
    canUseSlackDestinations: true,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: true,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: true,
    canUseLogs: true,
    canUseFileManager: true,
  },
};

export function normalizePlan(value: string | null | undefined): PlanId {
  if (value === "pro" || value === "team" || value === "enterprise") {
    return value;
  }

  return "free";
}

export function normalizeSubscriptionStatus(value: string | null | undefined): SubscriptionStatus {
  if (value === "active" || value === "past_due" || value === "inactive" || value === "canceled" || value === "paused") {
    return value;
  }

  return "inactive";
}

export function isPaidSubscriptionStatus(status: SubscriptionStatus) {
  return status === "active" || status === "past_due";
}

export function getEffectivePlanForEnforcement({
  plan,
  subscriptionStatus,
  isDonorPremium,
}: {
  plan: string | null | undefined;
  subscriptionStatus: string | null | undefined;
  isDonorPremium?: boolean;
}): PlanId {
  const normalizedPlan = normalizePlan(plan);
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeSubscriptionStatus(subscriptionStatus);
  const isPaidPlan = normalizedPlan !== "free";
  const isPaidSubscriptionActive = isPaidPlan && isPaidSubscriptionStatus(normalizedStatus);

  if (isPaidSubscriptionActive) {
    return normalizedPlan;
  }

  if (isDonorPremium) {
    return "pro";
  }

  return "free";
}
</file>

import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE } from "./watchtower-agent-release.ts";

export {

  getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy,
  isAgentVersionOutdated,

<file path="shared/watchtower-agent-release.ts">
export interface WatchtowerAgentRelease {
  version: string;
  tag: string;
  sourceLabel: string;
  published: boolean;
  releaseUrl: string;
  releaseNotesUrl: string;
  assetBaseUrl: string;
  installerAssetName: string;
  runtimeAssetName: string;
  uninstallAssetName: string;
  installerSha256: string;
  runtimeSha256: string;
  uninstallSha256: string;
}

export interface WatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse {
  latest_agent_version: string;
  agent_update_available: boolean;
  agent_update_status: WatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus;
  current_agent_version: string;
  preflight_command: string;
  upgrade_command: string;
  verify_command: string;
  repair_command: string;
  source_label: string;
  published_release: boolean;
  release_url: string;
  release_notes_url: string;
  checksum: string;
  install_command: string;
  advanced_manual_command: string;
  setup_summary: string;
  verify_summary: string;
  next_step_summary: string;
  mode_label: string;
}

export type WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode = "agent" | "cloudflare_tunnel";

export interface WatchtowerAgentEnrollmentCommandOptions {
  enrollmentToken: string;
  enrollUrl: string;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  bindAddress?: string;
  dockerSocketPath?: string;
  release?: WatchtowerAgentRelease;
}

export interface WatchtowerAgentInstallCommandOptions {
  agentApiKey: string;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  bindAddress?: string;
  dockerSocketPath?: string;
  release?: WatchtowerAgentRelease;
}

export type WatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus =
  | "pending"
  | "update_required"
  | "verification_required"
  | "current";

export interface WatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy {
  dialogDescription: string;
  statusPending: string;
  statusCurrent: string;
  statusUpdateRequired: string;
  statusVerificationRequired: string;
  sourcePrefix: string;
  sourceNotice: string | null;
  preflightCommandLabel: string;
  upgradeCommandLabel: string;
  verifyCommandLabel: string;
  repairCommandLabel: string;
  pendingSummary: string;
  outdatedSummary: (installedVersion: string, latestVersion: string) => string;
  verificationSummary: string;
  supportInstructions: string;
}

const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_OWNER = "MNDL-27";
const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_REPO = "docker-watchtower-dash";
const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_SOURCE_REF = "a788b98d70d3d8b9a342b32f28eef365e7ccde3d";
const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_APP_BASE_URL = "https://app.dockerdash.app";

export const CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE: WatchtowerAgentRelease = {
  version: "1.0.8",
  tag: "v1.0.8",
  sourceLabel: "Dockerdash hosted installer",
  published: false,
  releaseUrl: `${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_APP_BASE_URL}/watchtower-agent-install.sh?v=1.0.8`,
  releaseNotesUrl: `https://github.com/${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_OWNER}/${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_REPO}/commit/${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_SOURCE_REF}`,
  assetBaseUrl: WATCHTOWER_AGENT_APP_BASE_URL,
  installerAssetName: "watchtower-agent-install.sh",
  runtimeAssetName: "watchtower-agent.sh",
  uninstallAssetName: "watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh",
  installerSha256: "A72CF3E6C7E468D4612D1169DC6C991C1C74982D113608A9CD039E9AD82E71EF",
  runtimeSha256: "008F565C3E9E4533AE54E42C075CD1912AC1AF57737BA271E1A5E9C1A234B032",
  uninstallSha256: "449AFC5FF62742AF0FF15254827E82F120BDD17694C43500C08FAF9926D0985C",
};

function buildAtomicInstallerCommand({
  release,
  action,
  extraArgs = "",
}: {
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease;
  action: "check" | "install";
  extraArgs?: string;
}) {
  const installerUrl = buildWatchtowerAgentAssetUrl(release.installerAssetName, release);
  const baseArgs = action === "check" ? `--check --expected-version "${release.version}"` : `--expected-version "${release.version}"`;
  const actionArgs = `${baseArgs}${extraArgs ? ` ${extraArgs.trim()}` : ""}`;

  return `( set -euo pipefail
INSTALLER_URL="${installerUrl}"
EXPECTED_INSTALLER_SHA256="${release.installerSha256}"
TMP_FILE="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$TMP_FILE"' EXIT

echo "Downloading Dockerdash installer..."
curl -fsSL "$INSTALLER_URL" -o "$TMP_FILE"

echo "Verifying installer..."
ACTUAL_INSTALLER_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$TMP_FILE" | awk '{print toupper($1)}')"
if [ "$ACTUAL_INSTALLER_SHA256" != "$EXPECTED_INSTALLER_SHA256" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Installer verification failed." >&2
  echo "Expected SHA256: $EXPECTED_INSTALLER_SHA256" >&2
  echo "Actual SHA256:   $ACTUAL_INSTALLER_SHA256" >&2
  echo "Refresh Dockerdash, copy a fresh command, and try again." >&2
  exit 1
fi

chmod +x "$TMP_FILE"
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
  "$TMP_FILE" ${actionArgs}
else
  sudo "$TMP_FILE" ${actionArgs}
fi )`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand(
  _release?: WatchtowerAgentRelease,
) {
  return "sudo watchtower-agent-update --check";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(
  _release?: WatchtowerAgentRelease,
) {
  return "sudo watchtower-agent-update";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentAssetUrl(
  assetName: string,
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  return `${release.assetBaseUrl}/${assetName}?v=${encodeURIComponent(release.version)}`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentInstallCommand(
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  return buildAtomicInstallerCommand({ release, action: "install" });
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? "0.0.0.0" : "0.0.0.0";
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentModeLabel(
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? "Agent via Cloudflare Tunnel" : "Agent (Direct)";
}

function buildInstallerExtraArgs({
  connectionMode,
  bindAddress,
  dockerSocketPath,
}: {
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  bindAddress?: string;
  dockerSocketPath?: string;
}) {
  const args: string[] = [`--connection-mode "${connectionMode}"`];

  if (bindAddress) {
    args.push(`--bind-address "${bindAddress}"`);
  }

  if (dockerSocketPath && dockerSocketPath !== "/var/run/docker.sock") {
    args.push(`--docker-socket "${dockerSocketPath}"`);
  }

  return args.join(" ");
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentEnrollmentInstallCommand({
  enrollmentToken,
  enrollUrl,
  connectionMode,
  bindAddress = getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(connectionMode),
  dockerSocketPath = "/var/run/docker.sock",
  release = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
}: WatchtowerAgentEnrollmentCommandOptions) {
  const extraArgs = [
    `--enrollment-token "${enrollmentToken}"`,
    `--enroll-url "${enrollUrl}"`,
    buildInstallerExtraArgs({ connectionMode, bindAddress, dockerSocketPath }),
  ].join(" ");

  return buildAtomicInstallerCommand({
    release,
    action: "install",
    extraArgs,
  });
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({
  agentApiKey,
  connectionMode,
  bindAddress = getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(connectionMode),
  dockerSocketPath = "/var/run/docker.sock",
  release = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
}: WatchtowerAgentInstallCommandOptions) {
  const extraArgs = [
    `--api-key "${agentApiKey}"`,
    buildInstallerExtraArgs({ connectionMode, bindAddress, dockerSocketPath }),
  ].join(" ");

  return buildAtomicInstallerCommand({
    release,
    action: "install",
    extraArgs,
  });
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand(agentApiKeyPlaceholder = "<agent-api-key>") {
  return `curl -i http://127.0.0.1:9876/agent/version
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:9876/metrics -H "X-Agent-Key: ${agentApiKeyPlaceholder}"`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand() {
  return `sudo bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
source /etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env
curl -i "http://\${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS}:\${AGENT_PORT}/agent/version"
curl -i "http://\${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS}:\${AGENT_PORT}/metrics" -H "X-Agent-Key: \${AGENT_API_KEY}"'`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentSetupSummary(connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel"
    ? "Install the agent locally, keep it on localhost, then route traffic through your Cloudflare Tunnel."
    : "Install the agent on the host, expose it behind HTTPS, then finish the connection test in Dockerdash.";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentVerifySummary(connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel"
    ? "Verify the local agent first, then confirm your tunnel hostname forwards to the same local service."
    : "Verify the local agent first, then confirm your public HTTPS endpoint reaches the same local service.";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentNextStepSummary(connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel"
    ? "After the local verify passes, return to Dockerdash and click Finish setup to test the tunnel URL."
    : "After the local verify passes, return to Dockerdash and click Finish setup to test the HTTPS agent URL.";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand(
  agentApiKeyPlaceholder = "<agent-api-key>",
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  return `${buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(release)}

${buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand(agentApiKeyPlaceholder)}`;
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus(options: {
  installedVersion?: string | null;
  capabilityGap?: boolean;
}): WatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus {
  const { installedVersion, capabilityGap = false } = options;
  if (!installedVersion) {
    return "pending";
  }
  if (isAgentVersionOutdated(installedVersion)) {
    return "update_required";
  }
  if (capabilityGap) {
    return "verification_required";
  }
  return "current";
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy(
  status: WatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus,
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return {
        title: "Version pending",
        description: `The host is reachable, but it has not reported agent version ${release.version} yet. Run Preflight, then Update.`,
      };
    case "update_required":
      return {
        title: "Update required",
        description: `Agent is behind ${release.version}. Run Preflight, Update, then Verify.`,
      };
    case "verification_required":
      return {
        title: "Verification required",
        description: "The current agent version is installed, but uptime and per-disk metrics still need to be confirmed. Run Verify or Troubleshoot / Repair.",
      };
    case "current":
    default:
      return {
        title: "Current",
        description: `Agent ${release.version} is current and the capability checks look healthy.`,
      };
  }
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy(
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
): WatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy {
  return {
    dialogDescription: "Run the updater command directly on the host. The dashboard does not execute privileged commands remotely.",
    statusPending: "Version pending",
    statusCurrent: "Current",
    statusUpdateRequired: "Update required",
    statusVerificationRequired: "Verification required",
    sourcePrefix: "Source:",
    sourceNotice: release.published
      ? null
      : "This command currently uses the Dockerdash-hosted installer asset instead of a published GitHub release bundle.",
    preflightCommandLabel: "Preflight",
    upgradeCommandLabel: "Update",
    verifyCommandLabel: "Verify",
    repairCommandLabel: "Troubleshoot / Repair",
    verificationSummary: "Current version is installed, but the host still needs capability verification for uptime and disk details.",
    outdatedSummary: (installedVersion: string, latestVersion: string) =>
      `Agent ${installedVersion} is behind ${latestVersion}.`,
    pendingSummary: "This host has not reported an installed agent version yet.",
    supportInstructions:
      "Running the updater preserves the stored config in /etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env. If the host still fails after Update, run Verify and inspect sudo journalctl -u watchtower-agent -n 50 before retrying Troubleshoot / Repair.",
  };
}

export function isAgentVersionOutdated(agentVersion: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!agentVersion) {
    return false;
  }

  const agentParts = agentVersion.trim().replace(/^v/, '').split('.').map(Number);
  const currentParts = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version.replace(/^v/, '').split('.').map(Number);

  for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(agentParts.length, currentParts.length); i++) {
    const a = agentParts[i] || 0;
    const c = currentParts[i] || 0;
    if (a < c) return true;
    if (a > c) return false;
  }

  return false;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(
  installedAgentVersion: string | null | undefined,
  capabilityGap = false,
): WatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse {
  const agentUpdateStatus = getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus({
    installedVersion: installedAgentVersion,
    capabilityGap,
  });
  return {
    latest_agent_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version,
    agent_update_available: agentUpdateStatus === "update_required",
    agent_update_status: agentUpdateStatus,
    current_agent_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version,
    preflight_command: buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    upgrade_command: buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    verify_command: buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand(),
    repair_command: buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand("<agent-api-key>", CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    source_label: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.sourceLabel,
    published_release: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.published,
    release_url: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.releaseUrl,
    release_notes_url: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.releaseNotesUrl,
    checksum: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.installerSha256,
    install_command: buildWatchtowerAgentInstallCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    advanced_manual_command: buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({
      agentApiKey: "<agent-api-key>",
      connectionMode: "agent",
      release: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
    }),
    setup_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentSetupSummary("agent"),
    verify_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentVerifySummary("agent"),
    next_step_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentNextStepSummary("agent"),
    mode_label: getWatchtowerAgentModeLabel("agent"),
  };
}
</file>

              type="datetime-local"
              onChange={(event) =>
                setBillingForm((current) => ({
                  ...current,
                  current_period_ends_at: event.target.value ? new Date(event.target.value).toISOString() : null,
                }))
              }
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Cancel at period end</Label>
            <Select
              value={String(
                billingForm.cancel_at_period_end ?? selectedBillingOrganization?.cancel_at_period_end ?? false,
              )}
              onValueChange={(value) => setBillingForm((current) => ({ ...current, cancel_at_period_end: value === "true" }))}
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="false">false</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="true">true</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label>Reason</Label>
          <Textarea
            value={billingForm.reason}
            onChange={(event) => setBillingForm((current) => ({ ...current, reason: event.target.value }))}
            placeholder="Required audit reason"
          />
        </div>
        <Button
          disabled={billingMutation.isPending || !selectedBillingOrganizationId || !billingForm.reason.trim()}
          onClick={async () => {
            try {
              await billingMutation.mutateAsync({ organizationId: selectedBillingOrganizationId!, values: billingForm });
              toast({ title: "Billing mirror updated" });
              setBillingForm({ reason: "" });
            } catch (error) {
              toast({
                title: "Billing update failed",
                description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
                variant: "destructive",
              });
            }
          }}
        >
          {billingMutation.isPending ? (
            <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <CheckCircle2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          )}
          Save billing override
        </Button>

        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-border space-y-3">
          <h4 className="font-medium">Manual donor reconciliation (DNR-8)</h4>
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Unmatched event</Label>
              <Select
                value={billingMatchForm.billing_event_id || "none"}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setBillingMatchForm((current) => ({ ...current, billing_event_id: value === "none" ? "" : value }))
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select unmatched event" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="none">Select unmatched event</SelectItem>
                  {(unmatchedBillingQuery.data ?? []).map((event: AdminBillingEvent) => (
                    <SelectItem key={event.id} value={event.id}>
                      {event.provider} · {event.provider_event_id ?? event.id.slice(0, 8)}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <div className="max-h-32 overflow-auto rounded-md border border-border p-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
                {(unmatchedBillingQuery.data ?? []).slice(0, 6).map((event: AdminBillingEvent) => (
                  <div key={`preview-${event.id}`} className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="truncate">{event.provider_event_id ?? event.id.slice(0, 8)}</span>
                    <span>
                      {event.amount ?? "—"} {event.currency ?? ""}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {(unmatchedBillingQuery.data ?? []).length === 0 ? <div>No unmatched events</div> : null}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Grant days</Label>
              <Input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={365}
                value={billingMatchForm.grant_days}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setBillingMatchForm((current) => ({ ...current, grant_days: Number(event.target.value || 30) }))
                }
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Reason</Label>
            <Textarea
              value={billingMatchForm.reason}
              onChange={(event) => setBillingMatchForm((current) => ({ ...current, reason: event.target.value }))}
              placeholder="Verified on PayPal/Liberapay dashboard"
            />
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            disabled={
              matchBillingMutation.isPending ||
              !billingMatchForm.billing_event_id ||
              !selectedBillingOrganizationId ||
              !billingMatchForm.reason.trim()
            }
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                await matchBillingMutation.mutateAsync({
                  billing_event_id: billingMatchForm.billing_event_id,
                  organization_id: selectedBillingOrganizationId!,
                  reason: billingMatchForm.reason,
                  grant_days: billingMatchForm.grant_days,
                });
                toast({ title: "Donor premium granted" });
                setBillingMatchForm({ billing_event_id: "", grant_days: 30, reason: "" });
              } catch (error) {
                toast({
                  title: "Donor match failed",
                  description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
                  variant: "destructive",
                });
              }
            }}
          >
            {matchBillingMutation.isPending ? (
              <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <CheckCircle2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            )}
            Match event & grant premium
          </Button>

          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-border space-y-3">
            <h4 className="font-medium">Donor email delivery history</h4>
            <div className="max-h-64 overflow-auto rounded-md border border-border">
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Sent</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Template</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Organization</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Recipient</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {(donorEmailDeliveriesQuery.data ?? []).slice(0, 12).map((delivery: AdminDonorEmailDelivery) => (
                    <TableRow
                      key={delivery.id}
                      className={selectedDeliveryId === delivery.id ? "bg-muted/40" : ""}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedDeliveryId(delivery.id)}
                    >
                      <TableCell>{formatDate(delivery.sent_at)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{delivery.template}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="max-w-[180px] truncate">{delivery.organization_name}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="max-w-[220px] truncate">{delivery.recipient_email}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <StatusPill active={delivery.status === "sent" || delivery.status === "resent"} label={delivery.status} />
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                  {(donorEmailDeliveriesQuery.data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell colSpan={5} className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        No donor emails sent yet
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ) : null}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>

            {selectedDeliveryId && donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data ? (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <h5 className="font-medium">Delivery details</h5>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      Inspect provider message ID, errors, and metadata before retrying.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <StatusPill
                    active={
                      donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.status === "sent" ||
                      donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.status === "resent"
                    }
                    label={donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.status}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <DetailField label="Organization" value={donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.organization_name} />
                  <DetailField label="Recipient" value={donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.recipient_email} />
                  <DetailField label="Template" value={donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.template} />
                  <DetailField label="Provider" value={donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.provider} />
                  <DetailField label="Provider Message ID" value={donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.provider_message_id} />
                  <DetailField label="Sent" value={formatDate(donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.sent_at)} />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Error</Label>
                  <div className="rounded-md border border-border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.error || "No provider error recorded"}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Metadata</Label>
                  <pre className="max-h-56 overflow-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs">
                    {JSON.stringify(donorEmailDeliveryDetailQuery.data.metadata, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Retry reason</Label>
                  <Textarea
                    value={resendReason}
                    onChange={(event) => setResendReason(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Why are you retrying this email?"
                  />
                </div>

                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  disabled={resendDonorEmailMutation.isPending || !resendReason.trim()}
                  onClick={async () => {
                    try {
                      await resendDonorEmailMutation.mutateAsync({
                        deliveryId: selectedDeliveryId,
                        reason: resendReason.trim(),
                      });
                      toast({ title: "Donor email retried" });
                      setResendReason("");
                    } catch (error) {
                      toast({
                        title: "Retry failed",
                        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
                        variant: "destructive",
                      });
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  {resendDonorEmailMutation.isPending ? (
                    <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <RefreshCcw className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                  )}
                  Retry send with Resend
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/admin/AdminHostManagement.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useAdminHosts,
  useQuarantineAdminHost,
  useUnquarantineAdminHost,
  useMarkAdminHostNeedsReconnect,
} from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { StatusPill, formatDate, filterByQuery, AdminActionDialog } from "./AdminShared";
import type { AdminHostRow } from "@/types/admin";
import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";

export function AdminHostManagement() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [hostQuery, setHostQuery] = useState("");
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | {
    kind: string;
    targetId: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    confirmLabel: string;
  }>(null);

  const hostsQuery = useAdminHosts();
  const quarantineMutation = useQuarantineAdminHost();
  const unquarantineMutation = useUnquarantineAdminHost();
  const reconnectMutation = useMarkAdminHostNeedsReconnect();

  const hosts = filterByQuery(hostsQuery.data ?? [], hostQuery, [
    "name",
    "organization_name",
    "host_url",
    "status",
  ]) as AdminHostRow[];

  const pendingDialogSubmitting =
    quarantineMutation.isPending || unquarantineMutation.isPending || reconnectMutation.isPending;

  const runAction = async (reason: string) => {
    if (!pendingAction) return;
    try {
      switch (pendingAction.kind) {
        case "quarantine-host":
          await quarantineMutation.mutateAsync({ hostId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "unquarantine-host":
          await unquarantineMutation.mutateAsync({ hostId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "mark-needs-reconnect":
          await reconnectMutation.mutateAsync({ hostId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
      }
      toast({ title: "Admin action completed" });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Admin action failed",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="border-b border-border p-4">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              value={hostQuery}
              onChange={(event) => setHostQuery(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search hosts"
              className="pl-9"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Host</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Organization</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Last Seen</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {hosts.map((host) => (
              <TableRow key={host.id}>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="font-medium">{host.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{host.host_url}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{host.organization_name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <StatusPill
                      active={!host.is_quarantined}
                      label={host.is_quarantined ? "Quarantined" : host.status}
                    />
                    {host.needs_reconnect ? <Badge variant="outline">Needs reconnect</Badge> : null}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDate(host.last_seen_at)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setPendingAction({
                          kind: host.is_quarantined ? "unquarantine-host" : "quarantine-host",
                          targetId: host.id,
                          title: host.is_quarantined ? "Unquarantine host" : "Quarantine host",
                          description: "Quarantined hosts are blocked from proxy and control operations.",
                          confirmLabel: host.is_quarantined ? "Unquarantine" : "Quarantine",
                        })
                      }
                    >
                      {host.is_quarantined ? "Unquarantine" : "Quarantine"}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setPendingAction({
                          kind: "mark-needs-reconnect",
                          targetId: host.id,
                          title: "Mark host as needs reconnect",
                          description:
                            "Use this when the host should be surfaced to support or tenant owners as requiring attention.",
                          confirmLabel: "Mark needs reconnect",
                        })
                      }
                    >
                      Mark Needs Reconnect
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      <AdminActionDialog
        open={Boolean(pendingAction)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPendingAction(null);
        }}
        title={pendingAction?.title ?? ""}
        description={pendingAction?.description ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={pendingAction?.confirmLabel ?? "Confirm"}
        submitting={pendingDialogSubmitting}
        onConfirm={runAction}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/admin/AdminNotifications.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { format } from "date-fns";
import { Trash2, Plus, BellRing } from "lucide-react";

import { useAdminNotifications, useCreateAdminNotification, useDeleteAdminNotification } from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { StatusPill } from "./AdminShared";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function AdminNotifications() {
  const { data: notifications, isLoading } = useAdminNotifications();
  const createMutation = useCreateAdminNotification();
  const deleteMutation = useDeleteAdminNotification();
  
  const [isCreateOpen, setIsCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState("info");
  const [link, setLink] = useState("");
  const [organizationId, setOrganizationId] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!title || !message || !reason) {
      toast.error("Please fill in all required fields (title, message, reason)");
      return;
    }

    try {
      await createMutation.mutateAsync({
        title,
        message,
        type,
        link: link || null,
        organizationId: organizationId || null,
        reason,
      });
      toast.success("Notification created successfully");
      setIsCreateOpen(false);
      setTitle("");
      setMessage("");
      setLink("");
      setOrganizationId("");
      setReason("");
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || "Failed to create notification");
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    const reasonForDeletion = window.prompt("Reason for deleting this notification:");
    if (!reasonForDeletion) return;

    try {
      await deleteMutation.mutateAsync({ id, reason: reasonForDeletion });
      toast.success("Notification deleted successfully");
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || "Failed to delete notification");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-medium">Global Notifications</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Push notifications to all users or specific organizations</p>
        </div>
        
        <Dialog open={isCreateOpen} onOpenChange={setIsCreateOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button size="sm">
              <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              New Notification
            </Button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>Create Notification</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                Push a new notification to users. Leave Organization ID empty for a global notification.
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="grid gap-4 py-4">
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Title *</Label>
                <Input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="E.g., Scheduled Maintenance" />
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Message *</Label>
                <Textarea value={message} onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)} placeholder="Details about the notification..." />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="grid gap-2">
                  <Label>Type</Label>
                  <Select value={type} onValueChange={setType}>
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="info">Info</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="warning">Warning</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="error">Error</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="success">Success</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="grid gap-2">
                  <Label>Organization ID (Optional)</Label>
                  <Input value={organizationId} onChange={(e) => setOrganizationId(e.target.value)} placeholder="org_..." />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Link URL (Optional)</Label>
                <Input value={link} onChange={(e) => setLink(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://..." />
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Reason for Audit Log *</Label>
                <Input value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} placeholder="Why is this being sent?" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsCreateOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button onClick={handleCreate} disabled={createMutation.isPending || !title || !message || !reason}>
                {createMutation.isPending ? "Creating..." : "Create Notification"}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[200px]">Title</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Message</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Scope</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Stats</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {isLoading ? (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={7} className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  Loading notifications...
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : notifications?.length === 0 ? (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={7} className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  No active notifications found.
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : (
              notifications?.map((notification) => (
                <TableRow key={notification.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <StatusPill 
                      label={notification.type} 
                      active={notification.type === 'info' || notification.type === 'success'} 
                      variant={notification.type === 'error' ? 'destructive' : notification.type === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'default'}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium truncate max-w-[200px]">{notification.title}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="truncate max-w-[300px]" title={notification.message}>{notification.message}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    {notification.organization_id ? (
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono bg-muted px-2 py-1 rounded">Org: {notification.organization_id.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/10 px-2 py-1 rounded">Global</span>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex items-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <BellRing className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      {notification.dismiss_count || 0} dismissals
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <div>{format(new Date(notification.created_at), "MMM d, yyyy")}</div>
                    <div>by {notification.created_by_email || 'System'}</div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">
                    <Button 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(notification.id)}
                      disabled={deleteMutation.isPending}
                      className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))
            )}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/admin/AdminOperations.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRightLeft, Loader2, Shield } from "lucide-react";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useAdminOrganizations,
  useAdminHosts,
  useAdminOperations,
  useRunAdminSecretMigration,
} from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { StatusPill, formatDate } from "./AdminShared";

export function AdminOperations() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [migrationScope, setMigrationScope] = useState<{
    organization_id?: string;
    host_id?: string;
    dry_run?: boolean;
  }>({});
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");

  const organizationsQuery = useAdminOrganizations();
  const hostsQuery = useAdminHosts();
  const operationsQuery = useAdminOperations();
  const migrateSecretsMutation = useRunAdminSecretMigration();

  const handleRunMigration = async () => {
    try {
      await migrateSecretsMutation.mutateAsync({ ...migrationScope, reason });
      toast({ title: "Migration operation recorded" });
      setReason("");
      setMigrationScope({});
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Migration failed",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]">
      <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-2">
            <ArrowRightLeft className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-medium">Secret migration</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Re-encrypt Docker host secrets with the active backend key, globally or against a specific org or host.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Organization scope</Label>
            <Select
              value={migrationScope.organization_id ?? "all"}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                setMigrationScope((current) => ({ ...current, organization_id: value === "all" ? undefined : value }))
              }
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All organizations</SelectItem>
                {(organizationsQuery.data ?? []).map((organization) => (
                  <SelectItem key={organization.id} value={organization.id}>
                    {organization.name}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Host scope</Label>
            <Select
              value={migrationScope.host_id ?? "all"}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                setMigrationScope((current) => ({ ...current, host_id: value === "all" ? undefined : value }))
              }
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All hosts</SelectItem>
                {(hostsQuery.data ?? []).map((host) => (
                  <SelectItem key={host.id} value={host.id}>
                    {host.name} ({host.organization_name})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Reason</Label>
            <Textarea
              value={reason}
              onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Why this maintenance run is needed"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setMigrationScope((current) => ({ ...current, dry_run: !current.dry_run }))}
            >
              {migrationScope.dry_run ? "Disable dry run" : "Dry run next"}
            </Button>
            <Button disabled={migrateSecretsMutation.isPending || !reason.trim()} onClick={handleRunMigration}>
              {migrateSecretsMutation.isPending ? (
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Shield className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              )}
              Run migration
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card p-5">
        <h3 className="mb-4 font-medium">Operation history</h3>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Operation</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Scope</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {(operationsQuery.data ?? []).map((item) => (
              <TableRow key={item.id}>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="font-medium">{item.operation_name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.reason}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <StatusPill active={!item.status.includes("error")} label={item.status} />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {item.scope_type ?? "global"}
                  {item.scope_id ? `:${item.scope_id}` : ""}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDate(item.created_at)}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/admin/AdminOrganizationManagement.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Search, Loader2, Lock, RefreshCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useAdminOrganizations,
  useAdminOrganization,
  useLockAdminOrganization,
  useUnlockAdminOrganization,
  useResetAdminOnboarding,
} from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { StatusPill, DetailField, formatDate, filterByQuery, AdminActionDialog } from "./AdminShared";
import type { AdminOrganizationRow } from "@/types/admin";

export function AdminOrganizationManagement() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [organizationQuery, setOrganizationQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedOrganizationId, setSelectedOrganizationId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | {
    kind: string;
    targetId: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    confirmLabel: string;
  }>(null);

  const organizationsQuery = useAdminOrganizations();
  const organizationDetailQuery = useAdminOrganization(selectedOrganizationId);

  const lockOrgMutation = useLockAdminOrganization();
  const unlockOrgMutation = useUnlockAdminOrganization();
  const resetOnboardingMutation = useResetAdminOnboarding();

  const organizations = filterByQuery(organizationsQuery.data ?? [], organizationQuery, [
    "name",
    "slug",
    "plan",
    "subscription_status",
  ]) as AdminOrganizationRow[];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedOrganizationId && organizationsQuery.data?.[0]) setSelectedOrganizationId(organizationsQuery.data[0].id);
  }, [organizationsQuery.data, selectedOrganizationId]);

  const pendingDialogSubmitting =
    lockOrgMutation.isPending || unlockOrgMutation.isPending || resetOnboardingMutation.isPending;

  const runAction = async (reason: string) => {
    if (!pendingAction) return;
    try {
      switch (pendingAction.kind) {
        case "lock-organization":
          await lockOrgMutation.mutateAsync({ organizationId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "unlock-organization":
          await unlockOrgMutation.mutateAsync({ organizationId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "reset-onboarding":
          await resetOnboardingMutation.mutateAsync({ organizationId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
      }
      toast({ title: "Admin action completed" });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Admin action failed",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="border-b border-border p-4">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              value={organizationQuery}
              onChange={(event) => setOrganizationQuery(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search organizations"
              className="pl-9"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Organization</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Plan</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Members</TableHead>
              <TableHead>State</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {organizations.map((organization) => (
              <TableRow
                key={organization.id}
                className={selectedOrganizationId === organization.id ? "bg-muted/40" : ""}
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrganizationId(organization.id)}
              >
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="font-medium">{organization.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{organization.slug}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{organization.plan}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{organization.member_count}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <StatusPill active={!organization.is_locked} label={organization.is_locked ? "Locked" : "Open"} />
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card p-5">
        {organizationDetailQuery.isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex min-h-64 items-center justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : organizationDetailQuery.data ? (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{organizationDetailQuery.data.name}</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{organizationDetailQuery.data.slug}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <DetailField label="Plan" value={organizationDetailQuery.data.plan} />
              <DetailField label="Subscription" value={organizationDetailQuery.data.subscription_status} />
              <DetailField label="Current Period End" value={formatDate(organizationDetailQuery.data.current_period_ends_at)} />
              <DetailField label="Onboarding" value={organizationDetailQuery.data.onboarding_status} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={organizationDetailQuery.data.is_locked ? "outline" : "destructive"}
                onClick={() =>
                  setPendingAction({
                    kind: organizationDetailQuery.data!.is_locked ? "unlock-organization" : "lock-organization",
                    targetId: organizationDetailQuery.data!.id,
                    title: organizationDetailQuery.data!.is_locked ? "Unlock organization" : "Lock organization",
                    description: "Locked organizations remain visible but tenant write actions are blocked.",
                    confirmLabel: organizationDetailQuery.data!.is_locked ? "Unlock" : "Lock",
                  })
                }
              >
                <Lock className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                {organizationDetailQuery.data.is_locked ? "Unlock" : "Lock"}
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() =>
                  setPendingAction({
                    kind: "reset-onboarding",
                    targetId: organizationDetailQuery.data!.id,
                    title: "Reset onboarding",
                    description: "This forces the organization back into onboarding state.",
                    confirmLabel: "Reset onboarding",
                  })
                }
              >
                <RefreshCcw className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                Reset Onboarding
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Select an organization to inspect platform controls.</div>
        )}
      </div>

      <AdminActionDialog
        open={Boolean(pendingAction)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPendingAction(null);
        }}
        title={pendingAction?.title ?? ""}
        description={pendingAction?.description ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={pendingAction?.confirmLabel ?? "Confirm"}
        submitting={pendingDialogSubmitting}
        onConfirm={runAction}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/admin/AdminOverview.tsx">

                  {item.scope_type ?? "global"}
                  {item.scope_id ? `:${item.scope_id}` : ""}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="max-w-[420px] truncate">{item.reason}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDate(item.created_at)}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}

        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
