<file path="src/components/admin/AdminShared.tsx">
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function formatDate(value: string | null | undefined) {
  if (!value) return "Never";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleString();
}

export function filterByQuery<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(rows: T[], query: string, keys: Array<keyof T>) {
  const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!normalized) return rows;
  return rows.filter((row) =>
    keys.some((key) => String(row[key] ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(normalized)),
  );
}

export function DetailField({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | number | null | undefined }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <div className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
      <div className="text-sm">{value ?? "—"}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StatusPill({ active, label, variant }: { active: boolean; label: string; variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "destructive" | "outline" | "warning" }) {
  return <Badge variant={variant || (active ? "default" : "outline")}>{label}</Badge>;
}

export function AdminActionDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  title,
  description,
  confirmLabel,
  confirmValue,
  requireTypedConfirm = false,
  submitting,
  onConfirm,
  extra,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
  confirmValue?: string;
  requireTypedConfirm?: boolean;
  submitting?: boolean;
  onConfirm: (reason: string) => Promise<void>;
  extra?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [typedValue, setTypedValue] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setReason("");
      setTypedValue("");
    }
  }, [open]);

  const typedOk = !requireTypedConfirm || !confirmValue || typedValue === confirmValue;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{title}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{description}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {extra}
          {requireTypedConfirm && confirmValue ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="typed-confirm">Type <span className="font-mono">{confirmValue}</span> to confirm</Label>
              <Input id="typed-confirm" value={typedValue} onChange={(event) => setTypedValue(event.target.value)} />
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="admin-reason">Reason</Label>
            <Textarea id="admin-reason" value={reason} onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)} placeholder="Required audit reason" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button
            disabled={submitting || !reason.trim() || !typedOk}
            onClick={async () => {
              await onConfirm(reason.trim());
              onOpenChange(false);
            }}
          >
            {submitting ? "Running..." : confirmLabel}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/admin/AdminUserManagement.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Search, Loader2, UserCheck, Ban, Shield } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useAdminUsers,
  useAdminUser,
  useApproveAdminUser,
  useRevokeAdminUserApproval,
  useSuspendAdminUser,
  useUnsuspendAdminUser,
  useHardDisableAdminUser,
  useHardEnableAdminUser,
  useAddAdminOrgBan,
} from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { StatusPill, DetailField, formatDate, filterByQuery, AdminActionDialog } from "./AdminShared";
import type { AdminUserRow } from "@/types/admin";

export function AdminUserManagement() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [userQuery, setUserQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedUserId, setSelectedUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [banOrganizationId, setBanOrganizationId] = useState("");
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | {
    kind: string;
    targetId: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    confirmLabel: string;
    confirmValue?: string;
  }>(null);

  const usersQuery = useAdminUsers();
  const userDetailQuery = useAdminUser(selectedUserId);

  const approveMutation = useApproveAdminUser();
  const revokeApprovalMutation = useRevokeAdminUserApproval();
  const suspendMutation = useSuspendAdminUser();
  const unsuspendMutation = useUnsuspendAdminUser();
  const hardDisableMutation = useHardDisableAdminUser();
  const hardEnableMutation = useHardEnableAdminUser();
  const addOrgBanMutation = useAddAdminOrgBan();

  const users = filterByQuery(usersQuery.data ?? [], userQuery, ["email", "full_name"]) as AdminUserRow[];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedUserId && usersQuery.data?.[0]) setSelectedUserId(usersQuery.data[0].id);
  }, [selectedUserId, usersQuery.data]);

  const pendingDialogSubmitting =
    approveMutation.isPending ||
    revokeApprovalMutation.isPending ||
    suspendMutation.isPending ||
    unsuspendMutation.isPending ||
    hardDisableMutation.isPending ||
    hardEnableMutation.isPending ||
    addOrgBanMutation.isPending;

  const runAction = async (reason: string) => {
    if (!pendingAction) return;
    try {
      switch (pendingAction.kind) {
        case "approve-user":
          await approveMutation.mutateAsync({ userId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "revoke-approval":
          await revokeApprovalMutation.mutateAsync({ userId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "suspend-user":
          await suspendMutation.mutateAsync({ userId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "unsuspend-user":
          await unsuspendMutation.mutateAsync({ userId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "hard-disable-user":
          await hardDisableMutation.mutateAsync({ userId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "hard-enable-user":
          await hardEnableMutation.mutateAsync({ userId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "add-org-ban":
          if (!banOrganizationId) throw new Error("Select an organization first.");
          await addOrgBanMutation.mutateAsync({
            userId: pendingAction.targetId,
            organizationId: banOrganizationId,
            reason,
          });
          break;
      }
      toast({ title: "Admin action completed" });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Admin action failed",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="border-b border-border p-4">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              value={userQuery}
              onChange={(event) => setUserQuery(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search users by name or email"
              className="pl-9"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>User</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Approval</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Access</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Orgs</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {users.map((user) => (
              <TableRow
                key={user.id}
                className={selectedUserId === user.id ? "bg-muted/40" : ""}
                onClick={() => setSelectedUserId(user.id)}
              >
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="font-medium">{user.full_name || user.email}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{user.email}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <StatusPill active={user.is_approved} label={user.is_approved ? "Approved" : "Pending"} />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <StatusPill
                    active={!user.is_suspended && !user.is_hard_disabled}
                    label={user.is_hard_disabled ? "Hard disabled" : user.is_suspended ? "Suspended" : "Active"}
                  />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{user.organization_count}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card p-5">
        {userDetailQuery.isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex min-h-64 items-center justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : userDetailQuery.data ? (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{userDetailQuery.data.full_name || userDetailQuery.data.email}</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{userDetailQuery.data.email}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <DetailField label="Approved" value={userDetailQuery.data.is_approved ? "Yes" : "No"} />
              <DetailField label="Created" value={formatDate(userDetailQuery.data.created_at)} />
              <DetailField label="Suspended" value={userDetailQuery.data.is_suspended ? "Yes" : "No"} />
              <DetailField label="Hard Disabled" value={userDetailQuery.data.is_hard_disabled ? "Yes" : "No"} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={userDetailQuery.data.is_approved ? "outline" : "default"}
                onClick={() =>
                  setPendingAction({
                    kind: userDetailQuery.data!.is_approved ? "revoke-approval" : "approve-user",
                    targetId: userDetailQuery.data!.id,
                    title: userDetailQuery.data!.is_approved ? "Revoke approval" : "Approve user",
                    description: "This changes whether the account can access tenant routes.",
                    confirmLabel: userDetailQuery.data!.is_approved ? "Revoke approval" : "Approve user",
                  })
                }
              >
                <UserCheck className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                {userDetailQuery.data.is_approved ? "Revoke Approval" : "Approve User"}
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() =>
                  setPendingAction({
                    kind: userDetailQuery.data!.is_suspended ? "unsuspend-user" : "suspend-user",
                    targetId: userDetailQuery.data!.id,
                    title: userDetailQuery.data!.is_suspended ? "Restore access" : "Suspend user",
                    description: "Soft suspension blocks product access but keeps the account intact.",
                    confirmLabel: userDetailQuery.data!.is_suspended ? "Restore access" : "Suspend user",
                  })
                }
              >
                <Ban className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                {userDetailQuery.data.is_suspended ? "Restore Access" : "Suspend"}
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={userDetailQuery.data.is_hard_disabled ? "outline" : "destructive"}
                onClick={() =>
                  setPendingAction({
                    kind: userDetailQuery.data!.is_hard_disabled ? "hard-enable-user" : "hard-disable-user",
                    targetId: userDetailQuery.data!.id,
                    title: userDetailQuery.data!.is_hard_disabled ? "Re-enable user" : "Hard disable user",
                    description: "Hard disable also locks and bans the Clerk user.",
                    confirmLabel: userDetailQuery.data!.is_hard_disabled ? "Re-enable" : "Hard disable",
                    confirmValue: userDetailQuery.data!.email,
                  })
                }
              >
                <Shield className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                {userDetailQuery.data.is_hard_disabled ? "Re-enable" : "Hard Disable"}
              </Button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Per-organization ban</Label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Select value={banOrganizationId} onValueChange={setBanOrganizationId}>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Choose organization" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {userDetailQuery.data.memberships.map((membership) => (
                      <SelectItem key={membership.organization_id} value={membership.organization_id}>
                        {membership.organization_name}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setPendingAction({
                      kind: "add-org-ban",
                      targetId: userDetailQuery.data!.id,
                      title: "Ban from organization",
                      description: "This blocks the user from one organization while leaving access elsewhere intact.",
                      confirmLabel: "Apply org ban",
                    })
                  }
                >
                  Add Ban
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Select a user to inspect and manage.</div>
        )}
      </div>

      <AdminActionDialog
        open={Boolean(pendingAction)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPendingAction(null);
        }}
        title={pendingAction?.title ?? ""}
        description={pendingAction?.description ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={pendingAction?.confirmLabel ?? "Confirm"}
        confirmValue={pendingAction?.confirmValue}
        requireTypedConfirm={Boolean(pendingAction?.confirmValue)}
        submitting={pendingDialogSubmitting}
        extra={
          pendingAction?.kind === "add-org-ban" ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Organization</Label>
              <Select value={banOrganizationId} onValueChange={setBanOrganizationId}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select organization" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {userDetailQuery.data?.memberships.map((membership) => (
                    <SelectItem key={membership.organization_id} value={membership.organization_id}>
                      {membership.organization_name}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          ) : undefined
        }
        onConfirm={runAction}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/alerts/ActiveAlertsTable.tsx">
import { Loader2, ShieldPlus } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import type { AlertEvent } from "@/types/database";

type AlertRow = AlertEvent & { href?: string };

function formatEventTime(value: string | null) {
  return value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString() : "Never";
}

function describeResource(alert: AlertRow) {
  const metadata = alert.metadata ?? {};
  const hostName = typeof metadata.host_name === "string" ? metadata.host_name : null;
  const containerName = typeof metadata.container_name === "string" ? metadata.container_name : null;

  if (containerName && hostName) return `${containerName} on ${hostName}`;
  if (hostName) return hostName;
  return alert.source_ref;
}

export function ActiveAlertsTable({
  alerts,
  canManage,
  onAcknowledge,
  onResolve,
  onCreateIncident,
  pendingId,
}: {
  alerts: AlertRow[];
  canManage: boolean;
  pendingId?: string | null;
  onAcknowledge: (id: string) => void;
  onResolve: (id: string) => void;
  onCreateIncident: (alert: AlertRow) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Active Alerts</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Persisted alert state with acknowledgement, resolution, and incident escalation.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow className="hover:bg-transparent">
            <TableHead>Alert</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Severity</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Affected Resource</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Last Seen</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {alerts.length === 0 ? (
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell colSpan={6} className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                No alerts match the current view.
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ) : (
            alerts.map((alert) => (
              <TableRow key={alert.id}>
                <TableCell className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="font-medium">{alert.title}</div>
                  <div className="max-w-xl text-xs text-muted-foreground">{alert.message}</div>
                  <Link to={alert.href || "/app/alerts"} className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline">
                    Open affected resource
                  </Link>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell><StatusBadge status={alert.severity} /></TableCell>
                <TableCell><StatusBadge status={alert.status} /></TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{describeResource(alert)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{formatEventTime(alert.last_seen_at)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">
                    {canManage ? (
                      <>
                        {alert.status === "open" ? (
                          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onAcknowledge(alert.id)} disabled={pendingId === alert.id}>
                            {pendingId === alert.id ? <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : null}
                            Acknowledge
                          </Button>
                        ) : null}
                        {alert.status !== "resolved" ? (
                          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onResolve(alert.id)} disabled={pendingId === alert.id}>
                            Resolve
                          </Button>
                        ) : null}
                        {!alert.incident_id ? (
                          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onCreateIncident(alert)} disabled={pendingId === alert.id}>
                            <ShieldPlus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            Incident
                          </Button>
                        ) : null}
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Read only</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))
          )}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/alerts/AlertHistoryFeed.tsx">
import { Clock3, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import type { AlertEvent, Incident } from "@/types/database";

export function AlertHistoryFeed({
  incidents,
  history,
}: {
  incidents: Incident[];
  history: Array<AlertEvent & { href?: string }>;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Recent Activity</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Incident creation and alert lifecycle history for the active organization.</p>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-0 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]">
        <div className="border-b border-border p-4 lg:border-b-0 lg:border-r">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
            <ShieldAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Open Incidents
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {incidents.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No incidents opened from alerts yet.</p>
            ) : (
              incidents.map((incident) => (
                <div key={incident.id} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/20 p-3">
                  <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="font-medium">{incident.title}</span>
                    <StatusBadge status={incident.status} />
                  </div>
                  {incident.summary ? <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{incident.summary}</p> : null}
                  <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Opened {new Date(incident.opened_at).toLocaleString()}</div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
            <Clock3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Alert History
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {history.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Alert history will appear here as signals are detected and resolved.</p>
            ) : (
              history.slice(0, 6).map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/20 p-3">
                  <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="font-medium">{item.title}</span>
                    <StatusBadge status={item.status} />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{item.message}</p>
                  <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <span>{new Date(item.updated_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    <Link to={item.href || "/app/alerts"} className="text-primary hover:underline">Open resource</Link>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/alerts/AlertRuleDialog.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import type { AlertRule } from "@/types/database";
import type { AlertConditionType, AlertRuleFormValues, AlertSeverity } from "@/types/alerts";

const CONDITION_OPTIONS: Array<{ value: AlertConditionType; label: string }> = [
  { value: "host_offline", label: "Host offline" },
  { value: "container_exited", label: "Container exited" },
  { value: "container_restart_loop", label: "Restart loop" },
  { value: "cpu_usage", label: "CPU threshold" },
  { value: "memory_usage", label: "Memory threshold" },
];

const SEVERITY_OPTIONS: AlertSeverity[] = ["info", "warning", "error", "critical"];
const CHANNEL_OPTIONS = ["slack", "email", "webhook"];

function toInitialValues(rule?: AlertRule | null): AlertRuleFormValues {
  return {
    name: rule?.name ?? "",
    condition_type: rule?.condition_type ?? "host_offline",
    threshold_value: rule?.threshold_value ?? null,
    threshold_window_minutes: rule?.threshold_window_minutes ?? 5,
    severity: rule?.severity ?? "warning",
    notification_channels: rule?.notification_channels ?? ["slack"],
    enabled: rule?.enabled ?? true,
  };
}

export function AlertRuleDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  rule,
  saving,
  slackDestinationsCount,
  webhookDestinationsCount,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  rule?: AlertRule | null;
  saving?: boolean;
  slackDestinationsCount?: number;
  webhookDestinationsCount?: number;
  onSubmit: (values: AlertRuleFormValues) => void;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<AlertRuleFormValues>(toInitialValues(rule));

  useEffect(() => {
    setValues(toInitialValues(rule));
  }, [rule, open]);

  const requiresThreshold = values.condition_type === "cpu_usage" || values.condition_type === "memory_usage";

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{rule ? "Edit alert rule" : "Create alert rule"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Rules are stored per organization and evaluated against connected hosts and containers.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid gap-4 py-2 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
            <Label htmlFor="rule-name">Rule name</Label>
            <Input id="rule-name" value={values.name} onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, name: event.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. High CPU usage" />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Condition</Label>
            <Select value={values.condition_type} onValueChange={(value) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, condition_type: value as AlertConditionType }))}>
              <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {CONDITION_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Severity</Label>
            <Select value={values.severity} onValueChange={(value) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, severity: value as AlertSeverity }))}>
              <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {SEVERITY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>{option}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="rule-window">Window (minutes)</Label>
            <Input
              id="rule-window"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              value={values.threshold_window_minutes}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, threshold_window_minutes: Math.max(1, Number(event.target.value) || 1) }))}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="rule-threshold">Threshold</Label>
            <Input
              id="rule-threshold"
              type="number"
              value={values.threshold_value ?? ""}
              disabled={!requiresThreshold}
              placeholder={requiresThreshold ? "85" : "Not required"}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({
                ...current,
                threshold_value: event.target.value === "" ? null : Number(event.target.value),
              }))}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
            <Label>Notification channels</Label>
            <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/30 p-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              {CHANNEL_OPTIONS.map((channel) => {
                const checked = values.notification_channels.includes(channel);
                return (
                  <label key={channel} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm capitalize">
                    <Checkbox
                      checked={checked}
                      onCheckedChange={(next) =>
                        setValues((current) => ({
                          ...current,
                          notification_channels: next
                            ? [...current.notification_channels, channel]
                            : current.notification_channels.filter((item) => item !== channel),
                        }))
                      }
                    />
                    {channel}
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            {values.notification_channels.includes("slack") && (slackDestinationsCount ?? 0) === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-warning">No Slack destinations are configured yet. Rules can still be saved, but Slack notifications won&apos;t be sent until Settings &gt; Notifications is configured.</p>
            ) : null}
            {values.notification_channels.includes("webhook") && (webhookDestinationsCount ?? 0) === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-warning">No webhook destinations are configured yet. Rules can still be saved, but deliveries won&apos;t be sent until Settings &gt; Webhooks is configured.</p>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-3 md:col-span-2">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Rule enabled</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disabled rules stay stored but won’t generate alerts.</p>
            </div>
            <Switch checked={values.enabled} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, enabled: checked }))} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => onSubmit(values)} disabled={saving || !values.name.trim() || values.notification_channels.length === 0}>
            {saving ? "Saving..." : rule ? "Save changes" : "Create rule"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/alerts/AlertRulesPanel.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { Plus, Settings2 } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import { AlertRuleDialog } from "@/components/alerts/AlertRuleDialog";
import type { AlertRule } from "@/types/database";
import type { AlertRuleFormValues } from "@/types/alerts";

function formatCondition(rule: AlertRule) {
  if (rule.condition_type === "cpu_usage") return `CPU > ${rule.threshold_value ?? 85}% for ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}m`;
  if (rule.condition_type === "memory_usage") return `Memory > ${rule.threshold_value ?? 90}% for ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}m`;
  if (rule.condition_type === "host_offline") return `Host state unhealthy for ${rule.threshold_window_minutes}m`;
  if (rule.condition_type === "container_exited") return "Container exit detected";
  return "Container restart loop detected";
}

export function AlertRulesPanel({
  rules,
  canManage,
  saving,
  slackDestinationsCount,
  webhookDestinationsCount,
  onCreate,
  onUpdate,
}: {
  rules: AlertRule[];
  canManage: boolean;
  saving?: boolean;
  slackDestinationsCount?: number;
  webhookDestinationsCount?: number;
  onCreate: (values: AlertRuleFormValues) => void;
  onUpdate: (ruleId: string, values: Partial<AlertRuleFormValues>) => void;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingRule, setEditingRule] = useState<AlertRule | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = (values: AlertRuleFormValues) => {
    if (editingRule) {
      onUpdate(editingRule.id, values);
    } else {
      onCreate(values);
    }
    setOpen(false);
    setEditingRule(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Alert Rules</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Organization-level rules for host health, container lifecycle, and resource thresholds.</p>
          </div>
          {canManage ? (
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setEditingRule(null); setOpen(true); }}>
              <Plus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Create rule
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="divide-y divide-border">
          {rules.map((rule) => (
            <div key={rule.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="font-medium">{rule.name}</span>
                  <StatusBadge status={rule.enabled ? "running" : "paused"} />
                  <StatusBadge status={rule.severity} />
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{formatCondition(rule)}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Channels: {rule.notification_channels.join(", ") || "none"}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {canManage ? (
                  <>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setEditingRule(rule); setOpen(true); }}>
                      <Settings2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Edit
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={saving} onClick={() => onUpdate(rule.id, { enabled: !rule.enabled })}>
                      {rule.enabled ? "Pause" : "Enable"}
                    </Button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Read only</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <AlertRuleDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        rule={editingRule}
        saving={saving}
        slackDestinationsCount={slackDestinationsCount}
        webhookDestinationsCount={webhookDestinationsCount}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      />
    </>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/alerts/AlertsSummaryCards.tsx">
import { BellRing, ShieldAlert, Siren, Workflow } from "lucide-react";

import { KPICard } from "@/components/dashboard/KPICard";
import type { AlertsSummary } from "@/services/alerts-api";

export function AlertsSummaryCards({ summary }: { summary: AlertsSummary }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
      <KPICard label="Active Alerts" value={summary.total_alerts} subtext="Currently firing or acknowledged" icon={BellRing} status={summary.total_alerts > 0 ? "warning" : "success"} />
      <KPICard label="Critical" value={summary.critical_alerts} subtext="Immediate operator attention" icon={Siren} status={summary.critical_alerts > 0 ? "destructive" : "neutral"} />
      <KPICard label="Enabled Rules" value={summary.enabled_rules} subtext="Organization-scoped automations" icon={Workflow} status={summary.enabled_rules > 0 ? "success" : "neutral"} />
      <KPICard label="Open Incidents" value={summary.open_incidents} subtext="Escalated investigation threads" icon={ShieldAlert} status={summary.open_incidents > 0 ? "warning" : "neutral"} />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/dashboard/ContainersTable.tsx">
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Box, Square, RefreshCcw, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { DashboardContainerSummary } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-types";

interface ContainersTableProps {
  containers: DashboardContainerSummary[];
  isLoading?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export function ContainersTable({ containers, isLoading, className }: ContainersTableProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full", className)}>
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Box className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Active Containers</h3>
        </div>
        <Link to="/app/containers" className="text-[11px] font-bold text-primary hover:underline flex items-center">
          VIEW ALL <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3 ml-0.5" />
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse min-w-[600px]">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-white/[0.02] border-b border-white/5">
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest leading-none">Container</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest leading-none">Status</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest leading-none">CPU Usage</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest leading-none">Memory</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest leading-none">Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
            {isLoading ? (
              Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
                <tr key={i} className="animate-pulse">
                  <td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-4 h-12 bg-white/[0.02]" />
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : containers.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  No containers found across connected hosts.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              containers.slice(0, 10).map((container) => (
                <tr key={container.Id} className="hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors group">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold truncate max-w-[180px]">
                        {(container.Names?.[0] || "unknown").replace(/^\//, "")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium truncate max-w-[180px]">
                        {container.Image}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          "w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full",
                          container.State === "running" ? "bg-success animate-pulse" : "bg-destructive",
                        )}
                      />
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          "text-[10px] font-bold uppercase",
                          container.State === "running" ? "text-success" : "text-destructive",
                        )}
                      >
                        {container.State}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 w-24">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">-</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">-</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg">
                        <RefreshCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10">
                        <Square className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AlertTriangle, Info, ShieldAlert, Clock, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { AlertItem } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-types";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

interface DashboardAlertsProps {
  alerts: AlertItem[];
  className?: string;
}

export function DashboardAlerts({ alerts, className }: DashboardAlertsProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full border-l-0 md:border-l border-white/5", className)}>
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <ShieldAlert className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">Operational Issues</h3>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-destructive border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/5 px-1.5 py-0 h-4">
          {alerts.length} NEW
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        {alerts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-12 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full opacity-50">
            <Info className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <p className="text-sm">No critical issues detected</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
            {alerts.map((alert) => (
              <Link
                key={alert.id}
                to={alert.href || "/app/alerts"}
                className="block p-4 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors cursor-pointer group relative focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
              >
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5",
                    alert.severity === "error" ? "bg-destructive" : alert.severity === "warning" ? "bg-warning" : "bg-primary",
                  )}
                />
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "mt-1 p-1 rounded-md",
                      alert.severity === "error" ? "text-destructive" : alert.severity === "warning" ? "text-warning" : "text-primary",
                    )}
                  >
                    <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col gap-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">{alert.title}</span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest opacity-60">
                        <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                        {alert.timestamp}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">{alert.description}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/5">
        <Button asChild variant="ghost" className="w-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary">
          <Link to="/app/alerts">
          EXPLORE ALL EVENTS <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" />
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { KPICard } from "@/components/dashboard/KPICard";
import { HostHealthGrid } from "@/components/dashboard/HostHealthGrid";
import { FleetResourceChart } from "@/components/dashboard/FleetResourceChart";
import { ContainersTable } from "@/components/dashboard/ContainersTable";
import { DashboardAlerts } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardAlerts";
import { Activity, AlertCircle, Box, Server } from "lucide-react";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import type { DashboardStats } from "@/lib/dashboard-summary";

interface DashboardOverviewProps {
  organizationName?: string;
  organizationId: string | null;
  hosts: DockerHost[];
  stats: DashboardStats;
  containersLoading: boolean;
  liveDataError?: string | null;
  fleetMetricsRefetchInterval?: number | false;
}

export function DashboardOverview({
  organizationName,
  organizationId,
  hosts,
  stats,
  containersLoading,
  liveDataError,
  fleetMetricsRefetchInterval = 10000,
}: DashboardOverviewProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in pb-10">
      <div className="p-6 pb-0">
        <PageHeader
          title="Dashboard"
          description={organizationName || "Overview"}
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Operations" }, { label: "Fleet Summary" }]}
        />
      </div>

      {liveDataError ? (
        <div className="px-6">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
            {liveDataError}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="px-6 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        <KPICard label="Total Hosts" value={stats.hostsCount} subtext="Connected infra" icon={Server} status={stats.hostsCount > 0 ? "success" : "neutral"} />
        <KPICard label="Connected" value={stats.connectedCount} subtext="Active & healthy" status={stats.connectedCount === stats.hostsCount ? "success" : "warning"} trend={{ value: "Stable", type: "neutral" }} />
        <KPICard label="Unhealthy" value={stats.unhealthyCount} subtext="Critical attention" status={stats.unhealthyCount > 0 ? "destructive" : "success"} />
        <KPICard label="Containers" value={stats.containersCount} subtext="Total workloads" icon={Box} status="neutral" />
        <KPICard label="Running" value={stats.runningCount} subtext="Productive tasks" icon={Activity} status="success" />
        <KPICard label="Issues" value={stats.alerts.length} subtext="Active alerts" icon={AlertCircle} status={stats.alerts.length > 0 ? "destructive" : "success"} />

      <div className="px-6 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

        <div className="lg:col-span-2 h-[350px]">
          <FleetResourceChart orgId={organizationId} refetchInterval={fleetMetricsRefetchInterval} />

          <ContainersTable containers={stats.containers} isLoading={containersLoading} />
        </div>
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 min-h-[450px]">
          <DashboardAlerts alerts={stats.alerts} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/dashboard/FleetResourceChart.tsx">
import { AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';
import { Activity } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useFleetMetrics, type FleetMetrics } from "@/hooks/useFleetMetrics";

interface FleetResourceChartProps {
  orgId: string | null;
  className?: string;
  maxDataPoints?: number;
  refetchInterval?: number | false;
}

const MAX_DATA_POINTS = 20;

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0.00 B';
  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  return `${(bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

function formatPercentage(value: number): string {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value.toFixed(2) : '0.00';
}

function formatSpeed(bytesPerSecond: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytesPerSecond) || bytesPerSecond === null || bytesPerSecond === undefined || bytesPerSecond < 0) {
    return 'N/A';
  }

  if (bytesPerSecond === 0) {
    return '0.00 B/s';
  }

  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ['B/s', 'KB/s', 'MB/s', 'GB/s', 'TB/s'];
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytesPerSecond) / Math.log(k)), sizes.length - 1);
  return `${(bytesPerSecond / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

interface FleetResourceTooltipProps {
  active?: boolean;
  label?: string;
  payload?: Array<{
    name?: string;
    value?: number | string;
    payload?: FleetMetrics;
  }>;
}

function FleetResourceTooltip({ active, label, payload }: FleetResourceTooltipProps) {
  if (!active || !payload || payload.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const dataPoint = payload[0]?.payload;
  if (!dataPoint) {
    return null;
  }

  const cpuEntry = payload.find((item) => item.name === 'CPU Usage');
  const memoryEntry = payload.find((item) => item.name === 'Memory Usage');
  const cpuPercent = Number.isFinite(Number(cpuEntry?.value)) ? Number(cpuEntry?.value) : dataPoint.cpu;
  const memoryPercent = Number.isFinite(Number(memoryEntry?.value)) ? Number(memoryEntry?.value) : dataPoint.memory;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(13, 17, 23, 0.95)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        fontSize: '12px',
        color: '#fff',
        boxShadow: '0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
        padding: '10px 12px',
        minWidth: '280px',
      }}
    >
      {label && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: '6px' }}>
          {label}
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '4px' }}>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#0EA5E9', fontWeight: 700 }}>CPU:</span>{' '}
          <span>
            {formatPercentage(cpuPercent)}% of fleet (Load: {dataPoint.usedCores.toFixed(2)} / {dataPoint.totalCores.toFixed(2)} cores)
          </span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#10B981', fontWeight: 700 }}>Memory:</span>{' '}
          <span>
            {formatPercentage(memoryPercent)}% of fleet ({formatBytes(dataPoint.memoryUsed)} / {formatBytes(dataPoint.memoryLimit)})
          </span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Network In:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.networkInBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Network Out:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.networkOutBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Disk Read:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.diskReadBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Disk Write:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.diskWriteBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface CompactMetricProps {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}

function CompactMetric({ label, value }: CompactMetricProps) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.02] px-2.5 py-2">
      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground/80">{label}</div>
      <div className="text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-foreground mt-0.5">{value}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function FleetResourceChart({
  orgId,
  className,
  maxDataPoints = MAX_DATA_POINTS,
  refetchInterval = 10000,
}: FleetResourceChartProps) {
  const [chartData, setChartData] = useState<FleetMetrics[]>([]);
  const { data: newData, isLoading, error } = useFleetMetrics(orgId, refetchInterval);

       // Initialize with some data points if empty (only once)
   useEffect(() => {
     if (chartData.length === 0 && orgId) {
       const now = new Date();
       const initialData: FleetMetrics[] = [];
        for (let i = maxDataPoints - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const date = new Date(now.getTime() - i * 60000);
          const t = date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });
          const cpu = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 30 + Math.random() * 20));
          const memory = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 45 + Math.random() * 20));
         // Mock data for new fields: assume 4 cores and 8GB memory for initial mock
          const totalCoresMock = 4;
          const memoryLimitMock = 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; // 8GB in bytes
           initialData.push({
             timestamp: date.getTime(),
             time: t,
             cpu: cpu,
             memory: memory,
             usedCores: (cpu / 100) * totalCoresMock,
             totalCores: totalCoresMock,
            memoryUsed: (memory / 100) * memoryLimitMock,
            memoryLimit: memoryLimitMock,
            networkInBytesPerSec: null,
            networkOutBytesPerSec: null,
            diskReadBytesPerSec: null,
            diskWriteBytesPerSec: null,
          });
        }
        setChartData(initialData);
      }
    }, [orgId, maxDataPoints]);

  // Update with new data points as they come in
  useEffect(() => {
    if (newData && newData.length > 0) {
      setChartData((prev) => {
        const updated = [...prev, ...newData]
          .filter((point) => Number.isFinite(point.timestamp))
          .sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);

        if (updated.length > maxDataPoints) {
          return updated.slice(-maxDataPoints);
        }

        return updated;
      });
    }
  }, [newData, maxDataPoints]);

  const displayData = chartData.length > 0 ? chartData : [];
  const latestPoint = displayData.length > 0 ? displayData[displayData.length - 1] : undefined;

  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full", className)}>
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
           <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
           <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Fleet Resource Trends</h3>
         </div>
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Updating...</span>
          </div>
        )}
        {!isLoading && error instanceof Error ? (
          <span className="text-[10px] text-destructive">{error.message}</span>
        ) : null}
         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
             <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary" />
             <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase opacity-70">CPU</span>
           </div>
           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
             <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-success" />
             <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase opacity-70">MEM</span>
           </div>
         </div>
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex-1 p-4 pt-6">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          <AreaChart data={displayData} margin={{ top: 0, right: 0, left: -20, bottom: 0 }}>
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="colorCpu" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#0EA5E9" stopOpacity={0.3}/>
                <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#0EA5E9" stopOpacity={0}/>
              </linearGradient>
              <linearGradient id="colorMem" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.3}/>
                <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0}/>
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)" />
            <XAxis 
              dataKey="time" 
              axisLine={false} 
              tickLine={false} 
              tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)', fontWeight: 600 }}
              dy={10}
            />
            <YAxis 
              axisLine={false} 
              tickLine={false} 
              tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)', fontWeight: 600 }}
              domain={[0, 'auto']}
              allowDecimals={false}
              tickFormatter={(value: number | string) => `${formatPercentage(typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value))}%`}
            />
            <Tooltip content={<FleetResourceTooltip />} />
            <Area 
              type="monotone" 
              dataKey="cpu" 
              name="CPU Usage"
              stroke="#0EA5E9" 
              strokeWidth={2}
              fillOpacity={1} 
              fill="url(#colorCpu)" 
              isAnimationActive={false}
            />
            <Area 
              type="monotone" 
              dataKey="memory" 
              name="Memory Usage"
              stroke="#10B981" 
              strokeWidth={2}
              fillOpacity={1} 
              fill="url(#colorMem)" 
              isAnimationActive={false}
            />
          </AreaChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 pb-4 pt-2 border-t border-white/5">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <CompactMetric label="Network In" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.networkInBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
          <CompactMetric label="Network Out" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.networkOutBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
          <CompactMetric label="Disk Read" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.diskReadBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
          <CompactMetric label="Disk Write" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.diskWriteBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/dashboard/HostHealthGrid.tsx">
import { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Server, Activity, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, ChevronRight, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  connected: "Healthy",
  stale: "Stale",
  error: "Error",
  unhealthy: "Unhealthy",
  down: "Down",
  disconnected: "Offline",
  unknown: "Unknown",
};

function statusColor(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "connected":
      return { bg: "bg-success/10", text: "text-success" };
    case "stale":
    case "error":
      return { bg: "bg-warning/10", text: "text-warning" };
    default:
      return { bg: "bg-destructive/10", text: "text-destructive" };
  }
}

interface HostHealthGridProps {
  hosts: DockerHost[];
  className?: string;
}

export function HostHealthGrid({ hosts, className }: HostHealthGridProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full", className)}>
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Server className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Host Health Overview</h3>
        </div>
        <Link to="/app/hosts" className="text-[11px] font-bold text-primary hover:underline flex items-center">
          MANAGE HOSTS <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 ml-0.5" />
        </Link>
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        {hosts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full opacity-50">
            <Server className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <p className="text-sm">No hosts connected</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
            {hosts.map((host) => {
              const normalized = normalizeHostStatus(host.status);
              const isHealthy = normalized === "connected";
              const isWarning = normalized === "stale" || normalized === "error";
              const colors = statusColor(normalized);
              const label = STATUS_LABEL[normalized] || "Unknown";

              return (
                <Link 
                  key={host.id} 
                  to={`/app/hosts/${host.id}`}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors group"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={cn("p-1.5 rounded-lg", colors.bg)}>
                      {isHealthy ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className={cn("h-4 w-4", colors.text)} />
                      ) : isWarning ? (
                        <AlertTriangle className={cn("h-4 w-4", colors.text)} />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertCircle className={cn("h-4 w-4", colors.text)} />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">{host.name}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">
                        {host.os_info || "Linux"} • {host.connection_mode.replace('_', ' ')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-right">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-end">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Activity className={cn("h-3 w-3", isHealthy ? "text-success" : "text-muted-foreground")} />
                        <span className={cn("text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter", colors.text)}>
                          {label}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {host.last_seen_at && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                          Seen {new Date(host.last_seen_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/dashboard/KPICard.tsx">
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { LucideIcon, ArrowUpRight, ArrowDownRight } from "lucide-react";

interface KPICardProps {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  subtext?: string;
  trend?: {
    value: string | number;
    type: "positive" | "negative" | "neutral";
  };
  status?: "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | "neutral";
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  className?: string;
}

export function KPICard({ 
  label, 
  value, 
  subtext, 
  trend, 
  status = "neutral", 
  icon: Icon, 
  className 
}: KPICardProps) {
  const statusColors = {
    success: "bg-success/20 text-success",
    warning: "bg-warning/20 text-warning",
    destructive: "bg-destructive/20 text-destructive",
    neutral: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
  };

  const dotColors = {
    success: "bg-success",
    warning: "bg-warning",
    destructive: "bg-destructive",
    neutral: "bg-muted-foreground",
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card p-4 flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[120px] transition-all hover:border-primary/30 group", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className={cn("w-2 h-2 rounded-full", dotColors[status])} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest">{label}</span>
        </div>
        {Icon && <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />}
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
          <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">{value}</span>
          {trend && (
            <div className={cn("flex items-center text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded", 
              trend.type === "positive" ? "text-success bg-success/10" : 
              trend.type === "negative" ? "text-destructive bg-destructive/10" : 
              "text-muted-foreground bg-muted"
            )}>
              {trend.type === "positive" ? <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3 mr-0.5" /> : 
               trend.type === "negative" ? <ArrowDownRight className="h-3 w-3 mr-0.5" /> : null}
              {trend.value}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {subtext && <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1">{subtext}</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/docker/AddHostDialog.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Plus, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, ShieldCheck, CloudCog, Terminal, Pencil, Eye, EyeOff, Copy, RefreshCw, Wrench } from "lucide-react";
import { useAddDockerHost, useUpdateDockerHost } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { agentEnrollmentApi, type AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse } from "@/services/agent-enrollment";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import type { ConnectionMode, DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION, isAgentVersionOutdated } from "@/lib/agent-version";
import { sanitizeConnectionError } from "@/lib/error-sanitizer";
interface AddHostDialogProps {
  orgId: string;
  trigger?: React.ReactNode;
  host?: DockerHost | null;
}

interface EditableHostSecrets {
  agentApiKey: string;
  cfServiceTokenId: string;
  cfServiceTokenSecret: string;
}

type GuidedStage = "form" | "guided" | "finalizing";

function CommandBlock({
  label,
  command,
  masked = false,
}: {
  label: string;
  command: string;
  masked?: boolean;
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(!masked);
  const visibleCommand = masked && !revealed ? command.replace(/[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}/g, "••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••") : command;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command);
    setCopied(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Label>{label}</Label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {masked ? (
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={() => setRevealed((value) => !value)}>
              {revealed ? <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
              {revealed ? "Hide" : "Reveal"}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={handleCopy}>
            <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-background p-4 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed">
        <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-all text-foreground/90">{visibleCommand}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AddHostDialog({ orgId, trigger, host }: AddHostDialogProps) {
  const isEditing = !!host;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<GuidedStage>("form");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ConnectionMode>("agent");
  const [hostUrl, setHostUrl] = useState("");
  const [socketPath, setSocketPath] = useState("/var/run/docker.sock");
  const [agentApiKey, setAgentApiKey] = useState("");
  const [cfServiceTokenId, setCfServiceTokenId] = useState("");
  const [cfServiceTokenSecret, setCfServiceTokenSecret] = useState("");
  const [loadingSecrets, setLoadingSecrets] = useState(false);
  const [showAgentKey, setShowAgentKey] = useState(false);
  const [showCfSecret, setShowCfSecret] = useState(false);
  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);
  const [enrollment, setEnrollment] = useState<AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse | null>(null);
  const [guidedError, setGuidedError] = useState("");
  const [testStatus, setTestStatus] = useState<"idle" | "testing" | "success" | "error">("idle");
  const [testError, setTestError] = useState("");
  const [testMessage, setTestMessage] = useState("");
  const [remediationCommand, setRemediationCommand] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const addHost = useAddDockerHost();
  const updateHost = useUpdateDockerHost();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const resetForm = () => {
    setName(host?.name ?? "");
    setHostUrl(host?.host_url ?? "");
    setMode(host?.connection_mode ?? "agent");
    setSocketPath(host?.docker_socket_path ?? "/var/run/docker.sock");
    setAgentApiKey("");
    setCfServiceTokenId("");
    setCfServiceTokenSecret("");
    setLoadingSecrets(false);
    setShowAgentKey(false);
    setShowCfSecret(false);
    setShowAdvanced(false);
    setEnrollment(null);
    setGuidedError("");
    setStage("form");
    setTestStatus("idle");
    setTestError("");
    setTestMessage("");
    setRemediationCommand(null);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    resetForm();
  }, [open, host]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !host) return;

    let active = true;
    setLoadingSecrets(true);
    apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?hostId=${host.id}&includeSecrets=true`)
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const secrets = (data as { secrets?: EditableHostSecrets }).secrets;
        setAgentApiKey(secrets?.agentApiKey ?? "");
        setCfServiceTokenId(secrets?.cfServiceTokenId ?? "");
        setCfServiceTokenSecret(secrets?.cfServiceTokenSecret ?? "");
      })
      .catch((error: any) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
        toast({
          title: "Failed to load host secrets",
          description: sanitized.description,
          variant: "destructive",
        });
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setLoadingSecrets(false);
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [open, host, toast]);

  const handleSaveEdit = async () => {
    try {
      new URL(hostUrl);
    } catch {
      toast({ title: "Invalid URL", description: "Enter a valid agent or tunnel URL.", variant: "destructive" });
      return;
    }

    if (!agentApiKey.trim()) {
      toast({ title: "API Key required", description: "The agent API key is required for both connection modes.", variant: "destructive" });
      return;
    }

    try {
      const payload = {
        name,
        hostUrl,
        connectionMode: mode,
        dockerSocketPath: socketPath,
        secrets: {
          agentApiKey: agentApiKey.trim(),
          ...(mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" && {
            cfServiceTokenId: cfServiceTokenId.trim() || undefined,
            cfServiceTokenSecret: cfServiceTokenSecret.trim() || undefined,
          }),
        },
      };

      const savedHost = await updateHost.mutateAsync({
        hostId: host!.id,
        ...payload,
      });

      setTestStatus("testing");
      try {
        const result = await dockerApi.ping(savedHost.id);
        if (result.ok) {
          setTestStatus("success");
          setTestMessage(result.agent_version_error || "");
          const agentVersion = result.agent_version || null;
          const latestVersion = result.latest_agent_version || CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION;
          const agentOutdated = isAgentVersionOutdated(agentVersion);
          toast({
            title: "Host updated!",
            description: [
              `Docker ${result.docker_version || "detected"}.`,
              agentVersion
                ? `Agent ${agentVersion}${agentOutdated ? ` is behind ${latestVersion}` : ""}.`
                : result.agent_version_error
                  ? `Agent version not reported yet (${result.agent_version_error}). Current release is ${latestVersion}.`
                  : `Agent version not reported yet. Current release is ${latestVersion}.`,
            ].join(" "),
          });
        } else {
          setTestStatus("error");
          setTestError("Docker API did not respond with OK");
          toast({ title: "Host updated but unreachable", description: "Check URL and credentials.", variant: "destructive" });
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        setTestStatus("error");
        const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(e);
        setTestError(sanitized.description);
        toast({ title: sanitized.title, description: sanitized.description, variant: "destructive" });
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        setOpen(false);
        resetForm();
      }, 1500);
    } catch (error: any) {
      const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
      toast({ title: "Failed to update host", description: sanitized.description, variant: "destructive" });
    }
  };

  const handleStartGuidedSetup = async () => {
    setGuidedError("");
    try {
      new URL(hostUrl);
    } catch {
      setGuidedError("Enter a valid URL (for example https://agent.example.com:9876).");
      return;
    }

    if (!name.trim()) {
      setGuidedError("Host name is required.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setStage("finalizing");
      const response = await agentEnrollmentApi.create({
        organizationId: orgId,
        hostName: name,
        hostUrl,
        connectionMode: mode,
        dockerSocketPath: socketPath,
        cfServiceTokenId: mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenId.trim() || undefined : undefined,
        cfServiceTokenSecret: mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenSecret.trim() || undefined : undefined,
      });
      setEnrollment(response);
      setGuidedError("");
      setStage("guided");
    } catch (error: any) {
      const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
      setGuidedError(sanitized.description || "Failed to prepare the guided setup command.");
      setStage("form");
    }
  };

  const handleFinalizeGuidedSetup = async () => {
    if (!enrollment?.session_id) return;
    setGuidedError("");
    setTestError("");
    setRemediationCommand(null);
    setStage("finalizing");

    try {
      const result = await agentEnrollmentApi.finalize(enrollment.session_id);
      if (result.ok) {
        setTestStatus("success");
        setTestMessage(
          result.reason_code === "agent_outdated"
            ? "Host connected, but the installed agent is behind the current release."
            : result.reason_code === "metrics_unavailable"
              ? "Host connected, but local metrics verification still needs attention."
              : "Connection verified successfully."
        );
        toast({
          title: "Host connected!",
          description: result.reason_code
            ? "The host is reachable. Review the follow-up guidance if shown."
            : "The host was installed and verified through Dockerdash.",
        });
        setTimeout(() => {
          setOpen(false);
          resetForm();
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        setTestStatus("error");
        setTestError(result.status || "Connection test failed.");
        setRemediationCommand(result.remediation_command);
        setStage("guided");
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      setTestStatus("error");
