      const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
      setTestError(sanitized.description || "Connection test failed.");
      setStage("guided");
    }
  };

  const modes: { value: ConnectionMode; label: string; icon: typeof Terminal; desc: string }[] = [
    { value: "agent", label: "Agent (Direct)", icon: Terminal, desc: "Connect to the Watchtower Agent over HTTPS." },
    { value: "cloudflare_tunnel", label: "Agent via CF Tunnel", icon: CloudCog, desc: "Same agent, accessed through a Cloudflare Tunnel." },
  ];

  const isBusy = addHost.isPending || updateHost.isPending || loadingSecrets || stage === "finalizing";

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => { setOpen(value); if (!value) resetForm(); }}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        {trigger || (
          <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
            {isEditing ? <Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
            {isEditing ? "Edit Host" : "Connect Host"}
          </Button>
        )}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            {isEditing ? "Edit Docker Host" : "Connect Docker Host"}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {isEditing
              ? "Update the saved host connection, endpoint, and credentials."
              : "Create a guided one-command installer flow, then finish the host test through Dockerdash."}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {!isEditing && stage === "guided" && enrollment ? (
          <div className="space-y-4 mt-2">
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-4 text-sm text-primary">
              {enrollment.setup_summary}
            </div>

            <CommandBlock label="Primary install command" command={enrollment.install_command} />
            <CommandBlock label="Local verify command" command={enrollment.verify_command} />

            <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/20 p-4 space-y-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium"
                onClick={() => setShowAdvanced((value) => !value)}
              >
                <Wrench className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                {showAdvanced ? "Hide manual fallback" : "Use manual install instead"}
              </button>
              {showAdvanced ? (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    This advanced command embeds the long-lived API key. Use it only if you want to skip the enrollment-token flow.
                  </p>
                  <CommandBlock label="Advanced manual install" command={enrollment.advanced_manual_command} masked />
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            {guidedError ? (
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">
                <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{guidedError}</p>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {testStatus === "error" && testError ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">
                  <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{testError}</p>
                </div>
                {remediationCommand ? <CommandBlock label="Suggested remediation command" command={remediationCommand} /> : null}
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {testStatus === "success" ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-primary/10 border border-primary/20">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <p className="text-xs text-primary">Connection successful!</p>
                  {testMessage ? <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{testMessage}</p> : null}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleStartGuidedSetup} className="gap-2">
                <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
                Regenerate command
              </Button>
              <Button onClick={handleFinalizeGuidedSetup} className="flex-1">
                {stage === "finalizing" ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-2" />Finishing...</> : "Finish Setup & Test"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4 mt-2">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Connection Method</Label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {modes.map((m) => (
                  <button
                    key={m.value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMode(m.value)}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-left transition-all ${
                      mode === m.value
                        ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 ring-1 ring-primary/20"
                        : "border-border hover:border-primary/40"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <m.icon className={`h-4 w-4 mb-1 ${mode === m.value ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground"}`} />
                    <div className="text-xs font-medium">{m.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{m.desc}</div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Host Name</Label>
              <Input placeholder="e.g. prod-server-01" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>{mode === "agent" ? "Agent URL" : "Tunnel URL"}</Label>
              <Input
                placeholder={mode === "agent" ? "https://your-host:9876" : "https://docker.your-team.cloudflareaccess.com"}
                value={hostUrl}
                onChange={(e) => setHostUrl(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Docker Socket Path <span className="text-muted-foreground">(optional)</span></Label>
              <Input placeholder="/var/run/docker.sock" value={socketPath} onChange={(e) => setSocketPath(e.target.value)} />
            </div>

            {mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? (
              <>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>CF Access Service Token ID <span className="text-muted-foreground">(optional)</span></Label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="Only if CF Access is protecting the tunnel"
                    value={cfServiceTokenId}
                    onChange={(e) => setCfServiceTokenId(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>CF Access Service Token Secret <span className="text-muted-foreground">(optional)</span></Label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Input
                      type={showCfSecret ? "text" : "password"}
                      placeholder="Only if CF Access is protecting the tunnel"
                      value={cfServiceTokenSecret}
                      onChange={(e) => setCfServiceTokenSecret(e.target.value)}
                      className="pr-10"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowCfSecret((value) => !value)}
                      className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                      {showCfSecret ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}

            {isEditing ? (
              <>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Agent API Key</Label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Input
                      type={showAgentKey ? "text" : "password"}
                      placeholder="Shared secret for authenticating with the agent"
                      value={agentApiKey}
                      onChange={(e) => setAgentApiKey(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={loadingSecrets}
                      className="pr-10"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowAgentKey((value) => !value)}
                      className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                      {showAgentKey ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {testStatus === "error" && testError ? (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">
                    <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{testError}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                {testStatus === "success" ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-primary/10 border border-primary/20">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <div className="space-y-0.5">
                      <p className="text-xs text-primary">Connection successful!</p>
                      {testMessage ? <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{testMessage}</p> : null}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                <Button onClick={handleSaveEdit} disabled={!name || !hostUrl || isBusy || !agentApiKey.trim()} className="w-full">
                  {isBusy || testStatus === "testing" ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-2" />Saving...</> : "Save Changes & Test Connection"}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                {guidedError ? (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">
                    <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{guidedError}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                <Button onClick={handleStartGuidedSetup} disabled={!name || !hostUrl || isBusy} className="w-full">
                  {isBusy ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-2" />Preparing...</> : "Generate Install Command"}
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/docker/LogConsole.tsx">
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { formatDistanceToNowStrict, parseISO, isValid } from "date-fns";
import { Search, AlertTriangle, Clock3, Info, TerminalSquare, RefreshCw, XCircle } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type LogTone = "error" | "warning" | "info" | "neutral";
type TimeRangeValue = "all" | "5m" | "15m" | "1h" | "6h" | "24h";

interface LogConsoleProps {
  logs: string[];
  loading?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  heightClassName?: string;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
  refreshLabel?: string;
}

interface ParsedLogLine {
  raw: string;
  message: string;
  timestamp: string | null;
  timestampDate: Date | null;
  relativeTime: string | null;
  tone: LogTone;
}

const timeRangeOptions: Array<{ value: TimeRangeValue; label: string; minutes: number | null }> = [
  { value: "all", label: "All time", minutes: null },
  { value: "5m", label: "Last 5m", minutes: 5 },
  { value: "15m", label: "Last 15m", minutes: 15 },
  { value: "1h", label: "Last 1h", minutes: 60 },
  { value: "6h", label: "Last 6h", minutes: 360 },
  { value: "24h", label: "Last 24h", minutes: 1440 },
];

function parseLogLine(line: string): ParsedLogLine {
  const match = line.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T[^\s]+)\s+(.*)$/);
  const timestamp = match?.[1] ?? null;
  const message = match?.[2] ?? line;
  const lower = message.toLowerCase();
  const parsedTimestamp = timestamp ? parseISO(timestamp) : null;
  const timestampDate = parsedTimestamp && isValid(parsedTimestamp) ? parsedTimestamp : null;
  const relativeTime =
    timestampDate
      ? formatDistanceToNowStrict(timestampDate, { addSuffix: true })
      : null;

  let tone: LogTone = "neutral";
  if (/\b(error|fatal|panic|exception|failed|traceback)\b/.test(lower)) {
    tone = "error";
  } else if (/\b(warn|warning|retry|timeout|deprecated)\b/.test(lower)) {
    tone = "warning";
  } else if (/\b(info|ready|started|listening|connected|healthy|ok)\b/.test(lower)) {
    tone = "info";
  }

  return { raw: line, message, timestamp, timestampDate, relativeTime, tone };
}

const toneStyles: Record<LogTone, string> = {
  error: "border-l-destructive/70 bg-destructive/[0.06]",
  warning: "border-l-warning/70 bg-warning/[0.06]",
  info: "border-l-primary/60 bg-primary/[0.05]",
  neutral: "border-l-border bg-transparent",
};

const toneBadgeStyles: Record<LogTone, string> = {
  error: "text-destructive bg-destructive/10 border-destructive/20",
  warning: "text-warning bg-warning/10 border-warning/20",
  info: "text-primary bg-primary/10 border-primary/20",
  neutral: "text-muted-foreground bg-secondary/70 border-border",
};

export function LogConsole({
  logs,
  loading = false,
  title = "Logs",
  emptyMessage = "No logs available.",
  heightClassName = "h-[520px]",
  onRefresh,
  refreshLabel = "Refresh",
}: LogConsoleProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [timestampFilter, setTimestampFilter] = useState("");
  const [activeTone, setActiveTone] = useState<LogTone | null>(null);
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<TimeRangeValue>("all");

  const parsedLogs = useMemo(() => logs.map(parseLogLine), [logs]);
  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    const messageNeedle = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const timestampNeedle = timestampFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
    const selectedRange = timeRangeOptions.find((option) => option.value === timeRange);
    const cutoff = selectedRange?.minutes ? Date.now() - selectedRange.minutes * 60_000 : null;

    return parsedLogs.filter((line) => {
      const matchesTone = !activeTone || line.tone === activeTone;
      const matchesMessage = !messageNeedle || line.raw.toLowerCase().includes(messageNeedle);
      const matchesTimestamp =
        !timestampNeedle ||
        line.timestamp?.toLowerCase().includes(timestampNeedle) ||
        line.relativeTime?.toLowerCase().includes(timestampNeedle);
      const matchesTimeRange =
        !cutoff || (line.timestampDate ? line.timestampDate.getTime() >= cutoff : false);

      return matchesTone && matchesMessage && matchesTimestamp && matchesTimeRange;
    });
  }, [activeTone, parsedLogs, search, timeRange, timestampFilter]);

  const severityCounts = useMemo(
    () =>
      parsedLogs.reduce(
        (acc, line) => {
          acc[line.tone] += 1;
          return acc;
        },
        { error: 0, warning: 0, info: 0, neutral: 0 } as Record<LogTone, number>,
      ),
    [parsedLogs],
  );

  const severityMeta: Array<{ tone: LogTone; label: string; count: number; icon: typeof XCircle }> = [
    { tone: "error", label: "errors", count: severityCounts.error, icon: XCircle },
    { tone: "warning", label: "warnings", count: severityCounts.warning, icon: AlertTriangle },
    { tone: "info", label: "info", count: severityCounts.info, icon: Info },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="border-b border-border bg-card/90 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <TerminalSquare className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              <span>{filteredLogs.length} visible</span>
              <span>{logs.length} total</span>
              {severityMeta.map(({ tone, label, count, icon: Icon }) => (
                <button
                  key={tone}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveTone((current) => (current === tone ? null : tone))}
                  className={cn(
                    "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 transition-colors",
                    toneBadgeStyles[tone],
                    activeTone === tone && "ring-1 ring-current",
                    activeTone && activeTone !== tone && "opacity-50",
                  )}
                  title={activeTone === tone ? `Clear ${label} filter` : `Filter to ${label}`}
                >
                  <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />
                  {count} {label}
                </button>
              ))}
              {activeTone ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveTone(null)}
                  className="rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
                >
                  Clear level
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:min-w-[34rem]">
            <div className="relative min-w-[220px] flex-1 sm:w-72">
              <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Filter message text..."
                className="h-9 border-white/10 bg-background/70 pl-8 text-sm"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-2.5">
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">
                <Clock3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Time Window
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {timeRangeOptions.map((option) => (
                    <button
                      key={option.value}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setTimeRange(option.value)}
                      className={cn(
                        "rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
                        timeRange === option.value
                          ? "border-primary/50 bg-primary/15 text-primary shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15)]"
                          : "border-white/10 bg-background/60 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground",
                      )}
                    >
                      {option.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                  <Select value={timeRange} onValueChange={(value) => setTimeRange(value as TimeRangeValue)}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="h-9 border-white/10 bg-background/70 text-sm sm:w-[160px]">
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Choose range" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {timeRangeOptions.map((option) => (
                        <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                          {option.label}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                  <Input
                    value={timestampFilter}
                    onChange={(event) => setTimestampFilter(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Match exact timestamp or relative label..."
                    className="h-9 border-white/10 bg-background/70 text-sm"
                  />
                  {onRefresh ? (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onRefresh} className="gap-1.5">
                      <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      {refreshLabel}
                    </Button>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex h-40 items-center justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading logs...</div>
      ) : logs.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{emptyMessage}</div>
      ) : filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No log lines match the current filter.</div>
      ) : (
        <ScrollArea className={cn("bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,14,18,0.9),rgba(7,10,14,0.96))]", heightClassName)}>
          <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
            {filteredLogs.map((line, index) => (
              <div
                key={`${line.raw}-${index}`}
                className={cn(
                  "grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-3 border-l-2 px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors hover:bg-white/[0.03]",
                  toneStyles[line.tone],
                )}
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col items-end gap-1 text-right">
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-muted-foreground/70">
                    {String(index + 1).padStart(3, "0")}
                  </span>
                  <span className={cn("rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em]", toneBadgeStyles[line.tone])}>
                    {line.tone}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
                  {line.timestamp ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-primary/80">
                      <span>{line.timestamp}</span>
                      {line.relativeTime ? (
                        <span className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">
                          {line.relativeTime}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                  <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono text-[12px] leading-6 text-foreground/92">
                    {line.message}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/hosts/AgentUpdateDialog.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { Copy, ExternalLink, Terminal } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import {
  CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
  buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy,
  buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand,
  getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy,
} from "@/lib/agent-release";

function statusTone(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "current":
      return "border-success/20 bg-success/10 text-success";
    case "update_required":
      return "border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 text-warning";
    case "verification_required":
      return "border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 text-primary";
    case "pending":
    default:
      return "border-white/10 bg-background/60 text-muted-foreground";
  }
}

function statusSummaryTone(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "current":
      return "text-success";
    case "update_required":
      return "text-warning";
    case "verification_required":
      return "text-primary";
    case "pending":
    default:
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}

function AgentCommandBlock({
  label,
  command,
}: {
  label: string;
  command: string;
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command);
    setCopied(true);
    toast({ title: "Copied to clipboard" });
    window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
        <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={handleCopy}>
          <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/60 p-4">
        <pre className="overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap break-all font-mono text-sm text-foreground/90">{command}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function UpdateCommandSection({
  title,
  description,
  command,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  command: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4 space-y-3">
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
      </div>
      <AgentCommandBlock label={title} command={command} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function AgentUpdateDialog({
  host,
  trigger,
  status,
  statusCopy,
  verificationReason,
}: {
  host: DockerHost;
  trigger: React.ReactNode;
  status: string;
  statusCopy: { title: string; description: string };
  verificationReason: string | null;
}) {
  const normalizedStatus =
    status === "current" || status === "update_required" || status === "verification_required"
      ? status
      : "pending";
  const resolvedStatusCopy = statusCopy ?? getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy(normalizedStatus, CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const updateCopy = buildWatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const installedVersion = host.agent_version || "Pending";
  const latestVersion = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version;
  const preflightCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const upgradeCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const verifyCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand();
  const repairCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand();
  const dialogTitle =
    normalizedStatus === "verification_required"
      ? "Verify Host Agent"
      : normalizedStatus === "current"
        ? "Host Agent"
        : "Update Host Agent";

  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>{trigger}</DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{dialogTitle}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{updateCopy.dialogDescription}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Installed version</p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{installedVersion}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Latest approved</p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{latestVersion}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Status</p>
              <p className={cn("mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight", statusSummaryTone(normalizedStatus))}>{resolvedStatusCopy.title}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{resolvedStatusCopy.description}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={cn("rounded-2xl border p-4 text-sm", statusTone(normalizedStatus))}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] opacity-80">Current state</p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-base font-medium">{resolvedStatusCopy.title}</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm opacity-90">{resolvedStatusCopy.description}</p>
              </div>
              <span className="rounded-full border border-current/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">
                {normalizedStatus}
              </span>
            </div>
            {verificationReason ? (
              <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {verificationReason}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-primary/15 bg-primary/5 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {updateCopy.sourcePrefix}{" "}
            <a
              href={CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.releaseUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-primary hover:underline"
            >
              {CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.sourceLabel}
              <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </a>
            {updateCopy.sourceNotice ? ` ${updateCopy.sourceNotice}` : ""}
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4">
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.preflightCommandLabel}
              description="Checks prerequisites and verifies the installer automatically before making any changes."
              command={preflightCommand}
            />
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.upgradeCommandLabel}
              description="Downloads the current installer, verifies it automatically, and runs the in-place update."
              command={upgradeCommand}
            />
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.verifyCommandLabel}
              description="Confirms the local agent version and metrics endpoints after the update."
              command={verifyCommand}
            />
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.repairCommandLabel}
              description="Use this when the host needs repair guidance after a failed or partial update."
              command={repairCommand}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {updateCopy.supportInstructions}
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/hosts/HostCard.tsx">
import { Lock, Wifi, WifiOff } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { getHostStatusAppearance } from "@/lib/host-health-state";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import type { HostMetricsPoint } from "@/hooks/useHostMetrics";

export function HostCard({
  host,
  selected,
  previewMetrics,
  onSelect,
  isLocked,
}: {
  host: DockerHost;
  selected: boolean;
  previewMetrics?: Pick<HostMetricsPoint, "cpu" | "memory"> | null;
  onSelect: () => void;
  isLocked?: boolean;
}) {
  const statusAppearance = getHostStatusAppearance(host.status);

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onSelect}
      className={cn(
        "w-full rounded-2xl border p-4 text-left transition-all",
        isLocked
          ? "border-white/5 bg-background/20 opacity-60 hover:opacity-80 hover:border-warning/30"
          : selected
            ? "border-primary/40 bg-primary/10 shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(34,197,94,0.15)]"
            : "border-white/5 bg-background/40 hover:border-primary/20 hover:bg-background/60",
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="truncate text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{host.name}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">
            {host.connection_mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? "Cloudflare tunnel" : "Agent"}
          </p>
        </div>
        {isLocked ? (
          <Lock className="mt-1 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-warning" />
        ) : (
          <span className={cn("mt-1 h-3 w-3 shrink-0 rounded-full", statusAppearance.dotClassName)} />
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {isLocked ? (
          <span className="text-xs text-warning">Upgrade to access</span>
        ) : (
          <>
            <span>CPU: {previewMetrics ? `${previewMetrics.cpu.toFixed(0)}%` : "--"}</span>
            <span>RAM: {previewMetrics ? `${previewMetrics.memory.toFixed(0)}%` : "--"}</span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/hosts/HostDetailHeader.tsx">
import { formatDistanceToNowStrict } from "date-fns";
import {
  Box,
  Clock3,
  CloudCog,
  Activity,
  Loader2,
  Pencil,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  Server,
  Terminal,
  Trash2,
  Wifi,
  WifiOff,
} from "lucide-react";

import { AddHostDialog } from "@/components/docker/AddHostDialog";
import { AgentUpdateDialog } from "@/components/hosts/AgentUpdateDialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { getHostStatusAppearance, normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION } from "@/lib/agent-version";

function formatLastSeen(lastSeenAt: string | null): string {
  if (!lastSeenAt) return "Never";
  return formatDistanceToNowStrict(new Date(lastSeenAt), { addSuffix: true });
}

function formatUptime(seconds: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds === null || seconds === undefined || seconds < 0) {
    return "Unavailable";
  }

  const totalSeconds = Math.floor(seconds);
  const days = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86400);
  const hours = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 86400) / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);

  if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  if (minutes > 0) return `${minutes}m`;
  return `${totalSeconds}s`;
}

function SummaryCard({ label, value, helper, icon: Icon }: { label: string; value: string; helper?: string; icon: typeof Server }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
        <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
      <p className="mt-4 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{value}</p>
      {helper && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{helper}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface HostDetailHeaderProps {
  selectedHost: DockerHost;
  containers: any[];
  runningCount: number;
  orgId: string | undefined;
  testing: boolean;
  liveRefreshPending: boolean;
  selectedHostAutoProbe: boolean;
  missingExtendedMetrics: boolean;
  uptimeSeconds: number | null | undefined;
  agentUpdateStatus: string;
  agentUpdateStatusCopy: { title: string; description: string };
  verificationReason: string | null;
  showAgentUpdateCta: boolean;
  onTest: () => void;
  onRefreshLiveData: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}

export function HostDetailHeader({
  selectedHost,
  containers,
  runningCount,
  orgId,
  testing,
  liveRefreshPending,
  selectedHostAutoProbe,
  missingExtendedMetrics,
  uptimeSeconds,
  agentUpdateStatus,
  agentUpdateStatusCopy,
  verificationReason,
  showAgentUpdateCta,
  onTest,
  onRefreshLiveData,
  onDelete,
}: HostDetailHeaderProps) {
  const selectedHostAppearance = getHostStatusAppearance(selectedHost.status);
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(selectedHost.status);

  const uptimeHelper = (() => {
    if (uptimeSeconds !== null && uptimeSeconds !== undefined) {
      return "From current host metrics sample";
    }
    if (missingExtendedMetrics) {
      return `Update or reinstall the host agent to ${CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION}`;
    }
    if (normalizedStatus === "connected") return "Waiting for uptime sample";
    if (normalizedStatus === "stale") return "Heartbeat is stale";
    return "Waiting for a successful probe";
  })();

  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-6 space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 xl:flex-row xl:items-start xl:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 p-4">
            <Server className="h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <h2 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{selectedHost.name}</h2>
              <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em]", selectedHostAppearance.pillClassName)}>
                {selectedHostAppearance.isOnlineIcon ? <Wifi className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <WifiOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                {selectedHost.status}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Endpoint: {selectedHost.host_url}</p>
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-white/10 px-2.5 py-1">
                {selectedHost.connection_mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? <CloudCog className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Terminal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                {selectedHost.connection_mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? "Cloudflare tunnel" : "Agent connection"}
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-white/10 px-2.5 py-1">
                <Activity className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Last seen {formatLastSeen(selectedHost.last_seen_at)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Button variant="outline" className="gap-2" onClick={onTest} disabled={testing}>
            {testing ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />}
            Test Connection
          </Button>
          {showAgentUpdateCta ? (
            <AgentUpdateDialog
              host={selectedHost}
              status={agentUpdateStatus}
              statusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
              verificationReason={verificationReason}
              trigger={
                <Button variant="outline" className="gap-2">
                  <Terminal className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Update Agent
                </Button>
              }
            />
          ) : null}
          {orgId && selectedHost ? (
            <AddHostDialog
              orgId={orgId}
              host={selectedHost}
              trigger={
                <Button variant="outline" className="gap-2">
                  <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Edit Host
                </Button>
              }
            />
          ) : null}
          <Button variant="destructive" className="gap-2" onClick={onDelete}>
            <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
            Remove Host
          </Button>
          {orgId ? (
            <AddHostDialog
              orgId={orgId}
              trigger={
                <Button className="gap-2">
                  <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Add Host
                </Button>
              }
            />
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <SummaryCard label="Running containers" value={`${runningCount}`} helper={`${containers.length} total`} icon={Box} />
        <SummaryCard
          label="Uptime"
          value={formatUptime(uptimeSeconds)}
          helper={uptimeHelper}
          icon={Clock3}
        />
        <SummaryCard label="Operating system" value={selectedHost.os_info || "Unknown"} helper={`Docker ${selectedHost.docker_version || "pending"}`} icon={Server} />
        <SummaryCard
          label="Agent version"
          value={selectedHost.agent_version || "Pending"}
          helper={agentUpdateStatusCopy.description}
          icon={Terminal}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/hosts/HostMetricsGrid.tsx">
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { AgentUpdateDialog } from "@/components/hosts/AgentUpdateDialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Terminal } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";
import type { HostMetricsDisk, HostMetricsFailure, HostMetricsPoint } from "@/hooks/useHostMetrics";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION } from "@/lib/agent-version";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared formatting helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function formatBytes(bytes: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (bytes === null || bytes === undefined || !Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "Unavailable";
  if (bytes === 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const exponent = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exponent;
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 || exponent === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[exponent]}`;
}

function formatSpeed(bytesPerSecond: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytesPerSecond) || bytesPerSecond === null || bytesPerSecond === undefined || bytesPerSecond < 0) {
    return "Unavailable";
  }
  if (bytesPerSecond === 0) return "0 B/s";
  return `${formatBytes(bytesPerSecond)}/s`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sub-components
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function EmptyState({ title, description }: { title: string; description: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[220px] p-6 flex flex-col justify-center text-center">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function LoadingState() {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[220px] p-6 flex items-center justify-center">
      <Loader2 className="h-7 w-7 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
    </div>
  );
}

function RingCard({ point }: { point: HostMetricsPoint }) {
  const value = point.cpu !== null ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, point.cpu)) : 0;
  const colorVar = value >= 90 ? "var(--destructive)" : value >= 70 ? "var(--warning)" : "var(--primary)";

  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[260px] p-5 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4">
      <div className="text-center">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-muted-foreground">CPU usage</p>
      </div>
      <div
        className="relative flex h-44 w-44 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
        style={{
          background: point.cpu !== null 
            ? `conic-gradient(hsl(${colorVar}) ${value}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) ${value}% 100%)` 
            : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex h-32 w-32 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-background/95">
          <span className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            {point.cpu !== null ? `${value.toFixed(0)}%` : "Unavailable"}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
        {point.usedCores !== null ? point.usedCores.toFixed(2) : "--"} / {point.totalCores !== null ? point.totalCores.toFixed(2) : "--"} cores
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function ContainerSummaryCard({
  total,
  running,
  loading,
  disconnected,
  paused,
}: {
  total: number;
  running: number;
  loading: boolean;
  disconnected: boolean;
  paused?: boolean;
}) {
  const stopped = Math.max(0, total - running);
  const showStoppedCount = !disconnected && !paused && !loading;

  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[220px] p-5 flex flex-col justify-between">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Containers</p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">Host workload</h3>
        </div>
      </div>

      {disconnected ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Reconnect the host to load container counts.</p>
      ) : paused && total === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Container counts are paused while the host heartbeat is stale.</p>
      ) : loading ? (
        <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Total</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{total}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Running</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{running}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showStoppedCount ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stopped} stopped containers on this host.</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function MeterCard({
  title,
  value,
  helper,
  progress,
  footer,
}: {
  title: string;
  value: string;
  helper?: string;
  progress?: number | null;
  footer?: string;
}) {
  const width = progress === null || progress === undefined ? undefined : `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress))}%`;
  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>
          <p className="mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{value}</p>
        </div>
        {helper && <span className="text-xs text-right text-muted-foreground">{helper}</span>}
      </div>
      {width && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="h-3 rounded-full bg-white/5 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width }} />
          </div>
          {footer && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{footer}</p>}
        </div>
      )}
      {!width && footer && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{footer}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function DiskUsageCard({ disk }: { disk: HostMetricsDisk }) {
  const progress = disk.totalBytes > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (disk.usedBytes / disk.totalBytes) * 100)) : 0;

  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Disk usage ({disk.device})</p>
          <p className="mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            {formatBytes(disk.usedBytes)} <span className="text-muted-foreground">/ {formatBytes(disk.totalBytes)}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <p className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground">{disk.mount}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/5">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{progress.toFixed(0)}% utilized</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
        <span>Read: <span className="text-foreground">{formatSpeed(disk.readBytesPerSec)}</span></span>
        <span>Write: <span className="text-foreground">{formatSpeed(disk.writeBytesPerSec)}</span></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TrendBars({
  history,
  accessor,
  secondaryAccessor,
  maxBars = 24,
}: {
  history: HostMetricsPoint[];
  accessor: (point: HostMetricsPoint) => number | null;
  secondaryAccessor?: (point: HostMetricsPoint) => number | null;
  maxBars?: number;
}) {
  const totals = history.map(p => (accessor(p) ?? 0) + (secondaryAccessor?.(p) ?? 0));
  const maxValue = totals.length > 0 ? Math.max(...totals, 1) : 1;
  const hasData = history.length > 0;

  if (!hasData) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-36 items-end gap-2">
        {Array.from({ length: maxBars }).map((_, index) => {
          const height = 18 + (index % 5) * 10;
          return (
            <div
              key={`placeholder-${index}`}
              className="flex-1 rounded-t-full bg-primary/20 transition-all"
              style={{ height: `${height}%` }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const emptySlots = Math.max(0, maxBars - history.length);
  const dataBars = history.slice(-maxBars);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-36 items-end gap-2">
      {Array.from({ length: emptySlots }).map((_, index) => (
        <div key={`empty-${index}`} className="flex-1 rounded-t-full bg-white/5 transition-all" style={{ height: '4px' }} />
      ))}
      {dataBars.map((point) => {
        const valPrimary = accessor(point) ?? 0;
        const valSecondary = secondaryAccessor?.(point) ?? 0;
        const total = valPrimary + valSecondary;

        const primaryHeight = total === 0 ? 2 : Math.max(2, Math.round((valPrimary / maxValue) * 100));
        const secondaryHeight = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((valSecondary / maxValue) * 100);

        return (
          <div
            key={point.timestamp}
            className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-end gap-[1px]"
            style={{ height: `${Math.max(4, primaryHeight + secondaryHeight)}%` }}
          >
            {valSecondary > 0 && (
              <div
                className="w-full rounded-t-full bg-muted-foreground/40 transition-all duration-500"
                style={{ height: `${(secondaryHeight / (primaryHeight + secondaryHeight)) * 100}%` }}
              />
            )}
            <div
              className={cn(
                "w-full transition-all duration-500",
                valSecondary > 0 ? "rounded-b-sm" : "rounded-t-full",
                "bg-primary/60"
              )}
              style={{ height: `${(primaryHeight / (primaryHeight + secondaryHeight)) * 100}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Metrics status helpers (resolve which panel variant to render)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface MetricsState {
  disconnected: boolean;
  stale: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  hasLatestPoint: boolean;
  hasFailure: boolean;
  hasHistory: boolean;
}

type MetricsVariant = "disconnected" | "loading" | "failure" | "stale" | "data" | "empty";

function resolveMetricsVariant(state: MetricsState): MetricsVariant {
  if (state.disconnected) return "disconnected";
  if (state.isLoading && !state.hasLatestPoint) return "loading";
  if (state.hasFailure && !state.hasLatestPoint) return "failure";
  if (state.hasLatestPoint) return "data";
  if (state.stale) return "stale";
  return "empty";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main grid component
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface HostMetricsGridProps {
  selectedHost: DockerHost;
  metricsQuery: {
    isLoading: boolean;
    isFetching: boolean;
    latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
    history: HostMetricsPoint[];
    failure: HostMetricsFailure | null;
  };
  containersQuery: {
    isLoading: boolean;
    isFetching: boolean;
    data: unknown;
    error: unknown;
  };
  containers: unknown[];
  runningCount: number;
  metricsFailureDisplay: { title: string; description: string } | null;
  missingExtendedMetrics: boolean;
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  agentUpdateStatus: string;
  agentUpdateStatusCopy: { title: string; description: string };
  verificationReason: string | null;
  showAgentUpdateCta: boolean;
}

export function HostMetricsGrid({
  selectedHost,
  metricsQuery,
  containersQuery,
  containers,
  runningCount,
  metricsFailureDisplay,
  missingExtendedMetrics,
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  agentUpdateStatus,
  agentUpdateStatusCopy,
  verificationReason,
  showAgentUpdateCta,
}: HostMetricsGridProps) {
  const metricsState: MetricsState = {
    disconnected: selectedHostDisconnected,
    stale: selectedHostStale,
    isLoading: metricsQuery.isLoading,
    hasLatestPoint: !!metricsQuery.latestPoint,
    hasFailure: !!metricsQuery.failure,
    hasHistory: metricsQuery.history.length > 0,
  };

  const variant = resolveMetricsVariant(metricsState);
  const failureTitle = metricsFailureDisplay?.title || "Host metrics unavailable";
  const failureDescription = metricsFailureDisplay?.description || "The host metrics probe failed before a usable sample was returned.";

  const missingHint = missingExtendedMetrics
    ? `Update or repair the host agent to restore the full metrics sample.`
    : "Waiting for a usable metrics sample from the host agent.";

  const diskMissingHint = missingExtendedMetrics
    ? `This host agent is not reporting per-disk usage yet. Update or repair the agent to ${CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION}, then Verify.`
    : "Waiting for a usable per-disk metrics sample from the host agent.";

  return (
    <>
      {/* Agent update CTA banner */}
      {showAgentUpdateCta && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-4 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="font-medium text-foreground">{agentUpdateStatusCopy.title}</p>
            <p className="mt-1">{agentUpdateStatusCopy.description}</p>
          </div>
          <AgentUpdateDialog
            host={selectedHost}
            status={agentUpdateStatus}
            statusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
            verificationReason={verificationReason}
            trigger={
              <Button className="gap-2">
                <Terminal className="h-4 w-4" />
                {agentUpdateStatus === "verification_required" ? "Open Verification Steps" : "Open Update Steps"}
              </Button>
            }
          />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(280px,340px),1fr]">
        {/* Left column: CPU ring + container summary */}
        <div className="grid gap-6">
          <CpuPanel variant={variant} latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint} failureTitle={failureTitle} failureDescription={failureDescription} />
          <ContainerSummaryCard
            total={containers.length}
            running={runningCount}
            loading={containersQuery.isLoading}
            disconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
            paused={selectedHostStale}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Right column: memory, disk, network */}
        <div className="grid gap-6">
          <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
            <MemoryPanel variant={variant} latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint} failureTitle={failureTitle} failureDescription={failureDescription} missingHint={missingHint} />
            <DiskPanel variant={variant} latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint} failureTitle={failureTitle} failureDescription={failureDescription} diskMissingHint={diskMissingHint} />
          </div>
          <NetworkPanel
            variant={variant}
            latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint}
            history={metricsQuery.history}
            failureDescription={failureDescription}
            selectedHostDisconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
            selectedHostStale={selectedHostStale}
            metricsIsLoading={metricsQuery.isLoading}
            hasFailure={!!metricsQuery.failure}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Panel sub-components (one per metrics section)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function CpuPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  failureTitle,
  failureDescription,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  failureTitle: string;
  failureDescription: string;
}) {
  switch (variant) {
    case "disconnected":
      return <EmptyState title="Host is disconnected" description="Reconnect the host or run a successful connection test to start collecting host metrics." />;
    case "loading":
      return <div className="glass-card min-h-[260px] flex items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>;
    case "failure":
      return <EmptyState title={failureTitle} description={failureDescription} />;
    case "data":
      return <RingCard point={latestPoint!} />;
    case "stale":
      return <EmptyState title="Metrics paused" description="Automatic metrics collection is paused while the host heartbeat is stale. Data will resume after a successful health check or connection test." />;
    default:
      return <EmptyState title="No CPU metrics yet" description="The host is connected, but the agent has not returned a usable metrics sample yet." />;
  }
}

function MemoryPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  failureTitle,
  failureDescription,
  missingHint,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  failureTitle: string;
  failureDescription: string;
  missingHint: string;
}) {
  switch (variant) {
    case "disconnected":
      return <EmptyState title="Memory metrics unavailable" description="Memory panels appear after a connected host returns a metrics sample." />;
    case "loading":
      return <LoadingState />;
    case "failure":
      return <EmptyState title={failureTitle || "Memory metrics unavailable"} description={failureDescription || "The host metrics probe failed before memory data was returned."} />;
    case "data":
      return (
        <MeterCard
          title="Memory usage"
          value={formatBytes(latestPoint!.memoryUsed)}
          helper={latestPoint!.memoryLimit !== null ? formatBytes(latestPoint!.memoryLimit) : undefined}
          progress={latestPoint!.memory}
          footer={latestPoint!.memory !== null ? `${latestPoint!.memory.toFixed(0)}% utilized` : undefined}
        />
      );
    case "stale":
      return <EmptyState title="Memory metrics paused" description="Automatic metrics collection is paused while the host heartbeat is stale." />;
    default:
      return <EmptyState title="Memory metrics unavailable" description={missingHint} />;
  }
}

function DiskPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  failureTitle,
  failureDescription,
  diskMissingHint,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  failureTitle: string;
  failureDescription: string;
  diskMissingHint: string;
}) {
  switch (variant) {
    case "disconnected":
      return <EmptyState title="Disk usage unavailable" description="Disk usage is shown only for connected hosts with live metrics." />;
    case "loading":
      return <LoadingState />;
    case "failure":
      return <EmptyState title={failureTitle || "Disk usage unavailable"} description={failureDescription || "The host metrics probe failed before disk usage data was returned."} />;
    case "data":
      if (latestPoint?.disks.length) {
        return (
          <>
            {latestPoint.disks.map((disk) => (
              <DiskUsageCard key={`${disk.device}-${disk.mount}`} disk={disk} />
            ))}
          </>
        );
      }
      return <EmptyState title="Disk usage unavailable" description={diskMissingHint} />;
    case "stale":
      return <EmptyState title="Disk metrics paused" description="Automatic metrics collection is paused while the host heartbeat is stale." />;
    default:
      return <EmptyState title="Disk usage unavailable" description={diskMissingHint} />;
  }
}

function NetworkPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  history,
  failureDescription,
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  metricsIsLoading,
  hasFailure,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  history: HostMetricsPoint[];
  failureDescription: string;
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  metricsIsLoading: boolean;
  hasFailure: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Network activity</p>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-primary uppercase tracking-wider">Inbound</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                {latestPoint ? formatSpeed(latestPoint.networkInBytesPerSec) : "Unavailable"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Outbound</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                {latestPoint ? formatSpeed(latestPoint.networkOutBytesPerSec) : "Unavailable"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-primary" />Inbound</span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/60" />Outbound</span>
          </div>
          {latestPoint?.networkMonthlyTotal !== undefined ? (
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              Monthly usage: <span className="text-foreground">{formatBytes(latestPoint.networkMonthlyTotal)}</span>
            </p>
          ) : latestPoint ? (
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              Total: <span className="text-foreground">{formatSpeed((latestPoint.networkInBytesPerSec || 0) + (latestPoint.networkOutBytesPerSec || 0))}</span>
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
      <NetworkTrendSection
        selectedHostDisconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
        selectedHostStale={selectedHostStale}
        metricsIsLoading={metricsIsLoading}
        hasLatestPoint={!!latestPoint}
        hasFailure={hasFailure}
        hasHistory={history.length > 0}
        history={history}
        failureDescription={failureDescription}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function NetworkTrendSection({
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  metricsIsLoading,
  hasLatestPoint,
  hasFailure,
  hasHistory,
  history,
  failureDescription,
}: {
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  metricsIsLoading: boolean;
  hasLatestPoint: boolean;
  hasFailure: boolean;
  hasHistory: boolean;
  history: HostMetricsPoint[];
  failureDescription: string;
}) {
  if (selectedHostDisconnected) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Connect this host to start rendering throughput history.</p>;
  }
  if (metricsIsLoading && !hasLatestPoint) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-36 items-center justify-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (hasFailure && !hasLatestPoint) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-36 items-center justify-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center max-w-md">
          {failureDescription || "Network throughput is unavailable while the metrics probe cannot reach this host."}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (selectedHostStale && !hasHistory) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Network throughput history is paused while the host heartbeat is stale.</p>;
  }
  return (
    <TrendBars
      history={history}
      accessor={(point) => point.networkInBytesPerSec}
      secondaryAccessor={(point) => point.networkOutBytesPerSec}
    />
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/hosts/HostSidebar.tsx">
import { Search, PanelLeftClose } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { HostCard } from "@/components/hosts/HostCard";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import type { HostMetricsPoint } from "@/hooks/useHostMetrics";

interface HostSidebarProps {
  filteredHosts: DockerHost[];
  selectedHost: DockerHost | null;
  selectedPreviewMetrics: Pick<HostMetricsPoint, "cpu" | "memory"> | null;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
  onSelectHost: (hostId: string) => void;
  onHideSidebar: () => void;
  isHostLocked: (hostId: string) => boolean;
}

export function HostSidebar({
  filteredHosts,
  selectedHost,
  selectedPreviewMetrics,
  search,
  onSearchChange,
  onSelectHost,
  onHideSidebar,
  isHostLocked,
}: HostSidebarProps) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-4 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Host infrastructure</p>
            <h2 className="mt-1 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">Browse hosts</h2>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            className="shrink-0"
            onClick={onHideSidebar}
            aria-label="Hide host infrastructure panel"
          >
            <PanelLeftClose className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
          <Input 
            value={search} 
            onChange={(event) => onSearchChange(event.target.value)} 
            placeholder="Search hosts..." 
            className="pl-9" 
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <ScrollArea className="h-[calc(100vh-18rem)]">
        <div className="space-y-3 p-4">
          {filteredHosts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-white/10 p-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              No hosts match your search.
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredHosts.map((host) => (
              <HostCard
                key={host.id}
                host={host}
                selected={host.id === selectedHost?.id}
                previewMetrics={host.id === selectedHost?.id ? selectedPreviewMetrics : null}
                onSelect={() => onSelectHost(host.id)}
                isLocked={isHostLocked(host.id)}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </ScrollArea>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/hosts/HostUpgradeDialog.tsx">
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Lock } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";

export function HostUpgradeDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  nodeLimit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  nodeLimit: number | null;
}) {
  const displayLimit = nodeLimit ?? 1;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-full bg-warning/10 p-2.5">
              <Lock className="h-5 w-5 text-warning" />
            </div>
            Host Limit Reached
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Your current plan allows monitoring up to{" "}
            <strong className="text-foreground">{displayLimit} host{displayLimit === 1 ? "" : "s"}</strong>.
            Upgrade your plan to connect and monitor additional hosts.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pt-2">
          <Button asChild size="lg" className="w-full">
            <Link to="/app/billing" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
              Upgrade Plan
            </Link>
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            className="text-muted-foreground"
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
          >
            Not now
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
