<file path="src/components/hosts/HostWorkspace.tsx">
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Loader2, Terminal } from "lucide-react";

import { AddHostDialog } from "@/components/docker/AddHostDialog";
import { HostUpgradeDialog } from "@/components/hosts/HostUpgradeDialog";
import { HostSidebar } from "@/components/hosts/HostSidebar";
import { SelectedHostView } from "@/components/hosts/SelectedHostView";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { isReadableHostStatus, normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";
import { useDeleteDockerHost, useDockerHosts, useHostContainers } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { HostMetricsFailure, useHostMetricsHistory } from "@/hooks/useHostMetrics";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION } from "@/lib/agent-version";
import { sanitizeConnectionError } from "@/lib/error-sanitizer";
import {
  CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
  getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus,
  getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy,
} from "@/lib/agent-release";
import { PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN, normalizePlan } from "../../../shared/schema/plan-policy";

function agentVerificationReason(
  failure: HostMetricsFailure | null | undefined,
  missingExtendedMetrics: boolean,
): string | null {
  if (failure?.unsupportedEndpoint) {
    return "This host agent does not expose /metrics yet. Run Preflight, Update, then Verify.";
  }

  if (failure?.code === "agent_timeout") {
    return "The agent responded too slowly. Check the local service, then use Troubleshoot / Repair.";
  }

  if (failure?.code === "agent_connection_failed") {
    return "The dashboard could not reach the host agent. Confirm the host URL, tunnel, and local service.";
  }

  if (failure?.code === "docker_socket_unavailable") {
    return "The agent is reachable, but it cannot reach Docker. Run Troubleshoot / Repair to restore Docker socket access.";
  }

  if (failure?.malformedPayload) {
    return "The host returned a malformed metrics sample. Update the agent, then Verify the local service.";
  }

  if (missingExtendedMetrics) {
    return "The current agent version is installed, but uptime and per-disk fields are still missing. Run Verify or Troubleshoot / Repair.";
  }

  return null;
}

function formatHostMetricsFailure(
  failure: HostMetricsFailure | null | undefined,
  host: DockerHost | null,
) {
  if (!failure) return null;

  if (failure.unsupportedEndpoint) {
    const versionCopy = host?.agent_version
      ? `Installed agent: ${host.agent_version}. Current release: ${CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION}.`
      : `Current release: ${CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION}.`;
    return {
      title: "Metrics endpoint unavailable",
      description: `This host agent does not expose /metrics yet. Upgrade the agent and test the connection again. ${versionCopy}`,
    };
  }

  if (failure.code === "agent_timeout") {
    return {
      title: "Metrics request timed out",
      description: "The dashboard reached the host agent, but /metrics did not respond before the timeout window.",
    };
  }

  if (failure.code === "agent_connection_failed") {
    return {
      title: "Metrics connection failed",
      description: "The dashboard could not reach the host agent metrics endpoint. Check the tunnel, host URL, and agent process.",
    };
  }

  if (failure.code === "docker_socket_unavailable") {
    return {
      title: "Docker socket inaccessible",
      description: "The agent is reachable, but the service cannot access Docker. Run Troubleshoot / Repair so systemd grants the agent Docker socket group access.",
    };
  }

  if (failure.malformedPayload) {
    return {
      title: "Malformed metrics payload",
      description: "The host agent returned a success response, but the metrics payload was incomplete or invalid.",
    };
  }

  return {
    title: "Host metrics unavailable",
    description: "The host agent did not return a usable metrics sample.",
  };
}

export function HostWorkspace() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { id: routeHostId } = useParams();
  const { organization: currentOrg } = useOrganization();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const deleteHost = useDeleteDockerHost();
  const { data: hosts = [], isLoading, refetch } = useDockerHosts(currentOrg?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);
  const [isInfrastructureVisible, setIsInfrastructureVisible] = useState(true);
  const [upgradeDialogOpen, setUpgradeDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const effectivePlan = viewer?.active_org_effective_plan ?? viewer?.active_org_plan;
  
  const normalizedPlan = normalizePlan(effectivePlan);
  const fallbackNodeLimit = PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN[normalizedPlan].nodeLimit;
  const nodeLimit = viewer?.entitlements ? viewer.entitlements.nodeLimit : fallbackNodeLimit;

  // Hosts sorted by creation date (oldest first) — matches backend enforcement order
  const hostsSortedByCreation = useMemo(() => {
    return [...hosts].sort((a, b) => {
      const dateA = a.created_at ? new Date(a.created_at).getTime() : 0;
      const dateB = b.created_at ? new Date(b.created_at).getTime() : 0;
      return dateA - dateB || a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
    });
  }, [hosts]);

  // Set of host IDs that are allowed by the current plan's node limit
  const allowedHostIds = useMemo(() => {
    if (nodeLimit === null) return null; // unlimited
    const allowed = new Set<string>();
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(nodeLimit, hostsSortedByCreation.length); i++) {
      allowed.add(hostsSortedByCreation[i].id);
    }
    return allowed;
  }, [hostsSortedByCreation, nodeLimit]);

  const isHostLocked = useCallback((hostId: string) => {
    if (allowedHostIds === null) return false; // unlimited plan
    return !allowedHostIds.has(hostId);
  }, [allowedHostIds]);

  const filteredHosts = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return hosts;
    return hosts.filter((host) =>
      [host.name, host.host_url, host.connection_mode, host.status, host.os_info || ""].some((value) =>
        value.toLowerCase().includes(query),
      ),
    );
  }, [hosts, search]);

  const selectedHost = useMemo(() => {
    if (routeHostId) return hosts.find((host) => host.id === routeHostId) ?? null;
    // Default selection: prefer first allowed host
    if (allowedHostIds !== null) {
      const firstAllowed = filteredHosts.find(h => allowedHostIds.has(h.id))
        ?? hosts.find(h => allowedHostIds.has(h.id));
      return firstAllowed ?? null;
    }
    return filteredHosts[0] ?? hosts[0] ?? null;
  }, [allowedHostIds, filteredHosts, hosts, routeHostId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading || !routeHostId) return;

    // Redirect away from locked hosts
    if (isHostLocked(routeHostId)) {
      const firstAllowed = hostsSortedByCreation.find(h => !isHostLocked(h.id));
      setUpgradeDialogOpen(true);
      navigate(firstAllowed ? `/app/hosts/${firstAllowed.id}` : "/app/hosts", { replace: true });
      return;
    }

    if (selectedHost) return;

    if (hosts.length === 0) {
      navigate("/app/hosts", { replace: true });
      return;
    }

    navigate(`/app/hosts/${filteredHosts[0]?.id ?? hosts[0].id}`, { replace: true });
  }, [filteredHosts, hosts, hostsSortedByCreation, isHostLocked, isLoading, navigate, routeHostId, selectedHost]);

  const selectedHostReadable = isReadableHostStatus(selectedHost?.status);
  const selectedHostDisconnected = !isReadableHostStatus(selectedHost?.status);
  const selectedHostAutoProbe = normalizeHostStatus(selectedHost?.status) === "connected";
  const selectedHostStale = normalizeHostStatus(selectedHost?.status) === "stale";

  const selectedHostLocked = selectedHost ? isHostLocked(selectedHost.id) : false;
  const containersQuery = useHostContainers(selectedHostAutoProbe && !selectedHostLocked ? selectedHost?.id : null, 15000);
  const metricsQuery = useHostMetricsHistory(selectedHostAutoProbe && !selectedHostLocked ? selectedHost?.id : null, {
    enabled: selectedHostAutoProbe && !selectedHostLocked,
    refetchInterval: 10000,
    maxDataPoints: 24,
  });
  const metricsFailureDisplay = formatHostMetricsFailure(metricsQuery.failure, selectedHost);
  const selectedPreviewMetrics = metricsQuery.latestPoint
    ? { cpu: metricsQuery.latestPoint.cpu, memory: metricsQuery.latestPoint.memory }
    : null;
  const missingUptimeMetric = !!metricsQuery.latestPoint && metricsQuery.latestPoint.uptimeSeconds === null;
  const missingDiskMetrics = !!metricsQuery.latestPoint && metricsQuery.latestPoint.disks.length === 0;
  const missingExtendedMetrics = missingUptimeMetric || missingDiskMetrics;
  const metricsErrorMessage = metricsQuery.failure
    ? [
        metricsQuery.failure.message,
        metricsQuery.failure.upstreamStatus ? `Upstream status: ${metricsQuery.failure.upstreamStatus}.` : null,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
    : null;
  const liveRefreshPending = containersQuery.isFetching || metricsQuery.isFetching;

  const containers = Array.isArray(containersQuery.data) ? containersQuery.data : [];
  const runningCount = containers.filter((container: any) => container.State === "running").length;
  const agentUpdateStatus = getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus({
    installedVersion: selectedHost?.agent_version ?? null,
    capabilityGap: selectedHostReadable ? missingExtendedMetrics || !!metricsQuery.failure : false,
  });
  const agentUpdateStatusCopy =
    getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy(agentUpdateStatus, CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE)
    ?? getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy("pending", CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const verificationReason = agentVerificationReason(metricsQuery.failure, missingExtendedMetrics);
  const showAgentUpdateCta = !!selectedHost && agentUpdateStatus !== "current";

  const handleSelectHost = (hostId: string) => {
    if (isHostLocked(hostId)) {
      setUpgradeDialogOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    navigate(`/app/hosts/${hostId}`);
  };

  const handleRefreshLiveData = async () => {
    await Promise.allSettled([containersQuery.refetch(), metricsQuery.refetch()]);
    await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["auth-me"] });
  };

  const handleTest = async () => {
    if (!selectedHost) return;
    setTesting(true);
    try {
      const result = await dockerApi.ping(selectedHost.id);
      const latestVersion = result.latest_agent_version || CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION;
      const resultStatusCopy =
        result.agent_update_status
          ? getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy(result.agent_update_status, CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE)
          : null;
      toast({
        title: result.ok ? "Connection successful" : "Connection failed",
        description: result.ok
          ? [
              `Docker ${result.docker_version || "detected"}.`,
              result.agent_version
                ? `Agent ${result.agent_version}. ${resultStatusCopy?.description || (result.agent_update_available ? `Update available: ${latestVersion}.` : `Current release is ${latestVersion}.`)}`
                : result.agent_version_error
                  ? `Agent version not reported yet (${result.agent_version_error}). ${resultStatusCopy?.description || `Current release is ${latestVersion}.`}`
                  : `Agent version not reported yet. ${resultStatusCopy?.description || `Current release is ${latestVersion}.`}`,
            ].join(" ")
          : undefined,
      });
      await refetch();
    } catch (error: any) {
      const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
      toast({ title: sanitized.title, description: sanitized.description, variant: "destructive" });
    } finally {
      setTesting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!selectedHost) return;
    if (!confirm(`Remove host "${selectedHost.name}"? This only removes it from the dashboard.`)) return;
    try {
      await deleteHost.mutateAsync(selectedHost.id);
      toast({ title: "Host removed" });
      const refreshed = await refetch();
      const remainingHosts = Array.isArray(refreshed.data) ? refreshed.data : [];
      const fallbackHost = remainingHosts.find((host) => host.id !== selectedHost.id) ?? remainingHosts[0] ?? null;
      navigate(fallbackHost ? `/app/hosts/${fallbackHost.id}` : "/app/hosts", { replace: true });
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast({ title: "Failed", description: error.message, variant: "destructive" });
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64"><Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Hosts"
        description={hosts.length > 0 ? `${hosts.length} host(s) configured` : "Connect Docker hosts to monitor"}
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Infrastructure" }, { label: "Hosts" }]}
        actions={currentOrg ? <AddHostDialog orgId={currentOrg.id} /> : undefined}
      />

      {hosts.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="glass-card p-12 text-center">
          <Terminal className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">No Docker hosts connected</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6 max-w-md mx-auto">
            Connect a Docker host via a lightweight agent or Cloudflare Tunnel. No open Docker ports needed.
          </p>
          {currentOrg && <AddHostDialog orgId={currentOrg.id} trigger={<Button>Connect Your First Host</Button>} />}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={cn("grid gap-6", isInfrastructureVisible ? "xl:grid-cols-[320px,minmax(0,1fr)]" : "xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)]")}>
          {isInfrastructureVisible ? (
            <HostSidebar
              filteredHosts={filteredHosts}
              selectedHost={selectedHost}
              selectedPreviewMetrics={selectedPreviewMetrics}
              search={search}
              onSearchChange={setSearch}
              onSelectHost={handleSelectHost}
              onHideSidebar={() => setIsInfrastructureVisible(false)}
              isHostLocked={isHostLocked}
            />
          ) : null}

          {selectedHost ? (
            <SelectedHostView
              selectedHost={selectedHost}
              containers={containers}
              runningCount={runningCount}
              orgId={currentOrg?.id}
              testing={testing}
              liveRefreshPending={liveRefreshPending}
              selectedHostAutoProbe={selectedHostAutoProbe}
              selectedHostDisconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
              selectedHostStale={selectedHostStale}
              selectedHostReadable={selectedHostReadable}
              missingExtendedMetrics={missingExtendedMetrics}
              metricsQuery={metricsQuery}
              containersQuery={containersQuery}
              metricsFailureDisplay={metricsFailureDisplay}
              metricsErrorMessage={metricsErrorMessage}
              agentUpdateStatus={agentUpdateStatus}
              agentUpdateStatusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
              verificationReason={verificationReason}
              showAgentUpdateCta={showAgentUpdateCta}
              isInfrastructureVisible={isInfrastructureVisible}
              onShowSidebar={() => setIsInfrastructureVisible(true)}
              onTest={handleTest}
              onRefreshLiveData={() => void handleRefreshLiveData()}
              onDelete={handleDelete}
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="glass-card p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">Select a host to view its details.</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <HostUpgradeDialog open={upgradeDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setUpgradeDialogOpen} nodeLimit={nodeLimit} />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/hosts/SelectedHostView.tsx">
import { PanelLeftOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { HostDetailHeader } from "@/components/hosts/HostDetailHeader";
import { HostMetricsGrid } from "@/components/hosts/HostMetricsGrid";
import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";
import { sanitizeConnectionError } from "@/lib/error-sanitizer";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";

interface SelectedHostViewProps {
  selectedHost: DockerHost;
  containers: any[];
  runningCount: number;
  orgId: string | undefined;
  testing: boolean;
  liveRefreshPending: boolean;
  selectedHostAutoProbe: boolean;
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  selectedHostReadable: boolean;
  missingExtendedMetrics: boolean;
  metricsQuery: any;
  containersQuery: any;
  metricsFailureDisplay: { title: string; description: string } | null;
  metricsErrorMessage: string | null;
  agentUpdateStatus: string;
  agentUpdateStatusCopy: { title: string; description: string };
  verificationReason: string | null;
  showAgentUpdateCta: boolean;
  isInfrastructureVisible: boolean;
  onShowSidebar: () => void;
  onTest: () => void;
  onRefreshLiveData: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}

export function SelectedHostView({
  selectedHost,
  containers,
  runningCount,
  orgId,
  testing,
  liveRefreshPending,
  selectedHostAutoProbe,
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  selectedHostReadable,
  missingExtendedMetrics,
  metricsQuery,
  containersQuery,
  metricsFailureDisplay,
  metricsErrorMessage,
  agentUpdateStatus,
  agentUpdateStatusCopy,
  verificationReason,
  showAgentUpdateCta,
  isInfrastructureVisible,
  onShowSidebar,
  onTest,
  onRefreshLiveData,
  onDelete,
}: SelectedHostViewProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {!isInfrastructureVisible ? (
        <div className="flex justify-start">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="gap-2" onClick={onShowSidebar}>
            <PanelLeftOpen className="h-4 w-4" />
            Show Host Infrastructure
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <HostDetailHeader
        selectedHost={selectedHost}
        containers={containers}
        runningCount={runningCount}
        orgId={orgId}
        testing={testing}
        liveRefreshPending={liveRefreshPending}
        selectedHostAutoProbe={selectedHostAutoProbe}
        missingExtendedMetrics={missingExtendedMetrics}
        uptimeSeconds={metricsQuery.latestPoint?.uptimeSeconds}
        agentUpdateStatus={agentUpdateStatus}
        agentUpdateStatusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
        verificationReason={verificationReason}
        showAgentUpdateCta={showAgentUpdateCta}
        onTest={onTest}
        onRefreshLiveData={onRefreshLiveData}
        onDelete={onDelete}
      />

      {normalizeHostStatus(selectedHost.status) === "stale" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning">
          This host heartbeat is stale. Automatic metrics and container reads are paused until the next successful health check or a manual connection test.
        </div>
      )}

      {containersQuery.error instanceof Error ? (() => {
        const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(containersQuery.error);
        return (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/5 px-5 py-4 space-y-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">{sanitized.title}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{sanitized.description}</p>
          </div>
        );
      })() : null}

      <HostMetricsGrid
        selectedHost={selectedHost}
        metricsQuery={metricsQuery}
        containersQuery={containersQuery}
        containers={containers}
        runningCount={runningCount}
        metricsFailureDisplay={metricsFailureDisplay}
        missingExtendedMetrics={missingExtendedMetrics}
        selectedHostDisconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
        selectedHostStale={selectedHostStale}
        agentUpdateStatus={agentUpdateStatus}
        agentUpdateStatusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
        verificationReason={verificationReason}
        showAgentUpdateCta={showAgentUpdateCta}
      />

      {metricsErrorMessage && selectedHostReadable && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning">
          {metricsErrorMessage}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/layout/AppSidebar.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { LogoLink } from "@/components/shared/LogoLink";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  LayoutDashboard, Server, Box, FileText, FolderOpen, Bell, CreditCard, Settings,
  HelpCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight,
  Building2, Users, Shield, BookOpen, Lock
} from "lucide-react";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";

const navGroups = [
  {
    label: "Overview",
    items: [
      { label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard, href: "/app" },
      { label: "Organizations", icon: Building2, href: "/app/organizations" },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "Infrastructure",
    items: [
      { label: "Hosts", icon: Server, href: "/app/hosts" },
      { label: "Containers", icon: Box, href: "/app/containers" },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "Observability",
    items: [
      { label: "Logs", icon: FileText, href: "/app/logs", premiumKey: "canUseLogs" as const },
      { label: "Files", icon: FolderOpen, href: "/app/files", premiumKey: "canUseFileManager" as const },
      { label: "Alerts", icon: Bell, href: "/app/alerts" },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "Management",
    items: [
      { label: "Billing", icon: CreditCard, href: "/app/billing" },
      { label: "Settings", icon: Settings, href: "/app/settings" },
      { label: "Admin", icon: Shield, href: "/app/admin" },
      { label: "Help", icon: HelpCircle, href: "/app/help" },
    ],
  },
];

export function AppSidebar() {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const entitlements = viewer?.entitlements;

  const visibleGroups = navGroups.map((group) => ({
    ...group,
    items: group.items.filter((item) => {
      if (item.href === "/app/admin" && !viewer?.is_platform_admin) return false;
      return true;
    }),
  }));

  return (
    <aside className={cn(
      "flex flex-col h-screen border-r border-border bg-sidebar shrink-0 transition-all duration-200",
      collapsed ? "w-16" : "w-56"
    )}>
      {/* Logo */}
      <div className="flex items-center h-14 px-4 border-b border-border shrink-0">
        <LogoLink className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md bg-primary flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <Box className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-foreground" />
          </div>
          {!collapsed && <span className="font-semibold text-sm tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap">Docker Dashboard</span>}
        </LogoLink>
      </div>

      {/* Nav */}
      <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-2 px-2 space-y-4">
        {visibleGroups.map((group) => (
          <div key={group.label}>
            {!collapsed && (
              <span className="px-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1 block">
                {group.label}
              </span>
            )}
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              {group.items.map((item) => {
                const active = location.pathname === item.href || (item.href !== "/app" && location.pathname.startsWith(item.href));
                return (
                  <Link
                    key={item.href}
                    to={item.href}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm transition-colors",
                      active
                        ? "bg-sidebar-accent text-sidebar-accent-foreground font-medium"
                        : "text-sidebar-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent/50 hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground"
                    )}
                  >
                    <item.icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    {!collapsed && (
                      <>
                        <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
                        {item.premiumKey && !entitlements?.[item.premiumKey] && (
                          <Lock className="h-3 w-3 ml-auto text-muted-foreground/50 shrink-0" />
                        )}
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>

      {/* Collapse toggle */}
      <div className="border-t border-border p-2 shrink-0">
        <button
          onClick={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}
          className="flex items-center justify-center w-full p-1.5 rounded-md text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent/50 transition-colors"
        >
          {collapsed ? <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/layout/AppTopBar.tsx">
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Search, Command, Moon, Sun, LayoutDashboard, Server, Box, ActivitySquare, Settings, LifeBuoy } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { UserButton, OrganizationSwitcher, useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import {
  CommandDialog,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList,
  CommandShortcut,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import { useContainers, useDockerHosts } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { NotificationBell } from "./NotificationBell";

type SearchableContainer = {
  Id?: string;
  Names?: string[];
  Image?: string;
  State?: string;
  _hostId?: string;
  _hostName?: string;
};

const quickSearchItems = [
  { label: "Dashboard", path: "/app", keywords: "overview metrics", Icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { label: "Hosts", path: "/app/hosts", keywords: "servers docker", Icon: Server },
  { label: "Containers", path: "/app/containers", keywords: "images workload", Icon: Box },
  { label: "Alerts", path: "/app/alerts", keywords: "incidents monitoring", Icon: ActivitySquare },
  { label: "Settings", path: "/app/settings", keywords: "preferences config", Icon: Settings },
  { label: "Help", path: "/app/help", keywords: "support docs", Icon: LifeBuoy },
];

export function AppTopBar() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { organization } = useOrganization();
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(() => document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark"));
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const { data: hosts = [] } = useDockerHosts(organization?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const { data: rawContainers } = useContainers(organization?.id, searchOpen && hosts.length > 0);

  const containers = useMemo(() => (Array.isArray(rawContainers) ? (rawContainers as SearchableContainer[]) : []), [rawContainers]);

  const hostResults = useMemo(() => {
    return hosts.map((host) => ({
      id: host.id,
      label: host.name,
      subtitle: `${host.status} · ${host.connection_mode}`,
      value: `${host.name} ${host.host_url} ${host.connection_mode} ${host.status}`,
      path: `/app/hosts/${host.id}`,
    }));
  }, [hosts]);

  const containerResults = useMemo(() => {
    return containers.map((container) => {
      const id = container.Id ?? "";
      const shortId = id.slice(0, 12);
      const label = (container.Names?.[0] || shortId || "Unknown container").replace(/^\//, "");
      const hostId = container._hostId;
      return {
        id,
        label,
        subtitle: `${container._hostName || "Unknown host"} · ${container.State || "unknown"}`,
        value: `${label} ${container.Image || ""} ${container._hostName || ""} ${container.State || ""}`,
        path: hostId && shortId ? `/app/containers/${shortId}?host=${hostId}` : "/app/containers",
      };
    });
  }, [containers]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "k" && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setSearchOpen((open) => !open);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark");
    setIsDark(!isDark);
  };

  const handleSearchNavigate = (path: string) => {
    setSearchOpen(false);
    navigate(path);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <header className="h-14 border-b border-border bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-between px-4 shrink-0 sticky top-0 z-30">
        {/* Left: Org Switcher */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <OrganizationSwitcher hidePersonal={true} />
        </div>

        {/* Center: Search */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
          className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground bg-secondary rounded-md border border-border hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors w-72"
          aria-label="Open quick search"
        >
          <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>Search hosts, containers...</span>
          <kbd className="ml-auto text-[10px] bg-background px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-border font-mono">
            <Command className="h-2.5 w-2.5 inline" />K
          </kbd>
        </button>

        {/* Right: Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <NotificationBell />
          
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={toggleTheme}>
            {isDark ? <Sun className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Moon className="h-4 w-4" />}
          </Button>

          <div className="relative flex items-center h-8">
            <UserButton />
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <CommandDialog open={searchOpen} onOpenChange={setSearchOpen}>
        <CommandInput placeholder="Search hosts, containers, pages..." />
        <CommandList>
          <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
          <CommandGroup heading="Navigate">
            {quickSearchItems.map((item) => (
              <CommandItem
                key={item.path}
                value={`${item.label} ${item.keywords}`}
                onSelect={() => handleSearchNavigate(item.path)}
              >
                <item.Icon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                <CommandShortcut>{item.path.replace("/app", "App")}</CommandShortcut>
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>

          {hostResults.length > 0 ? (
            <CommandGroup heading="Hosts">
              {hostResults.map((host) => (
                <CommandItem key={host.id} value={host.value} onSelect={() => handleSearchNavigate(host.path)}>
                  <Server className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                    <span className="truncate">{host.label}</span>
                    <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{host.subtitle}</span>
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              ))}
            </CommandGroup>
          ) : null}

          {containerResults.length > 0 ? (
            <CommandGroup heading="Containers">
              {containerResults.map((container) => (
                <CommandItem key={container.id || container.path} value={container.value} onSelect={() => handleSearchNavigate(container.path)}>
                  <Box className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                    <span className="truncate">{container.label}</span>
                    <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{container.subtitle}</span>
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              ))}
            </CommandGroup>
          ) : null}
        </CommandList>
      </CommandDialog>
    </>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/layout/NotificationBell.tsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Bell, Check, Info, AlertTriangle, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useNotifications, useDismissNotification, useDismissAllNotifications } from "../../hooks/useNotifications";
import { useViewerState } from "../../hooks/useViewerState";
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "../ui/popover";
import { Button } from "../ui/button";
import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";
import { formatDistanceToNow } from "date-fns";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Notification } from "../../types/database";

const NotificationIcon = ({ type }: { type: Notification["type"] }) => {
  switch (type) {
    case "error":
      return <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />;
    case "warning":
      return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />;
    case "success":
      return <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />;
    case "update":
      return <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />;
    default:
      return <Info className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" />;
  }
};

export function NotificationBell() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const orgId = viewer?.active_org_id || null;
  
  const { data: notifications, unreadCount } = useNotifications(orgId);
  const dismissMutation = useDismissNotification(orgId);
  const dismissAllMutation = useDismissAllNotifications(orgId);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleDismiss = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    dismissMutation.mutate(id);
  };

  const handleDismissAll = () => {
    dismissAllMutation.mutate();
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleClick = (n: Notification) => {
    if (n.link) {
      setOpen(false);
      if (n.link.startsWith("http://") || n.link.startsWith("https://")) {
        window.open(n.link, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
      } else {
        navigate(n.link);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="relative h-9 w-9 rounded-full">
          <Bell className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400" />
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 flex h-2 w-2">
              <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-red-400 opacity-75"></span>
              <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-red-500"></span>
            </span>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-80 p-0 mr-4" align="end">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Notifications</h3>
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <Button 
              variant="ghost" 
              size="sm" 
              onClick={handleDismissAll}
              className="h-8 text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
              disabled={dismissAllMutation.isPending}
            >
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
              Mark all read
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
          {!notifications || notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              You have no new notifications.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/50">
              {notifications.map((n) => (
                <div 
                  key={n.id} 
                  className={cn(
                    "flex gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors group",
                    n.link && "cursor-pointer"
                  )}
                  onClick={() => handleClick(n)}
                >
                  <div className="flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                    <NotificationIcon type={n.type} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                      {n.title}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1 break-words">
                      {n.message}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 mt-2">
                      {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(n.created_at), { addSuffix: true })}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-shrink-0">
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-6 w-6 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                      onClick={(e) => handleDismiss(n.id, e)}
                    >
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/layout/PublicFooter.tsx">
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Box } from "lucide-react";

export function PublicFooter() {
  return (
    <footer className="bg-card border-t border-border py-12">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 mb-8">
          <div className="col-span-2 md:col-span-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
              <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Box className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <span className="font-bold tracking-tight">Docker Dashboard</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-xs transition-opacity hover:opacity-80">
              Modern monitor and management fleet for Docker containers. Secure, lightweight, and launch-ready.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Product</h4>
            <ul className="space-y-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <li><Link to="/features" className="hover:text-primary transition-colors">Features</Link></li>
              <li><Link to="/pricing" className="hover:text-primary transition-colors">Pricing</Link></li>

<file path="src/components/settings/OrganizationMembersWorkspace.tsx">
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import { Download, Loader2, MailPlus, MoreHorizontal, Search, Shield, UserMinus, Users } from "lucide-react";

import {
  useInviteOrganizationMember,
  useOrganizationAccess,
  useRemoveOrganizationMember,
  useResendOrganizationInvitation,
  useRevokeOrganizationInvitation,
  useUpdateOrganizationMemberRole,
} from "@/hooks/useOrganizationAccess";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/EmptyState";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import type {
  OrganizationAccessInvitation,
  OrganizationAccessMember,
  OrganizationAccessResponse,
  OrganizationInvitationFormValues,
  OrganizationMemberRole,
} from "@/types/organization-access";

type AccessRow =
  | (OrganizationAccessMember & { row_type: "member"; row_id: string; display_name: string; secondary_text: string })
  | (OrganizationAccessInvitation & { row_type: "invitation"; row_id: string; display_name: string; secondary_text: string });

const ROLE_OPTIONS: OrganizationMemberRole[] = ["owner", "admin", "member"];

function formatDate(value: string) {
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString();
}

function createRows(data?: OrganizationAccessResponse | null): AccessRow[] {
  if (!data) return [];

  const memberRows: AccessRow[] = data.members.map((member) => ({
    ...member,
    row_type: "member",
    row_id: member.user_id,
    display_name: member.full_name || member.email,
    secondary_text: member.email,
  }));

  const invitationRows: AccessRow[] = data.invitations.map((invitation) => ({
    ...invitation,
    row_type: "invitation",
    row_id: invitation.id,
    display_name: invitation.email,
    secondary_text: invitation.expires_at ? `Expires ${formatDate(invitation.expires_at)}` : "Pending invite",
  }));

  return [...memberRows, ...invitationRows];
}

function buildCsv(rows: AccessRow[]) {
  const lines = [
    ["name", "email", "role", "status", "joined_or_invited_at"],
    ...rows.map((row) => [
      row.display_name,
      row.email,
      row.role,
      row.status,
      row.row_type === "member" ? row.joined_at : row.created_at,
    ]),
  ];

  return lines
    .map((columns) =>
      columns
        .map((column) => `"${String(column).replaceAll('"', '""')}"`)
        .join(","),
    )
    .join("\n");
}

function downloadCsv(rows: AccessRow[]) {
  const blob = new Blob([buildCsv(rows)], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = "organization-members.csv";
  link.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function SummaryCard({ label, value, helper }: { label: string; value: number; helper: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card/70 p-4">
      <div className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-end gap-2">
        <span className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{value}</span>
        <span className="pb-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{helper}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function InviteMemberDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  saving,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  saving?: boolean;
  onSubmit: (values: OrganizationInvitationFormValues) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<OrganizationInvitationFormValues>({ email: "", role: "member" });

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    await onSubmit(values);
    setValues({ email: "", role: "member" });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Invite member</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Send an organization invitation using the current active organization in Clerk.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid gap-4 py-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="invite-email">Email</Label>
            <Input
              id="invite-email"
              type="email"
              value={values.email}
              placeholder="teammate@example.com"
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, email: event.target.value }))}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Role</Label>
            <Select value={values.role} onValueChange={(value) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, role: value as OrganizationMemberRole }))}>
              <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((role) => (
                  <SelectItem key={role} value={role}>{role}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button disabled={saving || !values.email.trim()} onClick={handleSubmit}>
            {saving ? "Sending..." : "Send invite"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export function OrganizationMembersWorkspaceView({
  data,
  canManage,
  isLoading,
  activeOrgName,
  inviteSaving,
  pendingMemberId,
  pendingInvitationId,
  onInvite,
  onRoleChange,
  onRemoveMember,
  onResendInvitation,
  onRevokeInvitation,
}: {
  data?: OrganizationAccessResponse | null;
  canManage: boolean;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  activeOrgName?: string | null;
  inviteSaving?: boolean;
  pendingMemberId?: string | null;
  pendingInvitationId?: string | null;
  onInvite: (values: OrganizationInvitationFormValues) => Promise<void>;
  onRoleChange: (userId: string, role: OrganizationMemberRole) => Promise<void>;
  onRemoveMember: (userId: string) => Promise<void>;
  onResendInvitation: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  onRevokeInvitation: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<"all" | "active" | "invited">("all");
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<"all" | OrganizationMemberRole>("all");
  const [inviteOpen, setInviteOpen] = useState(false);

  const rows = useMemo(() => createRows(data), [data]);
  const filteredRows = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return rows.filter((row) => {
      if (statusFilter !== "all" && row.status !== statusFilter) return false;
      if (roleFilter !== "all" && row.role !== roleFilter) return false;
      if (!query) return true;
      return [row.display_name, row.email, row.secondary_text].some((value) => value.toLowerCase().includes(query));
    });
  }, [roleFilter, rows, search, statusFilter]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="glass-card flex min-h-64 items-center justify-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) {
    return (
      <div className="glass-card">
        <EmptyState
          icon={Users}
          title="No active organization"
          description="Select an organization to view members and invitations."
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
          <SummaryCard label="Members" value={data.summary.members_count} helper={activeOrgName || "Active organization"} />
          <SummaryCard label="Pending Invites" value={data.summary.pending_invites_count} helper="Awaiting acceptance" />
          <SummaryCard label="Admins" value={data.summary.admins_count} helper="Owner and admin roles" />
        </div>

        <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-border px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Team members</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Manage accepted members and pending invitations for your organization.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => downloadCsv(filteredRows)} disabled={filteredRows.length === 0}>
                <Download className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Export CSV
              </Button>
              {canManage ? (
                <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setInviteOpen(true)}>
                  <MailPlus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Invite member
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-border px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <div className="relative w-full lg:max-w-sm">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search name or email"
                className="pl-9"
              />
            </div>

            <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={(value) => setStatusFilter(value as "all" | "active" | "invited")}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full lg:w-[180px]"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="active">Active</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="invited">Invited</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>

            <Select value={roleFilter} onValueChange={(value) => setRoleFilter(value as "all" | OrganizationMemberRole)}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full lg:w-[180px]"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All roles</SelectItem>
                {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((role) => (
                  <SelectItem key={role} value={role}>{role}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          {filteredRows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Shield}
              title="No matching members"
              description="Adjust your search or filters, or invite a teammate to get started."
              actionLabel={canManage ? "Invite member" : undefined}
              onAction={canManage ? () => setInviteOpen(true) : undefined}
            />
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="bg-muted/20">
                  <TableHead>User</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Joined / Invited</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="w-[72px] text-right">Actions</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {filteredRows.map((row) => (
                  <TableRow key={row.row_id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <Avatar className="h-9 w-9">
                          {"avatar_url" in row && row.avatar_url ? <AvatarImage src={row.avatar_url} alt="" /> : null}
                          <AvatarFallback>{row.display_name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</AvatarFallback>
                        </Avatar>
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-medium">{row.display_name}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{row.secondary_text}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell><StatusBadge status={row.role} /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell><StatusBadge status={row.status} /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden md:table-cell text-muted-foreground">
                      {row.row_type === "member" ? formatDate(row.joined_at) : formatDate(row.created_at)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      {canManage ? (
                        <DropdownMenu>
                          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label={`Actions for ${row.display_name}`}>
                              <MoreHorizontal className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </Button>
                          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                          <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                            <DropdownMenuLabel>Member actions</DropdownMenuLabel>
                            {row.row_type === "member" ? (
                              <>
                                <DropdownMenuSub>
                                  <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>Change role</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                                  <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                                    {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((role) => (
                                      <DropdownMenuItem
                                        key={role}
                                        disabled={row.role === role || pendingMemberId === row.user_id}
                                        onClick={() => onRoleChange(row.user_id, role)}
                                      >
                                        {pendingMemberId === row.user_id && row.role !== role ? "Updating..." : role}
                                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                                    ))}
                                  </DropdownMenuSubContent>
                                </DropdownMenuSub>
                                <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                                <DropdownMenuItem
                                  className="text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
                                  disabled={pendingMemberId === row.user_id}
                                  onClick={() => onRemoveMember(row.user_id)}
                                >
                                  <UserMinus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                                  {pendingMemberId === row.user_id ? "Removing..." : "Remove member"}
                                </DropdownMenuItem>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                <DropdownMenuItem
                                  disabled={pendingInvitationId === row.id}
                                  onClick={() => onResendInvitation(row.id)}
                                >
                                  {pendingInvitationId === row.id ? "Resending..." : "Resend invite"}
                                </DropdownMenuItem>
                                <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                                <DropdownMenuItem
                                  className="text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
                                  disabled={pendingInvitationId === row.id}
                                  onClick={() => onRevokeInvitation(row.id)}
                                >
                                  {pendingInvitationId === row.id ? "Revoking..." : "Revoke invite"}
                                </DropdownMenuItem>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </DropdownMenuContent>
                        </DropdownMenu>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Read only</span>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <InviteMemberDialog
        open={inviteOpen}
        onOpenChange={setInviteOpen}
        saving={inviteSaving}
        onSubmit={async (values) => {
          await onInvite(values);
          setInviteOpen(false);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export function OrganizationMembersWorkspaceContainer() {
  const { organization } = useOrganization();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const accessQuery = useOrganizationAccess(organization?.id);
  const inviteMutation = useInviteOrganizationMember();
  const updateRoleMutation = useUpdateOrganizationMemberRole();
  const removeMemberMutation = useRemoveOrganizationMember();
  const resendInvitationMutation = useResendOrganizationInvitation();
  const revokeInvitationMutation = useRevokeOrganizationInvitation();

  const handleError = (title: string, error: unknown) => {
    toast({
      title,
      description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
      variant: "destructive",
    });
  };

  return (
    <OrganizationMembersWorkspaceView
      data={accessQuery.data}
      canManage={accessQuery.data?.can_manage_members ?? false}
      isLoading={accessQuery.isLoading}
      activeOrgName={organization?.name}
      inviteSaving={inviteMutation.isPending}
      pendingMemberId={updateRoleMutation.isPending ? updateRoleMutation.variables?.userId : removeMemberMutation.isPending ? removeMemberMutation.variables : null}
      pendingInvitationId={
        resendInvitationMutation.isPending ? resendInvitationMutation.variables :
          revokeInvitationMutation.isPending ? revokeInvitationMutation.variables :
            null
      }
      onInvite={async (values) => {
        try {
          await inviteMutation.mutateAsync(values);
          toast({ title: "Invitation sent" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to send invitation", error);
          throw error;
        }
      }}
      onRoleChange={async (userId, role) => {
        try {
          await updateRoleMutation.mutateAsync({ userId, role });
          toast({ title: "Member role updated" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to update member role", error);
        }
      }}
      onRemoveMember={async (userId) => {
        try {
          await removeMemberMutation.mutateAsync(userId);
          toast({ title: "Member removed" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to remove member", error);
        }
      }}
      onResendInvitation={async (id) => {
        try {
          await resendInvitationMutation.mutateAsync(id);
          toast({ title: "Invitation resent" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to resend invitation", error);
        }
      }}
      onRevokeInvitation={async (id) => {
        try {
          await revokeInvitationMutation.mutateAsync(id);
          toast({ title: "Invitation revoked" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to revoke invitation", error);
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/settings/SlackDestinationDialog.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import type { SlackDestination } from "@/types/database";
import type { SlackDestinationFormValues } from "@/types/alerts";

function toInitialValues(destination?: SlackDestination | null): SlackDestinationFormValues {
  return {
    name: destination?.name ?? "",
    webhook_url: "",
    enabled: destination?.enabled ?? true,
  };
}

export function SlackDestinationDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  destination,
  saving,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  destination?: SlackDestination | null;
  saving?: boolean;
  onSubmit: (values: SlackDestinationFormValues) => void;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<SlackDestinationFormValues>(toInitialValues(destination));

  useEffect(() => {
    setValues(toInitialValues(destination));
  }, [destination, open]);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{destination ? "Edit Slack destination" : "Add Slack destination"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Add a Slack Incoming Webhook URL to send alert notifications into a Slack channel.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid gap-4 py-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="slack-name">Name</Label>
            <Input
              id="slack-name"
              value={values.name}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, name: event.target.value }))}
              placeholder="Ops channel"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="slack-webhook-url">Slack Incoming Webhook URL</Label>
            <Input
              id="slack-webhook-url"
              type="password"
              value={values.webhook_url}
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, webhook_url: event.target.value }))}
              placeholder={destination ? "Leave blank to keep existing webhook URL" : "https://hooks.slack.com/services/..."}
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              The webhook URL is stored encrypted and used to send alert messages to Slack.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-3">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Destination enabled</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disabled Slack destinations stay stored but won&apos;t receive alert notifications.</p>
            </div>
            <Switch checked={values.enabled} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, enabled: checked }))} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => onSubmit(values)} disabled={saving || !values.name.trim() || (!destination && !values.webhook_url.trim())}>
            {saving ? "Saving..." : destination ? "Save changes" : "Create destination"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
