import * as React from "react";
import * as ToastPrimitives from "@radix-ui/react-toast";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const ToastProvider = ToastPrimitives.Provider;

const ToastViewport = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Viewport>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Viewport>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Viewport
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "fixed top-0 z-[100] flex max-h-screen w-full flex-col-reverse p-4 sm:bottom-0 sm:right-0 sm:top-auto sm:flex-col md:max-w-[420px]",
      className,
    )}
    {...props}
  />
));
ToastViewport.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Viewport.displayName;

const toastVariants = cva(
  "group pointer-events-auto relative flex w-full items-center justify-between space-x-4 overflow-hidden rounded-md border p-6 pr-8 shadow-lg transition-all data-[swipe=cancel]:translate-x-0 data-[swipe=end]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-end-x)] data-[swipe=move]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-move-x)] data-[swipe=move]:transition-none data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[swipe=end]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-80 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-right-full data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top-full data-[state=open]:sm:slide-in-from-bottom-full",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "border bg-background text-foreground",
        destructive: "destructive group border-destructive bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  },
);

const Toast = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root> & VariantProps<typeof toastVariants>
>(({ className, variant, ...props }, ref) => {
  return <ToastPrimitives.Root ref={ref} className={cn(toastVariants({ variant }), className)} {...props} />;
});
Toast.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Root.displayName;

const ToastAction = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Action>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Action>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Action
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-colors group-[.destructive]:border-muted/40 hover:bg-secondary group-[.destructive]:hover:border-destructive/30 group-[.destructive]:hover:bg-destructive group-[.destructive]:hover:text-destructive-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 group-[.destructive]:focus:ring-destructive disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
      className,
    )}
    {...props}
  />
));
ToastAction.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Action.displayName;

const ToastClose = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Close>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Close>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Close
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "absolute right-2 top-2 rounded-md p-1 text-foreground/50 opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 group-[.destructive]:text-red-300 hover:text-foreground group-[.destructive]:hover:text-red-50 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 group-[.destructive]:focus:ring-red-400 group-[.destructive]:focus:ring-offset-red-600",
      className,
    )}
    toast-close=""
    {...props}
  >
    <X className="h-4 w-4" />
  </ToastPrimitives.Close>
));
ToastClose.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Close.displayName;

const ToastTitle = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Title>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Title>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Title ref={ref} className={cn("text-sm font-semibold", className)} {...props} />
));
ToastTitle.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Title.displayName;

const ToastDescription = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Description>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Description>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Description ref={ref} className={cn("text-sm opacity-90", className)} {...props} />
));
ToastDescription.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Description.displayName;

type ToastProps = React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Toast>;

type ToastActionElement = React.ReactElement<typeof ToastAction>;

export {
  type ToastProps,
  type ToastActionElement,
  ToastProvider,
  ToastViewport,
  Toast,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastClose,
  ToastAction,
};
</file>

<file path="src/components/ui/toaster.tsx">
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { Toast, ToastClose, ToastDescription, ToastProvider, ToastTitle, ToastViewport } from "@/components/ui/toast";

export function Toaster() {
  const { toasts } = useToast();

  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      {toasts.map(function ({ id, title, description, action, ...props }) {
        return (
          <Toast key={id} {...props}>
            <div className="grid gap-1">
              {title && <ToastTitle>{title}</ToastTitle>}
              {description && <ToastDescription>{description}</ToastDescription>}
            </div>
            {action}
            <ToastClose />
          </Toast>
        );
      })}
      <ToastViewport />
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/ui/toggle-group.tsx">
import * as React from "react";
import * as ToggleGroupPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-toggle-group";
import { type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { toggleVariants } from "@/components/ui/toggle";

const ToggleGroupContext = React.createContext<VariantProps<typeof toggleVariants>>({
  size: "default",
  variant: "default",
});

const ToggleGroup = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root> & VariantProps<typeof toggleVariants>
>(({ className, variant, size, children, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root ref={ref} className={cn("flex items-center justify-center gap-1", className)} {...props}>
    <ToggleGroupContext.Provider value={{ variant, size }}>{children}</ToggleGroupContext.Provider>
  </ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root>
));

ToggleGroup.displayName = ToggleGroupPrimitive.Root.displayName;

const ToggleGroupItem = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item> & VariantProps<typeof toggleVariants>
>(({ className, children, variant, size, ...props }, ref) => {
  const context = React.useContext(ToggleGroupContext);

  return (
    <ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        toggleVariants({
          variant: context.variant || variant,
          size: context.size || size,
        }),
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item>
  );
});

ToggleGroupItem.displayName = ToggleGroupPrimitive.Item.displayName;

export { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem };
</file>

<file path="src/components/AppRootRedirect.tsx">
import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled } from "@/lib/hostname";

/**
 * Root redirect for the app subdomain (app.dockerdash.app).
 *
 * - Signed in  → /app  (dashboard)
 * - Signed out → /login
 * - Loading    → spinner
 */
export default function AppRootRedirect() {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const previewBypass = isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled();

  if (previewBypass) {
    return <Navigate to="/app" replace />;
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-background">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isSignedIn) {
    return <Navigate to="/app" replace />;
  }

  return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
}
</file>

import { NavLink as RouterNavLink, NavLinkProps } from "react-router-dom";
import { forwardRef } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface NavLinkCompatProps extends Omit<NavLinkProps, "className"> {
  className?: string;
  activeClassName?: string;
  pendingClassName?: string;
}

const NavLink = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, NavLinkCompatProps>(
  ({ className, activeClassName, pendingClassName, to, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <RouterNavLink
        ref={ref}
        to={to}
        className={({ isActive, isPending }) =>
          cn(className, isActive && activeClassName, isPending && pendingClassName)
        }
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);

NavLink.displayName = "NavLink";

export { NavLink };
</file>

<file path="src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx">
import { Navigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled } from "@/lib/hostname";
import { useAuthMe, type AuthMeState } from "@/hooks/useAuthMe";

interface ProtectedRouteProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  requireOnboarded?: boolean;
  allowMissingOrganization?: boolean;
  skipResolvedRedirect?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Main application routing gate.
 * 
 * Responsibilities:
 * 1. Clerk Auth Verification
 * 2. Backend State Sync (/api/auth/me)
 * 3. Dedicated Deployment Blocking
 * 4. Onboarding & Org Requirements
 */
export function ProtectedRoute({
  children,
  requireOnboarded = true,
  allowMissingOrganization = false,
  skipResolvedRedirect = false,
}: ProtectedRouteProps) {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const previewBypass = isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled();
  
  // Custom hook encapsulates fetch/retry/polling logic (flattens CC)
  const authMe = useAuthMe(!previewBypass);

  // 1. System-level bypass (Previews/Local Dev)
  if (previewBypass) return <>{children}</>;

  // 2. Auth Loading State
  if (!isLoaded || authMe.status === "loading") {
    return <FullScreenLoader />;
  }

  // 3. Unauthenticated State
  if (!isSignedIn || authMe.status === "unauthenticated") {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  // 4. Backend Synchronization Error
  if (authMe.status === "error") {
    return <AuthErrorState />;
  }

  // 5. State-driven Redirect Logic (flattens "Bumpy Road")
  const redirect = getRedirectTarget({
    state: authMe,
    pathname: location.pathname,
    requireOnboarded,
    allowMissingOrganization,
    skipResolvedRedirect
  });

  if (redirect) {
    return <Navigate to={redirect} replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

/**
 * Pure helper to determine redirect target based on application state.
 */
function getRedirectTarget({
  state,
  pathname,
  requireOnboarded,
  allowMissingOrganization,
  skipResolvedRedirect
}: {
  state: AuthMeState;
  pathname: string;
  requireOnboarded: boolean;
  allowMissingOrganization: boolean;
  skipResolvedRedirect: boolean;
}): string | null {
  // --- Route classification ---
  const isOnboardingRoute = pathname.startsWith("/onboarding");
  const isDedicatedIntakeRoute = pathname.startsWith("/dedicated/intake");
  const isDedicatedStatusRoute = pathname.startsWith("/app/dedicated-deployment");

  // --- Business rule predicates ---
  const deploymentInProgress = isDeploymentBlocked(state.dedicatedDeploymentStatus);

  const shouldBlockForDeployment =
    deploymentInProgress && !isDedicatedStatusRoute && !isDedicatedIntakeRoute;

  const needsOrgCreation =
    !state.hasOrgs && !allowMissingOrganization && !isOnboardingRoute;

  const shouldForceOnboarding =
    requireOnboarded && state.hasOrgs && state.needsOnboarding &&
    !deploymentInProgress && !isOnboardingRoute;

  const onboardingAlreadyComplete =
    !requireOnboarded && !skipResolvedRedirect && state.hasOrgs &&
    !state.needsOnboarding && !deploymentInProgress;

  // --- Redirect decision (first match wins) ---
  if (shouldBlockForDeployment) return "/app/dedicated-deployment";
  if (needsOrgCreation) return "/onboarding";
  if (shouldForceOnboarding) return "/onboarding";
  if (onboardingAlreadyComplete) return "/app";

  return null;
}

/** Deployment is blocked when status exists but isn't in a terminal state. */
function isDeploymentBlocked(status: string | null): boolean {
  if (status === null) return false;
  const terminalStates = ["ready_for_handoff", "active"];
  return !terminalStates.includes(status);
}

function FullScreenLoader() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-background">
      <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
    </div>
  );
}

function AuthErrorState() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-background px-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">Unable to verify onboarding status right now.</p>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
        className="text-sm font-medium text-primary hover:underline"
      >
        Retry
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/RequireAppSubdomain.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { getAppOrigin, isAppHost } from "@/lib/hostname";

/**
 * Enforces that product routes are only accessible on the app subdomain.
 * Redirects exactly to the matching path on the app subdomain.
 * Safe fallback for localhost development.
 */
export function RequireAppSubdomain({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  if (isAppHost()) {
    return <>{children}</>;
  }

  const targetUrl = `${getAppOrigin()}${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}`;
  window.location.replace(targetUrl);
  return null;

}
</file>

<file path="src/components/RequireFeatureEntitlement.tsx">
import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import type { ViewerEntitlements } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";

interface RequireFeatureEntitlementProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  feature: keyof Pick<
    ViewerEntitlements,
    "canUseTeamCollaboration" | "canUseSlackDestinations" | "canUseWebhookDestinations" | "canUseAdvancedAlerts" | "canUseFileManager"
  >;
  fallbackPath?: string;
}

export function RequireFeatureEntitlement({
  children,
  feature,
  fallbackPath = "/app/billing",
}: RequireFeatureEntitlementProps) {
  const { data: viewer, isLoading } = useViewerState();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[40vh] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!viewer?.entitlements?.[feature]) {
    return <Navigate to={fallbackPath} replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/RequirePlatformAdmin.tsx">
import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";

export function RequirePlatformAdmin({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { data: viewer, isLoading, error } = useViewerState();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !viewer?.is_platform_admin) {
    return <Navigate to="/app" replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx">
import * as React from "react";

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768;

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    };
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, []);

  return !!isMobile;
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/use-toast.ts">
import * as React from "react";

import type { ToastActionElement, ToastProps } from "@/components/ui/toast";

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1;
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  action?: ToastActionElement;
};

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const;

let count = 0;

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  return count.toString();
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;

type Action =
  | {
      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"];
      toast: ToasterToast;
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"];
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>;
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"];
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"];
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    };

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[];
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return;
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    });
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
};

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      };

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) => (t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t)),
      };

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action;

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
        });
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t,
        ),
      };
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        };
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      };
  }
};

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = [];

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState);
  });
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">;

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId();

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    });
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id });

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss();
      },
    },
  });

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  };
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState);
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }, [state]);

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  };
}

export { useToast, toast };
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useAdmin.ts">
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { adminApi } from "@/services/admin-api";
import type { AdminBillingUpdate } from "@/types/admin";

const adminQueryOptions = {
  retry: false as const,
  refetchOnWindowFocus: false as const,
  refetchOnReconnect: false as const,
};

export function useAdminOverview() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: ["admin-overview"], queryFn: adminApi.getOverview, ...adminQueryOptions });
}

export function useAdminUsers() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: ["admin-users"], queryFn: adminApi.getUsers, ...adminQueryOptions });
}

export function useAdminUser(userId: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["admin-user", userId],
    queryFn: () => adminApi.getUser(userId!),

  });

function useAdminMutation<TVariables>(mutationFn: (variables: TVariables) => Promise<unknown>) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn,
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-overview"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-user"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-organizations"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-organization"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-hosts"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-audit-log"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-operations"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-billing-unmatched"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-donor-email-deliveries"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-donor-email-delivery"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-notifications"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["auth-me"] });
    },
  });
}

function invalidateAlertsQueries(queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>) {

<file path="src/hooks/useAuthMe.ts">
import { useAuth, useClerk } from "@clerk/react";
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { normalizeOnboardingStatus, deriveNeedsOnboarding, type OnboardingStatus } from "@/lib/onboarding-gate";

export interface AuthMeState {
  status: "loading" | "resolved" | "error" | "unauthenticated";
  hasOrgs: boolean;
  onboardingStatus: OnboardingStatus;
  needsOnboarding: boolean;
  activeOrgPlan: string | null;
  dedicatedDeploymentStatus: string | null;
}

const initialState: AuthMeState = {
  status: "loading",
  hasOrgs: false,
  onboardingStatus: null,
  needsOnboarding: true,
  activeOrgPlan: null,
  dedicatedDeploymentStatus: null,
};

const unauthenticatedState: AuthMeState = {
  status: "unauthenticated",
  hasOrgs: false,
  onboardingStatus: null,
  needsOnboarding: true,
  activeOrgPlan: null,
  dedicatedDeploymentStatus: null,
};

export function useAuthMe(enabled: boolean) {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn, getToken } = useAuth();
  const { signOut } = useClerk();
  const [state, setState] = useState<AuthMeState>(initialState);

  const fetchAuthMe = useCallback(async (cancelled: { current: boolean }) => {
    const maxAttempts = 5;

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      try {
        const token = await getToken({ skipCache: attempt > 1 });

        if (!token) {
          if (!cancelled.current) setState(unauthenticatedState);
          return;
        }

        const res = await fetch("/api/auth/me", {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });

        // 202 Accepted: Initial setup in progress, retry
        if (res.status === 202) {
          const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          if (data?.retry) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
            continue;
          }
        }

        // 401 Unauthorized: Session invalid or expired
        if (res.status === 401) {
          if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300 * attempt));
            continue;
          }

          if (!cancelled.current) setState(unauthenticatedState);
          await signOut({ redirectUrl: "/login?reauth=1" }).catch(() => {
            window.location.assign("/login?reauth=1");
          });
          return;
        }

        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(`auth/me failed (${res.status})`);
        }

        const data = await res.json();
        const hasOrgs = !!data.user?.has_orgs;
        const onboardingStatus = normalizeOnboardingStatus(data.user?.onboarding_status);
        const needsOnboarding = deriveNeedsOnboarding(hasOrgs, onboardingStatus);

        if (!cancelled.current) {
          setState({
            status: "resolved",
            hasOrgs,
            onboardingStatus,
            needsOnboarding,
            activeOrgPlan: data.user?.active_org_plan ?? null,
            dedicatedDeploymentStatus: data.user?.dedicated_deployment_status ?? null,
          });
        }
        return;
      } catch (error) {
        if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300 * attempt));
          continue;
        }

        if (!cancelled.current) {
          setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: "error" }));
        }
      }
    }
  }, [getToken, signOut]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || !isLoaded) return;

    if (!isSignedIn) {
      setState(unauthenticatedState);
      return;
    }

    const cancelled = { current: false };
    fetchAuthMe(cancelled);

    return () => {
      cancelled.current = true;
    };
  }, [enabled, isLoaded, isSignedIn, fetchAuthMe]);

  return state;
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useDedicatedDeployment.ts">
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useOrganizationList } from "@clerk/react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { dedicatedDeploymentApi } from "@/services/dedicated-deployment-api";
import type {
  DedicatedDeploymentIntake,
  DedicatedDeploymentRecord,
  DedicatedIntakeState,
  DedicatedIntakeStep,
} from "@/types/dedicated";

export const DEDICATED_STEPS: DedicatedIntakeStep[] = [
  "scope",
  "infrastructure",
  "security",
  "integrations",
  "readiness",
  "review",
  "submitted",
];

export const DEFAULT_DEDICATED_INTAKE: DedicatedDeploymentIntake = {
  companyName: "",
  primaryContactName: "",
  primaryContactEmail: "",
  buyerRole: "",
  targetGoLiveWindow: "30_days",
  estimatedNodeRange: "6_15",
  environmentCount: 1,
  preferredRegion: "eu-central",
  secondaryRegions: [],
  needsCustomDomain: true,
  needsPrivateNetworking: false,
  complianceNeeds: [],
  retentionRequirementDays: 365,
  requiresSSO: true,
  integrations: [],
  technicalOwnerName: "",
  technicalOwnerEmail: "",
  operatorSeatEstimate: 5,
  hasExistingDockerAgentRollout: false,
  rolloutNotes: "",
  blockers: "",
};

function sanitizeOrgName(value: string) {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return trimmed.length > 2 ? trimmed : "Dedicated Deployment";
}

async function waitForActiveOrganization(maxAttempts = 12) {
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt += 1) {
    const data = await apiFetch("/auth/me");
    const activeOrgId = data.user?.active_org_id as string | null | undefined;
    if (activeOrgId) {
      return activeOrgId;
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 500 * attempt));
  }

  throw new Error("Workspace sync is still in progress. Please retry in a moment.");
}

export function useDedicatedDeployment() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["dedicated-deployment", "current"],
    queryFn: () => dedicatedDeploymentApi.getCurrent(),
    staleTime: 15_000,
    retry: false,
  });
}

export function useDedicatedIntakeState() {
  const { createOrganization, setActive, userMemberships } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: { infinite: true },
  });

  const [state, setState] = useState<DedicatedIntakeState>({
    step: "scope",
    data: DEFAULT_DEDICATED_INTAKE,
    isSaving: false,
    isSubmitting: false,
    submitError: null,
    referenceId: null,
  });

  const stepIndex = useMemo(() => DEDICATED_STEPS.indexOf(state.step), [state.step]);

  const updateField = <K extends keyof DedicatedDeploymentIntake>(key: K, value: DedicatedDeploymentIntake[K]) => {
    setState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      data: {
        ...current.data,
        [key]: value,
      },
      submitError: null,
    }));
  };

  const toggleArrayValue = (
    key: "secondaryRegions" | "complianceNeeds" | "integrations",
    value: string,
  ) => {
    setState((current) => {
      const existing = current.data[key] as string[];
      const next = existing.includes(value)
        ? existing.filter((item) => item !== value)
        : [...existing, value];

      return {
        ...current,
        data: {
          ...current.data,
          [key]: next,
        },
        submitError: null,
      };
    });
  };

  const nextStep = () => {
    setState((current) => {
      const currentIndex = DEDICATED_STEPS.indexOf(current.step);
      const next = DEDICATED_STEPS[Math.min(currentIndex + 1, DEDICATED_STEPS.length - 2)];
      return { ...current, step: next, submitError: null };
    });
  };

  const previousStep = () => {
    setState((current) => {
      const currentIndex = DEDICATED_STEPS.indexOf(current.step);
      const prev = DEDICATED_STEPS[Math.max(currentIndex - 1, 0)];
      return { ...current, step: prev, submitError: null };
    });
  };

  const ensureWorkspace = async () => {
    const auth = await apiFetch("/auth/me");
    const activeOrgId = auth.user?.active_org_id as string | null | undefined;
    if (activeOrgId) {
      return activeOrgId;
    }

    const firstMembership = userMemberships.data?.[0]?.organization?.id;
    if (firstMembership && setActive) {
      await setActive({ organization: firstMembership });
      return waitForActiveOrganization();
    }

    if (!createOrganization || !setActive) {
      throw new Error("Workspace tools are not ready yet. Please refresh and try again.");
    }

    const org = await createOrganization({ name: sanitizeOrgName(state.data.companyName) });
    await setActive({ organization: org.id });
    return waitForActiveOrganization();
  };

  const submit = async (): Promise<DedicatedDeploymentRecord> => {
    setState((current) => ({ ...current, isSubmitting: true, submitError: null }));

    try {
      await ensureWorkspace();
      const result = await dedicatedDeploymentApi.create(state.data);
      setState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        step: "submitted",
        isSubmitting: false,
        referenceId: result.reference_id,
      }));
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not submit the deployment request.";
      setState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        isSubmitting: false,
        submitError: message,
      }));
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return {
    state,
    stepIndex,
    updateField,
    toggleArrayValue,
    nextStep,
    previousStep,
    submit,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useDestinationSettings.ts">
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useCreateSlackDestination,
  useSlackDestinations,
  useTestSlackDestination,
  useUpdateSlackDestination,
} from "@/hooks/useSlackDestinations";
import {
  useCreateWebhookDestination,
  useTestWebhookDestination,
  useUpdateWebhookDestination,
  useWebhookDestinations,
} from "@/hooks/useWebhookDestinations";
import type { SlackDestinationFormValues, WebhookDestinationFormValues } from "@/types/alerts";

// ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface TestResult {
  succeeded: boolean;
  http_status?: number;
  error_summary?: string;
}

/** Show a success/failure toast for a destination test attempt. */
function buildTestToast(attempt: TestResult, label: string) {
  if (attempt.succeeded) {
    return {
      title: `${label} test delivered`,
      description: attempt.http_status
        ? `${label} responded with ${attempt.http_status}.`
        : `${label} accepted the test message.`,
    } as const;
  }
  return {
    title: `${label} test failed`,
    description: attempt.error_summary ?? `${label} did not accept the test message.`,
    variant: "destructive",
  } as const;
}

// ── Hook ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useDestinationSettings(orgId: string | undefined, canSlack: boolean, canWebhook: boolean) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [latestSecret, setLatestSecret] = useState<{ destinationName: string; value: string } | null>(null);

  /** Run a mutation and show a toast, catching errors uniformly. */
  async function run<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, successTitle: string, errorTitle: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
    try {
      const result = await fn();
      toast({ title: successTitle });
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: errorTitle,
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  // ── Slack queries & mutations ─────────────────────────────────────
  const slackQuery = useSlackDestinations(orgId, canSlack);
  const createSlackMut = useCreateSlackDestination();
  const updateSlackMut = useUpdateSlackDestination();
  const testSlackMut = useTestSlackDestination();

  const handleCreateSlack = (values: SlackDestinationFormValues) =>
    run(() => createSlackMut.mutateAsync(values), "Slack destination created", "Failed to create Slack destination");

  const handleUpdateSlack = (id: string, values: Partial<SlackDestinationFormValues>) =>
    run(() => updateSlackMut.mutateAsync({ id, values }), "Slack destination updated", "Failed to update Slack destination");

  const handleTestSlack = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const attempt = await testSlackMut.mutateAsync(id);
      toast(buildTestToast(attempt, "Slack"));
    } catch (error) {
      toast({ title: "Failed to send Slack test", description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error", variant: "destructive" });
    }
  };

  // ── Webhook queries & mutations ───────────────────────────────────
  const webhookQuery = useWebhookDestinations(orgId, canWebhook);
  const createWebhookMut = useCreateWebhookDestination();
  const updateWebhookMut = useUpdateWebhookDestination();
  const testWebhookMut = useTestWebhookDestination();

  const handleCreateWebhook = async (values: WebhookDestinationFormValues) => {
    const result = await run(
      () => createWebhookMut.mutateAsync(values),
      "Webhook destination created",
      "Failed to create webhook destination",
    );
    if (result?.signing_secret) {
      setLatestSecret({ destinationName: result.destination.name, value: result.signing_secret });
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateWebhook = async (id: string, values: Partial<WebhookDestinationFormValues> & { regenerate_secret?: boolean }) => {
    const result = await run(
      () => updateWebhookMut.mutateAsync({ id, values }),
      "Webhook destination updated",
      "Failed to update webhook destination",
    );
    if (result?.signing_secret) {
      setLatestSecret({ destinationName: result.destination.name, value: result.signing_secret });
      toast({ title: "Signing secret regenerated" });
    }
  };

  const handleTestWebhook = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const attempt = await testWebhookMut.mutateAsync(id);
      toast(buildTestToast(attempt, "Endpoint"));
    } catch (error) {
      toast({ title: "Failed to send webhook test", description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error", variant: "destructive" });
    }
  };

  // ── Return ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return {
    slack: {
      destinations: slackQuery.data?.destinations ?? [],
      canManage: slackQuery.data?.can_manage ?? false,
      saving: createSlackMut.isPending || updateSlackMut.isPending,
      testingId: testSlackMut.isPending ? testSlackMut.variables : null,
      onCreate: handleCreateSlack,
      onUpdate: handleUpdateSlack,
      onTest: handleTestSlack,
    },
    webhook: {
      destinations: webhookQuery.data?.destinations ?? [],
      canManage: webhookQuery.data?.can_manage ?? false,
      saving: createWebhookMut.isPending || updateWebhookMut.isPending,
      testingId: testWebhookMut.isPending ? testWebhookMut.variables : null,
      latestSecret,
      onCreate: handleCreateWebhook,
      onUpdate: handleUpdateWebhook,
      onTest: handleTestWebhook,
      onDismissSecret: () => setLatestSecret(null),
    },
  };
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useDocker.ts">
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import type { DockerHost, ConnectionMode } from "@/types/database";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { normalizePlan, PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN } from "../../shared/schema/plan-policy";

// ── Shared types & helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────

/** Shared secrets shape for host mutations */
interface HostSecrets {
  agentApiKey?: string;
  cfServiceTokenId?: string;
  cfServiceTokenSecret?: string;
}

/** Shared fields for host create/update (WR-02) */
interface HostMutationBase {
  name: string;
  hostUrl: string;
  connectionMode: ConnectionMode;
  dockerSocketPath?: string;
  secrets: HostSecrets;
}

/** Build the API body from host mutation fields */
function buildHostBody(fields: HostMutationBase) {
  return {
    name: fields.name,
    host_url: fields.hostUrl,
    connection_mode: fields.connectionMode,
    docker_socket_path: fields.dockerSocketPath || '/var/run/docker.sock',
    secrets: fields.secrets,
  };
}

/** Resolve effective node limit from viewer entitlements + plan policy (WR-01) */
function resolveNodeLimit(viewer: any): number | null {
  const entitlements = viewer?.entitlements;
  // When entitlements are loaded, use nodeLimit directly — null means unlimited
  // (enterprise/dedicated plans). Only fall back to plan policy when entitlements
  // haven't loaded yet (viewer is undefined/null).
  if (entitlements) {
    return entitlements.nodeLimit; // null = unlimited, number = capped
  }
  const activePlan = normalizePlan(viewer?.active_org_effective_plan);
  return PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN[activePlan].nodeLimit;
}

/** Sort hosts by creation date (oldest first), breaking ties by ID (WR-01) */
function sortHostsByCreation(hosts: DockerHost[]): DockerHost[] {
  return [...hosts].sort((a, b) => {
    const dateA = new Date(a.created_at).getTime() || 0;
    const dateB = new Date(b.created_at).getTime() || 0;
    return dateA - dateB || a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
  });
}

/** Log query options parameter object (WR-03) */
interface ContainerLogOptions {
  tail?: number | string;
  since?: number;
  until?: number;
}

// ── Hooks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useDockerHosts(orgId?: string | null, options: { filterByPlan?: boolean } = {}) {
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['docker-hosts', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      return (await apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?orgId=${orgId}`)) as DockerHost[];
    },
    select: (hosts) => {
      if (!options.filterByPlan) return hosts;
      const nodeLimit = resolveNodeLimit(viewer);
      if (nodeLimit === null) return hosts;
      return sortHostsByCreation(hosts).slice(0, nodeLimit);
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error ? false : 15000),
  });
}

export function useAddDockerHost() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ orgId, ...fields }: { orgId: string } & HostMutationBase) => {
      const data = await apiFetch('/docker-hosts', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ organization_id: orgId, ...buildHostBody(fields) }),
      });
      return data as DockerHost;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['docker-hosts'] });
    },
  });
}

export function useDeleteDockerHost() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (hostId: string) => {
      await apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?hostId=${hostId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['docker-hosts'] });
    },
  });
}

export function useUpdateDockerHost() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ hostId, ...fields }: { hostId: string } & HostMutationBase) => {
      const data = await apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?hostId=${hostId}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: JSON.stringify(buildHostBody(fields)),
      });
      return data as DockerHost;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['docker-hosts'] });
    },
  });
}

export function useContainers(orgId?: string | null, hasHosts = true, refetchInterval: number | false = 30000) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: allowedHosts } = useDockerHosts(orgId, { filterByPlan: true });

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['containers', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const containers = await dockerApi.allContainers(orgId!);

      // Container fetch succeeded — the agent responded, so the host is alive.
      // Optimistically update host status in cache to eliminate the stale-status
      // gap between this fetch and the next hosts refetch cycle.
      queryClient.setQueryData<DockerHost[]>(['docker-hosts', orgId], (prev) => {
        if (!prev) return prev;
        const respondingHostIds = new Set<string>(
          containers
            .map((c: any) => c._hostId || c.hostId)
            .filter(Boolean),
        );
        if (respondingHostIds.size === 0) return prev;
        let changed = false;
        const updated = prev.map((host) => {
          if (respondingHostIds.has(host.id) && host.status !== 'connected') {
            changed = true;
            return { ...host, status: 'connected', last_seen_at: new Date().toISOString() };
          }
          return host;
        });
        return changed ? updated : prev;
      });

      return containers;
    },
    select: (containers) => {
      if (!allowedHosts) return containers;
      const allowedIds = new Set(allowedHosts.map(h => h.id));
      return containers.filter(c => c.hostId ? allowedIds.has(c.hostId) : allowedIds.has(c._hostId));
    },
    enabled: !!orgId && hasHosts,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval),
  });
}

export function useAllContainerStats(orgId?: string | null, hasHosts = true, refetchInterval: number | false = 15000) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['all-container-stats', orgId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.allContainerStats(orgId!),
    enabled: !!orgId && hasHosts,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval),
  });
}

export function useHostContainers(hostId?: string | null, refetchInterval: number | false = 15000) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['host-containers', hostId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.listContainers(hostId!),
    enabled: !!hostId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval),
  });
}

export function useContainerInspect(hostId?: string | null, containerId?: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['container-inspect', hostId, containerId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.inspectContainer(hostId!, containerId!),
    enabled: !!hostId && !!containerId,
  });
}

export function useContainerStats(
  hostId?: string | null,
  containerId?: string | null,
  refetchInterval: number | false = 10000,
) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['container-stats', hostId, containerId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.containerStats(hostId!, containerId!),
    enabled: !!hostId && !!containerId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval,
  });
}

export function useContainerLogs(
  hostId?: string | null,
  containerId?: string | null,
  options: ContainerLogOptions = {},
) {
  const { tail = 200, since, until } = options;
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['container-logs', hostId, containerId, tail, since, until],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.containerLogs(hostId!, containerId!, tail, since, until),
    enabled: !!hostId && !!containerId,
  });
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useFleetMetrics.ts">
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export interface FleetMetrics {
  timestamp: number;
  time: string;
  cpu: number;
  memory: number;
  usedCores: number;
  totalCores: number;
  memoryUsed: number;
  memoryLimit: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkOutBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskReadBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec: number | null;
  reportingHosts: number;
  totalHosts: number;
  isPartial: boolean;
}

interface FleetMetricsApiPoint {
  timestamp?: string | number;
  time?: string;
  cpu?: number;
  memory?: number;
  usedCores?: number;
  totalCores?: number;
  memoryUsed?: number;
  memoryLimit?: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec?: number;
  networkOutBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskReadBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec?: number;
  reportingHosts?: number;
  totalHosts?: number;
  isPartial?: boolean;
  network_in_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  network_out_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_read_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_write_bytes_per_sec?: number;
}

function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

function toTimestamp(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const numeric = Number(value);
    if (Number.isFinite(numeric)) {
      return numeric;
    }

    const parsed = Date.parse(value);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
      return parsed;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function formatTimeLabel(timestamp: number): string {
  return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false,
  });
}

function normalizeOptionalRate(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (numeric === null || numeric < 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return numeric;
}

function normalizeFleetMetricPoint(point: FleetMetricsApiPoint): FleetMetrics | null {
  const timestamp = toTimestamp(point.timestamp) ?? Date.now();

  const cpu = toFiniteNumber(point.cpu);
  const memory = toFiniteNumber(point.memory);
  const usedCores = toFiniteNumber(point.usedCores);
  const totalCores = toFiniteNumber(point.totalCores);
  const memoryUsed = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryUsed);
  const memoryLimit = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryLimit);
  const networkInBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkInBytesPerSec ?? point.network_in_bytes_per_sec);
  const networkOutBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkOutBytesPerSec ?? point.network_out_bytes_per_sec);
  const diskReadBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskReadBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_read_bytes_per_sec);
  const diskWriteBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskWriteBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_write_bytes_per_sec);
  const reportingHosts = Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(point.reportingHosts) ?? 0);
  const totalHosts = Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(point.totalHosts) ?? 0);
  const isPartial = point.isPartial === true;

  if (
    cpu === null ||
    memory === null ||
    usedCores === null ||
    totalCores === null ||
    memoryUsed === null ||
    memoryLimit === null
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    cpu < 0 ||
    cpu > 100 ||
    memory < 0 ||
    memory > 100 ||
    usedCores < 0 ||
    totalCores < 0 ||
    memoryUsed < 0 ||
    memoryLimit < 0
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  // Reject points that have no usable absolute-capacity context.
  // This filters malformed "all zeros" samples while preserving legitimate 0% usage
  // when capacity is known (e.g. usedCores=0 with totalCores>0).
  if (totalCores === 0 && memoryLimit === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  // Inconsistent points: non-zero percentage without corresponding capacity.
  if ((cpu > 0 && totalCores === 0) || (memory > 0 && memoryLimit === 0)) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    timestamp,
    time: formatTimeLabel(timestamp),
    cpu,
    memory,
    usedCores,
    totalCores,
    memoryUsed,
    memoryLimit,
    networkInBytesPerSec,
    networkOutBytesPerSec,
    diskReadBytesPerSec,
    diskWriteBytesPerSec,
    reportingHosts,
    totalHosts,
    isPartial,
  };
}

export function useFleetMetrics(orgId: string | null | undefined, refetchInterval: number | false = 10000) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['fleet-metrics', orgId],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<FleetMetrics[]> => {
      if (!orgId) {
        return [];
      }

      const data = await apiFetch('/fleet-metrics', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ orgId }),
      });

      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        return [];
      }

      const normalized = data
        .map((point) => normalizeFleetMetricPoint((point ?? {}) as FleetMetricsApiPoint))
        .filter((point): point is FleetMetrics => point !== null);

      return normalized;
    },
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      if (!orgId || refetchInterval === false) return false;
      return query.state.error ? false : refetchInterval;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
  });
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useHostMetrics.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { normalizeHostMetricsPoint } from "./useHostMetrics";

describe("normalizeHostMetricsPoint", () => {
  it("successfully normalizes a valid camelCase sample", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      memory: 60,
      usedCores: 2,
      totalCores: 4,
      memoryUsed: 8000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000,
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.cpu).toBe(45);
    expect(result?.totalCores).toBe(4);
  });

  it("successfully normalizes a valid snake_case sample", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      memory: 60,
      used_cores: 2,
      total_cores: 4,
      memory_used: 8000000000,
      memory_limit: 16000000000,
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.usedCores).toBe(2);
    expect(result?.totalCores).toBe(4);
  });

  it("returns null for missing core fields", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      // memory missing
      usedCores: 2,
      totalCores: 4,
      memoryUsed: 8000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000,
    };
    expect(normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("clamps out of range values instead of returning null", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 105, // > 100
      memory: -10, // < 0
      usedCores: 10, 
      totalCores: 4, // used > total
      memoryUsed: 20000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000, // used > limit
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.cpu).toBe(100);
    expect(result?.memory).toBe(0);
    expect(result?.usedCores).toBe(4); // clamped to total
    expect(result?.memoryUsed).toBe(16000000000); // clamped to limit
  });

  it("handles empty strings and nulls correctly in toFiniteNumber", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      memory: 60,
      usedCores: 2,
      totalCores: 4,
      memoryUsed: 8000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000,
      networkInBytesPerSec: "", // Should become null, not 0
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any);
    expect(result?.networkInBytesPerSec).toBeNull();
  });
});
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts">
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";

export interface HostMetricsPoint {
  timestamp: number;
  time: string;
  cpu: number | null;
  memory: number | null;
  usedCores: number | null;
  totalCores: number | null;
  memoryUsed: number | null;
  memoryLimit: number | null;
  networkInBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkOutBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkMonthlyTotal: number | null;
  diskReadBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec: number | null;
  uptimeSeconds: number | null;
  disks: HostMetricsDisk[];
}

export interface HostMetricsDisk {
  device: string;
  mount: string;
  usedBytes: number;
  totalBytes: number;
  readBytesPerSec: number | null;
  writeBytesPerSec: number | null;
}

export interface HostMetricsFailure {
  message: string;
  code?: string;
  details?: unknown;
  status?: number;
  upstreamStatus?: number;
  unsupportedEndpoint: boolean;
  malformedPayload: boolean;
}

interface HostMetricsApiPoint {
  timestamp?: string | number;
  time?: string;
  cpu?: number;
  memory?: number;
  usedCores?: number;
  totalCores?: number;
  memoryUsed?: number;
  memoryLimit?: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec?: number;
  networkOutBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskReadBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec?: number;
  network_in_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  network_out_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_read_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_write_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  networkMonthlyTotal?: number;
  network_monthly_total?: number;
  uptimeSeconds?: number;
  uptime_seconds?: number;
  used_cores?: number;
  total_cores?: number;
  memory_used?: number;
  memory_limit?: number;
  disks?: unknown;
}

interface HostMetricsApiDisk {
  device?: string;
  mount?: string;
  usedBytes?: number;
  totalBytes?: number;
  readBytesPerSec?: number;
  writeBytesPerSec?: number;
  used_bytes?: number;
  total_bytes?: number;
  read_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  write_bytes_per_sec?: number;
}

function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (value === null || value === "" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const numeric = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

function toTimestamp(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value === "string" && value !== "") {
    const numeric = Number(value);
    if (Number.isFinite(numeric)) return numeric;
    const parsed = Date.parse(value);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) return parsed;
  }
  return null;
}

function formatTimeLabel(timestamp: number): string {
  return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  });
}

function normalizeOptionalRate(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (numeric === null || numeric < 0) return null;
  return numeric;
}

function normalizeHostMetricsDisk(value: unknown): HostMetricsDisk | null {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;

  const disk = value as HostMetricsApiDisk;
  const device = typeof disk.device === "string" ? disk.device.trim() : "";
  const mount = typeof disk.mount === "string" ? disk.mount.trim() : "";
  const usedBytes = toFiniteNumber(disk.usedBytes ?? disk.used_bytes);
  const totalBytes = toFiniteNumber(disk.totalBytes ?? disk.total_bytes);
  const readBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(disk.readBytesPerSec ?? disk.read_bytes_per_sec);
  const writeBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(disk.writeBytesPerSec ?? disk.write_bytes_per_sec);

  if (!device || !mount || usedBytes === null || totalBytes === null || usedBytes < 0 || totalBytes <= 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    device,
    mount,
    usedBytes,
    totalBytes: Math.max(usedBytes, totalBytes),
    readBytesPerSec,
    writeBytesPerSec,
  };
}

function extractMetrics(point: HostMetricsApiPoint): HostMetricsPoint {
  const timestamp = toTimestamp(point.timestamp) ?? Date.now();

  const cpu = toFiniteNumber(point.cpu);
  const memory = toFiniteNumber(point.memory);
  const usedCores = toFiniteNumber(point.usedCores ?? point.used_cores);
  const totalCores = toFiniteNumber(point.totalCores ?? point.total_cores);
  const memoryUsed = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryUsed ?? point.memory_used);
  const memoryLimit = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryLimit ?? point.memory_limit);

  const networkInBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkInBytesPerSec ?? point.network_in_bytes_per_sec);
  const networkOutBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkOutBytesPerSec ?? point.network_out_bytes_per_sec);
  const networkMonthlyTotal = toFiniteNumber(point.networkMonthlyTotal ?? point.network_monthly_total);
  const diskReadBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskReadBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_read_bytes_per_sec);
  const diskWriteBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskWriteBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_write_bytes_per_sec);
  const uptimeSecondsRaw = toFiniteNumber(point.uptimeSeconds ?? point.uptime_seconds);
  const uptimeSeconds = uptimeSecondsRaw !== null && uptimeSecondsRaw >= 0 ? uptimeSecondsRaw : null;
  const disks = Array.isArray(point.disks) ? point.disks.map(normalizeHostMetricsDisk).filter((disk): disk is HostMetricsDisk => disk !== null) : [];

  return {
    timestamp,
    time: formatTimeLabel(timestamp),
    cpu,
    memory,
    usedCores,
    totalCores,
    memoryUsed,
    memoryLimit,
    networkInBytesPerSec,
    networkOutBytesPerSec,
    networkMonthlyTotal,
    diskReadBytesPerSec,
    diskWriteBytesPerSec,
    uptimeSeconds,
    disks,
  };
}

function validateMetricsRanges(metrics: HostMetricsPoint): HostMetricsPoint {
  const cpu = metrics.cpu !== null ? clamp(metrics.cpu, 0, 100) : null;
  const memory = metrics.memory !== null ? clamp(metrics.memory, 0, 100) : null;

  const totalCores = metrics.totalCores !== null ? Math.max(0, metrics.totalCores) : null;
  const usedCores = metrics.usedCores !== null 
    ? clamp(metrics.usedCores, 0, totalCores !== null ? totalCores : metrics.usedCores) 
    : null;

  const memoryLimit = metrics.memoryLimit !== null ? Math.max(0, metrics.memoryLimit) : null;
  const memoryUsed = metrics.memoryUsed !== null 
    ? clamp(metrics.memoryUsed, 0, memoryLimit !== null ? memoryLimit : metrics.memoryUsed) 
    : null;

  return {
    ...metrics,
    cpu,
    memory,
    usedCores,
    totalCores,
    memoryUsed,
    memoryLimit,
  };
}

function isMetricsSampleValid(metrics: HostMetricsPoint): boolean {
  return metrics.cpu !== null && metrics.memory !== null;
}

export function normalizeHostMetricsPoint(point: HostMetricsApiPoint): HostMetricsPoint | null {
  const extracted = extractMetrics(point);
  const validated = validateMetricsRanges(extracted);

  if (!isMetricsSampleValid(validated)) {
    return null;
  }

  return validated;
}

function formatFailureDetails(details: unknown): string | null {
  if (details === null || details === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof details === "string") return details;
  if (typeof details === "object") {
    const error = typeof (details as { error?: unknown }).error === "string" ? (details as { error: string }).error : null;
    if (error) return error;
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(details);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  return String(details);
}

export function getHostMetricsFailure(error: unknown): HostMetricsFailure | null {
  if (!error) return null;

  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    const details = error.details;
    const detailText = formatFailureDetails(details);
    const message = detailText ? `${error.message}: ${detailText}` : error.message;
    return {
      message,
      code: error.code,
      details,
      status: error.status,
      upstreamStatus: error.upstreamStatus,
      unsupportedEndpoint:
        error.code === "metrics_endpoint_unsupported" ||
        error.status === 404 ||
        error.status === 405,
      malformedPayload: error.code === "malformed_metrics_payload",
    };
  }

  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return {
      message: error.message,
      unsupportedEndpoint: false,
      malformedPayload: false,
    };
  }

  return {
    message: "Host metrics are temporarily unavailable.",
    unsupportedEndpoint: false,
    malformedPayload: false,
  };
}

interface UseHostMetricsOptions {
  enabled?: boolean;
  refetchInterval?: number | false;
}

export function useHostMetrics(hostId?: string | null, options: UseHostMetricsOptions = {}) {
  const { enabled = true, refetchInterval = 10000 } = options;

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["host-metrics", hostId],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<HostMetricsPoint> => {
      const data = await dockerApi.hostMetrics(hostId!);
      const normalized = normalizeHostMetricsPoint((data ?? {}) as HostMetricsApiPoint);
      if (!normalized) {
        throw new ApiError(
          502,
          {
            error: "Host metrics unavailable",
            code: "malformed_metrics_payload",
            details: "Agent returned a success response without a usable host metrics sample.",
          },
          "Host metrics unavailable",
        );
      }
      return normalized;
    },
    enabled: enabled && !!hostId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      if (!enabled || !hostId) return false;
      return query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval;
    },
  });

  return {
    ...query,
    failure: getHostMetricsFailure(query.error),
  };
}

interface UseHostMetricsHistoryOptions extends UseHostMetricsOptions {
  maxDataPoints?: number;
}

export function useHostMetricsHistory(hostId?: string | null, options: UseHostMetricsHistoryOptions = {}) {
  const { maxDataPoints = 24, enabled = true, refetchInterval = 10000 } = options;
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<HostMetricsPoint[]>([]);
  const query = useHostMetrics(hostId, { enabled, refetchInterval });

  useEffect(() => {
    setHistory([]);
  }, [hostId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query.data) return;

    setHistory((previous) => {
      const withoutDuplicate = previous.filter((point) => point.timestamp !== query.data!.timestamp);
      return [...withoutDuplicate, query.data!]
        .sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp)
        .slice(-maxDataPoints);
    });
  }, [maxDataPoints, query.data]);

  const latestPoint = history[history.length - 1] ?? query.data;
  const failure = useMemo(() => getHostMetricsFailure(query.error), [query.error]);

  return {
    ...query,
    history,
    latestPoint,
    failure,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="src/hooks/useNotifications.ts">
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import * as api from "../services/notification-api";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Notification } from "../types/database";

export const NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY = ["notifications"];

export function useNotifications(organizationId: string | null) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const previousNotificationsRef = useRef<Notification[]>([]);

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId],
    queryFn: () => {
      if (!organizationId) throw new Error("Missing organization ID");
      return api.getNotifications(organizationId);
    },
    enabled: !!organizationId,
    refetchInterval: 30000, // Poll every 30 seconds
  });

  // Check for newly arrived notifications to trigger toasts
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query.data) return;

    const previousIds = new Set(previousNotificationsRef.current.map((n) => n.id));
    const newNotifications = query.data.filter((n) => !previousIds.has(n.id));

    // Only toast if this isn't the first load (previous is not empty)
    if (previousNotificationsRef.current.length > 0 && newNotifications.length > 0) {
      newNotifications.forEach((n) => {
        // Find the right toast type
        const toastFn = n.type === "error" ? toast.error 
          : n.type === "success" ? toast.success 
          : n.type === "warning" ? toast.warning 
          : toast.info;

        toastFn(n.title, {
          description: n.message,
          duration: 5000,
        });
      });
    }

    previousNotificationsRef.current = query.data;
  }, [query.data]);

  return {
    ...query,
    unreadCount: query.data?.length || 0,
  };
}

export function useDismissNotification(organizationId: string | null) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (notificationId: string) => api.dismissNotification(notificationId),
    onMutate: async (notificationId) => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
      
      const previous = queryClient.getQueryData<Notification[]>([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId]);
      
      // Optimistically remove from list
      if (previous) {
        queryClient.setQueryData<Notification[]>(
          [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId],
          previous.filter((n) => n.id !== notificationId)
        );
      }
      
      return { previous };
    },
    onError: (err, newTodo, context) => {
      if (context?.previous) {
        queryClient.setQueryData([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId], context.previous);
      }
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
    },
  });
}

export function useDismissAllNotifications(organizationId: string | null) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => {
      if (!organizationId) throw new Error("Missing organization ID");
      return api.dismissAllNotifications(organizationId);
    },
    onMutate: async () => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
      const previous = queryClient.getQueryData<Notification[]>([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId]);
      
      // Optimistically clear all
      queryClient.setQueryData<Notification[]>([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId], []);
      
      return { previous };
    },
    onError: (err, newTodo, context) => {
      if (context?.previous) {
        queryClient.setQueryData([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId], context.previous);
      }
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
    },
  });
}
</file>
