<file path="src/lib/api.test.ts">
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { apiFetch, buildApiErrorMessage, summarizeApiErrorText } from "@/lib/api";

afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("api error normalization", () => {
  it("uses RFC7807 problem details when present", () => {
    expect(
      buildApiErrorMessage(
        502,
        {
          title: "Connection test failed",
          detail: "Cloudflare Tunnel could not reach your Watchtower agent.",
        },
        "",
      ),
    ).toBe("Connection test failed: Cloudflare Tunnel could not reach your Watchtower agent.");
  });

  it("summarizes Cloudflare HTML 502 pages into a readable message", () => {
    const raw = `
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html>
        <head>
          <title>dockerdash.app | 502: Bad gateway</title>
        </head>
        <body>cloudflare</body>
      </html>
    `;

    expect(summarizeApiErrorText(raw, 502)).toBe(
      "Cloudflare gateway error: dockerdash.app | 502: Bad gateway. Verify the saved host URL, tunnel or reverse proxy, and the Watchtower agent service.",
    );
  });

  it("preserves legacy error plus details payloads", () => {
    expect(
      buildApiErrorMessage(
        502,
        {
          error: "Agent connection failed",
          details: "connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9876",
        },
        "",
      ),
    ).toBe("Agent connection failed: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9876");
  });

  it("does not call protected APIs when Clerk has no session token", async () => {
    const fetchMock = vi.fn();
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
    vi.stubGlobal("window", {
      Clerk: {
        loaded: true,
        session: {
          getToken: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
        },
      },
    });

    await expect(apiFetch("/docker-proxy", { method: "POST", body: "{}" })).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 401,
      code: "missing_session_token",
    });

    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
</file>

<file path="src/lib/api.ts">
const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api';

import { summarizeDiagnosticText } from "../../shared/lib/diagnostics";

type ClerkSession = {
  getToken?: (options?: { skipCache?: boolean }) => Promise<string | null>;
};

type ClerkGlobal = {
  loaded?: boolean;
  session?: ClerkSession | null;
};

export interface ApiErrorBody {
  error?: string;
  code?: string;
  details?: unknown;
  title?: string;
  detail?: string;
  type?: string;
  upstream_status?: number;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

function trimErrorText(value: string, maxLength = 220) {
  return value.length > maxLength ? `${value.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...` : value;
}

function decodeHtmlEntities(value: string) {
  return value
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'");
}

export function summarizeApiErrorText(rawText: string, status?: number) {
  const trimmed = rawText.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return status ? `Request failed (${status})` : "Request failed";
  }

  if (/<(?:!doctype|html|head|body)\b/i.test(trimmed)) {
    const titleMatch = trimmed.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
    const title = titleMatch
      ? decodeHtmlEntities(titleMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())
      : null;
    const isCloudflare = /cloudflare/i.test(trimmed);

    if (isCloudflare && status === 502) {
      return title
        ? `Cloudflare gateway error: ${title}. Verify the saved host URL, tunnel or reverse proxy, and the Watchtower agent service.`
        : "Cloudflare gateway error. Verify the saved host URL, tunnel or reverse proxy, and the Watchtower agent service.";
    }

    if (title) {
      return `HTML error response: ${trimErrorText(title)}`;
    }

    return status ? `HTML error response (${status})` : "HTML error response";
  }

  return trimErrorText(trimmed.replace(/\s+/g, " "));
}

export function buildApiErrorMessage(status: number, body: ApiErrorBody | null, rawText: string) {
  if (typeof body?.error === "string" && body.error.trim()) {
    const message = body.error.trim();
    const details =
      typeof body.details === "string" && body.details.trim()
        ? body.details.trim()
        : null;
    return details ? `${message}: ${details}` : message;
  }

  if (typeof body?.title === "string" && body.title.trim()) {
    const title = body.title.trim();
    const detail =
      typeof body.detail === "string" && body.detail.trim()
        ? body.detail.trim()
        : null;
    return detail ? `${title}: ${detail}` : title;
  }

  return summarizeApiErrorText(rawText, status);
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  body: ApiErrorBody | null;
  rawText: string;
  details: unknown;
  code?: string;
  upstreamStatus?: number;

  constructor(status: number, body: ApiErrorBody | null, rawText: string) {
    super(buildApiErrorMessage(status, body, rawText));
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.body = body;
    this.rawText = rawText;
    this.details = body?.details ?? body?.detail;
    this.code = typeof body?.code === "string" ? body.code : undefined;
    this.upstreamStatus =
      typeof body?.upstream_status === "number" ? body.upstream_status : undefined;
  }
}

function wait(ms: number) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function getClerkGlobal(): ClerkGlobal | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  return ((window as unknown as { Clerk?: ClerkGlobal }).Clerk) ?? null;
}

async function getClerkSessionToken(forceFresh = false) {
  const tokenOptions = forceFresh ? { skipCache: true } : undefined;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
    const clerk = getClerkGlobal();
    const getToken = clerk?.session?.getToken;

    if (getToken) {
      const token = await getToken(tokenOptions);
      if (token || clerk?.loaded !== false) {
        return token ?? null;
      }
    } else if (clerk?.loaded) {
      return null;
    }

    if (attempt < 4) {
      await wait(50 * (attempt + 1));
    }
  }

  return null;
}

interface ApiFetchOptions extends RequestInit {
  requireAuth?: boolean;
}

export async function apiFetch(path: string, options: ApiFetchOptions = {}) {
  const { requireAuth = true, ...requestOptions } = options;
  let token = await getClerkSessionToken(false);
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...((requestOptions.headers as Record<string, string>) || {}),
  };

  if (token) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  } else if (requireAuth) {
    throw new ApiError(
      401,
      {
        error: "Authentication required",
        code: "missing_session_token",
        details: "Clerk did not return a session token for this request.",
      },
      "Authentication required",
    );
  }

  const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {
    ...requestOptions,
    headers,
  };

  // Handle body for POST/PUT requests
  if (requestOptions.body && typeof requestOptions.body === 'string') {
    fetchOptions.body = requestOptions.body;
  } else if (requestOptions.body) {
    fetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(requestOptions.body);
  }

  let response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, fetchOptions);

  if (response.status === 401 && token) {
    token = await getClerkSessionToken(true);
    if (token) {
      headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
      response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
        ...fetchOptions,
        headers,
      });
    }
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text();
    let errorData: ApiErrorBody | null = null;
    try {
      errorData = JSON.parse(errorText);
    } catch {
      errorData = errorText ? { error: summarizeDiagnosticText(errorText) } : null;
    }
    throw new ApiError(response.status, errorData, errorText);
  }

  return response.json();
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/auth-redirect.ts">
export function getSafeNextPath(rawValue: string | null | undefined, fallback = "/app") {
  if (!rawValue) {
    return fallback;
  }

  if (!rawValue.startsWith("/") || rawValue.startsWith("//")) {
    return fallback;
  }

  return rawValue;
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/dashboard-summary.ts">
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import type { AlertItem, DashboardContainerSummary } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-types";
import { getHostAlertCopy, isUnhealthyHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";

export interface DashboardStats {
  hostsCount: number;
  connectedCount: number;
  unhealthyCount: number;
  containersCount: number;
  runningCount: number;
  stoppedCount: number;
  alerts: AlertItem[];
  containers: DashboardContainerSummary[];
}

type RawContainer = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is RawContainer {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function toStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const strings = value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string");
  return strings.length > 0 ? strings : undefined;
}

export function normalizeDashboardContainers(containers: unknown): DashboardContainerSummary[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(containers)) {
    return [];
  }

  return containers.flatMap((container) => {
    if (!isRecord(container)) {
      return [];
    }

    const id = typeof container.Id === "string" ? container.Id : null;
    if (!id) {
      return [];
    }

    return [
      {
        Id: id,
        State: typeof container.State === "string" ? container.State : "unknown",
        Names: toStringArray(container.Names),
        Image: typeof container.Image === "string" ? container.Image : undefined,
        _hostId: typeof container._hostId === "string" ? container._hostId : undefined,
        _hostName: typeof container._hostName === "string" ? container._hostName : undefined,
      },
    ];
  });
}

export function buildDashboardStats(hosts: DockerHost[], containers: unknown): DashboardStats {
  const normalizedContainers = normalizeDashboardContainers(containers);
  const connectedHosts = hosts.filter((host) => host.status === "connected");
  const unhealthyHosts = hosts.filter((host) => isUnhealthyHostStatus(host.status));
  const runningContainers = normalizedContainers.filter((container) => container.State === "running");
  const stoppedContainers = normalizedContainers.filter((container) => container.State !== "running");
  const exitedContainers = normalizedContainers.filter((container) => container.State === "exited");

  const alerts: AlertItem[] = [
    ...unhealthyHosts.map((host) => {
      const copy = getHostAlertCopy(host.status, host.name);

      return {
        id: `host-${host.id}`,
        type: "host" as const,
        severity: "error" as const,
        title: copy.title,
        description: copy.description,
        timestamp: host.last_seen_at ? "Seen recently" : "Never seen",
        href: `/app/hosts/${host.id}`,
      };
    }),
    ...exitedContainers.map((container) => ({
      id: `cont-exited-${container.Id}`,
      type: "container" as const,
      severity: "warning" as const,
      title: "Container Exited",
      description: `${container.Names?.[0]?.replace("/", "") || "Container"} is stopped and needs review.`,
      timestamp: "Current state",
      href: container._hostId ? `/app/containers/${container.Id.substring(0, 12)}?host=${container._hostId}` : "/app/containers",
    })),
    ...normalizedContainers
      .filter((container) => container.State === "restarting")
      .map((container) => ({
        id: `cont-${container.Id}`,
        type: "container" as const,
        severity: "warning" as const,
        title: "Container Restart Loop",
        description: `${container.Names?.[0]?.replace("/", "") || "Container"} is restarting frequently.`,
        timestamp: "Just now",
        href: container._hostId ? `/app/containers/${container.Id.substring(0, 12)}?host=${container._hostId}` : "/app/containers",
      })),
  ];

  return {
    hostsCount: hosts.length,
    connectedCount: connectedHosts.length,
    unhealthyCount: unhealthyHosts.length,
    containersCount: normalizedContainers.length,
    runningCount: runningContainers.length,
    stoppedCount: stoppedContainers.length,
    alerts,
    containers: normalizedContainers,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/error-sanitizer.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { sanitizeConnectionError } from "@/lib/error-sanitizer";

describe("sanitizeConnectionError", () => {
  it("prioritizes agent API key failures over Cloudflare wording", () => {
    const error = Object.assign(
      new Error("Connection test failed: Cloudflare Tunnel returned HTTP 401: Invalid API key"),
      { body: { code: "agent_auth_failed", type: "agent_unauthorized" } },
    );

    expect(sanitizeConnectionError(error)).toMatchObject({
      title: "API key mismatch",
    });
  });

  it("does not classify the Dockerdash app edge 502 as a host tunnel outage", () => {
    expect(
      sanitizeConnectionError(
        "Cloudflare gateway error: app.dockerdash.app | 502: Bad gateway. Verify the saved host URL.",
      ),
    ).toMatchObject({
      title: "Dockerdash gateway error",
    });
  });

  it("classifies agent-side Docker socket failures separately from reachability", () => {
    const error = Object.assign(
      new Error(
        "Docker socket unavailable: The Watchtower agent is reachable, but it could not talk to Docker through its configured socket.",
      ),
      {
        body: {
          type: "docker_socket_unavailable",
          detail: "Docker API request failed",
        },
      },
    );

    expect(sanitizeConnectionError(error)).toMatchObject({
      title: "Docker socket inaccessible",
    });
  });

  it("keeps Cloudflare reachability copy for real tunnel failures", () => {
    expect(sanitizeConnectionError("Cloudflare HTML error page: 502 Bad Gateway")).toMatchObject({
      title: "Tunnel unreachable",
    });
  });
});

<file path="src/lib/error-sanitizer.ts">
/**
 * Sanitize raw API/connection error messages into user-friendly copy.
 * Strips technical noise (HTTP codes, raw HTML page titles, Cloudflare
 * diagnostic dumps) and returns a short, actionable sentence.
 */

interface SanitizedError {
  /** A short, human-readable headline (≤ 6 words). */
  title: string;
  /** A concise actionable description. */
  description: string;
  /** The original raw error message, useful for support links. */
  raw: string;
}

const CLOUDFLARE_PATTERNS = [
  /cloudflare/i,
  /cf-ray/i,
  /cloudflare tunnel error/i,
  /cloudflare html error/i,
];

const TIMEOUT_PATTERNS = [
  /timed?\s?out/i,
  /did not respond in time/i,
  /ETIMEDOUT/i,
  /timeout/i,
  /504/,
];

const UNREACHABLE_PATTERNS = [
  /ECONNREFUSED/i,
  /ENOTFOUND/i,
  /ENETUNREACH/i,
  /could not reach/i,
  /connection.*refused/i,
  /502/,
];

const AGENT_AUTH_PATTERNS = [
  /agent_auth_failed/i,
  /agent_unauthorized/i,
  /invalid api key/i,
  /invalid agent api key/i,
  /rejected the saved api key/i,
];

const DOCKER_SOCKET_PATTERNS = [
  /docker_socket_unavailable/i,
  /docker socket not found/i,
  /docker api request failed/i,
  /configured socket/i,
];

const DOCKERDASH_EDGE_PATTERNS = [
  /cloudflare gateway error:/i,
  /app\.dockerdash\.app/i,
  /dockerdash\.app\s*\|\s*502/i,
];

function isCloudflareError(msg: string) {
  return CLOUDFLARE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function isDockerdashEdgeError(msg: string) {
  return DOCKERDASH_EDGE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function isTimeoutError(msg: string) {
  return TIMEOUT_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function isUnreachableError(msg: string) {
  return UNREACHABLE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function stringifyStructuredError(error: unknown) {
  if (!error || typeof error !== "object") return "";

  const record = error as {
    code?: unknown;
    details?: unknown;
    body?: {
      code?: unknown;
      type?: unknown;
      detail?: unknown;
      details?: unknown;
      error?: unknown;
      title?: unknown;
    };
  };
  const values = [
    record.code,
    record.details,
    record.body?.code,
    record.body?.type,
    record.body?.detail,
    record.body?.details,
    record.body?.error,
    record.body?.title,
  ];

  return values
    .map((value) => {
      if (typeof value === "string") return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        try {
          return JSON.stringify(value);
        } catch {
          return "";
        }
      }
      return "";
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");
}

function isAgentAuthError(msg: string, error: unknown) {
  const haystack = `${msg} ${stringifyStructuredError(error)}`;
  return AGENT_AUTH_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(haystack));
}

function isDockerSocketError(msg: string, error: unknown) {
  const haystack = `${msg} ${stringifyStructuredError(error)}`;
  return DOCKER_SOCKET_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(haystack));
}

export function sanitizeConnectionError(error: unknown): SanitizedError {
  const raw =
    error instanceof Error ? error.message : typeof error === "string" ? error : "Unknown error";

  if (isAgentAuthError(raw, error)) {
    return {
      title: "API key mismatch",
      description:
        "The agent is reachable, but it rejected the saved API key. Re-enter the key from /etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env or run the agent repair command so both sides use the same key.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isDockerSocketError(raw, error)) {
    return {
      title: "Docker socket inaccessible",
      description:
        "The agent is reachable, but it cannot talk to Docker through its configured socket. Run Troubleshoot / Repair or reinstall the agent so the systemd service has Docker socket group access, then retry.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isTimeoutError(raw)) {
    return {
      title: "Connection timed out",
      description:
        "The agent did not respond in time. Make sure the Watchtower agent process is running and the host is reachable.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isCloudflareError(raw)) {
    if (isDockerdashEdgeError(raw)) {
      return {
        title: "Dockerdash gateway error",
        description:
          "Dockerdash returned a gateway error before the agent response could be classified. Retry, then check the saved host URL and API key if it persists.",
        raw,
      };
    }

    return {
      title: "Tunnel unreachable",
      description:
        "Cloudflare could not reach the Watchtower agent. Check that the tunnel is active, the route is correctly configured, and the agent service is running.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isUnreachableError(raw)) {
    return {
      title: "Host unreachable",
      description:
        "The dashboard could not connect to the Watchtower agent. Verify the host URL, ensure the agent is running, and check any firewall rules.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  // Catch-all: strip "Connection test failed:" prefix if present
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/^Connection test failed:\s*/i, "").trim();

  return {
    title: "Connection failed",
    description: cleaned || "The host could not be reached. Check the agent service and network configuration.",
    raw,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/host-health-state.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  getHostAlertCopy,
  getHostStatusAppearance,
  isReadableHostStatus,
  isUnhealthyHostStatus,
  normalizeHostStatus,
} from "@/lib/host-health-state";

describe("host-health-state", () => {
  it("normalizes supported statuses and falls back to unknown", () => {
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("CONNECTED")).toBe("connected");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("stale")).toBe("stale");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("Down")).toBe("down");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus("weird-status")).toBe("unknown");
    expect(normalizeHostStatus(null)).toBe("unknown");
  });

  it("classifies readable host statuses", () => {
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("connected")).toBe(true);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("stale")).toBe(true);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("down")).toBe(false);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("disconnected")).toBe(false);
    expect(isReadableHostStatus("error")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("classifies unhealthy host statuses", () => {
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("stale")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("error")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("unhealthy")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("down")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("disconnected")).toBe(true);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("connected")).toBe(false);
    expect(isUnhealthyHostStatus("unknown-value")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("returns consistent appearance metadata for connected and offline states", () => {
    expect(getHostStatusAppearance("connected")).toMatchObject({
      isOnlineIcon: true,
      pillClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-success"),
      dotClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-success"),
    });

    expect(getHostStatusAppearance("down")).toMatchObject({
      isOnlineIcon: false,
      pillClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-destructive"),
      dotClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-destructive"),
    });

    expect(getHostStatusAppearance("stale")).toMatchObject({
      isOnlineIcon: false,
      pillClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-warning"),
      dotClassName: expect.stringContaining("bg-warning"),
    });
  });

  it("returns status-aware alert copy", () => {
    expect(getHostAlertCopy("stale", "Prowlarr")).toEqual({
      title: "Host Heartbeat Stale",
      description: 'Host "Prowlarr" has not checked in recently. Metrics may be delayed until the next successful heartbeat.',
    });

    expect(getHostAlertCopy("down", "docker host")).toEqual({
      title: "Host Down",
      description: 'Host "docker host" appears offline. Check power, network reachability, and the local agent service.',
    });

    expect(getHostAlertCopy("unknown", "node-1")).toEqual({
      title: "Host Alert",
      description: 'Host "node-1" needs attention. Review connectivity and agent health.',
    });
  });
});
</file>

<file path="src/lib/host-health-state.ts">
export const DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES = 5;
export const DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD = 3;

export type NormalizedHostStatus =
  | "connected"
  | "stale"
  | "error"
  | "unhealthy"
  | "down"
  | "disconnected"
  | "unknown";

export function normalizeHostStatus(status: string | null | undefined): NormalizedHostStatus {
  const normalized = String(status || "").toLowerCase();

  switch (normalized) {
    case "connected":
    case "stale":
    case "error":
    case "unhealthy":
    case "down":
    case "disconnected":
      return normalized;
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

export function isReadableHostStatus(status: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);
  return normalizedStatus === "connected" || normalizedStatus === "stale";
}

export function isUnhealthyHostStatus(status: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);
  return ["error", "disconnected", "down", "stale", "unhealthy"].includes(normalizedStatus);
}

export function getHostStatusAppearance(status: string | null | undefined): {
  pillClassName: string;
  dotClassName: string;
  isOnlineIcon: boolean;
} {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);

  switch (normalizedStatus) {
    case "connected":
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/20",
        dotClassName: "bg-success shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(34,197,94,0.6)]",
        isOnlineIcon: true,
      };
    case "unhealthy":
    case "down":
    case "disconnected":
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border-destructive/20",
        dotClassName: "bg-destructive shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(239,68,68,0.45)]",
        isOnlineIcon: false,
      };
    case "stale":
    case "error":
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-warning/15 text-warning border-warning/20",
        dotClassName: "bg-warning shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(245,158,11,0.45)]",
        isOnlineIcon: false,
      };
    default:
      return {
        pillClassName: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border",
        dotClassName: "bg-muted-foreground/40",
        isOnlineIcon: false,
      };
  }
}

export function getHostAlertCopy(status: string | null | undefined, hostName: string): {
  title: string;
  description: string;
} {
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeHostStatus(status);

  switch (normalizedStatus) {
    case "stale":
      return {
        title: "Host Heartbeat Stale",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" has not checked in recently. Metrics may be delayed until the next successful heartbeat.`,
      };
    case "unhealthy":
      return {
        title: "Host Unhealthy",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" is failing health checks repeatedly. Investigate the agent and host connectivity.`,
      };
    case "down":
      return {
        title: "Host Down",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" appears offline. Check power, network reachability, and the local agent service.`,
      };
    case "disconnected":
      return {
        title: "Host Disconnected",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" is disconnected from the dashboard. Check tunnel or agent connectivity.`,
      };
    case "error":
      return {
        title: "Host Error",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" returned an error during health checks. Review agent logs and connectivity.`,
      };
    default:
      return {
        title: "Host Alert",
        description: `Host "${hostName}" needs attention. Review connectivity and agent health.`,
      };
  }
}

export function parseStaleThresholdMinutes(rawValue: unknown): number {
  const n = Number(rawValue);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES;
  return Math.floor(n);
}

export function shouldMarkHostStale(
  host: { status?: string; last_seen_at?: string | null } | null | undefined,
  now: Date,
  staleThresholdMinutes: number,
): boolean {
  if (!host) return false;
  if (host.status !== "connected") return false;
  if (!host.last_seen_at) return false;

  const seenAt = new Date(host.last_seen_at);
  if (Number.isNaN(seenAt.getTime())) return false;

  const cutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - staleThresholdMinutes * 60_000);
  return seenAt < cutoff;
}

export function failureStatusForCount(failureCount: number, unhealthyThreshold: number): "error" | "unhealthy" {
  return failureCount >= unhealthyThreshold ? "unhealthy" : "error";
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/hostname.ts">
/**
 * Hostname detection for subdomain-based routing.
 *
 * - `dockerdash.app`     => marketing
 * - `app.dockerdash.app` => product
 * - `docs.dockerdash.app` => documentation
 * - `localhost` / dev    => local development
 * - `*.netlify.app`      => preview deploys
 */

const APP_SUBDOMAIN = "app.dockerdash.app";
const DOCS_SUBDOMAIN = "docs.dockerdash.app";
const NETLIFY_PREVIEW_SUFFIX = ".netlify.app";

export function isLocalDev(): boolean {
  const host = window.location.hostname;
  return host === "localhost" || host === "127.0.0.1" || host.endsWith(".local");
}

export function isNetlifyPreview(): boolean {
  return window.location.hostname.endsWith(NETLIFY_PREVIEW_SUFFIX);
}

export function isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled(): boolean {
  return isNetlifyPreview() && import.meta.env.VITE_PREVIEW_BYPASS_AUTH === "true";
}

export function isAppHost(): boolean {
  return isLocalDev() || isNetlifyPreview() || window.location.hostname === APP_SUBDOMAIN;
}

export function isAppSubdomain(): boolean {
  if (isLocalDev()) return false;
  return window.location.hostname === APP_SUBDOMAIN;
}

export function isDocsSubdomain(): boolean {
  if (isLocalDev()) return false;
  return window.location.hostname === DOCS_SUBDOMAIN;
}

export function getAppOrigin(): string {
  if (isLocalDev() || isNetlifyPreview()) {
    return window.location.origin;
  }

  return `https://${APP_SUBDOMAIN}`;
}

export function getPublicOrigin(): string {
  if (isLocalDev() || isNetlifyPreview()) {
    return window.location.origin;
  }

  return "https://dockerdash.app";
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/onboarding-gate.ts">
export type OnboardingStatus = 'not_started' | 'skipped' | 'completed' | null;

export function normalizeOnboardingStatus(value: unknown): OnboardingStatus {
  if (value === 'not_started' || value === 'skipped' || value === 'completed') {
    return value;
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Single source of truth for route gating behavior.
 *
 * Rules:
 * - No org yet -> onboarding required
 * - not_started -> onboarding required
 * - skipped/completed -> onboarding not required
 */
export function deriveNeedsOnboarding(hasOrgs: boolean, onboardingStatus: OnboardingStatus): boolean {
  if (!hasOrgs) return false;
  return onboardingStatus !== 'skipped' && onboardingStatus !== 'completed';
}
</file>

import { useState } from "react";

import { AdminHostManagement } from "@/components/admin/AdminHostManagement";
import { AdminBillingManagement } from "@/components/admin/AdminBillingManagement";
import { AdminOperations } from "@/components/admin/AdminOperations";
import { AdminAuditLog } from "@/components/admin/AdminAuditLog";
import { AdminNotifications } from "@/components/admin/AdminNotifications";

const tabs = ["Overview", "Users", "Organizations", "Hosts", "Billing", "Operations", "Audit Log", "Notifications"] as const;
type AdminTab = (typeof tabs)[number];

export default function AdminPage() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<AdminTab>("Overview");
  const { organization: currentOrg } = useOrganization();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Admin"
        description="Internal control plane for platform operations, tenant access, and billing overrides"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Admin" }]}
        actions={currentOrg ? <AddHostDialog orgId={currentOrg.id} /> : undefined}
      />

      <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={(value) => setTab(value as AdminTab)} className="space-y-4">
        <TabsList className="h-auto w-full justify-start overflow-x-auto bg-secondary p-1">
          {tabs.map((item) => (
            <TabsTrigger key={item} value={item} className="text-xs">
              {item}
            </TabsTrigger>
          ))}
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="Overview">
          <AdminOverview />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Users">
          <AdminUserManagement />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Organizations">
          <AdminOrganizationManagement />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Hosts">
          <AdminHostManagement />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Billing">
          <AdminBillingManagement />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Operations">
          <AdminOperations />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Audit Log">
          <AdminAuditLog />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Notifications">
          <AdminNotifications />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/AlertsPage.tsx">
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import { BellRing, Loader2, MessageSquareShare, ServerCrash, Webhook } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import { AddHostDialog } from "@/components/docker/AddHostDialog";
import { AlertsSummaryCards } from "@/components/alerts/AlertsSummaryCards";
import { ActiveAlertsTable } from "@/components/alerts/ActiveAlertsTable";
import { AlertHistoryFeed } from "@/components/alerts/AlertHistoryFeed";
import { AlertRulesPanel } from "@/components/alerts/AlertRulesPanel";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/EmptyState";
import { PremiumFeatureBlock } from "@/components/shared/PremiumFeatureBlock";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { useDockerHosts } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useAcknowledgeAlert, useAlertRules, useAlertsWorkspace, useCreateAlertRule, useCreateIncident, useIncidentsFeed, useResolveAlert, useUpdateAlertRule } from "@/hooks/useAlerts";
import { useSlackDestinations } from "@/hooks/useSlackDestinations";
import { useWebhookDestinations } from "@/hooks/useWebhookDestinations";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import type { AlertEvent } from "@/types/database";
import type { AlertRuleFormValues } from "@/types/alerts";

export default function AlertsPage() {
  const { organization: currentOrg } = useOrganization();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [severityFilter, setSeverityFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("open");
  const [pendingAlertId, setPendingAlertId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hostsQuery = useDockerHosts(currentOrg?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const alertsQuery = useAlertsWorkspace(currentOrg?.id, {
    severity: severityFilter === "all" ? undefined : severityFilter,
    status: statusFilter === "all" ? undefined : statusFilter,
  });
  const rulesQuery = useAlertRules(currentOrg?.id);
  const incidentsQuery = useIncidentsFeed(currentOrg?.id);
  const slackDestinationsQuery = useSlackDestinations(currentOrg?.id);
  const webhookDestinationsQuery = useWebhookDestinations(currentOrg?.id);

  const acknowledgeMutation = useAcknowledgeAlert();
  const resolveMutation = useResolveAlert();
  const createRuleMutation = useCreateAlertRule();
  const updateRuleMutation = useUpdateAlertRule();
  const createIncidentMutation = useCreateIncident();

  const alerts = alertsQuery.data?.alerts ?? [];
  const rules = rulesQuery.data ?? [];
  const incidents = incidentsQuery.data?.incidents ?? [];
  const history = incidentsQuery.data?.history ?? [];
  const slackDestinations = slackDestinationsQuery.data?.destinations ?? [];
  const webhookDestinations = webhookDestinationsQuery.data?.destinations ?? [];
  const canManage = alertsQuery.data?.can_manage ?? false;
  const summary = alertsQuery.data?.summary ?? {
    total_alerts: 0,
    critical_alerts: 0,
    enabled_rules: 0,
    open_incidents: 0,
  };

  const loading = hostsQuery.isLoading || alertsQuery.isLoading || rulesQuery.isLoading || incidentsQuery.isLoading || slackDestinationsQuery.isLoading || webhookDestinationsQuery.isLoading;
  const hasHosts = (hostsQuery.data?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  const enabledSlackDestinationsCount = slackDestinations.filter((destination) => destination.enabled).length;
  const enabledWebhookDestinationsCount = webhookDestinations.filter((destination) => destination.enabled).length;
  const hasSlackRules = rules.some((rule) => rule.notification_channels.includes("slack"));
  const hasWebhookRules = rules.some((rule) => rule.notification_channels.includes("webhook"));

  const handleMutationError = (message: string, error: unknown) => {
    toast({
      title: message,
      description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
      variant: "destructive",
    });
  };

  const handleAcknowledge = async (id: string) => {
    setPendingAlertId(id);
    try {
      await acknowledgeMutation.mutateAsync(id);
      toast({ title: "Alert acknowledged" });
    } catch (error) {
      handleMutationError("Failed to acknowledge alert", error);
    } finally {
      setPendingAlertId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleResolve = async (id: string) => {
    setPendingAlertId(id);
    try {
      await resolveMutation.mutateAsync(id);
      toast({ title: "Alert resolved" });
    } catch (error) {
      handleMutationError("Failed to resolve alert", error);
    } finally {
      setPendingAlertId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRule = async (values: AlertRuleFormValues) => {
    try {
      await createRuleMutation.mutateAsync(values);
      toast({ title: "Alert rule created" });
    } catch (error) {
      handleMutationError("Failed to create alert rule", error);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateRule = async (ruleId: string, values: Partial<AlertRuleFormValues>) => {
    try {
      await updateRuleMutation.mutateAsync({ id: ruleId, values });
      toast({ title: "Alert rule updated" });
    } catch (error) {
      handleMutationError("Failed to update alert rule", error);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateIncident = async (alert: AlertEvent & { href?: string }) => {
    setPendingAlertId(alert.id);
    try {
      await createIncidentMutation.mutateAsync({
        alertId: alert.id,
        title: `Investigate: ${alert.title}`,
        summary: alert.message,
        severity: alert.severity,
      });
      toast({ title: "Incident created from alert" });
    } catch (error) {
      handleMutationError("Failed to create incident", error);
    } finally {
      setPendingAlertId(null);
    }
  };

  const filterLabel = useMemo(() => {
    const parts = [];
    if (severityFilter !== "all") parts.push(severityFilter);
    if (statusFilter !== "all") parts.push(statusFilter);
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(" / ") : "all alerts";
  }, [severityFilter, statusFilter]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="flex h-64 items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Alerts & Monitoring"
        description="Persisted alert state, rule management, and recent incident activity for your active organization."
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Observability" }, { label: "Alerts" }]}
        actions={canManage ? (
          <Button onClick={() => document.getElementById("alert-rules-section")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" })}>
            <BellRing className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
            Manage Rules
          </Button>
        ) : undefined}
      />

      {!currentOrg ? (
        <div className="glass-card">
          <EmptyState icon={ServerCrash} title="No active organization" description="Select an organization before managing alert rules and incident history." />
        </div>
      ) : !hasHosts ? (
        <div className="glass-card">
          <EmptyState
            icon={ServerCrash}
            title="Connect a host to enable alerts"
            description="Alert rules evaluate host connectivity, container lifecycle, and resource thresholds from connected Docker hosts."
            actionLabel={canManage ? "Connect your first host" : undefined}
            onAction={canManage ? () => undefined : undefined}
          />
          {canManage ? (
            <div className="pb-8 text-center">
              <AddHostDialog orgId={currentOrg.id} trigger={<Button>Connect your first host</Button>} />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <AlertsSummaryCards summary={summary} />

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card/60 p-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Active view</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Currently showing {filterLabel} for the active organization.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
              <Select value={severityFilter} onValueChange={setSeverityFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-full sm:w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="Severity" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All severities</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="critical">Critical</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="error">Error</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="warning">Warning</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="info">Info</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-full sm:w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="Status" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="open">Open only</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="acknowledged">Acknowledged</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="resolved">Resolved</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <ActiveAlertsTable
            alerts={alerts}
            canManage={canManage}
            onAcknowledge={handleAcknowledge}
            onResolve={handleResolve}
            onCreateIncident={handleCreateIncident}
            pendingId={pendingAlertId}
          />

          {hasSlackRules && enabledSlackDestinationsCount === 0 ? (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 p-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="rounded-full bg-warning/15 p-2">
                    <MessageSquareShare className="h-4 w-4 text-warning" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">Slack notifications are enabled on one or more rules, but no Slack destinations are configured.</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Those rules will keep evaluating normally, but Slack messages will not be sent until an organization-level destination is added.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {canManage ? (
                  <Button asChild size="sm" variant="outline">
                    <Link to="/app/settings?tab=Notifications">Open Notifications</Link>
                  </Button>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {hasWebhookRules && enabledWebhookDestinationsCount === 0 ? (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 p-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="rounded-full bg-warning/15 p-2">
                    <Webhook className="h-4 w-4 text-warning" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">Webhook delivery is enabled on one or more rules, but no destinations are configured.</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Those rules will continue evaluating normally, but outbound webhook sends will be skipped until an organization-level destination is added.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {canManage ? (
                  <Button asChild size="sm" variant="outline">
                    <Link to="/app/settings?tab=Webhooks">Open Webhooks</Link>
                  </Button>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <div id="alert-rules-section">
            <PremiumFeatureBlock
              title="Advanced Alert Rules"
              description="Upgrade your plan to create and manage custom alert rules for your infrastructure."
              hasAccess={viewer?.entitlements?.canUseAdvancedAlerts ?? false}
            >
              <AlertRulesPanel
                rules={rules}
                canManage={canManage}
                saving={createRuleMutation.isPending || updateRuleMutation.isPending}
                slackDestinationsCount={enabledSlackDestinationsCount}
                webhookDestinationsCount={enabledWebhookDestinationsCount}
                onCreate={handleCreateRule}
                onUpdate={handleUpdateRule}
              />
            </PremiumFeatureBlock>
          </div>

          <AlertHistoryFeed incidents={incidents} history={history} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/BillingPage.tsx">
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { AlertTriangle, Construction, Check, ArrowRight, X, Loader2, Zap, Box, HeartHandshake } from "lucide-react";
import { useSearchParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useOrganization, useUser } from "@clerk/react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { getCheckoutPriceId, getPricingPlan } from "@/lib/pricing";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";

export default function BillingPage() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { organization } = useOrganization();
  const { user } = useUser();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [selectedPlan, setSelectedPlan] = useState<"pro" | "team" | null>(null);
  const [donorIntentLoading, setDonorIntentLoading] = useState(false);
  const [donorIntent, setDonorIntent] = useState<null | {
    reference_token: string;
    instructions: string[];
    grant_days: number;
  }>(null);
  const [donorTransactionId, setDonorTransactionId] = useState("");
  const [paddleStatus, setPaddleStatus] = useState<"checking" | "ready" | "unavailable">(() =>
    typeof window !== "undefined" && window.Paddle ? "ready" : "checking",
  );
  const freePlanDetails = getPricingPlan("free");
  const activeOrganizationId = viewer?.active_org_id ?? null;
  const effectivePlan = viewer?.active_org_effective_plan ?? viewer?.active_org_plan;

  // Fetch real organization details including billing state
  const { data: orgDetails, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['billing-org-details', activeOrganizationId ?? organization?.id],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const orgs = await apiFetch('/organizations') as Array<{
        id: string;
        clerk_org_id?: string;
        plan: string;
        subscription_status?: string;
        current_period_ends_at?: string;
        cancel_at_period_end?: boolean;
        donor_premium_expires_at?: string | null;
        payment_provider?: string | null;
      }>;
      return orgs.find((o) => o.id === activeOrganizationId);
    },
    enabled: Boolean(activeOrganizationId),
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const plan = searchParams.get("plan") || sessionStorage.getItem("dockerdash_pending_plan");
    if ((plan === "pro" || plan === "team") && (!orgDetails || orgDetails.plan === "free")) {
      setSelectedPlan(plan);
      if (plan) sessionStorage.setItem("dockerdash_pending_plan", plan);
    }
  }, [searchParams, orgDetails]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      return;
    }

    if (window.Paddle) {
      setPaddleStatus("ready");
      return;
    }

    const paddleScript = document.querySelector<HTMLScriptElement>('script[src*="cdn.paddle.com/paddle/v2/paddle.js"]');
    const markReady = () => setPaddleStatus("ready");
    const markUnavailable = () => setPaddleStatus("unavailable");
    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (!window.Paddle) {
        markUnavailable();
      }
    }, 4000);

    paddleScript?.addEventListener("load", markReady);
    paddleScript?.addEventListener("error", markUnavailable);

    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      paddleScript?.removeEventListener("load", markReady);
      paddleScript?.removeEventListener("error", markUnavailable);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleClearPlan = () => {
    sessionStorage.removeItem("dockerdash_pending_plan");
    setSelectedPlan(null);
    navigate("/app/billing", { replace: true });
  };

  const handleCheckout = () => {
    if (!selectedPlan || !activeOrganizationId) {
      return;
    }

    if (!window.Paddle) {
      setPaddleStatus("unavailable");
      toast({
        title: "Checkout is unavailable",
        description: "Paddle did not load in this browser. Disable blockers for Paddle and try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      return;
    }

    const priceId = getCheckoutPriceId(selectedPlan);

    if (!priceId) {
      console.error("Missing Price ID for plan:", selectedPlan);
      toast({
        title: "Checkout is unavailable",
        description: "The billing price ID is missing for this plan.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      return;
    }

    window.Paddle.Checkout.open({
      items: [{ priceId: priceId, quantity: 1 }],
      customer: user?.primaryEmailAddress?.emailAddress ? { email: user.primaryEmailAddress.emailAddress } : undefined,
      customData: {
        organization_id: activeOrganizationId,
        intended_plan: selectedPlan
      },
      settings: {
        displayMode: 'overlay',
        theme: 'dark'
      }
    });

    // Clear local intent once handoff starts
    sessionStorage.removeItem("dockerdash_pending_plan");
  };

  const donationUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_DONATION_URL || "https://liberapay.com/MNDL-27/";
  const paypalDonationUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_PAYPAL_DONATION_URL || "https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/ProtikMondal27";

  const handleCreateDonorIntent = async () => {
    if (!activeOrganizationId) return;

    setDonorIntentLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch('/donor-intent', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          organization_id: activeOrganizationId,
          intended_plan: selectedPlan || 'pro',
          payer_email: user?.primaryEmailAddress?.emailAddress || undefined,
        },
      }) as { reference_token: string; instructions: string[]; grant_days: number };

      setDonorIntent(response);
      toast({
        title: 'Donor token created',
        description: `Reference ${response.reference_token} ready. Include it in your payment note.`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: 'Could not create donor token',
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please retry in a few moments.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      });
    } finally {
      setDonorIntentLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitTransactionHint = () => {
    if (!donorTransactionId.trim()) {
      toast({ title: 'Transaction ID required', description: 'Paste your PayPal transaction ID first.', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }

    toast({
      title: 'Payment note recorded',
      description: 'Share this transaction ID with support/admin for faster donor premium activation.',
    });
    setDonorTransactionId('');
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Active or Pending Subscription View
  const hasPremiumAccess = effectivePlan && effectivePlan !== 'free';
  if (orgDetails && hasPremiumAccess) {
    const activePlan = getPricingPlan(effectivePlan as "pro" | "team" | "enterprise");
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
        <PageHeader
          title="Billing"
          description="Manage your subscription and billing"
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Management" }, { label: "Billing" }]}
        />

        
        
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="glass-card p-6 md:col-span-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Zap className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">{activePlan?.name ?? orgDetails.plan} Plan</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Status: <span className="text-foreground font-medium capitalize">{orgDetails.subscription_status || 'Active'}</span></p>
              </div>
              <div className="ml-auto">
                <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-success/20 text-success text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                  {orgDetails.subscription_status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Processing'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-border">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Billing Period</span>
                <span>Monthly</span>
              </div>
              {orgDetails.current_period_ends_at && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Next Invoice</span>
                  <span>{new Date(orgDetails.current_period_ends_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Payment Method</span>
                <span>{orgDetails.payment_provider ? `${orgDetails.payment_provider} managed` : 'Paddle managed'}</span>
              </div>
              {orgDetails.donor_premium_expires_at && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Donor premium access</span>
                  <span>Active until {new Date(orgDetails.donor_premium_expires_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-8 flex gap-3">
              {orgDetails.plan === "enterprise" || viewer?.dedicated_deployment_status ? (
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => navigate('/app/dedicated-deployment')}>
                  Deployment Status
                </Button>
              ) : null}
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => window.open('https://paddle.com/support', '_blank')}>
                Billing Support
              </Button>
              {orgDetails.cancel_at_period_end ? (
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled>Canceled at end of period</Button>
              ) : (
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive">
                  Cancel Subscription
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="glass-card p-6">
            <h4 className="font-semibold mb-4">Plan Limits</h4>
            <ul className="space-y-3">
              {(activePlan?.highlights ?? []).map(f => (
                <li key={f} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                  <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-success shrink-0" /> {f}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Checkout State View (User selected a plan but hasn't paid)
  if (selectedPlan && (selectedPlan === "pro" || selectedPlan === "team")) {
    const details = getPricingPlan(selectedPlan);
    if (!details) {
      return null;
    }
    const paddleBlocked = paddleStatus === "unavailable";
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
        <PageHeader
          title="Complete your Subscription"
          description={`Almost there. Activate the ${details.name} plan to unlock the paid operating envelope and premium alerting.`}
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Management" }, { label: "Billing" }, { label: "Checkout" }]}
        />

        
        
        <div className="max-w-md mx-auto space-y-4">
          <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden ring-2 ring-primary">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-border bg-primary/5 flex justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-lg">{details.name} Plan</h3>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{details.priceLabel}</p>
              </div>
              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={handleClearPlan}>

                </p>

            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              <Button variant="outline" className="w-full" onClick={handleCreateDonorIntent} disabled={donorIntentLoading}>

              {donorIntent ? (

                  <ul className="space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">

  // Default Free / Empty State View

        <div className="glass-card p-8 md:col-span-2">

          <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleCreateDonorIntent} disabled={donorIntentLoading}>
              {donorIntentLoading ? <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
              Generate donor token (DNR-8)
            </Button>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1" onClick={() => window.open(donationUrl, '_blank')}>Open Liberapay</Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1" onClick={() => window.open(paypalDonationUrl, '_blank')}>Open PayPal</Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {donorIntent ? (
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-border p-4 space-y-2">
              <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Reference token</div>
              <div className="font-mono text-sm">{donorIntent.reference_token}</div>
              <ul className="space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {donorIntent.instructions.map((instruction) => (
                  <li key={instruction}>• {instruction}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Manual verification target: within 24 hours. Access is granted for {donorIntent.grant_days} days per matched donation.
              </p>

          <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
            <input
              value={donorTransactionId}

            />
            <Button size="sm" onClick={handleSubmitTransactionHint}>I have paid</Button>

}
