import { useState } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Link, useParams, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { formatDistanceToNowStrict } from "date-fns";
import {
  Activity,
  Box,
  CheckCircle2,
  Cpu,
  HardDrive,
  Loader2,
  Network,
  Play,
  RotateCcw,
  ScrollText,
  Server,
  Settings2,
  Square,
  TerminalSquare,
  FolderOpen,
  Lock,
} from "lucide-react";

import { LogConsole } from "@/components/docker/LogConsole";
import { HostUpgradeDialog } from "@/components/hosts/HostUpgradeDialog";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useContainerInspect, useContainerLogs, useContainerStats, useDockerHosts } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN, normalizePlan } from "../../../shared/schema/plan-policy";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";

function formatBytes(bytes: number) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const exponent = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exponent;
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 || exponent === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[exponent]}`;
}

function formatCount(value: number | string | undefined | null) {
  const numeric = Number(value ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? String(numeric) : "0";
}

function calcCpuPercent(stats: any) {
  if (!stats?.cpu_stats || !stats?.precpu_stats) return "0.0";
  const cpuDelta = stats.cpu_stats.cpu_usage.total_usage - stats.precpu_stats.cpu_usage.total_usage;
  const sysDelta = stats.cpu_stats.system_cpu_usage - stats.precpu_stats.system_cpu_usage;
  const cpus = stats.cpu_stats.online_cpus || 1;
  return sysDelta > 0 ? ((cpuDelta / sysDelta) * cpus * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
}

function calcNetworkIo(stats: any) {
  const networks = stats?.networks;
  if (!networks || typeof networks !== "object") {
    return null;
  }

  let rx = 0;
  let tx = 0;
  for (const value of Object.values(networks) as Array<any>) {
    rx += Number(value?.rx_bytes || 0);
    tx += Number(value?.tx_bytes || 0);
  }

  return { rx, tx, total: rx + tx };
}

function calcBlkioTotal(stats: any) {
  const entries = stats?.blkio_stats?.io_service_bytes_recursive;
  if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return null;

  let total = 0;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    total += Number(entry?.value || 0);
  }

  return total > 0 ? total : 0;
}

function getPrimaryIp(inspect: any) {
  const networks = inspect?.NetworkSettings?.Networks;
  if (!networks || typeof networks !== "object") return null;

  for (const value of Object.values(networks) as Array<any>) {
    if (value?.IPAddress) {
      return value.IPAddress;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function getContainerHealth(state: any) {
  const healthStatus = state?.Health?.Status;
  if (healthStatus === "healthy") return "healthy";
  if (healthStatus === "unhealthy") return "unhealthy";
  if (state?.Running) return "running";
  if (state?.Paused) return "paused";
  return "stopped";
}

function formatContainerUptime(startedAt: string | undefined) {
  if (!startedAt || startedAt === "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z") return "Unavailable";
  const date = new Date(startedAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "Unavailable";
  return formatDistanceToNowStrict(date);
}

function DetailStatCard({
  title,
  value,
  helper,
  valueTone = "text-primary",
  progress,
}: {
  title: string;
  value: string;
  helper?: string;
  valueTone?: string;
  progress?: number | null;
}) {
  const width = progress !== null && progress !== undefined ? `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress))}%` : null;

  return (
    <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>
        <span className={cn("text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight", valueTone)}>{value}</span>
      </div>
      {width ? (
        <div className="mt-8 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex h-24 items-end gap-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                className={cn(
                  "flex-1 rounded-t-md bg-primary/15",
                  index === 6 && "bg-primary",
                )}
                style={{ height: `${Math.max(30, Math.min(100, progress ?? 0) * (0.45 + index * 0.08))}%` }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
          {helper ? <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{helper}</p> : null}
        </div>
      ) : helper ? (
        <div className="mt-8">
          <div className="h-4 rounded-full bg-white/5">
            <div className="h-full w-0 rounded-full bg-primary" />
          </div>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{helper}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function MiniSummaryCard({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-6">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-4 text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function ConfigRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4">
      <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <p className="break-all font-mono text-sm text-foreground">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ContainerDetailPage() {
  const { id: containerId } = useParams();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const hostId = searchParams.get("host");
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [upgradeDialogOpen, setUpgradeDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const effectivePlan = viewer?.active_org_effective_plan ?? viewer?.active_org_plan;

  const { data: allowedHosts = [], isLoading: hostsLoading } = useDockerHosts(viewer?.active_org_id ?? null, { filterByPlan: true });
  const isHostAllowed = hostId ? allowedHosts.some(h => h.id === hostId) : false;

  // Only fetch container data if the host passes plan entitlement checks
  const guardedHostId = isHostAllowed ? hostId : null;
  const { data: inspect, isLoading: inspectLoading, error: inspectError } = useContainerInspect(guardedHostId, containerId);
  const {
    data: stats,
    error: statsError,
    isFetching: statsFetching,
    refetch: refetchStats,
  } = useContainerStats(guardedHostId, containerId, 10000);
  const { data: logsData, isLoading: logsLoading, refetch: refetchLogs } = useContainerLogs(guardedHostId, containerId, { tail: 200 });

  const handleAction = async (action: "container-start" | "container-stop" | "container-restart") => {
    if (!hostId || !containerId) return;
    const label = action.replace("container-", "");
    setActionLoading(label);

    try {
      const fn =
        action === "container-start"
          ? dockerApi.startContainer
          : action === "container-stop"
            ? dockerApi.stopContainer
            : dockerApi.restartContainer;

      const result = await fn(hostId, containerId);
      toast({ title: result.ok ? `Container ${label}ed` : `${label} failed` });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["container-inspect", hostId, containerId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["container-stats", hostId, containerId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["containers"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["host-containers"] });
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast({ title: `${label} failed`, description: error.message, variant: "destructive" });
    }

    setActionLoading(null);
  };

  if (!hostId) {
    return (
      <div className="glass-card p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
        Missing host parameter. Go back to <Link to="/app/containers" className="text-primary hover:underline">Containers</Link>.
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (hostsLoading || inspectLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-64 items-center justify-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isHostAllowed && allowedHosts.length > 0) {
    const normalizedPlan = normalizePlan(effectivePlan);
    const fallbackNodeLimit = PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN[normalizedPlan].nodeLimit;
    const nodeLimit = viewer?.entitlements ? viewer.entitlements.nodeLimit : fallbackNodeLimit;

    return (
      <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
        <PageHeader
          title="Access Restricted"
          description="Host limit exceeded"
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Containers", href: "/app/containers" }, { label: "Restricted" }]}
        />
        <div className="glass-card p-12 text-center">
          <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-warning/10">
            <Lock className="h-6 w-6 text-warning" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Host Access Restricted</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-6 max-w-md mx-auto">
            This container belongs to a host that exceeds your current plan's node limit ({nodeLimit} node{nodeLimit === 1 ? "" : "s"}).
          </p>
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-4">
            <Button variant="outline" asChild>
              <Link to="/app/containers">Back to Containers</Link>
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => setUpgradeDialogOpen(true)}>
              Upgrade Plan
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <HostUpgradeDialog open={upgradeDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setUpgradeDialogOpen} nodeLimit={nodeLimit} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (inspectError || !inspect) {
    return (
      <div className="glass-card p-8 text-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Failed to load container: {(inspectError as Error)?.message || "Not found"}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const name = (inspect.Name || "").replace(/^\//, "");
  const state = inspect.State || {};
  const config = inspect.Config || {};
  const cpuPercent = calcCpuPercent(stats);
  const memUsage = stats?.memory_stats?.usage || 0;
  const memLimit = stats?.memory_stats?.limit || 0;
  const memPercent = memLimit > 0 ? Number(((memUsage / memLimit) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 0;
  const restartCount = state.RestartCount || inspect.RestartCount || 0;
  const uptime = formatContainerUptime(state.StartedAt);
  const logs: string[] = logsData?.logs || [];
  const primaryIp = getPrimaryIp(inspect) || "No IP";
  const health = getContainerHealth(state);
  const networkIo = calcNetworkIo(stats);
  const blkioTotal = calcBlkioTotal(stats);
  const statusTone =
    health === "healthy" || health === "running"
      ? "border-success/20 bg-success/10 text-success"
      : health === "unhealthy"
        ? "border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
        : "border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 text-warning";

  const environment = Array.isArray(config.Env) ? config.Env : [];
  const networks = inspect.NetworkSettings?.Networks ? Object.entries(inspect.NetworkSettings.Networks) : [];
  const portBindings = inspect.HostConfig?.PortBindings ? Object.entries(inspect.HostConfig.PortBindings) : [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title={name || containerId || ""}
        description={config.Image}
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Containers", href: "/app/containers" }, { label: name || containerId || "" }]}
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.9fr),220px,220px]">
          <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-7">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-5">
                <div className="flex h-24 w-24 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[28px] border border-primary/20 bg-primary/10">
                  <Box className="h-11 w-11 text-primary" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                    <h2 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">{name || containerId}</h2>
                    <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.14em]", statusTone)}>
                      <Activity className="h-4 w-4" />
                      {health}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-xl text-muted-foreground">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                      <ScrollText className="h-4 w-4" />
                      {config.Image || "Unknown image"}
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Network className="h-4 w-4" />
                      {primaryIp}
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-foreground">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      {state.Running ? "Running" : state.Status || "Stopped"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <MiniSummaryCard label="Uptime" value={uptime} />
          <MiniSummaryCard label="Restarts" value={formatCount(restartCount)} />
        </div>

        <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] px-6 py-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <Button
                className="gap-2 rounded-full px-7"
                disabled={!!actionLoading || state.Running}
                onClick={() => handleAction("container-start")}
              >
                {actionLoading === "start" ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Play className="h-4 w-4" />}
                Start
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="gap-2 rounded-full px-7"
                disabled={!!actionLoading || !state.Running}
                onClick={() => handleAction("container-stop")}
              >
                {actionLoading === "stop" ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Square className="h-4 w-4" />}
                Stop
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="gap-2 rounded-full px-7"
                disabled={!!actionLoading}
                onClick={() => handleAction("container-restart")}
              >
                {actionLoading === "restart" ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" />}
                Restart
              </Button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <Sheet>
                <SheetTrigger asChild>
                  <Button className="gap-2 rounded-full px-7">
                    <Settings2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    View Config
                  </Button>
                </SheetTrigger>
                <SheetContent side="right" className="w-full overflow-y-auto border-white/10 bg-background/95 p-6 sm:max-w-2xl">
                  <SheetHeader>
                    <SheetTitle>{name || containerId}</SheetTitle>
                    <SheetDescription>Container inspect, environment, networking, and port binding details.</SheetDescription>
                  </SheetHeader>

                  <div className="mt-6 space-y-6">
                    <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                      <ConfigRow label="Container ID" value={(inspect.Id || "").substring(0, 12) || "-"} />
                      <ConfigRow label="Image" value={config.Image || "-"} />
                      <ConfigRow label="Status" value={state.Status || "-"} />
                      <ConfigRow label="Restart policy" value={inspect.HostConfig?.RestartPolicy?.Name || "-"} />
                      <ConfigRow label="Started at" value={state.StartedAt ? new Date(state.StartedAt).toLocaleString() : "-"} />
                      <ConfigRow
                        label="Finished at"
                        value={
                          state.FinishedAt && state.FinishedAt !== "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"
                            ? new Date(state.FinishedAt).toLocaleString()
                            : "-"
                        }
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Environment</h3>
                      {environment.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          No environment variables set.
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          {environment.map((env: string, index: number) => {
                            const [key, ...rest] = env.split("=");
                            return (
                              <div key={`${key}-${index}`} className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4 font-mono text-sm">
                                <span className="font-semibold text-primary">{key}</span>
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground">={rest.join("=")}</span>
                              </div>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Networking</h3>
                      {networks.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          No attached networks.
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                          {networks.map(([networkName, network]: [string, any]) => (
                            <div key={networkName} className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4">
                              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">{networkName}</p>
                              <p className="mt-2 font-mono text-sm">{network?.IPAddress || "-"}</p>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Port bindings</h3>
                      {portBindings.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          No port bindings.
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          {portBindings.map(([port, bindings]: [string, any]) => (
                            <div key={port} className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4 font-mono text-sm">
                              {port} - {(bindings || []).map((binding: any) => `${binding.HostIp || "0.0.0.0"}:${binding.HostPort}`).join(", ")}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </SheetContent>
              </Sheet>

              <Button variant="outline" className="gap-2 rounded-full px-7" disabled title="Container shell is not available in the current agent API.">
                <TerminalSquare className="h-4 w-4" />
                Shell
              </Button>
              <Link to={`/app/files?host=${hostId}&container=${containerId}`}>
                <Button variant="outline" className="gap-2 rounded-full px-7">
                  <FolderOpen className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Browse Files
                </Button>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {statsError instanceof Error ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
            {statsError.message}
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <div className="grid gap-5 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <DetailStatCard
            title="CPU usage"
            value={`${cpuPercent}%`}
            helper="Current sample from Docker stats"
            progress={Number(cpuPercent)}
          />
          <DetailStatCard
            title="Memory"
            value={formatBytes(memUsage)}
            helper={memLimit > 0 ? `${memPercent}% of ${formatBytes(memLimit)}` : "Memory limit unavailable"}
            progress={memLimit > 0 ? memPercent : 0}
          />
          <DetailStatCard
            title="Network I/O"
            value={networkIo ? formatBytes(networkIo.total) : "Unavailable"}
            helper={networkIo ? `RX ${formatBytes(networkIo.rx)} / TX ${formatBytes(networkIo.tx)}` : "Network totals unavailable"}
            progress={networkIo ? Math.min(100, (networkIo.total / (1024 * 1024 * 10)) * 100) : null}
          />
          <DetailStatCard
            title="Disk usage"
            value={blkioTotal !== null ? formatBytes(blkioTotal) : "Unavailable"}
            helper={blkioTotal !== null ? "Block I/O total reported by Docker stats" : "Container filesystem usage is not exposed by the current agent"}
            progress={null}
            valueTone={blkioTotal !== null ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground"}
          />
        </div>

        <LogConsole
          logs={logs}
          loading={logsLoading}
          title={`Live logs - ${name || containerId}`}
          emptyMessage="No logs available for this container."
          heightClassName="h-[560px]"
          onRefresh={() => refetchLogs()}
          refreshLabel="Refresh logs"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/ContainersPage.tsx">
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  Activity,
  AlertTriangle,
  Box,
  ChevronDown,
  Cpu,
  Loader2,
  MemoryStick,
  Play,
  RotateCw,
  Search,
  Server,
  Square,
} from "lucide-react";

import { KPICard } from "@/components/dashboard/KPICard";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { useAllContainerStats, useContainers, useDockerHosts } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useFleetMetrics } from "@/hooks/useFleetMetrics";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN, normalizePlan } from "../../../shared/schema/plan-policy";

type BadgeStatus = "running" | "unhealthy" | "exited" | "restarting" | "paused" | "critical" | "warning";

const STATE_TABS = [
  { key: "all", label: "All" },
  { key: "running", label: "Running" },
  { key: "unhealthy", label: "Unhealthy" },
  { key: "restarting", label: "Restarting" },
  { key: "exited", label: "Exited" },
] as const;

function relativeAge(created?: number): string {
  if (!created) return "--";
  const seconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000 - created);
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  if (days < 30) return `${days}d`;
  return `${Math.floor(days / 30)}mo`;
}

function shortenImage(img: string): string {
  if (!img) return "--";
  const parts = img.split("/");
  return parts[parts.length - 1] || img;
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const exponent = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024));
  return `${(bytes / 1024 ** exponent).toFixed(exponent > 1 ? 1 : 0)} ${units[exponent]}`;
}

function formatNetIO(rx: number, tx: number): string {
  return `${formatBytes(rx)} / ${formatBytes(tx)}`;
}

function formatPercent(value: number): string {
  return `${value.toFixed(1)}%`;
}

function mapState(state?: string, health?: string): BadgeStatus {
  if (health === "unhealthy") return "unhealthy";
  if (state === "running") return "running";
  if (state === "exited") return "exited";
  if (state === "restarting") return "restarting";
  if (state === "paused") return "paused";
  return "exited";
}

function severityBorderClass(state?: string, health?: string): string {
  if (health === "unhealthy") return "border-l-2 border-l-destructive/60";
  if (state === "restarting") return "border-l-2 border-l-warning/60";
  return "";
}

function metricTone(value: number | null): "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | "neutral" {
  if (value === null) return "neutral";
  if (value >= 90) return "destructive";
  if (value >= 80) return "warning";
  return "success";
}

function TelemetryBadge({
  loading,
  available,
  partial,
  autoRefresh,
}: {
  loading: boolean;
  available: boolean;
  partial: boolean;
  autoRefresh: boolean;
}) {
  const tone = loading
    ? "border-white/10 bg-background/50 text-muted-foreground"
    : !available
      ? "border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
      : partial
        ? "border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 text-warning"
        : "border-success/20 bg-success/10 text-success";

  const label = loading
    ? "Updating telemetry"
    : !available
      ? "Telemetry unavailable"
      : !autoRefresh
        ? "Manual telemetry"
      : partial
        ? "Partial telemetry"
        : "Fleet telemetry live";

  return <span className={cn("inline-flex rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em]", tone)}>{label}</span>;
}

function FleetSignalCard({
  label,
  value,
  helper,
  icon: Icon,
  status,
  progress,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  helper: string;
  icon: typeof Cpu;
  status: "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | "neutral";
  progress: number;
}) {
  const barTone = status === "destructive" ? "bg-destructive" : status === "warning" ? "bg-warning" : status === "success" ? "bg-primary" : "bg-muted-foreground/40";
  const iconTone = status === "destructive" ? "text-destructive" : status === "warning" ? "text-warning" : status === "success" ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground";

  return (
    <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
          <p className="mt-4 text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">{value}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-3">
          <Icon className={cn("h-5 w-5", iconTone)} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-5 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/5">
        <div className={cn("h-full rounded-full transition-all", barTone)} style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress))}%` }} />
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">{helper}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ContainersPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { organization: currentOrg } = useOrganization();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { data: hosts = [], isLoading: hostsLoading } = useDockerHosts(currentOrg?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const effectivePlan = viewer?.active_org_effective_plan ?? viewer?.active_org_plan;
  const {
    data: rawContainers,
    isLoading: containersLoading,
    isFetching: containersFetching,
    refetch: refetchContainers,
    error,
  } = useContainers(currentOrg?.id, hosts.length > 0, 30000);
  const {
    data: rawStats,
    isFetching: statsFetching,
    refetch: refetchStats,
    error: statsError,
  } = useAllContainerStats(currentOrg?.id, hosts.length > 0, 15000);
  const {
    data: fleetMetrics = [],
    isLoading: fleetMetricsLoading,
    isFetching: fleetMetricsFetching,
    refetch: refetchFleetMetrics,
    error: fleetMetricsError,
  } = useFleetMetrics(currentOrg?.id, 15000);

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [stateTab, setStateTab] = useState("all");
  const [hostFilter, setHostFilter] = useState("");
  const [imageFilter, setImageFilter] = useState("");
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const containers: any[] = useMemo(() => (Array.isArray(rawContainers) ? rawContainers : []), [rawContainers]);

  const uniqueHosts = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, string>();
    containers.forEach((c: any) => {
      if (c._hostId && c._hostName) map.set(c._hostId, c._hostName);
    });
    return Array.from(map.entries());
  }, [containers]);

  const uniqueImages = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    containers.forEach((c: any) => c.Image && set.add(c.Image));
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [containers]);

  const statsMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, any>();
    if (Array.isArray(rawStats)) rawStats.forEach((s: any) => map.set(s.containerId, s));
    return map;
  }, [rawStats]);

  const kpi = useMemo(() => {
    let running = 0;
    let unhealthy = 0;
    let restarting = 0;
    containers.forEach((c: any) => {
      if (c.State === "running") running++;
      const status = (c.Status || "").toLowerCase();
      if (status.includes("unhealthy") || c.State === "unhealthy") unhealthy++;
      if (c.State === "restarting") restarting++;
    });
    return { total: containers.length, running, unhealthy, restarting };
  }, [containers]);

  const latestFleetMetrics = useMemo(() => (fleetMetrics.length > 0 ? fleetMetrics[fleetMetrics.length - 1] : null), [fleetMetrics]);
  const hostCoverage = latestFleetMetrics ? `${latestFleetMetrics.reportingHosts}/${latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts}` : "--";

  const fleetCpuCard = useMemo(() => {
    if (fleetMetricsLoading) return { value: "--", helper: "Loading fleet telemetry...", status: "neutral" as const, progress: 0 };
    if (!latestFleetMetrics) return { value: "--", helper: "Fleet telemetry unavailable", status: "neutral" as const, progress: 0 };
    const coverage = latestFleetMetrics.reportingHosts === latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts
      ? `across ${latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts} host${latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
      : `from ${latestFleetMetrics.reportingHosts} of ${latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts} hosts`;
    return {
      value: formatPercent(latestFleetMetrics.cpu),
      helper: `${latestFleetMetrics.usedCores.toFixed(2)} / ${latestFleetMetrics.totalCores.toFixed(2)} cores ${coverage}`.trim(),
      status: metricTone(latestFleetMetrics.cpu),
      progress: latestFleetMetrics.cpu,
    };
  }, [fleetMetricsLoading, latestFleetMetrics]);

  const fleetMemoryCard = useMemo(() => {
    if (fleetMetricsLoading) return { value: "--", helper: "Loading fleet telemetry...", status: "neutral" as const, progress: 0 };
    if (!latestFleetMetrics) return { value: "--", helper: "Fleet telemetry unavailable", status: "neutral" as const, progress: 0 };
    const coverage = latestFleetMetrics.reportingHosts === latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts
      ? `across ${latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts} host${latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
      : `from ${latestFleetMetrics.reportingHosts} of ${latestFleetMetrics.totalHosts} hosts`;
    return {
      value: formatBytes(latestFleetMetrics.memoryUsed),
      helper: `${formatPercent(latestFleetMetrics.memory)} of ${formatBytes(latestFleetMetrics.memoryLimit)} ${coverage}`.trim(),
      status: metricTone(latestFleetMetrics.memory),
      progress: latestFleetMetrics.memory,
    };
  }, [fleetMetricsLoading, latestFleetMetrics]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return containers.filter((c: any) => {
      const name = (c.Names?.[0] || "").replace(/^\//, "").toLowerCase();
      const image = (c.Image || "").toLowerCase();
      const hostName = (c._hostName || "").toLowerCase();
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      if (q && !name.includes(q) && !image.includes(q) && !hostName.includes(q)) return false;
      if (stateTab === "unhealthy") {
        const status = (c.Status || "").toLowerCase();
        if (!status.includes("unhealthy") && c.State !== "unhealthy") return false;
      } else if (stateTab !== "all" && c.State !== stateTab) {
        return false;
      }
      if (hostFilter && c._hostId !== hostFilter) return false;
      if (imageFilter && c.Image !== imageFilter) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [containers, search, stateTab, hostFilter, imageFilter]);

  const hasActiveFilters = !!search || stateTab !== "all" || !!hostFilter || !!imageFilter;
  const activeHostLabel = uniqueHosts.find(([id]) => id === hostFilter)?.[1] || "";
  const telemetryAvailable = !!latestFleetMetrics;
  const telemetryPartial = latestFleetMetrics?.isPartial === true;
  const liveRefreshPending = containersFetching || statsFetching || fleetMetricsFetching;
  const auxiliaryErrorMessage = [statsError, fleetMetricsError]
    .map((queryError) => (queryError instanceof Error ? queryError.message : null))
    .filter((message): message is string => !!message)
    .join(" ");

  async function handleRefreshLiveData() {
    await Promise.allSettled([refetchContainers(), refetchStats(), refetchFleetMetrics()]);
    await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['auth-me'] });
  }

  async function handleAction(hostIdValue: string, containerId: string, action: "start" | "stop" | "restart") {
    setActionLoading(containerId);
    try {
      if (action === "start") await dockerApi.startContainer(hostIdValue, containerId);
      else if (action === "stop") await dockerApi.stopContainer(hostIdValue, containerId);
      else await dockerApi.restartContainer(hostIdValue, containerId);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(`Container ${action} failed:`, e);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    setSearch("");
    setStateTab("all");
    setHostFilter("");
    setImageFilter("");
  }

  if (hostsLoading || containersLoading) {
    return <div className="flex h-64 items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
        <PageHeader title="Containers" breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Infrastructure" }, { label: "Containers" }]} />
        <div className="glass-card p-8 text-center"><p className="text-sm text-destructive">Failed to load containers: {errorMessage}</p></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (containers.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
        <PageHeader title="Containers" breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Infrastructure" }, { label: "Containers" }]} />
        <div className="glass-card p-12 text-center">
          <Box className="mx-auto mb-4 h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground" />
          <h2 className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold">No containers found</h2>
          <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {hosts.length === 0 ? "Connect a Docker host first, then containers will appear here." : "No containers are currently running on your connected hosts."}
          </p>
          {hosts.length === 0 && <Link to="/app/hosts"><Button variant="outline">Go to Hosts</Button></Link>}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in pb-10">
      <PageHeader
        title="Containers"
        description={`${containers.length} containers across ${uniqueHosts.length} host(s)`}
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Infrastructure" }, { label: "Containers" }]}
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <TelemetryBadge loading={fleetMetricsLoading} available={telemetryAvailable} partial={telemetryPartial} autoRefresh={true} />
          </div>
        }
      />

      {auxiliaryErrorMessage ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/35 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <p className="text-destructive">{auxiliaryErrorMessage}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <FleetSignalCard label="Fleet CPU" value={fleetCpuCard.value} helper={fleetCpuCard.helper} icon={Cpu} status={fleetCpuCard.status} progress={fleetCpuCard.progress} />
        <FleetSignalCard label="Fleet Memory" value={fleetMemoryCard.value} helper={fleetMemoryCard.helper} icon={MemoryStick} status={fleetMemoryCard.status} progress={fleetMemoryCard.progress} />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <KPICard label="Total" value={kpi.total} subtext="Tracked containers" icon={Box} status="neutral" />
        <KPICard label="Running" value={kpi.running} subtext="Actively serving traffic" icon={Activity} status={kpi.running > 0 ? "success" : "neutral"} />
        <KPICard label="Unhealthy" value={kpi.unhealthy} subtext="Immediate investigation" icon={AlertTriangle} status={kpi.unhealthy > 0 ? "destructive" : "neutral"} />
        <KPICard label="Restarting" value={kpi.restarting} subtext="Potential crash loops" icon={RotateCw} status={kpi.restarting > 0 ? "warning" : "neutral"} />
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden rounded-[28px]">
        <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-6 py-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">Containers</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Live stats update automatically. Use the control rail to narrow the dataset before acting.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/35 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Showing {filtered.length} of {containers.length}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-6 py-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
            <div className="relative w-full xl:max-w-md">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input placeholder="Search containers, images, or hosts..." className="h-10 rounded-full border-white/10 bg-background/40 pl-10" value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/35 p-1">
                {STATE_TABS.map((tab) => {
                  const isActive = stateTab === tab.key;
                  const count = tab.key === "all" ? containers.length : tab.key === "unhealthy" ? kpi.unhealthy : tab.key === "running" ? kpi.running : tab.key === "restarting" ? kpi.restarting : containers.filter((c: any) => c.State === tab.key).length;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={tab.key}
                      onClick={() => setStateTab(tab.key)}
                      className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors", isActive ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm" : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground")}
                    >
                      <span className="font-medium">{tab.label}</span>
                      <span className="ml-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums opacity-70">{count}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <select value={hostFilter} onChange={(e) => setHostFilter(e.target.value)} className="appearance-none rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/40 px-4 py-2 pr-9 text-xs text-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring">
                  <option value="">All hosts</option>
                  {uniqueHosts.map(([id, name]) => <option key={id} value={id}>{name}</option>)}
                </select>
                <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <select value={imageFilter} onChange={(e) => setImageFilter(e.target.value)} className="max-w-[180px] appearance-none truncate rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/40 px-4 py-2 pr-9 text-xs text-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring">
                  <option value="">All images</option>
                  {uniqueImages.map((img) => <option key={img} value={img}>{shortenImage(img)}</option>)}
                </select>
                <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              </div>

              {hasActiveFilters ? <Button variant="ghost" className="rounded-full px-4 text-xs" onClick={clearFilters}>Clear filters</Button> : null}
            </div>
          </div>

          {hasActiveFilters ? (
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {search ? <span className="rounded-full border border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-primary">Search: {search}</span> : null}
              {stateTab !== "all" ? <span className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/45 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">State: {STATE_TABS.find((tab) => tab.key === stateTab)?.label}</span> : null}
              {hostFilter ? <span className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/45 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Host: {activeHostLabel}</span> : null}
              {imageFilter ? <span className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/45 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Image: {shortenImage(imageFilter)}</span> : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow className="border-b border-white/5 bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/20">
              <TableHead className="px-6 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Container</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Host</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Image</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden xl:table-cell text-right text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">CPU</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden xl:table-cell text-right text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Memory</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden xl:table-cell text-right text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Net I/O</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell text-right text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Restarts</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell text-right text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Age</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[116px] text-right text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">Action</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>

          <TableBody>
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <TableRow className="hover:bg-transparent">
                <TableCell colSpan={10} className="px-6 py-14 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No containers match the current filters.</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : null}

            {filtered.map((c: any) => {
              const name = (c.Names?.[0] || c.Id?.substring(0, 12) || "unknown").replace(/^\//, "");
              const health = (c.Status || "").toLowerCase().includes("unhealthy") ? "unhealthy" : undefined;
              const badge = mapState(c.State, health);
              const isExited = c.State === "exited";
              const isRunning = c.State === "running";
              const restartCount = c.RestartCount ?? (c.HostConfig?.RestartPolicy?.MaximumRetryCount || 0);
              const borderClass = severityBorderClass(c.State, health);

              return (
                <TableRow key={c.Id || name} className={cn("border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-background/60", isExited && "opacity-70", borderClass)}>
                  <TableCell className="px-6 py-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className={cn("flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border", isRunning ? "border-primary/20 bg-primary/10" : "border-white/10 bg-background/35")}>
                        <Box className={cn("h-5 w-5", isRunning ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground")} />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <Link to={`/app/containers/${c.Id?.substring(0, 12)}?host=${c._hostId}`} className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold text-foreground transition-colors hover:text-primary">{name}</Link>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-muted-foreground/70">{c.Id?.substring(0, 12)}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="py-4"><StatusBadge status={badge} /></TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="py-4">
                    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/35 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <Server className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span className="max-w-[120px] truncate">{c._hostName || "--"}</span>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="hidden py-4 lg:table-cell"><div className="max-w-[200px] truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{shortenImage(c.Image)}</div></TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="hidden py-4 text-right text-xs tabular-nums xl:table-cell">
                    {(() => {
                      const s = statsMap.get(c.Id);
                      if (!s || !isRunning) return <span className="text-muted-foreground">--</span>;
                      return <span className={cn(s.cpu_percent > 80 ? "font-semibold text-warning" : "text-muted-foreground")}>{s.cpu_percent}%</span>;
                    })()}
                  </TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="hidden py-4 text-right text-xs tabular-nums xl:table-cell">
                    {(() => {
                      const s = statsMap.get(c.Id);
                      if (!s || !isRunning) return <span className="text-muted-foreground">--</span>;
                      const pct = s.memory_limit > 0 ? Math.round((s.memory_usage / s.memory_limit) * 100) : 0;
                      return (
                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <div className={cn(pct > 85 ? "font-semibold text-warning" : "text-muted-foreground")}>{formatBytes(s.memory_usage)}</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60">{pct}% of {formatBytes(s.memory_limit)}</div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="hidden py-4 text-right text-xs tabular-nums xl:table-cell">
                    {(() => {
                      const s = statsMap.get(c.Id);
                      if (!s || !isRunning) return <span className="text-muted-foreground">--</span>;
                      return <span className="text-muted-foreground">{formatNetIO(s.net_rx, s.net_tx)}</span>;
                    })()}
                  </TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="hidden py-4 text-right text-xs tabular-nums md:table-cell"><span className={cn(restartCount > 0 ? "font-semibold text-warning" : "text-muted-foreground")}>{restartCount}</span></TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="hidden py-4 text-right text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{relativeAge(c.Created)}</TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="py-4 text-right">
                    {actionLoading === c.Id ? (
                      <Loader2 className="inline h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
                    ) : isRunning ? (
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/35 p-1">
                        <button onClick={() => handleAction(c._hostId, c.Id, "restart")} title="Restart" className="rounded-full p-2 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-warning/10 hover:text-warning"><RotateCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button>
                        <button onClick={() => handleAction(c._hostId, c.Id, "stop")} title="Stop" className="rounded-full p-2 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive"><Square className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <button onClick={() => handleAction(c._hostId, c.Id, "start")} title="Start" className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-background/35 p-2 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-success/10 hover:text-success"><Play className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              );
            })}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/DashboardPage.tsx">
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useOrganization, useOrganizationList } from "@clerk/react";
import { useDockerHosts, useContainers } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { buildDashboardStats } from "@/lib/dashboard-summary";
import { DashboardLoadingState } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardLoadingState";
import { DashboardNoOrganizationState } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardNoOrganizationState";
import { DashboardEmptyHostsState } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardEmptyHostsState";
import { DashboardOverview } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardOverview";

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { organization, isLoaded: orgLoaded } = useOrganization();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { userMemberships, isLoaded: listLoaded } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: {
      infinite: true,
    },
  });

  const currentOrg = organization;
  const hasOrgs = userMemberships.count ? userMemberships.count > 0 : false;
  const orgLoading = !orgLoaded || !listLoaded;

  const { data: hosts = [], isLoading: hostsLoading } = useDockerHosts(currentOrg?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const {
    data: containers = [],
    isLoading: containersLoading,
    isFetching: containersFetching,
    refetch: refetchContainers,
    error: containersError,
  } = useContainers(currentOrg?.id, hosts.length > 0, 30000);

  const stats = useMemo(() => buildDashboardStats(hosts, containers), [hosts, containers]);

  if (orgLoading) {
    return <DashboardLoadingState />;
  }

  if (!hasOrgs) {
    return <DashboardNoOrganizationState />;
  }

  const isLoading = (hostsLoading || containersLoading) && hosts.length === 0;
  if (isLoading) {
    return <DashboardLoadingState />;
  }

  if (hosts.length === 0) {
    return <DashboardEmptyHostsState organizationName={currentOrg?.name} />;
  }

  return (
    <DashboardOverview
      organizationName={currentOrg?.name}
      organizationId={organization?.id ?? null}
      hosts={hosts}
      stats={stats}
      containersLoading={containersLoading}
      liveDataError={containersError instanceof Error ? containersError.message : null}
      fleetMetricsRefetchInterval={10000}
    />
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/DedicatedDeploymentPage.tsx">
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { CheckCircle2, Circle, Clock3, Mail, Rocket, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useDedicatedDeployment } from "@/hooks/useDedicatedDeployment";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import type { DedicatedDeploymentStatus } from "@/types/dedicated";

const STATUS_ORDER: DedicatedDeploymentStatus[] = [
  "intake_received",
  "capacity_reserved",
  "provisioning",
  "hardening",
  "ready_for_handoff",
];

const STATUS_COPY: Record<
  DedicatedDeploymentStatus,
  { label: string; detail: string }
> = {
  intake_received: {
    label: "Deployment brief accepted",
    detail: "The provisioning queue has your infrastructure brief and is validating the operating envelope.",
  },
  capacity_reserved: {
    label: "Capacity reserved",
    detail: "Dedicated capacity is being assigned for your isolated environment before provisioning begins.",
  },
  provisioning: {
    label: "Infrastructure provisioning",
    detail: "Compute, networking, and the dedicated data path are being provisioned for your organization.",
  },
  hardening: {
    label: "Security hardening",
    detail: "Baseline security controls, access boundaries, and readiness checks are being applied.",
  },
  ready_for_handoff: {
    label: "Workspace handoff ready",
    detail: "The managed environment is secured and ready for guided activation inside the product.",
  },
  active: {
    label: "Dedicated environment active",
    detail: "Provisioning is complete and the organization can operate normally inside Docker Dash.",
  },
};

export default function DedicatedDeploymentPage() {
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { data: deployment, isLoading } = useDedicatedDeployment();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-64 items-center justify-center">
        <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!deployment) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
        <PageHeader
          title="Dedicated Deployment"
          description="No managed deployment brief has been submitted yet."
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Management" }, { label: "Dedicated deployment" }]}
        />

        <div className="rounded-[2rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/70 p-8">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Start the managed intake</h2>
          <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
            Dedicated environments are provisioned through an intake brief rather than the normal
            self-serve checkout flow. Once submitted, this page becomes your deployment status
            dashboard.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-6">
            <Link to="/dedicated/intake">
              <Button>Open deployment intake</Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const activeIndex =
    deployment.status === "active"
      ? STATUS_ORDER.length - 1
      : Math.max(STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(deployment.status), 0);
  const activeCopy = STATUS_COPY[deployment.status];
  const canLaunchOnboarding = deployment.status === "ready_for_handoff" || deployment.status === "active";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Dedicated Deployment"
        description="Follow the managed provisioning milestones while your isolated environment is prepared."
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Management" }, { label: "Dedicated deployment" }]}
        actions={
          canLaunchOnboarding ? (
            <Link to={deployment.status === "active" ? "/app" : "/onboarding"}>
              <Button>{deployment.status === "active" ? "Open workspace" : "Begin guided activation"}</Button>
            </Link>
          ) : null
        }
      />

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]">
        <div className="rounded-[2rem] border border-primary/25 bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/8 via-card/90 to-card/70 p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-primary">
                Deployment reference
              </p>
              <h2 className="mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{deployment.reference_id}</h2>
              <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                {activeCopy.detail}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/70 bg-background/65 px-4 py-3 text-right">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
                Expected window
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 font-medium">{deployment.target_window_label}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-8 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-5">
            {STATUS_ORDER.map((status, index) => {
              const copy = STATUS_COPY[status];
              const isDone = index < activeIndex || deployment.status === "active";
              const isActive = status === deployment.status || (deployment.status === "active" && status === "ready_for_handoff");

              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={status}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: 0.06 * index, duration: 0.32 }}
                  className={`rounded-[1.35rem] border p-4 ${
                    isActive
                      ? "border-primary/50 bg-primary/10 shadow-[0_18px_50px_-36px_hsl(var(--primary)/0.8)]"
                      : isDone
                        ? "border-border/70 bg-background/60"
                        : "border-border/60 bg-background/30"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">
                    {isDone ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    ) : isActive ? (
                      <Clock3 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    ) : (
                      <Circle className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/60" />
                    )}
                    Stage {index + 1}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium">{copy.label}</div>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/70 p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              <div>
                <div className="font-medium">Latest operator update</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {deployment.latest_update_at
                    ? new Date(deployment.latest_update_at).toLocaleString()
                    : "Awaiting first update"}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">{deployment.latest_update_note}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/70 p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Rocket className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              <div className="font-medium">What your team can do now</div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              {deployment.checklist.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border/60 bg-background/55 px-4 py-3">
                  {item.completed ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                  ) : (
                    <Circle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground/60" />
                  )}
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{item.label}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/70 p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Mail className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              <div className="font-medium">Support path</div>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
              Primary contact: {viewer?.email ?? "Signed-in user"}.
              {canLaunchOnboarding
                ? " Your environment is ready for guided activation."
                : " You will receive additional provisioning updates during the white-glove rollout window."}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {canLaunchOnboarding ? (
                <Link to="/onboarding">
                  <Button>Start first host activation</Button>
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <Link to="/app/help">
                  <Button variant="outline">View support options</Button>
                </Link>
              )}
              <Link to="/app/billing">
                <Button variant="ghost">Billing context</Button>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>
