<file path="src/pages/app/FileManagerPage.tsx">
import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ChevronRight,
  File,
  FileCode,
  FileJson,
  FileText,
  Folder,
  FolderOpen,
  HardDrive,
  Home,
  Link2,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  Server,
  X,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useContainerFileList, useContainerFileContent } from "@/hooks/useContainerFiles";
import { useContainers } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { PremiumFeatureBlock } from "@/components/shared/PremiumFeatureBlock";
import type { FileEntry } from "@/services/docker-api";

// ── Helpers ──

function getFileIcon(entry: FileEntry) {
  if (entry.type === "directory") return Folder;
  if (entry.type === "symlink") return Link2;
  const ext = entry.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  if (["json", "jsonl"].includes(ext)) return FileJson;
  if (["ts", "tsx", "js", "jsx", "py", "go", "rs", "sh", "bash", "rb", "java", "c", "cpp", "h", "css", "scss", "html", "xml", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "ini", "conf", "cfg", "env", "dockerfile", "makefile"].includes(ext)) return FileCode;
  if (["md", "txt", "log", "csv"].includes(ext)) return FileText;
  return File;
}

function formatFileSize(bytes: number) {
  if (bytes <= 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  const exponent = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exponent;
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 || exponent === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[exponent]}`;
}

function getLanguageFromPath(path: string): string {
  const ext = path.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    ts: "typescript", tsx: "tsx", js: "javascript", jsx: "jsx",
    json: "json", yaml: "yaml", yml: "yaml", toml: "toml",
    py: "python", go: "go", rs: "rust", sh: "bash", bash: "bash",
    rb: "ruby", java: "java", c: "c", cpp: "cpp", h: "c",
    css: "css", scss: "scss", html: "html", xml: "xml",
    md: "markdown", sql: "sql", dockerfile: "dockerfile",
    makefile: "makefile", ini: "ini", conf: "conf", cfg: "conf",
    env: "bash", log: "log", txt: "plaintext", csv: "csv",
  };
  return map[ext] || "plaintext";
}

// ── Breadcrumb ──

function PathBreadcrumb({
  path,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  path: string;
  onNavigate: (path: string) => void;
}) {
  const segments = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto text-sm">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onNavigate("/")}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-foreground"
      >
        <Home className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        <span>/</span>
      </button>
      {segments.map((segment, index) => {
        const segmentPath = "/" + segments.slice(0, index + 1).join("/");
        const isLast = index === segments.length - 1;
        return (
          <div key={segmentPath} className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onNavigate(segmentPath)}
              className={cn(
                "rounded-md px-2 py-1 transition-colors",
                isLast
                  ? "font-medium text-foreground"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-foreground",
              )}
            >
              {segment}
            </button>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Container Selector ──

function ContainerSelector({
  containers,
  selectedContainerId,
  selectedHostId,
  onSelect,
}: {
  containers: any[];
  selectedContainerId: string | null;
  selectedHostId: string | null;
  onSelect: (containerId: string, hostId: string, containerName: string) => void;
}) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  const filteredContainers = useMemo(() => {
    const running = containers.filter((c: any) => c.State === "running");
    if (!searchQuery) return running;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return running.filter(
      (c: any) =>
        (c.Names?.[0] || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (c.Image || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (c._hostName || "").toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [containers, searchQuery]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input
          placeholder="Search running containers..."
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
          className="pl-10 bg-background/40 border-white/10 rounded-xl"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="max-h-[420px] space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
        {filteredContainers.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {containers.length === 0
              ? "No containers available"
              : "No running containers match your search. File browsing requires a running container."}
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredContainers.map((c: any) => {
            const name = (c.Names?.[0] || "").replace(/^\//, "");
            const isSelected = c.Id === selectedContainerId && c._hostId === selectedHostId;
            return (
              <button
                key={`${c._hostId}-${c.Id}`}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelect(c.Id, c._hostId, name)}
                className={cn(
                  "flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all",
                  isSelected
                    ? "border border-primary/30 bg-primary/10"
                    : "border border-transparent hover:border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5",
                )}
              >
                <div className={cn("flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg", isSelected ? "bg-primary/20" : "bg-white/5")}>
                  <HardDrive className={cn("h-4 w-4", isSelected ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground")} />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className={cn("truncate text-sm font-medium", isSelected ? "text-primary" : "text-foreground")}>{name}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <span className="truncate">{(c.Image || "").split(":")[0]}</span>
                    {c._hostName && (
                      <>
                        <span className="text-white/20">·</span>
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                          <Server className="h-3 w-3" />
                          {c._hostName}
                        </span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── File Content Viewer ──

function FileViewer({
  hostId,
  containerId,
  filePath,
  onClose,
}: {
  hostId: string;
  containerId: string;
  filePath: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const canRead = !!viewer?.entitlements?.canUseFileManager;

  const { data, isLoading, error } = useContainerFileContent(
    canRead ? hostId : null,
    canRead ? containerId : null,
    canRead ? filePath : null
  );
  const fileName = filePath.split("/").pop() || filePath;
  const lang = getLanguageFromPath(filePath);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileCode className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <span className="truncate font-mono text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{fileName}</span>
            <span className="rounded-md bg-white/5 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{lang}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{filePath}</p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={onClose} className="shrink-0 rounded-lg">
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        {!canRead ? (
          <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center p-8">
            <div className="max-w-md w-full">
              <PremiumFeatureBlock
                title="File Explorer Pro"
                description="Viewing file contents is a premium feature. Upgrade your plan to inspect configuration files, logs, and more directly from the dashboard."
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive/60" />
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{(error as Error).message}</p>
          </div>
        ) : data?.binary ? (
          <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
            <File className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Binary file ({formatFileSize(data.size)})</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">Binary file preview is not supported</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="relative">
            {data?.truncated && (
              <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 border-b border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-warning">
                File truncated — showing first 2 MB of {formatFileSize(data.size)}
              </div>
            )}
            {data?.size !== undefined && (
              <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-4 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">
                {formatFileSize(data.size)}
              </div>
            )}
            <pre className="overflow-x-auto p-4 font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed text-foreground/90">
              <code>{data?.content || ""}</code>
            </pre>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Page ──

export default function FileManagerPage() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const orgId = viewer?.active_org_id;

  const paramContainerId = searchParams.get("container");
  const paramHostId = searchParams.get("host");

  const [selectedContainerId, setSelectedContainerId] = useState<string | null>(paramContainerId);
  const [selectedHostId, setSelectedHostId] = useState<string | null>(paramHostId);
  const [selectedContainerName, setSelectedContainerName] = useState<string>("");
  const [currentPath, setCurrentPath] = useState("/");
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterQuery, setFilterQuery] = useState("");

  const { data: containers = [], isLoading: containersLoading } = useContainers(orgId, true);

  const {
    data: dirData,
    isLoading: dirLoading,
    error: dirError,
    refetch: refetchDir,
  } = useContainerFileList(selectedHostId, selectedContainerId, currentPath);

  const entries = dirData?.entries ?? [];
  const filteredEntries = useMemo(() => {
    if (!filterQuery) return entries;
    const q = filterQuery.toLowerCase();
    return entries.filter((e) => e.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [entries, filterQuery]);

  const handleSelectContainer = (containerId: string, hostId: string, containerName: string) => {
    setSelectedContainerId(containerId);
    setSelectedHostId(hostId);
    setSelectedContainerName(containerName);
    setCurrentPath("/");
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setFilterQuery("");
    setSearchParams({ host: hostId, container: containerId });
  };

  const handleNavigate = (path: string) => {
    setCurrentPath(path);
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setFilterQuery("");
  };

  const handleEntryClick = (entry: FileEntry) => {
    if (entry.type === "directory") {
      const newPath = currentPath === "/" ? `/${entry.name}` : `${currentPath}/${entry.name}`;
      handleNavigate(newPath);
    } else if (entry.type === "file" || entry.type === "symlink") {
      const filePath = currentPath === "/" ? `/${entry.name}` : `${currentPath}/${entry.name}`;
      setSelectedFile(filePath);
    }
  };

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    refetchDir();
    if (selectedFile) {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["container-fs-read", selectedHostId, selectedContainerId, selectedFile],
      });
    }
  };

  const hasContainer = !!selectedContainerId && !!selectedHostId;

  const canUseFileManager = !!viewer?.entitlements?.canUseFileManager;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="File Manager"
        description="Browse and view files inside your Docker containers"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "File Manager" }]}
      />

      {!canUseFileManager ? (
        <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-8">
          <PremiumFeatureBlock
            title="File Manager"
            description="Browse container filesystems, inspect configuration files, and preview logs directly from the dashboard. Upgrade to an Individual, Business, or Dedicated plan to unlock the File Manager."
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[320px,1fr]">
          {/* Left: Container selector */}
          <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-5">
            <h3 className="mb-4 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
              Select Container
            </h3>
            {containersLoading ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
                <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ContainerSelector
                containers={containers as any[]}
                selectedContainerId={selectedContainerId}
                selectedHostId={selectedHostId}
                onSelect={handleSelectContainer}
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Right: File browser + viewer */}
          <div className="min-w-0 space-y-4">
            {!hasContainer ? (
              <div className="glass-card flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-[28px] py-24 text-center">
                <FolderOpen className="mb-4 h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground/30" />
                <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">Select a running container</p>
                <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Choose a container from the sidebar to browse its filesystem. Only running containers support file browsing.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Toolbar */}
                <div className="glass-card flex items-center gap-3 rounded-[20px] px-5 py-3">
                  <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden">
                    <PathBreadcrumb path={currentPath} onNavigate={handleNavigate} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <Input
                        placeholder="Filter..."
                        value={filterQuery}
                        onChange={(e) => setFilterQuery(e.target.value)}
                        className="h-8 w-40 bg-background/40 border-white/10 rounded-lg pl-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg"
                      onClick={handleRefresh}
                      title="Refresh"
                    >
                      <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className={cn("grid gap-4", selectedFile ? "xl:grid-cols-[1fr,1fr]" : "xl:grid-cols-1")}>
                  {/* Directory listing */}
                  <div className="glass-card min-w-0 rounded-[24px] overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
                          {selectedContainerName || "Files"}
                        </h4>
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-white/5 px-3 py-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {filteredEntries.length} {filteredEntries.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {dirLoading ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-16">
                        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
                      </div>
                    ) : dirError ? (
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive/60" />
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{(dirError as Error).message}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Make sure the container is running and the path exists.</p>
                      </div>
                    ) : filteredEntries.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
                        <Folder className="mb-3 h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/30" />
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {filterQuery ? "No files match your filter" : "Empty directory"}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="max-h-[560px] overflow-y-auto">
                        {/* Parent directory */}
                        {currentPath !== "/" && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const parent = currentPath.split("/").slice(0, -1).join("/") || "/";
                              handleNavigate(parent);
                            }}
                            className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-white/5"
                          >
                            <Folder className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">..</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {filteredEntries.map((entry) => {
                          const Icon = getFileIcon(entry);
                          const entryPath = currentPath === "/" ? `/${entry.name}` : `${currentPath}/${entry.name}`;
                          const isActive = selectedFile === entryPath;
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={entry.name}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleEntryClick(entry)}
                              className={cn(
                                "group flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors",
                                isActive
                                  ? "bg-primary/10"
                                  : "hover:bg-white/5",
                              )}
                            >
                              <Icon
                                className={cn(
                                  "h-4 w-4 shrink-0",
                                  entry.type === "directory"
                                    ? "text-primary"
                                    : entry.type === "symlink"
                                      ? "text-sky-400"
                                      : "text-muted-foreground",
                                )}
                              />
                              <span
                                className={cn(
                                  "min-w-0 flex-1 truncate",
                                  entry.type === "directory"
                                    ? "font-medium text-foreground"
                                    : isActive
                                      ? "text-primary"
                                      : "text-foreground/80",
                                )}
                              >
                                {entry.name}
                                {entry.linkTarget && (
                                  <span className="ml-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">→ {entry.linkTarget}</span>
                                )}
                              </span>
                              <span className="shrink-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">
                                {entry.type === "directory" ? "" : formatFileSize(entry.size)}
                              </span>
                              <span className="hidden shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 sm:block">
                                {entry.permissions}
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* File content viewer */}
                  {selectedFile && selectedHostId && selectedContainerId && (
                    <div className="glass-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-[24px]">
                      <FileViewer
                        hostId={selectedHostId}
                        containerId={selectedContainerId}
                        filePath={selectedFile}
                        onClose={() => setSelectedFile(null)}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";

}

<file path="src/pages/app/LogsPage.tsx">
import { LogConsole } from "@/components/docker/LogConsole";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { PremiumFeatureBlock } from "@/components/shared/PremiumFeatureBlock";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Loader2, RefreshCw, FileText } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import { useDockerHosts } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";

export default function LogsPage() {
  const { organization: currentOrg } = useOrganization();
  const { data: hosts = [] } = useDockerHosts(currentOrg?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const hasAccess = viewer?.entitlements?.canUseLogs ?? false;
  const [selectedHost, setSelectedHost] = useState<string>("");
  const [selectedContainer, setSelectedContainer] = useState<string>("");
  const [containers, setContainers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const connectedHosts = hosts.filter(h => h.status === 'connected');

  const handleHostChange = async (hostId: string) => {
    setSelectedHost(hostId);
    setSelectedContainer("");
    setLogs([]);
    if (!hostId) { setContainers([]); return; }
    try {
      const data = await dockerApi.listContainers(hostId);
      setContainers(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch { setContainers([]); }
  };

  const handleFetchLogs = async () => {
    if (!selectedHost || !selectedContainer) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await dockerApi.containerLogs(selectedHost, selectedContainer, 300);
      setLogs(data?.logs || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setLogs([`Error: ${e.message}`]);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader title="Log Explorer" description="View real container logs" breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Observability" }, { label: "Logs" }]} />

      <PremiumFeatureBlock
        title="Log Explorer is a paid feature"
        description="Upgrade to an Individual, Business, or Dedicated plan to view real-time container logs from your Docker hosts."
        hasAccess={hasAccess}
      >
        {connectedHosts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="glass-card p-12 text-center">
            <FileText className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">No connected hosts</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">Connect a Docker host first to view container logs.</p>
            <Link to="/app/hosts"><Button variant="outline">Go to Hosts</Button></Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <select
                className="h-8 px-3 text-sm bg-secondary border border-border rounded-md"
                value={selectedHost}
                onChange={e => handleHostChange(e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">Select host...</option>
                {connectedHosts.map(h => <option key={h.id} value={h.id}>{h.name}</option>)}
              </select>
              <select
                className="h-8 px-3 text-sm bg-secondary border border-border rounded-md"
                value={selectedContainer}
                onChange={e => setSelectedContainer(e.target.value)}
                disabled={!selectedHost}
              >
                <option value="">Select container...</option>
                {containers.map((c: any) => (
                  <option key={c.Id} value={c.Id?.substring(0, 12)}>
                    {(c.Names?.[0] || c.Id?.substring(0, 12)).replace(/^\//, '')} ({c.State})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <Button size="sm" onClick={handleFetchLogs} disabled={!selectedContainer || loading} className="gap-1.5">
                {loading ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                Fetch Logs
              </Button>
            </div>

            {logs.length > 0 ? (
              <LogConsole
                logs={logs}
                loading={loading}
                title="Fetched Logs"
                emptyMessage='Click "Fetch Logs" to load container logs.'
                heightClassName="h-[600px]"
                onRefresh={handleFetchLogs}
                refreshLabel="Fetch Again"
              />
            ) : selectedContainer && !loading ? (
              <div className="glass-card p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">Click "Fetch Logs" to load container logs.</div>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </PremiumFeatureBlock>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/OrganizationsPage.tsx">
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Building2, Loader2, Plus, Server } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { useOrganizationList } from "@clerk/react";
import { useDockerHosts } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

export default function OrganizationsPage() {
  const { userMemberships, isLoaded, createOrganization } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: { infinite: true },
  });
  const organizations = userMemberships.data?.map(m => m.organization) || [];
  const isLoading = !isLoaded;
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!newName.trim()) return;
    try {
      if (createOrganization) {
        await createOrganization({ name: newName.trim() });
        setNewName("");
        setCreating(false);
      }
    } catch {}
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64"><Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Organizations"
        description="Manage your workspaces"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Organizations" }]}
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={() => setCreating(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />New Organization
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {creating && (
        <div className="glass-card p-4 flex items-center gap-3 max-w-md">
          <Input placeholder="Organization name" value={newName} onChange={e => setNewName(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleCreate()} />
          <Button size="sm" onClick={handleCreate} disabled={!newName.trim()}>Create</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Cancel</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {organizations.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="glass-card p-12 text-center">
          <Building2 className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-3" />
          <h3 className="font-medium mb-1">No organizations yet</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">Create your first organization to start managing Docker hosts.</p>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setCreating(true)} className="gap-1.5">
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />Create Organization
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {organizations.map(org => (
            <OrgCard key={org.id} org={org} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function OrgCard({ org }: { org: { id: string; name: string; slug: string | null } }) {
  const { data: hosts = [] } = useDockerHosts(org.id, { filterByPlan: true });

  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Building2 className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-semibold">{org.name}</h3>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{org.slug} • {hosts.length} host{hosts.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {hosts.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {hosts.map(host => (
            <Link key={host.id} to={`/app/hosts/${host.id}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-background border border-border hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors">
              <Server className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{host.name}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground capitalize">{host.status}</div>
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No hosts connected yet. Go to Hosts to add one.</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/SettingsPage.tsx">
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { PremiumFeatureBlock } from "@/components/shared/PremiumFeatureBlock";
import { OrganizationMembersWorkspaceContainer } from "@/components/settings/OrganizationMembersWorkspace";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ProfileSettings } from "@/components/settings/ProfileSettings";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { SlackDestinationsPanel } from "@/components/settings/SlackDestinationsPanel";
import { WebhookDestinationsPanel } from "@/components/settings/WebhookDestinationsPanel";
import { useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { useDestinationSettings } from "@/hooks/useDestinationSettings";

// ── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const ALL_TABS = ["Members", "Profile", "Webhooks", "Notifications"] as const;
const DEFAULT_TAB = "Profile";

// ── URL-synced tab hook ─────────────────────────────────────────────

function useTabSync(validTabs: readonly string[], defaultTab: string) {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const requestedTab = searchParams.get("tab");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(requestedTab && validTabs.includes(requestedTab) ? requestedTab : defaultTab);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!validTabs.includes(tab)) {
      setTab(defaultTab);
      const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
      next.delete("tab");
      setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [tab, validTabs, searchParams, setSearchParams, defaultTab]);

  const onChange = useCallback(
    (nextTab: string) => {
      setTab(nextTab);
      const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
      if (nextTab === defaultTab) {
        next.delete("tab");
      } else {
        next.set("tab", nextTab);
      }
      setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
    },
    [searchParams, setSearchParams, defaultTab],
  );

  return { tab, onChange };
}

// ── Page ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const { organization: currentOrg } = useOrganization();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const entitlements = viewer?.entitlements;

  const { tab, onChange } = useTabSync(ALL_TABS, DEFAULT_TAB);
  const { slack, webhook } = useDestinationSettings(
    currentOrg?.id,
    entitlements?.canUseSlackDestinations ?? false,
    entitlements?.canUseWebhookDestinations ?? false,
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Settings"
        description="Manage organization and project settings"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Management" }, { label: "Settings" }]}
      />

      <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={onChange} className="space-y-4">
        <TabsList className="h-auto w-full justify-start overflow-x-auto bg-secondary p-1">
          {ALL_TABS.map((t) => (
            <TabsTrigger key={t} value={t} className="text-xs">
              {t}
            </TabsTrigger>
          ))}
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="Profile">
          <ProfileSettings />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Members">
          <PremiumFeatureBlock
            title="Team Collaboration"
            description="Upgrade your plan to invite team members to your organization and manage access together."
            hasAccess={entitlements?.canUseTeamCollaboration ?? false}
          >
            <OrganizationMembersWorkspaceContainer />
          </PremiumFeatureBlock>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Webhooks">
          <PremiumFeatureBlock
            title="Webhook Destinations"
            description="Upgrade your plan to configure custom webhook destinations for real-time alerts."
            hasAccess={entitlements?.canUseWebhookDestinations ?? false}
          >
            <WebhookDestinationsPanel
              destinations={webhook.destinations}
              canManage={webhook.canManage}
              saving={webhook.saving}
              testingId={webhook.testingId}
              latestSecret={webhook.latestSecret}
              onCreate={webhook.onCreate}
              onUpdate={webhook.onUpdate}
              onTest={webhook.onTest}
              onDismissSecret={webhook.onDismissSecret}
            />
          </PremiumFeatureBlock>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="Notifications">
          <PremiumFeatureBlock
            title="Slack & Discord Notifications"
            description="Upgrade your plan to integrate with Slack and Discord and receive alerts directly in your channels."
            hasAccess={entitlements?.canUseSlackDestinations ?? false}
          >
            <SlackDestinationsPanel
              destinations={slack.destinations}
              canManage={slack.canManage}
              saving={slack.saving}
              testingId={slack.testingId}
              onCreate={slack.onCreate}
              onUpdate={slack.onUpdate}
              onTest={slack.onTest}
            />
          </PremiumFeatureBlock>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/app/SetupGuidePage.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import {
  Terminal,
  CloudCog,
  Copy,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldCheck,
  Server,
  ArrowRight,
  AlertTriangle,
  Lock,
  Globe,
  CheckCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand,
  CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
} from "@/lib/agent-release";

function CopyBlock({ code, label }: { code: string; label?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopied(true);
    toast({ title: "Copied to clipboard" });
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative group">
      {label ? <div className="mb-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</div> : null}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-background p-4 font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed">
        <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-all text-foreground/90">{code}</pre>
        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="absolute right-3 top-3 rounded-md bg-muted/80 p-1.5 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground group-hover:opacity-100"
        >
          {copied ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" /> : <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StepCard({ step, title, children }: { step: number; title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
        <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 text-sm font-bold text-primary">
          {step}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-2 w-px flex-1 bg-border" />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pb-8">
        <h3 className="mb-3 text-base font-semibold">{title}</h3>
        <div className="space-y-3">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function InfoBox({ variant = "info", children }: { variant?: "info" | "warning" | "success"; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const styles = {
    info: "bg-primary/5 border-primary/20 text-primary",
    warning: "bg-warning/10 border-warning/20 text-warning",
    success: "bg-success/10 border-success/20 text-success",
  };
  const icons = {
    info: ShieldCheck,
    warning: AlertTriangle,
    success: CheckCheck,
  };
  const Icon = icons[variant];

  return (
    <div className={`flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border p-3.5 ${styles[variant]}`}>
      <Icon className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
      <div className="text-sm leading-relaxed">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SetupGuidePage() {
  const preflightCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand();
  const updateCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({
    agentApiKey: "<agent-api-key>",
    connectionMode: "agent",
  });
  const verifyCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand();
  const repairCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand();
  const tunnelInstallCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({
    agentApiKey: "<agent-api-key>",
    connectionMode: "cloudflare_tunnel",
  });
  const serviceCommands = `sudo systemctl status watchtower-agent
sudo journalctl -u watchtower-agent -f
sudo systemctl restart watchtower-agent
sudo watchtower-agent-uninstall`;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Agent Setup Guide"
        description="Install and configure the Watchtower Agent on your Docker hosts"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Help", href: "/app/help" }, { label: "Setup Guide" }]}
      />

      <div className="glass-card space-y-4 p-6">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold">
          <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          How It Works
        </h2>
        <div className="grid gap-4 text-center sm:grid-cols-3">
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 p-4">
            <Globe className="mx-auto mb-2 h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold">Watchtower Dashboard</div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Cloud-hosted UI and API</div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
            <ArrowRight className="hidden h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground sm:block" />
            <div className="h-6 w-px bg-border sm:hidden" />
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 p-4">
            <Server className="mx-auto mb-2 h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold">Watchtower Agent</div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Runs on your host and proxies to the Docker socket</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          The Watchtower Agent is a lightweight host service. It authenticates incoming requests with a shared API key,
          forwards them to Docker over the local Unix socket, and stays under your control.
          <strong> Your Docker socket is never exposed directly to the internet.</strong>
        </p>
        <InfoBox variant="success">
          Preferred setup path: start from <strong>Connect Host</strong> or onboarding to get a one-time guided install command.
          This page is the manual reference flow and advanced fallback.
        </InfoBox>
      </div>

      <Tabs defaultValue="agent" className="space-y-4">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full max-w-md grid-cols-2">
          <TabsTrigger value="agent" className="gap-1.5">
            <Terminal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Agent (Direct)
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="cloudflare" className="gap-1.5">
            <CloudCog className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Agent via CF Tunnel
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="agent" className="space-y-2">
          <InfoBox>
            This flow is for Linux hosts with <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">systemd</code> and local operator access.
            The dashboard never runs privileged commands remotely.
          </InfoBox>

          <StepCard step={1} title="Generate key">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Create a strong random secret that will authenticate requests between the dashboard and your agent.
            </p>
            <CopyBlock code="openssl rand -hex 32" label="Generate API key" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Save this key only if you are following the manual fallback path. The guided Dockerdash flow can generate a one-time install command for you instead.
            </p>
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={2} title="Preflight">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Check prerequisites before making any changes. This command verifies the installer, Docker socket access, and required host dependencies.
            </p>
            <CopyBlock label={`Preflight (${CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version})`} code={preflightCommand} />
            <InfoBox variant="warning">
              Preflight changes nothing. Fix any missing prerequisite, then rerun this step before updating.
            </InfoBox>
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={3} title="Update">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Run the manual install or in-place update on the host. It downloads the current installer, verifies it automatically, and preserves the stored config in <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">/etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env</code>.
            </p>
            <CopyBlock label={`Manual Install / Update (${CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.tag})`} code={updateCommand} />
            <InfoBox>
              The update is atomic: the installer only runs after the automatic integrity check passes. If the host already has the agent, rerunning this command replaces the runtime in place.
            </InfoBox>
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={4} title="Verify">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Confirm the local runtime is healthy after the update. This verify command reads the local env file and checks both <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">/agent/version</code> and <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">/metrics</code>.
            </p>
            <CopyBlock label="Verify agent endpoints" code={verifyCommand} />
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={5} title="Troubleshoot">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              If the host still misses uptime or per-disk fields after verification, rerun the repair flow and inspect the service logs locally.
            </p>
            <CopyBlock label="Troubleshoot / Repair" code={repairCommand} />
            <InfoBox>
              Repair is the same reinstall path plus local diagnostics. It preserves the existing config and helps confirm whether the failure is in the service, the socket, or the metrics payload.
            </InfoBox>
          </StepCard>

          <div className="pl-12">
            <InfoBox variant="success">
              Once Preflight, Update, and Verify pass, add the host in Watchtower with the same API key.
            </InfoBox>
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="cloudflare" className="space-y-2">
          <InfoBox>
            This mode reaches the same Watchtower Agent through a Cloudflare Tunnel. The API key still authenticates the
            requests. The tunnel only changes how traffic reaches the host.
          </InfoBox>

          <StepCard step={1} title="Generate an API Key">
            <CopyBlock code="openssl rand -hex 32" label="Generate a 256-bit key" />
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={2} title="Install the Agent on Your Host">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Use the same manual installer fallback. It binds to <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">0.0.0.0</code> by default, and Cloudflare Tunnel can still forward to the local agent port on the host.
            </p>
            <CopyBlock label="Install for tunnel-only access" code={tunnelInstallCommand} />
            <InfoBox>
              You can change <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS</code> later in
              <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded ml-1">/etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env</code>.
            </InfoBox>
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={3} title="Create a Cloudflare Tunnel">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Use <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">cloudflared</code> to create a tunnel pointing to the agent.
            </p>
            <CopyBlock
              label="Install cloudflared"
              code={`# Debian/Ubuntu
curl -fsSL https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-main.gpg | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare.gpg >/dev/null
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare.gpg] https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflared $(lsb_release -cs) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudflared.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install cloudflared`}
            />
            <CopyBlock
              label="Create and route tunnel"
              code={`cloudflared tunnel create watchtower-agent
cloudflared tunnel route dns watchtower-agent docker.your-team.com
cloudflared tunnel run --url http://127.0.0.1:9876 watchtower-agent`}
            />
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={4} title="(Optional) Protect with CF Access">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Add a Cloudflare Access policy to the tunnel hostname for an extra authentication layer. Create a service token
              in Cloudflare if you want Watchtower to present CF Access credentials too.
            </p>
          </StepCard>

          <StepCard step={5} title="Add Host in Watchtower">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Go to <strong>Hosts - Connect Host</strong> and enter:
            </p>
            <ul className="ml-4 space-y-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <CloudCog className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                <span>
                  <strong>Connection mode:</strong> Agent via CF Tunnel
                </span>
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <Globe className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                <span>
                  <strong>Tunnel URL:</strong> <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">https://docker.your-team.com</code>
                </span>
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <ShieldCheck className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                <span>
                  <strong>Agent API Key:</strong> The key from step 1
                </span>
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <Lock className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                <span>
                  <strong>CF Access tokens:</strong> Only if you configured CF Access in step 4
                </span>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </StepCard>

          <div className="pl-12">
            <InfoBox variant="success">
              The tunnel provides TLS and private routing without opening inbound ports on the host.
            </InfoBox>
          </div>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      <div className="glass-card space-y-3 p-6">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Agent Requirements</h2>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {[
            { label: "Linux + systemd", desc: "The guided installer targets standard Linux hosts with systemd" },
            { label: "Docker", desc: "Docker Engine 20.10+ installed and running" },
            { label: "Socket access", desc: "The service user must be able to read /var/run/docker.sock" },
            { label: "Runtime deps", desc: "bash, socat, curl, and jq must already be installed on the host" },
          ].map((r) => (
            <div key={r.label} className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-3">
              <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm font-medium">{r.label}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.desc}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card space-y-3 p-6">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Operate the Service</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          After installation, these are the main commands for status, logs, restart, and uninstall.
        </p>
        <CopyBlock code={serviceCommands} label="Lifecycle commands" />
        <InfoBox>
          If your host does not use <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">systemd</code>, wrap
          <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded ml-1">watchtower-agent.sh</code> with your existing process manager. If you
          already standardize on Docker-based host services, use restart behavior such as
          <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded ml-1">--restart unless-stopped</code>.
        </InfoBox>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/onboarding/CopyBlock.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";

/**
 * A code block with clipboard copy functionality.
 * Extracted from OnboardingPage for reuse.
 */
export function CopyBlock({ code, label }: { code: string; label?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopied(true);
    toast({ title: "Copied to clipboard" });
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };
  return (
    <div className="relative group">
      {label && (
        <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1.5">{label}</div>
      )}
      <div className="bg-background border border-border rounded-lg p-3.5 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed overflow-x-auto">
        <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-all text-foreground/90">{code}</pre>
        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 p-1.5 rounded-md bg-muted/80 hover:bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
        >
          {copied ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" /> : <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>
