<file path="src/pages/onboarding/StepHostBasics.tsx">
import { Server, ArrowRight, Check, Info, Terminal, CloudCog } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { ErrorBanner } from "./ErrorBanner";
import { CONNECTION_MODES } from "./useOnboardingState";
import type { ConnectionMode } from "@/types/database";

/* ── Icon map for connection mode cards ── */
const MODE_ICONS: Record<ConnectionMode, typeof Terminal> = {
  agent: Terminal,
  cloudflare_tunnel: CloudCog,
};

interface Props {
  hostName: string;
  onHostNameChange: (v: string) => void;
  hostUrl: string;
  onHostUrlChange: (v: string) => void;
  connectionMode: ConnectionMode;
  onConnectionModeChange: (v: ConnectionMode) => void;
  error: string | null;
  isSkipping: boolean;
  onNext: () => void;
  onSkip: () => void;
}

/** Step 1, Screen A — host name, connection method, and URL. */
export function StepHostBasics({
  hostName, onHostNameChange,
  hostUrl, onHostUrlChange,
  connectionMode, onConnectionModeChange,
  error, isSkipping,
  onNext, onSkip,
}: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="animate-fade-in w-full">
      <div className="text-center mb-10">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
          <Server className="h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-3">
          Add your first Docker host
        </h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm leading-relaxed max-w-sm mx-auto">
          Connect via the Watchtower Agent with a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel in front of it.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-lg p-8 space-y-6">
        {/* Host Name */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="host-name" className="text-base font-medium">Host Name</Label>
          <Input
            id="host-name"
            placeholder="e.g. prod-server-01"
            value={hostName}
            onChange={(e) => onHostNameChange(e.target.value)}
            className="h-11"
            autoFocus
          />
        </div>

        {/* Connection Mode Cards */}
        <ConnectionModeSelector
          connectionMode={connectionMode}
          onConnectionModeChange={onConnectionModeChange}
        />

        {/* Agent / Tunnel URL */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="host-url" className="text-base font-medium">
            {connectionMode === "agent" ? "Agent URL" : "Tunnel URL"}
          </Label>
          <Input
            id="host-url"
            placeholder={connectionMode === "agent" ? "https://your-host:9876" : "https://docker.your-team.cloudflareaccess.com"}
            value={hostUrl}
            onChange={(e) => onHostUrlChange(e.target.value)}
            className="h-11"
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1.5">
            {connectionMode === "agent"
              ? "The HTTPS URL where the Watchtower Agent is running."
              : "The Cloudflare Tunnel public hostname. Your tunnel must route traffic to the agent on port 9876."}
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && <ErrorBanner message={error} />}

        <Button className="w-full h-11 text-base" size="lg" onClick={onNext} disabled={!hostName || !hostUrl}>
          Next
          <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Skip */}
      <button
        type="button"
        className="w-full text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors mt-3 py-1 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        onClick={onSkip}
        disabled={isSkipping}
      >
        {isSkipping ? "Skipping..." : "Skip for now"}
      </button>

      {/* Helper info card */}
      <div className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 px-4 py-3">
        <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          {connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel"
            ? "The Watchtower Agent listens on port 9876. Configure your Cloudflare Tunnel to forward traffic to http://127.0.0.1:9876 on the host."
            : "The Watchtower Agent runs alongside Docker on your host. Keep it on localhost and expose it through HTTPS or Cloudflare Tunnel."}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Connection Mode Card Selector (extracted sub-component) ── */
function ConnectionModeSelector({
  connectionMode,
  onConnectionModeChange,
}: {
  connectionMode: ConnectionMode;
  onConnectionModeChange: (v: ConnectionMode) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Label className="text-base font-medium">Connection Method</Label>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        {CONNECTION_MODES.map((m) => {
          const isSelected = connectionMode === m.value;
          const Icon = MODE_ICONS[m.value];
          return (
            <button
              key={m.value}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onConnectionModeChange(m.value)}
              className={`relative p-4 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
                isSelected
                  ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 ring-1 ring-primary/30"
                  : "border-border hover:border-primary/40 hover:bg-muted/30"
              }`}
            >
              {isSelected && (
                <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5 text-primary-foreground" />
                </div>
              )}
              <Icon className={`h-5 w-5 mb-2 ${isSelected ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground"}`} />
              <div className={`text-sm font-medium ${isSelected ? "text-foreground" : "text-foreground/80"}`}>{m.label}</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 leading-snug">{m.desc}</div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/onboarding/StepHostCredentials.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { ShieldCheck, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Terminal, Copy, Eye, EyeOff, RefreshCw, Wrench, CloudCog } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ErrorBanner } from "./ErrorBanner";
import type { ConnectionMode } from "@/types/database";

interface Props {
  connectionMode: ConnectionMode;
  modeLabel: string;
  installCommand: string;
  verifyCommand: string;
  setupSummary: string;
  verifySummary: string;
  nextStepSummary: string;
  advancedManualCommand: string;
  expiresAt: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  onBack: () => void;
  onFinalize: () => void;
  onRegenerate: () => void;
}

function CopyCommand({
  label,
  command,
  masked = false,
}: {
  label: string;
  command: string;
  masked?: boolean;
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(!masked);

  const visibleCommand = masked && !revealed ? command.replace(/[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}/g, "••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••") : command;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command);
    setCopied(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {masked ? (
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={() => setRevealed((value) => !value)}>
              {revealed ? <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
              {revealed ? "Hide" : "Reveal"}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={handleCopy}>
            <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed">
        <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-all text-foreground/90">{visibleCommand}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StepHostCredentials({
  connectionMode,
  modeLabel,
  installCommand,
  verifyCommand,
  setupSummary,
  verifySummary,
  nextStepSummary,
  advancedManualCommand,
  expiresAt,
  error,
  onBack,
  onFinalize,
  onRegenerate,
}: Props) {
  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="animate-fade-in w-full">
      <div className="text-center mb-10">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
          <ShieldCheck className="h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-3">
          Install the agent
        </h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm leading-relaxed max-w-md mx-auto">
          {modeLabel} is ready. Run the generated command on your Linux Docker host, verify locally, then finish setup in Dockerdash.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-lg p-8 space-y-6">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-4 text-sm text-primary">
          {setupSummary}
        </div>

        {connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? (
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 p-4">
            <CloudCog className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                Configure your Cloudflare Tunnel
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                Point your tunnel's public hostname to{" "}
                <code className="bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-foreground">http://127.0.0.1:9876</code>{" "}
                on the host. The agent binds to localhost on port 9876 by default.
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70">
                Example: <code className="bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">cloudflared tunnel run --url http://127.0.0.1:9876 your-tunnel-name</code>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <CopyCommand label="Primary install command" command={installCommand} />

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed space-y-2">
          <p>{verifySummary}</p>
          <p>{nextStepSummary}</p>
          {expiresAt ? <p>Enrollment command expires at {new Date(expiresAt).toLocaleString()}.</p> : null}
        </div>

        <CopyCommand label="Local verify command" command={verifyCommand} />

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/20 p-4 space-y-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-foreground"
            onClick={() => setShowAdvanced((value) => !value)}
          >
            <Wrench className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            {showAdvanced ? "Hide manual fallback" : "Use manual install instead"}
          </button>
          {showAdvanced ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                This advanced command embeds the long-lived agent API key. Use it only if you do not want the enrollment-token flow.
              </p>
              <CopyCommand label="Advanced manual install" command={advancedManualCommand} masked />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {error && <ErrorBanner message={error} />}

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <Button variant="outline" className="h-11" onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
            Back
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" className="h-11 gap-2" onClick={onRegenerate}>
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            Regenerate command
          </Button>
          <Button className="flex-1 h-11 text-base" size="lg" onClick={onFinalize}>
            Finish setup
            <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed space-y-1">
          <p>
            The guided flow keeps the long-lived API key out of the default copied command.
          </p>
          <p>
            The generated installer command sets <code className="bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-foreground">AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0</code> by default.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/onboarding/StepTestFailed.tsx">
import { AlertTriangle, XCircle, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

interface Props {
  hostName: string;
  testError: string;
  remediationCommand?: string | null;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onFinishLater: () => void;
}

export function StepTestFailed({
  hostName,
  testError,
  remediationCommand,
  onRetry,
  onFinishLater,
}: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="animate-fade-in w-full">
      <div className="text-center mb-10">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-warning/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-7 w-7 text-warning" />
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-3">
          Host saved, connection not verified
        </h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm leading-relaxed max-w-sm mx-auto">
          <strong>"{hostName}"</strong> was saved to your workspace, but the connection test did not pass.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-lg p-8 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-warning/20 bg-warning/5">
          <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-warning shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="text-sm text-warning leading-relaxed">{testError || "Connection test failed."}</div>
        </div>

        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed space-y-1.5">
          <p>Common causes:</p>
          <ul className="list-disc pl-4 space-y-1">
            <li>Agent is not running on the host</li>
            <li>Firewall or tunnel rules are blocking the agent endpoint</li>
            <li>API key mismatch between Dockerdash and the agent</li>
            <li>URL, port, or Cloudflare Access configuration is incorrect</li>
          </ul>
          {remediationCommand ? (
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-3">
              <p className="mb-2 font-medium text-foreground">Suggested remediation command</p>
              <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-all font-mono text-[11px] text-foreground/90">{remediationCommand}</pre>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="border-t border-border" />

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <Button variant="outline" className="h-11" onClick={onRetry}>
            Retry Connection
          </Button>
          <Button className="flex-1 h-11 text-base" variant="secondary" onClick={onFinishLater}>
            Finish Later
            <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />
          </Button>
        </div>

        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground text-center">
          You can retry or edit this host anytime from <strong>Hosts</strong> in the dashboard.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/onboarding/useOnboardingState.ts">
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useOrganizationList, useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";
import { agentEnrollmentApi, type AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse, type AgentEnrollmentFinalizeResponse } from "@/services/agent-enrollment";
import type { ConnectionMode } from "@/types/database";
import { deriveNeedsOnboarding, normalizeOnboardingStatus } from "@/lib/onboarding-gate";

export type OnboardingStep =
  | { step: 0; phase: "form" }
  | { step: 0; phase: "creating" }
  | { step: 0; phase: "syncing" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "basics" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "preparing" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "install" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "finalizing" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "test-failed" }
  | { step: 2; phase: "done" };

export const STEPS = ["Create Organization", "Connect Host", "You're Ready"] as const;

export const CONNECTION_MODES: { value: ConnectionMode; label: string; desc: string }[] = [
  { value: "agent", label: "Agent (Direct)", desc: "Connect to the Watchtower Agent over HTTPS." },
  { value: "cloudflare_tunnel", label: "Agent via CF Tunnel", desc: "Same agent, accessed through a Cloudflare Tunnel." },
];

export function isStep0Submitting(state: OnboardingStep): boolean {
  return state.step === 0 && (state.phase === "creating" || state.phase === "syncing");
}

export function isStep1Loading(state: OnboardingStep): boolean {
  return state.step === 1 && (state.phase === "preparing" || state.phase === "finalizing");
}

export function getProgressWidth(state: OnboardingStep): string {
  if (state.step === 0) return "33%";
  if (state.step === 2) return "100%";
  if (state.phase === "basics") return "45%";
  if (state.phase === "install") return "72%";
  return "82%";
}

async function markOnboardingStatus(
  status: "not_started" | "skipped" | "completed",
  orgId: string | null | undefined,
  fallbackOrgId: string | null | undefined,
) {
  const activeClerkOrgId = orgId ?? fallbackOrgId ?? null;
  const maxAttempts = 20;
  let delay = 750;

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    // @ts-expect-error window.Clerk is injected globally by ClerkProvider
    const token = await window.Clerk?.session?.getToken(attempt > 1 ? { skipCache: true } : undefined);
    if (!token) throw new Error("Unauthorized");

    const res = await fetch("/api/organizations", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        onboardingStatus: status,
        ...(activeClerkOrgId ? { clerkOrgId: activeClerkOrgId } : {}),
      }),
    });

    if (res.ok) return;

    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const isRetryable202 = res.status === 202 && data?.retry;
    const isRetryableNotFound =
      res.status === 404 &&
      typeof data?.error === "string" &&
      data.error.toLowerCase().includes("requested organization not found");

    if ((isRetryable202 || isRetryableNotFound) && attempt < maxAttempts) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
      delay = Math.min(Math.floor(delay * 1.35), 4000);
      continue;
    }

    if (res.status === 202) {
      throw new Error(data?.error || "Sync pending. Your account is currently syncing.");
    }

    throw new Error(data?.error || `HTTP error ${res.status}`);
  }
}

// --- Sync Polling Logic ---

type AuthSyncStatus =
  | { type: "success"; hasOrgs: boolean; needsOnboarding: boolean }
  | { type: "retry"; delay?: number }
  | { type: "error" };

async function checkAuthSyncStatus(): Promise<AuthSyncStatus> {
  try {
    // @ts-expect-error window.Clerk is injected globally by ClerkProvider
    const token = await window.Clerk?.session?.getToken({ skipCache: true });
    if (!token) return { type: "retry" };

    const res = await fetch("/api/auth/me", {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });

    if (res.status === 202) {
      const syncState = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { type: "retry", delay: syncState?.retry ? 2000 : undefined };
    }

    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      const hasOrgs = !!data.user?.has_orgs;
      const onboardingStatus = normalizeOnboardingStatus(data.user?.onboarding_status);
      const needsOnboarding = deriveNeedsOnboarding(hasOrgs, onboardingStatus);
      return { type: "success", hasOrgs, needsOnboarding };
    }

    return { type: "retry" };
  } catch {
    return { type: "retry" };
  }
}

type SyncPollingResult =
  | { status: "ready" }
  | { status: "complete" }
  | { status: "timeout" }
  | { status: "cancelled" };

async function pollForOrganizationSync(onCancelCheck: () => boolean): Promise<SyncPollingResult> {
  const maxWait = 30_000;
  const start = Date.now();
  let delay = 500;

  while (Date.now() - start < maxWait) {
    if (onCancelCheck()) return { status: "cancelled" };

    const syncStatus = await checkAuthSyncStatus();

    if (syncStatus.type === "success") {
      if (syncStatus.hasOrgs && syncStatus.needsOnboarding) return { status: "ready" };
      if (!syncStatus.needsOnboarding) return { status: "complete" };
    } else if (syncStatus.type === "retry" && syncStatus.delay) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, syncStatus.delay));
      continue;
    }

    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay));
    delay = Math.min(delay * 1.5, 2000);
  }

  return { status: "timeout" };
}

function useOrganizationSyncEffect(
  setState: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<OnboardingStep>>,
  setError: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | null>>
) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    const resume = sessionStorage.getItem("onboarding_resume");
    if (resume !== "connect-host") return;

    let cancelled = false;

    (async () => {
      const result = await pollForOrganizationSync(() => cancelled);

      if (cancelled) return;

      switch (result.status) {
        case "ready":
          toast({ title: "Organization created", description: "Now connect your first Docker host." });
          setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
          break;
        case "complete":
          sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
          navigate("/app", { replace: true });
          break;
        case "timeout":
          sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
          setState({ step: 0, phase: "form" });
          setError("Organization sync took too long. Please try creating your organization again.");
          break;
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
}

export function useOnboardingState() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<OnboardingStep>(() =>
    sessionStorage.getItem("onboarding_resume") === "connect-host"
      ? { step: 0, phase: "syncing" }
      : { step: 0, phase: "form" },
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSkipping, setIsSkipping] = useState(false);
  const [testError, setTestError] = useState("");
  const [remediationCommand, setRemediationCommand] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [orgName, setOrgName] = useState("");
  const [hostName, setHostName] = useState("");
  const [hostUrl, setHostUrl] = useState("");
  const [connectionMode, setConnectionMode] = useState<ConnectionMode>("agent");
  const [socketPath, setSocketPath] = useState("/var/run/docker.sock");
  const [cfServiceTokenId, setCfServiceTokenId] = useState("");
  const [cfServiceTokenSecret, setCfServiceTokenSecret] = useState("");
  const [enrollment, setEnrollment] = useState<AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse | null>(null);
  const [finalizeResult, setFinalizeResult] = useState<AgentEnrollmentFinalizeResponse | null>(null);

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { isLoaded, orgId } = useAuth();
  const { createOrganization, setActive, userMemberships } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: { infinite: true },
  });

  const fallbackOrgId = userMemberships.data?.[0]?.organization?.id ?? null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded && orgId && state.step === 0 && state.phase === "form") {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
    }
  }, [isLoaded, orgId, state.step, state.phase]);

  useOrganizationSyncEffect(setState, setError);

  const completeOnboardingAndNavigate = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await markOnboardingStatus("completed", orgId, fallbackOrgId);
      sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
      const pendingPlan = sessionStorage.getItem("dockerdash_pending_plan");
      if (pendingPlan) {
        navigate(`/app/billing?plan=${pendingPlan}`, { replace: true });
      } else {
        navigate("/app", { replace: true });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: "Couldn't finalize onboarding",
        description:
          err instanceof Error
            ? err.message
            : "Unable to persist onboarding state. Please select an organization and try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    }
  }, [orgId, fallbackOrgId, navigate, toast]);

  const handleSkip = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSkipping(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await markOnboardingStatus("skipped", orgId, fallbackOrgId);
      sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
      navigate("/app", { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: "Still syncing your workspace",
        description:
          err instanceof Error
            ? err.message
            : "We couldn't finish yet. Please wait a moment and try again.",
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSkipping(false);
    }
  }, [orgId, fallbackOrgId, navigate, toast]);

  const handleCreateOrg = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!orgName.trim() || !createOrganization) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      setState({ step: 0, phase: "creating" });
      const org = await createOrganization({ name: orgName.trim() });
      if (setActive && org) {
        await setActive({ organization: org.id });
      }
      sessionStorage.setItem("onboarding_resume", "connect-host");
      window.location.assign("/onboarding");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setState({ step: 0, phase: "form" });
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create organization. Please try again.");
    }
  }, [orgName, createOrganization, setActive]);

  const createEnrollment = useCallback(async () => {
    const clerkOrgId = orgId ?? fallbackOrgId;
    if (!clerkOrgId) {
      throw new Error("No active organization found. Please refresh the page.");
    }

    const enrollmentResponse = await agentEnrollmentApi.create({
      organizationId: clerkOrgId,
      hostName,
      hostUrl,
      connectionMode,
      dockerSocketPath: socketPath,
      cfServiceTokenId: connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenId.trim() || undefined : undefined,
      cfServiceTokenSecret: connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenSecret.trim() || undefined : undefined,
    });

    setEnrollment(enrollmentResponse);
    setRemediationCommand(null);
    setTestError("");
    setError(null);
    setState({ step: 1, phase: "install" });
  }, [orgId, fallbackOrgId, hostName, hostUrl, connectionMode, socketPath, cfServiceTokenId, cfServiceTokenSecret]);

  const handleBasicsNext = useCallback(async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!hostName.trim()) {
      setError("Host name is required.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      new URL(hostUrl);
    } catch {
      setError("Enter a valid URL (e.g. https://agent.example.com:9876)");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "preparing" });
      await createEnrollment();
    } catch (err) {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to prepare the guided setup command.");
    }
  }, [hostName, hostUrl, createEnrollment]);

  const handleRegenerateEnrollment = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "preparing" });
      await createEnrollment();
      toast({ title: "Fresh setup command ready", description: "A new enrollment command was generated for this host." });
    } catch (err) {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "install" });
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to regenerate the setup command.");
    }
  }, [createEnrollment, toast]);

  const finalizeEnrollment = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!enrollment?.session_id) {
      setError("No enrollment session is active. Generate a setup command first.");
      return;
    }

    setError(null);
    setTestError("");
    setRemediationCommand(null);

    try {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "finalizing" });
      const result = await agentEnrollmentApi.finalize(enrollment.session_id);
      setFinalizeResult(result);

      if (!result.ok) {
        setTestError(result.status || "Connection test failed.");
        setRemediationCommand(result.remediation_command);
        setState({ step: 1, phase: "test-failed" });
        return;
      }

      const isWarning = result.reason_code === "agent_outdated" || result.reason_code === "metrics_unavailable";
      if (isWarning) {
        toast({
          title: "Host connected with follow-up recommended",
          description:
            result.reason_code === "agent_outdated"
              ? "The host is reachable, but the installed agent is behind the current release."
              : "The host is reachable, but local metrics verification still needs attention.",
        });
      } else {
        toast({ title: "Host connected!", description: `"${hostName}" is verified and ready.` });
      }
      setState({ step: 2, phase: "done" });
    } catch (err) {
      setTestError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Connection test failed.");
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "test-failed" });
    }
  }, [enrollment, hostName, toast]);

  const handleRetryTest = useCallback(async () => {
    await finalizeEnrollment();
  }, [finalizeEnrollment]);

  const handleBackToBasics = useCallback(() => {
    setError(null);
    setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
  }, []);

  return {
    state,
    error,
    isSkipping,
    testError,
    remediationCommand,
    orgName,
    setOrgName,
    handleCreateOrg,
    hostName,
    setHostName,
    hostUrl,
    setHostUrl,
    connectionMode,
    setConnectionMode,
    socketPath,
    setSocketPath,
    cfServiceTokenId,
    setCfServiceTokenId,
    cfServiceTokenSecret,
    setCfServiceTokenSecret,
    enrollment,
    finalizeResult,
    handleBasicsNext,
    handleRetryTest,
    handleBackToBasics,
    handleSkip,
    completeOnboardingAndNavigate,
    handleFinalizeEnrollment: finalizeEnrollment,
    handleRegenerateEnrollment,
  };
}
</file>

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Box, LifeBuoy, Mail, Wrench } from "lucide-react";
import { PublicNavbar } from "@/components/layout/PublicNavbar";
import { PublicFooter } from "@/components/layout/PublicFooter";
import { SEO } from "@/components/shared/SEO";

export default function ContactPage() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-background">
      <SEO 
        title="Contact" 
        description="Need help with your Docker fleet? Reach out to our support team for technical assistance, billing questions, or enterprise inquiries."
      />
      <PublicNavbar />

      <main className="flex-1 py-20">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-start">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-4">Talk to the team behind Docker Dashboard</h1>
              <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground">
                Use the direct contact paths below for support, rollout questions, and hosted deployment discussions.
              </p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary"><LifeBuoy className="h-5 w-5" /></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">Support</p>
                  <a href="mailto:support@dockerdash.app" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">support@dockerdash.app</a>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary"><Mail className="h-5 w-5" /></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">Chat with sales</p>
                  <a href="mailto:sales@dockerdash.app" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">sales@dockerdash.app</a>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary"><Wrench className="h-5 w-5" /></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">Implementation help</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">We can help with agent rollout, tunnel setup, and first-host onboarding.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="glass-card p-8 space-y-5">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Best current paths</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              For now, the fastest way to reach us is by email. That keeps the contact path real while the in-app support workflow stays intentionally small.
            </p>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <a href="mailto:support@dockerdash.app" className="block rounded-lg border border-border p-4 hover:bg-accent/30 transition-colors">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">Technical support</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">support@dockerdash.app</p>
              </a>
              <a href="mailto:sales@dockerdash.app" className="block rounded-lg border border-border p-4 hover:bg-accent/30 transition-colors">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">Sales and rollout discussions</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">sales@dockerdash.app</p>
              </a>
            </div>
            <Button asChild className="w-full text-base py-6">
              <a href="mailto:support@dockerdash.app?subject=Docker%20Dashboard%20support">Email Support</a>
            </Button>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-center text-muted-foreground">
              Contacting us means we may reply by email using the details you provide there. See our <Link to="/privacy" className="underline">Privacy Policy</Link>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
      <PublicFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/pages/DedicatedIntakePage.tsx">
import { useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useUser } from "@clerk/react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Building2, CheckCircle2, Circle, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { DEDICATED_STEPS, useDedicatedIntakeState } from "@/hooks/useDedicatedDeployment";
import type { ComplianceNeed, DedicatedRegion, IntegrationNeed } from "@/types/dedicated";

const REGION_OPTIONS: Array<{ value: DedicatedRegion; label: string }> = [
  { value: "eu-central", label: "EU Central" },
  { value: "eu-west", label: "EU West" },
  { value: "us-east", label: "US East" },
  { value: "us-west", label: "US West" },
  { value: "ap-south", label: "AP South" },
  { value: "custom", label: "Custom" },
];

const COMPLIANCE_OPTIONS: Array<{ value: ComplianceNeed; label: string }> = [
  { value: "soc2", label: "SOC 2" },
  { value: "iso27001", label: "ISO 27001" },
  { value: "gdpr", label: "GDPR" },
  { value: "data_residency", label: "Data residency" },
];

const INTEGRATION_OPTIONS: Array<{ value: IntegrationNeed; label: string }> = [
  { value: "aws_ecr", label: "AWS ECR" },
  { value: "slack", label: "Slack alerts" },
  { value: "pagerduty", label: "PagerDuty" },
  { value: "email", label: "Email notifications" },
  { value: "pdf_reports", label: "Scheduled PDF reports" },
  { value: "webhooks", label: "Custom webhooks" },
  { value: "sso", label: "SSO / identity integration" },
];

const STEP_LABELS = [
  { id: "scope", label: "Scope", kicker: "Company, timing, and host envelope" },
  { id: "infrastructure", label: "Infrastructure", kicker: "Region, network, and exposure model" },
  { id: "security", label: "Security", kicker: "Compliance and retention requirements" },
  { id: "integrations", label: "Integrations", kicker: "Alerting and workflow connections" },
  { id: "readiness", label: "Readiness", kicker: "Operators, ownership, and blockers" },
  { id: "review", label: "Review", kicker: "Confirm the deployment brief" },
];

function StepShell({
  title,
  description,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={title}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 14 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -12 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.28, ease: "easeOut" }}
      className="space-y-6"
    >
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
      </div>
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function Fieldset({
  label,
  description,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Label className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</Label>
      {description ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{description}</p> : null}
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function DedicatedIntakePage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useUser();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { state, stepIndex, updateField, toggleArrayValue, nextStep, previousStep, submit } =
    useDedicatedIntakeState();

  const currentStepConfig = STEP_LABELS[Math.min(stepIndex, STEP_LABELS.length - 1)];
  const progressValue = Math.round(((Math.min(stepIndex, STEP_LABELS.length - 1) + 1) / STEP_LABELS.length) * 100);
  const summaryRows = useMemo(
    () => [
      { label: "Go-live window", value: state.data.targetGoLiveWindow.replaceAll("_", " ") },
      { label: "Host range", value: state.data.estimatedNodeRange.replaceAll("_", " to ") },
      { label: "Preferred region", value: state.data.preferredRegion.replaceAll("-", " ") },
      { label: "Seat estimate", value: `${state.data.operatorSeatEstimate} operators` },
    ],
    [state.data],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) {
      return;
    }

    if (!state.data.primaryContactName && user.fullName) {
      updateField("primaryContactName", user.fullName);
    }

    const email = user.primaryEmailAddress?.emailAddress;
    if (!state.data.primaryContactEmail && email) {
      updateField("primaryContactEmail", email);
    }
  }, [state.data.primaryContactEmail, state.data.primaryContactName, updateField, user]);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    try {
      const record = await submit();
      toast({
        title: "Deployment brief received",
        description: `Reference ${record.reference_id} is now in the provisioning queue.`,
      });
      navigate("/app/dedicated-deployment", { replace: true });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Could not submit deployment brief",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Please retry in a moment.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    }
  };

  const isReviewStep = state.step === "review";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background">
      <div className="border-b border-border/70 bg-card/60 backdrop-blur">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-5">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.28em] text-primary">
              Dedicated Deployment Intake
            </p>
            <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
              Build the deployment brief before we reserve infrastructure.
            </h1>
          </div>
          <Link to="/pricing" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
            Back to pricing
          </Link>
        </div>
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 pb-5">
          <div className="h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-border/70">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: `${progressValue}%` }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.32, ease: "easeOut" }}
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <main className="mx-auto grid max-w-6xl gap-6 px-4 py-10 lg:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
        <section className="rounded-[2rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/70 p-6 shadow-[0_24px_70px_-55px_black]">
          <div className="mb-8 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
            {STEP_LABELS.map((step, index) => {
              const isActive = index === Math.min(stepIndex, STEP_LABELS.length - 1);
              const isDone = index < stepIndex;

              return (
                <div
                  key={step.id}
                  className={`rounded-2xl border px-3 py-3 ${
                    isActive
                      ? "border-primary/50 bg-primary/10"
                      : isDone
                        ? "border-border/70 bg-background/70"
                        : "border-border/50 bg-background/35"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
                    {isDone ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                    ) : isActive ? (
                      <Circle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 fill-primary text-primary" />
                    ) : (
                      <Circle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60" />
                    )}
                    Step {index + 1}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium">{step.label}</div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {state.step === "scope" ? (
              <StepShell
                title="Frame the rollout"
                description="Start with the buyer, the operating window, and the rough deployment size. This gives us enough to reserve the right envelope before we discuss deeper infrastructure details."
              >
                <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <Fieldset label="Company name">
                    <Input
                      value={state.data.companyName}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("companyName", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Example: Northwind Security"
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Buyer role">
                    <Input
                      value={state.data.buyerRole}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("buyerRole", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="VP Engineering, DevOps Lead, Founder..."
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Primary contact">
                    <Input
                      value={state.data.primaryContactName}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("primaryContactName", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Your name"
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Primary contact email">
                    <Input
                      type="email"
                      value={state.data.primaryContactEmail}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("primaryContactEmail", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="name@company.com"
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Target go-live window">
                    <select
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                      value={state.data.targetGoLiveWindow}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateField("targetGoLiveWindow", event.target.value as typeof state.data.targetGoLiveWindow)
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="asap">ASAP</option>
                      <option value="2_weeks">Within 2 weeks</option>
                      <option value="30_days">Within 30 days</option>
                      <option value="custom">Custom window</option>
                    </select>
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Estimated host range">
                    <select
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                      value={state.data.estimatedNodeRange}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateField("estimatedNodeRange", event.target.value as typeof state.data.estimatedNodeRange)
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="1_5">1 to 5 hosts</option>
                      <option value="6_15">6 to 15 hosts</option>
                      <option value="16_25">16 to 25 hosts</option>
                      <option value="26_plus">26 plus hosts</option>
                    </select>
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Environment count">
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={99}
                      value={state.data.environmentCount}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("environmentCount", Number(event.target.value || 1))}
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Operator seat estimate">
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={500}
                      value={state.data.operatorSeatEstimate}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("operatorSeatEstimate", Number(event.target.value || 1))}
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                </div>
              </StepShell>
            ) : null}

            {state.step === "infrastructure" ? (
              <StepShell
                title="Define the infrastructure envelope"
                description="Capture region placement, networking needs, and exposure expectations. This is the input that changes how the managed instance is physically shaped."
              >
                <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <Fieldset label="Preferred region">
                    <select
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                      value={state.data.preferredRegion}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateField("preferredRegion", event.target.value as typeof state.data.preferredRegion)
                      }
                    >
                      {REGION_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                        <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                          {option.label}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </Fieldset>

                  <Fieldset label="Secondary regions">
                    <div className="grid gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border/70 p-4">
                      {REGION_OPTIONS.filter((option) => option.value !== state.data.preferredRegion).map((option) => (
                        <label key={option.value} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
                          <Checkbox
                            checked={state.data.secondaryRegions.includes(option.value)}
                            onCheckedChange={() => toggleArrayValue("secondaryRegions", option.value)}
                          />
                          <span>{option.label}</span>
                        </label>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </Fieldset>

                  <Fieldset label="Dedicated domain required?">
                    <div className="flex gap-3">
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={state.data.needsCustomDomain ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("needsCustomDomain", true)}
                      >
                        Yes
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={!state.data.needsCustomDomain ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("needsCustomDomain", false)}
                      >
                        No
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </Fieldset>

                  <Fieldset label="Private networking required?">
                    <div className="flex gap-3">
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={state.data.needsPrivateNetworking ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("needsPrivateNetworking", true)}
                      >
                        Yes
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={!state.data.needsPrivateNetworking ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("needsPrivateNetworking", false)}
                      >
                        No
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </Fieldset>

                  <div className="md:col-span-2">
                    <Fieldset label="Rollout notes" description="Capture networking assumptions, host segmentation, or any environment-specific constraints we should know before provisioning.">
                      <Textarea
                        value={state.data.rolloutNotes}
                        onChange={(event) => updateField("rolloutNotes", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Example: production hosts must stay in EU Central, staging can live separately, secure tunnel ownership sits with internal platform team..."
                        rows={5}
                      />
                    </Fieldset>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </StepShell>
            ) : null}

            {state.step === "security" ? (
              <StepShell
                title="Capture security and compliance requirements"
                description="This turns the waiting period into useful operator work. We can provision faster when the compliance posture and retention expectations are explicit up front."
              >
                <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <Fieldset label="Compliance scope">
                    <div className="grid gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border/70 p-4">
                      {COMPLIANCE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                        <label key={option.value} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
                          <Checkbox
                            checked={state.data.complianceNeeds.includes(option.value)}
                            onCheckedChange={() => toggleArrayValue("complianceNeeds", option.value)}
                          />
                          <span>{option.label}</span>
                        </label>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </Fieldset>

                  <Fieldset label="Retention requirement (days)">
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      min={7}
                      value={state.data.retentionRequirementDays ?? ""}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateField(
                          "retentionRequirementDays",
                          event.target.value ? Number(event.target.value) : null,
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </Fieldset>

                  <Fieldset label="SSO required?">
                    <div className="flex gap-3">
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={state.data.requiresSSO ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("requiresSSO", true)}
                      >
                        Required
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={!state.data.requiresSSO ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("requiresSSO", false)}
                      >
                        Not initially
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </Fieldset>

                  <Fieldset label="Existing agent rollout in place?">
                    <div className="flex gap-3">
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={state.data.hasExistingDockerAgentRollout ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("hasExistingDockerAgentRollout", true)}
                      >
                        Yes
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant={!state.data.hasExistingDockerAgentRollout ? "default" : "outline"}
                        onClick={() => updateField("hasExistingDockerAgentRollout", false)}
                      >
                        No
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </Fieldset>
                </div>
              </StepShell>
            ) : null}

            {state.step === "integrations" ? (
              <StepShell
                title="Choose the initial workflow integrations"
                description="These selections do not permanently lock the deployment. They tell us what should be ready or documented at handoff."
              >
                <div className="grid gap-2 rounded-3xl border border-border/70 p-5">
                  {INTEGRATION_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                    <label
                      key={option.value}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-transparent px-3 py-3 hover:border-border/70 hover:bg-background/60"
                    >
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={state.data.integrations.includes(option.value)}
                        onCheckedChange={() => toggleArrayValue("integrations", option.value)}
                      />
                      <span className="text-sm">{option.label}</span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </StepShell>
            ) : null}

            {state.step === "readiness" ? (
              <StepShell
                title="Confirm operational ownership"
                description="We need one buyer contact and one technical owner to keep the rollout moving. Capture any blockers now so they become part of the handoff plan instead of a surprise."
              >
                <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <Fieldset label="Technical owner name">
                    <Input
                      value={state.data.technicalOwnerName}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("technicalOwnerName", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Platform or DevOps owner"
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                  <Fieldset label="Technical owner email">
                    <Input
                      type="email"
                      value={state.data.technicalOwnerEmail}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("technicalOwnerEmail", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="devops@company.com"
                    />
                  </Fieldset>
                  <div className="md:col-span-2">
                    <Fieldset label="Known blockers">
                      <Textarea
                        value={state.data.blockers}
                        onChange={(event) => updateField("blockers", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Example: SSO metadata is owned by security team, DNS approval takes 2 days, first host list still being finalized..."
                        rows={5}
                      />
                    </Fieldset>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </StepShell>
            ) : null}

            {state.step === "review" ? (
              <StepShell
                title="Review the deployment brief"
                description="This is the exact operating brief the provisioning queue will receive. Once submitted, we generate a deployment reference and move you into the managed status dashboard."
              >
                <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                  {[
                    ["Company", state.data.companyName || "Not provided"],
                    ["Primary contact", `${state.data.primaryContactName || "Not provided"}${state.data.primaryContactEmail ? ` • ${state.data.primaryContactEmail}` : ""}`],
                    ["Go-live", state.data.targetGoLiveWindow.replaceAll("_", " ")],
                    ["Host range", state.data.estimatedNodeRange.replaceAll("_", " to ")],
                    ["Region", state.data.preferredRegion.replaceAll("-", " ")],
                    ["Compliance", state.data.complianceNeeds.length ? state.data.complianceNeeds.join(", ") : "None selected"],
                    ["Integrations", state.data.integrations.length ? state.data.integrations.join(", ") : "None selected"],
                    ["Technical owner", `${state.data.technicalOwnerName || "Not provided"}${state.data.technicalOwnerEmail ? ` • ${state.data.technicalOwnerEmail}` : ""}`],
                  ].map(([label, value]) => (
                    <div key={label} className="rounded-2xl border border-border/70 bg-background/60 p-4">
                      <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
                        {label}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6">{value}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {state.submitError ? (
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
                    {state.submitError}
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </StepShell>
            ) : null}
          </AnimatePresence>

          <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-border/70 pt-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={previousStep} disabled={stepIndex === 0 || state.isSubmitting}>
              <ArrowLeft className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Back
            </Button>

            <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2 sm:flex-row">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => navigate("/pricing")}
                disabled={state.isSubmitting}
              >
                Save for later
              </Button>
              {isReviewStep ? (
                <Button type="button" onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={state.isSubmitting}>
                  {state.isSubmitting ? "Submitting..." : "Submit deployment brief"}
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button type="button" onClick={nextStep} disabled={state.isSubmitting}>
                  Continue
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <aside className="space-y-5">
          <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-primary/25 bg-primary/8 p-6">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-primary">
              Active deployment summary
            </p>
            <h2 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
              {currentStepConfig.label}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
              {currentStepConfig.kicker}
            </p>

            <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
              {summaryRows.map((row) => (
                <div key={row.label} className="rounded-2xl border border-border/60 bg-background/55 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">
                    {row.label}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-sm capitalize">{row.value}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/70 p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              <div className="font-medium">What happens after submission</div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <p>We generate a deployment reference and return you to a live provisioning dashboard.</p>
              <p>Within 1 business day, you receive your first operator update and any technical homework for the handoff window.</p>
              <p>The deployment dashboard stays visible until the environment is ready for guided activation.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/70 p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Building2 className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              <div className="font-medium">Why this is different from self-serve</div>
            </div>
            <ul className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <li>Dedicated infrastructure is provisioned per customer environment.</li>
              <li>Provisioning time is spent on isolation, hardening, and operational readiness.</li>
              <li>You do not enter the standard host-onboarding wizard until the environment is secured.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/DedicatedStartPage.tsx">
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  ArrowRight,
  Building2,
  CheckCircle2,
  Database,
  LockKeyhole,
  ServerCog,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { PublicNavbar } from "@/components/layout/PublicNavbar";
import { PublicFooter } from "@/components/layout/PublicFooter";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { pricingPlans } from "@/lib/pricing";

const enterprisePlan = pricingPlans.find((plan) => plan.id === "enterprise");

const deploymentMilestones = [
  "Architecture brief reviewed",
  "Capacity reserved on isolated infrastructure",
  "Security baseline and access controls applied",
  "Workspace prepared for guided handoff",
];

const trustPoints = [
  { icon: ShieldCheck, label: "Bare-metal isolation" },
  { icon: Database, label: "Dedicated database" },
  { icon: LockKeyhole, label: "SSO-ready identity path" },
  { icon: ServerCog, label: "Managed Hetzner and Proxmox stack" },
];

export default function DedicatedStartPage() {
  const { isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const primaryHref = isSignedIn ? "/dedicated/intake" : "/sign-up?next=/dedicated/intake";
  const secondaryHref = isSignedIn ? "/app" : "/login?next=/dedicated/intake";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground">
      <PublicNavbar />

      <main>
        <section className="relative overflow-hidden border-b border-border/70">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top,_hsl(var(--primary)/0.16),_transparent_42%)]" />
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-primary/50 to-transparent" />

          <div className="relative mx-auto grid max-w-6xl gap-10 px-4 py-16 md:py-24 lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 18 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: "easeOut" }}
              className="max-w-2xl"
            >
              <p className="mb-4 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.32em] text-primary">
                Dedicated Deployment
              </p>
              <h1 className="max-w-xl text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight md:text-6xl">
                Private Docker Dash infrastructure, provisioned by our team.
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-6 max-w-xl text-base leading-7 text-muted-foreground md:text-lg">
                This is not a shared SaaS checkout. We stand up a managed isolated environment,
                validate the baseline, and hand your team a guided rollout path within 3 to 5
                business days.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
                <Link to={primaryHref}>
                  <Button size="lg" className="w-full gap-2 sm:w-auto">
                    Start Private Deployment
                    <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
                <Link to={secondaryHref}>
                  <Button size="lg" variant="outline" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
                    {isSignedIn ? "Back to workspace" : "Sign in to continue"}
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </div>

              <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                We review requirements, reserve capacity, and return a deployment reference within
                1 business day.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-10 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {trustPoints.map((item, index) => (
                  <motion.div
                    key={item.label}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 14 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ delay: 0.08 * index, duration: 0.45, ease: "easeOut" }}
                    whileHover={{ y: -4 }}
                    className="rounded-3xl border border-border/70 bg-card/60 p-4 backdrop-blur"
                  >
                    <item.icon className="mb-3 h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium">{item.label}</div>
                  </motion.div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </motion.div>

            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.985, y: 18 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.55, ease: "easeOut", delay: 0.12 }}
              whileHover={{
                y: -6,
                boxShadow: "0 30px 90px -42px hsl(var(--primary) / 0.45)",
              }}
              className="rounded-[2rem] border border-primary/35 bg-card/80 p-6 shadow-[0_30px_90px_-52px_hsl(var(--primary)/0.6)] backdrop-blur"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">
                    {enterprisePlan?.name ?? "Dedicated"}
                  </p>
                  <h2 className="mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                    Dedicated (Managed Instance)
                  </h2>
                </div>
                <span className="rounded-full border border-primary/30 bg-primary/12 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-primary">
                  White-glove
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 rounded-3xl border border-border/70 bg-background/60 p-5">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Deployment window</div>
                <div className="mt-2 text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight">3-5 business days</div>
                <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Includes provisioning, hardening, validation, and handoff preparation.
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
                {deploymentMilestones.map((step) => (
                  <div
                    key={step}
                    className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border/60 bg-background/45 px-4 py-3"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{step}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border/70 p-5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <Building2 className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-medium">Best for regulated or high-trust buyers</div>
                    <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Dedicated hosting, isolated data paths, negotiated allocations, and identity
                      integration.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="py-16">
          <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-6xl gap-5 px-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            {[
              {
                title: "1. Intake and architecture review",
                body: "You submit deployment requirements. We review regions, compliance scope, SSO expectations, and integration needs before reserving capacity.",
              },
              {
                title: "2. Private environment provisioning",
                body: "We provision isolated infrastructure, apply baseline security controls, and prepare your dedicated workspace rather than dropping you into a shared control plane.",
              },
              {
                title: "3. Guided handoff",
                body: "Once the environment is secured, your team receives a deployment dashboard, rollout checklist, and guided first-host activation path.",
              },
            ].map((item, index) => (
              <motion.div
                key={item.title}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
                whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.35 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: 0.08 * index }}
                className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-border/70 bg-card/60 p-6"
              >
                <div className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{item.title}</div>
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">{item.body}</p>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <PublicFooter />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/pages/DocsPage.tsx">
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { LogoLink } from "@/components/shared/LogoLink";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Box,
  BookOpen,
  Server,
  Activity,
  ArrowRight,
  Terminal,
  Users,
  FileText,
  HelpCircle,
  Construction,
  ChevronDown,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  CloudCog,
  LayoutDashboard,
  Cable,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled } from "@/lib/hostname";
import { SEO } from "@/components/shared/SEO";

/*
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *  Task-oriented documentation.
 *
 *  Every section is written as a how-to guide grounded in what
 *  the product actually does today, verified against source code.
 *
 *  Source evidence:
 *    OnboardingPage.tsx, DashboardPage.tsx, HostsPage.tsx,
 *    HostDetailPage.tsx, ContainersPage.tsx, ContainerDetailPage.tsx,
 *    LogsPage.tsx, OrganizationsPage.tsx, MembersPage.tsx,
 *    AddHostDialog.tsx, useDocker.ts, docker-api.ts, database.ts,
 *    App.tsx, MonitoringPage.tsx, AlertsPage.tsx, IncidentsPage.tsx,
 *    DeploymentsPage.tsx, BillingPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 */

/* ── Table of Contents ── */
const TOC = [
  { id: "start-here", label: "Start Here", icon: BookOpen },
  { id: "how-connection-works", label: "How the Connection Works", icon: Cable },
  { id: "connect-host", label: "Connect Your First Host", icon: Server },
  { id: "dashboard", label: "Use the Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { id: "containers", label: "Containers", icon: Activity },
  { id: "logs", label: "Logs", icon: FileText },
  { id: "organizations", label: "Organizations & Access", icon: Users },
  { id: "troubleshooting", label: "Troubleshooting", icon: HelpCircle },
  { id: "limitations", label: "Current Limitations", icon: Construction },
];

/* ── Reusable callout component ── */
function Callout({
  type,
  title,
  children,
}: {
  type: "info" | "success" | "warning";
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const styles = {
    info: "border-primary/30 bg-primary/5",
    success: "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5",
    warning: "border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5",
  };
  const icons = {
    info: <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0 mt-0.5" />,
    success: <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />,
    warning: <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />,
  };
  return (
    <div className={`flex gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 ${styles[type]}`}>
      {icons[type]}
      <div>
        <div className="text-sm font-medium mb-1">{title}</div>
        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Step block ── */
function Step({ n, title, children }: { n: number; title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
        <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold shrink-0">
          {n}
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 w-px bg-border mt-2" />
      </div>
      <div className="pb-8 min-w-0">
        <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-2">{title}</h4>
        <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed space-y-2">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Section wrapper ── */
function Section({
  id,
  icon: Icon,
  title,
  children,
}: {
  id: string;
  icon: typeof BookOpen;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <section id={id} className="scroll-mt-20">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Icon className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-6">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

/* ── Troubleshooting row ── */
function TroubleshootRow({
  problem,
  cause,
  fix,
}: {
  problem: string;
  cause: string;
  fix: string;
}) {
  return (
    <details className="glass-card p-4 group">
      <summary className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer font-medium text-sm list-none">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
          {problem}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground group-open:rotate-180 transition-transform shrink-0 ml-4" />
      </summary>
      <div className="mt-3 ml-[22px] space-y-2 text-sm">
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
            Likely cause
          </span>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{cause}</p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
            What to do
          </span>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{fix}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}
