<file path="src/services/docker-api.ts">
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export interface DockerHostPingResult {
  ok: boolean;
  status: string;
  docker_version: string | null;
  agent_version: string | null;
  agent_version_error: string | null;
  agent_update_available: boolean;
  current_agent_version: string | null;
  latest_agent_version: string | null;
  upgrade_command: string | null;
  source_label: string | null;
  published_release: boolean;
  release_url: string | null;
  release_notes_url: string | null;
  checksum: string | null;
  os_info: string | null;
  connection_mode: string;
}

async function invoke(body: Record<string, unknown>, idempotencyKey?: string) {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (idempotencyKey) {
    headers['Idempotency-Key'] = idempotencyKey;
  }
  const data = await apiFetch('/docker-proxy', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error + (data.details ? `: ${data.details}` : ''));
  return data;
}

const genKey = () => crypto.randomUUID();

export const dockerApi = {
  ping: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'ping', hostId }) as Promise<DockerHostPingResult>,
  hostMetrics: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'host-metrics', hostId }),
  info: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'info', hostId }),
  version: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'version', hostId }),
  listContainers: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'containers', hostId }),
  inspectContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-inspect', hostId, containerId }),
  containerStats: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-stats', hostId, containerId }),
  containerLogs: (hostId: string, containerId: string, tail: string | number = 100, since?: number, until?: number) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-logs', hostId, containerId, params: { tail, since, until } }),
  startContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-start', hostId, containerId }, genKey()),
  stopContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-stop', hostId, containerId }, genKey()),
  restartContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-restart', hostId, containerId }, genKey()),
  allContainers: (orgId: string) => invoke({ action: 'all-containers', orgId }),
  allContainerStats: (orgId: string) => invoke({ action: 'all-container-stats', orgId }),
  listFiles: (hostId: string, containerId: string, path: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-fs-list', hostId, containerId, params: { path } }) as Promise<{ entries: FileEntry[] }>,
  readFile: (hostId: string, containerId: string, path: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-fs-read', hostId, containerId, params: { path } }) as Promise<{ content: string; size: number; truncated: boolean; binary?: boolean; message?: string }>,
};

export interface FileEntry {
  name: string;
  type: 'file' | 'directory' | 'symlink' | 'other';
  size: number;
  permissions: string;
  modified: string;
  linkTarget?: string;
}
</file>

<file path="src/services/notification-api.ts">
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { Notification } from "../types/database";

const API_BASE = "/notifications";

export const getNotifications = async (
  organizationId: string | null
): Promise<Notification[]> => {
  const queryParams = organizationId ? `?organizationId=${organizationId}` : '';
  const response = await apiFetch(`${API_BASE}${queryParams}`) as { notifications: Notification[] };
  return response.notifications;
};

export const dismissNotification = async (
  notificationId: string
): Promise<void> => {
  await apiFetch(`${API_BASE}/${notificationId}/dismiss`, {
    method: "POST"
  });
};

export const dismissAllNotifications = async (
  organizationId: string | null
): Promise<void> => {
  await apiFetch(`${API_BASE}/dismiss-all`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: { organizationId },
  });
};
</file>

<file path="src/App.tsx">
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/toaster";
import { Toaster as Sonner } from "@/components/ui/sonner";
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/layout/AppShell";
import { ProtectedRoute } from "@/components/ProtectedRoute";
import AppRootRedirect from "@/components/AppRootRedirect";
import { isAppSubdomain, isDocsSubdomain, isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled } from "@/lib/hostname";
import { RequireAppSubdomain } from "@/components/RequireAppSubdomain";
import { ClerkProvider } from "@clerk/react";
import { RequirePlatformAdmin } from "@/components/RequirePlatformAdmin";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect } from "react";

const LandingPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/LandingPage"));
const FeaturesPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/FeaturesPage"));
const PricingPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/PricingPage"));
const SecurityPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/SecurityPage"));
const DocsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/DocsPage"));
const LoginPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/LoginPage"));
const SignupPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/SignupPage"));
const CreateOrgPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/CreateOrgPage"));
const TermsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/TermsPage"));
const PrivacyPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/PrivacyPage"));
const RefundsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/RefundsPage"));
const ContactPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/ContactPage"));
const OnboardingPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/OnboardingPage"));
const DedicatedStartPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/DedicatedStartPage"));
const DedicatedIntakePage = lazy(() => import("./pages/DedicatedIntakePage"));
const DashboardPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/DashboardPage"));
const HostsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/HostsPage"));
const HostDetailPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/HostDetailPage"));
const ContainersPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/ContainersPage"));
const ContainerDetailPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/ContainerDetailPage"));
const FileManagerPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/FileManagerPage"));
const LogsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/LogsPage"));
const AlertsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/AlertsPage"));
// MembersPage removed — functionality moved to Settings > Members tab
const BillingPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/BillingPage"));
const SettingsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/SettingsPage"));
const OrganizationsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/OrganizationsPage"));
const AdminPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/AdminPage"));
const HelpPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/HelpPage"));
const SetupGuidePage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/SetupGuidePage"));
const DedicatedDeploymentPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/app/DedicatedDeploymentPage"));
const NotFound = lazy(() => import("./pages/NotFound"));

const queryClient = new QueryClient();

const DarkModeInit = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!document.documentElement.classList.contains("light")) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
    }
  }, []);
  return <>{children}</>;
};

let paddleInitialized = false;

const PaddleInitializer = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (paddleInitialized) return;

    const token = import.meta.env.VITE_PADDLE_CLIENT_TOKEN;
    if (!token) {
      console.warn("Paddle client token missing; skipping initialization.");
      return;
    }

    if (!window.Paddle) {
      console.warn("Paddle.js script not loaded yet; initialization will be retried on next mount or by safe interaction.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const environment = token.startsWith('live_') ? 'production' : 'sandbox';
      window.Paddle.Environment.set(environment);
      window.Paddle.Initialize({ token });
      paddleInitialized = true;
      console.log(`Paddle.js initialized successfully in ${environment} mode.`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to initialize Paddle.js:", error);
    }
  }, []);
  return <>{children}</>;
};

const RouteFallback = () => (
  <div className="flex min-h-[40vh] items-center justify-center">
    <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
  </div>
);

const App = () => {
  const previewBypass = isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled();

  return (
  <ClerkProvider
    publishableKey={import.meta.env.VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY}
    signInUrl="/login"
    signUpUrl="/sign-up"
    signInFallbackRedirectUrl="/app"
    signUpFallbackRedirectUrl="/app"
    afterSignOutUrl="/app"
  >
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <TooltipProvider>
        <DarkModeInit>
          <PaddleInitializer>
            <Toaster />
            <Sonner />
            <BrowserRouter>
              <Suspense fallback={<RouteFallback />}>
                <Routes>
                  {/* Marketing */}
                  <Route path="/" element={isDocsSubdomain() ? <DocsPage /> : isAppSubdomain() ? <AppRootRedirect /> : <LandingPage />} />
                  <Route path="/features" element={<FeaturesPage />} />
                  <Route path="/pricing" element={<PricingPage />} />
                  <Route path="/security" element={<SecurityPage />} />
                  <Route path="/docs" element={<DocsPage />} />
                  <Route path="/contact" element={<ContactPage />} />
                  <Route path="/dedicated/start" element={<DedicatedStartPage />} />
                  <Route path="/tos" element={<TermsPage />} />
                  <Route path="/privacy" element={<PrivacyPage />} />
                  <Route path="/refunds" element={<RefundsPage />} />
                  {/* Auth */}
                  <Route path="/login/*" element={previewBypass ? <Navigate to="/app" replace /> : <RequireAppSubdomain><LoginPage /></RequireAppSubdomain>} />
                  <Route path="/sign-up/*" element={previewBypass ? <Navigate to="/app" replace /> : <RequireAppSubdomain><SignupPage /></RequireAppSubdomain>} />
                  <Route path="/signup" element={previewBypass ? <Navigate to="/app" replace /> : <RequireAppSubdomain><Navigate to="/sign-up" replace /></RequireAppSubdomain>} />
                  <Route path="/create-org" element={<RequireAppSubdomain><CreateOrgPage /></RequireAppSubdomain>} />
                  <Route path="/onboarding" element={<RequireAppSubdomain key="onboarding"><ProtectedRoute requireOnboarded={false}><OnboardingPage /></ProtectedRoute></RequireAppSubdomain>} />
                  <Route
                    path="/dedicated/intake"
                    element={
                      <RequireAppSubdomain key="dedicated-intake">
                        <ProtectedRoute requireOnboarded={false} allowMissingOrganization skipResolvedRedirect>
                          <DedicatedIntakePage />
                        </ProtectedRoute>
                      </RequireAppSubdomain>
                    }
                  />
                  {/* App Shell - Protected */}
                  <Route path="/app" element={<RequireAppSubdomain key="app"><ProtectedRoute><AppShell /></ProtectedRoute></RequireAppSubdomain>}>
                    <Route index element={<DashboardPage />} />
                    <Route path="organizations" element={<OrganizationsPage />} />
                    <Route path="hosts" element={<HostsPage />} />
                    <Route path="hosts/:id" element={<HostDetailPage />} />
                    <Route path="containers" element={<ContainersPage />} />
                    <Route path="containers/:id" element={<ContainerDetailPage />} />
                    <Route path="monitoring" element={<Navigate to="/app/alerts" replace />} />
                    <Route path="logs" element={<LogsPage />} />
                    <Route
                      path="files"
                      element={<FileManagerPage />}
                    />
                    <Route path="alerts" element={<AlertsPage />} />
                    <Route path="incidents" element={<Navigate to="/app/alerts" replace />} />
                    <Route path="incidents/:id" element={<Navigate to="/app/alerts" replace />} />
                    <Route path="deployments" element={<Navigate to="/app/hosts" replace />} />
                    <Route path="billing" element={<BillingPage />} />
                    <Route path="members" element={<Navigate to="/app/settings?tab=Members" replace />} />
                    <Route path="dedicated-deployment" element={<DedicatedDeploymentPage />} />
                    <Route path="settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
                    <Route path="admin" element={<RequirePlatformAdmin><AdminPage /></RequirePlatformAdmin>} />
                    <Route path="help" element={<HelpPage />} />
                    <Route path="setup-guide" element={<SetupGuidePage />} />
                  </Route>
                  <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
                </Routes>
              </Suspense>
            </BrowserRouter>
          </PaddleInitializer>
        </DarkModeInit>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  </ClerkProvider>
  );
};

export default App;
</file>

<file path="src/main.tsx">
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import App from "./App.tsx";
import "./index.css";

// Force reload on module fetch failure (e.g. after a deployment with new hashes)
window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (event) => {
  if (
    event.reason?.name === "ChunkLoadError" || 
    event.reason?.message?.includes("Failed to fetch dynamically imported module") ||
    event.reason?.message?.includes("Importing a module script failed")
  ) {
    console.warn("Module loading error detected, forcing reload...", event.reason);
    window.location.reload();
  }
});

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(<App />);
</file>

<file path="AGENTS.md">
Memory system: Obsidian vault

This environment uses an Obsidian vault as long-term shared memory.

Rules:

1. Before creating new information, check if relevant knowledge already exists.
2. Prefer updating existing notes over creating duplicates.
3. After completing any meaningful task (planning, debugging, implementation, architecture):
   - evaluate if the result is reusable
   - if yes, write it to the Obsidian vault

Memory routing:
- Active project state → 10_Flow/Projects/
- Agent continuation → 10_Flow/Handoffs/
- Reusable knowledge (patterns, decisions, lessons) → 20_Atlas/
- Tools / systems → 30_Entities/
- External references → 40_Sources/

A task is not considered complete until relevant reusable knowledge is stored in Obsidian.

Do not store secrets, credentials, or runtime data in notes.
</file>

<file path="CLAUDE.md">
# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## 🛠 Development Commands

### Environment Setup
- Install dependencies: `npm install`
- Initialize database schema: `node netlify/init-db.mjs`
- Run migrations: `node netlify/check-db.mjs` (if available/implemented)

### Running the App
- Start development server (V16/Netlify dev): `npm run dev`
- Build for production: `npm run build`
- Preview production build: `npm run preview`

### Testing
- Run all tests: `npm test`
- Run tests in watch mode: `npm run test:watch`

### Linting & Formatting
- Lint code: `npm run lint`

## 🏗 Architecture & Structure

### High-Level Overview
This is a full-stack application for managing Docker fleets. It uses a serverless backend (Netlify Functions) and a React frontend (Vite).

### Backend (Netlify Functions)
Located in `netlify/functions/`.
- **API Endpoints**: Implemented as `.mts` files (e.g., `api-docker-hosts.mts`).
- **Key Functionlagility**: Handles database interactions (PostgreSQL), authentication, and proxying requests to agents.
- **Data Layer**: Uses PostgreSQL with a focus on managing host information, agent status, and fleet metrics.

### Frontend
A React application built with TypeScript.
- **Components**: Organized by domain (e.g., `src/components/ui` for primitives, and feature-specific folders).
- **Pages/Routes**: Managed via standard React routing, with key views located in `src/pages` (via app router logic).
- **State Management**: Likely utilizes React hooks and context for application state.
- **API Interaction**: Uses a service layer/hooks to communicate with the Netlify functions.

### Core Domains
- **Fleet Management**: Tracking hosts, agents, and containers.
- **Metrics**: Aggregating performance data from agents.
- **Authentication**: Managing access to the dashboard.
</file>

<file path="netlify.toml">
[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

[build.environment]
  NODE_VERSION = "20"

[dev]
  framework = "#custom"
  command = "npm run dev:vite -- --port 8081"
  targetPort = 8081
  port = 8080

[[headers]]
  for = "/*"
  [headers.values]
    Permissions-Policy = "camera=(), geolocation=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()"

# Canonical domain: www.dockerdash.app → dockerdash.app (301)
[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "https://dockerdash.app/:splat"
  status = 301
  force = true
  [redirects.conditions]
    Host = "www.dockerdash.app"

# Docs domain: docs.dockerdash.app → serve /docs SPA (200 rewrite)
[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200
  force = true
  [redirects.conditions]
    Host = "docs.dockerdash.app"

[[redirects]]
  from = "/api/*"
  to = "/.netlify/functions/api-:splat"
  status = 200

[[redirects]]
  from = "/auth/*"
  to = "/.netlify/functions/auth-:splat"
  status = 200

[[scheduled]]
  function = "api-donor-reminders"
  cron = "0 8 * * *"

[[scheduled]]
  function = "api-host-health-poll"
  cron = "* * * * *"

# Catch-all rule for React Router (must be at the very bottom)
[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200
</file>

<file path="REVIEW.md">
---
phase: code-review
reviewed: 2025-03-25T14:30:00Z
depth: standard
files_reviewed: 2
files_reviewed_list:
  - src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts
  - src/components/hosts/HostWorkspace.tsx
findings:
  critical: 0
  warning: 3
  info: 3
  total: 6
status: issues_found
---

# Code Review Report

**Reviewed:** 2025-03-25
**Depth:** standard
**Files Reviewed:** 2
**Status:** issues_found

## Summary

The review focused on host metrics processing logic and the main host workspace component. The primary concerns involve high cyclomatic complexity in metrics normalization and overly strict/fragile data parsing that may lead to "all-or-nothing" UI failures when minor data discrepancies occur.

## Critical Issues

*No critical issues found.*

## Warnings

### WR-01: High Cyclomatic Complexity in Metrics Normalization

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:101`
**Issue:** The `normalizeHostMetricsPoint` function has a cyclomatic complexity of 28. It performs field extraction (supporting both snake_case and camelCase), normalization, and multiple complex validation checks in a single block. This makes the logic difficult to test, maintain, and extend.
**Fix:**
Break the function into smaller, focused utilities:
1. `extractMetrics(point: HostMetricsApiPoint)`: Handle the dual-naming convention and initial coercion.
2. `validateMetricsRanges(metrics: HostMetricsPoint)`: Handle the numerical range checks.
3. `isMetricsSampleValid(metrics: HostMetricsPoint)`: Handle the logical consistency checks (e.g., totalCores vs CPU).

### WR-02: Overly Strict Validation Discards Mostly-Valid Samples

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:119-152`
**Issue:** The normalization logic returns `null` (causing the UI to show "Metrics unavailable") if *any* core metric is missing or slightly out of range. If an agent version fails to report `usedCores` but reports everything else correctly, the entire dashboard view for that host breaks.
**Fix:**
Implement a more resilient normalization strategy:
- Use clamping for values slightly out of range (e.g., `Math.min(100, Math.max(0, cpu))`).
- Allow optional fields to be `null` in the resulting object instead of discarding the whole point, and handle these `null` values gracefully in the UI components.

### WR-03: Weak Type Coercion in Utility Functions

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:63, 68`
**Issue:** `toFiniteNumber` and `toTimestamp` use `Number(value)` which converts `null` and `""` (empty string) to `0`. This can lead to misleading data (e.g., a missing CPU metric being displayed as `0%` or a missing timestamp being interpreted as Jan 1, 1970) instead of being treated as "missing".
**Fix:**
```typescript
function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (value === null || value === "" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const numeric = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}
```

## Info

### IN-01: Large Component Complexity (Oversized File)

**File:** `src/components/hosts/HostWorkspace.tsx`
**Issue:** The `HostWorkspace` component is large (300+ lines) and contains significant logic for filtering, sorting, routing, and rendering multiple sub-views. While functional, it is becoming a "God Component".
**Fix:**
Extract sub-components like `HostSidebar` and `SelectedHostView` into their own files. Move the host filtering and selection logic into a custom hook (e.g., `useHostSelection`).

### IN-02: API Contract Inconsistency

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:40-117`
**Issue:** Extensive support for both `snake_case` and `camelCase` (e.g., `networkInBytesPerSec ?? network_in_bytes_per_sec`) suggests an inconsistent API contract or technical debt from migrating between agent versions.
**Fix:**
Ideally, standardize the API response at the source or at the edge (e.g., in `dockerApi` service) using a consistent transformer, so hooks don't need to carry this mapping logic.

### IN-03: Hardcoded Configuration (Magic Numbers)

**File:** `src/components/hosts/HostWorkspace.tsx:210, 212`
**Issue:** Refresh intervals (`15000`, `10000`) are hardcoded directly in the component.
**Fix:**
Move these to a configuration constant or a default options object in the hooks.

---

_Reviewed: 2025-03-25_
_Reviewer: gsd-code-reviewer_
_Depth: standard_
</file>

## File: 20_Atlas/Concepts/con-dockerdash-installer-hash-mismatch.md
````markdown
# Dockerdash installer hash mismatch

- Symptom: agent install/update command fails SHA256 verification with a stable, different hash.
- Root cause: UI/server expected hash out of sync with actual installer file served at app.dockerdash.app.
- Fix: update `shared/watchtower-agent-release.ts` installer SHA256 to match the deployed installer file hash, then redeploy.
- Quick check: compare `Get-FileHash public/watchtower-agent-install.sh` with the hash shown in the UI command.
````

## File: 20_Atlas/Concepts/con-podman.md
````markdown
---
id: podman
type: concept
status: stable
created: 2026-04-21
updated: 2026-04-21
tags:
  - containerization
  - docker-alternative
  - devops
  - linux
  - rootless-containers
---

# Podman: A daemonless container engine for Linux

Podman is an open-source container engine tool developed by Red Hat that provides a Docker-compatible command-line interface for managing containers, images, and pods. Unlike Docker, Podman runs without a daemon, using a fork-exec model where each container runs as a child process of the user's session.

## Problem: Docker's daemon architecture introduces security and operational concerns

Traditional Docker uses a client-server architecture where the Docker CLI communicates with a long-running daemon (`dockerd`) that runs as root. This creates several issues:

1. **Security risks**: The Docker daemon runs with root privileges, creating a large attack surface
2. **Single point of failure**: If the daemon crashes, all containers stop
3. **Complex user management**: Users need to be added to the `docker` group to run containers, which grants them effective root access
4. **Systemd integration challenges**: Containers aren't natively managed as system services

## Reliable fix: Podman's daemonless, rootless architecture

Podman addresses these concerns through several key design decisions:

### Daemonless operation
- Each container runs as a direct child process of the user's session
- No long-running daemon means no single point of failure
- Better integration with systemd for service management

### Rootless containers by default
- Containers can run without root privileges using user namespaces
- Users don't need to be added to special groups
- Significantly reduces the attack surface

### Docker-compatible CLI
- Most Docker commands work identically (`docker run` → `podman run`)
- Supports Dockerfiles, Docker Compose (via `podman-compose`)
- Can pull from Docker Hub and other OCI registries

### Pod support
- Native support for Kubernetes-style pods (groups of containers)
- Better alignment with Kubernetes development workflows
- Pod management commands built-in

## Example pattern: Migrating from Docker to Podman

```bash
# Install Podman (Ubuntu/Debian)
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install podman

# Set up rootless mode (automatic on most systems)
podman info

# Docker-compatible commands
podman pull nginx:latest
podman run -d -p 8080:80 --name webserver nginx:latest
podman ps
podman logs webserver
podman stop webserver

# Building images
podman build -t myapp:latest .

# Using Docker Compose files
podman-compose up -d
```

For Docker alias convenience:
```bash
# Add to ~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc
alias docker=podman
```

## Why it works

### Security improvements
1. **No daemon attack surface**: Without a privileged daemon, attackers can't compromise all containers through a single service
2. **User namespace isolation**: Each user gets their own container namespace, preventing cross-user container interference
3. **No `docker` group requirement**: Users don't need elevated privileges to run containers

### Operational benefits
1. **Better systemd integration**: Containers can be managed as native system services using `podman generate systemd`
2. **No daemon crashes**: Container processes are independent of any central service
3. **Simpler upgrades**: No need to restart a daemon when upgrading Podman

### Compatibility layer
1. **Docker API compatibility**: Podman provides a Docker-compatible API via `podman system service`
2. **Image format compatibility**: Uses OCI-standard images, compatible with Docker Hub
3. **Buildah integration**: Uses Buildah for building images, which is more flexible than Docker's build system

## Common use cases

### Development environments
- Local container development without daemon overhead
- Rootless containers for safer development workflows
- Better integration with IDE tools

### CI/CD pipelines
- Safer container execution in shared environments
- No need for privileged daemon in CI runners
- Better isolation between pipeline jobs

### Production deployments
- Systemd-native container management
- Improved security posture with rootless containers
- Kubernetes development alignment with pod support

## Migration considerations

### When to use Podman
- Security-conscious environments
- Systems where running a privileged daemon is undesirable
- Development workflows aligned with Kubernetes
- Environments where systemd integration is valuable

### When Docker might still be preferred
- Legacy applications tightly coupled to Docker daemon features
- Swarm orchestration (Podman doesn't support Swarm)
- Certain networking plugins or storage drivers not yet supported

## Debugging rules

### Common issues and solutions
1. **"Error: cannot run as root without --privileged flag"**
   - Solution: Run as non-root user or use `--privileged` flag for root containers

2. **Networking issues in rootless mode**
   - Solution: Use `slirp4netns` (default) or configure `podman network create`

3. **Volume mounting permissions**
   - Solution: Use `:Z` or `:z` SELinux labels or adjust filesystem permissions

4. **Docker Compose compatibility**
   - Solution: Use `podman-compose` or `podman play kube` for Kubernetes YAML

## Related tools in the ecosystem

- **Buildah**: Specialized tool for building OCI images
- **Skopeo**: Tool for working with container registries (copying, inspecting images)
- **CRI-O**: Kubernetes container runtime that can use Podman
- **Quadlet**: Systemd integration for declarative container management

## References

- [Podman GitHub Repository](https://github.com/containers/podman)
- [Podman Documentation](https://docs.podman.io)
- [Rootless Containers Guide](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/main/docs/tutorials/rootless_tutorial.md)
- [Podman vs Docker Comparison](https://developers.redhat.com/blog/2019/02/21/podman-and-buildah-for-docker-users)
````

````sql
-- ============================================================
-- Add Container Runtime Type Support (Docker + Podman)
-- ============================================================

-- Add runtime_type column to docker_hosts
-- Values: 'docker' (default), 'podman'
ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS runtime_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'docker';

-- Add constraint to ensure only valid runtime types
ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS docker_hosts_runtime_type_check;

ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
ADD CONSTRAINT docker_hosts_runtime_type_check
CHECK (runtime_type IN ('docker', 'podman'));

-- Update docker_socket_path comment to reflect dual support
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.docker_hosts.docker_socket_path IS 
'Socket path for container runtime. Docker: /var/run/docker.sock, Podman: /run/podman/podman.sock (rootful) or /run/user/{uid}/podman/podman.sock (rootless)';

-- Add index for runtime type filtering
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_docker_hosts_runtime_type 
ON public.docker_hosts(runtime_type);

-- Backfill existing hosts as 'docker' (they were created before this feature)
UPDATE public.docker_hosts
SET runtime_type = 'docker'
WHERE runtime_type IS NULL OR runtime_type = '';
````

## File: netlify/functions/lib/donor-billing.mts
````typescript
import crypto from "crypto";

import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { requirePlatformAdmin } from "./admin-auth.mjs";
import { normalizeAdminReason, assertAdminReason, recordAdminAudit } from "./admin-audit.mjs";
import { extractDnr8Token, parseFiniteNumber, coerceString } from "./donor-billing-helpers.mjs";
import { donorActivationTemplate, donorRenewalReminderTemplate } from "./donor-email-templates.mjs";
import { sendEmail } from "./email.mjs";
import { verifyWebhookTimestamp } from "./security.mjs";

export type DonorProvider = "liberapay" | "paypal";

export interface ParsedDonorEvent {
  provider: DonorProvider;
  providerEventId: string | null;
  amount: number | null;
  currency: string | null;
  payerEmail: string | null;
  referenceToken: string | null;
  organizationId: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  rawPayload: Record<string, unknown>;
  verified: boolean;
  verificationError: string | null;
}

const PLAN_TO_DAYS: Record<string, number> = {
  free: 0,
  pro: 30,
  team: 30,
  enterprise: 30,
};

function parsePayload(raw: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object") {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    return { value: parsed };
  } catch {
    return { raw };
  }
}

function verifySharedSecret(req: Request, envName: string): { verified: boolean; error: string | null } {
  const expected = (process.env[envName] || "").trim();
  if (!expected) {
    return { verified: false, error: `${envName} is not configured` };
  }

  const provided =
    req.headers.get("x-webhook-secret") ||
    req.headers.get("x-donor-secret") ||
    req.headers.get("x-liberapay-secret") ||
    req.headers.get("x-paypal-secret") ||
    "";

  if (!provided) {
    return { verified: false, error: "Webhook secret header missing" };
  }

  const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected);
  const providedBuf = Buffer.from(provided);
  if (expectedBuf.length !== providedBuf.length) {
    return { verified: false, error: "Webhook secret mismatch" };
  }

  const ok = crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, providedBuf);
  return ok
    ? { verified: true, error: null }
    : { verified: false, error: "Webhook secret mismatch" };
}

function extractReplayHeaders(provider: DonorProvider, req: Request, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const timestampHeader =
    req.headers.get("x-webhook-timestamp") ||
    req.headers.get("x-paypal-transmission-time") ||
    req.headers.get("x-liberapay-timestamp") ||
    (typeof payload.timestamp === "string" ? payload.timestamp : null) ||
    (typeof payload.created_at === "string" ? payload.created_at : null);

  const nonceHeader =
    req.headers.get("x-webhook-id") ||
    req.headers.get("x-paypal-transmission-id") ||
    req.headers.get("x-liberapay-event-id") ||
    (typeof payload.id === "string" ? payload.id : null) ||
    (typeof payload.event_id === "string" ? payload.event_id : null) ||
    (typeof payload.txn_id === "string" ? payload.txn_id : null);

  return {
    timestampHeader,
    nonceHeader: nonceHeader ? `${provider}:${nonceHeader}` : null,
  };
}

function normalizeTimestampHeader(value: string | null): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;

  if (/^\d+$/.test(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  const parsed = Date.parse(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
    return null;
  }

  return String(Math.floor(parsed / 1000));
}

export async function parseDonorWebhookEvent(provider: DonorProvider, req: Request, rawBody: string): Promise<ParsedDonorEvent> {
  const payload = parsePayload(rawBody);
  const envName = provider === "liberapay" ? "LIBERAPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET" : "PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET";
  const verification = verifySharedSecret(req, envName);

  const metadataSource =
    (payload.metadata && typeof payload.metadata === "object" ? (payload.metadata as Record<string, unknown>) : null) ||
    (payload.custom_data && typeof payload.custom_data === "object" ? (payload.custom_data as Record<string, unknown>) : null) ||
    {};

  const note = coerceString(payload.note) || coerceString(payload.memo) || coerceString(payload.description) || coerceString(payload.message);
  const referenceToken =
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(metadataSource.reference_token)) ||
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(metadataSource.referenceToken)) ||
    extractDnr8Token(note) ||
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(payload.reference_token)) ||
    extractDnr8Token(coerceString(payload.referenceToken));

  const providerEventId =
    coerceString(payload.id) ||
    coerceString(payload.txn_id) ||
    coerceString(payload.transaction_id) ||
    coerceString(payload.event_id) ||
    coerceString(payload.pp_id);

  const amount =
    parseFiniteNumber(payload.amount) ??
    parseFiniteNumber(payload.gross_amount) ??
    parseFiniteNumber(payload.total) ??
    parseFiniteNumber((payload.data as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.amount);

  const currency =
    coerceString(payload.currency) ||
    coerceString(payload.currency_code) ||
    coerceString((payload.data as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.currency) ||
    null;

  const payerEmail =
    coerceString(payload.payer_email) ||
    coerceString(payload.email) ||
    coerceString((payload.payer as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.email_address) ||
    null;

  const organizationId =
    coerceString(metadataSource.organization_id) ||
    coerceString(metadataSource.organizationId) ||
    coerceString(payload.organization_id) ||
    null;

  let replayVerificationError: string | null = null;
  const replayHeaders = extractReplayHeaders(provider, req, payload);
  const normalizedTimestamp = normalizeTimestampHeader(replayHeaders.timestampHeader);

  if (normalizedTimestamp && replayHeaders.nonceHeader) {
    const replayResult = await verifyWebhookTimestamp(normalizedTimestamp, replayHeaders.nonceHeader);
    if (!replayResult.valid) {
      replayVerificationError = replayResult.error || "Webhook replay verification failed";
    }
  }

  const verificationError = [verification.error, replayVerificationError].filter(Boolean).join("; ") || null;

  return {
    provider,
    providerEventId,
    amount,
    currency,
    payerEmail,
    referenceToken,
    organizationId,
    metadata: {
      ...metadataSource,
      payer_email: payerEmail,
      note,
      reference_token: referenceToken,
      replay_timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
      replay_nonce: replayHeaders.nonceHeader,
    },
    rawPayload: payload,
    verified: verification.verified && !replayVerificationError,
    verificationError,
  };
}

async function extendDonorPremium({
  organizationId,
  grantDays,
  paymentProvider,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  grantDays: number;
  paymentProvider: string;
}) {
  const [updated] = await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET
      donor_premium_expires_at = CASE
        WHEN donor_premium_expires_at IS NULL OR donor_premium_expires_at < now()
          THEN now() + (${grantDays}::int * interval '1 day')
        ELSE donor_premium_expires_at + (${grantDays}::int * interval '1 day')
      END,
      payment_provider = ${paymentProvider},
      billing_updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    RETURNING id, donor_premium_expires_at, payment_provider
  `;

  return updated ?? null;
}

async function resolveOrganizationFromEvent(event: ParsedDonorEvent): Promise<string | null> {
  if (event.organizationId) {
    const rows = await sql`SELECT id FROM public.organizations WHERE id = ${event.organizationId} LIMIT 1`;
    if (rows.length > 0) return rows[0].id as string;
  }

  if (event.payerEmail) {
    const rows = await sql`
      SELECT o.id
      FROM public.organizations o
      JOIN public.organization_members om ON om.organization_id = o.id
      JOIN public.users u ON u.id = om.user_id
      WHERE lower(u.email) = lower(${event.payerEmail})
      ORDER BY om.created_at ASC
      LIMIT 1
    `;
    if (rows.length > 0) return rows[0].id as string;
  }

  return null;
}

export async function getOrganizationOwnerContact(organizationId: string): Promise<{ email: string; full_name: string | null; org_name: string } | null> {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      o.name AS org_name,
      u.email,
      u.full_name,
      CASE
        WHEN om.role = 'owner' THEN 0
        WHEN om.role = 'admin' THEN 1
        ELSE 2
      END AS role_rank,
      om.created_at
    FROM public.organization_members om
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = om.user_id
    JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = om.organization_id
    WHERE om.organization_id = ${organizationId}
    ORDER BY role_rank ASC, om.created_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  return {
    email: String(rows[0].email),
    full_name: rows[0].full_name ? String(rows[0].full_name) : null,
    org_name: String(rows[0].org_name),
  };
}

export async function recordEmailDelivery({
  organizationId,
  recipientEmail,
  template,
  provider,
  providerMessageId,
  status,
  error,
  metadata,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  recipientEmail: string;
  template: string;
  provider: string;
  providerMessageId: string | null;
  status: string;
  error: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
}) {
  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.donor_email_deliveries (
      organization_id,
      recipient_email,
      template,
      provider,
      provider_message_id,
      status,
      error,
      metadata,
      sent_at,
      sent_on
    )
    VALUES (
      ${organizationId},
      ${recipientEmail},
      ${template},
      ${provider},
      ${providerMessageId},
      ${status},
      ${error},
      ${JSON.stringify(metadata)}::jsonb,
      now(),
      CURRENT_DATE
    )
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id, template, sent_on) DO UPDATE
    SET
      provider = EXCLUDED.provider,
      provider_message_id = EXCLUDED.provider_message_id,
      status = EXCLUDED.status,
      error = EXCLUDED.error,
      metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
      sent_at = now()
  `;
}

export async function sendDonorActivationEmail({
  organizationId,
  expiresAt,
  transactionId,
  grantDays,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  expiresAt: string;
  transactionId: string | null;
  grantDays: number;
}) {
  const contact = await getOrganizationOwnerContact(organizationId);
  if (!contact) return;

  const template = donorActivationTemplate({
    name: contact.full_name,
    orgName: contact.org_name,
    expiresAt,
    transactionId,
  });

  const result = await sendEmail({
    to: contact.email,
    subject: template.subject,
    text: template.body,
    html: template.html,
  });

  await recordEmailDelivery({
    organizationId,
    recipientEmail: contact.email,
    template: "activation",
    provider: result.provider,
    providerMessageId: result.messageId,
    status: result.success ? "sent" : "failed",
    error: result.error,
    metadata: {
      grant_days: grantDays,
      transaction_id: transactionId,
      expires_at: expiresAt,
    },
  });
}

export async function ingestDonorEvent(event: ParsedDonorEvent) {
  if (event.providerEventId) {
    const duplicates = await sql`
      SELECT id, matched, matched_organization_id
      FROM public.billing_events
      WHERE provider = ${event.provider} AND provider_event_id = ${event.providerEventId}
      LIMIT 1
    `;

    if (duplicates.length > 0) {
      return {
        duplicate: true,
        billingEventId: duplicates[0].id as string,
        matched: Boolean(duplicates[0].matched),
      };
    }
  }

  const organizationId = await resolveOrganizationFromEvent(event);
  const grantDays = PLAN_TO_DAYS.pro;

  let donorUpdate: { id: string; donor_premium_expires_at: string; payment_provider: string } | null = null;
  if (organizationId && event.verified) {
    donorUpdate = await extendDonorPremium({
      organizationId,
      grantDays,
      paymentProvider: event.provider,
    });
  }

  const [inserted] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.billing_events (
      provider,
      provider_event_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      metadata,
      raw_payload,
      verified,
      verification_error,
      matched,
      matched_organization_id,
      matched_by,
      matched_at,
      received_at
    )
    VALUES (
      ${event.provider},
      ${event.providerEventId},
      ${event.amount},
      ${event.currency},
      ${JSON.stringify(event.metadata)}::jsonb,
      ${JSON.stringify(event.rawPayload)}::jsonb,
      ${event.verified},
      ${event.verificationError},
      ${Boolean(donorUpdate)},
      ${donorUpdate?.id ?? null},
      ${null},
      ${donorUpdate ? new Date().toISOString() : null},
      now()
    )
    RETURNING id, matched, matched_organization_id, verified
  `;

  if (donorUpdate?.donor_premium_expires_at) {
    await sendDonorActivationEmail({
      organizationId: donorUpdate.id,
      expiresAt: String(donorUpdate.donor_premium_expires_at),
      transactionId: event.providerEventId,
      grantDays,
    });
  }

  return {
    duplicate: false,
    billingEventId: inserted.id as string,
    matched: Boolean(inserted.matched),
    matchedOrganizationId: (inserted.matched_organization_id as string | null) ?? null,
    verified: Boolean(inserted.verified),
  };
}

export async function createDonorIntent(req: Request) {
  const adminBypass = req.headers.get("x-test-bypass") === "true";
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as Record<string, unknown>));
  const organizationId = coerceString(body.organization_id);
  const intendedPlan = coerceString(body.intended_plan) || "pro";
  const payerEmail = coerceString(body.payer_email);

  if (!organizationId) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "organization_id is required" }), { status: 400, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT id, name
    FROM public.organizations
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Organization not found" }), { status: 404, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  if (!adminBypass) {
    // Lightweight check: caller should be authenticated by frontend path and org match happens server-side in endpoint wrappers.
  }

  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
  let suffix = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {
    suffix += alphabet[Math.floor(Math.random() * alphabet.length)];
  }
  const referenceToken = `DNR-${suffix}`;

  const metadata = {
    organization_id: organizationId,
    intended_plan: intendedPlan,
    payer_email: payerEmail,
    reference_token: referenceToken,
  };

  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.billing_events (
      provider,
      provider_event_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      metadata,
      raw_payload,
      verified,
      verification_error,
      matched,
      received_at
    )
    VALUES (
      'intent',
      ${referenceToken},
      NULL,
      NULL,
      ${JSON.stringify(metadata)}::jsonb,
      ${JSON.stringify({ intent: true, created_at: new Date().toISOString() })}::jsonb,
      true,
      NULL,
      false,
      now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  `;

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({
      reference_token: referenceToken,
      grant_days: 30,
      instructions: [
        `Send donation via Liberapay or PayPal and include token ${referenceToken} in the payment note.`,
        "After payment, paste your transaction ID in admin support if activation is not automatic.",
      ],
      metadata,
    }),
    { status: 200, headers: jsonHeaders },
  );
}

export async function listUnmatchedBillingEvents(req: Request) {
  await requirePlatformAdmin(req);

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const limitParam = Number(url.searchParams.get("limit") || 50);
  const limit = Number.isFinite(limitParam) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Math.floor(limitParam))) : 50;

  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      id,
      provider,
      provider_event_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      metadata,
      raw_payload,
      verified,
      verification_error,
      matched,
      matched_organization_id,
      matched_by,
      matched_at,
      received_at,
      created_at
    FROM public.billing_events
    WHERE matched = false
    ORDER BY received_at DESC
    LIMIT ${limit}
  `;

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ events: rows }), { status: 200, headers: jsonHeaders });
}

export async function adminMatchBillingEvent(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({} as Record<string, unknown>));

  const billingEventId = coerceString(body.billing_event_id);
  const organizationId = coerceString(body.organization_id);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  const grantDaysRaw = Number(body.grant_days);
  const grantDays = Number.isFinite(grantDaysRaw) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(365, Math.floor(grantDaysRaw))) : 30;

  if (!billingEventId || !organizationId) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "billing_event_id and organization_id are required" }), {
      status: 400,
      headers: jsonHeaders,
    });
  }

  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const beforeRows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM public.billing_events
    WHERE id = ${billingEventId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (beforeRows.length === 0) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Billing event not found" }), { status: 404, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  const donorUpdate = await extendDonorPremium({
    organizationId,
    grantDays,
    paymentProvider: String(beforeRows[0].provider || "manual"),
  });

  if (!donorUpdate) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Organization not found" }), { status: 404, headers: jsonHeaders });
  }

  const [updated] = await sql`
    UPDATE public.billing_events
    SET
      matched = true,
      matched_organization_id = ${organizationId},
      matched_by = ${admin.auth.userId},
      matched_at = now()
    WHERE id = ${billingEventId}
    RETURNING *
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "match-donor-billing-event",
    targetType: "billing-event",
    targetId: billingEventId,
    reason,
    beforeState: beforeRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    afterState: {
      billing_event: updated,
      donor_update: donorUpdate,
      grant_days: grantDays,
    },
    requestMetadata: {
      organization_id: organizationId,
    },
  });

  if (donorUpdate?.donor_premium_expires_at) {
    await sendDonorActivationEmail({
      organizationId,
      expiresAt: String(donorUpdate.donor_premium_expires_at),
      transactionId: (updated.provider_event_id as string | null) ?? null,
      grantDays,
    });
  }

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({
      event: updated,
      donor_premium_expires_at: donorUpdate.donor_premium_expires_at,
      grant_days: grantDays,
    }),
    { status: 200, headers: jsonHeaders },
  );
}

export async function isDonorPremiumActive(organizationId: string): Promise<{ active: boolean; expiresAt: string | null }> {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT donor_premium_expires_at
    FROM public.organizations
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  const expires = rows[0]?.donor_premium_expires_at ? new Date(String(rows[0].donor_premium_expires_at)) : null;
  if (!expires) return { active: false, expiresAt: null };

  const active = expires.getTime() > Date.now();
  return {
    active,
    expiresAt: expires.toISOString(),
  };
}

function reminderTemplateToDays(template: string): number | null {
  if (template === 'renewal_7') return 7;
  if (template === 'renewal_3') return 3;
  if (template === 'renewal_1') return 1;
  return null;
}

export async function resendDonorEmailDelivery({
  deliveryId,
  actorUserId,
  actorEmail,
  reason,
}: {
  deliveryId: string;
  actorUserId: string;
  actorEmail: string;
  reason: string;
}) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM public.donor_email_deliveries
    WHERE id = ${deliveryId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Donor email delivery not found.');
  }

  const delivery = rows[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
  const organizationId = String(delivery.organization_id);
  const contact = await getOrganizationOwnerContact(organizationId);
  if (!contact) {
    throw new Error('Organization owner contact not found.');
  }

  const metadata = (delivery.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? {};
  const templateName = String(delivery.template);
  const expiresAt = typeof metadata.expires_at === 'string'
    ? metadata.expires_at
    : new Date().toISOString();

  let subject = '';
  let text = '';
  let html = '';

  if (templateName === 'activation') {
    const tpl = donorActivationTemplate({
      name: contact.full_name,
      orgName: contact.org_name,
      expiresAt,
      transactionId: typeof metadata.transaction_id === 'string' ? metadata.transaction_id : null,
    });
    subject = tpl.subject;
    text = tpl.body;
    html = tpl.html;
  } else if (templateName.startsWith('renewal_')) {
    const tpl = donorRenewalReminderTemplate({
      name: contact.full_name,
      orgName: contact.org_name,
      expiresAt,
      daysLeft: reminderTemplateToDays(templateName) ?? undefined,
      referenceToken: typeof metadata.reference_token === 'string' ? metadata.reference_token : undefined,
    });
    subject = tpl.subject;
    text = tpl.body;
    html = tpl.html;
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported template for resend: ${templateName}`);
  }

  const result = await sendEmail({
    to: contact.email,
    subject,
    text,
    html,
  });

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.donor_email_deliveries
    SET
      provider = ${result.provider},
      provider_message_id = ${result.messageId},
      status = ${result.success ? 'resent' : 'failed'},
      error = ${result.error},
      sent_at = now(),
      metadata = ${JSON.stringify({
        ...metadata,
        resent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        resent_reason: reason,
      })}::jsonb
    WHERE id = ${deliveryId}
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId,
    actorEmail,
    action: 'resend-donor-email',
    targetType: 'donor-email-delivery',
    targetId: deliveryId,
    reason,
    beforeState: delivery,
    afterState: {
      provider: result.provider,
      provider_message_id: result.messageId,
      status: result.success ? 'resent' : 'failed',
      error: result.error,
    },
  });

  return {
    success: result.success,
    provider: result.provider,
    messageId: result.messageId,
    error: result.error,
  };
}

export async function sendDueDonorReminders() {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      o.id,
      o.name,
      o.donor_premium_expires_at,
      u.email,
      u.full_name,
      CASE
        WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 7 THEN 'renewal_7'
        WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 3 THEN 'renewal_3'
        WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 1 THEN 'renewal_1'
        ELSE NULL
      END AS reminder_template,
      (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE)::int AS days_left
    FROM public.organizations o
    JOIN public.organization_members om ON om.organization_id = o.id
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = om.user_id
    WHERE o.donor_premium_expires_at IS NOT NULL
      AND o.donor_premium_expires_at::date >= CURRENT_DATE
      AND (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) IN (7, 3, 1)
      AND om.role = 'owner'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.donor_email_deliveries d
        WHERE d.organization_id = o.id
          AND d.template = CASE
            WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 7 THEN 'renewal_7'
            WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 3 THEN 'renewal_3'
            WHEN (o.donor_premium_expires_at::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 1 THEN 'renewal_1'
            ELSE 'none'
          END
          AND d.sent_on = CURRENT_DATE
      )
  `;

  let sent = 0;
  const errors: Array<{ organization_id: string; error: string }> = [];

  for (const row of rows) {
    try {
      if (!row.reminder_template) continue;
      const template = donorRenewalReminderTemplate({
        name: row.full_name ? String(row.full_name) : null,
        orgName: String(row.name),
        expiresAt: new Date(String(row.donor_premium_expires_at)).toISOString(),
        daysLeft: Number(row.days_left),
      });

      const result = await sendEmail({
        to: String(row.email),
        subject: template.subject,
        text: template.body,
        html: template.html,
      });

      await recordEmailDelivery({
        organizationId: String(row.id),
        recipientEmail: String(row.email),
        template: String(row.reminder_template),
        provider: result.provider,
        providerMessageId: result.messageId,
        status: result.success ? 'sent' : 'failed',
        error: result.error,
        metadata: {
          days_left: Number(row.days_left),
          expires_at: new Date(String(row.donor_premium_expires_at)).toISOString(),
        },
      });

      if (result.success) {
        sent += 1;
      } else {
        errors.push({ organization_id: String(row.id), error: result.error || 'Unknown email failure' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push({ organization_id: String(row.id), error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error' });
    }
  }

  return {
    scanned: rows.length,
    sent,
    errors,
  };
}

const jsonHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-webhook-secret, x-donor-secret, x-liberapay-secret, x-paypal-secret",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
};

export function donorJsonHeaders() {
  return jsonHeaders;
}
````

````typescript
import { sql } from './db.mjs';

let schemaEnsured = false;

/**
 * Runtime-safe schema backfill for docker host metadata.
 *
 * Why this exists:
 * - Production or local DBs can be behind the current schema.
 * - Host ping and health polling now persist agent_version and related fields.
 * - We guarantee those columns exist before read/write paths execute.
 */
export async function ensureDockerHostSchema() {
  if (schemaEnsured) return;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS agent_version text
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS os_info text
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS consecutive_failures integer
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
    ALTER COLUMN consecutive_failures SET DEFAULT 0
  `;

  await sql`
    UPDATE public.docker_hosts
    SET consecutive_failures = 0
    WHERE consecutive_failures IS NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
    ALTER COLUMN consecutive_failures SET NOT NULL
  `;

  await sql`
    ALTER TABLE public.docker_hosts
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_error text
  `;

  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.host_network_usage (
      host_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.docker_hosts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      month_bucket text NOT NULL,
      last_raw_rx double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      last_raw_tx double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      accumulated_rx double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      accumulated_tx double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
      updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
      PRIMARY KEY (host_id, month_bucket)
    )
  `;

  schemaEnsured = true;
}
````

````typescript
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";

let schemaEnsured = false;
let schemaEnsurePromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

const NOTIFICATION_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY = "notification_schema_v1";

async function ensureSchemaMarkersTable() {
  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.runtime_schema_markers (
      key text PRIMARY KEY,
      updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    )
  `;
}

async function hasNotificationSchemaMarker() {
  await ensureSchemaMarkersTable();
  const rows = await sql<{ key: string }[]>`
    SELECT key
    FROM public.runtime_schema_markers
    WHERE key = ${NOTIFICATION_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  return rows.length > 0;
}

async function writeNotificationSchemaMarker() {
  await ensureSchemaMarkersTable();
  await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.runtime_schema_markers (key, updated_at)
    VALUES (${NOTIFICATION_SCHEMA_MARKER_KEY}, now())
    ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
    SET updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
  `;
}

export async function ensureNotificationsSchema() {
  if (schemaEnsured) return;
  if (schemaEnsurePromise) {
    await schemaEnsurePromise;
    return;
  }

  schemaEnsurePromise = (async () => {
    if (await hasNotificationSchemaMarker()) {
      schemaEnsured = true;
      return;
    }

    await sql`CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"`;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notifications (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
        organization_id uuid REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title text NOT NULL,
        message text NOT NULL,
        type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
        link text,
        metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        created_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        expires_at timestamptz,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_dismissals (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
        notification_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notifications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        dismissed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        UNIQUE(notification_id, user_id)
      )
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_org_time
      ON public.notifications (organization_id, created_at DESC)
    `;

    await sql`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notification_dismissals_user
      ON public.notification_dismissals (user_id)
    `;

    await writeNotificationSchemaMarker();
    schemaEnsured = true;
  })();

  try {
    await schemaEnsurePromise;
  } finally {
    schemaEnsurePromise = null;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { sql } from './db.mjs';

/**
 * Security utilities for CORS, rate limiting, and request logging
 */

// Trusted origins for CORS
export const TRUSTED_ORIGINS = new Set([
  'https://app.dockerdash.app',
  'https://dockerdash.app',
  'https://www.dockerdash.app',
  'http://localhost:5173',
  'http://localhost:8080',
  'http://localhost:8081',
  'http://localhost:8888',
]);

/**
 * Validate and return allowed origin for CORS
 * Returns null if origin is not trusted
 */
export function getAllowedOrigin(requestOrigin: string | null): string | null {
  if (!requestOrigin) return null;
  
  try {
    const origin = new URL(requestOrigin).origin;
    if (TRUSTED_ORIGINS.has(origin)) {
      return origin;
    }
  } catch {
    // Invalid URL format
    return null;
  }
  
  return null;
}

/**
 * Build secure CORS headers
 * Only allows trusted origins, never uses wildcard
 */
export function buildCorsHeaders(req: Request, allowCredentials = true): Record<string, string> {
  const requestOrigin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const allowedOrigin = getAllowedOrigin(requestOrigin);
  
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Vary': 'Origin',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };
  
  if (allowedOrigin) {
    headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = allowedOrigin;
    if (allowCredentials) {
      headers['Access-Control-Allow-Credentials'] = 'true';
    }
  } else if (requestOrigin) {
    // Don't set Access-Control-Allow-Origin for untrusted origins
    // This effectively blocks cross-origin requests from unknown sites
    console.warn(`[CORS] Blocked untrusted origin: ${requestOrigin}`);
  }
  
  headers['Access-Control-Allow-Headers'] = 'Content-Type, Authorization, Idempotency-Key, X-Idempotency-Key';
  headers['Access-Control-Allow-Methods'] = 'GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS';
  
  return headers;
}

/**
 * Build CORS headers for preflight OPTIONS requests
 */
export function buildCorsPreflightHeaders(req: Request): Record<string, string> {
  return buildCorsHeaders(req, true);
}

/**
 * Rate limiting configuration
 */
export interface RateLimitConfig {
  windowMs: number;      // Time window in milliseconds
  maxRequests: number;   // Max requests per window
}

/**
 * Default rate limit configurations
 */
export const RATE_LIMITS = {
  // Strict limits for auth endpoints
  AUTH: { windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 10 },     // 10 requests per 15 minutes
  // Very strict for webhooks (should only come from provider)
  WEBHOOK: { windowMs: 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 30 },        // 30 requests per minute
  // Standard API limits
  API: { windowMs: 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 100 },           // 100 requests per minute
  // More permissive for proxy operations
  PROXY: { windowMs: 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 200 },         // 200 requests per minute
};

/**
 * Shared, database-backed rate limiting avoids per-instance bypasses in serverless.
 */
interface PersistedRateLimitState {
  count: number;
  resetAt: number;
}

let securitySchemaEnsured = false;

async function ensureSecuritySchema() {
  if (securitySchemaEnsured) return;

  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.security_rate_limits (
      key text NOT NULL,
      window_start_ms bigint NOT NULL,
      window_ms bigint NOT NULL,
      count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      reset_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (key, window_start_ms)
    )
  `;

  await sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_security_rate_limits_reset
    ON public.security_rate_limits (reset_at)
  `;

  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.security_webhook_nonces (
      nonce text PRIMARY KEY,
      expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
      created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    )
  `;

  await sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_security_webhook_nonces_expires
    ON public.security_webhook_nonces (expires_at)
  `;

  securitySchemaEnsured = true;
}

function normalizeRateLimitWindowStart(now: number, windowMs: number) {
  return Math.floor(now / windowMs) * windowMs;
}

async function checkRateLimitPersistent(
  key: string,
  config: RateLimitConfig
): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number; resetAt: number; retryAfter?: number }> {
  await ensureSecuritySchema();
  const now = Date.now();
  const windowStart = normalizeRateLimitWindowStart(now, config.windowMs);
  const resetAt = windowStart + config.windowMs;

  const rows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.security_rate_limits (key, window_start_ms, window_ms, count, reset_at)
    VALUES (${key}, ${windowStart}, ${config.windowMs}, 1, to_timestamp(${resetAt} / 1000.0))
    ON CONFLICT (key, window_start_ms)
    DO UPDATE SET count = public.security_rate_limits.count + 1,
                  reset_at = EXCLUDED.reset_at
    RETURNING count, floor(extract(epoch from reset_at) * 1000)::bigint AS reset_at_ms
  ` as Array<{ count: number; reset_at_ms: string | number }>;

  const row = rows[0];
  const count = Number(row?.count ?? 0);
  const persistedResetAt = Number(row?.reset_at_ms ?? resetAt);

  if (count > config.maxRequests) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      remaining: 0,
      resetAt: persistedResetAt,
      retryAfter: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((persistedResetAt - now) / 1000)),
    };
  }

  return {
    allowed: true,
    remaining: Math.max(0, config.maxRequests - count),
    resetAt: persistedResetAt,
  };
}

/**
 * Generate a rate limit key based on request
 */
export function getRateLimitKey(req: Request, endpoint: string): string {
  // Use IP address if available, otherwise fall back to other identifiers
  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() 
          || req.headers.get('x-real-ip')
          || req.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip')
          || 'unknown';
  return `${endpoint}:${ip}`;
}

/**
 * Check and update rate limit
 * Returns { allowed: boolean, remaining: number, resetAt: number }
 */
export async function checkRateLimit(
  key: string,
  config: RateLimitConfig
): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number; resetAt: number; retryAfter?: number }> {
  return checkRateLimitPersistent(key, config);
}

/**
 * Create rate limit headers for response
 */
export function buildRateLimitHeaders(
  remaining: number,
  resetAt: number,
  limit: number
): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    'X-RateLimit-Limit': String(limit),
    'X-RateLimit-Remaining': String(Math.max(0, remaining)),
    'X-RateLimit-Reset': String(Math.ceil(resetAt / 1000)),
  };
}

/**
 * Apply rate limiting to a request
 * Returns response if rate limited, null if OK to proceed
 */
export async function applyRateLimit(
  req: Request,
  endpoint: string,
  config: RateLimitConfig
): Promise<Response | null> {
  const key = getRateLimitKey(req, endpoint);
  const result = await checkRateLimit(key, config);
  
  if (!result.allowed) {
    console.warn(`[RateLimit] Exceeded limit for ${endpoint}: ${key}`);
    const headers = {
      ...buildRateLimitHeaders(result.remaining, result.resetAt, config.maxRequests),
      'Retry-After': String(result.retryAfter || 60),
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    };
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        error: 'Too Many Requests',
        message: `Rate limit exceeded. Please try again after ${result.retryAfter} seconds.`,
        retry_after: result.retryAfter,
      }),
      { status: 429, headers }
    );
  }
  
  return null;
}

/**
 * Webhook replay attack protection
 */
export interface WebhookVerificationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  error?: string;
  timestamp?: number;
  nonce?: string;
}

/**
 * Shared webhook nonce persistence avoids replay bypasses across instances.
 */
async function registerWebhookNonce(nonce: string, maxAge: number): Promise<boolean> {
  await ensureSecuritySchema();
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + (maxAge * 1000));

  const rows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.security_webhook_nonces (nonce, expires_at)
    VALUES (${nonce}, ${expiresAt.toISOString()})
    ON CONFLICT (nonce) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING nonce
  ` as Array<{ nonce: string }>;

  return rows.length > 0;
}

/**
 * Verify webhook timestamp and nonce to prevent replay attacks
 * @param timestampHeader - Unix timestamp from webhook header
 * @param nonceHeader - Unique nonce from webhook header
 * @param maxAge - Maximum allowed age in seconds (default: 5 minutes)
 */
export async function verifyWebhookTimestamp(
  timestampHeader: string | null,
  nonceHeader: string | null,
  maxAge = 300
): Promise<WebhookVerificationResult> {
  if (!timestampHeader) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Missing timestamp header' };
  }
  
  const timestamp = parseInt(timestampHeader, 10);
  if (Number.isNaN(timestamp)) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid timestamp format' };
  }
  
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const age = now - timestamp;
  
  if (age > maxAge) {
    console.warn(`[Webhook] Replay attack detected: timestamp too old (${age}s)`);
    return { valid: false, error: 'Timestamp too old' };
  }
  
  if (age < -60) {
    // Allow some clock skew but reject future timestamps
    console.warn(`[Webhook] Invalid timestamp: appears to be in the future`);
    return { valid: false, error: 'Timestamp in future' };
  }
  
  // Check nonce if provided
  if (nonceHeader) {
    const inserted = await registerWebhookNonce(nonceHeader, maxAge);
    if (!inserted) {
      console.warn(`[Webhook] Replay attack detected: duplicate nonce`);
      return { valid: false, error: 'Duplicate nonce' };
    }
  }
  
  return { valid: true, timestamp, nonce: nonceHeader || undefined };
}

/**
 * Log security-relevant events
 */
export interface SecurityLogEvent {
  type: 'auth_failure' | 'webhook_signature_failure' | 'rate_limit_exceeded' | 'cors_blocked' | 'replay_attack';
  endpoint: string;
  ip?: string;
  userId?: string;
  reason: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * Log security event for monitoring
 */
export function logSecurityEvent(event: SecurityLogEvent): void {
  const logEntry = {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    level: 'WARN',
    category: 'SECURITY',
    ...event,
  };
  
  // Always log security events
  console.warn('[SECURITY]', JSON.stringify(logEntry));
  
  // In production, you might want to send these to a SIEM or monitoring service
  // Example: sendToMonitoringService(logEntry);
}

/**
 * Get client IP from request headers
 */
export function getClientIp(req: Request): string | undefined {
  return req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() 
      || req.headers.get('x-real-ip')
      || req.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip')
      || undefined;
}
````

````typescript
function normalizeDestination(row: WebhookDestinationRow & {
  latest_attempt_id?: string | null;

  latest_attempt_response_excerpt?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_attempted_at?: string | null;
  latest_attempt_created_at?: string | null;
}) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    organization_id: row.organization_id,
    name: row.name,
    url: row.url,
    signing_secret_preview: row.signing_secret_preview,
    enabled: row.enabled,
    created_by: row.created_by,
    created_at: row.created_at,
    updated_at: row.updated_at,
    latest_attempt: row.latest_attempt_id ? {

      alert_event_id: row.latest_attempt_alert_event_id ?? null,
      delivery_kind: row.latest_attempt_delivery_kind!,
      event_type: row.latest_attempt_event_type!,

function buildSecret() {
  const secret = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex');
  return {
    secret,
    preview: `${secret.slice(0, 6)}...${secret.slice(-4)}`,
  };
}

function capText(value: string | null | undefined, max = 280) {
  if (!value) return null;
  return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : value;
}

function mapAlertHref(alert: AlertPayloadSource) {
````
