        ? metadata.container_id.slice(0, 12)
        : null;
  if ((alert.source_type === 'container' || alert.source_type === 'metric') && containerShortId && hostId) return `/app/containers/${containerShortId}?host=${hostId}`;
  if (hostId) return `/app/hosts/${hostId}`;
  return '/app/alerts';
}

function buildSignedRequestBody(destination: Pick<WebhookDestinationRow, 'signing_secret'>, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', destination.signing_secret).update(`${timestamp}.${body}`).digest('hex');
  return {
    body,
    timestamp,
    signature: `sha256=${signature}`,
  };
}

async function recordAttempt(params: {
  organizationId: string;
  destinationId: string;
  alertEventId?: string | null;
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test';
  eventType: string;
  succeeded: boolean;
  httpStatus?: number | null;
  errorSummary?: string | null;
  responseExcerpt?: string | null;
}) {
  const [attempt] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO alert_delivery_attempts (
      organization_id, webhook_destination_id, alert_event_id, delivery_kind,
      event_type, succeeded, http_status, error_summary, response_excerpt
    )
    VALUES (
      ${params.organizationId}, ${params.destinationId}, ${params.alertEventId ?? null}, ${params.deliveryKind},
      ${params.eventType}, ${params.succeeded}, ${params.httpStatus ?? null}, ${params.errorSummary ?? null}, ${params.responseExcerpt ?? null}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return attempt as DeliveryAttemptRow;
}

const DISCORD_URL_RE = /^https:\/\/(?:discord\.com|discordapp\.com)\/api\/webhooks\//;

function isDiscordUrl(url: string) {
  return DISCORD_URL_RE.test(url);
}

const SEVERITY_COLORS: Record<string, number> = {
  critical: 0xef4444, // red
  warning:  0xf59e0b, // amber
  info:     0x3b82f6, // blue
  ok:       0x22c55e, // green
};

function buildDiscordBody(payload: Record<string, unknown>, eventType: DeliveryEventType) {
  const alert = (payload.alert ?? payload.sample ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const severity = String(alert.severity ?? 'info').toLowerCase();
  const status   = String(alert.status ?? eventType);
  const title    = String(alert.title ?? 'Docker Dashboard Alert');
  const message  = String(alert.message ?? '');
  const href     = typeof alert.href === 'string' ? alert.href : null;

  const color = SEVERITY_COLORS[severity] ?? 0x6366f1; // indigo fallback

  const fields: Array<{ name: string; value: string; inline: boolean }> = [
    { name: 'Event',    value: `\`${eventType}\``, inline: true },
    { name: 'Severity', value: severity,           inline: true },
    { name: 'Status',   value: status,             inline: true },
  ];

  if (alert.source_type)  fields.push({ name: 'Source', value: String(alert.source_type), inline: true });
  if (alert.source_ref)   fields.push({ name: 'Ref',    value: `\`${String(alert.source_ref)}\``, inline: true });

  const embed: Record<string, unknown> = {
    title,
    description: message || undefined,
    color,
    fields,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    footer: { text: 'Docker Dashboard' },
  };

  if (href) {
    const base = process.env.URL || 'https://app.dockerdash.app';
    embed.url = href.startsWith('http') ? href : `${base}${href}`;
  }

  return JSON.stringify({ embeds: [embed] });
}

async function dispatchWebhook(
  destination: WebhookDestinationRow,
  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
  eventType: DeliveryEventType,
  deliveryKind: 'alert' | 'test',
  alertEventId?: string | null,
) {
  const discord = isDiscordUrl(destination.url);

  // Build request body — Discord gets embeds, everything else gets signed payload
  let body: string;
  let headers: Record<string, string>;

  if (discord) {
    body = buildDiscordBody(payload, eventType);
    headers = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'DockerDash-Webhooks/1.0',
    };
  } else {
    const signed = buildSignedRequestBody(destination, payload);
    body = signed.body;
    headers = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'DockerDash-Webhooks/1.0',
      'X-DockerDash-Event': eventType,
      'X-DockerDash-Timestamp': signed.timestamp,
      'X-DockerDash-Signature': signed.signature,
    };
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetch(destination.url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers,
      body,
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    const responseText = capText(await response.text());
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: response.ok,
      httpStatus: response.status,
      errorSummary: response.ok ? null : capText(response.statusText || 'Webhook responded with non-2xx status'),
      responseExcerpt: responseText,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return recordAttempt({
      organizationId: destination.organization_id,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      alertEventId,
      deliveryKind,
      eventType,
      succeeded: false,
      errorSummary: capText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Webhook request failed'),
    });
  }
}

async function getDestinationForOrg(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM webhook_destinations
    WHERE id = ${destinationId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  return (rows[0] as WebhookDestinationRow | undefined) ?? null;
}

export async function listWebhookDestinations(auth: AppAuthContext) {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      d.*,
      a.id AS latest_attempt_id,
      a.organization_id AS latest_attempt_org_id,
      a.webhook_destination_id AS latest_attempt_destination_id,
      a.alert_event_id AS latest_attempt_alert_event_id,
      a.delivery_kind AS latest_attempt_delivery_kind,
      a.event_type AS latest_attempt_event_type,
      a.succeeded AS latest_attempt_succeeded,
      a.http_status AS latest_attempt_http_status,
      a.error_summary AS latest_attempt_error_summary,
      a.response_excerpt AS latest_attempt_response_excerpt,
      a.attempted_at AS latest_attempt_attempted_at,
      a.created_at AS latest_attempt_created_at
    FROM webhook_destinations d
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT *
      FROM alert_delivery_attempts
      WHERE webhook_destination_id = d.id
      ORDER BY attempted_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) a ON true
    WHERE d.organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  `;

  return rows.map((row) => normalizeDestination(row as any));
}

export async function createWebhookDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { name: string; url: string; enabled?: boolean },
) {
  const destinationUrl = normalizeAndValidateWebhookUrl(values.url);
  const { secret, preview } = buildSecret();
  const [row] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO webhook_destinations (
      organization_id, name, url, signing_secret, signing_secret_preview, enabled, created_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${auth.orgId}, ${values.name}, ${destinationUrl}, ${secret}, ${preview}, ${values.enabled ?? true}, ${auth.userId}
    )
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return {
    destination: normalizeDestination(row as any),
    signing_secret: secret,
  };
}

export async function updateWebhookDestination(
  auth: AppAuthContext,
  values: { id: string; name?: string; url?: string; enabled?: boolean; regenerate_secret?: boolean },
) {
  const existing = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, values.id);
  if (!existing) throw new Error('Webhook destination not found');

  const secretState = values.regenerate_secret ? buildSecret() : {
    secret: existing.signing_secret,
    preview: existing.signing_secret_preview,
  };
  const nextUrl = values.url ? normalizeAndValidateWebhookUrl(values.url) : existing.url;

  const [row] = await sql`
    UPDATE webhook_destinations
    SET
      name = ${values.name ?? existing.name},
      url = ${nextUrl},
      enabled = ${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, 'enabled') ? values.enabled : existing.enabled},
      signing_secret = ${secretState.secret},
      signing_secret_preview = ${secretState.preview}
    WHERE id = ${values.id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    RETURNING *
  `;

  return {
    destination: normalizeDestination(row as any),
    signing_secret: values.regenerate_secret ? secretState.secret : undefined,
  };
}

export async function sendWebhookDestinationTest(auth: AppAuthContext, destinationId: string) {
  const destination = await getDestinationForOrg(auth, destinationId);
  if (!destination) throw new Error('Webhook destination not found');

  const payload = {
    event_type: 'alert.test',
    sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    organization_id: auth.orgId,
    destination_id: destination.id,
    sample: {
      severity: 'warning',
      status: 'open',
      title: 'Webhook test from Docker Dashboard',
      message: 'This is a signed test delivery from your alert webhook configuration.',
      href: '/app/settings?tab=Webhooks',
    },
  };

  return dispatchWebhook(destination, payload, 'alert.test', 'test', null);
}

export async function deliverAlertWebhooks(auth: AppAuthContext, alert: AlertPayloadSource, eventType: DeliveryEventType) {
  if (!alert.rule_id) return [];

  const ruleRows = await sql`
    SELECT notification_channels
    FROM alert_rules
    WHERE id = ${alert.rule_id} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  const channels = Array.isArray(ruleRows[0]?.notification_channels)
    ? ruleRows[0].notification_channels.filter((item: unknown): item is string => typeof item === 'string')
    : [];

  if (!channels.includes('webhook')) return [];

  const destinationRows = await sql`
    SELECT *
    FROM webhook_destinations
    WHERE organization_id = ${auth.orgId} AND enabled = true
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
  `;

  if (destinationRows.length === 0) return [];

  const payload = {
    event_type: eventType,
    organization_id: alert.organization_id,
    alert: {
      id: alert.id,
      incident_id: alert.incident_id ?? null,
      severity: alert.severity,
      status: alert.status,
      title: alert.title,
      message: alert.message,
      source_type: alert.source_type,
      source_ref: alert.source_ref,
      first_seen_at: alert.first_seen_at ?? null,
      last_seen_at: alert.last_seen_at ?? null,
      acknowledged_at: alert.acknowledged_at ?? null,
      resolved_at: alert.resolved_at ?? null,
      created_at: alert.created_at ?? null,
      updated_at: alert.updated_at ?? null,
      href: mapAlertHref(alert),
      metadata: alert.metadata ?? {},
    },
  };

  return Promise.all(
    (destinationRows as WebhookDestinationRow[]).map((destination) =>
      dispatchWebhook(destination, payload, eventType, 'alert', alert.id),
    ),
  );
}

import type { Config } from "@netlify/functions";
import { sql } from "./lib/db.mjs";
import { requireAuth } from "./lib/auth.mjs";
import { assertOrganizationNodeCapacityAvailable, assertOrganizationWriteAllowed, enforceOrganizationNodeLimit } from "./lib/access-controls.mjs";
import { decryptSecret, encryptSecret } from "./lib/crypto.mjs";
import { ensureAgentEnrollmentSchema } from "./lib/ensure-agent-enrollment-schema.mjs";
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl, normalizeAndValidateHostUrl } from "./lib/host-url.mjs";
import {
  buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentEnrollmentInstallCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentNextStepSummary,
  buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse,
  buildWatchtowerAgentSetupSummary,
  buildWatchtowerAgentVerifySummary,
  CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
  getWatchtowerAgentModeLabel,
  getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress,
  type WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
} from "../../shared/watchtower-agent-release.ts";

const headers = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
};

type SessionStatus = "created" | "claimed" | "installed" | "expired" | "cancelled";
type ReasonCode =
  | "url_unreachable"
  | "agent_unauthorized"
  | "agent_not_installed"
  | "agent_outdated"
  | "cloudflare_access_missing"
  | "metrics_unavailable";

function json(body: unknown, init: ResponseInit = {}) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    ...init,
    headers: { ...headers, ...(init.headers || {}) },
  });
}

function badRequest(error: string, code?: string, status = 400) {
  return json({ error, ...(code ? { code } : {}) }, { status });
}

function parseConnectionMode(value: unknown): WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode | null {
  return value === "agent" || value === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? value : null;
}

function hashEnrollmentToken(token: string) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");
}

function createEnrollmentToken() {
  return crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
}

function createAgentApiKey() {
  return crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
}

function trimOrDefault(value: unknown, fallback: string) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : fallback;
}

async function requireOrgAdmin(organizationId: string, userId: string, isPlatformAdmin: boolean) {
  await assertOrganizationWriteAllowed({ organizationId, isPlatformAdmin });

  const members = await sql`
    SELECT role FROM organization_members
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId} AND user_id = ${userId}
  `;

  return members.length > 0 && ["owner", "admin"].includes(members[0].role);
}

function buildAgentHeaders(options: {
  hostUrl: string;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  dockerSocketPath: string;
  agentApiKey: string | null;
  cfServiceTokenId: string | null;
  cfServiceTokenSecret: string | null;
  path: string;
}) {
  const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};

  if (options.agentApiKey) {
    reqHeaders["X-Agent-Key"] = options.agentApiKey;
  }

  if (options.dockerSocketPath && options.dockerSocketPath !== "/var/run/docker.sock") {
    reqHeaders["X-Docker-Socket"] = options.dockerSocketPath;
  }

  if (options.connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel") {
    if (options.cfServiceTokenId) {
      reqHeaders["CF-Access-Client-Id"] = options.cfServiceTokenId;
    }
    if (options.cfServiceTokenSecret) {
      reqHeaders["CF-Access-Client-Secret"] = options.cfServiceTokenSecret;
    }
  }

  return { url: buildValidatedAgentUrl(options.hostUrl, options.path), headers: reqHeaders };
}

async function fetchWithTimeout(url: string, init: RequestInit, timeoutMs = 5000) {
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs) });
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.name === "AbortError" || error?.name === "TimeoutError") {
      throw new Error("Agent connection timed out");
    }
    throw new Error(error?.message || "Agent connection failed");
  }
}

function reasonFromFailure(options: {
  status?: number;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  message?: string;
  stage: "ping" | "agent_version" | "metrics";
}): ReasonCode {
  if (options.connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" && options.status === 403) {
    return "cloudflare_access_missing";
  }
  if (options.status === 401) {
    return "agent_unauthorized";
  }
  if (options.status === 404 || options.status === 405) {
    return "agent_not_installed";
  }
  if (options.stage === "metrics") {
    return "metrics_unavailable";
  }
  return "url_unreachable";
}

function remediationForReason(
  reason: ReasonCode,
  agentApiKey: string,
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
) {
  switch (reason) {
    case "agent_outdated":
      return buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({ agentApiKey, connectionMode });
    case "metrics_unavailable":
      return buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand();
    case "agent_not_installed":
    case "agent_unauthorized":
    case "cloudflare_access_missing":
    case "url_unreachable":
    default:
      return buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand();
  }
}

async function pingEnrollmentHost(input: {
  hostId: string;
  hostUrl: string;
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  dockerSocketPath: string;
  agentApiKey: string;
  cfServiceTokenId: string | null;
  cfServiceTokenSecret: string | null;
}) {
  const common = {
    hostUrl: input.hostUrl,
    connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
    dockerSocketPath: input.dockerSocketPath,
    agentApiKey: input.agentApiKey,
    cfServiceTokenId: input.cfServiceTokenId,
    cfServiceTokenSecret: input.cfServiceTokenSecret,
  };

  try {
    const pingReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/docker/_ping" });
    const pingResp = await fetchWithTimeout(pingReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: pingReq.headers }, 5000);
    const pingText = await pingResp.text();

    if (!pingResp.ok) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        status: pingText,
        reason_code: reasonFromFailure({
          status: pingResp.status,
          connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
          message: pingText,
          stage: "ping",
        }),
      };
    }

    let dockerVersion: string | null = null;
    let osInfo: string | null = null;
    try {
      const versionReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/docker/version" });
      const versionResp = await fetchWithTimeout(versionReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: versionReq.headers }, 5000);
      if (versionResp.ok) {
        const versionData = await versionResp.json();
        dockerVersion = versionData.Version || null;
        osInfo = versionData.Os ? `${versionData.Os}/${versionData.Arch}` : null;
      }
    } catch {
      // best effort
    }

    let agentVersion: string | null = null;
    let agentVersionError: string | null = null;
    try {
      const agentReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/agent/version" });
      const agentResp = await fetchWithTimeout(agentReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: agentReq.headers }, 5000);
      if (agentResp.ok) {
        const agentData = await agentResp.json();
        agentVersion = agentData.agent_version || agentData.version || null;
      } else {
        agentVersionError = `GET /agent/version returned ${agentResp.status}`;
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      agentVersionError = error?.message || "GET /agent/version failed";
    }

    let metricsReason: ReasonCode | null = null;
    let capabilityGap = false;
    try {
      const metricsReq = buildAgentHeaders({ ...common, path: "/metrics" });
      const metricsResp = await fetchWithTimeout(metricsReq.url, { method: "GET", headers: metricsReq.headers }, 5000);
      if (!metricsResp.ok) {
        metricsReason = reasonFromFailure({
          status: metricsResp.status,
          connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
          stage: "metrics",
        });
      } else {
        const metricsData = await metricsResp.json();
        capabilityGap = !metricsData || typeof metricsData !== "object" || metricsData.uptime_seconds == null || !Array.isArray(metricsData.disks);
      }
    } catch {
      metricsReason = "metrics_unavailable";
    }

    const releaseResponse = buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(agentVersion, capabilityGap);
    const reasonCode =
      releaseResponse.agent_update_status === "update_required"
        ? "agent_outdated"
        : metricsReason;

    await sql`
      UPDATE docker_hosts
      SET status = 'connected',
          last_seen_at = now(),
          docker_version = COALESCE(${dockerVersion}, docker_version),
          agent_version = COALESCE(${agentVersion}, agent_version),
          os_info = COALESCE(${osInfo}, os_info),
          last_error = ${reasonCode},
          consecutive_failures = 0
      WHERE id = ${input.hostId}
    `;

    return {
      ok: true,
      status: pingText,
      docker_version: dockerVersion,
      agent_version: agentVersion,
      agent_version_error: agentVersionError,
      os_info: osInfo,
      connection_mode: input.connectionMode,
      reason_code: reasonCode,
      ...releaseResponse,
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    const reasonCode = reasonFromFailure({
      connectionMode: input.connectionMode,
      message: error?.message,
      stage: "ping",
    });

    await sql`
      UPDATE docker_hosts
      SET status = 'error',
          last_error = ${error?.message || reasonCode},
          consecutive_failures = COALESCE(consecutive_failures, 0) + 1
      WHERE id = ${input.hostId}
    `;

    return {
      ok: false,
      status: error?.message || "Connection failed",
      reason_code: reasonCode,
      docker_version: null,
      agent_version: null,
      agent_version_error: null,
      os_info: null,
      connection_mode: input.connectionMode,
      ...buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(null),
    };
  }
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  await ensureAgentEnrollmentSchema();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const pathname = url.pathname;

  try {
    if (req.method === "POST" && pathname.endsWith("/exchange")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
      const enrollmentToken = typeof body?.enrollment_token === "string" ? body.enrollment_token.trim() : "";
      if (!enrollmentToken) {
        return badRequest("enrollment_token is required");
      }

      const tokenHash = hashEnrollmentToken(enrollmentToken);
      const rows = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM agent_enrollment_sessions
        WHERE enrollment_token_hash = ${tokenHash}
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        return badRequest("Enrollment token is invalid or expired", "invalid_enrollment_token", 404);
      }

      const session = rows[0];
      const now = new Date();
      const expired = new Date(session.expires_at) <= now;
      if (expired) {
        await sql`
          UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
          SET status = 'expired'
          WHERE id = ${session.id}
        `;
        return badRequest("Enrollment token has expired", "expired_enrollment_token", 410);
      }

      if (session.status !== "created") {
        return badRequest("Enrollment token has already been used", "claimed_enrollment_token", 409);
      }

      await sql`
        UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
        SET status = 'claimed',
            claimed_at = now()
        WHERE id = ${session.id}
      `;

      return json({
        session_id: session.id,
        agent_api_key: decryptSecret(session.encrypted_agent_api_key, session.id, "agent_api_key"),
        expected_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version,
        bind_address: getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(session.connection_mode),
        port: "9876",
        docker_socket_path: session.docker_socket_path,
        connection_mode: session.connection_mode,
      });
    }

    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    if (!auth.orgId) {
      return badRequest("Active org required");
    }

    const isAdmin = await requireOrgAdmin(auth.orgId, auth.userId, auth.isPlatformAdmin);
    if (!isAdmin) {
      return badRequest("Admin access required for active org", undefined, 403);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && pathname.endsWith("/finalize")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
      const sessionId = typeof body?.session_id === "string" ? body.session_id.trim() : "";
      if (!sessionId) {
        return badRequest("session_id is required");
      }

      const rows = await sql`
        SELECT *
        FROM agent_enrollment_sessions
        WHERE id = ${sessionId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
        LIMIT 1
      `;

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        return badRequest("Enrollment session not found", "missing_enrollment_session", 404);
      }

      const session = rows[0];
      if (session.status === "cancelled") {
        return badRequest("Enrollment session is cancelled", "cancelled_enrollment_session", 409);
      }

      if (new Date(session.expires_at) <= new Date() && session.status !== "installed") {
        await sql`
          UPDATE agent_enrollment_sessions
          SET status = 'expired'
          WHERE id = ${session.id}
        `;
        return badRequest("Enrollment session has expired", "expired_enrollment_session", 410);
      }

      const agentApiKey = decryptSecret(session.encrypted_agent_api_key, session.id, "agent_api_key");
      const cfServiceTokenId = decryptSecret(session.encrypted_cf_service_token_id, session.id, "cf_service_token_id");
      const cfServiceTokenSecret = decryptSecret(session.encrypted_cf_service_token_secret, session.id, "cf_service_token_secret");
      if (!agentApiKey) {
        return badRequest("Enrollment session is missing an agent API key", "invalid_enrollment_session", 500);
      }

      let hostId = session.docker_host_id as string | null;
      let host;

      if (hostId) {
        const existing = await sql`
          SELECT * FROM docker_hosts
          WHERE id = ${hostId} AND organization_id = ${auth.orgId}
          LIMIT 1
        `;
        host = existing[0] || null;
      }

      if (!host) {
        await assertOrganizationNodeCapacityAvailable({
          organizationId: auth.orgId,
          isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,

            encrypted_cf_service_token_id = ${cfServiceTokenId ? encryptSecret(cfServiceTokenId, session.id, "cf_service_token_id") : null},

        enrollment_token: token,
        expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
        install_command: buildWatchtowerAgentEnrollmentInstallCommand({
          enrollmentToken: token,
          enrollUrl,
          connectionMode,
          dockerSocketPath,

export default async (req: Request) => {

        WHERE organization_id = ${targetOrgId} AND user_id = ${auth.userId}

        return false;
      }

      return true;

        `;

          SELECT h.* FROM docker_hosts h
          JOIN organization_members om ON h.organization_id = om.organization_id
          WHERE h.id = ${hostId} AND om.user_id = ${auth.userId}
        `;
        if (hosts.length === 0) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Not found' }), { status: 404, headers });

        const limitState = await enforceOrganizationNodeLimit({
          organizationId: hosts[0].organization_id,
          isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
        });

        if (!limitState.allowedHostIds.includes(hostId)) {
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({ error: 'This host is over your current plan limit. Remove extra hosts or upgrade to reactivate it.' }),
            { status: 402, headers },
          );
        }

        const includeSecrets = url.searchParams.get('includeSecrets') === 'true';
        if (!includeSecrets) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify(hosts[0]), { headers });
        }

        const isAdmin = await requireOrgAdmin(hosts[0].organization_id);
        if (!isAdmin) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Admin access required for active org' }), { status: 403, headers });
        }

        const secretsRecord = await sql`
          SELECT agent_api_key, cf_service_token_id, cf_service_token_secret
          FROM docker_host_secrets
          WHERE host_id = ${hostId}
        `;
        const secrets = decryptHostSecrets(secretsRecord[0] || null, hostId);

      }

      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(host), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      if (!hostId) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'hostId required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      await assertHostProxyAllowed({ hostId, isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin });

      const hostRecords = await sql`

        JOIN organization_members om ON h.organization_id = om.organization_id
        WHERE h.id = ${hostId} AND om.user_id = ${auth.userId}

      const host = hostRecords[0];

      if (!isAdmin) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Admin access required for active org' }), { status: 403, headers });
      }

      }

      const [updatedHost] = await sql`
        UPDATE docker_hosts
        SET
          name = ${body.name},
          host_url = ${hostUrl},
          connection_mode = ${body.connection_mode},
          docker_socket_path = ${body.docker_socket_path || '/var/run/docker.sock'},
          updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = ${hostId}
        RETURNING *
      `;

      if (body.secrets) {
        const encryptedAgentKey = body.secrets.agentApiKey ? encryptSecret(body.secrets.agentApiKey, host.id, 'agent_api_key') : null;
        const encryptedCfId = body.secrets.cfServiceTokenId ? encryptSecret(body.secrets.cfServiceTokenId, host.id, 'cf_service_token_id') : null;
        const encryptedCfSecret = body.secrets.cfServiceTokenSecret ? encryptSecret(body.secrets.cfServiceTokenSecret, host.id, 'cf_service_token_secret') : null;

        await sql`
          INSERT INTO docker_host_secrets (host_id, agent_api_key, cf_service_token_id, cf_service_token_secret)
          VALUES (${host.id}, ${encryptedAgentKey}, ${encryptedCfId}, ${encryptedCfSecret})
          ON CONFLICT (host_id)
          DO UPDATE SET
            agent_api_key = EXCLUDED.agent_api_key,
            cf_service_token_id = EXCLUDED.cf_service_token_id,

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(updatedHost), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'DELETE') {

    }

  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers });

import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { decryptHostSecrets, SecretCryptoError } from './lib/crypto.mjs';
import {
  DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD,
  parseStaleThresholdMinutes,
  staleCutoffDate,
  failureStatusForCount,
} from './lib/host-health.mjs';
import { enforceOrganizationNodeLimit } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse } from './lib/agent-release.mts';
import { ensureDockerHostSchema } from './lib/ensure-docker-host-schema.mjs';
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl } from './lib/host-url.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, x-cron-secret',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

const PING_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000

function isAuthorizedSchedulerRequest(req: Request) {
  const expectedSecret = (process.env.HEALTH_POLL_SECRET || '').trim()
  const providedSecret = (req.headers.get('x-cron-secret') || '').trim()
  const schedulerEvent = (req.headers.get('x-nf-event') || '').trim().toLowerCase()

  if (expectedSecret && providedSecret === expectedSecret) {
    return true
  }

  return schedulerEvent === 'schedule'
}

function buildPingRequest(
  host: { host_url: string; connection_mode: string; docker_socket_path: string | null },
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
) {
  const base = host.host_url.replace(/\/$/, '')
  const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = {}

  if (secrets?.agent_api_key) {
    reqHeaders['X-Agent-Key'] = secrets.agent_api_key
  }

  if (host.docker_socket_path && host.docker_socket_path !== '/var/run/docker.sock') {
    reqHeaders['X-Docker-Socket'] = host.docker_socket_path
  }

  if (host.connection_mode === 'cloudflare_tunnel') {
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_id) reqHeaders['CF-Access-Client-Id'] = secrets.cf_service_token_id
    if (secrets?.cf_service_token_secret) reqHeaders['CF-Access-Client-Secret'] = secrets.cf_service_token_secret
  }

  return {
    pingUrl: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, '/docker/_ping'),
    dockerVersionUrl: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, '/docker/version'),
    agentVersionUrl: buildValidatedAgentUrl(base, '/agent/version'),
    headers: reqHeaders
  }
}

function trimDiagnostic(value: string, maxLength = 160) {
  return value.length > maxLength ? `${value.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...` : value
}

async function fetchAgentVersionReport(
  host: { id: string; host_url: string; connection_mode: string; docker_socket_path: string | null },
  secrets: { agent_api_key?: string; cf_service_token_id?: string; cf_service_token_secret?: string } | null,
) {
  const { agentVersionUrl, headers: reqHeaders } = buildPingRequest(host, secrets)

  try {
    const agentResp = await fetch(agentVersionUrl, { headers: reqHeaders, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })
    if (!agentResp.ok) {
      const body = trimDiagnostic((await agentResp.text()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
      return {
        agentVersion: null as string | null,
        agentVersionError: trimDiagnostic(
          body
            ? `GET /agent/version returned ${agentResp.status}: ${body}`
            : `GET /agent/version returned ${agentResp.status}`,
        ),
      }
    }

    const agentData = await agentResp.json()
    const agentVersion = agentData.agent_version || agentData.version || null
    if (!agentVersion) {
      return {
        agentVersion: null as string | null,
        agentVersionError: 'GET /agent/version did not include an agent version',
      }
    }

    return { agentVersion, agentVersionError: null as string | null }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      agentVersion: null as string | null,
      agentVersionError: trimDiagnostic(`GET /agent/version failed: ${err?.message || 'Unknown error'}`),
    }
  }
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureDockerHostSchema();

    if (!isAuthorizedSchedulerRequest(req)) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401, headers })
    }

    const orgRows = await sql<Array<{ organization_id: string | null }>>`
      SELECT DISTINCT organization_id
      FROM docker_hosts
      WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL
    `;

    const allowedHostIds: string[] = [];
    for (const row of orgRows) {
      if (!row.organization_id) continue;
      const limitState = await enforceOrganizationNodeLimit({
        organizationId: row.organization_id,
        isPlatformAdmin: false,
      });
      allowedHostIds.push(...limitState.allowedHostIds);
    }

    if (allowedHostIds.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ polled: 0, message: 'No eligible hosts to poll' }), { headers });
    }

    const hosts = await sql`
      SELECT *
      FROM docker_hosts
      WHERE id = ANY(${allowedHostIds})
    `;

    const staleThresholdMinutes = parseStaleThresholdMinutes(process.env.HOST_STALE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES)
    const staleCutoff = staleCutoffDate(new Date(), staleThresholdMinutes)

    const staleUpdate = await sql`
      UPDATE docker_hosts
      SET status = 'stale'
      WHERE status = 'connected'
        AND id = ANY(${allowedHostIds})
        AND last_seen_at IS NOT NULL
        AND last_seen_at < ${staleCutoff.toISOString()}
      RETURNING id
    `

    if (hosts.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ polled: 0, message: 'No hosts to poll' }), { headers })
    }

    const results: any[] = []

    await Promise.allSettled(hosts.map(async (host) => {
      try {
        const secretsRecord = await sql`
          SELECT agent_api_key, cf_service_token_id, cf_service_token_secret 
          FROM docker_host_secrets WHERE host_id = ${host.id}
        `;
        const secrets = decryptHostSecrets(secretsRecord[0] || null, host.id);

        const { pingUrl, dockerVersionUrl, headers: reqHeaders } = buildPingRequest(host as any, secrets)

        const pingResp = await fetch(pingUrl, {
          method: 'GET',
          headers: reqHeaders,
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(PING_TIMEOUT_MS),
        })

        if (!pingResp.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Ping returned ${pingResp.status}: ${await pingResp.text()}`)
        }
        await pingResp.text()

        let dockerVersion: string | null = null
        let agentVersion: string | null = null
        let agentVersionError: string | null = null
        let osInfo: string | null = null
        try {
          const vResp = await fetch(dockerVersionUrl, { headers: reqHeaders, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })
          if (vResp.ok) {
            const vData = await vResp.json()
            dockerVersion = vData.Version || null
            osInfo = vData.Os ? `${vData.Os}/${vData.Arch}` : null
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        const agentVersionReport = await fetchAgentVersionReport(host as any, secrets)
        agentVersion = agentVersionReport.agentVersion
        agentVersionError = agentVersionReport.agentVersionError
        if (agentVersionError) {
          console.warn('[host-health-poll] agent version lookup failed', {
            hostId: host.id,
            hostUrl: host.host_url,
            error: agentVersionError,
          })
        }

        const releaseResponse = buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(agentVersion)
        const agentNeedsUpdate = releaseResponse.agent_update_status === 'update_required'

        await sql`
          UPDATE docker_hosts 
          SET status = 'connected', 
              last_seen_at = now(), 
              consecutive_failures = 0, 
              last_error = null,
              docker_version = COALESCE(${dockerVersion}, docker_version),
              agent_version = COALESCE(${agentVersion}, agent_version),
              os_info = COALESCE(${osInfo}, os_info)
          WHERE id = ${host.id}
        `;

        results.push({
          hostId: host.id,
          name: host.name,
          status: 'connected',
          docker_version: dockerVersion,
          agent_version: agentVersion,
          agent_version_error: agentVersionError,
          ...releaseResponse,
          agent_update_available: agentNeedsUpdate,
        })
      } catch (err: any) {
        const errorMsg = err.message || 'Unknown error'
        const newFailures = (host.consecutive_failures || 0) + 1
        const newStatus = failureStatusForCount(newFailures, DEFAULT_UNHEALTHY_THRESHOLD)

        await sql`
          UPDATE docker_hosts 
          SET status = ${newStatus}, 
              consecutive_failures = ${newFailures}, 
              last_error = ${errorMsg.substring(0, 500)}
          WHERE id = ${host.id}
        `;

        results.push({
          hostId: host.id,
          name: host.name,
          status: newStatus,
          error: errorMsg,
          ...(err instanceof SecretCryptoError ? { code: err.code } : {}),
        })
      }
    }))

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      polled: hosts.length,
      stale_marked: staleUpdate.length,
      stale_threshold_minutes: staleThresholdMinutes,
      results,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }), { headers })

  } catch (error: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), { status: 500, headers })
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/host-health-poll',
};
````

import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';

import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { getOrganizationRole, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import {
  createSlackDestination,
  listSlackDestinations,
  sendSlackDestinationTest,
  updateSlackDestination,
} from './lib/slack-delivery.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    await assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
      organizationId: auth.orgId!,
      isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
      feature: 'slack_destinations',
    });
    const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const destinations = await listSlackDestinations(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ destinations, role, can_manage: ['owner', 'admin'].includes(role) }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();

      if (body?.action === 'test') {
        if (!body?.id) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
        }
        const attempt = await sendSlackDestinationTest(auth, body.id);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(attempt), { headers });
      }

      if (!body?.name?.trim() || !body?.webhook_url?.trim()) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Name and Slack webhook URL are required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const destination = await createSlackDestination(auth, {
        name: body.name.trim(),
        webhook_url: body.webhook_url.trim(),
        enabled: body.enabled ?? true,
      });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(destination), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const destination = await updateSlackDestination(auth, {
        id: body.id,
        name: typeof body.name === 'string' ? body.name.trim() : undefined,
        webhook_url: typeof body.webhook_url === 'string' ? body.webhook_url.trim() : undefined,
        enabled: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'enabled') ? body.enabled : undefined,
      });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(destination), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied|require a[n]? /.test(error?.message || '')
      ? 403
      : /Slack webhook URL|URL must|URL cannot/.test(error?.message || '')
        ? 400
        : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process Slack destinations' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/slack-destinations',
};
````

import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';

import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { ensureAlertsSchema } from './lib/ensure-alerts-schema.mjs';
import { getOrganizationRole, requireOrganizationAdmin } from './lib/alerts.mjs';
import {
  createWebhookDestination,
  listWebhookDestinations,
  sendWebhookDestinationTest,
  updateWebhookDestination,
} from './lib/webhook-destinations.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAlertsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    await assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
      organizationId: auth.orgId!,
      isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
      feature: 'webhook_destinations',
    });
    const role = await getOrganizationRole(auth);

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const destinations = await listWebhookDestinations(auth);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ destinations, role, can_manage: ['owner', 'admin'].includes(role) }), { headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();

      if (body?.action === 'test') {
        if (!body?.id) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
        }
        const attempt = await sendWebhookDestinationTest(auth, body.id);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(attempt), { headers });
      }

      if (!body?.name?.trim() || !body?.url?.trim()) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Name and URL are required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const result = await createWebhookDestination(auth, {
        name: body.name.trim(),
        url: body.url.trim(),
        enabled: body.enabled ?? true,
      });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { status: 201, headers });
    }

    if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
      await requireOrganizationAdmin(auth);
      const body = await req.json();
      if (!body?.id) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Destination id required' }), { status: 400, headers });
      }

      const result = await updateWebhookDestination(auth, {
        id: body.id,
        name: typeof body.name === 'string' ? body.name.trim() : undefined,
        url: typeof body.url === 'string' ? body.url.trim() : undefined,
        enabled: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, 'enabled') ? body.enabled : undefined,
        regenerate_secret: !!body.regenerate_secret,
      });

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { headers });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed' }), { status: 405, headers });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = /Admin access required|Access denied|require a[n]? /.test(error?.message || '')
      ? 403
      : /URL must|URL cannot/.test(error?.message || '')
        ? 400
        : 500;
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error?.message || 'Failed to process webhook destinations' }), { status, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/webhook-destinations',
};

import { z } from "zod";
import { extendZodWithOpenApi } from "@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi";

extendZodWithOpenApi(z);

export const ProblemDetailsSchema = z.object({
  type: z.string().url().default("about:blank").openapi({
    description: "A URI reference that identifies the problem type.",
    example: "https://example.com/probs/out-of-credit",
  }),
  title: z.string().openapi({
    description: "A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.",
    example: "You do not have enough credit.",
  }),
  status: z.number().int().min(100).max(599).openapi({
    description: "The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.",
    example: 403,
  }),
  detail: z.string().optional().openapi({
    description: "A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.",
    example: "Your current balance is 30, but that costs 50.",
  }),
  instance: z.string().url().optional().openapi({
    description: "A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.",
    example: "/account/12345/msgs/abc",
  }),
}).openapi("ProblemDetails");

export function createProblemResponse(
  status: number,
  title: string,
  detail?: string,
  type = "about:blank",
  headers: Record<string, string> = {},
): Response {
  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({
      type,
      title,
      status,
      detail,
    }),
    {
      status,
      headers: {
        ...headers,
        "Content-Type": "application/problem+json",
      },
    }
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useAdminHosts,
  useQuarantineAdminHost,
  useUnquarantineAdminHost,
  useMarkAdminHostNeedsReconnect,
} from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { StatusPill, formatDate, filterByQuery, AdminActionDialog } from "./AdminShared";
import type { AdminHostRow } from "@/types/admin";
import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";

export function AdminHostManagement() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [hostQuery, setHostQuery] = useState("");
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | {
    kind: string;
    targetId: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    confirmLabel: string;
  }>(null);

  const hostsQuery = useAdminHosts();
  const quarantineMutation = useQuarantineAdminHost();
  const unquarantineMutation = useUnquarantineAdminHost();
  const reconnectMutation = useMarkAdminHostNeedsReconnect();

  const hosts = filterByQuery(hostsQuery.data ?? [], hostQuery, [
    "name",
    "organization_name",
    "host_url",
    "status",
  ]) as AdminHostRow[];

  const pendingDialogSubmitting =
    quarantineMutation.isPending || unquarantineMutation.isPending || reconnectMutation.isPending;

  const runAction = async (reason: string) => {
    if (!pendingAction) return;
    try {
      switch (pendingAction.kind) {
        case "quarantine-host":
          await quarantineMutation.mutateAsync({ hostId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "unquarantine-host":
          await unquarantineMutation.mutateAsync({ hostId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "mark-needs-reconnect":
          await reconnectMutation.mutateAsync({ hostId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
      }
      toast({ title: "Admin action completed" });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Admin action failed",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="border-b border-border p-4">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              value={hostQuery}
              onChange={(event) => setHostQuery(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search hosts"
              className="pl-9"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Host</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Organization</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Last Seen</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {hosts.map((host) => (
              <TableRow key={host.id}>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="font-medium">{host.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{host.host_url}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{host.organization_name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <StatusPill
                      active={!host.is_quarantined}
                      label={host.is_quarantined ? "Quarantined" : host.status}
                    />
                    {host.needs_reconnect ? <Badge variant="outline">Needs reconnect</Badge> : null}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDate(host.last_seen_at)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setPendingAction({
                          kind: host.is_quarantined ? "unquarantine-host" : "quarantine-host",
                          targetId: host.id,
                          title: host.is_quarantined ? "Unquarantine host" : "Quarantine host",
                          description: "Quarantined hosts are blocked from proxy and control operations.",
                          confirmLabel: host.is_quarantined ? "Unquarantine" : "Quarantine",
                        })
                      }
                    >
                      {host.is_quarantined ? "Unquarantine" : "Quarantine"}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setPendingAction({
                          kind: "mark-needs-reconnect",
                          targetId: host.id,
                          title: "Mark host as needs reconnect",
                          description:
                            "Use this when the host should be surfaced to support or tenant owners as requiring attention.",
                          confirmLabel: "Mark needs reconnect",
                        })
                      }
                    >
                      Mark Needs Reconnect
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      <AdminActionDialog
        open={Boolean(pendingAction)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPendingAction(null);
        }}
        title={pendingAction?.title ?? ""}
        description={pendingAction?.description ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={pendingAction?.confirmLabel ?? "Confirm"}
        submitting={pendingDialogSubmitting}
        onConfirm={runAction}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

import { useState } from "react";
import { format } from "date-fns";
import { Trash2, Plus, BellRing } from "lucide-react";

import { useAdminNotifications, useCreateAdminNotification, useDeleteAdminNotification } from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { StatusPill } from "./AdminShared";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function AdminNotifications() {
  const { data: notifications, isLoading } = useAdminNotifications();
  const createMutation = useCreateAdminNotification();
  const deleteMutation = useDeleteAdminNotification();
  
  const [isCreateOpen, setIsCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState("info");
  const [link, setLink] = useState("");
  const [organizationId, setOrganizationId] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!title || !message || !reason) {
      toast.error("Please fill in all required fields (title, message, reason)");
      return;
    }

    try {
      await createMutation.mutateAsync({
        title,
        message,
        type,
        link: link || null,
        organizationId: organizationId || null,
        reason,
      });
      toast.success("Notification created successfully");
      setIsCreateOpen(false);
      setTitle("");
      setMessage("");
      setLink("");
      setOrganizationId("");
      setReason("");
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || "Failed to create notification");
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    const reasonForDeletion = window.prompt("Reason for deleting this notification:");
    if (!reasonForDeletion) return;

    try {
      await deleteMutation.mutateAsync({ id, reason: reasonForDeletion });
      toast.success("Notification deleted successfully");
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || "Failed to delete notification");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-medium">Global Notifications</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Push notifications to all users or specific organizations</p>
        </div>
        
        <Dialog open={isCreateOpen} onOpenChange={setIsCreateOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button size="sm">
              <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              New Notification
            </Button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>Create Notification</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                Push a new notification to users. Leave Organization ID empty for a global notification.
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="grid gap-4 py-4">
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Title *</Label>
                <Input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="E.g., Scheduled Maintenance" />
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Message *</Label>
                <Textarea value={message} onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)} placeholder="Details about the notification..." />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="grid gap-2">
                  <Label>Type</Label>
                  <Select value={type} onValueChange={setType}>
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="info">Info</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="warning">Warning</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="error">Error</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="success">Success</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="grid gap-2">
                  <Label>Organization ID (Optional)</Label>
                  <Input value={organizationId} onChange={(e) => setOrganizationId(e.target.value)} placeholder="org_..." />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Link URL (Optional)</Label>
                <Input value={link} onChange={(e) => setLink(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://..." />
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label>Reason for Audit Log *</Label>
                <Input value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} placeholder="Why is this being sent?" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsCreateOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button onClick={handleCreate} disabled={createMutation.isPending || !title || !message || !reason}>
                {createMutation.isPending ? "Creating..." : "Create Notification"}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[200px]">Title</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Message</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Scope</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Stats</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {isLoading ? (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={7} className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  Loading notifications...
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : notifications?.length === 0 ? (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={7} className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  No active notifications found.
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : (
              notifications?.map((notification) => (
                <TableRow key={notification.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <StatusPill 
                      label={notification.type} 
                      active={notification.type === 'info' || notification.type === 'success'} 
                      variant={notification.type === 'error' ? 'destructive' : notification.type === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'default'}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium truncate max-w-[200px]">{notification.title}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="truncate max-w-[300px]" title={notification.message}>{notification.message}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    {notification.organization_id ? (
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono bg-muted px-2 py-1 rounded">Org: {notification.organization_id.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/10 px-2 py-1 rounded">Global</span>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex items-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <BellRing className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      {notification.dismiss_count || 0} dismissals
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <div>{format(new Date(notification.created_at), "MMM d, yyyy")}</div>
                    <div>by {notification.created_by_email || 'System'}</div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">
                    <Button 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(notification.id)}
                      disabled={deleteMutation.isPending}
                      className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))
            )}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRightLeft, Loader2, Shield } from "lucide-react";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useAdminOrganizations,
  useAdminHosts,
  useAdminOperations,
  useRunAdminSecretMigration,
} from "@/hooks/useAdmin";
import { StatusPill, formatDate } from "./AdminShared";

export function AdminOperations() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [migrationScope, setMigrationScope] = useState<{
    organization_id?: string;
    host_id?: string;
    dry_run?: boolean;
  }>({});
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");

  const organizationsQuery = useAdminOrganizations();
  const hostsQuery = useAdminHosts();
  const operationsQuery = useAdminOperations();
  const migrateSecretsMutation = useRunAdminSecretMigration();

  const handleRunMigration = async () => {
    try {
      await migrateSecretsMutation.mutateAsync({ ...migrationScope, reason });
      toast({ title: "Migration operation recorded" });
      setReason("");
      setMigrationScope({});
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Migration failed",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]">
      <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-2">
            <ArrowRightLeft className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-medium">Secret migration</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Re-encrypt Docker host secrets with the active backend key, globally or against a specific org or host.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Organization scope</Label>
            <Select
              value={migrationScope.organization_id ?? "all"}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                setMigrationScope((current) => ({ ...current, organization_id: value === "all" ? undefined : value }))
              }
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All organizations</SelectItem>
                {(organizationsQuery.data ?? []).map((organization) => (
                  <SelectItem key={organization.id} value={organization.id}>
                    {organization.name}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Host scope</Label>
            <Select
              value={migrationScope.host_id ?? "all"}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                setMigrationScope((current) => ({ ...current, host_id: value === "all" ? undefined : value }))
              }
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All hosts</SelectItem>
                {(hostsQuery.data ?? []).map((host) => (
                  <SelectItem key={host.id} value={host.id}>
                    {host.name} ({host.organization_name})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Reason</Label>
            <Textarea
              value={reason}
              onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Why this maintenance run is needed"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setMigrationScope((current) => ({ ...current, dry_run: !current.dry_run }))}
            >
              {migrationScope.dry_run ? "Disable dry run" : "Dry run next"}
            </Button>
            <Button disabled={migrateSecretsMutation.isPending || !reason.trim()} onClick={handleRunMigration}>
              {migrateSecretsMutation.isPending ? (
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Shield className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              )}
              Run migration
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card p-5">
        <h3 className="mb-4 font-medium">Operation history</h3>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Operation</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Scope</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {(operationsQuery.data ?? []).map((item) => (
              <TableRow key={item.id}>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="font-medium">{item.operation_name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.reason}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <StatusPill active={!item.status.includes("error")} label={item.status} />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {item.scope_type ?? "global"}
                  {item.scope_id ? `:${item.scope_id}` : ""}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDate(item.created_at)}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | {

    targetId: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;

  }>(null);

  const organizations = filterByQuery(organizationsQuery.data ?? [], organizationQuery, [
    "name",
    "slug",
    "plan",
    "subscription_status",
  ]) as AdminOrganizationRow[];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedOrganizationId && organizationsQuery.data?.[0]) setSelectedOrganizationId(organizationsQuery.data[0].id);
  }, [organizationsQuery.data, selectedOrganizationId]);

  const pendingDialogSubmitting =
    lockOrgMutation.isPending || unlockOrgMutation.isPending || resetOnboardingMutation.isPending;

  const runAction = async (reason: string) => {
    if (!pendingAction) return;
    try {
      switch (pendingAction.kind) {
        case "lock-organization":
          await lockOrgMutation.mutateAsync({ organizationId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "unlock-organization":
          await unlockOrgMutation.mutateAsync({ organizationId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
        case "reset-onboarding":
          await resetOnboardingMutation.mutateAsync({ organizationId: pendingAction.targetId, reason });
          break;
      }
      toast({ title: "Admin action completed" });
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: "Admin action failed",
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
      <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="border-b border-border p-4">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              value={organizationQuery}
              onChange={(event) => setOrganizationQuery(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search organizations"
              className="pl-9"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Organization</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Plan</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Members</TableHead>
              <TableHead>State</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {organizations.map((organization) => (
              <TableRow
                key={organization.id}
                className={selectedOrganizationId === organization.id ? "bg-muted/40" : ""}
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrganizationId(organization.id)}
              >
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="font-medium">{organization.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{organization.slug}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{organization.plan}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{organization.member_count}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <StatusPill active={!organization.is_locked} label={organization.is_locked ? "Locked" : "Open"} />
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card p-5">
        {organizationDetailQuery.isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex min-h-64 items-center justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : organizationDetailQuery.data ? (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{organizationDetailQuery.data.name}</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{organizationDetailQuery.data.slug}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <DetailField label="Plan" value={organizationDetailQuery.data.plan} />
              <DetailField label="Subscription" value={organizationDetailQuery.data.subscription_status} />
              <DetailField label="Current Period End" value={formatDate(organizationDetailQuery.data.current_period_ends_at)} />
              <DetailField label="Onboarding" value={organizationDetailQuery.data.onboarding_status} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={organizationDetailQuery.data.is_locked ? "outline" : "destructive"}
                onClick={() =>
                  setPendingAction({
                    kind: organizationDetailQuery.data!.is_locked ? "unlock-organization" : "lock-organization",
                    targetId: organizationDetailQuery.data!.id,
                    title: organizationDetailQuery.data!.is_locked ? "Unlock organization" : "Lock organization",
                    description: "Locked organizations remain visible but tenant write actions are blocked.",
                    confirmLabel: organizationDetailQuery.data!.is_locked ? "Unlock" : "Lock",
                  })

              <Button

                    description: "This forces the organization back into onboarding state.",
                    confirmLabel: "Reset onboarding",
                  })
                }
              >
                <RefreshCcw className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                Reset Onboarding
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Select an organization to inspect platform controls.</div>
        )}
      </div>

      <AdminActionDialog
        open={Boolean(pendingAction)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPendingAction(null);
        }}
        title={pendingAction?.title ?? ""}
        description={pendingAction?.description ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={pendingAction?.confirmLabel ?? "Confirm"}

        onConfirm={runAction}

  );
