## File: src/components/dashboard/FleetResourceChart.tsx
````typescript
import { AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';
import { Activity } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useFleetMetrics, type FleetMetrics } from "@/hooks/useFleetMetrics";

interface FleetResourceChartProps {
  orgId: string | null;
  className?: string;
  maxDataPoints?: number;
  refetchInterval?: number | false;
}

const MAX_DATA_POINTS = 20;

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0.00 B';
  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  return `${(bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

function formatPercentage(value: number): string {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value.toFixed(2) : '0.00';
}

function formatSpeed(bytesPerSecond: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytesPerSecond) || bytesPerSecond === null || bytesPerSecond === undefined || bytesPerSecond < 0) {
    return 'N/A';
  }

  if (bytesPerSecond === 0) {
    return '0.00 B/s';
  }

  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ['B/s', 'KB/s', 'MB/s', 'GB/s', 'TB/s'];
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytesPerSecond) / Math.log(k)), sizes.length - 1);
  return `${(bytesPerSecond / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

interface FleetResourceTooltipProps {
  active?: boolean;
  label?: string;
  payload?: Array<{
    name?: string;
    value?: number | string;
    payload?: FleetMetrics;
  }>;
}

function FleetResourceTooltip({ active, label, payload }: FleetResourceTooltipProps) {
  if (!active || !payload || payload.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const dataPoint = payload[0]?.payload;
  if (!dataPoint) {
    return null;
  }

  const cpuEntry = payload.find((item) => item.name === 'CPU Usage');
  const memoryEntry = payload.find((item) => item.name === 'Memory Usage');
  const cpuPercent = Number.isFinite(Number(cpuEntry?.value)) ? Number(cpuEntry?.value) : dataPoint.cpu;
  const memoryPercent = Number.isFinite(Number(memoryEntry?.value)) ? Number(memoryEntry?.value) : dataPoint.memory;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(13, 17, 23, 0.95)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        fontSize: '12px',
        color: '#fff',
        boxShadow: '0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
        padding: '10px 12px',
        minWidth: '280px',
      }}
    >
      {label && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: '6px' }}>
          {label}
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '4px' }}>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#0EA5E9', fontWeight: 700 }}>CPU:</span>{' '}
          <span>
            {formatPercentage(cpuPercent)}% of fleet (Load: {dataPoint.usedCores.toFixed(2)} / {dataPoint.totalCores.toFixed(2)} cores)
          </span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#10B981', fontWeight: 700 }}>Memory:</span>{' '}
          <span>
            {formatPercentage(memoryPercent)}% of fleet ({formatBytes(dataPoint.memoryUsed)} / {formatBytes(dataPoint.memoryLimit)})
          </span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Network In:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.networkInBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Network Out:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.networkOutBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Disk Read:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.diskReadBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontWeight: 700 }}>Disk Write:</span>{' '}
          <span>{formatSpeed(dataPoint.diskWriteBytesPerSec)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface CompactMetricProps {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}

function CompactMetric({ label, value }: CompactMetricProps) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.02] px-2.5 py-2">
      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground/80">{label}</div>
      <div className="text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-foreground mt-0.5">{value}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function FleetResourceChart({
  orgId,
  className,
  maxDataPoints = MAX_DATA_POINTS,
  refetchInterval = 10000,
}: FleetResourceChartProps) {
  const [chartData, setChartData] = useState<FleetMetrics[]>([]);
  const { data: newData, isLoading, error } = useFleetMetrics(orgId, refetchInterval);

       // Initialize with some data points if empty (only once)
   useEffect(() => {
     if (chartData.length === 0 && orgId) {
       const now = new Date();
       const initialData: FleetMetrics[] = [];
        for (let i = maxDataPoints - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const date = new Date(now.getTime() - i * 60000);
          const t = date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });
          const cpu = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 30 + Math.random() * 20));
          const memory = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 45 + Math.random() * 20));
         // Mock data for new fields: assume 4 cores and 8GB memory for initial mock
          const totalCoresMock = 4;
          const memoryLimitMock = 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; // 8GB in bytes
           initialData.push({
             timestamp: date.getTime(),
             time: t,
             cpu: cpu,
             memory: memory,
             usedCores: (cpu / 100) * totalCoresMock,
             totalCores: totalCoresMock,
            memoryUsed: (memory / 100) * memoryLimitMock,
            memoryLimit: memoryLimitMock,
            networkInBytesPerSec: null,
            networkOutBytesPerSec: null,
            diskReadBytesPerSec: null,
            diskWriteBytesPerSec: null,
          });
        }
        setChartData(initialData);
      }
    }, [orgId, maxDataPoints]);

  // Update with new data points as they come in
  useEffect(() => {
    if (newData && newData.length > 0) {
      setChartData((prev) => {
        const updated = [...prev, ...newData]
          .filter((point) => Number.isFinite(point.timestamp))
          .sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);

        if (updated.length > maxDataPoints) {
          return updated.slice(-maxDataPoints);
        }

        return updated;
      });
    }
  }, [newData, maxDataPoints]);

  const displayData = chartData.length > 0 ? chartData : [];
  const latestPoint = displayData.length > 0 ? displayData[displayData.length - 1] : undefined;

  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full", className)}>
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
           <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
           <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Fleet Resource Trends</h3>
         </div>
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Updating...</span>
          </div>
        )}
        {!isLoading && error instanceof Error ? (
          <span className="text-[10px] text-destructive">{error.message}</span>
        ) : null}
         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
             <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary" />
             <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase opacity-70">CPU</span>
           </div>
           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
             <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-success" />
             <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase opacity-70">MEM</span>
           </div>
         </div>
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex-1 p-4 pt-6">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          <AreaChart data={displayData} margin={{ top: 0, right: 0, left: -20, bottom: 0 }}>
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="colorCpu" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#0EA5E9" stopOpacity={0.3}/>
                <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#0EA5E9" stopOpacity={0}/>
              </linearGradient>
              <linearGradient id="colorMem" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.3}/>
                <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0}/>
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)" />
            <XAxis 
              dataKey="time" 
              axisLine={false} 
              tickLine={false} 
              tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)', fontWeight: 600 }}
              dy={10}
            />
            <YAxis 
              axisLine={false} 
              tickLine={false} 
              tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)', fontWeight: 600 }}
              domain={[0, 'auto']}
              allowDecimals={false}
              tickFormatter={(value: number | string) => `${formatPercentage(typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value))}%`}
            />
            <Tooltip content={<FleetResourceTooltip />} />
            <Area 
              type="monotone" 
              dataKey="cpu" 
              name="CPU Usage"
              stroke="#0EA5E9" 
              strokeWidth={2}
              fillOpacity={1} 
              fill="url(#colorCpu)" 
              isAnimationActive={false}
            />
            <Area 
              type="monotone" 
              dataKey="memory" 
              name="Memory Usage"
              stroke="#10B981" 
              strokeWidth={2}
              fillOpacity={1} 
              fill="url(#colorMem)" 
              isAnimationActive={false}
            />
          </AreaChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 pb-4 pt-2 border-t border-white/5">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <CompactMetric label="Network In" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.networkInBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
          <CompactMetric label="Network Out" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.networkOutBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
          <CompactMetric label="Disk Read" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.diskReadBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
          <CompactMetric label="Disk Write" value={formatSpeed(latestPoint?.diskWriteBytesPerSec ?? null)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Server, Activity, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, ChevronRight, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  connected: "Healthy",
  stale: "Stale",
  error: "Error",
  unhealthy: "Unhealthy",
  down: "Down",
  disconnected: "Offline",
  unknown: "Unknown",
};

function statusColor(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "connected":
      return { bg: "bg-success/10", text: "text-success" };
    case "stale":
    case "error":
      return { bg: "bg-warning/10", text: "text-warning" };
    default:
      return { bg: "bg-destructive/10", text: "text-destructive" };
  }
}

interface HostHealthGridProps {
  hosts: DockerHost[];
  className?: string;
}

export function HostHealthGrid({ hosts, className }: HostHealthGridProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("glass-card overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full", className)}>
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Server className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Host Health Overview</h3>
        </div>
        <Link to="/app/hosts" className="text-[11px] font-bold text-primary hover:underline flex items-center">
          MANAGE HOSTS <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 ml-0.5" />
        </Link>
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        {hosts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full opacity-50">
            <Server className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <p className="text-sm">No hosts connected</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
            {hosts.map((host) => {
              const normalized = normalizeHostStatus(host.status);
              const isHealthy = normalized === "connected";
              const isWarning = normalized === "stale" || normalized === "error";
              const colors = statusColor(normalized);
              const label = STATUS_LABEL[normalized] || "Unknown";

              return (
                <Link 
                  key={host.id} 
                  to={`/app/hosts/${host.id}`}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors group"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={cn("p-1.5 rounded-lg", colors.bg)}>
                      {isHealthy ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className={cn("h-4 w-4", colors.text)} />
                      ) : isWarning ? (
                        <AlertTriangle className={cn("h-4 w-4", colors.text)} />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertCircle className={cn("h-4 w-4", colors.text)} />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">{host.name}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">
                        {host.os_info || "Linux"} • {host.connection_mode.replace('_', ' ')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-right">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-end">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Activity className={cn("h-3 w-3", isHealthy ? "text-success" : "text-muted-foreground")} />
                        <span className={cn("text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter", colors.text)}>
                          {label}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {host.last_seen_at && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                          Seen {new Date(host.last_seen_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Plus, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, ShieldCheck, CloudCog, Terminal, Pencil, Eye, EyeOff, Copy, RefreshCw, Wrench } from "lucide-react";
import { useAddDockerHost, useUpdateDockerHost } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { agentEnrollmentApi, type AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse } from "@/services/agent-enrollment";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import type { ConnectionMode, DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION, isAgentVersionOutdated } from "@/lib/agent-version";
import { sanitizeConnectionError } from "@/lib/error-sanitizer";
interface AddHostDialogProps {
  orgId: string;
  trigger?: React.ReactNode;
  host?: DockerHost | null;
}

interface EditableHostSecrets {
  agentApiKey: string;
  cfServiceTokenId: string;
  cfServiceTokenSecret: string;
}

type GuidedStage = "form" | "guided" | "finalizing";

function CommandBlock({
  label,
  command,
  masked = false,
}: {
  label: string;
  command: string;
  masked?: boolean;
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(!masked);
  const visibleCommand = masked && !revealed ? command.replace(/[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}/g, "••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••") : command;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command);
    setCopied(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Label>{label}</Label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {masked ? (
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={() => setRevealed((value) => !value)}>
              {revealed ? <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
              {revealed ? "Hide" : "Reveal"}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={handleCopy}>
            <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-background p-4 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed">
        <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-all text-foreground/90">{visibleCommand}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AddHostDialog({ orgId, trigger, host }: AddHostDialogProps) {
  const isEditing = !!host;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<GuidedStage>("form");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ConnectionMode>("agent");
  const [hostUrl, setHostUrl] = useState("");
  const [socketPath, setSocketPath] = useState("/var/run/docker.sock");
  const [agentApiKey, setAgentApiKey] = useState("");
  const [cfServiceTokenId, setCfServiceTokenId] = useState("");
  const [cfServiceTokenSecret, setCfServiceTokenSecret] = useState("");
  const [loadingSecrets, setLoadingSecrets] = useState(false);
  const [showAgentKey, setShowAgentKey] = useState(false);
  const [showCfSecret, setShowCfSecret] = useState(false);
  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);
  const [enrollment, setEnrollment] = useState<AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse | null>(null);
  const [guidedError, setGuidedError] = useState("");
  const [testStatus, setTestStatus] = useState<"idle" | "testing" | "success" | "error">("idle");
  const [testError, setTestError] = useState("");
  const [testMessage, setTestMessage] = useState("");
  const [remediationCommand, setRemediationCommand] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const addHost = useAddDockerHost();
  const updateHost = useUpdateDockerHost();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const resetForm = () => {
    setName(host?.name ?? "");
    setHostUrl(host?.host_url ?? "");
    setMode(host?.connection_mode ?? "agent");
    setSocketPath(host?.docker_socket_path ?? "/var/run/docker.sock");
    setAgentApiKey("");
    setCfServiceTokenId("");
    setCfServiceTokenSecret("");
    setLoadingSecrets(false);
    setShowAgentKey(false);
    setShowCfSecret(false);
    setShowAdvanced(false);
    setEnrollment(null);
    setGuidedError("");
    setStage("form");
    setTestStatus("idle");
    setTestError("");
    setTestMessage("");
    setRemediationCommand(null);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    resetForm();
  }, [open, host]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !host) return;

    let active = true;
    setLoadingSecrets(true);
    apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?hostId=${host.id}&includeSecrets=true`)
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const secrets = (data as { secrets?: EditableHostSecrets }).secrets;
        setAgentApiKey(secrets?.agentApiKey ?? "");
        setCfServiceTokenId(secrets?.cfServiceTokenId ?? "");
        setCfServiceTokenSecret(secrets?.cfServiceTokenSecret ?? "");
      })
      .catch((error: any) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
        toast({
          title: "Failed to load host secrets",
          description: sanitized.description,
          variant: "destructive",

      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setLoadingSecrets(false);
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [open, host, toast]);

  const handleSaveEdit = async () => {
    try {
      new URL(hostUrl);
    } catch {
      toast({ title: "Invalid URL", description: "Enter a valid agent or tunnel URL.", variant: "destructive" });
      return;
    }

    if (!agentApiKey.trim()) {
      toast({ title: "API Key required", description: "The agent API key is required for both connection modes.", variant: "destructive" });
      return;
    }

    try {
      const payload = {
        name,
        hostUrl,
        connectionMode: mode,
        dockerSocketPath: socketPath,
        secrets: {
          agentApiKey: agentApiKey.trim(),
          ...(mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" && {
            cfServiceTokenId: cfServiceTokenId.trim() || undefined,
            cfServiceTokenSecret: cfServiceTokenSecret.trim() || undefined,
          }),
        },
      };

      const savedHost = await updateHost.mutateAsync({
        hostId: host!.id,
        ...payload,
      });

      setTestStatus("testing");
      try {
        const result = await dockerApi.ping(savedHost.id);
        if (result.ok) {
          setTestStatus("success");
          setTestMessage(result.agent_version_error || "");
          const agentVersion = result.agent_version || null;
          const latestVersion = result.latest_agent_version || CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION;
          const agentOutdated = isAgentVersionOutdated(agentVersion);
          toast({
            title: "Host updated!",
            description: [
              `Docker ${result.docker_version || "detected"}.`,
              agentVersion
                ? `Agent ${agentVersion}${agentOutdated ? ` is behind ${latestVersion}` : ""}.`
                : result.agent_version_error
                  ? `Agent version not reported yet (${result.agent_version_error}). Current release is ${latestVersion}.`
                  : `Agent version not reported yet. Current release is ${latestVersion}.`,
            ].join(" "),
          });
        } else {
          setTestStatus("error");
          setTestError("Docker API did not respond with OK");
          toast({ title: "Host updated but unreachable", description: "Check URL and credentials.", variant: "destructive" });
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        setTestStatus("error");
        const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(e);
        setTestError(sanitized.description);
        toast({ title: sanitized.title, description: sanitized.description, variant: "destructive" });
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        setOpen(false);
        resetForm();
      }, 1500);
    } catch (error: any) {
      const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
      toast({ title: "Failed to update host", description: sanitized.description, variant: "destructive" });
    }
  };

  const handleStartGuidedSetup = async () => {
    setGuidedError("");
    try {
      new URL(hostUrl);
    } catch {
      setGuidedError("Enter a valid URL (for example https://agent.example.com:9876).");
      return;
    }

    if (!name.trim()) {
      setGuidedError("Host name is required.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setStage("finalizing");
      const response = await agentEnrollmentApi.create({
        organizationId: orgId,
        hostName: name,
        hostUrl,
        connectionMode: mode,
        dockerSocketPath: socketPath,
        cfServiceTokenId: mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenId.trim() || undefined : undefined,
        cfServiceTokenSecret: mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenSecret.trim() || undefined : undefined,
      });
      setEnrollment(response);
      setGuidedError("");
      setStage("guided");
    } catch (error: any) {
      const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
      setGuidedError(sanitized.description || "Failed to prepare the guided setup command.");
      setStage("form");
    }
  };

  const handleFinalizeGuidedSetup = async () => {
    if (!enrollment?.session_id) return;
    setGuidedError("");
    setTestError("");
    setRemediationCommand(null);
    setStage("finalizing");

    try {
      const result = await agentEnrollmentApi.finalize(enrollment.session_id);
      if (result.ok) {
        setTestStatus("success");
        setTestMessage(
          result.reason_code === "agent_outdated"
            ? "Host connected, but the installed agent is behind the current release."
            : result.reason_code === "metrics_unavailable"
              ? "Host connected, but local metrics verification still needs attention."
              : "Connection verified successfully."
        );
        toast({
          title: "Host connected!",
          description: result.reason_code
            ? "The host is reachable. Review the follow-up guidance if shown."
            : "The host was installed and verified through Dockerdash.",
        });
        setTimeout(() => {
          setOpen(false);
          resetForm();
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        setTestStatus("error");
        setTestError(result.status || "Connection test failed.");
        setRemediationCommand(result.remediation_command);
        setStage("guided");
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      setTestStatus("error");
      const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(error);
      setTestError(sanitized.description || "Connection test failed.");
      setStage("guided");
    }
  };

  const modes: { value: ConnectionMode; label: string; icon: typeof Terminal; desc: string }[] = [
    { value: "agent", label: "Agent (Direct)", icon: Terminal, desc: "Connect to the Watchtower Agent over HTTPS." },
    { value: "cloudflare_tunnel", label: "Agent via CF Tunnel", icon: CloudCog, desc: "Same agent, accessed through a Cloudflare Tunnel." },
  ];

  const isBusy = addHost.isPending || updateHost.isPending || loadingSecrets || stage === "finalizing";

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => { setOpen(value); if (!value) resetForm(); }}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        {trigger || (
          <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5">

            {isEditing ? "Edit Docker Host" : "Connect Docker Host"}

          <DialogDescription>
            {isEditing
              ? "Update the saved host connection, endpoint, and credentials."
              : "Create a guided one-command installer flow, then finish the host test through Dockerdash."}
          </DialogDescription>

        {!isEditing && stage === "guided" && enrollment ? (
          <div className="space-y-4 mt-2">

              {enrollment.setup_summary}

            <CommandBlock label="Primary install command" command={enrollment.install_command} />
            <CommandBlock label="Local verify command" command={enrollment.verify_command} />

            <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/20 p-4 space-y-3">

              >

                {showAdvanced ? "Hide manual fallback" : "Use manual install instead"}

              {showAdvanced ? (
                <div className="space-y-2">

              <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">
                <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{guidedError}</p>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {testStatus === "error" && testError ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">

                {stage === "finalizing" ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-2" />Finishing...</> : "Finish Setup & Test"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4 mt-2">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Connection Method</Label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {modes.map((m) => (
                  <button
                    key={m.value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMode(m.value)}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-left transition-all ${
                      mode === m.value
                        ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 ring-1 ring-primary/20"
                        : "border-border hover:border-primary/40"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <m.icon className={`h-4 w-4 mb-1 ${mode === m.value ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground"}`} />
                    <div className="text-xs font-medium">{m.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{m.desc}</div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Host Name</Label>
              <Input placeholder="e.g. prod-server-01" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>{mode === "agent" ? "Agent URL" : "Tunnel URL"}</Label>
              <Input
                placeholder={mode === "agent" ? "https://your-host:9876" : "https://docker.your-team.cloudflareaccess.com"}
                value={hostUrl}
                onChange={(e) => setHostUrl(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Docker Socket Path <span className="text-muted-foreground">(optional)</span></Label>
              <Input placeholder="/var/run/docker.sock" value={socketPath} onChange={(e) => setSocketPath(e.target.value)} />
            </div>

            {mode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? (
              <>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>CF Access Service Token ID <span className="text-muted-foreground">(optional)</span></Label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="Only if CF Access is protecting the tunnel"
                    value={cfServiceTokenId}
                    onChange={(e) => setCfServiceTokenId(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>CF Access Service Token Secret <span className="text-muted-foreground">(optional)</span></Label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Input
                      type={showCfSecret ? "text" : "password"}
                      placeholder="Only if CF Access is protecting the tunnel"
                      value={cfServiceTokenSecret}
                      onChange={(e) => setCfServiceTokenSecret(e.target.value)}
                      className="pr-10"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowCfSecret((value) => !value)}
                      className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                      {showCfSecret ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}

            {isEditing ? (
              <>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>Agent API Key</Label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Input
                      type={showAgentKey ? "text" : "password"}
                      placeholder="Shared secret for authenticating with the agent"
                      value={agentApiKey}
                      onChange={(e) => setAgentApiKey(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={loadingSecrets}
                      className="pr-10"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowAgentKey((value) => !value)}
                      className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                      {showAgentKey ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {testStatus === "error" && testError ? (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">
                    <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{testError}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                {testStatus === "success" ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-primary/10 border border-primary/20">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <div className="space-y-0.5">
                      <p className="text-xs text-primary">Connection successful!</p>
                      {testMessage ? <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{testMessage}</p> : null}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                <Button onClick={handleSaveEdit} disabled={!name || !hostUrl || isBusy || !agentApiKey.trim()} className="w-full">
                  {isBusy || testStatus === "testing" ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-2" />Saving...</> : "Save Changes & Test Connection"}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                {guidedError ? (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20">
                    <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{guidedError}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                <Button onClick={handleStartGuidedSetup} disabled={!name || !hostUrl || isBusy} className="w-full">
                  {isBusy ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-2" />Preparing...</> : "Generate Install Command"}
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { Copy, ExternalLink, Terminal } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import {
  CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
  buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy,
  buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand,
  buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand,
  getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy,
} from "@/lib/agent-release";

function statusTone(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "current":
      return "border-success/20 bg-success/10 text-success";
    case "update_required":
      return "border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 text-warning";
    case "verification_required":
      return "border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 text-primary";
    case "pending":
    default:
      return "border-white/10 bg-background/60 text-muted-foreground";
  }
}

function statusSummaryTone(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "current":
      return "text-success";
    case "update_required":
      return "text-warning";
    case "verification_required":
      return "text-primary";
    case "pending":
    default:
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}

function AgentCommandBlock({
  label,
  command,
}: {
  label: string;
  command: string;
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command);
    setCopied(true);
    toast({ title: "Copied to clipboard" });
    window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
        <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={handleCopy}>
          <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/60 p-4">
        <pre className="overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap break-all font-mono text-sm text-foreground/90">{command}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function UpdateCommandSection({
  title,
  description,
  command,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  command: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4 space-y-3">
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
      </div>
      <AgentCommandBlock label={title} command={command} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function AgentUpdateDialog({
  host,
  trigger,
  status,
  statusCopy,
  verificationReason,
}: {
  host: DockerHost;
  trigger: React.ReactNode;
  status: string;
  statusCopy: { title: string; description: string };
  verificationReason: string | null;
}) {
  const normalizedStatus =
    status === "current" || status === "update_required" || status === "verification_required"
      ? status
      : "pending";
  const resolvedStatusCopy = statusCopy ?? getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy(normalizedStatus, CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const updateCopy = buildWatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const installedVersion = host.agent_version || "Pending";
  const latestVersion = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version;
  const preflightCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const upgradeCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE);
  const verifyCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand();
  const repairCommand = buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand();
  const dialogTitle =
    normalizedStatus === "verification_required"
      ? "Verify Host Agent"
      : normalizedStatus === "current"
        ? "Host Agent"
        : "Update Host Agent";

  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>{trigger}</DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{dialogTitle}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{updateCopy.dialogDescription}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Installed version</p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{installedVersion}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Latest approved</p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{latestVersion}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4">
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Status</p>
              <p className={cn("mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight", statusSummaryTone(normalizedStatus))}>{resolvedStatusCopy.title}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{resolvedStatusCopy.description}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={cn("rounded-2xl border p-4 text-sm", statusTone(normalizedStatus))}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] opacity-80">Current state</p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-base font-medium">{resolvedStatusCopy.title}</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm opacity-90">{resolvedStatusCopy.description}</p>
              </div>
              <span className="rounded-full border border-current/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em]">
                {normalizedStatus}
              </span>
            </div>
            {verificationReason ? (
              <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {verificationReason}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-primary/15 bg-primary/5 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {updateCopy.sourcePrefix}{" "}
            <a
              href={CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.releaseUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-primary hover:underline"
            >
              {CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.sourceLabel}
              <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </a>
            {updateCopy.sourceNotice ? ` ${updateCopy.sourceNotice}` : ""}
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4">
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.preflightCommandLabel}
              description="Checks prerequisites and verifies the installer automatically before making any changes."
              command={preflightCommand}
            />
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.upgradeCommandLabel}
              description="Downloads the current installer, verifies it automatically, and runs the in-place update."
              command={upgradeCommand}
            />
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.verifyCommandLabel}
              description="Confirms the local agent version and metrics endpoints after the update."
              command={verifyCommand}
            />
            <UpdateCommandSection
              title={updateCopy.repairCommandLabel}
              description="Use this when the host needs repair guidance after a failed or partial update."
              command={repairCommand}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/50 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {updateCopy.supportInstructions}
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````typescript
        )}

    </button>
  );
}
````

````typescript
interface HostSidebarProps {

  selectedHost: DockerHost | null;
  selectedPreviewMetrics: Pick<HostMetricsPoint, "cpu" | "memory"> | null;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
  onSelectHost: (hostId: string) => void;
  onHideSidebar: () => void;
  isHostLocked: (hostId: string) => boolean;
}

export function HostSidebar({
  filteredHosts,
  selectedHost,
  selectedPreviewMetrics,
  search,
  onSearchChange,
  onSelectHost,
  onHideSidebar,
  isHostLocked,

          <Button

          />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3 p-4">

            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-white/10 p-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">

            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredHosts.map((host) => (
              <HostCard
                key={host.id}
                host={host}
                selected={host.id === selectedHost?.id}
                previewMetrics={host.id === selectedHost?.id ? selectedPreviewMetrics : null}
                onSelect={() => onSelectHost(host.id)}
                isLocked={isHostLocked(host.id)}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
````

````typescript
import { PanelLeftOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { HostDetailHeader } from "@/components/hosts/HostDetailHeader";

import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";
import { sanitizeConnectionError } from "@/lib/error-sanitizer";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";

interface SelectedHostViewProps {
  selectedHost: DockerHost;
  containers: any[];
  runningCount: number;
  orgId: string | undefined;
  testing: boolean;
  liveRefreshPending: boolean;
  selectedHostAutoProbe: boolean;
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  selectedHostReadable: boolean;
  missingExtendedMetrics: boolean;
  metricsQuery: any;
  containersQuery: any;

  metricsErrorMessage: string | null;
  agentUpdateStatus: string;
  agentUpdateStatusCopy: { title: string; description: string };
  verificationReason: string | null;
  showAgentUpdateCta: boolean;
  isInfrastructureVisible: boolean;
  onShowSidebar: () => void;
  onTest: () => void;
  onRefreshLiveData: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}

export function SelectedHostView({
  selectedHost,
  containers,
  runningCount,
  orgId,
  testing,
  liveRefreshPending,
  selectedHostAutoProbe,
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  selectedHostReadable,
  missingExtendedMetrics,
  metricsQuery,
  containersQuery,
  metricsFailureDisplay,
  metricsErrorMessage,
  agentUpdateStatus,
  agentUpdateStatusCopy,
  verificationReason,
  showAgentUpdateCta,
  isInfrastructureVisible,
  onShowSidebar,
  onTest,
  onRefreshLiveData,
  onDelete,
}: SelectedHostViewProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {!isInfrastructureVisible ? (
        <div className="flex justify-start">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="gap-2" onClick={onShowSidebar}>
            <PanelLeftOpen className="h-4 w-4" />
            Show Host Infrastructure
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <HostDetailHeader
        selectedHost={selectedHost}
        containers={containers}
        runningCount={runningCount}
        orgId={orgId}
        testing={testing}
        liveRefreshPending={liveRefreshPending}
        selectedHostAutoProbe={selectedHostAutoProbe}
        missingExtendedMetrics={missingExtendedMetrics}
        uptimeSeconds={metricsQuery.latestPoint?.uptimeSeconds}
        agentUpdateStatus={agentUpdateStatus}
        agentUpdateStatusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
        verificationReason={verificationReason}
        showAgentUpdateCta={showAgentUpdateCta}
        onTest={onTest}
        onRefreshLiveData={onRefreshLiveData}
        onDelete={onDelete}
      />

      {normalizeHostStatus(selectedHost.status) === "stale" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning">
          This host heartbeat is stale. Automatic metrics and container reads are paused until the next successful health check or a manual connection test.
        </div>
      )}

      {containersQuery.error instanceof Error ? (() => {
        const sanitized = sanitizeConnectionError(containersQuery.error);
        return (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/5 px-5 py-4 space-y-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">{sanitized.title}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{sanitized.description}</p>
          </div>
        );
      })() : null}

      <HostMetricsGrid
        selectedHost={selectedHost}
        metricsQuery={metricsQuery}
        containersQuery={containersQuery}
        containers={containers}
        runningCount={runningCount}
        metricsFailureDisplay={metricsFailureDisplay}
        missingExtendedMetrics={missingExtendedMetrics}
        selectedHostDisconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
        selectedHostStale={selectedHostStale}
        agentUpdateStatus={agentUpdateStatus}
        agentUpdateStatusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
        verificationReason={verificationReason}
        showAgentUpdateCta={showAgentUpdateCta}
      />

      {metricsErrorMessage && selectedHostReadable && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning">
          {metricsErrorMessage}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
````

````typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";

import {
  useInviteOrganizationMember,
  useOrganizationAccess,
  useRemoveOrganizationMember,
  useResendOrganizationInvitation,
  useRevokeOrganizationInvitation,
  useUpdateOrganizationMemberRole,
} from "@/hooks/useOrganizationAccess";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/EmptyState";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/StatusBadge";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {

  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,

} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import type {
  OrganizationAccessInvitation,
  OrganizationAccessMember,
  OrganizationAccessResponse,
  OrganizationInvitationFormValues,
  OrganizationMemberRole,
} from "@/types/organization-access";

type AccessRow =
  | (OrganizationAccessMember & { row_type: "member"; row_id: string; display_name: string; secondary_text: string })
  | (OrganizationAccessInvitation & { row_type: "invitation"; row_id: string; display_name: string; secondary_text: string });

const ROLE_OPTIONS: OrganizationMemberRole[] = ["owner", "admin", "member"];

function formatDate(value: string) {
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString();
}

function createRows(data?: OrganizationAccessResponse | null): AccessRow[] {
  if (!data) return [];

  const memberRows: AccessRow[] = data.members.map((member) => ({
    ...member,
    row_type: "member",
    row_id: member.user_id,
    display_name: member.full_name || member.email,
    secondary_text: member.email,
  }));

  const invitationRows: AccessRow[] = data.invitations.map((invitation) => ({
    ...invitation,
    row_type: "invitation",
    row_id: invitation.id,
    display_name: invitation.email,
    secondary_text: invitation.expires_at ? `Expires ${formatDate(invitation.expires_at)}` : "Pending invite",
  }));

  return [...memberRows, ...invitationRows];
}

function buildCsv(rows: AccessRow[]) {
  const lines = [
    ["name", "email", "role", "status", "joined_or_invited_at"],
    ...rows.map((row) => [
      row.display_name,
      row.email,
      row.role,
      row.status,
      row.row_type === "member" ? row.joined_at : row.created_at,
    ]),
  ];

  return lines
    .map((columns) =>
      columns
        .map((column) => `"${String(column).replaceAll('"', '""')}"`)
        .join(","),
    )
    .join("\n");
}

function downloadCsv(rows: AccessRow[]) {
  const blob = new Blob([buildCsv(rows)], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = "organization-members.csv";
  link.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function SummaryCard({ label, value, helper }: { label: string; value: number; helper: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card/70 p-4">
      <div className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-end gap-2">
        <span className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{value}</span>
        <span className="pb-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{helper}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function InviteMemberDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  saving,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  saving?: boolean;
  onSubmit: (values: OrganizationInvitationFormValues) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<OrganizationInvitationFormValues>({ email: "", role: "member" });

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    await onSubmit(values);
    setValues({ email: "", role: "member" });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Invite member</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Send an organization invitation using the current active organization in Clerk.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid gap-4 py-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="invite-email">Email</Label>
            <Input
              id="invite-email"
              type="email"
              value={values.email}
              placeholder="teammate@example.com"
              onChange={(event) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, email: event.target.value }))}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Role</Label>
            <Select value={values.role} onValueChange={(value) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, role: value as OrganizationMemberRole }))}>
              <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((role) => (
                  <SelectItem key={role} value={role}>{role}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button disabled={saving || !values.email.trim()} onClick={handleSubmit}>
            {saving ? "Sending..." : "Send invite"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => downloadCsv(filteredRows)} disabled={filteredRows.length === 0}>
                <Download className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Export CSV
              </Button>
              {canManage ? (
                <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setInviteOpen(true)}>
                  <MailPlus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Invite member
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-border px-4 py-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <div className="relative w-full lg:max-w-sm">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search name or email"
                className="pl-9"

            </div>

            <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={(value) => setStatusFilter(value as "all" | "active" | "invited")}>

export function OrganizationMembersWorkspaceContainer() {
  const { organization } = useOrganization();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const accessQuery = useOrganizationAccess(organization?.id);
  const inviteMutation = useInviteOrganizationMember();
  const updateRoleMutation = useUpdateOrganizationMemberRole();
  const removeMemberMutation = useRemoveOrganizationMember();
  const resendInvitationMutation = useResendOrganizationInvitation();
  const revokeInvitationMutation = useRevokeOrganizationInvitation();

  const handleError = (title: string, error: unknown) => {
    toast({
      title,
      description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
      variant: "destructive",
    });
  };

  return (
    <OrganizationMembersWorkspaceView
      data={accessQuery.data}
      canManage={accessQuery.data?.can_manage_members ?? false}
      isLoading={accessQuery.isLoading}
      activeOrgName={organization?.name}
      inviteSaving={inviteMutation.isPending}
      pendingMemberId={updateRoleMutation.isPending ? updateRoleMutation.variables?.userId : removeMemberMutation.isPending ? removeMemberMutation.variables : null}
      pendingInvitationId={
        resendInvitationMutation.isPending ? resendInvitationMutation.variables :
          revokeInvitationMutation.isPending ? revokeInvitationMutation.variables :
            null
      }
      onInvite={async (values) => {
        try {
          await inviteMutation.mutateAsync(values);
          toast({ title: "Invitation sent" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to send invitation", error);
          throw error;
        }
      }}
      onRoleChange={async (userId, role) => {
        try {
          await updateRoleMutation.mutateAsync({ userId, role });
          toast({ title: "Member role updated" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to update member role", error);
        }
      }}
      onRemoveMember={async (userId) => {
        try {
          await removeMemberMutation.mutateAsync(userId);
          toast({ title: "Member removed" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to remove member", error);
        }
      }}
      onResendInvitation={async (id) => {
        try {
          await resendInvitationMutation.mutateAsync(id);
          toast({ title: "Invitation resent" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to resend invitation", error);
        }
      }}
      onRevokeInvitation={async (id) => {
        try {
          await revokeInvitationMutation.mutateAsync(id);
          toast({ title: "Invitation revoked" });
        } catch (error) {
          handleError("Failed to revoke invitation", error);
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { getAppOrigin, getPublicOrigin, isLocalDev } from "@/lib/hostname";

/**
 * Shared LogoLink that controls cross-origin navigation rules.
 * 
 * - Logged out -> public origin
 * - Logged in  -> app origin
 * 
 * Uses standard <a> tags instead of React Router <Link> to ensure that 
 * clicking the logo properly exits the current subdomain context and 
 * triggers a full cross-domain navigation, avoiding router sub-domain traps.
 */
export function LogoLink({ 
  className,
  forcePublic,
  children 
}: { 
  className?: string;
  forcePublic?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();

  // Default to apex while auth loads to prevent wrong routing traps
  let targetUrl = isLocalDev() ? "/" : getPublicOrigin();

  if (forcePublic) {
    targetUrl = isLocalDev() ? "/" : getPublicOrigin();
  } else if (isLoaded) {
    if (isSignedIn) {
      targetUrl = isLocalDev() ? "/app" : getAppOrigin();
    } else {
      targetUrl = isLocalDev() ? "/" : getPublicOrigin();
    }
  }

  return (
    <a href={targetUrl} className={className}>
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect } from "react";

interface SEOProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
}

/**
 * SEO component to update document title and meta description dynamically.
 * Place this at the top of page components.
 */
export function SEO({ title, description }: SEOProps) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const baseTitle = "Docker Dashboard";
    const fullTitle = title ? `${title} — ${baseTitle}` : baseTitle;
    
    // Update document title
    document.title = fullTitle;

    // Update meta description if provided
    if (description) {
      const metaDescription = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]');
      if (metaDescription) {
        metaDescription.setAttribute("content", description);
      } else {
        // Create meta description if it doesn't exist
        const meta = document.createElement('meta');
        meta.name = "description";
        meta.content = description;
        document.head.appendChild(meta);
      }
      
      // Also update OpenGraph description
      const ogDescription = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:description"]');
      if (ogDescription) {
        ogDescription.setAttribute("content", description);
      }
    }

    // Update OpenGraph title
    const ogTitle = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]');
    if (ogTitle) {
      ogTitle.setAttribute("content", fullTitle);
    }
    
    const twitterTitle = document.querySelector('meta[name="twitter:title"]');
    if (twitterTitle) {
      twitterTitle.setAttribute("content", fullTitle);
    }

  }, [title, description]);

  return null;
}
````

````typescript
  "inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2",
  {
    variants: {

        default: "border-transparent bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/80",

        outline: "text-foreground",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  },
);

export interface BadgeProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> {}

function Badge({ className, variant, ...props }: BadgeProps) {
````

````typescript
import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled } from "@/lib/hostname";

/**
 * Root redirect for the app subdomain (app.dockerdash.app).
 *
 * - Signed in  → /app  (dashboard)
 * - Signed out → /login
 * - Loading    → spinner
 */
export default function AppRootRedirect() {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const previewBypass = isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled();

  if (previewBypass) {
    return <Navigate to="/app" replace />;
  }

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-background">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isSignedIn) {
    return <Navigate to="/app" replace />;
  }

  return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
}
````

````typescript
import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import type { ViewerEntitlements } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";

interface RequireFeatureEntitlementProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  feature: keyof Pick<
    ViewerEntitlements,
    "canUseTeamCollaboration" | "canUseSlackDestinations" | "canUseWebhookDestinations" | "canUseAdvancedAlerts" | "canUseFileManager"
  >;
  fallbackPath?: string;
}

export function RequireFeatureEntitlement({
  children,
  feature,
  fallbackPath = "/app/billing",
}: RequireFeatureEntitlementProps) {
  const { data: viewer, isLoading } = useViewerState();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[40vh] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!viewer?.entitlements?.[feature]) {
    return <Navigate to={fallbackPath} replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}
````

## File: src/hooks/useDedicatedDeployment.ts
````typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useOrganizationList } from "@clerk/react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { dedicatedDeploymentApi } from "@/services/dedicated-deployment-api";
import type {
  DedicatedDeploymentIntake,
  DedicatedDeploymentRecord,
  DedicatedIntakeState,
  DedicatedIntakeStep,
} from "@/types/dedicated";

export const DEDICATED_STEPS: DedicatedIntakeStep[] = [
  "scope",
  "infrastructure",
  "security",
  "integrations",
  "readiness",
  "review",
  "submitted",
];

export const DEFAULT_DEDICATED_INTAKE: DedicatedDeploymentIntake = {
  companyName: "",
  primaryContactName: "",
  primaryContactEmail: "",
  buyerRole: "",
  targetGoLiveWindow: "30_days",
  estimatedNodeRange: "6_15",
  environmentCount: 1,
  preferredRegion: "eu-central",
  secondaryRegions: [],
  needsCustomDomain: true,
  needsPrivateNetworking: false,
  complianceNeeds: [],
  retentionRequirementDays: 365,
  requiresSSO: true,
  integrations: [],
  technicalOwnerName: "",
  technicalOwnerEmail: "",
  operatorSeatEstimate: 5,
  hasExistingDockerAgentRollout: false,
  rolloutNotes: "",
  blockers: "",
};

function sanitizeOrgName(value: string) {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return trimmed.length > 2 ? trimmed : "Dedicated Deployment";
}

async function waitForActiveOrganization(maxAttempts = 12) {
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt += 1) {
    const data = await apiFetch("/auth/me");
    const activeOrgId = data.user?.active_org_id as string | null | undefined;
    if (activeOrgId) {
      return activeOrgId;
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 500 * attempt));
  }

  throw new Error("Workspace sync is still in progress. Please retry in a moment.");
}

export function useDedicatedDeployment() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["dedicated-deployment", "current"],
    queryFn: () => dedicatedDeploymentApi.getCurrent(),
    staleTime: 15_000,
    retry: false,
  });
}

export function useDedicatedIntakeState() {
  const { createOrganization, setActive, userMemberships } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: { infinite: true },
  });

  const [state, setState] = useState<DedicatedIntakeState>({
    step: "scope",
    data: DEFAULT_DEDICATED_INTAKE,
    isSaving: false,
    isSubmitting: false,
    submitError: null,
    referenceId: null,
  });

  const stepIndex = useMemo(() => DEDICATED_STEPS.indexOf(state.step), [state.step]);

  const updateField = <K extends keyof DedicatedDeploymentIntake>(key: K, value: DedicatedDeploymentIntake[K]) => {
    setState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      data: {
        ...current.data,
        [key]: value,
      },
      submitError: null,
    }));
  };

  const toggleArrayValue = (
    key: "secondaryRegions" | "complianceNeeds" | "integrations",
    value: string,
  ) => {
    setState((current) => {
      const existing = current.data[key] as string[];
      const next = existing.includes(value)
        ? existing.filter((item) => item !== value)
        : [...existing, value];

      return {
        ...current,
        data: {
          ...current.data,
          [key]: next,
        },
        submitError: null,
      };
    });
  };

  const nextStep = () => {
    setState((current) => {
      const currentIndex = DEDICATED_STEPS.indexOf(current.step);
      const next = DEDICATED_STEPS[Math.min(currentIndex + 1, DEDICATED_STEPS.length - 2)];
      return { ...current, step: next, submitError: null };
    });
  };

  const previousStep = () => {
    setState((current) => {
      const currentIndex = DEDICATED_STEPS.indexOf(current.step);
      const prev = DEDICATED_STEPS[Math.max(currentIndex - 1, 0)];
      return { ...current, step: prev, submitError: null };
    });
  };

  const ensureWorkspace = async () => {
    const auth = await apiFetch("/auth/me");
    const activeOrgId = auth.user?.active_org_id as string | null | undefined;
    if (activeOrgId) {
      return activeOrgId;
    }

    const firstMembership = userMemberships.data?.[0]?.organization?.id;
    if (firstMembership && setActive) {
      await setActive({ organization: firstMembership });
      return waitForActiveOrganization();
    }

    if (!createOrganization || !setActive) {
      throw new Error("Workspace tools are not ready yet. Please refresh and try again.");
    }

    const org = await createOrganization({ name: sanitizeOrgName(state.data.companyName) });
    await setActive({ organization: org.id });
    return waitForActiveOrganization();
  };

  const submit = async (): Promise<DedicatedDeploymentRecord> => {
    setState((current) => ({ ...current, isSubmitting: true, submitError: null }));

    try {
      await ensureWorkspace();
      const result = await dedicatedDeploymentApi.create(state.data);
      setState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        step: "submitted",
        isSubmitting: false,
        referenceId: result.reference_id,
      }));
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not submit the deployment request.";
      setState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        isSubmitting: false,
        submitError: message,
      }));
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return {
    state,
    stepIndex,
    updateField,
    toggleArrayValue,
    nextStep,
    previousStep,
    submit,
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { normalizeHostMetricsPoint } from "./useHostMetrics";

describe("normalizeHostMetricsPoint", () => {
  it("successfully normalizes a valid camelCase sample", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      memory: 60,
      usedCores: 2,
      totalCores: 4,
      memoryUsed: 8000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000,
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.cpu).toBe(45);
    expect(result?.totalCores).toBe(4);
  });

  it("successfully normalizes a valid snake_case sample", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      memory: 60,
      used_cores: 2,
      total_cores: 4,
      memory_used: 8000000000,
      memory_limit: 16000000000,
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.usedCores).toBe(2);
    expect(result?.totalCores).toBe(4);
  });

  it("returns null for missing core fields", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      // memory missing
      usedCores: 2,
      totalCores: 4,
      memoryUsed: 8000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000,
    };
    expect(normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("clamps out of range values instead of returning null", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 105, // > 100
      memory: -10, // < 0
      usedCores: 10, 
      totalCores: 4, // used > total
      memoryUsed: 20000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000, // used > limit
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.cpu).toBe(100);
    expect(result?.memory).toBe(0);
    expect(result?.usedCores).toBe(4); // clamped to total
    expect(result?.memoryUsed).toBe(16000000000); // clamped to limit
  });

  it("handles empty strings and nulls correctly in toFiniteNumber", () => {
    const raw = {
      timestamp: 1625097600000,
      cpu: 45,
      memory: 60,
      usedCores: 2,
      totalCores: 4,
      memoryUsed: 8000000000,
      memoryLimit: 16000000000,
      networkInBytesPerSec: "", // Should become null, not 0
    };
    const result = normalizeHostMetricsPoint(raw as any);
    expect(result?.networkInBytesPerSec).toBeNull();
  });
});
````

## File: src/hooks/useNotifications.ts
````typescript
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import * as api from "../services/notification-api";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Notification } from "../types/database";

export const NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY = ["notifications"];

export function useNotifications(organizationId: string | null) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const previousNotificationsRef = useRef<Notification[]>([]);

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId],
    queryFn: () => {
      if (!organizationId) throw new Error("Missing organization ID");
      return api.getNotifications(organizationId);
    },
    enabled: !!organizationId,
    refetchInterval: 30000, // Poll every 30 seconds
  });

  // Check for newly arrived notifications to trigger toasts
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query.data) return;

    const previousIds = new Set(previousNotificationsRef.current.map((n) => n.id));
    const newNotifications = query.data.filter((n) => !previousIds.has(n.id));

    // Only toast if this isn't the first load (previous is not empty)
    if (previousNotificationsRef.current.length > 0 && newNotifications.length > 0) {
      newNotifications.forEach((n) => {
        // Find the right toast type
        const toastFn = n.type === "error" ? toast.error 
          : n.type === "success" ? toast.success 
          : n.type === "warning" ? toast.warning 
          : toast.info;

        toastFn(n.title, {
          description: n.message,
          duration: 5000,
        });
      });
    }

    previousNotificationsRef.current = query.data;
  }, [query.data]);

  return {
    ...query,
    unreadCount: query.data?.length || 0,
  };
}

export function useDismissNotification(organizationId: string | null) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (notificationId: string) => api.dismissNotification(notificationId),
    onMutate: async (notificationId) => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
      
      const previous = queryClient.getQueryData<Notification[]>([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId]);
      
      // Optimistically remove from list
      if (previous) {
        queryClient.setQueryData<Notification[]>(
          [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId],
          previous.filter((n) => n.id !== notificationId)
        );
      }
      
      return { previous };
    },
    onError: (err, newTodo, context) => {
      if (context?.previous) {
        queryClient.setQueryData([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId], context.previous);
      }
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
    },
  });
}

export function useDismissAllNotifications(organizationId: string | null) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => {
      if (!organizationId) throw new Error("Missing organization ID");
      return api.dismissAllNotifications(organizationId);
    },
    onMutate: async () => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
      const previous = queryClient.getQueryData<Notification[]>([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId]);
      
      // Optimistically clear all
      queryClient.setQueryData<Notification[]>([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId], []);
      
      return { previous };
    },
    onError: (err, newTodo, context) => {
      if (context?.previous) {
        queryClient.setQueryData([...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId], context.previous);
      }
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...NOTIFICATIONS_QUERY_KEY, organizationId] });
    },
  });
}
````
