````typescript
const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api';

import { summarizeDiagnosticText } from "../../shared/lib/diagnostics";

type ClerkSession = {
  getToken?: (options?: { skipCache?: boolean }) => Promise<string | null>;
};

type ClerkGlobal = {
  loaded?: boolean;
  session?: ClerkSession | null;
};

export interface ApiErrorBody {
  error?: string;
  code?: string;
  details?: unknown;
  title?: string;
  detail?: string;
  type?: string;
  upstream_status?: number;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

function trimErrorText(value: string, maxLength = 220) {
  return value.length > maxLength ? `${value.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...` : value;
}

function decodeHtmlEntities(value: string) {
  return value
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'");
}

export function summarizeApiErrorText(rawText: string, status?: number) {
  const trimmed = rawText.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return status ? `Request failed (${status})` : "Request failed";
  }

  if (/<(?:!doctype|html|head|body)\b/i.test(trimmed)) {
    const titleMatch = trimmed.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
    const title = titleMatch
      ? decodeHtmlEntities(titleMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())
      : null;
    const isCloudflare = /cloudflare/i.test(trimmed);

    if (isCloudflare && status === 502) {
      return title
        ? `Cloudflare gateway error: ${title}. Verify the saved host URL, tunnel or reverse proxy, and the Watchtower agent service.`
        : "Cloudflare gateway error. Verify the saved host URL, tunnel or reverse proxy, and the Watchtower agent service.";
    }

    if (title) {
      return `HTML error response: ${trimErrorText(title)}`;
    }

    return status ? `HTML error response (${status})` : "HTML error response";
  }

  return trimErrorText(trimmed.replace(/\s+/g, " "));
}

export function buildApiErrorMessage(status: number, body: ApiErrorBody | null, rawText: string) {
  if (typeof body?.error === "string" && body.error.trim()) {
    const message = body.error.trim();
    const details =
      typeof body.details === "string" && body.details.trim()
        ? body.details.trim()
        : null;
    return details ? `${message}: ${details}` : message;
  }

  if (typeof body?.title === "string" && body.title.trim()) {
    const title = body.title.trim();
    const detail =
      typeof body.detail === "string" && body.detail.trim()
        ? body.detail.trim()
        : null;
    return detail ? `${title}: ${detail}` : title;
  }

  return summarizeApiErrorText(rawText, status);
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  body: ApiErrorBody | null;
  rawText: string;
  details: unknown;
  code?: string;
  upstreamStatus?: number;

  constructor(status: number, body: ApiErrorBody | null, rawText: string) {
    super(buildApiErrorMessage(status, body, rawText));
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.body = body;
    this.rawText = rawText;
    this.details = body?.details ?? body?.detail;
    this.code = typeof body?.code === "string" ? body.code : undefined;
    this.upstreamStatus =
      typeof body?.upstream_status === "number" ? body.upstream_status : undefined;
  }
}

function wait(ms: number) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function getClerkGlobal(): ClerkGlobal | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  return ((window as unknown as { Clerk?: ClerkGlobal }).Clerk) ?? null;
}

async function getClerkSessionToken(forceFresh = false) {
  const tokenOptions = forceFresh ? { skipCache: true } : undefined;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
    const clerk = getClerkGlobal();
    const getToken = clerk?.session?.getToken;

    if (getToken) {
      const token = await getToken(tokenOptions);
      if (token || clerk?.loaded !== false) {
        return token ?? null;
      }
    } else if (clerk?.loaded) {
      return null;
    }

    if (attempt < 4) {
      await wait(50 * (attempt + 1));
    }
  }

  return null;
}

interface ApiFetchOptions extends RequestInit {
  requireAuth?: boolean;
}

export async function apiFetch(path: string, options: ApiFetchOptions = {}) {
  const { requireAuth = true, ...requestOptions } = options;
  let token = await getClerkSessionToken(false);
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...((requestOptions.headers as Record<string, string>) || {}),
  };

  if (token) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  } else if (requireAuth) {
    throw new ApiError(
      401,
      {
        error: "Authentication required",
        code: "missing_session_token",
        details: "Clerk did not return a session token for this request.",
      },
      "Authentication required",
    );
  }

  const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {
    ...requestOptions,
    headers,
  };

  // Handle body for POST/PUT requests
  if (requestOptions.body && typeof requestOptions.body === 'string') {
    fetchOptions.body = requestOptions.body;
  } else if (requestOptions.body) {
    fetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(requestOptions.body);
  }

  let response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, fetchOptions);

  if (response.status === 401 && token) {
    token = await getClerkSessionToken(true);
    if (token) {
      headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
      response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
        ...fetchOptions,
        headers,
      });
    }
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text();
    let errorData: ApiErrorBody | null = null;
    try {
      errorData = JSON.parse(errorText);
    } catch {
      errorData = errorText ? { error: summarizeDiagnosticText(errorText) } : null;
    }
    throw new ApiError(response.status, errorData, errorText);
  }

  return response.json();
}

          <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
          {problem}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground group-open:rotate-180 transition-transform shrink-0 ml-4" />
      </summary>
      <div className="mt-3 ml-[22px] space-y-2 text-sm">
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
            Likely cause
          </span>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{cause}</p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
            What to do
          </span>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{fix}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}

            <Section id="how-connection-works" icon={Cable} title="How the Connection Works">
              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">The short answer</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  Docker does <strong>not</strong> connect to Docker Dashboard on its own. Instead,
                  a small program called the <strong>Watchtower Agent</strong> runs on your Docker
                  host. When you use the dashboard, your requests go through our backend, which calls
                  the agent, and the agent talks to Docker on your behalf.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">What is the Watchtower Agent?</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  The Watchtower Agent is a lightweight HTTPS server that you run alongside Docker on
                  your host machine. It acts as a secure bridge between Docker Dashboard and your
                  Docker Engine. The agent:
                </p>
                <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1.5 list-disc ml-4">
                  <li>Listens for authenticated HTTPS requests from the Docker Dashboard backend</li>
                  <li>Verifies the API key on every request</li>
                  <li>Forwards the request to the Docker socket on your host</li>
                  <li>Returns the Docker API response back to the dashboard</li>
                </ul>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  Your Docker socket is <strong>never</strong> exposed to the internet. The agent is
                  the only thing that talks to Docker directly.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">How it flows</h3>
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/20 p-4 font-mono text-xs space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">You (Browser)</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">→ Request authenticated with your login session</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-2 ml-0 sm:ml-4">
                    <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">Docker Dashboard Backend</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">→ Verifies your identity, decrypts the stored API key</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-2 ml-0 sm:ml-8">
                    <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">Watchtower Agent</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">→ Validates API key, forwards to Docker</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-2 ml-0 sm:ml-12">
                    <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">Docker Engine</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">→ Executes the action (list containers, fetch logs, start/stop, etc.)</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Every request follows this chain. The dashboard never connects to Docker directly.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">What the dashboard stores from you</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  When you add a host, the dashboard saves the following:
                </p>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-xs border border-border rounded-md">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-muted/30">
                        <th className="text-left p-2 font-medium">What is stored</th>
                        <th className="text-left p-2 font-medium">How</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="text-muted-foreground">
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Host name</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Plain text — it's just a display label you choose</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Agent URL or Tunnel URL</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Plain text — the HTTPS address of your agent</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Connection mode</td>
                        <td className="p-2">"agent" (direct) or "cloudflare_tunnel"</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Agent API Key</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). Decrypted only server-side when calling the agent. <strong>Never returned to the browser</strong> after saving.</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Docker Socket Path</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Optional — defaults to <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">/var/run/docker.sock</code></td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">CF Access Service Token ID & Secret</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Optional, only for CF Tunnel mode. Encrypted at rest like the API key.</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">What happens during a connection test</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  When you click <strong>"Save & Test Connection"</strong>, two things happen:
                </p>
                <ol className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-2 list-decimal ml-4 leading-relaxed">
                  <li>
                    <strong>A ping is sent to the agent</strong> — the backend sends a request to your
                    agent's <code className="text-xs bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 rounded">/_ping</code> endpoint.
                    This confirms the agent is reachable and Docker is responding.
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    <strong>Docker version is fetched</strong> — if the ping succeeds, the backend also
                    calls the agent's <code className="text-xs bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 rounded">/version</code>{" "}
                    endpoint and records your Docker version and OS info.
                  </li>
                </ol>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  If both succeed, the host status is set to <strong className="text-emerald-500">connected</strong>.
                  If the ping fails, the status is set to <strong className="text-amber-500">error</strong>,
                  but the host is still saved — you can fix the issue and re-test later.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">What happens after a host is saved</h3>
                <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1.5 list-disc ml-4">
                  <li>The host appears in your Hosts list and on the dashboard</li>
                  <li>Every time you view containers, fetch logs, or perform actions, the backend proxies requests through the agent to Docker</li>
                  <li>A server-side health poller periodically pings each host and updates its status automatically</li>
                  <li>Host data (containers, stats, logs) refreshes automatically every 30 seconds in the dashboard</li>
                </ul>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Direct vs. Cloudflare Tunnel — in plain language</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Terminal className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium">Agent (Direct)</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                      The dashboard's backend connects directly to your agent over the internet via
                      HTTPS. Your agent needs to be reachable at a public URL or IP address. This is
                      the simpler option if your server has a public IP or domain.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <CloudCog className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium">Agent via CF Tunnel</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                      Same Watchtower Agent, but accessed through a Cloudflare Tunnel. The agent does
                      not need to be directly reachable from the internet — the tunnel handles routing.
                      Use this if your host is behind a firewall, NAT, or you don't want to open any
                      inbound ports.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Both modes use the same agent and the same API key. The only difference is how the
                  network traffic reaches the agent.
                </p>
              </div>

              <Callout type="success" title="How to know it worked">
                <ul className="list-disc ml-4 space-y-1 mt-1">
                  <li>Host status shows <strong className="text-emerald-400">connected</strong> in the Hosts table</li>
                  <li>A Docker version number appears in the Docker column</li>
                  <li>Going to Containers shows containers from that host</li>
                  <li>You can fetch logs and view container details without errors</li>
                </ul>
              </Callout>

              <Callout type="warning" title="If this fails">
                <p className="mb-2">The most common failure causes, based on the app's behavior:</p>
                <ul className="list-disc ml-4 space-y-1">
                  <li><strong>Wrong agent URL</strong> — must include <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded text-xs">https://</code> and the correct port</li>
                  <li><strong>API key mismatch</strong> — the key you entered must exactly match what the agent is configured with</li>
                  <li><strong>Agent not running</strong> — the agent process must be active on the Docker host</li>
                  <li><strong>Firewall blocking</strong> — the agent's port must be reachable from the internet (Direct mode) or the CF Tunnel must be active (Tunnel mode)</li>
                  <li><strong>CF Access misconfigured</strong> — if using CF Access, the service token ID and secret must be correct</li>
                  <li><strong>Docker not running</strong> — the Docker Engine must be running on the host for the agent to respond</li>
                </ul>
                <p className="mt-2">The host is still saved even if the test fails. You can fix the issue and re-test from the Hosts page.</p>
              </Callout>
            </Section>

            {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
                2 — CONNECT YOUR FIRST HOST
               ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <Section id="connect-host" icon={Server} title="Connect Your First Host">

                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">

                        <CloudCog className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />

                <Step n={3} title="Fill in the required fields">
                  <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full text-xs border border-border rounded-md">
                      <thead>
                        <tr className="bg-muted/30">
                          <th className="text-left p-2 font-medium">Field</th>
                          <th className="text-left p-2 font-medium">Required</th>
                          <th className="text-left p-2 font-medium">What it is</th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody className="text-muted-foreground">
                        <tr className="border-t border-border">
                          <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Host Name</td>

                          <td className="p-2">Yes</td>

                        </tr>
                        <tr className="border-t border-border">
                          <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Docker Socket Path</td>
                          <td className="p-2">No</td>
                          <td className="p-2">Defaults to <code className="bg-muted px-1 rounded">/var/run/docker.sock</code></td>

                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">

                </p>

                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide mt-4">Metric cards</h4>

                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-muted/30">
                        <th className="text-left p-2 font-medium">Card</th>
                        <th className="text-left p-2 font-medium">What it shows</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="text-muted-foreground">
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Total Hosts</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Number of Docker hosts registered in this organization</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Connected</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Hosts where the last health check succeeded (status = "connected")</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Containers</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Total containers across all connected hosts (all states)</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-t border-border">
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium text-foreground">Running</td>
                        <td className="p-2">Containers currently in the "running" state</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide mt-4">Below the cards</h4>
                <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1.5 list-disc ml-4">
                  <li><strong>Recent Containers</strong> — shows up to 8 containers with name, image, state badge, and host name. Click any to view details.</li>
                  <li><strong>Host Status</strong> — lists all registered hosts with their name, URL, and connection status. Click to view host details.</li>
                </ul>

                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide mt-4">Host status values</h4>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500">connected</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-500/15 text-red-500">unhealthy</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500">error</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground">unknown</span>

                </p>

                  <li><strong>Host</strong> — which registered host the container is on</li>
                  <li><strong>Image</strong> — the Docker image name</li>
                  <li><strong>Status</strong> — Docker's human-readable status (e.g. "Up 3 hours")</li>

                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Container detail view</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold mb-1">Overview</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      CPU usage %, memory usage (bytes and %), restart count, and a details
                      panel with name, ID, image, status, start/finish times, restart policy,
                      PID, and exit code. Stats refresh every 10 seconds.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold mb-1">Logs</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      Last 200 lines of container output. Displayed in a monospace viewer.
                      Click "Refresh" to fetch new lines.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold mb-1">Environment</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      Lists all environment variables set on the container (key=value pairs
                      from the container's configuration).
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold mb-1">Networking</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      Shows Docker networks the container is attached to, its IP address on
                      each network, and any port bindings.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Supported actions</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  From the container detail page header, you can:
                </p>
                <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1 list-disc ml-4">
                  <li><strong>Start</strong> — available when the container is stopped</li>
                  <li><strong>Stop</strong> — available when the container is running</li>
                  <li><strong>Restart</strong> — available any time</li>
                </ul>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  These actions are proxied through the backend to the Docker Engine API on the host.
                </p>
              </div>

              <Callout type="info" title="Refresh behavior">
                The container list refreshes every 30 seconds. Container stats (CPU/memory) on the
                detail page refresh every 10 seconds. Logs are fetched on-demand and not streamed.
              </Callout>

              <Callout type="warning" title="What is not supported">
                <ul className="list-disc ml-4 space-y-1 mt-1">
                  <li>Exec / shell into containers</li>
                  <li>Creating or removing containers</li>
                  <li>Image management (pull, build, remove)</li>
                  <li>Volume or network management</li>
                </ul>
              </Callout>
            </Section>

            {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
                5 — LOGS
               ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <Section id="logs" icon={FileText} title="Logs">
              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-1">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-4">How to fetch logs</h3>

                <Step n={1} title="Select a host">
                  <p>
                    Open <strong>Logs</strong> from the sidebar. Choose a host from the dropdown.
                    Only hosts with status <strong className="text-emerald-500">connected</strong> appear
                    in the list.
                  </p>
                </Step>

                <Step n={2} title="Select a container">
                  <p>
                    After selecting a host, the container dropdown populates with all containers on
                    that host (including stopped ones). Select the container you want logs from.
                  </p>
                </Step>

                <Step n={3} title='Click "Fetch Logs"'>
                  <p>
                    The last <strong>300 lines</strong> of the container's stdout/stderr are fetched
                    from the Docker Engine API and displayed in a monospace log viewer.
                  </p>
                </Step>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-3">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Filtering</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  After logs are loaded, a text filter input appears. Type any text to filter the
                  displayed lines. Filtering is <strong>case-insensitive</strong> and happens client-side
                  against the currently loaded log lines.
                </p>
              </div>

              <Callout type="warning" title="Limitations">
                <ul className="list-disc ml-4 space-y-1 mt-1">
                  <li>Logs are fetched <strong>on-demand</strong>, not streamed in real time</li>
                  <li>Each fetch returns the last 300 lines only</li>
                  <li>No log persistence, export, or download</li>
                  <li>No cross-container log aggregation</li>
                  <li>You can also view logs (last 200 lines) in the container detail page's Logs tab</li>
                </ul>
              </Callout>
            </Section>

            {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
                6 — ORGANIZATIONS & ACCESS
               ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <Section id="organizations" icon={Users} title="Organizations & Access">
              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">How organizations work</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  Each organization is a separate workspace with its own Docker hosts and members.
                  All data (hosts, containers, settings) is isolated per organization — backend API queries
                  always scope to the active organization.
                </p>
                <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1.5 list-disc ml-4">
                  <li>You create your first organization during onboarding</li>
                  <li>You can create additional organizations from the <strong>Organizations</strong> page</li>
                  <li>Switch between organizations using the organization switcher in the top bar</li>
                </ul>
              </div>

              <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Members</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  The <strong>Members</strong> page shows a read-only list of organization members with
                  their name, role (owner or member), and join date. Organization membership is managed
                  through Clerk.
                </p>
              </div>

              <Callout type="info" title="What you see on the Organizations page">
                Each organization card shows the org name, slug, number of connected hosts, and a list
                of hosts with their status. Click a host to go to its detail page.
              </Callout>
            </Section>

            {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
                7 — TROUBLESHOOTING
               ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <Section id="troubleshooting" icon={HelpCircle} title="Troubleshooting">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                Click any issue below to see the likely cause and what to do.
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <TroubleshootRow
                  problem='Host shows "error" or "unhealthy" status'
                  cause="The server-side health poller cannot reach the agent. This is updated after consecutive failed pings. The host's last_error and consecutive_failures fields track this."
                  fix='Go to Hosts → click the host → click "Test Connection". Check that the agent URL is correct, the agent process is running, your firewall allows outbound HTTPS, and the API key matches. For CF Tunnel hosts, verify the tunnel is active.'
                />
                <TroubleshootRow
                  problem="No containers appear on the Containers page"
                  cause="Either no hosts are connected, or connected hosts have no Docker containers running."
                  fix='Check the dashboard — if "Connected" is 0, your hosts are unreachable. Fix host connectivity first. If hosts are connected but you still see no containers, verify that Docker containers exist on those hosts (docker ps -a).'
                />
                <TroubleshootRow
                  problem="Logs are not appearing"
                  cause="Logs are fetched on-demand, not streamed. The host must be connected and the container must exist."
                  fix='Select a host with status "connected", select a container, and click "Fetch Logs". If the host is not connected, fix the connection first. If you see an error, the agent may not be able to reach the Docker socket.'
                />
                <TroubleshootRow
                  problem="Connection test fails when adding a host"
                  cause="The agent URL is unreachable, the API key is wrong, or the agent is not running."
                  fix='Verify the agent URL format (must include https:// and port). Ensure the API key matches the agent configuration. Check that the agent is running on the host. The host is saved even if the test fails — you can re-test later from the Hosts page.'
                />
                <TroubleshootRow
                  problem="Dashboard shows empty state after login"
                  cause="You have an organization but no Docker hosts connected to it yet."
                  fix='This is normal for new accounts. Click "Connect Your First Host" on the empty dashboard or go to Hosts to add one.'
                />
                <TroubleshootRow
                  problem='"No active organization found" error'
                  cause="The Clerk session may not have synced the organization membership yet."
                  fix='Refresh the page. If the problem persists, go to Organizations and verify you are a member of at least one organization.'
                />
              </div>
            </Section>

            {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
                8 — CURRENT LIMITATIONS
               ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <Section id="limitations" icon={Construction} title="Current Limitations">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                The following features are in the product roadmap but show a "Coming Soon" placeholder
                in the app today. They are not functional.
              </p>
              <div className="glass-card overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-border bg-muted/30">
                      <th className="text-left p-3 font-medium text-muted-foreground text-xs">Feature</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-3 font-medium text-muted-foreground text-xs">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {[
                      ["Monitoring dashboards (CPU, memory, network, disk charts)", "Placeholder — page exists with \"Coming Soon\" message"],
                      ["Alert rules (container failures, resource thresholds, restart loops)", "Placeholder"],
                      ["Incident management (timelines, impacted services)", "Placeholder"],
                      ["Deployment tracking (image change detection, rollback, CI/CD)", "Placeholder"],
                      ["Billing & subscriptions", "Placeholder"],
                      ["Settings — General, API Keys, Webhooks, Notifications, Audit Logs, Danger Zone tabs", "Placeholder — only the Profile tab is functional"],
                      ["Log streaming (real-time)", "Not available — logs are fetched on-demand"],
                      ["Log export / download", "Not available"],
                      ["Container exec / shell access", "Not supported"],
                      ["Image, volume, and network management", "Not supported"],
                      ["Docs search", "Disabled"],
                    ].map(([feature, status]) => (
                      <tr key={feature} className="border-b border-border last:border-0">
                        <td className="p-3 text-sm">{feature}</td>

                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </Section>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* CTA */}
      <section className="py-16 border-t border-border">
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto px-4 text-center">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-3">Ready to get started?</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-6">Create your account and connect your first Docker host in under 5 minutes.</p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <Link to="/contact"><Button size="lg" variant="outline">Contact Support</Button></Link>
            <Link to="/login"><Button size="lg" className="gap-2">Get Started <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" /></Button></Link>
          </div>
        </div>

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="border-t border-border py-8 bg-card/30">
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">

import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { Notification } from "../types/database";

const API_BASE = "/notifications";

export const getNotifications = async (
  organizationId: string | null
): Promise<Notification[]> => {
  const queryParams = organizationId ? `?organizationId=${organizationId}` : '';
  const response = await apiFetch(`${API_BASE}${queryParams}`) as { notifications: Notification[] };
  return response.notifications;
};

export const dismissNotification = async (
  notificationId: string
): Promise<void> => {
  await apiFetch(`${API_BASE}/${notificationId}/dismiss`, {
    method: "POST"
  });
};

export const dismissAllNotifications = async (
  organizationId: string | null
): Promise<void> => {
  await apiFetch(`${API_BASE}/dismiss-all`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: { organizationId },
  });
};
````

## File: src/main.tsx
````typescript
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import App from "./App.tsx";
import "./index.css";

// Force reload on module fetch failure (e.g. after a deployment with new hashes)
window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (event) => {
  if (
    event.reason?.name === "ChunkLoadError" || 
    event.reason?.message?.includes("Failed to fetch dynamically imported module") ||
    event.reason?.message?.includes("Importing a module script failed")
  ) {
    console.warn("Module loading error detected, forcing reload...", event.reason);
    window.location.reload();
  }
});

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(<App />);
````

## File: AGENTS.md
````markdown
Memory system: Obsidian vault

This environment uses an Obsidian vault as long-term shared memory.

Rules:

1. Before creating new information, check if relevant knowledge already exists.
2. Prefer updating existing notes over creating duplicates.
3. After completing any meaningful task (planning, debugging, implementation, architecture):
   - evaluate if the result is reusable
   - if yes, write it to the Obsidian vault

Memory routing:
- Active project state → 10_Flow/Projects/
- Agent continuation → 10_Flow/Handoffs/
- Reusable knowledge (patterns, decisions, lessons) → 20_Atlas/
- Tools / systems → 30_Entities/
- External references → 40_Sources/

A task is not considered complete until relevant reusable knowledge is stored in Obsidian.

Do not store secrets, credentials, or runtime data in notes.
````

````markdown
---
phase: code-review
reviewed: 2025-03-25T14:30:00Z
depth: standard
files_reviewed: 2
files_reviewed_list:
  - src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts
  - src/components/hosts/HostWorkspace.tsx
findings:
  critical: 0
  warning: 3
  info: 3
  total: 6
status: issues_found
---

# Code Review Report

**Reviewed:** 2025-03-25
**Depth:** standard
**Files Reviewed:** 2
**Status:** issues_found

## Summary

The review focused on host metrics processing logic and the main host workspace component. The primary concerns involve high cyclomatic complexity in metrics normalization and overly strict/fragile data parsing that may lead to "all-or-nothing" UI failures when minor data discrepancies occur.

## Critical Issues

*No critical issues found.*

## Warnings

### WR-01: High Cyclomatic Complexity in Metrics Normalization

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:101`
**Issue:** The `normalizeHostMetricsPoint` function has a cyclomatic complexity of 28. It performs field extraction (supporting both snake_case and camelCase), normalization, and multiple complex validation checks in a single block. This makes the logic difficult to test, maintain, and extend.
**Fix:**
Break the function into smaller, focused utilities:
1. `extractMetrics(point: HostMetricsApiPoint)`: Handle the dual-naming convention and initial coercion.
2. `validateMetricsRanges(metrics: HostMetricsPoint)`: Handle the numerical range checks.
3. `isMetricsSampleValid(metrics: HostMetricsPoint)`: Handle the logical consistency checks (e.g., totalCores vs CPU).

### WR-02: Overly Strict Validation Discards Mostly-Valid Samples

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:119-152`
**Issue:** The normalization logic returns `null` (causing the UI to show "Metrics unavailable") if *any* core metric is missing or slightly out of range. If an agent version fails to report `usedCores` but reports everything else correctly, the entire dashboard view for that host breaks.
**Fix:**
Implement a more resilient normalization strategy:
- Use clamping for values slightly out of range (e.g., `Math.min(100, Math.max(0, cpu))`).
- Allow optional fields to be `null` in the resulting object instead of discarding the whole point, and handle these `null` values gracefully in the UI components.

### WR-03: Weak Type Coercion in Utility Functions

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:63, 68`
**Issue:** `toFiniteNumber` and `toTimestamp` use `Number(value)` which converts `null` and `""` (empty string) to `0`. This can lead to misleading data (e.g., a missing CPU metric being displayed as `0%` or a missing timestamp being interpreted as Jan 1, 1970) instead of being treated as "missing".
**Fix:**
```typescript
function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (value === null || value === "" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const numeric = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}
```

## Info

### IN-01: Large Component Complexity (Oversized File)

**File:** `src/components/hosts/HostWorkspace.tsx`
**Issue:** The `HostWorkspace` component is large (300+ lines) and contains significant logic for filtering, sorting, routing, and rendering multiple sub-views. While functional, it is becoming a "God Component".
**Fix:**
Extract sub-components like `HostSidebar` and `SelectedHostView` into their own files. Move the host filtering and selection logic into a custom hook (e.g., `useHostSelection`).

### IN-02: API Contract Inconsistency

**File:** `src/hooks/useHostMetrics.ts:40-117`
**Issue:** Extensive support for both `snake_case` and `camelCase` (e.g., `networkInBytesPerSec ?? network_in_bytes_per_sec`) suggests an inconsistent API contract or technical debt from migrating between agent versions.
**Fix:**
Ideally, standardize the API response at the source or at the edge (e.g., in `dockerApi` service) using a consistent transformer, so hooks don't need to carry this mapping logic.

### IN-03: Hardcoded Configuration (Magic Numbers)

**File:** `src/components/hosts/HostWorkspace.tsx:210, 212`
**Issue:** Refresh intervals (`15000`, `10000`) are hardcoded directly in the component.
**Fix:**
Move these to a configuration constant or a default options object in the hooks.

---

_Reviewed: 2025-03-25_
_Reviewer: gsd-code-reviewer_
_Depth: standard_
````

const headers = {

  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS",

};

function json(data: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers });
}

async function readBody(req: Request) {

}

function parsePath(req: Request) {

  return (url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/admin/, "") || "/").split("/").filter(Boolean);
}

function toBoolean(value: unknown) {

}

function toNullableTimestamp(value: unknown) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) return null;
  const parsed = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed.toISOString();
}

async function getOverview() {
  const [orgCount, userCount, activeHosts, suspendedUsers, lockedOrgs, quarantinedHosts] = await Promise.all([
    sql<{ count: string }[]>`SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM public.organizations`,
    sql<{ count: string }[]>`SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM public.users`,
    sql<{ count: string }[]>`SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM public.docker_hosts WHERE status = 'connected'`,
    sql<{ count: string }[]>`SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM public.user_access_controls WHERE is_suspended = true OR is_hard_disabled = true`,
    sql<{ count: string }[]>`SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM public.organization_access_controls WHERE is_locked = true`,
    sql<{ count: string }[]>`SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM public.docker_host_admin_controls WHERE is_quarantined = true`,
  ]);

  const recentOperations = await sql`
    SELECT
      id,
      operation_name,
      scope_type,
      scope_id,
      status,
      reason,
      result_summary,
      created_at
    FROM public.admin_operation_runs
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 10
  `;

  return {
    metrics: {
      total_organizations: Number(orgCount[0]?.count || "0"),
      total_users: Number(userCount[0]?.count || "0"),
      active_hosts: Number(activeHosts[0]?.count || "0"),
      suspended_users: Number(suspendedUsers[0]?.count || "0"),
      locked_organizations: Number(lockedOrgs[0]?.count || "0"),
      quarantined_hosts: Number(quarantinedHosts[0]?.count || "0"),
    },
    recent_operations: recentOperations.map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      created_at: new Date(String(row.created_at)).toISOString(),
    })),
  };
}

async function listUsers() {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      u.id,
      u.clerk_user_id,
      u.email,
      u.full_name,
      u.avatar_url,
      u.is_approved,
      u.created_at,
      COALESCE(uac.is_suspended, false) AS is_suspended,
      COALESCE(uac.is_hard_disabled, false) AS is_hard_disabled,
      uac.suspension_reason,
      COUNT(DISTINCT om.organization_id)::int AS organization_count
    FROM public.users u
    LEFT JOIN public.user_access_controls uac ON uac.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN public.organization_members om ON om.user_id = u.id
    GROUP BY u.id, uac.user_id
    ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
  `;

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    created_at: new Date(String(row.created_at)).toISOString(),
  }));
}

async function getUserDetail(userId: string) {
  const users = await sql`
    SELECT
      u.id,
      u.clerk_user_id,
      u.email,
      u.full_name,
      u.avatar_url,
      u.is_approved,
      u.created_at,
      COALESCE(uac.is_suspended, false) AS is_suspended,
      COALESCE(uac.is_hard_disabled, false) AS is_hard_disabled,
      uac.suspension_reason,
      uac.internal_notes
    FROM public.users u
    LEFT JOIN public.user_access_controls uac ON uac.user_id = u.id
    WHERE u.id = ${userId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (users.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const [memberships, bans] = await Promise.all([
    sql`
      SELECT
        o.id AS organization_id,
        o.name AS organization_name,
        om.role
      FROM public.organization_members om
      JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = om.organization_id
      WHERE om.user_id = ${userId}
      ORDER BY o.name ASC
    `,
    sql`
      SELECT
        b.organization_id,
        o.name AS organization_name,
        b.reason,
        b.created_at
      FROM public.organization_user_bans b
      JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = b.organization_id
      WHERE b.user_id = ${userId}
      ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
    `,
  ]);

  return {
    ...users[0],
    created_at: new Date(String(users[0].created_at)).toISOString(),
    memberships,
    organization_bans: bans.map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      created_at: new Date(String(row.created_at)).toISOString(),
    })),
  };
}

async function getOrganizationDetail(organizationId: string) {

    FROM public.organizations o

    WHERE o.id = ${organizationId}

  `;

  if (organizations.length === 0) {

      ORDER BY b.created_at DESC

  ]);

}

  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT id, is_approved
    FROM public.users
    WHERE id = ${userId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (before.length === 0) return json({ error: "User not found" }, 404);

  const updated = await sql`
    UPDATE public.users
    SET is_approved = ${approved}
    WHERE id = ${userId}
    RETURNING id, is_approved
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: approved ? "approve-user" : "revoke-user-approval",
    targetType: "user",
    targetId: userId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    afterState: updated[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    requestMetadata: { ip: req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") || null },
  });

  return json({ user: updated[0] });
}

async function mutateUserAccess(userId: string, mode: "suspend" | "unsuspend" | "hard-disable" | "hard-enable", req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  const notes = typeof body.internal_notes === "string" ? body.internal_notes.trim() : null;
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const users = await sql`
    SELECT u.id, u.clerk_user_id, u.email, COALESCE(uac.is_suspended, false) AS is_suspended, COALESCE(uac.is_hard_disabled, false) AS is_hard_disabled
    FROM public.users u
    LEFT JOIN public.user_access_controls uac ON uac.user_id = u.id
    WHERE u.id = ${userId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (users.length === 0) return json({ error: "User not found" }, 404);

  const before = users[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
  const user = users[0];
  const isSuspended = mode === "suspend" ? true : mode === "unsuspend" ? false : Boolean(user.is_suspended);
  const isHardDisabled = mode === "hard-disable" ? true : mode === "hard-enable" ? false : Boolean(user.is_hard_disabled);
  const suspensionReason = mode === "suspend" || mode === "hard-disable" ? reason : null;

  if (user.clerk_user_id) {
    if (mode === "hard-disable") {
      await clerkClient.users.banUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
      await clerkClient.users.lockUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
    } else if (mode === "hard-enable") {
      await clerkClient.users.unbanUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
      await clerkClient.users.unlockUser(String(user.clerk_user_id));
    }
  }

  const afterRows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.user_access_controls (
      user_id,
      is_suspended,
      is_hard_disabled,
      suspension_reason,
      internal_notes,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${userId},
      ${isSuspended},
      ${isHardDisabled},
      ${suspensionReason},
      ${notes},
      ${admin.auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      is_suspended = EXCLUDED.is_suspended,
      is_hard_disabled = EXCLUDED.is_hard_disabled,
      suspension_reason = EXCLUDED.suspension_reason,
      internal_notes = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.internal_notes, public.user_access_controls.internal_notes),
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
    RETURNING user_id, is_suspended, is_hard_disabled, suspension_reason, internal_notes
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: mode,
    targetType: "user",
    targetId: userId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before,
    afterState: afterRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  return json({ control: afterRows[0] });
}

async function addOrganizationBan(userId: string, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const organizationId = typeof body.organization_id === "string" ? body.organization_id : "";
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  if (!organizationId) return json({ error: "organization_id is required" }, 400);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT organization_id, user_id, reason
    FROM public.organization_user_bans
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId} AND user_id = ${userId}
  `;

  const afterRows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.organization_user_bans (organization_id, user_id, reason, created_by)
    VALUES (${organizationId}, ${userId}, ${reason}, ${admin.auth.userId})
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO UPDATE
    SET reason = EXCLUDED.reason, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, created_at = now()
    RETURNING organization_id, user_id, reason, created_at
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "add-org-ban",
    targetType: "organization-user-ban",
    targetId: `${organizationId}:${userId}`,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
    afterState: afterRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  return json({ ban: afterRows[0] }, 201);
}

async function updateOrganizationBilling(organizationId: string, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const plan = typeof body.plan === "string" ? body.plan : null;
  const subscriptionStatus = typeof body.subscription_status === "string" ? body.subscription_status : null;
  const currentPeriodEndsAt = toNullableTimestamp(body.current_period_ends_at);
  const cancelAtPeriodEnd = typeof body.cancel_at_period_end === "boolean" ? body.cancel_at_period_end : null;

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT
      o.id,
      o.plan,
      o.subscription_status,
      o.current_period_ends_at,
      o.cancel_at_period_end,
      o.paddle_subscription_id,
      o.paddle_customer_id,
      o.paddle_price_id,
      oac.plan_override,
      oac.subscription_status_override,
      oac.current_period_ends_at_override,
      oac.cancel_at_period_end_override
    FROM public.organizations o
    LEFT JOIN public.organization_access_controls oac ON oac.organization_id = o.id
    WHERE o.id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  if (before.length === 0) return json({ error: "Organization not found" }, 404);

  const [organization] = await sql`
    UPDATE public.organizations
    SET
      plan = COALESCE(${plan}, plan),
      subscription_status = COALESCE(${subscriptionStatus}, subscription_status),
      current_period_ends_at = COALESCE(${currentPeriodEndsAt}, current_period_ends_at),
      cancel_at_period_end = COALESCE(${cancelAtPeriodEnd}, cancel_at_period_end),
      billing_updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    RETURNING id, plan, subscription_status, current_period_ends_at, cancel_at_period_end
  `;

  const [overrides] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.organization_access_controls (
      organization_id,
      plan_override,
      subscription_status_override,
      current_period_ends_at_override,
      cancel_at_period_end_override,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${organizationId},
      ${plan},
      ${subscriptionStatus},
      ${currentPeriodEndsAt},
      ${cancelAtPeriodEnd},
      ${admin.auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      plan_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.plan_override, public.organization_access_controls.plan_override),
      subscription_status_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.subscription_status_override, public.organization_access_controls.subscription_status_override),
      current_period_ends_at_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.current_period_ends_at_override, public.organization_access_controls.current_period_ends_at_override),
      cancel_at_period_end_override = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cancel_at_period_end_override, public.organization_access_controls.cancel_at_period_end_override),
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
    RETURNING organization_id, plan_override, subscription_status_override, current_period_ends_at_override, cancel_at_period_end_override
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "edit-billing",
    targetType: "organization",
    targetId: organizationId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
    afterState: { organization, overrides },
  });

  return json({ organization, overrides });
}

async function mutateHostControl(hostId: string, mode: "quarantine" | "unquarantine" | "mark-needs-reconnect", req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const before = await sql`
    SELECT
      host_id,
      COALESCE(is_quarantined, false) AS is_quarantined,
      quarantine_reason,
      COALESCE(needs_reconnect, false) AS needs_reconnect
    FROM public.docker_host_admin_controls
    WHERE host_id = ${hostId}
  `;

  const afterRows = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.docker_host_admin_controls (
      host_id,
      is_quarantined,
      quarantine_reason,
      needs_reconnect,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      ${hostId},
      ${mode === "quarantine"},
      ${mode === "quarantine" ? reason : null},
      ${mode === "mark-needs-reconnect"},
      ${admin.auth.userId}
    )
    ON CONFLICT (host_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      is_quarantined = CASE
        WHEN ${mode} = 'quarantine' THEN true
        WHEN ${mode} = 'unquarantine' THEN false
        ELSE public.docker_host_admin_controls.is_quarantined
      END,
      quarantine_reason = CASE
        WHEN ${mode} = 'quarantine' THEN ${reason}
        WHEN ${mode} = 'unquarantine' THEN NULL
        ELSE public.docker_host_admin_controls.quarantine_reason
      END,
      needs_reconnect = CASE
        WHEN ${mode} = 'mark-needs-reconnect' THEN true
        ELSE public.docker_host_admin_controls.needs_reconnect
      END,
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
    RETURNING host_id, is_quarantined, quarantine_reason, needs_reconnect
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: mode,
    targetType: "docker-host",
    targetId: hostId,
    reason,
    beforeState: before[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
    afterState: afterRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  return json({ host_control: afterRows[0] });
}

async function runAdminSecretMigration(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const scope = {
    organizationId: typeof body.organization_id === "string" ? body.organization_id : null,
    hostId: typeof body.host_id === "string" ? body.host_id : null,
    dryRun: toBoolean(body.dry_run),
  };

  const result = await runSecretMigration(scope);
  const [operation] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.admin_operation_runs (
      actor_user_id,
      operation_name,
      scope_type,
      scope_id,
      status,
      reason,
      metadata,
      result_summary
    )
    VALUES (
      ${admin.auth.userId},
      'migrate-secrets',
      ${scope.hostId ? "host" : scope.organizationId ? "organization" : "global"},
      ${scope.hostId ?? scope.organizationId ?? null},
      ${result.failedCount > 0 ? "completed-with-errors" : "completed"},
      ${reason},
      ${JSON.stringify(scope)}::jsonb,
      ${JSON.stringify(result)}::jsonb
    )
    RETURNING id, operation_name, scope_type, scope_id, status, reason, metadata, result_summary, created_at
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "migrate-secrets",
    targetType: "operation",
    targetId: String(operation.id),
    reason,
    beforeState: {},
    afterState: { result, operationId: operation.id },
  });

  return json({ success: true, result, operation: { ...operation, created_at: new Date(String(operation.created_at)).toISOString() } });
}

async function listNotifications() {
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT
      n.id,
      n.organization_id,
      n.title,
      n.message,
      n.type,
      n.link,
      n.expires_at,
      n.created_at,
      u.email as created_by_email,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.notification_dismissals d WHERE d.notification_id = n.id)::int as dismiss_count
    FROM public.notifications n
    LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id = n.created_by
    ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 100
  `;
  return rows;
}

async function createNotification(req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  
  const title = body.title?.trim();
  const message = body.message?.trim();
  const type = body.type || 'info';
  const organizationId = body.organizationId || null;
  const link = body.link?.trim() || null;
  const expiresAt = toNullableTimestamp(body.expiresAt);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);

  assertAdminReason(reason);
  if (!title || !message) throw new Error("Title and message are required");

  const [notification] = await sql`
    INSERT INTO public.notifications (
      organization_id, title, message, type, link, created_by, expires_at
    ) VALUES (
      ${organizationId}, ${title}, ${message}, ${type}, ${link}, ${admin.auth.userId}, ${expiresAt}
    )
    RETURNING id
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "create_notification",
    targetType: "notification",
    targetId: notification.id,
    reason,
    beforeState: {},
    afterState: { title, message, type, organizationId, link, expiresAt }
  });

  return { success: true, notificationId: notification.id };
}

async function deleteNotification(id: string, req: Request) {
  const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);

  assertAdminReason(reason);

  const [notification] = await sql`
    SELECT * FROM public.notifications WHERE id = ${id}
  `;
  if (!notification) throw new Error("Notification not found");

  await sql`
    DELETE FROM public.notifications WHERE id = ${id}
  `;

  await recordAdminAudit({
    actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
    actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
    action: "delete_notification",
    targetType: "notification",
    targetId: id,
    reason,
    beforeState: { title: notification.title },
    afterState: {}
  });

  return { success: true };
}

export async function handleAdminRequest(req: Request) {
  // Build secure CORS headers based on request origin
  const corsHeaders = buildCorsHeaders(req);
  
  // Override the json helper to use CORS headers
  function json(data: unknown, status = 200) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    await ensureAdminSchema();
    const parts = parsePath(req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 0) {
      return json(await getOverview());
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "overview") {
      return json(await getOverview());
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "users") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ users: await listUsers() });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "users") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const user = await getUserDetail(parts[1]);
      return user ? json({ user }) : json({ error: "User not found" }, 404);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "approve") return await mutateUserApproval(parts[1], true, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "revoke-approval") return await mutateUserApproval(parts[1], false, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "suspend") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "suspend", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "unsuspend") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "unsuspend", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "hard-disable") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "hard-disable", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "hard-enable") return await mutateUserAccess(parts[1], "hard-enable", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "org-bans") return await addOrganizationBan(parts[1], req);
    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 4 && parts[0] === "users" && parts[2] === "org-bans") return await removeOrganizationBan(parts[1], parts[3], req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "organizations") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ organizations: await listOrganizations() });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "organizations") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const organization = await getOrganizationDetail(parts[1]);
      return organization ? json({ organization }) : json({ error: "Organization not found" }, 404);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "lock") return await mutateOrganizationLock(parts[1], true, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "unlock") return await mutateOrganizationLock(parts[1], false, req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "billing") return await updateOrganizationBilling(parts[1], req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "organizations" && parts[2] === "reset-onboarding") return await resetOrganizationOnboarding(parts[1], req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "hosts") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ hosts: await listHosts() });
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "hosts" && parts[2] === "quarantine") return await mutateHostControl(parts[1], "quarantine", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "hosts" && parts[2] === "unquarantine") return await mutateHostControl(parts[1], "unquarantine", req);
    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "hosts" && parts[2] === "mark-needs-reconnect") return await mutateHostControl(parts[1], "mark-needs-reconnect", req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "audit-log") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ audit_log: await listAuditLog() });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "operations") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ operations: await listOperationRuns() });
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "migrate-secrets") return await runAdminSecretMigration(req);

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "unmatched") {
      return await listUnmatchedBillingEvents(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "match") {
      return await adminMatchBillingEvent(req);
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "email-deliveries") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const url = new URL(req.url);
      const limitParam = Number(url.searchParams.get("limit") || 100);
      const limit = Number.isFinite(limitParam) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(300, Math.floor(limitParam))) : 100;
      return json({ deliveries: await listDonorEmailDeliveries(limit) });
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "email-deliveries") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const delivery = await getDonorEmailDelivery(parts[2]);
      return delivery ? json({ delivery }) : json({ error: "Delivery not found" }, 404);
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 4 && parts[0] === "billing" && parts[1] === "email-deliveries" && parts[3] === "resend") {
      const admin = await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      const body = await readBody(req);
      const reason = normalizeAdminReason(body.reason);
      assertAdminReason(reason);
      return json(await resendDonorEmailDelivery({
        deliveryId: parts[2],
        actorUserId: admin.auth.userId,
        actorEmail: admin.actorEmail,
        reason,
      }));
    }

    if (req.method === "GET" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "notifications") {
      await requirePlatformAdmin(req);
      return json({ notifications: await listNotifications() });
    }

    if (req.method === "POST" && parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "notifications") {
      return json(await createNotification(req));
    }

    if (req.method === "DELETE" && parts.length === 2 && parts[0] === "notifications") {
      return json(await deleteNotification(parts[1], req));
    }

    return json({ error: "Method not allowed" }, 405);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    const lower = message.toLowerCase();
    const status = lower.includes("forbidden") ? 403 : lower.includes("unauthorized") ? 401 : 400;
    return json({ error: message }, status);
  }
}
