````bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

# watchtower-agent-update — One-command self-updater for Dockerdash agent
# Usage: sudo watchtower-agent-update

SERVICE_NAME="watchtower-agent"
INSTALL_DIR="/opt/watchtower-agent"
CONFIG_DIR="/etc/watchtower-agent"
ENV_FILE="${CONFIG_DIR}/watchtower-agent.env"
SERVICE_FILE="/etc/systemd/system/watchtower-agent.service"
UPDATE_URL="https://app.dockerdash.app/watchtower-agent.sh"
INSTALLER_URL="https://app.dockerdash.app/watchtower-agent-install.sh"
VERSION_URL="https://app.dockerdash.app/api/agent-release"

BOLD='\033[1m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
DIM='\033[2m'
RESET='\033[0m'

banner() {
  echo ""
  echo -e "${CYAN}${BOLD}╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗${RESET}"
  echo -e "${CYAN}${BOLD}║       Dockerdash Agent Updater           ║${RESET}"
  echo -e "${CYAN}${BOLD}╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝${RESET}"
  echo ""
}

step() {
  echo -e "  ${CYAN}▸${RESET} $*"
}

success() {
  echo -e "  ${GREEN}✔${RESET} $*"
}

warn() {
  echo -e "  ${YELLOW}⚠${RESET} $*"
}

fail() {
  echo -e "  ${RED}✖ ERROR:${RESET} $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: watchtower-agent-update [options]

Options:
  --check       Check for updates without installing
  --force       Force update even if already on the latest version
  --quiet       Suppress banner and decorative output
  --help        Show this help text

Run without options to check for and apply any available update.
EOF
}

extract_runtime_version() {
  local file_path="$1"
  [ -f "$file_path" ] || return 0
  sed -n 's/^WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION="${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION:-\([^"]*\)}"/\1/p' "$file_path" | head -1
}

repair_systemd_socket_group() {
  [ -f "$SERVICE_FILE" ] || return 0
  [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || return 0

  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  . "$ENV_FILE"

  local socket_path="${DOCKER_SOCKET:-/var/run/docker.sock}"
  if [ ! -S "$socket_path" ]; then
    warn "Docker socket not found at ${socket_path}; leaving systemd unit unchanged."
    return 0
  fi

  local socket_group
  socket_group="$(stat -c '%G' "$socket_path" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -z "$socket_group" ] || [ "$socket_group" = "UNKNOWN" ] || [ "$socket_group" = "root" ]; then
    warn "Docker socket group for ${socket_path} is not usable (${socket_group:-unknown}); leaving systemd unit unchanged."
    return 0
  fi

  if grep -q "^SupplementaryGroups=${socket_group}$" "$SERVICE_FILE"; then
    return 0
  fi

  step "Repairing systemd Docker socket group..."
  if grep -q '^SupplementaryGroups=' "$SERVICE_FILE"; then
    sed -i "s/^SupplementaryGroups=.*/SupplementaryGroups=${socket_group}/" "$SERVICE_FILE"
  elif grep -q '^Group=' "$SERVICE_FILE"; then
    sed -i "/^Group=/a SupplementaryGroups=${socket_group}" "$SERVICE_FILE"
  else
    warn "Could not find Group= in ${SERVICE_FILE}; reinstall the agent from Dockerdash to repair the unit."
  fi
}

verify_local_docker_ping() {
  [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || return 0

  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  . "$ENV_FILE"

  local bind_address="${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS:-127.0.0.1}"
  local port="${AGENT_PORT:-9876}"

  case "$bind_address" in
    ""|"0.0.0.0"|"::")
      bind_address="127.0.0.1"
      ;;
  esac

  if curl -fsS "http://${bind_address}:${port}/docker/_ping" -H "X-Agent-Key: ${AGENT_API_KEY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    success "Local Docker socket check passed"
  else
    warn "Agent is running, but local Docker ping failed. Inspect: sudo journalctl -u ${SERVICE_NAME} -n 50"
  fi
}

FLAG_CHECK="false"
FLAG_FORCE="false"
FLAG_QUIET="false"

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --check)
      FLAG_CHECK="true"
      shift
      ;;
    --force)
      FLAG_FORCE="true"
      shift
      ;;
    --quiet)
      FLAG_QUIET="true"
      shift
      ;;
    --help)
      usage
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      fail "Unknown option: $1. Run with --help for usage."
      ;;
  esac
done

# ── Pre-flight ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || fail "Run this command with sudo:  sudo watchtower-agent-update"

[ -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/watchtower-agent.sh" ] || fail "Watchtower agent is not installed at ${INSTALL_DIR}. Run the install command from your Dockerdash dashboard first."

[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || fail "Agent config not found at ${ENV_FILE}. The agent may not be installed properly."

command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "curl is required but not installed."
command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "systemd is required for this updater."
command -v stat >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "stat is required but not installed."
command -v sed >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "sed is required but not installed."
command -v grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "grep is required but not installed."

# ── Gather info ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CURRENT_VERSION="$(extract_runtime_version "${INSTALL_DIR}/watchtower-agent.sh" || echo "unknown")"

if [ "$FLAG_QUIET" != "true" ]; then
  banner
  step "Current agent version: ${BOLD}${CURRENT_VERSION}${RESET}"
fi

# ── Check latest version ────────────────────────────────────────────────

step "Checking for updates..."

LATEST_SCRIPT=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-latest.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$LATEST_SCRIPT"' EXIT INT TERM

if ! curl -fsSL "$UPDATE_URL" -o "$LATEST_SCRIPT" 2>/dev/null; then
  fail "Failed to download latest agent from ${UPDATE_URL}. Check your network connection."
fi

LATEST_VERSION="$(extract_runtime_version "$LATEST_SCRIPT" || echo "unknown")"

if [ "$LATEST_VERSION" = "unknown" ]; then
  fail "Could not determine the version of the downloaded agent. The download may be corrupt."
fi

if [ "$CURRENT_VERSION" = "$LATEST_VERSION" ] && [ "$FLAG_FORCE" != "true" ]; then
  success "Already on the latest version: ${BOLD}${CURRENT_VERSION}${RESET}"
  if [ "$FLAG_CHECK" = "true" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${DIM}No update needed.${RESET}"
  fi
  echo ""
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$FLAG_CHECK" = "true" ]; then
  echo ""
  echo -e "  ${YELLOW}Update available:${RESET} ${CURRENT_VERSION} → ${BOLD}${GREEN}${LATEST_VERSION}${RESET}"
  echo -e "  ${DIM}Run ${BOLD}sudo watchtower-agent-update${RESET}${DIM} to apply.${RESET}"
  echo ""
  exit 0
fi

# ── Apply update ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

echo ""
echo -e "  ${YELLOW}Updating:${RESET} ${CURRENT_VERSION} → ${BOLD}${GREEN}${LATEST_VERSION}${RESET}"
echo ""

step "Stopping service..."
systemctl stop "${SERVICE_NAME}.service" 2>/dev/null || true

step "Installing new agent runtime..."
install -m 0755 "$LATEST_SCRIPT" "${INSTALL_DIR}/watchtower-agent.sh"

repair_systemd_socket_group

step "Verifying agent config..."
if ! "${INSTALL_DIR}/watchtower-agent.sh" --check >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  warn "Config verification failed after update. Attempting rollback is not supported."
  warn "Inspect: sudo journalctl -u ${SERVICE_NAME} -n 50"
fi

step "Restarting service..."
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart "${SERVICE_NAME}.service" 2>/dev/null || systemctl start "${SERVICE_NAME}.service"

# Give it a moment to start
sleep 2

if systemctl --quiet is-active "${SERVICE_NAME}.service"; then
  INSTALLED_VERSION="$(extract_runtime_version "${INSTALL_DIR}/watchtower-agent.sh" || echo "unknown")"
  echo ""
  success "Agent updated successfully: ${BOLD}${INSTALLED_VERSION}${RESET}"
  verify_local_docker_ping
  echo ""
  echo -e "  ${DIM}Service status:${RESET}  sudo systemctl status ${SERVICE_NAME}"
  echo -e "  ${DIM}Service logs:${RESET}    sudo journalctl -u ${SERVICE_NAME} -f"
  echo ""
else
  echo ""
  warn "Service may not have started cleanly."
  echo -e "  ${DIM}Check status:${RESET}  sudo systemctl status ${SERVICE_NAME}"
  echo -e "  ${DIM}Check logs:${RESET}    sudo journalctl -u ${SERVICE_NAME} -n 50"
  echo ""
  exit 1
fi
````

````typescript
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function formatDate(value: string | null | undefined) {
  if (!value) return "Never";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleString();
}

export function filterByQuery<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(rows: T[], query: string, keys: Array<keyof T>) {
  const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!normalized) return rows;
  return rows.filter((row) =>
    keys.some((key) => String(row[key] ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(normalized)),
  );
}

export function DetailField({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | number | null | undefined }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <div className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
      <div className="text-sm">{value ?? "—"}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StatusPill({ active, label, variant }: { active: boolean; label: string; variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "destructive" | "outline" | "warning" }) {
  return <Badge variant={variant || (active ? "default" : "outline")}>{label}</Badge>;
}

export function AdminActionDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  title,
  description,
  confirmLabel,
  confirmValue,
  requireTypedConfirm = false,
  submitting,
  onConfirm,
  extra,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
  confirmValue?: string;
  requireTypedConfirm?: boolean;
  submitting?: boolean;
  onConfirm: (reason: string) => Promise<void>;
  extra?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [typedValue, setTypedValue] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setReason("");
      setTypedValue("");
    }
  }, [open]);

  const typedOk = !requireTypedConfirm || !confirmValue || typedValue === confirmValue;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{title}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{description}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {extra}
          {requireTypedConfirm && confirmValue ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="typed-confirm">Type <span className="font-mono">{confirmValue}</span> to confirm</Label>
              <Input id="typed-confirm" value={typedValue} onChange={(event) => setTypedValue(event.target.value)} />
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="admin-reason">Reason</Label>
            <Textarea id="admin-reason" value={reason} onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)} placeholder="Required audit reason" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button
            disabled={submitting || !reason.trim() || !typedOk}
            onClick={async () => {
              await onConfirm(reason.trim());
              onOpenChange(false);
            }}
          >
            {submitting ? "Running..." : confirmLabel}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````typescript
function formatLastSeen(lastSeenAt: string | null): string {
  if (!lastSeenAt) return "Never";
  return formatDistanceToNowStrict(new Date(lastSeenAt), { addSuffix: true });
}

function formatUptime(seconds: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds === null || seconds === undefined || seconds < 0) {
    return "Unavailable";
  }

  const totalSeconds = Math.floor(seconds);
  const days = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86400);
  const hours = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 86400) / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);

  if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  if (minutes > 0) return `${minutes}m`;
  return `${totalSeconds}s`;
}
````

````typescript
import { useNotifications, useDismissNotification, useDismissAllNotifications } from "../../hooks/useNotifications";

import { Notification } from "../../types/database";

const NotificationIcon = ({ type }: { type: Notification["type"] }) => {
  switch (type) {
    case "error":
      return <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />;
    case "warning":
      return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />;
    case "success":
      return <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />;
    case "update":
      return <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />;
    default:
      return <Info className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" />;
  }
};

export function NotificationBell() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const orgId = viewer?.active_org_id || null;
  
  const { data: notifications, unreadCount } = useNotifications(orgId);
  const dismissMutation = useDismissNotification(orgId);
  const dismissAllMutation = useDismissAllNotifications(orgId);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleDismiss = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    dismissMutation.mutate(id);
  };

  const handleDismissAll = () => {
    dismissAllMutation.mutate();
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleClick = (n: Notification) => {
    if (n.link) {
      setOpen(false);
      if (n.link.startsWith("http://") || n.link.startsWith("https://")) {
        window.open(n.link, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
      } else {
        navigate(n.link);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="relative h-9 w-9 rounded-full">
          <Bell className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400" />
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 flex h-2 w-2">
              <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-red-400 opacity-75"></span>
              <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-red-500"></span>
            </span>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-80 p-0 mr-4" align="end">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Notifications</h3>
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <Button 
              variant="ghost" 
              size="sm" 
              onClick={handleDismissAll}
              className="h-8 text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
              disabled={dismissAllMutation.isPending}
            >
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
              Mark all read
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
          {!notifications || notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              You have no new notifications.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/50">
              {notifications.map((n) => (
                <div 
                  key={n.id} 
                  className={cn(
                    "flex gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors group",
                    n.link && "cursor-pointer"
                  )}
                  onClick={() => handleClick(n)}
                >
                  <div className="flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                    <NotificationIcon type={n.type} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                      {n.title}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1 break-words">
                      {n.message}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 mt-2">
                      {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(n.created_at), { addSuffix: true })}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-shrink-0">
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-6 w-6 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                      onClick={(e) => handleDismiss(n.id, e)}
                    >
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useAuth, useClerk } from "@clerk/react";
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { normalizeOnboardingStatus, deriveNeedsOnboarding, type OnboardingStatus } from "@/lib/onboarding-gate";

export interface AuthMeState {
  status: "loading" | "resolved" | "error" | "unauthenticated";
  hasOrgs: boolean;
  onboardingStatus: OnboardingStatus;
  needsOnboarding: boolean;
  activeOrgPlan: string | null;
  dedicatedDeploymentStatus: string | null;
}

const initialState: AuthMeState = {
  status: "loading",
  hasOrgs: false,
  onboardingStatus: null,
  needsOnboarding: true,
  activeOrgPlan: null,
  dedicatedDeploymentStatus: null,
};

const unauthenticatedState: AuthMeState = {
  status: "unauthenticated",
  hasOrgs: false,
  onboardingStatus: null,
  needsOnboarding: true,
  activeOrgPlan: null,
  dedicatedDeploymentStatus: null,
};

export function useAuthMe(enabled: boolean) {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn, getToken } = useAuth();
  const { signOut } = useClerk();
  const [state, setState] = useState<AuthMeState>(initialState);

  const fetchAuthMe = useCallback(async (cancelled: { current: boolean }) => {
    const maxAttempts = 5;

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      try {
        const token = await getToken({ skipCache: attempt > 1 });

        if (!token) {
          if (!cancelled.current) setState(unauthenticatedState);
          return;
        }

        const res = await fetch("/api/auth/me", {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });

        // 202 Accepted: Initial setup in progress, retry
        if (res.status === 202) {
          const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          if (data?.retry) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
            continue;
          }
        }

        // 401 Unauthorized: Session invalid or expired
        if (res.status === 401) {
          if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300 * attempt));
            continue;
          }

          if (!cancelled.current) setState(unauthenticatedState);
          await signOut({ redirectUrl: "/login?reauth=1" }).catch(() => {
            window.location.assign("/login?reauth=1");
          });
          return;
        }

        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(`auth/me failed (${res.status})`);
        }

        const data = await res.json();
        const hasOrgs = !!data.user?.has_orgs;
        const onboardingStatus = normalizeOnboardingStatus(data.user?.onboarding_status);
        const needsOnboarding = deriveNeedsOnboarding(hasOrgs, onboardingStatus);

        if (!cancelled.current) {
          setState({
            status: "resolved",
            hasOrgs,
            onboardingStatus,
            needsOnboarding,
            activeOrgPlan: data.user?.active_org_plan ?? null,
            dedicatedDeploymentStatus: data.user?.dedicated_deployment_status ?? null,
          });
        }
        return;
      } catch (error) {
        if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300 * attempt));
          continue;
        }

        if (!cancelled.current) {
          setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: "error" }));
        }
      }
    }
  }, [getToken, signOut]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || !isLoaded) return;

    if (!isSignedIn) {
      setState(unauthenticatedState);
      return;
    }

    const cancelled = { current: false };
    fetchAuthMe(cancelled);

    return () => {
      cancelled.current = true;
    };
  }, [enabled, isLoaded, isSignedIn, fetchAuthMe]);

  return state;
}
````

````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  useCreateSlackDestination,
  useSlackDestinations,
  useTestSlackDestination,
  useUpdateSlackDestination,
} from "@/hooks/useSlackDestinations";
import {
  useCreateWebhookDestination,
  useTestWebhookDestination,
  useUpdateWebhookDestination,
  useWebhookDestinations,
} from "@/hooks/useWebhookDestinations";
import type { SlackDestinationFormValues, WebhookDestinationFormValues } from "@/types/alerts";

// ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface TestResult {
  succeeded: boolean;
  http_status?: number;
  error_summary?: string;
}

/** Show a success/failure toast for a destination test attempt. */
function buildTestToast(attempt: TestResult, label: string) {
  if (attempt.succeeded) {
    return {
      title: `${label} test delivered`,
      description: attempt.http_status
        ? `${label} responded with ${attempt.http_status}.`
        : `${label} accepted the test message.`,
    } as const;
  }
  return {
    title: `${label} test failed`,
    description: attempt.error_summary ?? `${label} did not accept the test message.`,
    variant: "destructive",
  } as const;
}

// ── Hook ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useDestinationSettings(orgId: string | undefined, canSlack: boolean, canWebhook: boolean) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [latestSecret, setLatestSecret] = useState<{ destinationName: string; value: string } | null>(null);

  /** Run a mutation and show a toast, catching errors uniformly. */
  async function run<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, successTitle: string, errorTitle: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
    try {
      const result = await fn();
      toast({ title: successTitle });
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: errorTitle,
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  // ── Slack queries & mutations ─────────────────────────────────────
  const slackQuery = useSlackDestinations(orgId, canSlack);
  const createSlackMut = useCreateSlackDestination();
  const updateSlackMut = useUpdateSlackDestination();
  const testSlackMut = useTestSlackDestination();

  const handleCreateSlack = (values: SlackDestinationFormValues) =>
    run(() => createSlackMut.mutateAsync(values), "Slack destination created", "Failed to create Slack destination");

  const handleUpdateSlack = (id: string, values: Partial<SlackDestinationFormValues>) =>
    run(() => updateSlackMut.mutateAsync({ id, values }), "Slack destination updated", "Failed to update Slack destination");

  const handleTestSlack = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const attempt = await testSlackMut.mutateAsync(id);
      toast(buildTestToast(attempt, "Slack"));
    } catch (error) {
      toast({ title: "Failed to send Slack test", description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error", variant: "destructive" });
    }
  };

  // ── Webhook queries & mutations ───────────────────────────────────
  const webhookQuery = useWebhookDestinations(orgId, canWebhook);
  const createWebhookMut = useCreateWebhookDestination();
  const updateWebhookMut = useUpdateWebhookDestination();
  const testWebhookMut = useTestWebhookDestination();

  const handleCreateWebhook = async (values: WebhookDestinationFormValues) => {
    const result = await run(
      () => createWebhookMut.mutateAsync(values),
      "Webhook destination created",
      "Failed to create webhook destination",
    );
    if (result?.signing_secret) {
      setLatestSecret({ destinationName: result.destination.name, value: result.signing_secret });
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateWebhook = async (id: string, values: Partial<WebhookDestinationFormValues> & { regenerate_secret?: boolean }) => {
    const result = await run(
      () => updateWebhookMut.mutateAsync({ id, values }),
      "Webhook destination updated",
      "Failed to update webhook destination",
    );
    if (result?.signing_secret) {
      setLatestSecret({ destinationName: result.destination.name, value: result.signing_secret });
      toast({ title: "Signing secret regenerated" });
    }
  };

  const handleTestWebhook = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const attempt = await testWebhookMut.mutateAsync(id);
      toast(buildTestToast(attempt, "Endpoint"));
    } catch (error) {
      toast({ title: "Failed to send webhook test", description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error", variant: "destructive" });
    }
  };

  // ── Return ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return {
    slack: {
      destinations: slackQuery.data?.destinations ?? [],
      canManage: slackQuery.data?.can_manage ?? false,
      saving: createSlackMut.isPending || updateSlackMut.isPending,
      testingId: testSlackMut.isPending ? testSlackMut.variables : null,
      onCreate: handleCreateSlack,
      onUpdate: handleUpdateSlack,
      onTest: handleTestSlack,
    },
    webhook: {
      destinations: webhookQuery.data?.destinations ?? [],
      canManage: webhookQuery.data?.can_manage ?? false,
      saving: createWebhookMut.isPending || updateWebhookMut.isPending,
      testingId: testWebhookMut.isPending ? testWebhookMut.variables : null,
      latestSecret,
      onCreate: handleCreateWebhook,
      onUpdate: handleUpdateWebhook,
      onTest: handleTestWebhook,
      onDismissSecret: () => setLatestSecret(null),
    },
  };
}
````

## File: src/hooks/useFleetMetrics.ts
````typescript
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export interface FleetMetrics {
  timestamp: number;
  time: string;
  cpu: number;
  memory: number;
  usedCores: number;
  totalCores: number;
  memoryUsed: number;
  memoryLimit: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkOutBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskReadBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec: number | null;
  reportingHosts: number;
  totalHosts: number;
  isPartial: boolean;
}

interface FleetMetricsApiPoint {
  timestamp?: string | number;
  time?: string;
  cpu?: number;
  memory?: number;
  usedCores?: number;
  totalCores?: number;
  memoryUsed?: number;
  memoryLimit?: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec?: number;
  networkOutBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskReadBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec?: number;
  reportingHosts?: number;
  totalHosts?: number;
  isPartial?: boolean;
  network_in_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  network_out_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_read_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_write_bytes_per_sec?: number;
}

function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

function toTimestamp(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const numeric = Number(value);
    if (Number.isFinite(numeric)) {
      return numeric;
    }

    const parsed = Date.parse(value);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
      return parsed;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function formatTimeLabel(timestamp: number): string {
  return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false,
  });
}

function normalizeOptionalRate(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (numeric === null || numeric < 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return numeric;
}

function normalizeFleetMetricPoint(point: FleetMetricsApiPoint): FleetMetrics | null {
  const timestamp = toTimestamp(point.timestamp) ?? Date.now();

  const cpu = toFiniteNumber(point.cpu);
  const memory = toFiniteNumber(point.memory);
  const usedCores = toFiniteNumber(point.usedCores);
  const totalCores = toFiniteNumber(point.totalCores);
  const memoryUsed = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryUsed);
  const memoryLimit = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryLimit);
  const networkInBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkInBytesPerSec ?? point.network_in_bytes_per_sec);
  const networkOutBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkOutBytesPerSec ?? point.network_out_bytes_per_sec);
  const diskReadBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskReadBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_read_bytes_per_sec);
  const diskWriteBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskWriteBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_write_bytes_per_sec);
  const reportingHosts = Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(point.reportingHosts) ?? 0);
  const totalHosts = Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(point.totalHosts) ?? 0);
  const isPartial = point.isPartial === true;

  if (
    cpu === null ||
    memory === null ||
    usedCores === null ||
    totalCores === null ||
    memoryUsed === null ||
    memoryLimit === null
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    cpu < 0 ||
    cpu > 100 ||
    memory < 0 ||
    memory > 100 ||
    usedCores < 0 ||
    totalCores < 0 ||
    memoryUsed < 0 ||
    memoryLimit < 0
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  // Reject points that have no usable absolute-capacity context.
  // This filters malformed "all zeros" samples while preserving legitimate 0% usage
  // when capacity is known (e.g. usedCores=0 with totalCores>0).
  if (totalCores === 0 && memoryLimit === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  // Inconsistent points: non-zero percentage without corresponding capacity.
  if ((cpu > 0 && totalCores === 0) || (memory > 0 && memoryLimit === 0)) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    timestamp,
    time: formatTimeLabel(timestamp),
    cpu,
    memory,
    usedCores,
    totalCores,
    memoryUsed,
    memoryLimit,
    networkInBytesPerSec,
    networkOutBytesPerSec,
    diskReadBytesPerSec,
    diskWriteBytesPerSec,
    reportingHosts,
    totalHosts,
    isPartial,
  };
}

export function useFleetMetrics(orgId: string | null | undefined, refetchInterval: number | false = 10000) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['fleet-metrics', orgId],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<FleetMetrics[]> => {
      if (!orgId) {
        return [];
      }

      const data = await apiFetch('/fleet-metrics', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ orgId }),
      });

      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        return [];
      }

      const normalized = data
        .map((point) => normalizeFleetMetricPoint((point ?? {}) as FleetMetricsApiPoint))
        .filter((point): point is FleetMetrics => point !== null);

      return normalized;
    },
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      if (!orgId || refetchInterval === false) return false;
      return query.state.error ? false : refetchInterval;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
  });
}
````

````typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { sanitizeConnectionError } from "@/lib/error-sanitizer";

describe("sanitizeConnectionError", () => {
  it("prioritizes agent API key failures over Cloudflare wording", () => {
    const error = Object.assign(
      new Error("Connection test failed: Cloudflare Tunnel returned HTTP 401: Invalid API key"),
      { body: { code: "agent_auth_failed", type: "agent_unauthorized" } },
    );

    expect(sanitizeConnectionError(error)).toMatchObject({
      title: "API key mismatch",
    });
  });

  it("does not classify the Dockerdash app edge 502 as a host tunnel outage", () => {
    expect(
      sanitizeConnectionError(
        "Cloudflare gateway error: app.dockerdash.app | 502: Bad gateway. Verify the saved host URL.",
      ),
    ).toMatchObject({
      title: "Dockerdash gateway error",
    });
  });

  it("classifies agent-side Docker socket failures separately from reachability", () => {
    const error = Object.assign(
      new Error(
        "Docker socket unavailable: The Watchtower agent is reachable, but it could not talk to Docker through its configured socket.",
      ),
      {
        body: {
          type: "docker_socket_unavailable",
          detail: "Docker API request failed",
        },
      },
    );

    expect(sanitizeConnectionError(error)).toMatchObject({
      title: "Docker socket inaccessible",
    });
  });

  it("keeps Cloudflare reachability copy for real tunnel failures", () => {
    expect(sanitizeConnectionError("Cloudflare HTML error page: 502 Bad Gateway")).toMatchObject({
      title: "Tunnel unreachable",
    });
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

export default function OrganizationsPage() {
  const { userMemberships, isLoaded, createOrganization } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: { infinite: true },
  });
  const organizations = userMemberships.data?.map(m => m.organization) || [];
  const isLoading = !isLoaded;
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!newName.trim()) return;
    try {
      if (createOrganization) {
        await createOrganization({ name: newName.trim() });
        setNewName("");
        setCreating(false);
      }
    } catch {}
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64"><Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="Organizations"
        description="Manage your workspaces"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Organizations" }]}
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={() => setCreating(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />New Organization
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {creating && (
        <div className="glass-card p-4 flex items-center gap-3 max-w-md">
          <Input placeholder="Organization name" value={newName} onChange={e => setNewName(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleCreate()} />
          <Button size="sm" onClick={handleCreate} disabled={!newName.trim()}>Create</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>Cancel</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {organizations.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="glass-card p-12 text-center">
          <Building2 className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-3" />
          <h3 className="font-medium mb-1">No organizations yet</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">Create your first organization to start managing Docker hosts.</p>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setCreating(true)} className="gap-1.5">
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />Create Organization
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {organizations.map(org => (
            <OrgCard key={org.id} org={org} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function OrgCard({ org }: { org: { id: string; name: string; slug: string | null } }) {
  const { data: hosts = [] } = useDockerHosts(org.id, { filterByPlan: true });

  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Building2 className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-semibold">{org.name}</h3>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{org.slug} • {hosts.length} host{hosts.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {hosts.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {hosts.map(host => (
            <Link key={host.id} to={`/app/hosts/${host.id}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-background border border-border hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors">
              <Server className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{host.name}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground capitalize">{host.status}</div>
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No hosts connected yet. Go to Hosts to add one.</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useOrganizationList, useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";
import { agentEnrollmentApi, type AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse, type AgentEnrollmentFinalizeResponse } from "@/services/agent-enrollment";
import type { ConnectionMode } from "@/types/database";
import { deriveNeedsOnboarding, normalizeOnboardingStatus } from "@/lib/onboarding-gate";

export type OnboardingStep =
  | { step: 0; phase: "form" }
  | { step: 0; phase: "creating" }
  | { step: 0; phase: "syncing" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "basics" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "preparing" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "install" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "finalizing" }
  | { step: 1; phase: "test-failed" }
  | { step: 2; phase: "done" };

export const STEPS = ["Create Organization", "Connect Host", "You're Ready"] as const;

export const CONNECTION_MODES: { value: ConnectionMode; label: string; desc: string }[] = [
  { value: "agent", label: "Agent (Direct)", desc: "Connect to the Watchtower Agent over HTTPS." },
  { value: "cloudflare_tunnel", label: "Agent via CF Tunnel", desc: "Same agent, accessed through a Cloudflare Tunnel." },
];

export function isStep0Submitting(state: OnboardingStep): boolean {
  return state.step === 0 && (state.phase === "creating" || state.phase === "syncing");
}

export function isStep1Loading(state: OnboardingStep): boolean {
  return state.step === 1 && (state.phase === "preparing" || state.phase === "finalizing");
}

export function getProgressWidth(state: OnboardingStep): string {
  if (state.step === 0) return "33%";
  if (state.step === 2) return "100%";
  if (state.phase === "basics") return "45%";
  if (state.phase === "install") return "72%";
  return "82%";
}

async function markOnboardingStatus(
  status: "not_started" | "skipped" | "completed",
  orgId: string | null | undefined,
  fallbackOrgId: string | null | undefined,
) {
  const activeClerkOrgId = orgId ?? fallbackOrgId ?? null;
  const maxAttempts = 20;
  let delay = 750;

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    // @ts-expect-error window.Clerk is injected globally by ClerkProvider
    const token = await window.Clerk?.session?.getToken(attempt > 1 ? { skipCache: true } : undefined);
    if (!token) throw new Error("Unauthorized");

    const res = await fetch("/api/organizations", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        onboardingStatus: status,
        ...(activeClerkOrgId ? { clerkOrgId: activeClerkOrgId } : {}),
      }),
    });

    if (res.ok) return;

    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const isRetryable202 = res.status === 202 && data?.retry;
    const isRetryableNotFound =
      res.status === 404 &&
      typeof data?.error === "string" &&
      data.error.toLowerCase().includes("requested organization not found");

    if ((isRetryable202 || isRetryableNotFound) && attempt < maxAttempts) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
      delay = Math.min(Math.floor(delay * 1.35), 4000);
      continue;
    }

    if (res.status === 202) {
      throw new Error(data?.error || "Sync pending. Your account is currently syncing.");
    }

    throw new Error(data?.error || `HTTP error ${res.status}`);
  }
}

// --- Sync Polling Logic ---

type AuthSyncStatus =
  | { type: "success"; hasOrgs: boolean; needsOnboarding: boolean }
  | { type: "retry"; delay?: number }
  | { type: "error" };

async function checkAuthSyncStatus(): Promise<AuthSyncStatus> {
  try {
    // @ts-expect-error window.Clerk is injected globally by ClerkProvider
    const token = await window.Clerk?.session?.getToken({ skipCache: true });
    if (!token) return { type: "retry" };

    const res = await fetch("/api/auth/me", {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });

    if (res.status === 202) {
      const syncState = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { type: "retry", delay: syncState?.retry ? 2000 : undefined };
    }

    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      const hasOrgs = !!data.user?.has_orgs;
      const onboardingStatus = normalizeOnboardingStatus(data.user?.onboarding_status);
      const needsOnboarding = deriveNeedsOnboarding(hasOrgs, onboardingStatus);
      return { type: "success", hasOrgs, needsOnboarding };
    }

    return { type: "retry" };
  } catch {
    return { type: "retry" };
  }
}

type SyncPollingResult =
  | { status: "ready" }
  | { status: "complete" }
  | { status: "timeout" }
  | { status: "cancelled" };

async function pollForOrganizationSync(onCancelCheck: () => boolean): Promise<SyncPollingResult> {
  const maxWait = 30_000;
  const start = Date.now();
  let delay = 500;

  while (Date.now() - start < maxWait) {
    if (onCancelCheck()) return { status: "cancelled" };

    const syncStatus = await checkAuthSyncStatus();

    if (syncStatus.type === "success") {
      if (syncStatus.hasOrgs && syncStatus.needsOnboarding) return { status: "ready" };
      if (!syncStatus.needsOnboarding) return { status: "complete" };
    } else if (syncStatus.type === "retry" && syncStatus.delay) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, syncStatus.delay));
      continue;
    }

    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay));
    delay = Math.min(delay * 1.5, 2000);
  }

  return { status: "timeout" };
}

function useOrganizationSyncEffect(
  setState: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<OnboardingStep>>,
  setError: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | null>>
) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    const resume = sessionStorage.getItem("onboarding_resume");
    if (resume !== "connect-host") return;

    let cancelled = false;

    (async () => {
      const result = await pollForOrganizationSync(() => cancelled);

      if (cancelled) return;

      switch (result.status) {
        case "ready":
          toast({ title: "Organization created", description: "Now connect your first Docker host." });
          setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
          break;
        case "complete":
          sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
          navigate("/app", { replace: true });
          break;
        case "timeout":
          sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
          setState({ step: 0, phase: "form" });
          setError("Organization sync took too long. Please try creating your organization again.");
          break;
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
}

export function useOnboardingState() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<OnboardingStep>(() =>
    sessionStorage.getItem("onboarding_resume") === "connect-host"
      ? { step: 0, phase: "syncing" }
      : { step: 0, phase: "form" },
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSkipping, setIsSkipping] = useState(false);
  const [testError, setTestError] = useState("");
  const [remediationCommand, setRemediationCommand] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [orgName, setOrgName] = useState("");
  const [hostName, setHostName] = useState("");
  const [hostUrl, setHostUrl] = useState("");
  const [connectionMode, setConnectionMode] = useState<ConnectionMode>("agent");
  const [socketPath, setSocketPath] = useState("/var/run/docker.sock");
  const [cfServiceTokenId, setCfServiceTokenId] = useState("");
  const [cfServiceTokenSecret, setCfServiceTokenSecret] = useState("");
  const [enrollment, setEnrollment] = useState<AgentEnrollmentCreateResponse | null>(null);
  const [finalizeResult, setFinalizeResult] = useState<AgentEnrollmentFinalizeResponse | null>(null);

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { isLoaded, orgId } = useAuth();
  const { createOrganization, setActive, userMemberships } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: { infinite: true },
  });

  const fallbackOrgId = userMemberships.data?.[0]?.organization?.id ?? null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded && orgId && state.step === 0 && state.phase === "form") {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
    }
  }, [isLoaded, orgId, state.step, state.phase]);

  useOrganizationSyncEffect(setState, setError);

  const completeOnboardingAndNavigate = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await markOnboardingStatus("completed", orgId, fallbackOrgId);
      sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
      const pendingPlan = sessionStorage.getItem("dockerdash_pending_plan");
      if (pendingPlan) {
        navigate(`/app/billing?plan=${pendingPlan}`, { replace: true });
      } else {
        navigate("/app", { replace: true });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: "Couldn't finalize onboarding",
        description:
          err instanceof Error
            ? err.message
            : "Unable to persist onboarding state. Please select an organization and try again.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    }
  }, [orgId, fallbackOrgId, navigate, toast]);

  const handleSkip = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSkipping(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await markOnboardingStatus("skipped", orgId, fallbackOrgId);
      sessionStorage.removeItem("onboarding_resume");
      navigate("/app", { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: "Still syncing your workspace",
        description:
          err instanceof Error
            ? err.message
            : "We couldn't finish yet. Please wait a moment and try again.",
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSkipping(false);
    }
  }, [orgId, fallbackOrgId, navigate, toast]);

  const handleCreateOrg = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!orgName.trim() || !createOrganization) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      setState({ step: 0, phase: "creating" });
      const org = await createOrganization({ name: orgName.trim() });
      if (setActive && org) {
        await setActive({ organization: org.id });
      }
      sessionStorage.setItem("onboarding_resume", "connect-host");
      window.location.assign("/onboarding");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setState({ step: 0, phase: "form" });
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create organization. Please try again.");
    }
  }, [orgName, createOrganization, setActive]);

  const createEnrollment = useCallback(async () => {
    const clerkOrgId = orgId ?? fallbackOrgId;
    if (!clerkOrgId) {
      throw new Error("No active organization found. Please refresh the page.");
    }

    const enrollmentResponse = await agentEnrollmentApi.create({
      organizationId: clerkOrgId,
      hostName,
      hostUrl,
      connectionMode,
      dockerSocketPath: socketPath,
      cfServiceTokenId: connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenId.trim() || undefined : undefined,
      cfServiceTokenSecret: connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? cfServiceTokenSecret.trim() || undefined : undefined,
    });

    setEnrollment(enrollmentResponse);
    setRemediationCommand(null);
    setTestError("");
    setError(null);
    setState({ step: 1, phase: "install" });
  }, [orgId, fallbackOrgId, hostName, hostUrl, connectionMode, socketPath, cfServiceTokenId, cfServiceTokenSecret]);

  const handleBasicsNext = useCallback(async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!hostName.trim()) {
      setError("Host name is required.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      new URL(hostUrl);
    } catch {
      setError("Enter a valid URL (e.g. https://agent.example.com:9876)");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "preparing" });
      await createEnrollment();
    } catch (err) {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to prepare the guided setup command.");
    }
  }, [hostName, hostUrl, createEnrollment]);

  const handleRegenerateEnrollment = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "preparing" });
      await createEnrollment();
      toast({ title: "Fresh setup command ready", description: "A new enrollment command was generated for this host." });
    } catch (err) {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "install" });
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to regenerate the setup command.");
    }
  }, [createEnrollment, toast]);

  const finalizeEnrollment = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!enrollment?.session_id) {
      setError("No enrollment session is active. Generate a setup command first.");
      return;
    }

    setError(null);
    setTestError("");
    setRemediationCommand(null);

    try {
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "finalizing" });
      const result = await agentEnrollmentApi.finalize(enrollment.session_id);
      setFinalizeResult(result);

      if (!result.ok) {
        setTestError(result.status || "Connection test failed.");
        setRemediationCommand(result.remediation_command);
        setState({ step: 1, phase: "test-failed" });
        return;
      }

      const isWarning = result.reason_code === "agent_outdated" || result.reason_code === "metrics_unavailable";
      if (isWarning) {
        toast({
          title: "Host connected with follow-up recommended",
          description:
            result.reason_code === "agent_outdated"
              ? "The host is reachable, but the installed agent is behind the current release."
              : "The host is reachable, but local metrics verification still needs attention.",
        });
      } else {
        toast({ title: "Host connected!", description: `"${hostName}" is verified and ready.` });
      }
      setState({ step: 2, phase: "done" });
    } catch (err) {
      setTestError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Connection test failed.");
      setState({ step: 1, phase: "test-failed" });
    }
  }, [enrollment, hostName, toast]);

  const handleRetryTest = useCallback(async () => {
    await finalizeEnrollment();
  }, [finalizeEnrollment]);

  const handleBackToBasics = useCallback(() => {
    setError(null);
    setState({ step: 1, phase: "basics" });
  }, []);

  return {
    state,
    error,
    isSkipping,
    testError,
    remediationCommand,
    orgName,
    setOrgName,
    handleCreateOrg,
    hostName,
    setHostName,
    hostUrl,
    setHostUrl,
    connectionMode,
    setConnectionMode,
    socketPath,
    setSocketPath,
    cfServiceTokenId,
    setCfServiceTokenId,
    cfServiceTokenSecret,
    setCfServiceTokenSecret,
    enrollment,
    finalizeResult,
    handleBasicsNext,
    handleRetryTest,
    handleBackToBasics,
    handleSkip,
    completeOnboardingAndNavigate,
    handleFinalizeEnrollment: finalizeEnrollment,
    handleRegenerateEnrollment,
  };
}
````

````typescript
            {STEP_LABELS.map((step, index) => {
              const isActive = index === Math.min(stepIndex, STEP_LABELS.length - 1);
              const isDone = index < stepIndex;

              return (
                <div
                  key={step.id}
                  className={`rounded-2xl border px-3 py-3 ${
                    isActive
                      ? "border-primary/50 bg-primary/10"
                      : isDone
                        ? "border-border/70 bg-background/70"
                        : "border-border/50 bg-background/35"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
                    {isDone ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                    ) : isActive ? (
                      <Circle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 fill-primary text-primary" />
                    ) : (
                      <Circle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60" />
                    )}
                    Step {index + 1}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium">{step.label}</div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {state.step === "scope" ? (

                title="Frame the rollout"
````

````typescript
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export interface DockerHostPingResult {
  ok: boolean;
  status: string;
  docker_version: string | null;
  agent_version: string | null;
  agent_version_error: string | null;
  agent_update_available: boolean;
  current_agent_version: string | null;
  latest_agent_version: string | null;
  upgrade_command: string | null;
  source_label: string | null;
  published_release: boolean;
  release_url: string | null;
  release_notes_url: string | null;
  checksum: string | null;
  os_info: string | null;
  connection_mode: string;
}

async function invoke(body: Record<string, unknown>, idempotencyKey?: string) {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (idempotencyKey) {
    headers['Idempotency-Key'] = idempotencyKey;
  }
  const data = await apiFetch('/docker-proxy', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error + (data.details ? `: ${data.details}` : ''));
  return data;
}

const genKey = () => crypto.randomUUID();

export const dockerApi = {
  ping: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'ping', hostId }) as Promise<DockerHostPingResult>,
  hostMetrics: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'host-metrics', hostId }),
  info: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'info', hostId }),
  version: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'version', hostId }),
  listContainers: (hostId: string) => invoke({ action: 'containers', hostId }),
  inspectContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-inspect', hostId, containerId }),
  containerStats: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-stats', hostId, containerId }),
  containerLogs: (hostId: string, containerId: string, tail: string | number = 100, since?: number, until?: number) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-logs', hostId, containerId, params: { tail, since, until } }),
  startContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-start', hostId, containerId }, genKey()),
  stopContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-stop', hostId, containerId }, genKey()),
  restartContainer: (hostId: string, containerId: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-restart', hostId, containerId }, genKey()),
  allContainers: (orgId: string) => invoke({ action: 'all-containers', orgId }),
  allContainerStats: (orgId: string) => invoke({ action: 'all-container-stats', orgId }),
  listFiles: (hostId: string, containerId: string, path: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-fs-list', hostId, containerId, params: { path } }) as Promise<{ entries: FileEntry[] }>,
  readFile: (hostId: string, containerId: string, path: string) =>
    invoke({ action: 'container-fs-read', hostId, containerId, params: { path } }) as Promise<{ content: string; size: number; truncated: boolean; binary?: boolean; message?: string }>,
};

export interface FileEntry {
  name: string;
  type: 'file' | 'directory' | 'symlink' | 'other';
  size: number;
  permissions: string;
  modified: string;
  linkTarget?: string;
````
````json
}
````

## File: netlify/functions/api-notifications.mts
````typescript
import type { Config, Context } from "@netlify/functions";
import { requireAuth } from "./lib/auth.mjs";
import { sql } from "./lib/db.mjs";
import { ensureNotificationsSchema } from "./lib/ensure-notifications-schema.mjs";

export default async (req: Request, context: Context) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, {
      status: 204,
      headers: {
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Authorization, Content-Type",
      },
    });
  }

  const corsHeaders = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  };

  try {
    await ensureNotificationsSchema();
    const auth = await requireAuth(req, { requireOrg: false });

    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const pathSegments = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);

    // GET /api/notifications
    if (req.method === "GET") {
      // Fetch active notifications (global or org-specific) that haven't been dismissed by this user
      // and haven't expired
      const notifications = await sql`
        SELECT n.*
        FROM public.notifications n
        LEFT JOIN public.notification_dismissals d 
          ON n.id = d.notification_id AND d.user_id = ${auth.userId}
        WHERE (n.organization_id = ${auth.orgId} OR n.organization_id IS NULL)
          AND d.id IS NULL
          AND (n.expires_at IS NULL OR n.expires_at > now())
        ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 50
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ notifications }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: corsHeaders,
      });
    }

    // POST /api/notifications/:id/dismiss
    if (req.method === "POST" && pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 1] === "dismiss") {
      const notificationId = pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 2];
      
      const [notification] = await sql`
        SELECT id FROM public.notifications 
        WHERE id = ${notificationId} 
          AND (organization_id = ${auth.orgId} OR organization_id IS NULL)
      `;

      if (!notification) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Notification not found or unauthorized" }), {
          status: 404,
          headers: corsHeaders,
        });
      }
      
      await sql`
        INSERT INTO public.notification_dismissals (notification_id, user_id)
        VALUES (${notificationId}, ${auth.userId})
        ON CONFLICT (notification_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
      `;

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: corsHeaders,
      });
    }

    // POST /api/notifications/dismiss-all
    if (req.method === "POST" && pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 1] === "dismiss-all") {
      // Get all active notifications for this org/global
      const notifications = await sql`
        SELECT n.id
        FROM public.notifications n
        LEFT JOIN public.notification_dismissals d 
          ON n.id = d.notification_id AND d.user_id = ${auth.userId}
        WHERE (n.organization_id = ${auth.orgId} OR n.organization_id IS NULL)
          AND d.id IS NULL
          AND (n.expires_at IS NULL OR n.expires_at > now())
      `;

      if (notifications.length > 0) {
        const insertData = notifications.map(n => ({
          notification_id: n.id,
          user_id: auth.userId
        }));

        await sql`
          INSERT INTO public.notification_dismissals ${sql(insertData)}
          ON CONFLICT (notification_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
        `;
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: corsHeaders,
      });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }), {
      status: 405,
      headers: corsHeaders,
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Notifications API Error:", error);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), {
      status: error.message?.includes('Unauthorized') || error.message?.includes('Sync pending') ? 401 : 500,
      headers: corsHeaders,
    });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: "/api/notifications/*",
};
````

````typescript
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { KPICard } from "@/components/dashboard/KPICard";
import { HostHealthGrid } from "@/components/dashboard/HostHealthGrid";
import { FleetResourceChart } from "@/components/dashboard/FleetResourceChart";
import { ContainersTable } from "@/components/dashboard/ContainersTable";
import { DashboardAlerts } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardAlerts";
import { Activity, AlertCircle, Box, Server } from "lucide-react";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import type { DashboardStats } from "@/lib/dashboard-summary";

interface DashboardOverviewProps {
  organizationName?: string;
  organizationId: string | null;
  hosts: DockerHost[];
  stats: DashboardStats;
  containersLoading: boolean;
  liveDataError?: string | null;
  fleetMetricsRefetchInterval?: number | false;
}

export function DashboardOverview({
  organizationName,
  organizationId,
  hosts,
  stats,
  containersLoading,
  liveDataError,
  fleetMetricsRefetchInterval = 10000,
}: DashboardOverviewProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in pb-10">
      <div className="p-6 pb-0">
        <PageHeader
          title="Dashboard"
          description={organizationName || "Overview"}
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Operations" }, { label: "Fleet Summary" }]}
        />
      </div>

      {liveDataError ? (
        <div className="px-6">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
            {liveDataError}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="px-6 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        <KPICard label="Total Hosts" value={stats.hostsCount} subtext="Connected infra" icon={Server} status={stats.hostsCount > 0 ? "success" : "neutral"} />
        <KPICard label="Connected" value={stats.connectedCount} subtext="Active & healthy" status={stats.connectedCount === stats.hostsCount ? "success" : "warning"} trend={{ value: "Stable", type: "neutral" }} />
        <KPICard label="Unhealthy" value={stats.unhealthyCount} subtext="Critical attention" status={stats.unhealthyCount > 0 ? "destructive" : "success"} />
        <KPICard label="Containers" value={stats.containersCount} subtext="Total workloads" icon={Box} status="neutral" />
        <KPICard label="Running" value={stats.runningCount} subtext="Productive tasks" icon={Activity} status="success" />
        <KPICard label="Issues" value={stats.alerts.length} subtext="Active alerts" icon={AlertCircle} status={stats.alerts.length > 0 ? "destructive" : "success"} />
      </div>

      <div className="px-6 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 h-[350px]">
          <HostHealthGrid hosts={hosts} />
        </div>
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 h-[350px]">
          <FleetResourceChart orgId={organizationId} refetchInterval={fleetMetricsRefetchInterval} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="px-6 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-3 min-h-[450px]">
          <ContainersTable containers={stats.containers} isLoading={containersLoading} />
        </div>
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 min-h-[450px]">
          <DashboardAlerts alerts={stats.alerts} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````
