import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { AgentUpdateDialog } from "@/components/hosts/AgentUpdateDialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Terminal } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { normalizeHostStatus } from "@/lib/host-health-state";
import type { HostMetricsDisk, HostMetricsFailure, HostMetricsPoint } from "@/hooks/useHostMetrics";
import type { DockerHost } from "@/types/database";
import { CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION } from "@/lib/agent-version";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared formatting helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function formatBytes(bytes: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (bytes === null || bytes === undefined || !Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "Unavailable";
  if (bytes === 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const exponent = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exponent;
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 || exponent === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[exponent]}`;
}

function formatSpeed(bytesPerSecond: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytesPerSecond) || bytesPerSecond === null || bytesPerSecond === undefined || bytesPerSecond < 0) {
    return "Unavailable";
  }
  if (bytesPerSecond === 0) return "0 B/s";
  return `${formatBytes(bytesPerSecond)}/s`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sub-components
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function EmptyState({ title, description }: { title: string; description: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[220px] p-6 flex flex-col justify-center text-center">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function LoadingState() {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[220px] p-6 flex items-center justify-center">
      <Loader2 className="h-7 w-7 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
    </div>
  );
}

function RingCard({ point }: { point: HostMetricsPoint }) {
  const value = point.cpu !== null ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, point.cpu)) : 0;
  const colorVar = value >= 90 ? "var(--destructive)" : value >= 70 ? "var(--warning)" : "var(--primary)";

  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[260px] p-5 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4">
      <div className="text-center">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-muted-foreground">CPU usage</p>
      </div>
      <div
        className="relative flex h-44 w-44 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
        style={{
          background: point.cpu !== null 
            ? `conic-gradient(hsl(${colorVar}) ${value}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) ${value}% 100%)` 
            : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex h-32 w-32 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-background/95">
          <span className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            {point.cpu !== null ? `${value.toFixed(0)}%` : "Unavailable"}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
        {point.usedCores !== null ? point.usedCores.toFixed(2) : "--"} / {point.totalCores !== null ? point.totalCores.toFixed(2) : "--"} cores
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function ContainerSummaryCard({
  total,
  running,
  loading,
  disconnected,
  paused,
}: {
  total: number;
  running: number;
  loading: boolean;
  disconnected: boolean;
  paused?: boolean;
}) {
  const stopped = Math.max(0, total - running);
  const showStoppedCount = !disconnected && !paused && !loading;

  return (
    <div className="glass-card min-h-[220px] p-5 flex flex-col justify-between">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Containers</p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">Host workload</h3>
        </div>
      </div>

      {disconnected ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Reconnect the host to load container counts.</p>
      ) : paused && total === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Container counts are paused while the host heartbeat is stale.</p>
      ) : loading ? (
        <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Total</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{total}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-background/40 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">Running</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{running}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showStoppedCount ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stopped} stopped containers on this host.</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function MeterCard({
  title,
  value,
  helper,
  progress,
  footer,
}: {
  title: string;
  value: string;
  helper?: string;
  progress?: number | null;
  footer?: string;
}) {
  const width = progress === null || progress === undefined ? undefined : `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress))}%`;
  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>
          <p className="mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{value}</p>
        </div>
        {helper && <span className="text-xs text-right text-muted-foreground">{helper}</span>}
      </div>
      {width && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="h-3 rounded-full bg-white/5 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width }} />
          </div>
          {footer && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{footer}</p>}
        </div>
      )}
      {!width && footer && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{footer}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function DiskUsageCard({ disk }: { disk: HostMetricsDisk }) {
  const progress = disk.totalBytes > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (disk.usedBytes / disk.totalBytes) * 100)) : 0;

  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Disk usage ({disk.device})</p>
          <p className="mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            {formatBytes(disk.usedBytes)} <span className="text-muted-foreground">/ {formatBytes(disk.totalBytes)}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <p className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground">{disk.mount}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/5">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{progress.toFixed(0)}% utilized</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
        <span>Read: <span className="text-foreground">{formatSpeed(disk.readBytesPerSec)}</span></span>
        <span>Write: <span className="text-foreground">{formatSpeed(disk.writeBytesPerSec)}</span></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TrendBars({
  history,
  accessor,
  secondaryAccessor,
  maxBars = 24,
}: {
  history: HostMetricsPoint[];
  accessor: (point: HostMetricsPoint) => number | null;
  secondaryAccessor?: (point: HostMetricsPoint) => number | null;
  maxBars?: number;
}) {
  const totals = history.map(p => (accessor(p) ?? 0) + (secondaryAccessor?.(p) ?? 0));
  const maxValue = totals.length > 0 ? Math.max(...totals, 1) : 1;
  const hasData = history.length > 0;

  if (!hasData) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-36 items-end gap-2">
        {Array.from({ length: maxBars }).map((_, index) => {
          const height = 18 + (index % 5) * 10;
          return (
            <div
              key={`placeholder-${index}`}
              className="flex-1 rounded-t-full bg-primary/20 transition-all"
              style={{ height: `${height}%` }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const emptySlots = Math.max(0, maxBars - history.length);
  const dataBars = history.slice(-maxBars);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-36 items-end gap-2">
      {Array.from({ length: emptySlots }).map((_, index) => (
        <div key={`empty-${index}`} className="flex-1 rounded-t-full bg-white/5 transition-all" style={{ height: '4px' }} />
      ))}
      {dataBars.map((point) => {
        const valPrimary = accessor(point) ?? 0;
        const valSecondary = secondaryAccessor?.(point) ?? 0;
        const total = valPrimary + valSecondary;

        const primaryHeight = total === 0 ? 2 : Math.max(2, Math.round((valPrimary / maxValue) * 100));
        const secondaryHeight = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((valSecondary / maxValue) * 100);

        return (
          <div
            key={point.timestamp}
            className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-end gap-[1px]"
            style={{ height: `${Math.max(4, primaryHeight + secondaryHeight)}%` }}
          >
            {valSecondary > 0 && (
              <div
                className="w-full rounded-t-full bg-muted-foreground/40 transition-all duration-500"
                style={{ height: `${(secondaryHeight / (primaryHeight + secondaryHeight)) * 100}%` }}
              />
            )}
            <div
              className={cn(
                "w-full transition-all duration-500",
                valSecondary > 0 ? "rounded-b-sm" : "rounded-t-full",
                "bg-primary/60"
              )}
              style={{ height: `${(primaryHeight / (primaryHeight + secondaryHeight)) * 100}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Metrics status helpers (resolve which panel variant to render)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface MetricsState {
  disconnected: boolean;
  stale: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  hasLatestPoint: boolean;
  hasFailure: boolean;
  hasHistory: boolean;
}

type MetricsVariant = "disconnected" | "loading" | "failure" | "stale" | "data" | "empty";

function resolveMetricsVariant(state: MetricsState): MetricsVariant {
  if (state.disconnected) return "disconnected";
  if (state.isLoading && !state.hasLatestPoint) return "loading";
  if (state.hasFailure && !state.hasLatestPoint) return "failure";
  if (state.hasLatestPoint) return "data";
  if (state.stale) return "stale";
  return "empty";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main grid component
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface HostMetricsGridProps {
  selectedHost: DockerHost;
  metricsQuery: {
    isLoading: boolean;
    isFetching: boolean;
    latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
    history: HostMetricsPoint[];
    failure: HostMetricsFailure | null;
  };
  containersQuery: {
    isLoading: boolean;
    isFetching: boolean;
    data: unknown;
    error: unknown;
  };
  containers: unknown[];
  runningCount: number;
  metricsFailureDisplay: { title: string; description: string } | null;
  missingExtendedMetrics: boolean;
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  agentUpdateStatus: string;
  agentUpdateStatusCopy: { title: string; description: string };
  verificationReason: string | null;
  showAgentUpdateCta: boolean;
}

export function HostMetricsGrid({
  selectedHost,
  metricsQuery,
  containersQuery,
  containers,
  runningCount,
  metricsFailureDisplay,
  missingExtendedMetrics,
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  agentUpdateStatus,
  agentUpdateStatusCopy,
  verificationReason,
  showAgentUpdateCta,
}: HostMetricsGridProps) {
  const metricsState: MetricsState = {
    disconnected: selectedHostDisconnected,
    stale: selectedHostStale,
    isLoading: metricsQuery.isLoading,
    hasLatestPoint: !!metricsQuery.latestPoint,
    hasFailure: !!metricsQuery.failure,
    hasHistory: metricsQuery.history.length > 0,
  };

  const variant = resolveMetricsVariant(metricsState);
  const failureTitle = metricsFailureDisplay?.title || "Host metrics unavailable";
  const failureDescription = metricsFailureDisplay?.description || "The host metrics probe failed before a usable sample was returned.";

  const missingHint = missingExtendedMetrics
    ? `Update or repair the host agent to restore the full metrics sample.`
    : "Waiting for a usable metrics sample from the host agent.";

  const diskMissingHint = missingExtendedMetrics
    ? `This host agent is not reporting per-disk usage yet. Update or repair the agent to ${CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION}, then Verify.`
    : "Waiting for a usable per-disk metrics sample from the host agent.";

  return (
    <>
      {/* Agent update CTA banner */}
      {showAgentUpdateCta && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-4 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="font-medium text-foreground">{agentUpdateStatusCopy.title}</p>
            <p className="mt-1">{agentUpdateStatusCopy.description}</p>
          </div>
          <AgentUpdateDialog
            host={selectedHost}
            status={agentUpdateStatus}
            statusCopy={agentUpdateStatusCopy}
            verificationReason={verificationReason}
            trigger={
              <Button className="gap-2">
                <Terminal className="h-4 w-4" />
                {agentUpdateStatus === "verification_required" ? "Open Verification Steps" : "Open Update Steps"}
              </Button>
            }
          />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(280px,340px),1fr]">
        {/* Left column: CPU ring + container summary */}
        <div className="grid gap-6">
          <CpuPanel variant={variant} latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint} failureTitle={failureTitle} failureDescription={failureDescription} />
          <ContainerSummaryCard
            total={containers.length}
            running={runningCount}
            loading={containersQuery.isLoading}
            disconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
            paused={selectedHostStale}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Right column: memory, disk, network */}
        <div className="grid gap-6">
          <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
            <MemoryPanel variant={variant} latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint} failureTitle={failureTitle} failureDescription={failureDescription} missingHint={missingHint} />
            <DiskPanel variant={variant} latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint} failureTitle={failureTitle} failureDescription={failureDescription} diskMissingHint={diskMissingHint} />
          </div>
          <NetworkPanel
            variant={variant}
            latestPoint={metricsQuery.latestPoint}
            history={metricsQuery.history}
            failureDescription={failureDescription}
            selectedHostDisconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
            selectedHostStale={selectedHostStale}
            metricsIsLoading={metricsQuery.isLoading}
            hasFailure={!!metricsQuery.failure}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Panel sub-components (one per metrics section)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function CpuPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  failureTitle,
  failureDescription,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  failureTitle: string;
  failureDescription: string;
}) {
  switch (variant) {
    case "disconnected":
      return <EmptyState title="Host is disconnected" description="Reconnect the host or run a successful connection test to start collecting host metrics." />;
    case "loading":
      return <div className="glass-card min-h-[260px] flex items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>;
    case "failure":
      return <EmptyState title={failureTitle} description={failureDescription} />;
    case "data":
      return <RingCard point={latestPoint!} />;
    case "stale":
      return <EmptyState title="Metrics paused" description="Automatic metrics collection is paused while the host heartbeat is stale. Data will resume after a successful health check or connection test." />;
    default:
      return <EmptyState title="No CPU metrics yet" description="The host is connected, but the agent has not returned a usable metrics sample yet." />;
  }
}

function MemoryPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  failureTitle,
  failureDescription,
  missingHint,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  failureTitle: string;
  failureDescription: string;
  missingHint: string;
}) {
  switch (variant) {
    case "disconnected":
      return <EmptyState title="Memory metrics unavailable" description="Memory panels appear after a connected host returns a metrics sample." />;
    case "loading":
      return <LoadingState />;
    case "failure":
      return <EmptyState title={failureTitle || "Memory metrics unavailable"} description={failureDescription || "The host metrics probe failed before memory data was returned."} />;
    case "data":
      return (
        <MeterCard
          title="Memory usage"
          value={formatBytes(latestPoint!.memoryUsed)}
          helper={latestPoint!.memoryLimit !== null ? formatBytes(latestPoint!.memoryLimit) : undefined}
          progress={latestPoint!.memory}
          footer={latestPoint!.memory !== null ? `${latestPoint!.memory.toFixed(0)}% utilized` : undefined}
        />
      );
    case "stale":
      return <EmptyState title="Memory metrics paused" description="Automatic metrics collection is paused while the host heartbeat is stale." />;
    default:
      return <EmptyState title="Memory metrics unavailable" description={missingHint} />;
  }
}

function DiskPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  failureTitle,
  failureDescription,
  diskMissingHint,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  failureTitle: string;
  failureDescription: string;
  diskMissingHint: string;
}) {
  switch (variant) {
    case "disconnected":
      return <EmptyState title="Disk usage unavailable" description="Disk usage is shown only for connected hosts with live metrics." />;
    case "loading":
      return <LoadingState />;
    case "failure":
      return <EmptyState title={failureTitle || "Disk usage unavailable"} description={failureDescription || "The host metrics probe failed before disk usage data was returned."} />;
    case "data":
      if (latestPoint?.disks.length) {
        return (
          <>
            {latestPoint.disks.map((disk) => (
              <DiskUsageCard key={`${disk.device}-${disk.mount}`} disk={disk} />
            ))}
          </>
        );
      }
      return <EmptyState title="Disk usage unavailable" description={diskMissingHint} />;
    case "stale":
      return <EmptyState title="Disk metrics paused" description="Automatic metrics collection is paused while the host heartbeat is stale." />;
    default:
      return <EmptyState title="Disk usage unavailable" description={diskMissingHint} />;
  }
}

function NetworkPanel({
  variant,
  latestPoint,
  history,
  failureDescription,
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  metricsIsLoading,
  hasFailure,
}: {
  variant: MetricsVariant;
  latestPoint: HostMetricsPoint | undefined;
  history: HostMetricsPoint[];
  failureDescription: string;
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  metricsIsLoading: boolean;
  hasFailure: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="glass-card p-5 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">Network activity</p>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-primary uppercase tracking-wider">Inbound</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                {latestPoint ? formatSpeed(latestPoint.networkInBytesPerSec) : "Unavailable"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Outbound</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                {latestPoint ? formatSpeed(latestPoint.networkOutBytesPerSec) : "Unavailable"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-primary" />Inbound</span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/60" />Outbound</span>
          </div>
          {latestPoint?.networkMonthlyTotal !== undefined ? (
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              Monthly usage: <span className="text-foreground">{formatBytes(latestPoint.networkMonthlyTotal)}</span>
            </p>
          ) : latestPoint ? (
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              Total: <span className="text-foreground">{formatSpeed((latestPoint.networkInBytesPerSec || 0) + (latestPoint.networkOutBytesPerSec || 0))}</span>
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
      <NetworkTrendSection
        selectedHostDisconnected={selectedHostDisconnected}
        selectedHostStale={selectedHostStale}
        metricsIsLoading={metricsIsLoading}
        hasLatestPoint={!!latestPoint}
        hasFailure={hasFailure}
        hasHistory={history.length > 0}
        history={history}
        failureDescription={failureDescription}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function NetworkTrendSection({
  selectedHostDisconnected,
  selectedHostStale,
  metricsIsLoading,
  hasLatestPoint,
  hasFailure,
  hasHistory,
  history,
  failureDescription,
}: {
  selectedHostDisconnected: boolean;
  selectedHostStale: boolean;
  metricsIsLoading: boolean;
  hasLatestPoint: boolean;
  hasFailure: boolean;
  hasHistory: boolean;
  history: HostMetricsPoint[];
  failureDescription: string;
}) {
  if (selectedHostDisconnected) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Connect this host to start rendering throughput history.</p>;
  }
  if (metricsIsLoading && !hasLatestPoint) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-36 items-center justify-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (hasFailure && !hasLatestPoint) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-36 items-center justify-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center max-w-md">
          {failureDescription || "Network throughput is unavailable while the metrics probe cannot reach this host."}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (selectedHostStale && !hasHistory) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Network throughput history is paused while the host heartbeat is stale.</p>;
  }
  return (
    <TrendBars
      history={history}
      accessor={(point) => point.networkInBytesPerSec}
      secondaryAccessor={(point) => point.networkOutBytesPerSec}
    />
  );
}

import { Navigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "@clerk/react";
import { isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled } from "@/lib/hostname";
import { useAuthMe, type AuthMeState } from "@/hooks/useAuthMe";

interface ProtectedRouteProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  requireOnboarded?: boolean;
  allowMissingOrganization?: boolean;
  skipResolvedRedirect?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Main application routing gate.
 * 
 * Responsibilities:
 * 1. Clerk Auth Verification
 * 2. Backend State Sync (/api/auth/me)
 * 3. Dedicated Deployment Blocking
 * 4. Onboarding & Org Requirements
 */
export function ProtectedRoute({
  children,
  requireOnboarded = true,
  allowMissingOrganization = false,
  skipResolvedRedirect = false,
}: ProtectedRouteProps) {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const previewBypass = isPreviewAuthBypassEnabled();
  
  // Custom hook encapsulates fetch/retry/polling logic (flattens CC)
  const authMe = useAuthMe(!previewBypass);

  // 1. System-level bypass (Previews/Local Dev)
  if (previewBypass) return <>{children}</>;

  // 2. Auth Loading State
  if (!isLoaded || authMe.status === "loading") {
    return <FullScreenLoader />;
  }

  // 3. Unauthenticated State
  if (!isSignedIn || authMe.status === "unauthenticated") {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  // 4. Backend Synchronization Error
  if (authMe.status === "error") {
    return <AuthErrorState />;
  }

  // 5. State-driven Redirect Logic (flattens "Bumpy Road")
  const redirect = getRedirectTarget({
    state: authMe,
    pathname: location.pathname,
    requireOnboarded,
    allowMissingOrganization,
    skipResolvedRedirect
  });

  if (redirect) {
    return <Navigate to={redirect} replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

/**
 * Pure helper to determine redirect target based on application state.
 */
function getRedirectTarget({
  state,
  pathname,
  requireOnboarded,
  allowMissingOrganization,
  skipResolvedRedirect
}: {
  state: AuthMeState;
  pathname: string;
  requireOnboarded: boolean;
  allowMissingOrganization: boolean;
  skipResolvedRedirect: boolean;
}): string | null {
  // --- Route classification ---
  const isOnboardingRoute = pathname.startsWith("/onboarding");
  const isDedicatedIntakeRoute = pathname.startsWith("/dedicated/intake");
  const isDedicatedStatusRoute = pathname.startsWith("/app/dedicated-deployment");

  // --- Business rule predicates ---
  const deploymentInProgress = isDeploymentBlocked(state.dedicatedDeploymentStatus);

  const shouldBlockForDeployment =
    deploymentInProgress && !isDedicatedStatusRoute && !isDedicatedIntakeRoute;

  const needsOrgCreation =
    !state.hasOrgs && !allowMissingOrganization && !isOnboardingRoute;

  const shouldForceOnboarding =
    requireOnboarded && state.hasOrgs && state.needsOnboarding &&
    !deploymentInProgress && !isOnboardingRoute;

  const onboardingAlreadyComplete =
    !requireOnboarded && !skipResolvedRedirect && state.hasOrgs &&
    !state.needsOnboarding && !deploymentInProgress;

  // --- Redirect decision (first match wins) ---
  if (shouldBlockForDeployment) return "/app/dedicated-deployment";
  if (needsOrgCreation) return "/onboarding";
  if (shouldForceOnboarding) return "/onboarding";
  if (onboardingAlreadyComplete) return "/app";

  return null;
}

/** Deployment is blocked when status exists but isn't in a terminal state. */
function isDeploymentBlocked(status: string | null): boolean {
  if (status === null) return false;
  const terminalStates = ["ready_for_handoff", "active"];
  return !terminalStates.includes(status);
}

function FullScreenLoader() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-background">
      <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
    </div>
  );
}

function AuthErrorState() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-background px-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">Unable to verify onboarding status right now.</p>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
        className="text-sm font-medium text-primary hover:underline"
      >
        Retry
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";

export interface HostMetricsPoint {
  timestamp: number;
  time: string;
  cpu: number | null;
  memory: number | null;
  usedCores: number | null;
  totalCores: number | null;
  memoryUsed: number | null;
  memoryLimit: number | null;
  networkInBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkOutBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkMonthlyTotal: number | null;
  diskReadBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec: number | null;
  uptimeSeconds: number | null;
  disks: HostMetricsDisk[];
}

export interface HostMetricsDisk {
  device: string;
  mount: string;
  usedBytes: number;
  totalBytes: number;
  readBytesPerSec: number | null;
  writeBytesPerSec: number | null;
}

export interface HostMetricsFailure {
  message: string;
  code?: string;
  details?: unknown;
  status?: number;
  upstreamStatus?: number;
  unsupportedEndpoint: boolean;
  malformedPayload: boolean;
}

interface HostMetricsApiPoint {
  timestamp?: string | number;
  time?: string;
  cpu?: number;
  memory?: number;
  usedCores?: number;
  totalCores?: number;
  memoryUsed?: number;
  memoryLimit?: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec?: number;
  networkOutBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskReadBytesPerSec?: number;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec?: number;
  network_in_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  network_out_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_read_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  disk_write_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  networkMonthlyTotal?: number;
  network_monthly_total?: number;
  uptimeSeconds?: number;
  uptime_seconds?: number;
  used_cores?: number;
  total_cores?: number;
  memory_used?: number;
  memory_limit?: number;
  disks?: unknown;
}

interface HostMetricsApiDisk {
  device?: string;
  mount?: string;
  usedBytes?: number;
  totalBytes?: number;
  readBytesPerSec?: number;
  writeBytesPerSec?: number;
  used_bytes?: number;
  total_bytes?: number;
  read_bytes_per_sec?: number;
  write_bytes_per_sec?: number;
}

function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (value === null || value === "" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const numeric = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

function toTimestamp(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value === "string" && value !== "") {
    const numeric = Number(value);
    if (Number.isFinite(numeric)) return numeric;
    const parsed = Date.parse(value);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) return parsed;
  }
  return null;
}

function formatTimeLabel(timestamp: number): string {
  return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  });
}

function normalizeOptionalRate(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (numeric === null || numeric < 0) return null;
  return numeric;
}

function normalizeHostMetricsDisk(value: unknown): HostMetricsDisk | null {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;

  const disk = value as HostMetricsApiDisk;
  const device = typeof disk.device === "string" ? disk.device.trim() : "";
  const mount = typeof disk.mount === "string" ? disk.mount.trim() : "";
  const usedBytes = toFiniteNumber(disk.usedBytes ?? disk.used_bytes);
  const totalBytes = toFiniteNumber(disk.totalBytes ?? disk.total_bytes);
  const readBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(disk.readBytesPerSec ?? disk.read_bytes_per_sec);
  const writeBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(disk.writeBytesPerSec ?? disk.write_bytes_per_sec);

  if (!device || !mount || usedBytes === null || totalBytes === null || usedBytes < 0 || totalBytes <= 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    device,
    mount,
    usedBytes,
    totalBytes: Math.max(usedBytes, totalBytes),
    readBytesPerSec,
    writeBytesPerSec,
  };
}

function extractMetrics(point: HostMetricsApiPoint): HostMetricsPoint {
  const timestamp = toTimestamp(point.timestamp) ?? Date.now();

  const cpu = toFiniteNumber(point.cpu);
  const memory = toFiniteNumber(point.memory);
  const usedCores = toFiniteNumber(point.usedCores ?? point.used_cores);
  const totalCores = toFiniteNumber(point.totalCores ?? point.total_cores);
  const memoryUsed = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryUsed ?? point.memory_used);
  const memoryLimit = toFiniteNumber(point.memoryLimit ?? point.memory_limit);

  const networkInBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkInBytesPerSec ?? point.network_in_bytes_per_sec);
  const networkOutBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.networkOutBytesPerSec ?? point.network_out_bytes_per_sec);
  const networkMonthlyTotal = toFiniteNumber(point.networkMonthlyTotal ?? point.network_monthly_total);
  const diskReadBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskReadBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_read_bytes_per_sec);
  const diskWriteBytesPerSec = normalizeOptionalRate(point.diskWriteBytesPerSec ?? point.disk_write_bytes_per_sec);
  const uptimeSecondsRaw = toFiniteNumber(point.uptimeSeconds ?? point.uptime_seconds);
  const uptimeSeconds = uptimeSecondsRaw !== null && uptimeSecondsRaw >= 0 ? uptimeSecondsRaw : null;
  const disks = Array.isArray(point.disks) ? point.disks.map(normalizeHostMetricsDisk).filter((disk): disk is HostMetricsDisk => disk !== null) : [];

  return {
    timestamp,
    time: formatTimeLabel(timestamp),
    cpu,
    memory,
    usedCores,
    totalCores,
    memoryUsed,
    memoryLimit,
    networkInBytesPerSec,
    networkOutBytesPerSec,
    networkMonthlyTotal,
    diskReadBytesPerSec,
    diskWriteBytesPerSec,
    uptimeSeconds,
    disks,
  };
}

function validateMetricsRanges(metrics: HostMetricsPoint): HostMetricsPoint {
  const cpu = metrics.cpu !== null ? clamp(metrics.cpu, 0, 100) : null;
  const memory = metrics.memory !== null ? clamp(metrics.memory, 0, 100) : null;

  const totalCores = metrics.totalCores !== null ? Math.max(0, metrics.totalCores) : null;
  const usedCores = metrics.usedCores !== null 
    ? clamp(metrics.usedCores, 0, totalCores !== null ? totalCores : metrics.usedCores) 
    : null;

  const memoryLimit = metrics.memoryLimit !== null ? Math.max(0, metrics.memoryLimit) : null;
  const memoryUsed = metrics.memoryUsed !== null 
    ? clamp(metrics.memoryUsed, 0, memoryLimit !== null ? memoryLimit : metrics.memoryUsed) 
    : null;

  return {
    ...metrics,
    cpu,
    memory,
    usedCores,
    totalCores,
    memoryUsed,
    memoryLimit,
  };
}

function isMetricsSampleValid(metrics: HostMetricsPoint): boolean {
  return metrics.cpu !== null && metrics.memory !== null;
}

export function normalizeHostMetricsPoint(point: HostMetricsApiPoint): HostMetricsPoint | null {
  const extracted = extractMetrics(point);
  const validated = validateMetricsRanges(extracted);

  if (!isMetricsSampleValid(validated)) {
    return null;
  }

  return validated;
}

function formatFailureDetails(details: unknown): string | null {
  if (details === null || details === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof details === "string") return details;
  if (typeof details === "object") {
    const error = typeof (details as { error?: unknown }).error === "string" ? (details as { error: string }).error : null;
    if (error) return error;
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(details);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  return String(details);
}

export function getHostMetricsFailure(error: unknown): HostMetricsFailure | null {
  if (!error) return null;

  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    const details = error.details;
    const detailText = formatFailureDetails(details);
    const message = detailText ? `${error.message}: ${detailText}` : error.message;
    return {
      message,
      code: error.code,
      details,
      status: error.status,
      upstreamStatus: error.upstreamStatus,
      unsupportedEndpoint:
        error.code === "metrics_endpoint_unsupported" ||
        error.status === 404 ||
        error.status === 405,
      malformedPayload: error.code === "malformed_metrics_payload",
    };
  }

  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return {
      message: error.message,
      unsupportedEndpoint: false,
      malformedPayload: false,
    };
  }

  return {
    message: "Host metrics are temporarily unavailable.",
    unsupportedEndpoint: false,
    malformedPayload: false,
  };
}

interface UseHostMetricsOptions {
  enabled?: boolean;
  refetchInterval?: number | false;
}

export function useHostMetrics(hostId?: string | null, options: UseHostMetricsOptions = {}) {
  const { enabled = true, refetchInterval = 10000 } = options;

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["host-metrics", hostId],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<HostMetricsPoint> => {
      const data = await dockerApi.hostMetrics(hostId!);
      const normalized = normalizeHostMetricsPoint((data ?? {}) as HostMetricsApiPoint);
      if (!normalized) {
        throw new ApiError(
          502,
          {
            error: "Host metrics unavailable",
            code: "malformed_metrics_payload",
            details: "Agent returned a success response without a usable host metrics sample.",
          },
          "Host metrics unavailable",
        );
      }
      return normalized;
    },
    enabled: enabled && !!hostId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      if (!enabled || !hostId) return false;
      return query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval;
    },
  });

  return {
    ...query,
    failure: getHostMetricsFailure(query.error),
  };
}

interface UseHostMetricsHistoryOptions extends UseHostMetricsOptions {
  maxDataPoints?: number;
}

export function useHostMetricsHistory(hostId?: string | null, options: UseHostMetricsHistoryOptions = {}) {
  const { maxDataPoints = 24, enabled = true, refetchInterval = 10000 } = options;
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<HostMetricsPoint[]>([]);
  const query = useHostMetrics(hostId, { enabled, refetchInterval });

  useEffect(() => {
    setHistory([]);
  }, [hostId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query.data) return;

    setHistory((previous) => {
      const withoutDuplicate = previous.filter((point) => point.timestamp !== query.data!.timestamp);
      return [...withoutDuplicate, query.data!]
        .sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp)
        .slice(-maxDataPoints);
    });
  }, [maxDataPoints, query.data]);

  const latestPoint = history[history.length - 1] ?? query.data;
  const failure = useMemo(() => getHostMetricsFailure(query.error), [query.error]);

  return {
    ...query,
    history,
    latestPoint,
    failure,
  };
}

/**
 * Sanitize raw API/connection error messages into user-friendly copy.
 * Strips technical noise (HTTP codes, raw HTML page titles, Cloudflare
 * diagnostic dumps) and returns a short, actionable sentence.
 */

interface SanitizedError {
  /** A short, human-readable headline (≤ 6 words). */
  title: string;
  /** A concise actionable description. */
  description: string;
  /** The original raw error message, useful for support links. */
  raw: string;
}

const CLOUDFLARE_PATTERNS = [
  /cloudflare/i,
  /cf-ray/i,
  /cloudflare tunnel error/i,
  /cloudflare html error/i,
];

const TIMEOUT_PATTERNS = [
  /timed?\s?out/i,
  /did not respond in time/i,
  /ETIMEDOUT/i,
  /timeout/i,
  /504/,
];

const UNREACHABLE_PATTERNS = [
  /ECONNREFUSED/i,
  /ENOTFOUND/i,
  /ENETUNREACH/i,
  /could not reach/i,
  /connection.*refused/i,
  /502/,
];

const AGENT_AUTH_PATTERNS = [
  /agent_auth_failed/i,
  /agent_unauthorized/i,
  /invalid api key/i,
  /invalid agent api key/i,
  /rejected the saved api key/i,
];

const DOCKER_SOCKET_PATTERNS = [
  /docker_socket_unavailable/i,
  /docker socket not found/i,
  /docker api request failed/i,
  /configured socket/i,
];

const DOCKERDASH_EDGE_PATTERNS = [
  /cloudflare gateway error:/i,
  /app\.dockerdash\.app/i,
  /dockerdash\.app\s*\|\s*502/i,
];

function isCloudflareError(msg: string) {
  return CLOUDFLARE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function isDockerdashEdgeError(msg: string) {
  return DOCKERDASH_EDGE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function isTimeoutError(msg: string) {
  return TIMEOUT_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function isUnreachableError(msg: string) {
  return UNREACHABLE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(msg));
}

function stringifyStructuredError(error: unknown) {
  if (!error || typeof error !== "object") return "";

  const record = error as {
    code?: unknown;
    details?: unknown;
    body?: {
      code?: unknown;
      type?: unknown;
      detail?: unknown;
      details?: unknown;
      error?: unknown;
      title?: unknown;
    };
  };
  const values = [
    record.code,
    record.details,
    record.body?.code,
    record.body?.type,
    record.body?.detail,
    record.body?.details,
    record.body?.error,
    record.body?.title,
  ];

  return values
    .map((value) => {
      if (typeof value === "string") return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        try {
          return JSON.stringify(value);
        } catch {
          return "";
        }
      }
      return "";
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");
}

function isAgentAuthError(msg: string, error: unknown) {
  const haystack = `${msg} ${stringifyStructuredError(error)}`;
  return AGENT_AUTH_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(haystack));
}

function isDockerSocketError(msg: string, error: unknown) {
  const haystack = `${msg} ${stringifyStructuredError(error)}`;
  return DOCKER_SOCKET_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(haystack));
}

export function sanitizeConnectionError(error: unknown): SanitizedError {
  const raw =
    error instanceof Error ? error.message : typeof error === "string" ? error : "Unknown error";

  if (isAgentAuthError(raw, error)) {
    return {
      title: "API key mismatch",
      description:
        "The agent is reachable, but it rejected the saved API key. Re-enter the key from /etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env or run the agent repair command so both sides use the same key.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isDockerSocketError(raw, error)) {
    return {
      title: "Docker socket inaccessible",
      description:
        "The agent is reachable, but it cannot talk to Docker through its configured socket. Run Troubleshoot / Repair or reinstall the agent so the systemd service has Docker socket group access, then retry.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isTimeoutError(raw)) {
    return {
      title: "Connection timed out",
      description:
        "The agent did not respond in time. Make sure the Watchtower agent process is running and the host is reachable.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isCloudflareError(raw)) {
    if (isDockerdashEdgeError(raw)) {
      return {
        title: "Dockerdash gateway error",
        description:
          "Dockerdash returned a gateway error before the agent response could be classified. Retry, then check the saved host URL and API key if it persists.",
        raw,
      };
    }

    return {
      title: "Tunnel unreachable",
      description:
        "Cloudflare could not reach the Watchtower agent. Check that the tunnel is active, the route is correctly configured, and the agent service is running.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  if (isUnreachableError(raw)) {
    return {
      title: "Host unreachable",
      description:
        "The dashboard could not connect to the Watchtower agent. Verify the host URL, ensure the agent is running, and check any firewall rules.",
      raw,
    };
  }

  // Catch-all: strip "Connection test failed:" prefix if present
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/^Connection test failed:\s*/i, "").trim();

  return {
    title: "Connection failed",
    description: cleaned || "The host could not be reached. Check the agent service and network configuration.",
    raw,
  };
}

                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All severities</SelectItem>

                  <SelectItem value="error">Error</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="warning">Warning</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="info">Info</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-full sm:w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="Status" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>

              <AlertRulesPanel

                slackDestinationsCount={enabledSlackDestinationsCount}

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ChevronRight,
  File,
  FileCode,
  FileJson,
  FileText,
  Folder,
  FolderOpen,
  HardDrive,
  Home,
  Link2,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  Server,
  X,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/PageHeader";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useContainerFileList, useContainerFileContent } from "@/hooks/useContainerFiles";
import { useContainers } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { PremiumFeatureBlock } from "@/components/shared/PremiumFeatureBlock";
import type { FileEntry } from "@/services/docker-api";

// ── Helpers ──

function getFileIcon(entry: FileEntry) {
  if (entry.type === "directory") return Folder;
  if (entry.type === "symlink") return Link2;
  const ext = entry.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  if (["json", "jsonl"].includes(ext)) return FileJson;
  if (["ts", "tsx", "js", "jsx", "py", "go", "rs", "sh", "bash", "rb", "java", "c", "cpp", "h", "css", "scss", "html", "xml", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "ini", "conf", "cfg", "env", "dockerfile", "makefile"].includes(ext)) return FileCode;
  if (["md", "txt", "log", "csv"].includes(ext)) return FileText;
  return File;
}

function formatFileSize(bytes: number) {
  if (bytes <= 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  const exponent = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exponent;
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 || exponent === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[exponent]}`;
}

function getLanguageFromPath(path: string): string {
  const ext = path.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    ts: "typescript", tsx: "tsx", js: "javascript", jsx: "jsx",
    json: "json", yaml: "yaml", yml: "yaml", toml: "toml",
    py: "python", go: "go", rs: "rust", sh: "bash", bash: "bash",
    rb: "ruby", java: "java", c: "c", cpp: "cpp", h: "c",
    css: "css", scss: "scss", html: "html", xml: "xml",
    md: "markdown", sql: "sql", dockerfile: "dockerfile",
    makefile: "makefile", ini: "ini", conf: "conf", cfg: "conf",
    env: "bash", log: "log", txt: "plaintext", csv: "csv",
  };
  return map[ext] || "plaintext";
}

// ── Breadcrumb ──

function PathBreadcrumb({
  path,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  path: string;
  onNavigate: (path: string) => void;
}) {
  const segments = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto text-sm">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onNavigate("/")}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-foreground"
      >
        <Home className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        <span>/</span>
      </button>
      {segments.map((segment, index) => {
        const segmentPath = "/" + segments.slice(0, index + 1).join("/");
        const isLast = index === segments.length - 1;
        return (
          <div key={segmentPath} className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onNavigate(segmentPath)}
              className={cn(
                "rounded-md px-2 py-1 transition-colors",
                isLast
                  ? "font-medium text-foreground"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-foreground",
              )}
            >
              {segment}
            </button>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Container Selector ──

function ContainerSelector({
  containers,
  selectedContainerId,
  selectedHostId,
  onSelect,
}: {
  containers: any[];
  selectedContainerId: string | null;
  selectedHostId: string | null;
  onSelect: (containerId: string, hostId: string, containerName: string) => void;
}) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  const filteredContainers = useMemo(() => {
    const running = containers.filter((c: any) => c.State === "running");
    if (!searchQuery) return running;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return running.filter(
      (c: any) =>
        (c.Names?.[0] || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (c.Image || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (c._hostName || "").toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [containers, searchQuery]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input
          placeholder="Search running containers..."
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
          className="pl-10 bg-background/40 border-white/10 rounded-xl"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="max-h-[420px] space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
        {filteredContainers.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {containers.length === 0
              ? "No containers available"
              : "No running containers match your search. File browsing requires a running container."}
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredContainers.map((c: any) => {
            const name = (c.Names?.[0] || "").replace(/^\//, "");
            const isSelected = c.Id === selectedContainerId && c._hostId === selectedHostId;
            return (
              <button
                key={`${c._hostId}-${c.Id}`}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelect(c.Id, c._hostId, name)}
                className={cn(
                  "flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all",
                  isSelected
                    ? "border border-primary/30 bg-primary/10"
                    : "border border-transparent hover:border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5",
                )}
              >
                <div className={cn("flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg", isSelected ? "bg-primary/20" : "bg-white/5")}>
                  <HardDrive className={cn("h-4 w-4", isSelected ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground")} />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className={cn("truncate text-sm font-medium", isSelected ? "text-primary" : "text-foreground")}>{name}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <span className="truncate">{(c.Image || "").split(":")[0]}</span>
                    {c._hostName && (
                      <>
                        <span className="text-white/20">·</span>
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                          <Server className="h-3 w-3" />
                          {c._hostName}
                        </span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── File Content Viewer ──

function FileViewer({
  hostId,
  containerId,
  filePath,
  onClose,
}: {
  hostId: string;
  containerId: string;
  filePath: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const canRead = !!viewer?.entitlements?.canUseFileManager;

  const { data, isLoading, error } = useContainerFileContent(
    canRead ? hostId : null,
    canRead ? containerId : null,
    canRead ? filePath : null
  );
  const fileName = filePath.split("/").pop() || filePath;
  const lang = getLanguageFromPath(filePath);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileCode className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <span className="truncate font-mono text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{fileName}</span>
            <span className="rounded-md bg-white/5 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{lang}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{filePath}</p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={onClose} className="shrink-0 rounded-lg">
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        {!canRead ? (
          <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center p-8">
            <div className="max-w-md w-full">
              <PremiumFeatureBlock
                title="File Explorer Pro"
                description="Viewing file contents is a premium feature. Upgrade your plan to inspect configuration files, logs, and more directly from the dashboard."
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive/60" />
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{(error as Error).message}</p>
          </div>
        ) : data?.binary ? (
          <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
            <File className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Binary file ({formatFileSize(data.size)})</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">Binary file preview is not supported</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="relative">
            {data?.truncated && (
              <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 border-b border-warning/20 bg-warning/10 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-warning">
                File truncated — showing first 2 MB of {formatFileSize(data.size)}
              </div>
            )}
            {data?.size !== undefined && (
              <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-4 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">
                {formatFileSize(data.size)}
              </div>
            )}
            <pre className="overflow-x-auto p-4 font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed text-foreground/90">
              <code>{data?.content || ""}</code>
            </pre>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Page ──

export default function FileManagerPage() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const orgId = viewer?.active_org_id;

  const paramContainerId = searchParams.get("container");
  const paramHostId = searchParams.get("host");

  const [selectedContainerId, setSelectedContainerId] = useState<string | null>(paramContainerId);
  const [selectedHostId, setSelectedHostId] = useState<string | null>(paramHostId);
  const [selectedContainerName, setSelectedContainerName] = useState<string>("");
  const [currentPath, setCurrentPath] = useState("/");
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterQuery, setFilterQuery] = useState("");

  const { data: containers = [], isLoading: containersLoading } = useContainers(orgId, true);

  const {
    data: dirData,
    isLoading: dirLoading,
    error: dirError,
    refetch: refetchDir,
  } = useContainerFileList(selectedHostId, selectedContainerId, currentPath);

  const entries = dirData?.entries ?? [];
  const filteredEntries = useMemo(() => {
    if (!filterQuery) return entries;
    const q = filterQuery.toLowerCase();
    return entries.filter((e) => e.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [entries, filterQuery]);

  const handleSelectContainer = (containerId: string, hostId: string, containerName: string) => {
    setSelectedContainerId(containerId);
    setSelectedHostId(hostId);
    setSelectedContainerName(containerName);
    setCurrentPath("/");
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setFilterQuery("");
    setSearchParams({ host: hostId, container: containerId });
  };

  const handleNavigate = (path: string) => {
    setCurrentPath(path);
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setFilterQuery("");
  };

  const handleEntryClick = (entry: FileEntry) => {
    if (entry.type === "directory") {
      const newPath = currentPath === "/" ? `/${entry.name}` : `${currentPath}/${entry.name}`;
      handleNavigate(newPath);
    } else if (entry.type === "file" || entry.type === "symlink") {
      const filePath = currentPath === "/" ? `/${entry.name}` : `${currentPath}/${entry.name}`;
      setSelectedFile(filePath);
    }
  };

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    refetchDir();
    if (selectedFile) {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["container-fs-read", selectedHostId, selectedContainerId, selectedFile],
      });
    }
  };

  const hasContainer = !!selectedContainerId && !!selectedHostId;

  const canUseFileManager = !!viewer?.entitlements?.canUseFileManager;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <PageHeader
        title="File Manager"
        description="Browse and view files inside your Docker containers"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "File Manager" }]}
      />

      {!canUseFileManager ? (
        <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-8">
          <PremiumFeatureBlock
            title="File Manager"
            description="Browse container filesystems, inspect configuration files, and preview logs directly from the dashboard. Upgrade to an Individual, Business, or Dedicated plan to unlock the File Manager."
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[320px,1fr]">
          {/* Left: Container selector */}
          <div className="glass-card rounded-[28px] p-5">
            <h3 className="mb-4 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
              Select Container
            </h3>
            {containersLoading ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
                <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ContainerSelector
                containers={containers as any[]}
                selectedContainerId={selectedContainerId}
                selectedHostId={selectedHostId}
                onSelect={handleSelectContainer}
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Right: File browser + viewer */}
          <div className="min-w-0 space-y-4">
            {!hasContainer ? (
              <div className="glass-card flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-[28px] py-24 text-center">
                <FolderOpen className="mb-4 h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground/30" />
                <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">Select a running container</p>
                <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Choose a container from the sidebar to browse its filesystem. Only running containers support file browsing.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Toolbar */}
                <div className="glass-card flex items-center gap-3 rounded-[20px] px-5 py-3">
                  <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden">
                    <PathBreadcrumb path={currentPath} onNavigate={handleNavigate} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <Input
                        placeholder="Filter..."
                        value={filterQuery}
                        onChange={(e) => setFilterQuery(e.target.value)}
                        className="h-8 w-40 bg-background/40 border-white/10 rounded-lg pl-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg"
                      onClick={handleRefresh}
                      title="Refresh"
                    >
                      <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className={cn("grid gap-4", selectedFile ? "xl:grid-cols-[1fr,1fr]" : "xl:grid-cols-1")}>
                  {/* Directory listing */}
                  <div className="glass-card min-w-0 rounded-[24px] overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
                          {selectedContainerName || "Files"}
                        </h4>
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-white/5 px-3 py-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {filteredEntries.length} {filteredEntries.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {dirLoading ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-16">
                        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
                      </div>
                    ) : dirError ? (
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive/60" />
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{(dirError as Error).message}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Make sure the container is running and the path exists.</p>
                      </div>
                    ) : filteredEntries.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
                        <Folder className="mb-3 h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/30" />
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {filterQuery ? "No files match your filter" : "Empty directory"}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="max-h-[560px] overflow-y-auto">
                        {/* Parent directory */}
                        {currentPath !== "/" && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const parent = currentPath.split("/").slice(0, -1).join("/") || "/";
                              handleNavigate(parent);
                            }}
                            className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-white/5"
                          >
                            <Folder className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">..</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {filteredEntries.map((entry) => {
                          const Icon = getFileIcon(entry);
                          const entryPath = currentPath === "/" ? `/${entry.name}` : `${currentPath}/${entry.name}`;
                          const isActive = selectedFile === entryPath;
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={entry.name}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleEntryClick(entry)}
                              className={cn(
                                "group flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors",
                                isActive
                                  ? "bg-primary/10"
                                  : "hover:bg-white/5",
                              )}
                            >
                              <Icon
                                className={cn(
                                  "h-4 w-4 shrink-0",
                                  entry.type === "directory"
                                    ? "text-primary"
                                    : entry.type === "symlink"
                                      ? "text-sky-400"
                                      : "text-muted-foreground",
                                )}
                              />
                              <span
                                className={cn(
                                  "min-w-0 flex-1 truncate",
                                  entry.type === "directory"
                                    ? "font-medium text-foreground"
                                    : isActive
                                      ? "text-primary"
                                      : "text-foreground/80",
                                )}
                              >
                                {entry.name}
                                {entry.linkTarget && (
                                  <span className="ml-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">→ {entry.linkTarget}</span>
                                )}
                              </span>
                              <span className="shrink-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">
                                {entry.type === "directory" ? "" : formatFileSize(entry.size)}
                              </span>
                              <span className="hidden shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 sm:block">
                                {entry.permissions}
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* File content viewer */}
                  {selectedFile && selectedHostId && selectedContainerId && (
                    <div className="glass-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-[24px]">
                      <FileViewer
                        hostId={selectedHostId}
                        containerId={selectedContainerId}
                        filePath={selectedFile}
                        onClose={() => setSelectedFile(null)}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

## File: netlify/functions/api-fleet-metrics.mts
````typescript
import type { Config } from '@netlify/functions';
import { sql } from './lib/db.mjs';
import { requireAuth } from './lib/auth.mjs';
import { enforceOrganizationNodeLimit } from './lib/access-controls.mjs';
import { decryptHostSecrets } from './lib/crypto.mjs';
import { buildValidatedAgentUrl } from './lib/host-url.mjs';

const headers = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

interface FleetMetricsPoint {
  timestamp: number;
  time: string;
  cpu: number;
  memory: number;
  usedCores: number;
  totalCores: number;
  memoryUsed: number;
  memoryLimit: number;
  networkInBytesPerSec: number | null;
  networkOutBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskReadBytesPerSec: number | null;
  diskWriteBytesPerSec: number | null;
  reportingHosts: number;
  totalHosts: number;
  isPartial: boolean;
}

interface HostMetricsResponse {
  cpu_time_ns: number;
  system_time_ns: number;
  online_cpus: number;
  memory_used: number;
  memory_limit: number;
  network_in_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
  network_out_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
  disk_read_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
  disk_write_bytes_per_sec: number | null;
}

function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

function normalizeOptionalRate(value: unknown): number | null {
  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (numeric === null || numeric < 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return numeric;
}

async function fetchHostMetrics(hostUrl: string, apiKey: string, timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<HostMetricsResponse | null> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(buildValidatedAgentUrl(hostUrl, '/metrics'), {
      headers: {
        'X-Agent-Key': apiKey,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
    });

    if (!response.ok) return null;

    const data = await response.json();
    // Agent returns CPU/memory fields and may include optional network/disk rates.
    return { 
      cpu_time_ns: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.cpu_time_ns) ?? 0),
      system_time_ns: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.system_time_ns) ?? 0),
      online_cpus: Math.max(1, toFiniteNumber(data.online_cpus) ?? 1),
      memory_used: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.memory_used) ?? 0),
      memory_limit: Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(data.memory_limit) ?? 0),
      network_in_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.network_in_bytes_per_sec ?? data.networkInBytesPerSec),
      network_out_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.network_out_bytes_per_sec ?? data.networkOutBytesPerSec),
      disk_read_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.disk_read_bytes_per_sec ?? data.diskReadBytesPerSec),
      disk_write_bytes_per_sec: normalizeOptionalRate(data.disk_write_bytes_per_sec ?? data.diskWriteBytesPerSec),
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export default async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAuth(req);
    const orgId = auth.orgId;

    if (!orgId) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Active org required' }), { status: 400, headers });
    }

    // Verify user has access to org
    const memberships = await sql`
      SELECT 1 FROM organization_members 
      WHERE organization_id = ${orgId} AND user_id = ${auth.userId}
    `;
    if (memberships.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Access denied' }), { status: 403, headers });
    }

    const limitState = await enforceOrganizationNodeLimit({
      organizationId: orgId,
      isPlatformAdmin: auth.isPlatformAdmin,
    });

    if (limitState.allowedHostIds.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify([]), { headers });
    }

    // Get all hosts for the org
    const hosts = await sql`
      SELECT h.id, h.host_url, h.name 
      FROM docker_hosts h
      WHERE h.organization_id = ${orgId}
        AND h.id = ANY(${limitState.allowedHostIds})
    `;

    if (hosts.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify([]), { headers });
    }

    // Fetch secrets and metrics for each host concurrently
    const now = new Date();
    const timestamp = now.getTime();
    const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });

    const connectedHostIds: string[] = [];

    const metricsPromises = hosts.map(async (host) => {
      try {
        // Get decrypted secrets for this host
        const secretsRecord = await sql`
          SELECT agent_api_key 
          FROM docker_host_secrets 
          WHERE host_id = ${host.id}
        `;

        if (secretsRecord.length === 0 || !secretsRecord[0].agent_api_key) {
          return null;
        }

        const decryptedSecrets = decryptHostSecrets(secretsRecord[0], host.id);
        const apiKey = decryptedSecrets?.agent_api_key;
        if (!apiKey) return null;

        const metrics = await fetchHostMetrics(host.host_url, apiKey);
        if (metrics) connectedHostIds.push(host.id);
        return metrics;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    });

    const results = await Promise.all(metricsPromises);

    // Update heartbeat for hosts that returned valid metrics
    if (connectedHostIds.length > 0) {
      try {
        await sql`
          UPDATE docker_hosts
          SET status = 'connected', last_seen_at = now(), consecutive_failures = 0
          WHERE id = ANY(${connectedHostIds})
        `;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[fleet-metrics] heartbeat update failed', e);
      }
    }

     // Aggregate: calculate fleet-wide CPU and memory utilization
     // For CPU: 
     //   Used cores = Σ[(cpu_time_ns / system_time_ns) * online_cpus] 
     //   Total capacity = Σ[online_cpus]
     //   Utilization % = (Used cores / Total capacity) * 100
     // For Memory:
     //   Utilization % = (totalMemoryUsed / totalMemoryLimit) * 100
     let totalCpuUsedCores = 0;     // total CPU cores used across fleet
     let totalCpuCapacityCores = 0; // total CPU cores available across fleet
     let totalMemoryUsed = 0;       // bytes
     let totalMemoryLimit = 0;      // bytes
     let networkInSum = 0;
     let networkInCount = 0;
     let networkOutSum = 0;
     let networkOutCount = 0;
     let diskReadSum = 0;
     let diskReadCount = 0;
     let diskWriteSum = 0;
     let diskWriteCount = 0;
     let hostCount = 0;

     results.forEach((result) => {
       if (result && result.system_time_ns > 0) {
         // Calculate used cores for this host: (cpu_time_ns / system_time_ns) * online_cpus
         const hostUsedCores = (result.cpu_time_ns / result.system_time_ns) * result.online_cpus;
         // Add to fleet totals
         totalCpuUsedCores += hostUsedCores;
          totalCpuCapacityCores += result.online_cpus;
          totalMemoryUsed += result.memory_used;
          totalMemoryLimit += result.memory_limit;

          if (result.network_in_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            networkInSum += result.network_in_bytes_per_sec;
            networkInCount++;
          }
          if (result.network_out_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            networkOutSum += result.network_out_bytes_per_sec;
            networkOutCount++;
          }
          if (result.disk_read_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            diskReadSum += result.disk_read_bytes_per_sec;
            diskReadCount++;
          }
          if (result.disk_write_bytes_per_sec !== null) {
            diskWriteSum += result.disk_write_bytes_per_sec;
            diskWriteCount++;
          }

          hostCount++;
        }
      });

     // Compute percentages
     // CPU: Fleet utilization percentage = (used cores / total capacity cores) * 100
     // Memory: Fleet utilization percentage = (used memory / total memory) * 100
     let cpuPercent = 0;
     let memPercent = 0;
     
     if (hostCount > 0) {
       // Memory: true fleet-wide percentage
       if (totalMemoryLimit > 0) {
         memPercent = Math.round((totalMemoryUsed / totalMemoryLimit) * 100);
       }
       
       // CPU: Fleet CPU utilization percentage
       if (totalCpuCapacityCores > 0) {
         cpuPercent = Math.round((totalCpuUsedCores / totalCpuCapacityCores) * 100);
       }
     }

      const fleetMetrics: FleetMetricsPoint[] = [{
         timestamp,
         time: timeStr,
         cpu: cpuPercent,
         memory: memPercent,
        usedCores: Math.round(totalCpuUsedCores * 100) / 100, // keep 2 decimal places for display
        totalCores: Math.round(totalCpuCapacityCores * 100) / 100,
        memoryUsed: totalMemoryUsed,
        memoryLimit: totalMemoryLimit,
        networkInBytesPerSec: networkInCount > 0 ? networkInSum : null,
        networkOutBytesPerSec: networkOutCount > 0 ? networkOutSum : null,
        diskReadBytesPerSec: diskReadCount > 0 ? diskReadSum : null,
        diskWriteBytesPerSec: diskWriteCount > 0 ? diskWriteSum : null,
        reportingHosts: hostCount,
        totalHosts: hosts.length,
        isPartial: hostCount > 0 && hostCount < hosts.length,
      }];

    return new Response(JSON.stringify(fleetMetrics), {
      headers,
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Failed to fetch fleet metrics', details: error.message }), { status: 500, headers });
  }
};

export const config: Config = {
  path: '/api/fleet-metrics',
};
````
