#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

fail() {
  echo "ERROR: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

require_command() {
  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "$1 is required but not installed"
}

check_config() {
  [ -n "$AGENT_API_KEY" ] || fail "AGENT_API_KEY is required. Set it in /etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env or export it before starting."
  validate_port "$AGENT_PORT"
  [ -n "$AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS" ] || fail "AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS must not be empty"
  require_command socat
  require_command curl
  require_command jq
  require_command mkdir
  require_command df
  [ -S "$DOCKER_SOCKET" ] || fail "Docker socket not found at $DOCKER_SOCKET. Ensure Docker is running or update DOCKER_SOCKET."
}

validate_port() {
  case "$1" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*)
      fail "AGENT_PORT must be a number between 1 and 65535"
      ;;
  esac

  if [ "$1" -lt 1 ] || [ "$1" -gt 65535 ]; then
    fail "AGENT_PORT must be a number between 1 and 65535"
  fi
}

cleanup() {
  if [ -n "${HANDLER_SCRIPT:-}" ] && [ -f "$HANDLER_SCRIPT" ]; then
    rm -f "$HANDLER_SCRIPT"
  fi
}

trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

AGENT_API_KEY="${AGENT_API_KEY:-}"
AGENT_PORT="${AGENT_PORT:-9876}"
AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS="${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS:-${AGENT_BIND:-0.0.0.0}}"
DOCKER_SOCKET="${DOCKER_SOCKET:-/var/run/docker.sock}"
WATCHTOWER_AGENT_STATE_DIR="${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_STATE_DIR:-/var/lib/watchtower-agent}"
WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION="${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION:-1.0.8}"

if [ "${1:-}" = "--check" ]; then
  check_config
  echo "watchtower-agent configuration is valid."
  exit 0
fi

check_config

HANDLER_SCRIPT="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-handler.XXXXXX")"

cat >"$HANDLER_SCRIPT" <<'HANDLER_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

respond_json() {
  local status="$1"
  local body="$2"
  printf 'HTTP/1.1 %s\r\n' "$status"
  printf 'Content-Type: application/json\r\n'
  printf 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n'
  printf 'Content-Length: %s\r\n' "${#body}"
  printf '\r\n'
  printf '%s' "$body"
}

json_escape() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'
}

validate_docker_path() {
  local path="$1"

  [ -n "$path" ] || return 1

  case "$path" in
    /*) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac

  case "$path" in
    *$'\r'*|*$'\n'*|*' '*|*'\t'*|*'\\'*|*'"'*|*"'"*|*'`'*|*';'*|*'|'*|*'&'*|*'<'*|*'>'*|*'('*|*')'*|*'{'*|*'}'*|*'['*|*']'*)
      return 1
      ;;
  esac

  case "$path" in
    *'..'*)
      return 1
      ;;
  esac

  return 0
}

cleanup_handler() {
  rm -f "${REQUEST_BODY_FILE:-}" "${RESPONSE_BODY_FILE:-}" "${RESPONSE_HEADERS_FILE:-}" "${CURL_ERROR_FILE:-}" "${FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE:-}"
}

trap cleanup_handler EXIT INT TERM

ensure_state_dir() {
  mkdir -p "$WATCHTOWER_AGENT_STATE_DIR"
}

metrics_cache_file() {
  printf '%s/metrics-cache' "$WATCHTOWER_AGENT_STATE_DIR"
}

read_cached_metrics() {
  local cache_file
  cache_file="$(metrics_cache_file)"

  [ -f "$cache_file" ] || return 1

  IFS='|' read -r \
    cached_timestamp \
    cached_cpu_time_ns \
    cached_system_time_ns \
    cached_network_in_bytes \
    cached_network_out_bytes \
    cached_disk_read_bytes \
    cached_disk_write_bytes \
    cached_disk_snapshots <"$cache_file" || return 1

  case "$cached_timestamp" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$cached_cpu_time_ns" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$cached_system_time_ns" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$cached_network_in_bytes" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$cached_network_out_bytes" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$cached_disk_read_bytes" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$cached_disk_write_bytes" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac

  printf '%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s' \
    "$cached_timestamp" \
    "$cached_cpu_time_ns" \
    "$cached_system_time_ns" \
    "$cached_network_in_bytes" \
    "$cached_network_out_bytes" \
    "$cached_disk_read_bytes" \
    "$cached_disk_write_bytes" \
    "${cached_disk_snapshots:-}"
}

write_cached_metrics() {
  local cache_file tmp_file
  cache_file="$(metrics_cache_file)"
  ensure_state_dir
  tmp_file="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-metrics-cache.XXXXXX")"

  printf '%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n' \
    "$1" \
    "$2" \
    "$3" \
    "$4" \
    "$5" \
    "$6" \
    "$7" \
    "${8:-}" >"$tmp_file"

  mv "$tmp_file" "$cache_file"
}

calculate_rate() {
  local current="$1"
  local previous="$2"
  local elapsed_ms="$3"

  awk -v current="$current" -v previous="$previous" -v elapsed_ms="$elapsed_ms" 'BEGIN {
    if (elapsed_ms <= 0) {
      print 0
      exit
    }

    delta = current - previous
    if (delta < 0) {
      delta = 0
    }

    printf "%.2f", delta / (elapsed_ms / 1000.0)
  }'
}

lookup_cached_disk_totals() {
  local snapshot="$1"
  local device="$2"

  [ -n "$snapshot" ] || return 1
  [ -n "$device" ] || return 1

  printf '%s' "$snapshot" | awk -F';' -v device="$device" '{
    for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
      split($i, parts, ":")
      if (parts[1] == device) {
        printf "%s|%s", parts[2], parts[3]
        exit
      }
    }
  }'
}

derive_parent_disk_device() {
  local device="$1"

  if [[ "$device" =~ ^((sd|vd|xvd)[a-z]+)[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    return 0
  fi

  if [[ "$device" =~ ^(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|mmcblk[0-9]+)p[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    return 0
  fi

  return 1
}

IFS= read -r REQUEST_LINE || exit 0

METHOD="$(printf '%s' "$REQUEST_LINE" | awk '{print $1}')"
PATH_RAW="$(printf '%s' "$REQUEST_LINE" | awk '{print $2}')"

if [ -z "$METHOD" ] || [ -z "$PATH_RAW" ]; then
  respond_json '400 Bad Request' '{"error":"Malformed HTTP request"}'
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$METHOD" = "OPTIONS" ]; then
  printf 'HTTP/1.1 204 No Content\r\n'
  printf 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n'
  printf 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers: X-Agent-Key, X-Docker-Socket, Content-Type\r\n'
  printf 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, PATCH, OPTIONS\r\n'
  printf 'Content-Length: 0\r\n'
  printf '\r\n'
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$PATH_RAW" = "/agent/version" ]; then
  respond_json '200 OK' "{\"agent_version\":\"${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION}\",\"version\":\"${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION}\"}"
  exit 0
fi

AGENT_KEY=""
DOCKER_SOCK_OVERRIDE=""
CONTENT_LENGTH=0
CONTENT_TYPE=""
IS_UPGRADE="false"
FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-forward-headers.XXXXXX")"

while IFS= read -r header_line; do
  header_line_stripped="$(printf '%s' "$header_line" | tr -d '\r')"
  [ -z "$header_line_stripped" ] && break

  header_name="$(printf '%s' "$header_line_stripped" | cut -d: -f1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
  header_value="$(printf '%s' "${header_line_stripped#*:}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"

  case "$header_name" in
    x-agent-key)
      AGENT_KEY="$header_value"
      ;;
    x-docker-socket)
      DOCKER_SOCK_OVERRIDE="$header_value"
      ;;
    content-length)
      CONTENT_LENGTH="$header_value"
      printf '%s\r\n' "$header_line_stripped" >> "$FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE"
      ;;
    content-type)
      CONTENT_TYPE="$header_value"
      printf '%s\r\n' "$header_line_stripped" >> "$FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE"
      ;;
    upgrade)
      IS_UPGRADE="true"
      printf '%s\r\n' "$header_line_stripped" >> "$FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE"
      ;;
    connection)
      case "$header_value" in
        *[Uu][Pp][Gg][Rr][Aa][Dd][Ee]*)
          IS_UPGRADE="true"
          ;;
      esac
      printf '%s\r\n' "$header_line_stripped" >> "$FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE"
      ;;
    *)
      printf '%s\r\n' "$header_line_stripped" >> "$FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE"
      ;;
  esac
done

SOCKET_PATH="${DOCKER_SOCK_OVERRIDE:-$DOCKER_SOCKET}"

if [ "$AGENT_KEY" != "$AGENT_API_KEY" ]; then
  respond_json '401 Unauthorized' '{"error":"Invalid API key"}'
  exit 0
fi

case "$CONTENT_LENGTH" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*)
    respond_json '400 Bad Request' '{"error":"Invalid Content-Length header"}'
    exit 0
    ;;
esac

REQUEST_BODY_FILE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-request-body.XXXXXX")"
RESPONSE_BODY_FILE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-response-body.XXXXXX")"
RESPONSE_HEADERS_FILE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-response-headers.XXXXXX")"
CURL_ERROR_FILE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watchtower-agent-curl-error.XXXXXX")"

if [ "$CONTENT_LENGTH" -gt 0 ]; then
  dd bs=1 count="$CONTENT_LENGTH" of="$REQUEST_BODY_FILE" status=none || true
fi

# Handle /metrics endpoint for fleet dashboard
# Returns: { cpu_time_ns: <ns>, system_time_ns: <ns>, online_cpus: <num>, memory_used: <bytes>, memory_limit: <bytes> }
# cpu_time_ns = container CPU usage delta
# system_time_ns = system CPU time delta (aggregate across cores)
# Backend computes: cpu % = Σ (cpu_time_ns / system_time_ns * online_cpus) × 100
# This matches Docker's standard formula: (cpuDelta / systemDelta) * onlineCPUs * 100
if [ "$PATH_RAW" = "/metrics" ]; then
  [ -S "$SOCKET_PATH" ] || {
    ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH="$(json_escape "$SOCKET_PATH")"
    respond_json '500 Internal Server Error' "{\"error\":\"Docker socket not found at ${ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH}\",\"code\":\"docker_socket_unavailable\",\"socket_path\":\"${ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH}\"}"
    exit 0
  }

  HOST_CORES=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
  UPTIME_SECONDS=null
  if [ -f /proc/uptime ]; then
    UPTIME_SECONDS="$(awk '{printf "%d", $1}' /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -z "$UPTIME_SECONDS" ]; then
      UPTIME_SECONDS=null
    fi
  fi

    TOTAL_CPU_TICKS=0
    ACTIVE_CPU_TICKS=0
    if [ -f /proc/stat ]; then
      read -r cpu user nice system idle iowait irq softirq steal _ < /proc/stat
      user=${user:-0}; nice=${nice:-0}; system=${system:-0}; idle=${idle:-0}; iowait=${iowait:-0}; irq=${irq:-0}; softirq=${softirq:-0}; steal=${steal:-0}
      TOTAL_CPU_TICKS=$((user + nice + system + idle + iowait + irq + softirq + steal))
      IDLE_ALL_TICKS=$((idle + iowait))
      ACTIVE_CPU_TICKS=$((TOTAL_CPU_TICKS - IDLE_ALL_TICKS))
    fi

    MemTotal=0; MemFree=0; Buffers=0; Cached=0; SReclaimable=0; Shmem=0
    if [ -f /proc/meminfo ]; then
      meminfo=$(cat /proc/meminfo)
      get_mem() { echo "$meminfo" | awk -v key="^$1:" '$0 ~ key {print $2; exit}' || echo 0; }
      MemTotal=$(get_mem MemTotal)
      MemFree=$(get_mem MemFree)
      Buffers=$(get_mem Buffers)
      Cached=$(get_mem Cached)
      SReclaimable=$(get_mem SReclaimable)
      Shmem=$(get_mem Shmem)
    fi

    TOTAL_MEM_LIMIT=$((MemTotal * 1024))
    USED_KB=$((MemTotal - MemFree - Buffers - (Cached + SReclaimable - Shmem)))
    if [ "$USED_KB" -lt 0 ]; then USED_KB=0; fi
    TOTAL_MEM_USED=$((USED_KB * 1024))

    TOTAL_NETWORK_IN_BYTES=0
    TOTAL_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES=0
    if [ -f /proc/net/dev ]; then
      read -r TOTAL_NETWORK_IN_BYTES TOTAL_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES <<< "$(awk '
        $1 ~ /:/ { 
          sub(/:/, "", $1); 
          if ($1 !~ /^(lo|veth|docker|br-)/) { 
            rx+=$2; tx+=$10 
          } 
        } END {print rx+0, tx+0}' /proc/net/dev)"
    fi

    TOTAL_DISK_READ_BYTES=0
    TOTAL_DISK_WRITE_BYTES=0
    CURRENT_DISK_SNAPSHOT=""
    if [ -f /proc/diskstats ]; then
      read -r DISK_SECTORS_READ DISK_SECTORS_WRITE <<< "$(awk '
        $3 ~ /^(sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|xvd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|mmcblk[0-9]+)$/ { 
          r+=$6; w+=$10 
        } END {print r+0, w+0}' /proc/diskstats)"
      CURRENT_DISK_SNAPSHOT="$(awk '
        $3 ~ /^(sd[a-z]+([0-9]+)?|vd[a-z]+([0-9]+)?|xvd[a-z]+([0-9]+)?|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+(p[0-9]+)?|mmcblk[0-9]+(p[0-9]+)?)$/ {
          printf "%s%s:%d:%d", sep, $3, $6 * 512, $10 * 512
          sep=";"
        }' /proc/diskstats)"
      TOTAL_DISK_READ_BYTES=$((DISK_SECTORS_READ * 512))
      TOTAL_DISK_WRITE_BYTES=$((DISK_SECTORS_WRITE * 512))
    fi

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP="$(date +%s%3N)"
    PREVIOUS_SAMPLE="$(read_cached_metrics || true)"
    PREVIOUS_TIMESTAMP=""
    PREVIOUS_ACTIVE=0
    PREVIOUS_TOTAL=0
    PREVIOUS_NETWORK_IN_BYTES=0
    PREVIOUS_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES=0
    PREVIOUS_DISK_READ_BYTES=0
    PREVIOUS_DISK_WRITE_BYTES=0
    PREVIOUS_DISK_SNAPSHOT=""

    if [ -n "$PREVIOUS_SAMPLE" ]; then
      IFS='|' read -r \
        PREVIOUS_TIMESTAMP \
        PREVIOUS_ACTIVE \
        PREVIOUS_TOTAL \
        PREVIOUS_NETWORK_IN_BYTES \
        PREVIOUS_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES \
        PREVIOUS_DISK_READ_BYTES \
        PREVIOUS_DISK_WRITE_BYTES \
        PREVIOUS_DISK_SNAPSHOT <<EOF
$PREVIOUS_SAMPLE
EOF
    fi

    ELAPSED_MS=0
    if [ -n "$PREVIOUS_TIMESTAMP" ] && [ "$CURRENT_TIMESTAMP" -gt "$PREVIOUS_TIMESTAMP" ]; then
      ELAPSED_MS=$((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - PREVIOUS_TIMESTAMP))
    fi

    NETWORK_IN_RATE=null
    NETWORK_OUT_RATE=null
    DISK_READ_RATE=null
    DISK_WRITE_RATE=null
    DELTA_ACTIVE=0
    DELTA_TOTAL=0
    DISK_ROWS=""

    if [ -n "$PREVIOUS_TIMESTAMP" ] && [ "$ELAPSED_MS" -gt 0 ]; then
      NETWORK_IN_RATE="$(calculate_rate "$TOTAL_NETWORK_IN_BYTES" "$PREVIOUS_NETWORK_IN_BYTES" "$ELAPSED_MS")"
      NETWORK_OUT_RATE="$(calculate_rate "$TOTAL_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES" "$PREVIOUS_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES" "$ELAPSED_MS")"
      DISK_READ_RATE="$(calculate_rate "$TOTAL_DISK_READ_BYTES" "$PREVIOUS_DISK_READ_BYTES" "$ELAPSED_MS")"
      DISK_WRITE_RATE="$(calculate_rate "$TOTAL_DISK_WRITE_BYTES" "$PREVIOUS_DISK_WRITE_BYTES" "$ELAPSED_MS")"
      
      DELTA_ACTIVE=$((ACTIVE_CPU_TICKS - PREVIOUS_ACTIVE))
      DELTA_TOTAL=$((TOTAL_CPU_TICKS - PREVIOUS_TOTAL))
      if [ "$DELTA_ACTIVE" -lt 0 ]; then DELTA_ACTIVE=0; fi
      if [ "$DELTA_TOTAL" -lt 0 ]; then DELTA_TOTAL=0; fi
    fi

    while IFS=$'\t' read -r DISK_SOURCE DISK_USED_BYTES DISK_TOTAL_BYTES DISK_MOUNT; do
      [ -n "$DISK_SOURCE" ] || continue

      DISK_DEVICE_NAME="${DISK_SOURCE#/dev/}"
      RATE_DEVICE="$DISK_DEVICE_NAME"
      DISK_READ_DEVICE_RATE=null
      DISK_WRITE_DEVICE_RATE=null

      if ! lookup_cached_disk_totals "$CURRENT_DISK_SNAPSHOT" "$RATE_DEVICE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        PARENT_DEVICE="$(derive_parent_disk_device "$DISK_DEVICE_NAME" || true)"
        if [ -n "$PARENT_DEVICE" ] && lookup_cached_disk_totals "$CURRENT_DISK_SNAPSHOT" "$PARENT_DEVICE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          RATE_DEVICE="$PARENT_DEVICE"
        else
          RATE_DEVICE=""
        fi
      fi

      if [ -n "$RATE_DEVICE" ] && [ "$ELAPSED_MS" -gt 0 ]; then
        CURRENT_DEVICE_TOTALS="$(lookup_cached_disk_totals "$CURRENT_DISK_SNAPSHOT" "$RATE_DEVICE" || true)"
        PREVIOUS_DEVICE_TOTALS="$(lookup_cached_disk_totals "$PREVIOUS_DISK_SNAPSHOT" "$RATE_DEVICE" || true)"

        if [ -n "$CURRENT_DEVICE_TOTALS" ] && [ -n "$PREVIOUS_DEVICE_TOTALS" ]; then
          IFS='|' read -r CURRENT_DEVICE_READ_BYTES CURRENT_DEVICE_WRITE_BYTES <<EOF
$CURRENT_DEVICE_TOTALS
EOF
          IFS='|' read -r PREVIOUS_DEVICE_READ_BYTES PREVIOUS_DEVICE_WRITE_BYTES <<EOF
$PREVIOUS_DEVICE_TOTALS
EOF
          DISK_READ_DEVICE_RATE="$(calculate_rate "$CURRENT_DEVICE_READ_BYTES" "$PREVIOUS_DEVICE_READ_BYTES" "$ELAPSED_MS")"
          DISK_WRITE_DEVICE_RATE="$(calculate_rate "$CURRENT_DEVICE_WRITE_BYTES" "$PREVIOUS_DEVICE_WRITE_BYTES" "$ELAPSED_MS")"
        fi
      fi

      DISK_ROWS+="${DISK_SOURCE}"$'\t'"${DISK_MOUNT}"$'\t'"${DISK_USED_BYTES}"$'\t'"${DISK_TOTAL_BYTES}"$'\t'"${DISK_READ_DEVICE_RATE}"$'\t'"${DISK_WRITE_DEVICE_RATE}"$'\n'
    done < <(df -P -B1 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR > 1 && $1 ~ "^/dev/" && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ {print $1 "\t" $3 "\t" $2 "\t" $6}')

    if [ -n "$DISK_ROWS" ]; then
      DISKS_JSON="$(printf '%s' "$DISK_ROWS" | jq -Rsc '
        split("\n")
        | map(select(length > 0) | split("\t"))
        | map({
            device: .[0],
            mount: .[1],
            used_bytes: (.[2] | tonumber),
            total_bytes: (.[3] | tonumber),
            read_bytes_per_sec: (if .[4] == "null" or .[4] == "" then null else (.[4] | tonumber) end),
            write_bytes_per_sec: (if .[5] == "null" or .[5] == "" then null else (.[5] | tonumber) end)
          })
      ')"
    else
      DISKS_JSON='[]'
    fi

    write_cached_metrics \
      "$CURRENT_TIMESTAMP" \
      "$ACTIVE_CPU_TICKS" \
      "$TOTAL_CPU_TICKS" \
      "$TOTAL_NETWORK_IN_BYTES" \
      "$TOTAL_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES" \
      "$TOTAL_DISK_READ_BYTES" \
      "$TOTAL_DISK_WRITE_BYTES" \
      "$CURRENT_DISK_SNAPSHOT"

    METRICS_JSON="$(jq -n \
      --argjson cpu_time_ns "$DELTA_ACTIVE" \
      --argjson system_time_ns "$DELTA_TOTAL" \
      --argjson online_cpus "$HOST_CORES" \
      --argjson memory_used "$TOTAL_MEM_USED" \
      --argjson memory_limit "$TOTAL_MEM_LIMIT" \
      --argjson network_in_bytes_per_sec "$NETWORK_IN_RATE" \
      --argjson network_out_bytes_per_sec "$NETWORK_OUT_RATE" \
      --argjson network_rx_total "$TOTAL_NETWORK_IN_BYTES" \
      --argjson network_tx_total "$TOTAL_NETWORK_OUT_BYTES" \
      --argjson disk_read_bytes_per_sec "$DISK_READ_RATE" \
      --argjson disk_write_bytes_per_sec "$DISK_WRITE_RATE" \
      --argjson uptime_seconds "$UPTIME_SECONDS" \
      --argjson disks "$DISKS_JSON" \
      '{
        cpu_time_ns: $cpu_time_ns,
        system_time_ns: $system_time_ns,
        online_cpus: $online_cpus,
        memory_used: $memory_used,
        memory_limit: $memory_limit,
        network_in_bytes_per_sec: $network_in_bytes_per_sec,
        network_out_bytes_per_sec: $network_out_bytes_per_sec,
        network_rx_total: $network_rx_total,
        network_tx_total: $network_tx_total,
        disk_read_bytes_per_sec: $disk_read_bytes_per_sec,
        disk_write_bytes_per_sec: $disk_write_bytes_per_sec,
        uptime_seconds: $uptime_seconds,
        disks: $disks
      }')"
    respond_json '200 OK' "$METRICS_JSON"
    exit 0
  fi

DOCKER_PATH="${PATH_RAW#/docker}"
[ -n "$DOCKER_PATH" ] || DOCKER_PATH="/"

if ! validate_docker_path "$DOCKER_PATH"; then
  respond_json '400 Bad Request' '{"error":"Invalid Docker API path"}'
  exit 0
fi

[ -S "$SOCKET_PATH" ] || {
  ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH="$(json_escape "$SOCKET_PATH")"
  respond_json '500 Internal Server Error' "{\"error\":\"Docker socket not found at ${ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH}\",\"code\":\"docker_socket_unavailable\",\"socket_path\":\"${ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH}\"}"
  exit 0
}

if [ "$IS_UPGRADE" = "true" ]; then
  {
    printf '%s %s HTTP/1.1\r\n' "$METHOD" "$DOCKER_PATH"
    if [ -f "$FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE" ]; then
      cat "$FORWARD_HEADERS_FILE"
    fi
    printf '\r\n'
    cat
  } | socat -t 3600 - "UNIX-CONNECT:$SOCKET_PATH"
  exit 0
fi

CURL_ARGS=(
  --silent
  --show-error
  --unix-socket "$SOCKET_PATH"
  --request "$METHOD"
  --output "$RESPONSE_BODY_FILE"
  --dump-header "$RESPONSE_HEADERS_FILE"
  "http://localhost${DOCKER_PATH}"
)

if [ "$CONTENT_LENGTH" -gt 0 ]; then
  CURL_ARGS+=(--data-binary "@$REQUEST_BODY_FILE")
  if [ -n "$CONTENT_TYPE" ]; then
    CURL_ARGS+=(--header "Content-Type: $CONTENT_TYPE")
  fi
fi

if ! curl "${CURL_ARGS[@]}" 2>"$CURL_ERROR_FILE"; then
  ERROR_MESSAGE="$(tr -d '\r' <"$CURL_ERROR_FILE" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')"
  ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH="$(json_escape "$SOCKET_PATH")"
  respond_json '502 Bad Gateway' "{\"error\":\"Docker API request failed\",\"code\":\"docker_socket_unavailable\",\"details\":\"${ERROR_MESSAGE}\",\"socket_path\":\"${ESCAPED_SOCKET_PATH}\"}"
  exit 0
fi

STATUS_LINE="$(head -n 1 "$RESPONSE_HEADERS_FILE" | tr -d '\r')"
STATUS_CODE="$(printf '%s' "$STATUS_LINE" | awk '{print $2}')"
STATUS_TEXT="$(printf '%s' "$STATUS_LINE" | cut -d' ' -f3-)"
BODY_LENGTH="$(wc -c <"$RESPONSE_BODY_FILE" | tr -d ' ')"

[ -n "$STATUS_CODE" ] || STATUS_CODE="502"
[ -n "$STATUS_TEXT" ] || STATUS_TEXT="Bad Gateway"

printf 'HTTP/1.1 %s %s\r\n' "$STATUS_CODE" "$STATUS_TEXT"

tail -n +2 "$RESPONSE_HEADERS_FILE" | while IFS= read -r header_line; do
  header_line="$(printf '%s' "$header_line" | tr -d '\r')"
  [ -z "$header_line" ] && continue

  case "$(printf '%s' "$header_line" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in
    content-length:*|transfer-encoding:*|connection:*|access-control-allow-origin:*)
      continue
      ;;
  esac

  printf '%s\r\n' "$header_line"
done

printf 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n'
printf 'Content-Length: %s\r\n' "$BODY_LENGTH"
printf '\r\n'
cat "$RESPONSE_BODY_FILE"
HANDLER_EOF

chmod 0755 "$HANDLER_SCRIPT"
export AGENT_API_KEY DOCKER_SOCKET WATCHTOWER_AGENT_VERSION WATCHTOWER_AGENT_STATE_DIR

echo "Starting watchtower-agent on ${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS}:${AGENT_PORT}"
echo "Docker socket: ${DOCKER_SOCKET}"

exec socat "TCP-LISTEN:${AGENT_PORT},bind=${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS},reuseaddr,fork" "EXEC:${HANDLER_SCRIPT}"
````

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Search, Command, Moon, Sun, LayoutDashboard, Server, Box, ActivitySquare, Settings, LifeBuoy } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { UserButton, OrganizationSwitcher, useOrganization } from "@clerk/react";
import {
  CommandDialog,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList,
  CommandShortcut,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import { useContainers, useDockerHosts } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { NotificationBell } from "./NotificationBell";

type SearchableContainer = {
  Id?: string;
  Names?: string[];
  Image?: string;
  State?: string;
  _hostId?: string;
  _hostName?: string;
};

const quickSearchItems = [
  { label: "Dashboard", path: "/app", keywords: "overview metrics", Icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { label: "Hosts", path: "/app/hosts", keywords: "servers docker", Icon: Server },
  { label: "Containers", path: "/app/containers", keywords: "images workload", Icon: Box },
  { label: "Alerts", path: "/app/alerts", keywords: "incidents monitoring", Icon: ActivitySquare },
  { label: "Settings", path: "/app/settings", keywords: "preferences config", Icon: Settings },
  { label: "Help", path: "/app/help", keywords: "support docs", Icon: LifeBuoy },
];

export function AppTopBar() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { organization } = useOrganization();
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(() => document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark"));
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const { data: hosts = [] } = useDockerHosts(organization?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const { data: rawContainers } = useContainers(organization?.id, searchOpen && hosts.length > 0);

  const containers = useMemo(() => (Array.isArray(rawContainers) ? (rawContainers as SearchableContainer[]) : []), [rawContainers]);

  const hostResults = useMemo(() => {
    return hosts.map((host) => ({
      id: host.id,
      label: host.name,
      subtitle: `${host.status} · ${host.connection_mode}`,
      value: `${host.name} ${host.host_url} ${host.connection_mode} ${host.status}`,
      path: `/app/hosts/${host.id}`,
    }));
  }, [hosts]);

  const containerResults = useMemo(() => {
    return containers.map((container) => {
      const id = container.Id ?? "";
      const shortId = id.slice(0, 12);
      const label = (container.Names?.[0] || shortId || "Unknown container").replace(/^\//, "");
      const hostId = container._hostId;
      return {
        id,
        label,
        subtitle: `${container._hostName || "Unknown host"} · ${container.State || "unknown"}`,
        value: `${label} ${container.Image || ""} ${container._hostName || ""} ${container.State || ""}`,
        path: hostId && shortId ? `/app/containers/${shortId}?host=${hostId}` : "/app/containers",
      };
    });
  }, [containers]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "k" && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setSearchOpen((open) => !open);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark");
    setIsDark(!isDark);
  };

  const handleSearchNavigate = (path: string) => {
    setSearchOpen(false);
    navigate(path);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <header className="h-14 border-b border-border bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-between px-4 shrink-0 sticky top-0 z-30">
        {/* Left: Org Switcher */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <OrganizationSwitcher hidePersonal={true} />
        </div>

        {/* Center: Search */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
          className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground bg-secondary rounded-md border border-border hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors w-72"
          aria-label="Open quick search"
        >
          <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>Search hosts, containers...</span>
          <kbd className="ml-auto text-[10px] bg-background px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-border font-mono">
            <Command className="h-2.5 w-2.5 inline" />K
          </kbd>
        </button>

        {/* Right: Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <NotificationBell />
          
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={toggleTheme}>
            {isDark ? <Sun className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Moon className="h-4 w-4" />}
          </Button>

          <div className="relative flex items-center h-8">
            <UserButton />
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <CommandDialog open={searchOpen} onOpenChange={setSearchOpen}>
        <CommandInput placeholder="Search hosts, containers, pages..." />
        <CommandList>
          <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
          <CommandGroup heading="Navigate">
            {quickSearchItems.map((item) => (
              <CommandItem
                key={item.path}
                value={`${item.label} ${item.keywords}`}
                onSelect={() => handleSearchNavigate(item.path)}
              >
                <item.Icon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                <CommandShortcut>{item.path.replace("/app", "App")}</CommandShortcut>
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>

          {hostResults.length > 0 ? (
            <CommandGroup heading="Hosts">
              {hostResults.map((host) => (
                <CommandItem key={host.id} value={host.value} onSelect={() => handleSearchNavigate(host.path)}>
                  <Server className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                    <span className="truncate">{host.label}</span>
                    <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{host.subtitle}</span>
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              ))}
            </CommandGroup>
          ) : null}

          {containerResults.length > 0 ? (
            <CommandGroup heading="Containers">
              {containerResults.map((container) => (
                <CommandItem key={container.id || container.path} value={container.value} onSelect={() => handleSearchNavigate(container.path)}>
                  <Box className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                    <span className="truncate">{container.label}</span>
                    <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{container.subtitle}</span>
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              ))}
            </CommandGroup>
          ) : null}
        </CommandList>
      </CommandDialog>
    </>
  );
}
````

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export interface ViewerEntitlements {
  plan: "free" | "pro" | "team" | "enterprise";
  subscriptionStatus: "active" | "inactive" | "past_due" | "canceled" | "paused";
  isPaidSubscriptionActive: boolean;
  isDonorPremium: boolean;
  seatLimit: number | null;
  nodeLimit: number | null;
  canUseWebhookDestinations: boolean;
  canUseSlackDestinations: boolean;
  canUseAdvancedAlerts: boolean;
  canUseTeamCollaboration: boolean;
  canUseLogs: boolean;
  canUseFileManager: boolean;
}

export interface ViewerState {

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useOrganization, useOrganizationList } from "@clerk/react";
import { useDockerHosts, useContainers } from "@/hooks/useDocker";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { buildDashboardStats } from "@/lib/dashboard-summary";
import { DashboardLoadingState } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardLoadingState";
import { DashboardNoOrganizationState } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardNoOrganizationState";
import { DashboardEmptyHostsState } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardEmptyHostsState";
import { DashboardOverview } from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardOverview";

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { organization, isLoaded: orgLoaded } = useOrganization();
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();
  const { userMemberships, isLoaded: listLoaded } = useOrganizationList({
    userMemberships: {
      infinite: true,
    },
  });

  const currentOrg = organization;
  const hasOrgs = userMemberships.count ? userMemberships.count > 0 : false;
  const orgLoading = !orgLoaded || !listLoaded;

  const { data: hosts = [], isLoading: hostsLoading } = useDockerHosts(currentOrg?.id, { filterByPlan: true });
  const {
    data: containers = [],
    isLoading: containersLoading,
    isFetching: containersFetching,
    refetch: refetchContainers,
    error: containersError,
  } = useContainers(currentOrg?.id, hosts.length > 0, 30000);

  const stats = useMemo(() => buildDashboardStats(hosts, containers), [hosts, containers]);

  if (orgLoading) {
    return <DashboardLoadingState />;
  }

  if (!hasOrgs) {
    return <DashboardNoOrganizationState />;
  }

  const isLoading = (hostsLoading || containersLoading) && hosts.length === 0;
  if (isLoading) {
    return <DashboardLoadingState />;
  }

  if (hosts.length === 0) {
    return <DashboardEmptyHostsState organizationName={currentOrg?.name} />;
  }

  return (
    <DashboardOverview
      organizationName={currentOrg?.name}
      organizationId={organization?.id ?? null}
      hosts={hosts}
      stats={stats}
      containersLoading={containersLoading}
      liveDataError={containersError instanceof Error ? containersError.message : null}
      fleetMetricsRefetchInterval={10000}
    />
  );
}

export type PlanId = "free" | "pro" | "team" | "enterprise";

export type SubscriptionStatus = "active" | "inactive" | "past_due" | "canceled" | "paused";

export interface PlanPolicy {
  seatLimit: number | null;
  nodeLimit: number | null;
  logTailLines: number;
  maxPayloadBytes: number;
  canUseWebhookDestinations: boolean;
  canUseSlackDestinations: boolean;
  canUseAdvancedAlerts: boolean;
  canUseTeamCollaboration: boolean;
  canUseLogs: boolean;
  canUseFileManager: boolean;
}

export const PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN: Record<PlanId, PlanPolicy> = {
  free: {
    seatLimit: 1,
    nodeLimit: 1,
    logTailLines: 100,
    maxPayloadBytes: 4 * 1024 * 1024, // 4 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: false,
    canUseSlackDestinations: false,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: false,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: false,
    canUseLogs: false,
    canUseFileManager: false,
  },
  pro: {
    seatLimit: 1,
    nodeLimit: 5,
    logTailLines: 1_000,
    maxPayloadBytes: 6 * 1024 * 1024, // 6 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: true,
    canUseSlackDestinations: false,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: true,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: false,
    canUseLogs: true,
    canUseFileManager: true,
  },
  team: {
    seatLimit: 10,
    nodeLimit: 25,
    logTailLines: 5_000,
    maxPayloadBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: true,
    canUseSlackDestinations: true,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: true,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: true,
    canUseLogs: true,
    canUseFileManager: true,
  },
  enterprise: {
    seatLimit: null,
    nodeLimit: null,
    logTailLines: 5_000,
    maxPayloadBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10 MB
    canUseWebhookDestinations: true,
    canUseSlackDestinations: true,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: true,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: true,
    canUseLogs: true,
    canUseFileManager: true,
  },
};

export function normalizePlan(value: string | null | undefined): PlanId {
  if (value === "pro" || value === "team" || value === "enterprise") {
    return value;
  }

  return "free";
}

export function normalizeSubscriptionStatus(value: string | null | undefined): SubscriptionStatus {
  if (value === "active" || value === "past_due" || value === "inactive" || value === "canceled" || value === "paused") {
    return value;
  }

  return "inactive";
}

export function isPaidSubscriptionStatus(status: SubscriptionStatus) {
  return status === "active" || status === "past_due";
}

export function getEffectivePlanForEnforcement({
  plan,
  subscriptionStatus,
  isDonorPremium,
}: {
  plan: string | null | undefined;
  subscriptionStatus: string | null | undefined;
  isDonorPremium?: boolean;
}): PlanId {
  const normalizedPlan = normalizePlan(plan);
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeSubscriptionStatus(subscriptionStatus);
  const isPaidPlan = normalizedPlan !== "free";
  const isPaidSubscriptionActive = isPaidPlan && isPaidSubscriptionStatus(normalizedStatus);

  if (isPaidSubscriptionActive) {
    return normalizedPlan;
  }

  if (isDonorPremium) {
    return "pro";
  }

  return "free";
}

  );
  const freePlanDetails = getPricingPlan("free");

    queryKey: ['billing-org-details', activeOrganizationId ?? organization?.id],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const orgs = await apiFetch('/organizations') as Array<{
        id: string;
        clerk_org_id?: string;

        current_period_ends_at?: string;

      return orgs.find((o) => o.id === activeOrganizationId);
    },

  });

  useEffect(() => {

    if ((plan === "pro" || plan === "team") && (!orgDetails || orgDetails.plan === "free")) {
      setSelectedPlan(plan);
      if (plan) sessionStorage.setItem("dockerdash_pending_plan", plan);
    }
  }, [searchParams, orgDetails]);

  useEffect(() => {

const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_OWNER = "MNDL-27";
const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_REPO = "docker-watchtower-dash";
const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_SOURCE_REF = "a788b98d70d3d8b9a342b32f28eef365e7ccde3d";
const WATCHTOWER_AGENT_APP_BASE_URL = "https://app.dockerdash.app";

export const CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE: WatchtowerAgentRelease = {
  version: "1.0.8",
  tag: "v1.0.8",
  sourceLabel: "Dockerdash hosted installer",
  published: false,
  releaseUrl: `${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_APP_BASE_URL}/watchtower-agent-install.sh?v=1.0.8`,
  releaseNotesUrl: `https://github.com/${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_OWNER}/${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_GITHUB_REPO}/commit/${WATCHTOWER_AGENT_SOURCE_REF}`,
  assetBaseUrl: WATCHTOWER_AGENT_APP_BASE_URL,
  installerAssetName: "watchtower-agent-install.sh",
  runtimeAssetName: "watchtower-agent.sh",
  uninstallAssetName: "watchtower-agent-uninstall.sh",
  installerSha256: "A72CF3E6C7E468D4612D1169DC6C991C1C74982D113608A9CD039E9AD82E71EF",
  runtimeSha256: "008F565C3E9E4533AE54E42C075CD1912AC1AF57737BA271E1A5E9C1A234B032",
  uninstallSha256: "449AFC5FF62742AF0FF15254827E82F120BDD17694C43500C08FAF9926D0985C",
};

function buildAtomicInstallerCommand({
  release,
  action,
  extraArgs = "",
}: {
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease;
  action: "check" | "install";
  extraArgs?: string;
}) {
  const installerUrl = buildWatchtowerAgentAssetUrl(release.installerAssetName, release);
  const baseArgs = action === "check" ? `--check --expected-version "${release.version}"` : `--expected-version "${release.version}"`;
  const actionArgs = `${baseArgs}${extraArgs ? ` ${extraArgs.trim()}` : ""}`;

  return `( set -euo pipefail
INSTALLER_URL="${installerUrl}"
EXPECTED_INSTALLER_SHA256="${release.installerSha256}"
TMP_FILE="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$TMP_FILE"' EXIT

echo "Downloading Dockerdash installer..."
curl -fsSL "$INSTALLER_URL" -o "$TMP_FILE"

echo "Verifying installer..."
ACTUAL_INSTALLER_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$TMP_FILE" | awk '{print toupper($1)}')"
if [ "$ACTUAL_INSTALLER_SHA256" != "$EXPECTED_INSTALLER_SHA256" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Installer verification failed." >&2
  echo "Expected SHA256: $EXPECTED_INSTALLER_SHA256" >&2
  echo "Actual SHA256:   $ACTUAL_INSTALLER_SHA256" >&2
  echo "Refresh Dockerdash, copy a fresh command, and try again." >&2
  exit 1
fi

chmod +x "$TMP_FILE"
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
  "$TMP_FILE" ${actionArgs}
else
  sudo "$TMP_FILE" ${actionArgs}
fi )`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand(
  _release?: WatchtowerAgentRelease,
) {
  return "sudo watchtower-agent-update --check";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(
  _release?: WatchtowerAgentRelease,
) {
  return "sudo watchtower-agent-update";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentAssetUrl(
  assetName: string,
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  return `${release.assetBaseUrl}/${assetName}?v=${encodeURIComponent(release.version)}`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentInstallCommand(
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  return buildAtomicInstallerCommand({ release, action: "install" });
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? "0.0.0.0" : "0.0.0.0";
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentModeLabel(
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode,
) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel" ? "Agent via Cloudflare Tunnel" : "Agent (Direct)";
}

function buildInstallerExtraArgs({
  connectionMode,
  bindAddress,
  dockerSocketPath,
}: {
  connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode;
  bindAddress?: string;
  dockerSocketPath?: string;
}) {
  const args: string[] = [`--connection-mode "${connectionMode}"`];

  if (bindAddress) {
    args.push(`--bind-address "${bindAddress}"`);
  }

  if (dockerSocketPath && dockerSocketPath !== "/var/run/docker.sock") {
    args.push(`--docker-socket "${dockerSocketPath}"`);
  }

  return args.join(" ");
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentEnrollmentInstallCommand({
  enrollmentToken,
  enrollUrl,
  connectionMode,
  bindAddress = getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(connectionMode),
  dockerSocketPath = "/var/run/docker.sock",
  release = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
}: WatchtowerAgentEnrollmentCommandOptions) {
  const extraArgs = [
    `--enrollment-token "${enrollmentToken}"`,
    `--enroll-url "${enrollUrl}"`,
    buildInstallerExtraArgs({ connectionMode, bindAddress, dockerSocketPath }),
  ].join(" ");

  return buildAtomicInstallerCommand({
    release,
    action: "install",
    extraArgs,
  });
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({
  agentApiKey,
  connectionMode,
  bindAddress = getWatchtowerAgentRecommendedBindAddress(connectionMode),
  dockerSocketPath = "/var/run/docker.sock",
  release = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
}: WatchtowerAgentInstallCommandOptions) {
  const extraArgs = [
    `--api-key "${agentApiKey}"`,
    buildInstallerExtraArgs({ connectionMode, bindAddress, dockerSocketPath }),
  ].join(" ");

  return buildAtomicInstallerCommand({
    release,
    action: "install",
    extraArgs,
  });
}

  return `curl -i http://127.0.0.1:9876/agent/version
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:9876/metrics -H "X-Agent-Key: ${agentApiKeyPlaceholder}"`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentLocalVerifyCommand() {
  return `sudo bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
source /etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env
curl -i "http://\${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS}:\${AGENT_PORT}/agent/version"
curl -i "http://\${AGENT_BIND_ADDRESS}:\${AGENT_PORT}/metrics" -H "X-Agent-Key: \${AGENT_API_KEY}"'`;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentSetupSummary(connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel"
    ? "Install the agent locally, keep it on localhost, then route traffic through your Cloudflare Tunnel."
    : "Install the agent on the host, expose it behind HTTPS, then finish the connection test in Dockerdash.";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentVerifySummary(connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel"
    ? "Verify the local agent first, then confirm your tunnel hostname forwards to the same local service."
    : "Verify the local agent first, then confirm your public HTTPS endpoint reaches the same local service.";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentNextStepSummary(connectionMode: WatchtowerAgentConnectionMode) {
  return connectionMode === "cloudflare_tunnel"
    ? "After the local verify passes, return to Dockerdash and click Finish setup to test the tunnel URL."
    : "After the local verify passes, return to Dockerdash and click Finish setup to test the HTTPS agent URL.";
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand(
  agentApiKeyPlaceholder = "<agent-api-key>",
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  return `${buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(release)}

${buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand(agentApiKeyPlaceholder)}`;
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus(options: {
  installedVersion?: string | null;
  capabilityGap?: boolean;
}): WatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus {
  const { installedVersion, capabilityGap = false } = options;
  if (!installedVersion) {
    return "pending";
  }
  if (isAgentVersionOutdated(installedVersion)) {
    return "update_required";
  }
  if (capabilityGap) {
    return "verification_required";
  }
  return "current";
}

export function getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatusCopy(
  status: WatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus,
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
) {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return {
        title: "Version pending",
        description: `The host is reachable, but it has not reported agent version ${release.version} yet. Run Preflight, then Update.`,
      };
    case "update_required":
      return {
        title: "Update required",
        description: `Agent is behind ${release.version}. Run Preflight, Update, then Verify.`,
      };
    case "verification_required":
      return {
        title: "Verification required",
        description: "The current agent version is installed, but uptime and per-disk metrics still need to be confirmed. Run Verify or Troubleshoot / Repair.",
      };
    case "current":
    default:
      return {
        title: "Current",
        description: `Agent ${release.version} is current and the capability checks look healthy.`,
      };
  }
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy(
  release: WatchtowerAgentRelease = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
): WatchtowerAgentUpdateCopy {
  return {
    dialogDescription: "Run the updater command directly on the host. The dashboard does not execute privileged commands remotely.",
    statusPending: "Version pending",
    statusCurrent: "Current",
    statusUpdateRequired: "Update required",
    statusVerificationRequired: "Verification required",
    sourcePrefix: "Source:",
    sourceNotice: release.published
      ? null
      : "This command currently uses the Dockerdash-hosted installer asset instead of a published GitHub release bundle.",
    preflightCommandLabel: "Preflight",
    upgradeCommandLabel: "Update",
    verifyCommandLabel: "Verify",
    repairCommandLabel: "Troubleshoot / Repair",
    verificationSummary: "Current version is installed, but the host still needs capability verification for uptime and disk details.",
    outdatedSummary: (installedVersion: string, latestVersion: string) =>
      `Agent ${installedVersion} is behind ${latestVersion}.`,
    pendingSummary: "This host has not reported an installed agent version yet.",
    supportInstructions:
      "Running the updater preserves the stored config in /etc/watchtower-agent/watchtower-agent.env. If the host still fails after Update, run Verify and inspect sudo journalctl -u watchtower-agent -n 50 before retrying Troubleshoot / Repair.",
  };
}

export function isAgentVersionOutdated(agentVersion: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!agentVersion) {
    return false;
  }

  const agentParts = agentVersion.trim().replace(/^v/, '').split('.').map(Number);
  const currentParts = CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version.replace(/^v/, '').split('.').map(Number);

  for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(agentParts.length, currentParts.length); i++) {
    const a = agentParts[i] || 0;
    const c = currentParts[i] || 0;
    if (a < c) return true;
    if (a > c) return false;
  }

  return false;
}

export function buildWatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse(
  installedAgentVersion: string | null | undefined,
  capabilityGap = false,
): WatchtowerAgentReleaseResponse {
  const agentUpdateStatus = getWatchtowerAgentUpdateStatus({
    installedVersion: installedAgentVersion,
    capabilityGap,
  });
  return {
    latest_agent_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version,
    agent_update_available: agentUpdateStatus === "update_required",
    agent_update_status: agentUpdateStatus,
    current_agent_version: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.version,
    preflight_command: buildWatchtowerAgentPreflightCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    upgrade_command: buildWatchtowerAgentUpgradeCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    verify_command: buildWatchtowerAgentVerifyCommand(),
    repair_command: buildWatchtowerAgentRepairCommand("<agent-api-key>", CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    source_label: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.sourceLabel,
    published_release: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.published,
    release_url: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.releaseUrl,
    release_notes_url: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.releaseNotesUrl,
    checksum: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE.installerSha256,
    install_command: buildWatchtowerAgentInstallCommand(CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE),
    advanced_manual_command: buildWatchtowerAgentAdvancedInstallCommand({
      agentApiKey: "<agent-api-key>",
      connectionMode: "agent",
      release: CURRENT_WATCHTOWER_AGENT_RELEASE,
    }),
    setup_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentSetupSummary("agent"),
    verify_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentVerifySummary("agent"),
    next_step_summary: buildWatchtowerAgentNextStepSummary("agent"),
    mode_label: getWatchtowerAgentModeLabel("agent"),
  };

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dockerApi } from "@/services/docker-api";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import type { DockerHost, ConnectionMode } from "@/types/database";
import { useViewerState } from "@/hooks/useViewerState";
import { normalizePlan, PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN } from "../../shared/schema/plan-policy";

// ── Shared types & helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────

/** Shared secrets shape for host mutations */
interface HostSecrets {
  agentApiKey?: string;
  cfServiceTokenId?: string;
  cfServiceTokenSecret?: string;
}

/** Shared fields for host create/update (WR-02) */
interface HostMutationBase {
  name: string;
  hostUrl: string;
  connectionMode: ConnectionMode;
  dockerSocketPath?: string;
  secrets: HostSecrets;
}

/** Build the API body from host mutation fields */
function buildHostBody(fields: HostMutationBase) {
  return {
    name: fields.name,
    host_url: fields.hostUrl,
    connection_mode: fields.connectionMode,
    docker_socket_path: fields.dockerSocketPath || '/var/run/docker.sock',
    secrets: fields.secrets,
  };
}

/** Resolve effective node limit from viewer entitlements + plan policy (WR-01) */
function resolveNodeLimit(viewer: any): number | null {
  const entitlements = viewer?.entitlements;
  // When entitlements are loaded, use nodeLimit directly — null means unlimited
  // (enterprise/dedicated plans). Only fall back to plan policy when entitlements
  // haven't loaded yet (viewer is undefined/null).
  if (entitlements) {
    return entitlements.nodeLimit; // null = unlimited, number = capped
  }
  const activePlan = normalizePlan(viewer?.active_org_effective_plan);
  return PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN[activePlan].nodeLimit;
}

/** Sort hosts by creation date (oldest first), breaking ties by ID (WR-01) */
function sortHostsByCreation(hosts: DockerHost[]): DockerHost[] {
  return [...hosts].sort((a, b) => {
    const dateA = new Date(a.created_at).getTime() || 0;
    const dateB = new Date(b.created_at).getTime() || 0;
    return dateA - dateB || a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
  });
}

/** Log query options parameter object (WR-03) */
interface ContainerLogOptions {
  tail?: number | string;
  since?: number;
  until?: number;
}

// ── Hooks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useDockerHosts(orgId?: string | null, options: { filterByPlan?: boolean } = {}) {
  const { data: viewer } = useViewerState();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['docker-hosts', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      return (await apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?orgId=${orgId}`)) as DockerHost[];
    },
    select: (hosts) => {
      if (!options.filterByPlan) return hosts;
      const nodeLimit = resolveNodeLimit(viewer);
      if (nodeLimit === null) return hosts;
      return sortHostsByCreation(hosts).slice(0, nodeLimit);
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error ? false : 15000),
  });
}

export function useAddDockerHost() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ orgId, ...fields }: { orgId: string } & HostMutationBase) => {
      const data = await apiFetch('/docker-hosts', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ organization_id: orgId, ...buildHostBody(fields) }),
      });
      return data as DockerHost;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['docker-hosts'] });
    },
  });
}

export function useDeleteDockerHost() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (hostId: string) => {
      await apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?hostId=${hostId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['docker-hosts'] });
    },
  });
}

export function useUpdateDockerHost() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ hostId, ...fields }: { hostId: string } & HostMutationBase) => {
      const data = await apiFetch(`/docker-hosts?hostId=${hostId}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: JSON.stringify(buildHostBody(fields)),
      });
      return data as DockerHost;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['docker-hosts'] });
    },
  });
}

export function useContainers(orgId?: string | null, hasHosts = true, refetchInterval: number | false = 30000) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: allowedHosts } = useDockerHosts(orgId, { filterByPlan: true });

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['containers', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const containers = await dockerApi.allContainers(orgId!);

      // Container fetch succeeded — the agent responded, so the host is alive.
      // Optimistically update host status in cache to eliminate the stale-status
      // gap between this fetch and the next hosts refetch cycle.
      queryClient.setQueryData<DockerHost[]>(['docker-hosts', orgId], (prev) => {
        if (!prev) return prev;
        const respondingHostIds = new Set<string>(
          containers
            .map((c: any) => c._hostId || c.hostId)
            .filter(Boolean),
        );
        if (respondingHostIds.size === 0) return prev;
        let changed = false;
        const updated = prev.map((host) => {
          if (respondingHostIds.has(host.id) && host.status !== 'connected') {
            changed = true;
            return { ...host, status: 'connected', last_seen_at: new Date().toISOString() };
          }
          return host;
        });
        return changed ? updated : prev;
      });

      return containers;
    },
    select: (containers) => {
      if (!allowedHosts) return containers;
      const allowedIds = new Set(allowedHosts.map(h => h.id));
      return containers.filter(c => c.hostId ? allowedIds.has(c.hostId) : allowedIds.has(c._hostId));
    },
    enabled: !!orgId && hasHosts,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval),
  });
}

export function useAllContainerStats(orgId?: string | null, hasHosts = true, refetchInterval: number | false = 15000) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['all-container-stats', orgId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.allContainerStats(orgId!),
    enabled: !!orgId && hasHosts,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval),
  });
}

export function useHostContainers(hostId?: string | null, refetchInterval: number | false = 15000) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['host-containers', hostId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.listContainers(hostId!),
    enabled: !!hostId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval: (query) => (query.state.error || refetchInterval === false ? false : refetchInterval),
  });
}

export function useContainerInspect(hostId?: string | null, containerId?: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['container-inspect', hostId, containerId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.inspectContainer(hostId!, containerId!),
    enabled: !!hostId && !!containerId,
  });
}

export function useContainerStats(
  hostId?: string | null,
  containerId?: string | null,
  refetchInterval: number | false = 10000,
) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['container-stats', hostId, containerId],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.containerStats(hostId!, containerId!),
    enabled: !!hostId && !!containerId,
    retry: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    refetchInterval,
  });
}

export function useContainerLogs(
  hostId?: string | null,
  containerId?: string | null,
  options: ContainerLogOptions = {},
) {
  const { tail = 200, since, until } = options;
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['container-logs', hostId, containerId, tail, since, until],
    queryFn: () => dockerApi.containerLogs(hostId!, containerId!, tail, since, until),
    enabled: !!hostId && !!containerId,
  });
}

````typescript
import { sql } from "./db.mjs";
import { ensureAdminSchema } from "./ensure-admin-schema.mjs";
import { isDonorPremiumActive } from "./donor-billing.mjs";
import {
  PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN,
  getEffectivePlanForEnforcement,
  normalizePlan,
  normalizeSubscriptionStatus,
  isPaidSubscriptionStatus,
  type PlanId,
  type SubscriptionStatus,
} from "../../../shared/schema/plan-policy.ts";

function requiresPlatformApproval() {
  const value = (process.env.REQUIRE_PLATFORM_APPROVALS || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  return value === "1" || value === "true" || value === "yes";
}

export interface UserAccessControl {
  is_suspended: boolean;
  is_hard_disabled: boolean;
  suspension_reason: string | null;
  internal_notes: string | null;
}

export interface OrganizationAccessControl {
  is_locked: boolean;
  lock_reason: string | null;
  plan_override: string | null;
  subscription_status_override: string | null;
  current_period_ends_at_override: string | null;
  cancel_at_period_end_override: boolean | null;
}

export interface DockerHostAdminControl {
  is_quarantined: boolean;
  quarantine_reason: string | null;
  needs_reconnect: boolean;
}

export interface OrganizationEntitlements {
  plan: PlanId;
  effectivePlan: PlanId;
  subscriptionStatus: SubscriptionStatus;
  isPaidSubscriptionActive: boolean;
  isDonorPremium: boolean;
  seatLimit: number | null;
  nodeLimit: number | null;
  logTailLines: number;
  maxPayloadBytes: number;
  canUseWebhookDestinations: boolean;
  canUseSlackDestinations: boolean;
  canUseAdvancedAlerts: boolean;
  canUseTeamCollaboration: boolean;
  canUseLogs: boolean;
  canUseFileManager: boolean;
}

type OrganizationFeature =
  | "webhook_destinations"
  | "slack_destinations"
  | "advanced_alerts"
  | "team_collaboration"
  | "logs"
  | "file_manager";

const HOST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_ERROR =
  "Host is inactive because your current plan limit has been exceeded. Remove extra hosts or upgrade to re-enable this host.";

/**
 * Compute entitlements purely from the organization's plan.
 * The plan is the absolute source of truth — isPlatformAdmin is accepted
 * for signature compatibility but intentionally ignored here.
 * Admin privileges only bypass user-level access checks (suspension,
 * org locks, host quarantine) elsewhere in this module; they never
 * inflate plan capacity or unlock paid features.
 */
export function computeOrganizationEntitlements({
  plan,
  subscriptionStatus,
  isDonorPremium,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  plan: string | null | undefined;
  subscriptionStatus: string | null | undefined;
  isDonorPremium: boolean;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}): OrganizationEntitlements {
  const normalizedPlan = normalizePlan(plan);
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeSubscriptionStatus(subscriptionStatus);

  if (isPlatformAdmin) {
    return {
      plan: normalizedPlan,
      effectivePlan: normalizedPlan,
      subscriptionStatus: normalizedStatus,
      isPaidSubscriptionActive: true,
      isDonorPremium,
      seatLimit: null,
      nodeLimit: null,
      logTailLines: 5000,
      maxPayloadBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
      canUseWebhookDestinations: true,
      canUseSlackDestinations: true,
      canUseAdvancedAlerts: true,
      canUseTeamCollaboration: true,
      canUseLogs: true,
      canUseFileManager: true,
    };
  }

  const isPaidPlan = normalizedPlan !== "free";
  const isPaidSubscriptionActive = isPaidPlan && isPaidSubscriptionStatus(normalizedStatus);
  const effectivePlan = getEffectivePlanForEnforcement({
    plan: normalizedPlan,
    subscriptionStatus: normalizedStatus,
    isDonorPremium,
  });
  const paidTierPolicy = PLAN_POLICY_BY_PLAN[effectivePlan];

  return {
    plan: normalizedPlan,
    effectivePlan,
    subscriptionStatus: normalizedStatus,
    isPaidSubscriptionActive,
    isDonorPremium,
    seatLimit: paidTierPolicy.seatLimit,
    nodeLimit: paidTierPolicy.nodeLimit,
    logTailLines: paidTierPolicy.logTailLines,
    maxPayloadBytes: paidTierPolicy.maxPayloadBytes,
    canUseWebhookDestinations: paidTierPolicy.canUseWebhookDestinations,
    canUseSlackDestinations: paidTierPolicy.canUseSlackDestinations,
    canUseAdvancedAlerts: paidTierPolicy.canUseAdvancedAlerts || isDonorPremium,
    canUseTeamCollaboration: paidTierPolicy.canUseTeamCollaboration,
    canUseLogs: paidTierPolicy.canUseLogs || isDonorPremium,
    canUseFileManager: paidTierPolicy.canUseFileManager,
  };
}

export async function resolveOrganizationEntitlements({
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}): Promise<OrganizationEntitlements> {
  await ensureAdminSchema();

  const [organization] = await sql<
    Array<{
      plan: string | null;
      subscription_status: string | null;
    }>
  >`
    SELECT plan, subscription_status
    FROM public.organizations
    WHERE id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  if (!organization) {
    throw new Error("Organization not found");
  }

  const control = await getOrganizationAccessControl(organizationId);

  const { active: isDonorPremium } = await isDonorPremiumActive(organizationId);

  return computeOrganizationEntitlements({
    plan: control.plan_override ?? organization.plan,
    subscriptionStatus: control.subscription_status_override ?? organization.subscription_status,
    isDonorPremium,
    isPlatformAdmin,
  });
}

export async function assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
  feature,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
  feature: OrganizationFeature;
}) {
  const entitlements = await resolveOrganizationEntitlements({ organizationId, isPlatformAdmin });

  const allowedByFeature: Record<OrganizationFeature, boolean> = {
    webhook_destinations: entitlements.canUseWebhookDestinations,
    slack_destinations: entitlements.canUseSlackDestinations,
    advanced_alerts: entitlements.canUseAdvancedAlerts,
    team_collaboration: entitlements.canUseTeamCollaboration,
    logs: entitlements.canUseLogs,
    file_manager: entitlements.canUseFileManager,
  };

  if (allowedByFeature[feature]) {
    return entitlements;
  }

  const messages: Record<OrganizationFeature, string> = {
    webhook_destinations: "Webhook destinations require an Individual, Business, or Dedicated subscription.",
    slack_destinations: "Slack destinations require a Business or Dedicated subscription.",
    advanced_alerts: "Advanced Alert Rules require an Individual, Business, or Dedicated subscription.",
    team_collaboration: "Team collaboration requires a Business or Dedicated subscription.",
    logs: "Container logs require an Individual, Business, or Dedicated subscription.",
    file_manager: "The File Manager requires an Individual, Business, or Dedicated subscription.",
  };

  throw new Error(messages[feature]);
}

export async function assertOrganizationNodeCapacityAvailable({
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}) {
  const entitlements = await resolveOrganizationEntitlements({ organizationId, isPlatformAdmin });
  if (entitlements.nodeLimit === null) {
    return entitlements;
  }

  const [{ count }] = await sql<Array<{ count: string }>>`
    SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS count
    FROM public.docker_hosts
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId}
  `;

  const nodeCount = Number.parseInt(count ?? "0", 10);
  if (Number.isFinite(nodeCount) && nodeCount < entitlements.nodeLimit) {
    return entitlements;
  }

  throw new Error(`This plan allows up to ${entitlements.nodeLimit} connected host(s). Upgrade to add more hosts.`);
}

export async function enforceOrganizationNodeLimit({
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}) {
  const entitlements = await resolveOrganizationEntitlements({ organizationId, isPlatformAdmin });

  const hosts = await sql<Array<{ id: string }>>`
    SELECT id
    FROM public.docker_hosts
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId}
    ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
  `;

  if (entitlements.nodeLimit === null) {
    return {
      entitlements,
      allowedHostIds: hosts.map((host) => host.id),
      blockedHostIds: [] as string[],
    };
  }

  const allowedHostIds = hosts.slice(0, entitlements.nodeLimit).map((host) => host.id);
  const blockedHostIds = hosts.slice(entitlements.nodeLimit).map((host) => host.id);

  if (blockedHostIds.length > 0) {
    await sql`
      UPDATE public.docker_hosts
      SET
        status = 'disconnected',
        last_error = ${HOST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_ERROR},
        consecutive_failures = GREATEST(COALESCE(consecutive_failures, 0), 1)
      WHERE id = ANY(${blockedHostIds})
    `;
  }

  if (allowedHostIds.length > 0) {
    await sql`
      UPDATE public.docker_hosts
      SET
        last_error = NULL,
        consecutive_failures = 0
      WHERE id = ANY(${allowedHostIds})
        AND last_error = ${HOST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_ERROR}
    `;
  }

  return {
    entitlements,
    allowedHostIds,
    blockedHostIds,
  };
}

export async function assertOrganizationSeatCapacityAvailable({
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}) {
  const entitlements = await resolveOrganizationEntitlements({ organizationId, isPlatformAdmin });
  if (entitlements.seatLimit === null) {
    return entitlements;
  }

  const [{ count }] = await sql<Array<{ count: string }>>`
    SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS count
    FROM public.organization_members
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId}
  `;

  const memberCount = Number.parseInt(count ?? "0", 10);
  if (Number.isFinite(memberCount) && memberCount < entitlements.seatLimit) {
    return entitlements;
  }

  throw new Error(`This plan allows up to ${entitlements.seatLimit} seat(s). Upgrade for team access.`);
}

export async function getUserAccessControl(userId: string): Promise<UserAccessControl> {
  await ensureAdminSchema();
  const rows = await sql<UserAccessControl[]>`
    SELECT
      is_suspended,
      is_hard_disabled,
      suspension_reason,
      internal_notes
    FROM public.user_access_controls
    WHERE user_id = ${userId}
  `;

  return rows[0] ?? {
    is_suspended: false,
    is_hard_disabled: false,
    suspension_reason: null,
    internal_notes: null,
  };
}

export async function getOrganizationAccessControl(organizationId: string): Promise<OrganizationAccessControl> {
  await ensureAdminSchema();
  const rows = await sql<OrganizationAccessControl[]>`
    SELECT
      is_locked,
      lock_reason,
      plan_override,
      subscription_status_override,
      current_period_ends_at_override::text,
      cancel_at_period_end_override
    FROM public.organization_access_controls
    WHERE organization_id = ${organizationId}
  `;

  return rows[0] ?? {
    is_locked: false,
    lock_reason: null,
    plan_override: null,
    subscription_status_override: null,
    current_period_ends_at_override: null,
    cancel_at_period_end_override: null,
  };
}

export async function getDockerHostAdminControl(hostId: string): Promise<DockerHostAdminControl> {
  await ensureAdminSchema();
  const rows = await sql<DockerHostAdminControl[]>`
    SELECT
      is_quarantined,
      quarantine_reason,
      needs_reconnect
    FROM public.docker_host_admin_controls
    WHERE host_id = ${hostId}
  `;

  return rows[0] ?? {
    is_quarantined: false,
    quarantine_reason: null,
    needs_reconnect: false,
  };
}

export async function isUserBannedFromOrganization(userId: string, organizationId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  await ensureAdminSchema();
  const rows = await sql`
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.organization_user_bans
    WHERE user_id = ${userId} AND organization_id = ${organizationId}
    LIMIT 1
  `;

  return rows.length > 0;
}

export async function assertTenantAccessAllowed({
  userId,
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
  isApproved,
}: {
  userId: string;
  organizationId?: string | null;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
  isApproved: boolean;
}) {
  await ensureAdminSchema();

  if (!isPlatformAdmin && requiresPlatformApproval() && !isApproved) {
    throw new Error("Your account is awaiting platform approval.");
  }

  if (isPlatformAdmin) return;

  const userControl = await getUserAccessControl(userId);
  if (userControl.is_hard_disabled) {
    throw new Error("Your account has been disabled by a platform administrator.");
  }

  if (userControl.is_suspended) {
    throw new Error(userControl.suspension_reason || "Your account is suspended.");
  }

  if (organizationId) {
    const banned = await isUserBannedFromOrganization(userId, organizationId);
    if (banned) {
      throw new Error("You no longer have access to the selected organization.");
    }
  }
}

export async function assertOrganizationWriteAllowed({
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}) {
  await ensureAdminSchema();
  if (isPlatformAdmin) return;

  const control = await getOrganizationAccessControl(organizationId);
  if (control.is_locked) {
    throw new Error(control.lock_reason || "This organization is locked by platform admin.");
  }
}

export async function assertHostProxyAllowed({
  hostId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  hostId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}) {
  await ensureAdminSchema();
  if (isPlatformAdmin) return;

  const control = await getDockerHostAdminControl(hostId);
  if (control.is_quarantined) {
    throw new Error(control.quarantine_reason || "This host is quarantined by platform admin.");
  }
}

export async function assertAdvancedAlertsAccessAllowed({
  organizationId,
  isPlatformAdmin,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
}) {
  await assertOrganizationFeatureAllowed({
    organizationId,
    isPlatformAdmin,
    feature: "advanced_alerts",
  });
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
